**Process Overview\***
 Global Markets Global Valuation Group (GVG) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for providing valuation and independent price verification methodology support to Business Finance \& Control (BFC) teams for execution of IPV, calculation of valuation adjustments and prudential valuation adjustments. The team is also responsible for reporting and governance across all valuation processes. Additionally, the team works on a number of regulatory deliverables related to valuations and drives the overall valuation control automation agenda in partnership with Technology and other stakeholders.
   

  

 The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, business finance controllers, market risk, quantitative risk and technology teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 We are looking to hire a seasoned leader in the Global Valuations Group to project manage number of regulatory deliverables for GM \& GCIB Finance organization. The person will be responsible for planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases. They will be required to manage stakeholders from different divisions within the bank to ensure that right responsibilities are allocated to right teams and the teams deliver on those in a timely fashion. They will be helping the team put together regulatory submissions, will track progress and milestones, escalate risks as needed and facilitate issue resolution.
   

  

 Given this role will be part of the valuations group and will involve interactions with senior management of technical functions, we need the person to have a deep understanding of all regulatory guidelines (like CCAR stress testing, Prudential Valuation guidelines from a PRA and ECB perspective, ICAAP etc.). Additionally, they should also have a good knowledge of financial products and their valuations. Ideally, this role will best suit a person who has already been managing such technical regulatory projects for multiple years.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases
* Stakeholder management including ensuring adequate ownership and responsibilities of the different parties involved
* End to end project management of regulatory deliverables including putting together submissions, tracking of progress and milestone, escalation of risks and issues and facilitating issue resolution
* Providing upward communication on project progress to CFO senior leadership
* Ensuring high quality outputs from SME team by setting standards and providing guidance on expectations
* Interpret regulatory changes and engage with CFO teams to perform impact assessments and drive change so that we are compliant with the new changes
* Put together technical presentations in partnership with CFO teams
* Drive the operational excellence agenda, ensuring process standardization, controls maturity, and continuous improvement across business‑critical activities.
* Drive valuation related projects such as market data assessment for various asset classes, back\-testing of results as per regulatory guidelines, drive intra\-month prices testing of results etc.
* Manage the overall Model governance process for valuation related models
* Identify, document, and assess AI opportunities; collaborate with Technology, FLUs, and SMEs to evaluate feasibility, ROI, risk considerations, and operational impact.
* Ensure adherence to AI use‑case governance, including risk alignment, model‑development documentation, compliance with enterprise AI policies, and responsible‑AI practices.
* Govern technology and change portfolios, ensuring transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery accountability.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate/ Postgraduate in Finance/Management from Tier I/II institute
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 12–18 years of relevant experience in finance domain related to project management of quantitative/technical regulatory projects or Valuations / Valuation Governance
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Good understanding of regulatory landscape (Prudential valuation guidelines, ICAAP, CCAR, Valuation principles)
* Ability to interpret regulatory guidelines (existing and forthcoming) and identify gaps/perform impact assessments
* Strong project management skills with prior experience of running end to end project management for regulatory engagements ideally for large banks
* Strong organization and structured thinking
* Strong communication skills to be able to present to a highly technical and senior audience
* Strong written communication skills and dashboarding skills
* Good knowledge of global markets products along with basic risk and valuation principles
* Attention to details and rigor to meet expectations or internal audit and supervisor requirements.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines
* Strong technology skills (understanding of automation tools such as Alteryx) and understanding of AI tools to enable identification and implementation of OPEX opportunities
* Experience working with Technology partners on architecture discussions, feasibility assessments, and solution design


**Additional Skills**
* Prior experience leading engagement with model governance and awareness of model governance life cycle
* Hands on experience with coding (ex: Python)
* Hands on experience in managing AI projects at large scale
* Strong understanding of Market risk and valuation principles.
* Prior experience performing market data assessment and working with vendors on assessing quality of data

 About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

 Position Overview:
   

  

 The PUD Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end operations of one or more Pickup \& Delivery Units (PUDs), ensuring safe, timely and cost\-effective execution of first\-mile pickup, last\-mile delivery and customer service operations. The role is accountable for operational performance, fleet readiness, workforce productivity, customer satisfaction and service quality across the assigned locations.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regional PUD Manager, the incumbent leads frontline operational teams, coordinates with cross\-functional stakeholders and transport partners, and ensures seamless integration of pickup, delivery and hub operations. The role drives operational discipline, revenue assurance, people capability and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with organisational standards and customer commitments.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 To lead and manage the operations of assigned Pickup \& Delivery Units by delivering operational excellence, customer service, workforce productivity, fleet optimisation and revenue assurance while ensuring safe, compliant and profitable first\-mile and last\-mile operations aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 PUD Operations Leadership
   

  

  

* Lead the overall operations of the assigned PUD(s), ensuring consistent achievement of operational, service and business objectives.
* Drive operational planning and execution across pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
* Ensure adherence to operational workflows, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and service commitments.
* Monitor daily operational performance and implement timely corrective actions to address service gaps.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, fleet and infrastructure to support business requirements.


 Pickup \& Delivery Operations
   

  

  

* Manage first\-mile pickup and last\-mile delivery operations to achieve committed service levels and customer expectations.
* Monitor daily pickup schedules, delivery performance and route execution to maximise operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely processing, dispatch and movement of shipments through seamless coordination with hubs and service centres.
* Drive reduction in missed pickups, delivery exceptions, return\-to\-origin (RTO) cases and operational delays.
* Monitor shipment visibility and ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.


 Customer Service \& Service Quality
   

  

  

* Drive customer service excellence by ensuring adherence to pickup and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Customer Service teams to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and service issues.
* Monitor customer feedback, operational performance and Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends to improve customer experience.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational issues impacting customers.
* Support implementation of initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, service reliability and operational quality.


 Fleet, Route \& Resource Management
   

  

  

* Ensure optimum deployment and utilisation of fleet resources to support daily pickup and delivery operations.
* Coordinate with Fleet Operations teams and transport partners to ensure vehicle availability and route optimisation.
* Monitor route productivity, vehicle utilisation and operational efficiency across assigned PUDs.

description:
**Brief Description**
 Head of Partner Performance Management
   

  

**Pune, India**
**Reporting to: Chief Operating Officer**
**Salary: 38,00,000 – 45,00,000 per annum \+ benefits**
 Lead a Global Partner Engineering Workforce
   

  

 ESP Global Services is a leading provider of End User Computing, Field Engineering and Infrastructure Support services to enterprise customers across the globe.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Head of Partner Performance Management to lead the operational performance of our global partner engineering network, ensuring that hundreds of third\-party engineers consistently deliver exceptional service to our customers.
   

  

**This is not a traditional procurement or vendor management role.**
 You will be responsible for ensuring that partner\-employed engineers perform as an extension of ESP's own workforce, meeting customer expectations, contractual service levels and commercial objectives across multiple international regions.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Success, Service Delivery, Procurement and Executive Leadership, you will drive accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement across our global partner ecosystem.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 You will lead the governance and operational performance of approximately 200 third\-party engineers delivering:
   

  

* End User Computing (EUC)
* Field Engineering
* Deskside Support
* Infrastructure Support
* Engineer Augmentation Services
* Smart Hands and Technical Onsite Services


 Your focus is ensuring the right engineers are deployed, performing effectively, meeting service commitments and representing ESP professionally within customer environments.
   

  

 Success will be measured by operational performance, customer satisfaction, partner accountability and commercial performance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the operational performance of ESP's global partner\-delivered engineering workforce.
* Lead the governance framework across multiple engineering partners and suppliers.
* Ensure partner engineers consistently achieve agreed SLAs, KPIs and customer service standards.
* Drive engineer utilisation, workforce planning, attendance, availability and capacity management.
* Manage operational escalations relating to engineer performance, service delivery and customer experience.
* Hold partners accountable through structured governance, service reviews, corrective action plans and Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Drive continuous improvement across partner performance, engineer quality and operational consistency.
* Work closely with Service Delivery, Customer Success and Operations teams to ensure customer commitments are consistently achieved.
* Own the commercial performance of partner\-delivered services, including budgets, forecasting, billing accuracy and cost optimisation.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, tooling and process standardisation.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 This role will suit someone who has managed large operational teams of third\-party engineers delivering IT support services.
   

  

**You Will Bring** 
  

  

* 10\+ years' experience leading partner\-delivered IT service operations, supplier performance or field engineering organisations.
* Demonstrable experience managing third\-party engineers delivering End User Computing, Infrastructure Support, Field Services or Engineer Augmentation.
* Experience managing multiple global partner organisations simultaneously.
* Proven success improving partner operational performance through structured governance and performance management.
* Strong experience managing:
+ SLA and KPI performance
+ Workforce planning and engineer utilisation
+ Operational reporting and analytics
+ Service governance
+ Customer escalations
+ Supplier accountability

* Commercial experience managing budgets, forecasting, supplier costs and financial performance.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across Operations, Service Delivery, Customer Success and Procurement.
* Strong analytical capability with the confidence to challenge poor performance using operational data.


**Essential Experience**
**We are particularly interested in candidates who have operational responsibility for partner\-employed engineers delivering services such as:**
* End User Computing (EUC)
* Field Engineering
* Desktop Support
* Infrastructure Support
* Smart Hands
* IMAC Services
* Break/Fix Services
* Data Centre Support
* Managed Services


 Candidates whose experience is primarily within procurement, sourcing, contract administration or general vendor management, without operational accountability for technical service delivery, are unlikely to be suitable for this role.
   

  

 Why Join ESP?
   

  

 This is a highly visible leadership role reporting directly to the COO.
   

  

 You will shape how ESP manages and develops a global network of engineering partners supporting enterprise customers across multiple continents. Your work will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational excellence, service quality and commercial performance.
   

  

 If you enjoy leading through influence, improving operational performance, holding partners accountable and building world\-class engineering services, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

 Before You Apply
   

  

**To help us identify the right experience, please ensure your CV clearly demonstrates:**
* The number of third\-party engineers you have managed.
* The types of IT support services those engineers delivered.
* The countries or regions you were responsible for.
* Examples of how you improved partner performance or service delivery.
* The operational KPIs, SLAs or commercial outcomes you were accountable for.

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. **What would you do?** 
 You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data/reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions. Record to Report (RTR) is the end\-to\-end finance and accounting process that covers the collection, processing, and reporting of financial data to provide a complete and accurate picture of business performance. It includes general ledger accounting, journal entry processing, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, fixed assets management, financial close management, and statutory and management reporting. The goal is to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Effective RTR operations underpin strong financial controls and support informed business decision\-making. Keywords include: (“General Ledger”, “Journal Entry”, “Account Reconciliation”, “Financial Close”, “Intercompany Accounting”, “Fixed Assets”, “Financial Reporting”, “Statutory Reporting”, “US GAAP”, “IFRS”) Design, implement, manage and support record to report and general ledger accounting activities for an organization by applying the relevant processes, policies and applications.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Education :Bcom, M Com, Chartered Accountant

* Corporate planning \& strategic planning with focus on financial reporting integrity, close cycle efficiency, and controllership excellence
* Risk management covering financial reporting risk, internal controls, audit exposure, and regulatory compliance
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders including controllership, FP\&A, internal audit, external auditors, and senior business leadership

* Well\-versed in process controls, including a strong understanding and practical experience with SOX controls related to financial close, journal entries, and account reconciliations
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards including GAAP and/or IFRS, with the ability to interpret and apply standards to complex business transactions
* Experience overseeing intercompany accounting, fixed assets accounting, and lease accounting (ASC 842 / IFRS 16\) is highly desirable
* Ability to govern the financial close calendar, drive on\-time delivery of period\-end close activities, and ensure quality of balance sheet reconciliations
* Familiarity with RTR technology platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud Financials, BlackLine, or Cadency (Trintech) is highly preferred

* Engage with senior client stakeholders, internal and external auditors on accounting and reporting matters, providing technical guidance and leading audit readiness and support activities
* The person manages large to medium sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture
* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

 The role will be responsible for ensuring project delivery, schedule adherence, cost control, quality, safety, contractual compliance and profitability , while leading multiple project teams and driving operational excellence.

Ensure adherence to contractual scope, approved schedules, budgets, quality standards and profitability targets. Lead Project Managers, Construction, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, Commercial and other project functions. Drive manpower planning, resource allocation, equipment deployment and subcontractor management. Identify project risks, bottlenecks and deviations and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions. Support contract administration, variation orders, claims, commercial negotiations and dispute resolution. Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, statutory approvals, HSE norms, quality systems and applicable industry standards. Act as the senior management interface with key clients, consultants, government authorities, JV partners and other stakeholders. Lead project review meetings, progress presentations and critical issue/escalation management. Drive client satisfaction, successful project completion and opportunities for repeat business. Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites and ensure zero-tolerance towards major HSE violations. Ensure effective implementation of QA/QC systems, audits, inspections and quality improvement initiatives. Provide regular project performance reports and strategic recommendations to senior management. Support pre-bid reviews, technical evaluation, project feasibility, execution strategy and resource planning . Drive operational excellence, standardisation, process improvement and lessons-learned initiatives. 
 Education BE / BTech in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering Post-Graduation / MBA in Project Management will be an added advantage. 
 Experience 1520 years of overall experience in Infrastructure / EPC project execution. Strong experience in Power Transmission & Distribution projects . Proven exposure to Metro / Railway infrastructure projects . Experience in Renewable Energy, Solar, Water & Wastewater and BESS projects will be an added advantage. Demonstrated experience in managing multiple large-scale, high-value EPC projects . Experience in an HO-based Project Operations / Business Operations leadership role is preferred. Candidates should have strong experience in managing large project teams and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 Technical & Leadership Competencies Strong understanding of EPC, Turnkey and LSTK project execution . Strong knowledge of project planning, project controls, cost management and resource planning. Strong understanding of contracts, claims, variations and commercial aspects of EPC projects. Excellent leadership, people management and stakeholder management skills. Strong decision-making, negotiation and problem-solving abilities. Knowledge of statutory approvals, HSE requirements, quality systems, codes and industry standards. Strong analytical ability with experience in MIS, project dashboards and performance reviews . Ability to manage project risks, escalations and critical delivery situations. 
 Preferred Background Candidates from reputed Infrastructure EPC / Engineering & Construction companies . Experience handling high-value and complex infrastructure projects . Proven track record of successful project delivery, profitability and client management. Exposure to HO-based operational leadership and strategic project management . Candidates with strong experience across Power T&D and Metro/Railway projects will be preferred. 
 Key Performance Areas Project delivery within approved time, cost, quality and safety parameters Project profitability and cost optimisation Cash flow, billing and collection performance Client satisfaction and stakeholder management Resource and subcontractor productivity HSE and quality compliance Risk mitigation and timely resolution of project issues Successful commissioning and handover Operational excellence and continuous improvement

title: Production Operations Manager
description:
**Operations \& Production Manager – Events \& Retail
 



  





 Company: Nudge Asia
 



 Location: Delhi NCR
 



 Function: Operations \& Production
 



 Industry: Experiential \| Events \| Retail \| Activations
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 Nudge Asia is looking for a hands\-on Operations \& Production Manager who can take an idea from a design file to flawless on\-ground execution.
 



  





 You will manage end\-to\-end production and operations across events, brand activations, retail installations, pop\-ups, exhibitions and experiential projects across India.
 



  





 What You’ll Own
 



  





 \* End\-to\-End Production: From recce and measurements to fabrication, installation, execution and dismantling.
 



 \* Fabrication: Strong understanding of carpentry, metal, acrylic, printing, signage, lighting, AV, materials and finishes.
 



 \* Events \& Activations: Manage venues, vendors, manpower, logistics, technical requirements and complete on\-ground execution.
 



 \* Retail Production: Execute POSM, kiosks, shop\-in\-shops, displays, pop\-ups, window displays and permanent/semi\-permanent installations.
 



 \* Vendor Management: Source, negotiate and manage fabricators, printers, AV teams, logistics partners and specialist vendors across India.
 



 \* BOQs \& Costing: Prepare BOQs, vendor comparisons, production estimates and project budgets while constantly finding smarter ways to optimise costs.
 



 \* Quality Control: Ensure everything produced matches approved designs, dimensions, materials and finishing standards.
 



 \* Timelines: Build production schedules and ensure every deadline is met — including those very real last\-minute event deadlines.
 



 \* Team Management: Lead internal operations teams, vendors, technicians and on\-ground manpower across simultaneous projects.
 



 \* Problem Solving: Anticipate production challenges and find solutions quickly without compromising the creative idea.
 



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



  





 \* 5–8\+ years of relevant experience in event production, experiential agencies, retail production or fabrication.
 



 \* Strong technical understanding of how things are actually built, not just how projects are coordinated.
 



 \* Experience handling both large\-format events and scalable retail rollouts.
 



 \* Ability to understand 2D drawings, 3D renders, technical drawings and BOQs.
 



 \* Strong vendor network across Delhi NCR and preferably other key Indian cities.
 



 \* Excellent negotiation, budgeting and project\-management skills.
 



 \* Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
 



 \* Willing to travel across India and work on\-site when required.
 



  





 The Nudge Person
 



  





 We need someone who can be in a client meeting in the morning, at the fabrication unit in the afternoon and at an event site at midnight — and be equally comfortable at all three.
 



  





 If we can imagine it, you should know how we’re going to build it.
 



  





 Think fast. Build smart. Execute better.**

title: Procurement Logistics Manager
description:
**About Humyn Labs** 




 Humyn Labs builds the intelligence layer for physical\-world AI — systems that perceive, reason, and act in real environments. Our work sits at the intersection of egocentric video understanding, embodied AI, robotics perception, and voice\-driven interaction. We move fast, obsess over data quality, and ship at scale.
 



  





 Humyn Labs converts human action \- across sound, sight, movement, and touch \- into high\-quality multi\-modal data signals for physical AI. Operating across 20\+ countries in India, southeast Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East: the real\-world environments where physical AI deploys, not the labs where it is built.
 



  





 Our data isn't just collected; it's evaluated, defended, and production\-ready. Because before AI can be trusted, its training data must be.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Procurement \& Logistics Manager to own hardware procurement, logistics, base setup, and troubleshooting across our operations. This role is central to keeping bases equipped and running \- from sourcing the right electronics/hardware components (including from China) to ensuring smooth logistics between BLR and base locations. You'll work very closely with the Data Upload Pod, since the Data Upload Center functions as the Base HQ.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end procurement of hardware/electronics components required for base setup and operations (cameras, SD cards, storage devices, networking equipment, etc.)
* Build and maintain a strong sourcing network in China/Other location for electronics procurement \- identifying reliable suppliers/manufacturers, negotiating pricing, and managing vendor relationships
* Manage logistics and shipment coordination between BLR and base sites \- ensuring hardware reaches bases on time, in good condition, and within budget
* Lead new base setup from a hardware/logistics standpoint \- procurement planning, equipment installation coordination, and readiness checks
* Provide general troubleshooting support for hardware/logistics issues across bases (damaged equipment, shipment delays, stock shortages)
* Work closely with the Data Upload Pod to align hardware availability (SD cards, storage, upload equipment) with 24x7 upload operations and T\+1 TAT requirements
* Maintain inventory tracking, reorder points, and vendor documentation (invoices,import/customs paperwork, warranties)
* Evaluate cost\-saving opportunities in sourcing and logistics without compromising quality or timelines
* Coordinate customs/import processes for hardware sourced internationally



  





**Requirements** 



* 3–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, or logistics — ideally with hands\-on electronics/hardware sourcing experience
* Strong existing network of suppliers/vendors in China for electronics procurement
* Proficiency in Mandarin (spoken/written) and comfort communicating via WeChat is a strong plus \- this will directly help in vendor negotiation and relationship management
* Sharp negotiation skills \- able to get competitive pricing and reliable terms from suppliers
* Strong problem\-solving mindset \- comfortable handling last\-minute logistics issues, shipment delays, or on\-ground troubleshooting
* Understanding of import/export processes, customs documentation, and cross\-border shipping (China–India preferred)
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with Ops and Data Upload teams, balancing speed with cost\-efficiency
* Comfortable with occasional travel to base sites for setup/troubleshooting



  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior experience procuring for AI/robotics/autonomous systems, IoT devices, or camera/sensor hardware
* Experience setting up new operational bases/hubs from a hardware and infrastructure standpoint
* Existing relationships with electronics manufacturers/trading companies in Shenzhen or other major China hubs

* **Transition and Stabilization:** 
 Lead knowledge transfer, process validation, SOP and desktop procedure creation, payroll calendar design, control definition, parallel runs, readiness reviews, cutover, go\-live and stabilization for the new account.
* **Client and Stakeholder Management:** 
 Act as the primary tower contact for client Payroll, HR, Finance, Tax, Treasury, Benefits, HRIS and other connected teams; manage governance, escalations, dependencies, decisions and action closure.
* **Vendor and Third\-Party Management:** 
 Govern payroll providers and other delivery partners against defined outcomes, calendars, controls, issue resolution and escalation protocols.
* **People Leadership:** 
 Lead, coach and develop managers, team leads and payroll specialists; establish role clarity, skill matrices, cross\-training, succession plans and a culture of ownership, confidentiality, accuracy and customer focus.
* **Technology and Data Governance:** 
 Oversee payroll processing across relevant payroll, HRIS, time, case management and reporting platforms; govern interfaces, data validations, reconciliations, mass uploads, defects and change impacts.
* **Transformation and Improvement:** 
 Build an improvement roadmap covering global standardization, process simplification, automation, analytics, knowledge management, self\-service and defect elimination.
* **Governance and Reporting:** 
 Provide executive\-ready reporting on payroll status, service performance, accuracy, timeliness, backlog, risks, controls, capacity, customer experience, improvements and decisions required.



**Required Experience and Competencies** 



* 12 to 18 years of overall experience, with substantial leadership experience in payroll operations, HR shared services, outsourcing or HRO delivery.
* Proven ownership of end\-to\-end payroll operations across multiple countries, including complex payroll calendars, controls, reconciliations, issue management and governance.
* Demonstrated experience managing large or multi\-layered teams, client stakeholders, third\-party payroll providers, service performance and business\-critical escalations.
* Strong understanding of payroll inputs and outputs, gross\-to\-net processing, payroll accounting interfaces, payments coordination, statutory deliverables, year\-end or period\-end activities and employee query dependencies.
* Experience with payroll platforms such as SAP Payroll, Workday Payroll, Oracle HCM Payroll, ADP, CloudPay, Dayforce or equivalent, together with HRIS and case management tools.
* Experience in transitions, knowledge transfer, parallel payroll runs, cutover, stabilization, operating model design, documentation and governance for new or expanding accounts.
* Working knowledge of data privacy, segregation of duties, access controls, audit requirements and business continuity in a sensitive payroll environment.
* Advanced analytical, reporting and presentation capability, including effective use of Excel and dashboards for operational decisions.
* Excellent communication, executive presence, negotiation, problem\-solving and stakeholder management skills.



**Education and Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Professional certification in payroll, HR operations, accounting, project management, Lean Six Sigma or service management is an advantage.
* Experience supporting global or multi\-country employee populations in an outsourcing or shared\-services environment is preferred.

title: Centre Manager
description:
Centre Manager – Ayurveda Clinic

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Industry:** Healthcare / Ayurveda

About the Role

We are looking for a **Centre Manager** to manage the overall operations and business performance of our Ayurveda clinic. The role will involve managing the **front desk, pharmacy, staff, patient experience, daily operations and centre revenue**.

The ideal candidate should be a hands\-on manager with strong communication, people\-management and business\-development skills.

Key Responsibilities

**Centre Operations**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the clinic.
* Ensure smooth coordination between doctors, therapists, front office, pharmacy and housekeeping.
* Ensure adherence to clinic SOPs, quality standards and operational processes.

**Front Desk \& Patient Management**

* Manage appointments, registrations, billing and patient coordination.
* Monitor patient footfall, follow\-ups and conversions.
* Ensure a professional and positive patient experience.
* Handle patient queries and resolve operational complaints.

**Pharmacy \& Inventory**

* Manage day\-to\-day pharmacy operations and inventory.
* Monitor stock levels, expiry and stock movement.
* Ensure timely procurement and minimise stock\-outs.
* Conduct regular stock reconciliation.

**Staff Management**

* Prepare staff duty rosters and manage daily manpower requirements.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality and staff productivity.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure adequate staffing.
* Conduct regular team briefings and coordinate staff training.

**Business \& Revenue**

* Take ownership of the centre's monthly revenue and business targets.
* Monitor consultations, therapies, pharmacy sales and collections.
* Track leads, conversions, follow\-ups and repeat patients.
* Identify opportunities to increase patient visits and centre revenue.
* Support local marketing, referral and business\-development initiatives.

**Administration \& Reporting**

* Monitor daily collections and ensure proper reconciliation.
* Maintain centre reports, registers and operational records.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports.
* Coordinate with management, accounts, HR, procurement and marketing teams.

Key Performance Areas

* Centre Revenue \& Business Growth
* Patient Footfall \& Retention
* Consultation \& Therapy Conversion
* Pharmacy Sales \& Inventory Management
* Staff Productivity \& Attendance
* Patient Experience
* Operational \& SOP Compliance

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in **Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, Business Administration, Ayurveda, Life Sciences** or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in **clinic, hospital, Ayurveda, wellness or healthcare operations**.
* Strong communication and team\-management skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple functions independently.
* Prior experience in Ayurveda/healthcare operations will be an advantage.

What We Are Looking For

A **hands\-on Centre Manager** who can independently manage the clinic's **people, patients, pharmacy, operations and business**, while maintaining a high standard of patient experience.

Pay: From ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Plant Manager / Production Manager
description:
For our Client:
 



  





 Chemical Blending Facility – Speciality Chemicals
 



  





 Position Overview
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager / Production Manager to lead the setup, commissioning, and ongoing operations of a chemical blending facility for the manufacture of detergents, surfactants, and dicing fluids. The role will be responsible for safe, efficient, quality\-driven, and compliant plant operations, including production planning, batch manufacturing, raw material handling, packaging, maintenance coordination, manpower management, and continuous improvement.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will bring strong hands\-on experience in chemical blending, specialty chemicals, surfactants, detergents, lubricants, process chemicals, personal care chemicals, or related formulation\-based manufacturing environments, along with proven leadership of plant teams and adherence to safety, quality, and statutory requirements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead day\-to\-day production operations for chemical blending, mixing, filtration, filling, packaging, storage, and dispatch activities.
 



 Manage plant setup activities including layout readiness, equipment installation support, utilities coordination, trial batches, commissioning, and operational handover.
 



 Ensure all batches are manufactured strictly as per approved formulations, batch sheets, SOPs, work instructions, and quality specifications.
 



 Plan production schedules based on customer requirements, raw material availability, manpower, equipment capacity, and delivery commitments.
 



 Supervise handling, storage, charging, transfer, and use of chemicals including surfactants, solvents, additives, builders, preservatives, pH adjusters, fragrances, and specialty performance additives.
 



 Maintain strong control over batch yields, rework, wastage, spillage, process losses, and product consistency.
 



 Coordinate closely with Quality Control / Quality Assurance for raw material release, in\-process checks, finished product testing, non\-conformance handling, and corrective actions.
 



 Implement and enforce EHS practices related to chemical handling, PPE, MSDS/SDS compliance, spill response, fire safety, hazardous storage, effluent control, and emergency preparedness.
 



 Maintain compliance with applicable factory, labour, environmental, statutory, ISO, customer, and internal audit requirements.
 



 Lead, train, schedule, and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, helpers, and contract employees across shifts.
 



 Coordinate with maintenance and engineering teams to ensure preventive maintenance, breakdown response, calibration, utility reliability, and equipment uptime.
 



 Monitor production performance using KPIs such as output, batch cycle time, right\-first\-time quality, OEE, downtime, yield, cost, rejection rate, and on\-time delivery.
 



 Maintain accurate plant documentation, including batch records, production reports, stock records, shift logs, equipment cleaning records, EHS records, and audit trails.
 



 Drive continuous improvement initiatives in productivity, safety, housekeeping, process standardization, material usage, energy efficiency, and cost reduction.
 



 Support procurement, stores, warehouse, logistics, R\&D, technical service, and commercial teams to ensure smooth end\-to\-end operations.
 



 Required Qualifications and Experience
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, Chemistry, Polymer Science, Production Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 



 Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in chemical manufacturing, preferably in chemical blending, detergents, surfactants, specialty chemicals, metalworking fluids, dicing fluids, lubricants, process chemicals, home care, personal care, coatings, adhesives, or similar formulation\-based industries.
 



 At least 3–5 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial production role with responsibility for teams, shifts, production targets, safety, and quality outcomes.
 



 Experience in plant startup, commissioning, scale\-up, process stabilization, or greenfield / brownfield expansion projects will be highly preferred.
 



 Strong working knowledge of batch processing, blending vessels, agitators, pumps, transfer lines, filtration systems, filling lines, storage tanks, weighing systems, utilities, and packaging operations.
 



 Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, 5S, lean manufacturing, and statutory compliance requirements applicable to chemical plants.
 



 Technical Competencies
 



 Understanding of surfactant chemistry, detergent formulations, emulsions, pH control, viscosity control, foam behaviour, compatibility, and stability requirements.
 



 Knowledge of chemical blending methods, batch sequencing, raw material compatibility, and contamination prevention.
 



 Ability to read and implement formulations, batch manufacturing records, process parameters, SOPs, SDS/MSDS documents, and quality specifications.
 



 Strong awareness of safe storage and handling of acids, alkalis, solvents, surfactants, preservatives, additives, and other industrial chemicals.
 



 Working knowledge of effluent, waste, spill, and emissions management practices relevant to chemical blending facilities.
 



 Ability to troubleshoot production issues such as off\-spec batches, phase separation, foaming, viscosity deviation, contamination, colour / odour variation, filling losses, and equipment downtime.
 



 Leadership and Behavioural Competencies
 



 Strong leadership, ownership, discipline, and hands\-on plant\-floor orientation.
 



 Ability to build and lead teams in a startup or scale\-up manufacturing environment.
 



 High commitment to safety, quality, compliance, housekeeping, and operational reliability.
 



 Good communication skills for coordination with senior management, technical teams, vendors, auditors, customers, and shop\-floor employees.
 



 Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical, data\-driven, and cost\-conscious approach.
 



 Ability to create systems, enforce SOPs, train teams, and sustain operational discipline.
 



 Key Performance Indicators
 



 Achievement of monthly and weekly production plans.
 



 Right\-first\-time batch quality and reduction in non\-conformances.
 



 Improvement in yield, productivity, batch cycle time, and equipment uptime.
 



 Reduction in wastage, rework, spills, downtime, and customer complaints.
 



 Compliance with EHS, statutory, audit, and documentation requirements.
 



 Manpower productivity, training completion, retention, and discipline.
 



 On\-time availability of finished goods for dispatch.
 



 Reporting and Interfaces
 



 Reports to: Business Head
 



 Preferred Candidate Profile
 



 The preferred candidate will be a practical, technically strong, safety\-conscious production leader who has grown through plant operations and understands both formulation accuracy and shop\-floor execution. The person should be comfortable working in a hands\-on environment, setting up systems from scratch, leading teams across shifts, and ensuring that the facility operates with high standards of quality, discipline, compliance, and cost control.
 



  





 Location \- Chennai
 



  





 Budget \- Open

 "The spending youth, especially the millennials \& Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. title: Associate / Assistant manager - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Position Overview"** 




  




* **Job Title:** 
 Associate / Assistant manager \- Transaction Reporting
* **Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations
* **Location:** 
 Chennai
* **Business Line / Function:** 
 Reporting Production Analyst – Regulatory Transaction Reporting (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite)



  





**Position Purpose:** 




  





 Execute day‑to‑day regulatory transaction reporting across EU and UK jurisdictions (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II) and ASIC Rewrite. Serve as the first‑line defence to ensure accurate, complete and timely submission to Trade Repositories or Approved Reporting Mechanisms, while overseeing outsourced reporting providers and delegated broker reports.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




  





 1\. Oversight \& Monitoring of Outsourced Reporting (EMIR EU/UK, ASIC)
 


* Monitor daily production and submission status of the 3rd‑party service provider (SP).
* Validate SP controls, reconcile internal trades against SP reports, and track escalations or SLA breaches.
* Maintain audit evidence and act as the primary SP point‑of‑contact.



 2\. Daily Trade \& Transaction Reporting (SFTR \& MiFID II – EU/UK)
 


* Produce and submit all reportable trades within regulatory deadlines.
* Monitor platforms and intraday flows, validate post‑submission content, and ensure final acceptance by the Trade Repository or ARM/APA.



 3\. Rejections \& Exceptions Remediation
 


* Investigate NACKs and other exceptions; identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing).
* Amend and resubmit corrected reports within the required jurisdictional timeframes.
* Keep a detailed audit trail of all remediation actions.



 4\. Daily \& Monthly Reconciliation
 


* Perform daily reconciliation for SFTR and MiFID II (EU/UK) and reconcile internal data against SP output for EMIR and ASIC.
* Conduct monthly reconciliations to confirm consistency between source data and submitted data.
* Document results and escalate any unresolved breaks with a clear resolution plan.



 5\. Oversight of Delegated EMIR Reporting on ETD (Clearing Brokers)
 


* Validate the completeness and timeliness of broker‑submitted reports.
* Engage brokers to correct discrepancies, track issues and retain audit evidence.



 6\. Pairing \& Matching
 


* Resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions; manage UTI processing in line with internal procedures.
* Monitor pairing and matching rates as a key quality indicator.



 7\. Reporting to RTR Team
 


* Produce daily dashboards covering volumes, pairing/matching rates, acceptance, rejections and remediation.
* Highlight emerging issues, trends and risks in a structured manner.



**8\. Continuous Improvement \& Knowledge Sharing** 



* Identify and escalate recurring issues; keep procedures, run‑books and knowledge base up‑to‑date.
* Cross‑train team members to maintain full interchangeability.
* Stay current with regulatory changes and contribute to impact assessments.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience (must have):** 




  




* **Regulatory Reporting Experience:** 
 Minimum
 **(Associate \- 3\-6 years)**
* **( Assistant Manager 7\- 11 years)** 
 in regulatory transaction reporting within financial services (asset‑management or sell‑side).
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** 
 Solid understanding of reporting mechanics (submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI, pairing‑matching, lifecycle events) and proficiency in at least one regime (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite) with a willingness to master all four.
* **Outsourced‑Provider Oversight:** 
 Proven ability to monitor, challenge and review controls and SLAs of an external reporting provider.
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Advanced Excel (pivot tables, look‑ups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting.
* **Analytical \& Investigative Skills:** 
 Strong root‑cause analysis of data‑quality issues.
* **Communication:** 
 Ability to translate technical issues into clear messages for the RTR team and senior management; capable of producing presentations and KPI reports.
* **Team Interchangeability:** 
 Support colleagues through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
* **Behavioral Skills:** 
 Active listening, adaptability, knowledge sharing and meticulous attention to details



  





**Preferred Education, Skills \& Experience :** 




  




* **Regulatory Regimes:** 
 Working knowledge of two or more of the following – EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite.
* **Reporting Platforms:** 
 Hands‑on experience with Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri‑Optima, DTCC or IHS Markit.
* **Additional Technical Tools:** 
 Familiarity with automated reconciliation or data‑quality tools (e.g., Python‑based scripting, SQL) – advantageous but not mandatory.

title: Portfolio Lead
description:
****Company Description****
**About Entain India**
 There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.
   

  

****Job Description****
 The Portfolio Lead is accountable for delivery performance across a sub\-domain of 4\-6 pods (Engineering, Quality, Product). They lead the flow of value from idea to production, ensuring pods deliver with pace, predictability and understanding to outcomes.
   

  

 They combine hands\-on delivery leadership with AI\-augmented ways of working and data\-driven decision\-making. They do not prescribe a single framework \- instead they adapt approaches that best serve each pod's context.
   

  

 They partner with Engineering and Product leadership to reduce waste, improve throughput and help pods achieve Autonomy, Accountability and Agreement to value outcomes.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
**Pod Performance \& Accountability**
 You are responsible for pod delivery performance across the sub\-domain.
   

  

 You will lead and communicate delivery health, risks and performance to leadership
   

  

 Ensure pods operate as, self\-organising units delivering value outcomes
   

  

 Support pod leads with coaching, facilitation and conflict resolution
   

  

 Ensure cross\-pod agreement on priorities, dependencies and shared goals
   

  

 Facilitate communication and collaboration between pods to promote knowledge sharing
   

  

**Problem Solving**
 You will be an expert; deploy root cause analysis, systems thinking and structured techniques to analyse and guide out resolutions.
   

  

 Be an escalation point for cross\-pod blockers and systemic impediments
   

  

 Identify patterns across pods that indicate deeper organisational or process issues
   

  

**AI\-Augmented Delivery**
 Champion AI agent adoption across pods \- including coding agents, test generation, story creation, board health and deployment automation
   

  

 Identify opportunities where AI can reduce toil, accelerate delivery or improve decision\-making
   

  

 Apply AI to improve delivery effectiveness, including workflow insights, risk prediction, and automation of reporting
   

  

 Track and demonstrate the impact of AI on delivery performance
   

  

**Flow \& Efficiency**
 Monitor and improve delivery flow (lead time, cycle time, WIP, throughput) using Kanban and lean principles
   

  

 Ensure WIP limits are respected and surface ageing items through Board Walks
   

  

 Identify bottlenecks, ageing work and sources of delay across pods.
   

  

 Improve through regular assessment and experimentation.
   

  

 Support teams in breaking down work into deliverable, value\-driven increments
   

  

**Agile Ways of Working**
 Support and evolve the agile operating model for a pod\-based environment focused on pace, not ceremony.
   

  

 Adapt delivery approaches (Kanban, flow\-based, lean) appropriate to each pod's needs
   

  

 Ensure consistency of practice across pods without being prescriptive
   

  

 Promote outcome\-driven delivery vs output\-driven activity
   

  

 Guide teams to operate with autonomy and accountability
   

  

**Metrics \& Reporting**
 Define and maintain delivery metrics: cycle time, flow efficiency, lead time of initiative, PDLC compression, dependency reduction, rework rate, team satisfaction, and AI effectiveness
   

  

 Build dashboards (cumulative flow diagrams, throughput charts, WIP ageing) that provide leadership visibility and lead informed decision\-making
   

  

 Analyse performance data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement
   

  

 Use data to facilitate conversations and coach pods — not just track output
   

  

**Stakeholder Management**
 Partner with Engineering and Product leadership at sub\-domain level
   

  

 Represent delivery health and risks in leadership forums
   

  

 Build trusted relationships that allow fast decision\-making
   

  

 Communicate delivery performance to both technical and non\-technical audiences
   

  

**Commercial Awareness**
 Understand the commercial context of the sub\-domain
   

  

 Connect delivery decisions to revenue, cost, and customer impact
   

  

 Support prioritisation trade\-offs with a business lens
   

  

**Capacity Planning**
 Forecast capacity across pods based on team composition, skills mix and upcoming demand
   

  

 Identify resourcing gaps and support hiring/allocation decisions
   

  

 Balance workload across pods to prevent burnout and underutilisation

title: Independent Director
description:
**Enterprise context** 




  





 The company designs, installs and maintains landscaped environments for institutional and commercial customers. Delivery combines horticultural knowledge, irrigation, civil works, nursery sourcing, chemicals, equipment, seasonal labour and long\-term maintenance. Assets are living systems: survival, establishment and appearance depend on soil, water, species selection, weather, care and customer\-controlled conditions.
 



  





 The business is expanding organically and through acquisitions. Project revenue can look attractive before plant replacement, establishment obligations, delayed site access, unapproved variations and maintenance mobilisation are fully recognised. Recurring maintenance contracts can also be uneconomic when water, labour, waste removal, seasonal replacement or service frequencies are underestimated. The Board seeks an Independent Director who can govern these lifecycle obligations while supporting a disciplined buy\-and\-build strategy.
 



  





**Board mandate** 




  





 The Director will provide independent oversight of water stewardship, species and nursery provenance, chemical use, worker safety, project accounting, survival guarantees, contract economics, equipment, customer conduct, acquisition diligence and integration. The appointee must ensure that environmental claims are supported by measurable outcomes rather than visual presentation or planting counts.
 



  





 The role requires site\-level curiosity. Board information should distinguish installed plants from surviving, established landscapes; irrigation capacity from responsible water use; and signed maintenance revenue from contracts capable of funding safe, competent delivery.
 



  





**Strategic and governance responsibilities** 




  




1. Govern design suitability.
 
 Review climate, soil, water, light, maintenance capability, root space, biodiversity, user safety and lifecycle cost. Aesthetics should not override site conditions or sustainable maintenance.
2. Protect planting provenance.
 
 Establish nursery approval, species identity, plant health, pest status, source legality, receipt quality and traceability. Substitutions require qualified review and customer agreement where material.
3. Define establishment and survival obligations.
 
 Clarify measurement periods, exclusions, replacement responsibility, customer dependencies and evidence. Revenue and provisions should reflect the true warranty burden.
4. Strengthen water stewardship.
 
 Measure source, entitlement, quality, irrigation efficiency, leakage, runoff and consumption by site. Water\-saving claims should use credible baselines and include establishment needs.
5. Govern chemical use.
 
 Review approved products, storage, issue, dose, application conditions, protective equipment, public notification, disposal and non\-chemical alternatives.
6. Protect workforce safety and dignity.
 
 Examine heat stress, machinery, work at height, traffic exposure, manual handling, chemicals, sanitation, wages, contractor practices and grievance access.
7. Make project economics complete.
 
 Include design revision, mobilisation, site delay, plant loss, irrigation changes, civil rework, customer retention, replacement and working capital.
8. Make maintenance economics complete.
 
 Include route time, crew composition, seasonal intensity, equipment, water responsibility, waste, replacements, reporting and service\-credit exposure.
9. Control variation and acceptance.
 
 Ensure scope changes, customer instructions, measurements, completion, snagging and handover are documented. Unapproved work should not accumulate as optimistic receivables.
10. Govern equipment and fleet.
 
 Review utilisation, custody, maintenance, fuel, operator competence, leasing, theft and capital proposals. Equipment growth should follow route and project density.
11. Substantiate sustainability claims.
 
 Define canopy, survival, biodiversity, water, waste and carbon boundaries. Do not equate planted quantity with durable ecological outcome.
12. Create acquisition discipline.
 
 Assess customer contracts, survival liabilities, workforce compliance, chemical inventory, nursery arrangements, equipment, claims, receivables and owner dependence.
13. Integrate controls before synergies.
 
 Align safety, payroll, chemical custody, customer records, project estimates, procurement and incident escalation early. Revenue synergies should not precede minimum control standards.
14. Protect balance\-sheet resilience.
 
 Stress\-test weather\-related replacement, customer failure, delayed projects, water restriction, labour shortage, acquisition underperformance and debt service.



  





**Decisions expected at Board level** 




  





 The Director will contribute to acquisitions, long\-duration maintenance contracts, large development projects, nurseries, irrigation technology, fleet and equipment, water partnerships, regional expansion, leverage and strategic exit readiness.
 



  





 Each material project should disclose site readiness, design responsibility, water basis, planting provenance, survival obligations, seasonal risk, variation process, full working capital and exit conditions.
 



  





 Acquisition value should be adjusted for unrecorded replacement, labour, environmental and customer liabilities.

title: Branch Operations Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position:** Branch Operations Manager  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Department:** Business Operations  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Founder / Managing Director  
**Experience:** 5–8 years  
**Preferred Background:** Consulting, strategy, branding, business advisory, professional services, B2B services, or a high\-accountability business environment

**ABOUT MAGSmen**

Magsmen is a business\-integrated brand consulting firm working at the intersection of business strategy, brand strategy, market intelligence, communication, experience, digital systems, governance, and commercial growth. Magsmen does not approach branding as a communication exercise. The objective is to understand the business, diagnose structural problems, create strategic clarity, and translate that clarity into measurable business outcomes.

Our approach moves through Discovery, Diagnosis, Design, Delivery, and Development. Our work addresses business positioning, market intelligence, audience behaviour, brand perception, identity, communication, digital infrastructure, financial alignment, legal and governance considerations, internal culture, and future readiness.

The Hyderabad branch is intended to become a serious regional business centre for Magsmen. The Branch Operations Manager will be responsible for building the operating discipline, commercial performance, client relationships, team capability, and regional presence required to achieve this.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Branch Operations Manager will own the day\-to\-day business operations of the Hyderabad region and will be accountable for branch revenue, business development coordination, client management, project execution, team productivity, collections, process discipline, market development, and operational performance.

This is not an administrative coordination role. The person will act as the operating bridge between Magsmen’s central strategic direction and Hyderabad execution.

The manager must be able to look at Hyderabad as a business unit and continuously answer five questions: Where is revenue coming from? What is blocking conversion? What is happening with every active client? Where is the team losing productivity? What needs to change now?

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Branch Business Ownership**

Own Hyderabad branch performance against agreed revenue, profitability, client, team, and operational targets. Convert company\-level objectives into a regional operating plan covering client acquisition, revenue, pipeline, delivery, manpower, partnerships, and market development. Establish weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating rhythms. Track performance against targets and identify deviations early. Maintain visibility on revenue, collections, sales pipeline, proposals, active projects, receivables, team productivity, client health, and operational risks. Solve problems within the branch wherever authority permits and escalate only matters requiring leadership intervention.

**Revenue and Commercial Operations**

Own the commercial operating discipline of the branch in coordination with business development and consulting teams. Maintain a structured pipeline from prospecting through qualification, meetings, proposals, negotiation, closure, onboarding, and collection. Ensure every opportunity has an owner, value, stage, probability, next action, and expected closure date. Track lead\-to\-meeting, meeting\-to\-proposal, proposal\-to\-closure, and closure\-to\-collection conversion. Diagnose lost opportunities and identify issues relating to pricing, positioning, proposal quality, competition, decision\-maker access, or sales execution. Support senior leadership in high\-value meetings and negotiations. Ensure commercial commitments match approved scope, pricing, and delivery capacity. Prevent uncontrolled discounting and commercially weak commitments. Track receivables and payment milestones closely.

**Business Development and Hyderabad Market Development**

Build Magsmen’s presence within Hyderabad’s business ecosystem. Develop relationships with founders, promoters, CXOs, investors, family businesses, professional networks, institutions, industry associations, and relevant ecosystem stakeholders. Identify sectors and business clusters where Magsmen can create significant strategic value. Develop a regional opportunity map covering target companies, decision\-makers, business stage, strategic problems, opportunity value, and relationship status. Build structured prospecting and referral systems rather than depending entirely on inbound leads. Represent Magsmen at relevant business forums, founder communities, conferences, and industry events. Focus on high\-quality strategic opportunities rather than lead volume.

**Client Management**

Own the quality of the client experience from onboarding to project completion and subsequent engagement. Establish clear communication between clients and internal consulting, strategy, research, creative, digital, and specialist teams. Monitor expectations against contracted scope. Identify scope creep, delays, communication gaps, quality concerns, and relationship risks before they become escalations. Track client health, satisfaction, repeat business, referrals, pending decisions, commercial opportunities, and risks. Support account expansion when genuine strategic requirements emerge while maintaining commercial discipline. Protect Magsmen’s reputation in every client interaction.

**Project and Delivery Operations**

Create operating discipline across Hyderabad projects. Ensure every project has defined objectives, scope, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, dependencies, review points, and completion criteria. Monitor progress against agreed timelines. Coordinate internal resources and resolve bottlenecks involving information, approvals, people, assets, or decisions. Maintain project documentation. Track resource utilisation and project economics where applicable. Ensure final outputs meet Magsmen’s consulting standards and agreed client mandate. Distinguish between strategic problems and execution problems and intervene accordingly.

**Team Management**

Manage and develop the Hyderabad team. Establish responsibilities, reporting structures, priorities, and performance expectations. Conduct regular team and individual reviews. Monitor productivity and capability gaps. Ensure employees understand both what they are expected to execute and the business reason behind the work. Build accountability around ownership and deadlines. Address underperformance early. Work with leadership on recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, and retention. Develop future team leaders. Ensure the branch reflects Magsmen’s standards of strategic thinking, commercial discipline, client confidentiality, professional conduct, and intellectual honesty.

**Process and Operating System**

Build and continuously improve the Hyderabad operating system. Standardise recurring processes covering sales coordination, client onboarding, project initiation, project tracking, reporting, collections, reviews, documentation, and feedback. Identify processes that can be simplified or automated. Ensure CRM and internal systems remain accurate and current. Build dashboards and reporting systems that give leadership a clear view of branch performance. Introduce SOPs where recurring operational failures are identified. The objective is not bureaucracy. It is predictability.

**Performance Reporting**

Prepare regular branch performance reports for senior leadership covering revenue, collections, pipeline, conversion, projects, profitability, client health, team productivity, recruitment needs, risks, and regional opportunities. Reporting must include diagnosis, not merely numbers. Where targets are missed, identify the cause, owner, corrective action, and timeline. Where performance improves, determine whether the improvement is sustainable.

**Financial and Commercial Discipline**

Coordinate with finance to monitor branch\-level billing, collections, receivables, expenses, project costs, and profitability. Ensure commercial commitments are properly documented and approved. Monitor project scope against contracts and flag margin erosion, excessive resource usage, delayed billing, unapproved work, and payment risks. Develop strong commercial judgement. A project can be successful for the client and still be commercially weak for Magsmen.

**Governance, Legal and IP Discipline**

Ensure branch operations comply with Magsmen’s policies, client agreements, confidentiality requirements, intellectual property standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Protect client information, strategic documents, proprietary frameworks, research, commercial information, and other confidential assets. Ensure employees do not make unauthorised commitments. Maintain discipline around Magsmen’s proprietary methodologies, templates, presentations, research, frameworks, and intellectual property. Escalate potential contractual, legal, reputational, confidentiality, IP, or compliance risks immediately. Support appropriate documentation of contracts, statements of work, approvals, commercial commitments, and client communications.

**Brand Representation**

Represent Magsmen professionally in the Hyderabad market. Ensure branch communication remains consistent with Magsmen’s positioning as a strategic consulting firm and is not reduced to conventional advertising, design, or marketing agency work. Maintain consistency across meetings, proposals, presentations, events, office interactions, digital communication, and client servicing.

**Market Intelligence**

Continuously track Hyderabad’s business environment and identify opportunities relevant to Magsmen. Monitor emerging industries, investment activity, GCC development, startup growth, family business transitions, corporate restructuring, D2C growth, technology adoption, category disruption, and changing founder priorities. Identify recurring strategic problems and convert relevant intelligence into business development opportunities. Feed regional intelligence back to leadership.

**Leadership Support**

Support the Founder and senior consulting leadership on major Hyderabad initiatives. Prepare client intelligence, meeting briefs, opportunity assessments, business information, and follow\-up plans. Translate leadership decisions into execution and follow initiatives through to completion. Identify issues that leadership may not see because of distance from daily operations. The manager is expected to solve problems independently rather than become a messenger between leadership and employees.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Performance will be measured through outcomes, not activity volume. Core KPIs include Hyderabad revenue against target, collections against billing, qualified sales pipeline, proposal\-to\-closure conversion, new client acquisition, average account value, repeat business, referral generation, client retention, project delivery against timelines, project profitability, client satisfaction, team productivity, employee retention, receivables ageing, operating cost discipline, and branch contribution to overall Magsmen growth.

Additional measures will include reduction in operational errors, speed of issue resolution, reporting quality, process maturity, and reduced dependence on Founder intervention.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate will have 5–8 years of experience in business operations, consulting operations, professional services, business development, account management, or a comparable B2B environment. Demonstrated experience managing teams, targets, clients, and measurable business outcomes is essential.

Strong commercial understanding and financial awareness are required. The candidate should be comfortable with CRM systems, project management systems, dashboards, reporting, and structured operating processes. Experience in consulting, branding, advertising, business advisory, or professional services is preferred. Hyderabad market knowledge and an established professional network will be an advantage.

The person must demonstrate strong communication, negotiation, analytical thinking, problem solving, project management, people leadership, client management, and execution discipline. The candidate must be comfortable handling ambiguity, deadlines, commercial pressure, difficult conversations, and multiple priorities.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

This is not an office administration position, pure sales position, client servicing coordinator role, or project coordination role. It is a business operations leadership position where revenue, delivery, people, client experience, finance, and market development must operate as one system.

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

During the first 30 days, the manager will understand Magsmen’s methodology, business model, active clients, sales pipeline, team structure, delivery system, financial processes, reporting mechanisms, internal standards, and Hyderabad market.

By 60 days, the manager should have established branch operating rhythms, pipeline visibility, project tracking, team reviews, client health tracking, reporting, and immediate corrective actions for operational gaps.

By 90 days, the manager should be independently operating Hyderabad against measurable accountability for revenue, pipeline, delivery, people, collections, and client experience, with a clear regional growth plan.

**SUCCESS DEFINITION**

The Branch Operations Manager will succeed when Hyderabad operates as a predictable and commercially accountable business unit rather than a collection of individuals.

The objective is to build a branch capable of acquiring the right clients, delivering high\-quality strategic work, collecting revenue on time, retaining strong people, protecting Magsmen’s intellectual property and reputation, and creating a sustainable regional growth engine.

**COMPENSATION**

Compensation will be based on experience, capability, and demonstrated commercial ownership. A performance\-linked component may be attached to agreed branch\-level business outcomes.

**APPLICATION**

Candidates should submit their CV along with a brief note describing their experience in managing business operations, revenue, teams, clients, and measurable business outcomes. Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical case exercise based on a simulated Hyderabad branch operating problem.

Magsmen is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on capability, experience, performance, professional conduct, and organisational requirements.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
