Payroll Operations Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Payroll Operations Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end multi\-country payroll service delivery through the Payroll Central India (PCI). This position will be directly managing and responsible for the output of country\-grouped processing pods, consisting of pod Leads, Processors \& Administration team members, working as part of a scalable operation to ensure the accurate and timely payroll processing of all countries serviced through the PCI.
   

  

 The incumbent is responsible for ensuring quality control and compliance of payroll provision, underpinned by strict SLA/KPI service measures that ensure accuracy, efficiency and customer satisfaction. Will lead and manage all PCI Team members, ensuring they are appropriately trained and developed for continuous improvement across the different levels of processing competency with an ongoing focus on business continuity through cross coverage to ensure the demands of the PCI payment cycles are always met.
   

  

 The Payroll Operations Manager will be the subject matter expert for payroll processing within our ADP systems and form a strong collaboration with ADP Service Management to ensure smooth delivery between parties and appropriate upskilling of the PCI Team when it comes to working with our Global payroll partner ADP. Partner closely with Regional Payroll \& Technology Specialists, in maintaining \& optimizing the overall payroll and compliance landscape that governs the capabilities and attribute of the PCI. Also, will work in close partnership with the wider HR Function and other key stakeholders in the payroll process, such as Finance, Tax \& Treasury teams, as necessary to fulfill the operational requirements of the PCI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Oversee on\-cycle \& off\-cycle payroll runs as per strict country calendars, ensuring processing methodology and agreed controls are adhered to as part of daily operations across all pods.
* Ensure quality control measures are complied with as part of the standard payroll sign off process, with appropriate checklists, controlling and reconciliation processes at each stage of the payroll cycle.
* Coordinate with ADP support teams and internal stakeholders for issue resolution and compliance adherence that impact payroll delivery.
* Manage risk mitigation to anything that impacts the delivery of individual payroll cycles or pay days and embed changes to future practices to avoid further recurrences.
* Provide optimization planning for each pending cycle to ensure special measures or activities, such as special projects or legislative updates, are undertaken in addition to the standard processing practices.
* Manage and ensure execution of the annual calendar of activities, such as tax year end, compensation and benefit renewals.
* Ensure comprehensive process documentation, robust process coverage, and effective contingency plans for uninterrupted payroll delivery.
* Conducts variance analysis and ensure reconciliation accuracy across pods to monitor performance and efficiencies.
* Drive standardization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the payroll hub.
* Manage pod teams to ensure they are appropriately staffed and upskilled (technical \& service orientation) to meet the demands of all country pay cycles.
* Provide direction, coaching, and performance oversight to Leads, Supervisors, Processors, \& Administrators.
* Ensure Team performance is measured and monitored in line with service delivery SLAs \& KPIs and acted upon where performance is substandard.
* Create a culture of high performance and high collaboration across pods, with a focus on cross training and contingency.
* Maintain manpower planning to ensure Payroll Central India is always staffed and can manage natural attrition without service disruptions.
* Ensure all activities undertaken by the PCI are all tracked \& documented to ensure 100% compliance with audit all controls.
* Ensure all payroll country requirements, including internal \& external compliance, as managed and advised by Regional Payroll Specialists are reflected in processing operations within the PCI to ensure ADP \& other systems and processing operations are always 100% compliant.
* Ensure all aspects of the PCI are documented within the appropriate Knowledge Base for ongoing reference by customers, stakeholders \& team members.
* Ensure Payroll Request Management is used effectively to manage team workload and also used to drive business insight for improvements and priorities.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of multi country payroll delivery experience.
* Proven managerial experience of Payroll Teams in a multinational organization.
* Experience with centralized, shared services, or captive payroll models.
* Strong background working with ADP (or similar) payroll platforms.
* Multi\-country payroll operations and statutory compliance knowledge.
* Country migration and parallel payroll experience.
* Payroll governance, controls and audit awareness.
* Strong experience with using Enterprise Payroll Software or working with a payroll vendor such as ADP.
* Strong experience with payroll systems development such as interfaces to Timekeeping \& HCM.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and complex stakeholder environments.
* Structured, detail\-oriented and outcome\-focused mindset.


**About Us**
 Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
   

  

**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
 Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
   

  

**Global Family**
 We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**Purposeful Innovation**
 Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
   

  

**Service Above All**
 This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**WHO ARE WE?** 




  





**WE CONNECT PEOPLE AND WORK** 




  





**TrueBlue** 
 (NYSE: TBI) is a leading staffing, recruiting and workforce management company. The company fills individual positions on demand, staffs entire facilities, and manages outsourced recruiting processes and staffing vendor programs for a wide variety of clients. The company's specialized workforce solutions meet clients' needs for a reliable, efficient workforce in a wide variety of industries including \- construction, manufacturing, financial services, pharmaceuticals, transportation, aviation, and energy. TrueBlue assigns as many as 100,000 people to work each day, drawing from a data base of hundreds of thousands of candidates, and places more than 250,000 people in permanent positions each year.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Operations Manager** 
 to lead and manage a high\-performing recruitment delivery team in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment. This role will have end\-to\-end ownership of operational performance, team productivity, service delivery, stakeholder management, and continuous process improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and manage team, driving performance, engagement, productivity, and professional development.
* Own the recruitment delivery function end\-to\-end, ensuring achievement of productivity, quality, SLA, and operational targets.
* Monitor key performance indicators and implement appropriate action plans to address performance gaps.
* Participate in business reviews, governance meetings, and stakeholder discussions, providing operational insights and updates to senior stakeholders.
* Manage escalations and complex operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and effective stakeholder communication.
* Identify process gaps and opportunities for improvement, and implement process optimization, automation, and workflow enhancements.
* Coach and mentor team members, build leadership capability, and develop succession plans and career growth opportunities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high\-quality service delivery.
* Support change management initiatives and ensure effective implementation of new processes and operational strategies.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and cost effectiveness across recruitment operations.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Experience in RPO, staffing, recruitment operations, or another high\-volume, fast\-paced operational environment.
* Strong experience in people management, performance management, coaching, and team development.
* Demonstrated experience managing business reviews, escalations, and senior stakeholder interactions.
* Strong understanding of KPIs, SLAs, productivity, quality, and operational metrics, preferably within an RPO environment.
* Hands\-on experience in process improvement, automation, workflow optimization, or cost\-efficiency initiatives.
* Experience in team building, succession planning, and managing organizational or process changes.

title: Operations Manager - E-commerce & Supply Chain
description:
ROLE DETAILS
 



 Industry: Apparel \& Fashion / E\-commerce
 



 Function: Operations / Supply Chain
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 8\+ years
 



 Compensation: Fixed \+ Variable \+ ESOP (ESOP structure to be confirmed)
 



 Location: Okhla, New Delhi
 



 Work Mode: Work from Office
 



 Work Schedule: Monday–Saturday
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



 We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to own and drive our client's end\-to\-end operational ecosystem across inventory, supply chain, warehouse, fulfilment, logistics and marketplace operations.
 



  





 This is a business\-critical role that goes beyond day\-to\-day warehouse management. You will be responsible for building a predictable, efficient and scalable operating system that enables them to grow across channels without compromising on availability, speed, accuracy, cost or customer experience.
 



 You will work closely with production, warehouse, customer service, finance, marketplaces, technology and external logistics partners, acting as the central point of ownership for operational execution.
 



 The ideal candidate is someone who can think strategically, plan ahead and still get into the details when required — someone who can identify operational gaps, build processes around them and take complete ownership of outcomes.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR
 



 • An experienced operations professional with strong exposure to e\-commerce, D2C, marketplace or multi\-channel businesses.
 



 • Someone who understands operations end\-to\-end, from demand planning and inventory procurement through warehouse fulfilment, dispatch, logistics, returns and reconciliation.
 



 • Strong understanding of inventory planning, forecasting, stock availability, inventory ageing and working capital efficiency.
 



 • Ability to translate business and sales forecasts into operational capacity and inventory plans.
 



 • Strong experience managing and coordinating with 3PL, courier and logistics partners.
 



 • Someone who can work cross\-functionally and drive closure across production, warehouse, customer service, finance and corporate teams.
 



 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability with a data\-driven approach to operational decision\-making.
 



 • A process builder who can establish SOPs, KPIs, MIS and operating rhythms rather than simply manage existing processes.
 



 • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently identify issues, prioritise them and drive solutions.
 



 • Comfortable operating in a high\-growth environment where processes and systems are continuously evolving.
 



 • Clear and effective communication with both ground\-level teams and senior management.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
 



 END\-TO\-END OPERATIONS
 



 • Own the overall operational flow across inventory, warehouse, fulfilment, logistics and order management.
 



 • Ensure seamless movement of products from production/inbound through storage, fulfilment, dispatch, delivery and returns.
 



 • Establish operational plans aligned with business growth, sales targets and channel requirements.
 



 • Monitor operational performance and proactively identify risks, bottlenecks and capacity constraints.
 



 • Ensure operational SLAs are consistently achieved across functions and partners.
 



 • Build a scalable operating model that can support significant growth in orders, SKUs and sales channels.
 



  





 SUPPLY CHAIN \& INVENTORY PLANNING
 



 • Own inventory planning and forecasting across Salty's D2C and marketplace channels.
 



 • Analyse historical sales, demand trends, channel performance and upcoming business requirements to plan inventory.
 



 • Ensure optimum inventory availability while controlling overstock, stock\-outs and working capital blockage.
 



 • Monitor stock movements, replenishment, transfers and inventory allocation across channels.
 



 • Track inventory ageing, slow\-moving and dead stock and drive corrective actions.
 



 • Coordinate with production and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely availability of inventory.
 



 • Establish inventory planning and replenishment processes that can scale with business growth.
 



  





 WAREHOUSE \& FULFILMENT MANAGEMENT
 



 • Oversee warehouse operations including inbound, put\-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns and stock reconciliation.
 



 • Set and monitor productivity, accuracy, turnaround time and fulfilment SLAs.
 



 • Identify warehouse capacity requirements based on projected business volumes.
 



 • Ensure efficient utilisation of manpower, space and operational resources.
 



 • Drive improvements in warehouse processes, layouts, workflows and productivity.
 



 • Ensure high inventory accuracy through systematic audits, cycle counts and reconciliation.
 



 • Work with warehouse teams to resolve operational bottlenecks and recurring issues.
 



  





 LOGISTICS \& 3PL MANAGEMENT
 



 • Own relationships and operational coordination with 3PL, courier and logistics partners.
 



 • Monitor dispatch, delivery, RTO, NDR, returns and other logistics performance metrics.
 



 • Establish and monitor partner SLAs and ensure service levels are maintained.
 



 • Identify recurring logistics issues and work with partners to improve performance.
 



 • Evaluate operational performance and identify opportunities for cost optimisation and service improvement.
 



 • Ensure timely escalation and resolution of delivery and fulfilment issues.
 



  





 MARKETPLACE \& MULTI\-CHANNEL OPERATIONS
 



 • Oversee operational execution across the D2C website and marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra.
 



 • Ensure accurate channel\-wise inventory availability and order flow.
 



 • Monitor marketplace fulfilment requirements, operational SLAs and inventory commitments.
 



 • Coordinate with internal teams and marketplace stakeholders to resolve operational issues.
 



 • Ensure systems accurately reflect orders, inventory, dispatches, cancellations and returns across channels.
 



 • Identify operational challenges arising from multi\-channel selling and build processes to address them.
 



  





 SYSTEMS, WMS/OMS \& DATA
 



 • Own the operational usage and effectiveness of WMS, OMS and inventory/order management systems.
 



 • Ensure accurate data flow between sales channels, inventory systems, warehouse and logistics partners.
 



 • Work with technology/internal teams to identify system gaps and improve operational workflows.
 



 • Drive automation wherever possible to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide management with clear visibility into operational performance.
 



  





 PROCESS EXCELLENCE \& SOPs
 



 • Build, document and continuously improve SOPs and operational processes across the supply chain.
 



 • Identify process gaps, root causes and recurring operational inefficiencies.
 



 • Implement systems and controls to improve speed, accuracy, cost and scalability.
 



 • Establish clear ownership and escalation mechanisms across operational functions.
 



 • Build processes that reduce dependency on individual team members and enable consistent execution.
 



  





 MIS, KPIs \& MANAGEMENT REPORTING
 



 • Establish and track key operational KPIs across inventory, fulfilment, warehouse and logistics.
 



 • Prepare regular MIS and performance reports for management.
 



 Track metrics such as:
 



 • Order fulfilment TAT
 



 • Inventory accuracy
 



 • Stock availability
 



 • Inventory ageing
 



 • Warehouse productivity
 



 • Dispatch SLA
 



 • RTO / NDR
 



 • Return rates
 



 • Logistics performance
 



 • Cost per order
 



 • Operational losses
 



 • Use data to identify trends, anticipate problems and recommend corrective actions to management.
 



  





 CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP
 



 • Act as the central operational link between production, procurement, warehouse, customer service, finance, technology, marketplaces and logistics partners.
 



 • Ensure dependencies between teams are proactively identified and resolved.
 



 • Work with leadership to translate business plans into operational requirements.
 



 • Drive accountability across internal teams and external partners.
 



 • Ensure operational issues are owned through to closure rather than being passed between functions.
 



  





 COST \& OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY
 



 • Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs without compromising service quality.
 



 • Optimise warehouse, logistics, manpower and fulfilment costs.
 



 • Analyse operational spends and identify inefficiencies or leakages.
 



 • Work towards improving cost per order, inventory turns and overall operational productivity.
 



 • Build processes that allow the business to scale volumes without proportionately increasing operational costs.
 



  





 REQUIREMENTS
 



 • 8\+ years of experience in operations, supply chain, e\-commerce operations, fulfilment or a related field.
 



 • Strong experience in D2C, e\-commerce, marketplace or multi\-channel businesses.
 



 • Proven experience managing end\-to\-end operations, not just warehouse operations.
 



 • Strong experience in inventory planning, forecasting, stock management and supply chain coordination.
 



 • Experience managing warehouse operations and fulfilment at scale.
 



 • Experience working with 3PL, courier and logistics partners.
 



 • Strong understanding of marketplace and D2C operational workflows.
 



 • Experience working with WMS/OMS and inventory/order management systems.
 



 • Strong analytical, planning, problem\-solving and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to build processes, SOPs, KPIs and reporting systems.
 



 • Ability to manage ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast\-growing startup environment.
 



 • Must be willing to work from office in Okhla, New Delhi.
 



  





 GOOD TO HAVE
 



 • Experience managing operations for a high\-growth D2C/e\-commerce brand.
 



 • Experience handling Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and D2C website operations.
 



 • Prior experience with Unicommerce/Uniware or similar WMS/OMS platforms.
 



 • Experience managing high\-SKU and high\-order\-volume environments.
 



 • Experience in inventory optimisation and working\-capital management.
 



 • Experience in logistics cost optimisation and 3PL performance management.
 



 • Experience building operations from an early\-stage/high\-growth environment.
 



 • Exposure to automation, integrations and technology\-led operational improvements.

title: Technology Operations Manager
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Technology Operations Manager

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage and develop team of individual contributors with low to moderate complexity and risk in Technology Operations
* Manage the operational outcomes of key IT services delivered by network services and operations, database services, infrastructure services including server and storage services
* Identify and recommend opportunities for technology operations process improvement and development
* Leverage metrics to support infrastructure associated with applications that are highly automated, and latency sensitive, client facing and internal applications consumed by the Business
* Leverage enterprise tools to digitize work\-flows as appropriate, asset and configuration management, metrics and measurement of services including availability SLAs, OLAs, mean time to recovery, repeat incidents and issues
* Instill repeatable processes that consistently meet SLAs and OLAs
* Manage backups, recovery and ensure recovery includes periodic tests to ensure business continuity
* Work with IT risk management, compliance and all lines of defense, including Audit, to ensure platform risks are proactively managed
* Institute controls in partnership with Operation Risks to ensure risk management is sustainable
* Manage the costs, demand and resource capacity for the team resources, leveraging external resources as needed
* Make decisions and resolve issues regarding resources, objectives and operations of technology operations to meet business objectives
* Interpret and develop policies and procedures
* Collaborate with and consult with peers, colleagues and multiple level managers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for technology operations
* Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring talent

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Technology Operations experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2\+ years of Leadership experience

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* TIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional certification.
* Experience leading large enterprise Service Desk operations supporting 10,000\+ users.
* Exposure to AI\-powered support solutions, chatbot technologies, and automation platforms.
* Experience with Knowledge Management frameworks and self\-service strategies.
* PMP, Six Sigma, Lean, or Agile certifications are advantageous.
* Financial services industry experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes and service management best practices.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms.
* Experience managing vendors, outsourced service providers, and geographically dispersed global teams.

 **Job Expectations:**

* The IT Service Desk Operations Manager is responsible for leading enterprise\-wide IT support operations, delivering exceptional employee experience through a combination of people, process, technology, and automation. This role owns service delivery across multiple support channels, including phone, chat, email, virtual agents, self\-service portals, and emerging AI\-driven platforms.
* The ideal candidate is a dynamic leader who demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and operational discipline while driving service excellence, automation, digital transformation, and workforce optimization. The role requires expertise in ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, CCaaS technologies, omnichannel support models, self\-heal solutions, knowledge management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Service Desk Operations**

* Manage 24x7 IT Service Desk operations supporting enterprise users globally.
* Ensure achievement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Oversee incident, service request, and major incident support processes.
* Drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) and reduce Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).
* Monitor operational performance and implement corrective actions as needed.

**Team Leadership \& People Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop Service Desk supervisors, leads, and support analysts.
* Conduct performance reviews, talent assessments, succession planning, and career development activities.
* Foster a high\-performance and customer\-centric culture.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, and recognition initiatives.

**Vendor \& Partner Management**

* Manage outsourced service providers and vendor teams.
* Conduct monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Monitor contractual obligations, SLA adherence, and financial commitments.
* Drive vendor performance improvement initiatives and optimization opportunities.

**Service Quality \& Customer Experience**

* Establish quality assurance frameworks and monitoring programs.
* Analyze customer feedback and CSAT trends.
* Identify service improvement opportunities and implement action plans.
* Ensure consistent user experience across all support channels.

**Process Governance \& ITSM**

* Ensure adherence to ITIL\-aligned Incident, Request, Knowledge, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Drive operational process standardization and compliance.
* Partner with risk, compliance, and audit teams to address findings and controls.
* Maintain operational readiness for audits and regulatory reviews.

**Automation \& Digital Transformation**

* Drive adoption of AI, automation, self\-service, chatbots, virtual agents, and knowledge management solutions.
* Drive improvements in call routing, IVR effectiveness, chatbot containment, and agent productivity.
* Implement ticket deflection and shift\-left strategies.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity and reduce operational costs.
* Champion self\-heal and self\-remediation solutions that proactively resolve common user issues.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives that enhance employee experience.

**Reporting \& Analytics**

* Develop operational dashboards and executive\-level performance reports.
* Analyze service trends, ticket volumes, demand patterns, and workforce utilization.
* Present operational reviews to senior leadership.
* Use data\-driven insights to recommend strategic improvements.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Application Support, Security, Network, and Workplace Technology teams.
* Serve as the escalation point for critical service interruptions.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and technology stakeholders.
* Communicate operational risks, performance, and improvement plans effectively.

**Posting End Date:**


16 Sep 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.


Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**


To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

  

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**


a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.


b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

title: Event Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 guch is a global provider of high\-quality video services, supporting clients with brand films, testimonial videos, and product explainers tailored to diverse marketing needs. The company focuses on delivering polished, professional visual content that helps organizations showcase their stories and offerings effectively. guch collaborates with clients across industries and locations, emphasizing reliability, creativity, and streamlined production workflows. Team members work closely with clients to bring concepts to life through video while maintaining clear communication and strong project management. Interested partners and clients can reach the company at hello@guch.me.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Event Operations Manager is a full\-time, remote role responsible for overseeing the planning and execution of virtual and live events that support guch’s video production and client engagement initiatives. This role coordinates event logistics, including schedules, resources, and vendor relationships, ensuring smooth delivery of webinars, launches, client showcases, and internal events. The Event Operations Manager collaborates with cross\-functional teams to align event objectives with business goals, manages event timelines, and monitors workflows to maintain quality and consistency. Day\-to\-day tasks include organizing event briefs, managing budgets, tracking key performance indicators, and resolving operational issues quickly and effectively. The role also involves maintaining clear communication with clients and stakeholders, gathering feedback, and continuously improving event processes to enhance participant experience and operational efficiency.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Operations Management skills, including process optimization, workflow coordination, and vendor management.
* Demonstrated Event Planning experience, covering logistics, scheduling, resource allocation, and event execution.
* Excellent Customer Service and Communication skills, with the ability to manage client expectations and foster positive relationships.
* Proficiency in Budgeting, financial tracking, and cost control for events and operational activities.
* Experience using event management and project management tools; familiarity with virtual event platforms is beneficial.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced setting.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to addressing operational challenges.
* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



  





 Prior Experience will be considered as an add on.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us\***
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services\***
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The Finance Change team, which is part of the Global Finance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Finance Project Manager resource responsible for leading medium sized or portions of large, more complex projects in support of delivery of programs/projects across US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting, general ledger operations, Treasury and global market teams. It may also support BAU projects from a finance systems production services perspective. The role works closely with Global Technology and Operations, CFO and LOB stakeholders.
   

  

 Change teams supporting these functions implement strategic solutions for business users based in the US, Europe \& APAC, working with the technology teams based onshore and in India. The candidate will join the department in India to project manage one of the in\-flight major initiatives as part of the strategic build\-out of the bank's platforms.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* The successful candidate will be responsible for project managing the delivery for key new regulatory requirements, for critical enhancements and for implementing the required processes and control framework
* The role will require extensive project management experience and the skills required to deliver a complex and multi\-faceted project end\-to\-end
* The candidate will be responsible for both medium/long term project planning, as well as day\-to\-day task tracking and monitoring of risks, issues and dependencies
* The role will include working within a wider change programme and established Agile framework, as part of an ongoing complex strategic regulatory reporting infrastructure build programme
* Stakeholder and team management will be required across multiple global locations including the US, UK, Ireland and France
* This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who has demonstrable experience on large\-scale regulatory change to manage and deliver a significant and high profile initiative


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any – Project Management
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 18\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Strong project management experience structuring and delivering complex initiatives
* Proven experience delivering Finance regulatory reporting solutions and processes
* Understanding of high profile regulations (FinRep, CoRep, AnaCredit etc), financial markets and products
* Excellent communication skills required with ability to manage senior stakeholders and provide leadership updates
* Ability to positively drive work forward and create a strong team environment
* Structured approach to defining, executing and evidencing deliverables
* Ability to operate within a global environment working with stakeholders from multiple locations and time zones
* Experience in identifying and managing the risks, issues and dependencies inherent in delivering complex regulatory change


**Desired Skills**
* Prior experience working within Agile methodologies / framework
* Experience of working within challenging and dynamic organizational contexts

 Gurugram / Mumbai

title: Event Operations Manager
description:
Job Overview
 
 We are looking for an
 **Event Operations Manager** 
 who can take ownership of the end\-to\-end execution and operational management of events. The role will be responsible for ensuring that every event is delivered smoothly, on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards.
 



 The ideal candidate should be highly organised, solution\-oriented, hands\-on, and comfortable managing multiple stakeholders, vendors, teams, and deadlines simultaneously.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 
**Event Planning \& Execution** 



* Manage end\-to\-end event operations from planning and pre\-production to on\-ground execution and closure.
* Develop detailed event execution plans, timelines, checklists, and operational schedules.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Creative, Client Servicing, Production, Design, and Accounts.
* Ensure all event requirements, deliverables, manpower, materials, and technical elements are planned well in advance.
* Manage event setup, rehearsals, show flow, event\-day execution, and dismantling.
* Be the primary operational point of contact during event execution.



**Vendor \& Partner Management** 



* Identify, brief, coordinate, and manage external vendors and production partners.
* Negotiate with vendors and ensure commercial terms are aligned with approved budgets.
* Track vendor deliverables, timelines, quality, and payments.
* Build and maintain a reliable network of event vendors, fabricators, technicians, manpower agencies, AV partners, decorators, and other service providers.



**On\-Ground Operations** 



* Lead and supervise event\-day operations and execution teams.
* Conduct venue recce and assess logistical, technical, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate venue access, permissions, loading/unloading, setup, branding, seating, AV, lighting, power, backstage, hospitality, and other event requirements.
* Ensure all production elements are installed and tested within timelines.
* Troubleshoot operational issues quickly and implement contingency plans wherever required.
* Ensure smooth coordination between all teams during live events.



**Budget \& Cost Management** 



* Work closely with Accounts/Finance to manage event budgets and operational costs.
* Obtain and compare vendor quotations.
* Track production and operational expenses against approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising event quality.
* Ensure timely submission and closure of vendor bills and event\-related expenses.



**Team Management** 



* Allocate responsibilities to internal and external teams based on event requirements.
* Brief teams clearly on timelines, responsibilities, escalation points, and event protocols.
* Manage freelancers, event crew, technicians, and temporary manpower where required.
* Ensure teams adhere to timelines, quality standards, and safety protocols.



**Client \& Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Coordinate with clients and stakeholders on operational requirements whenever required.
* Translate client requirements into actionable operational plans.
* Provide regular updates on event readiness, production status, risks, and dependencies.
* Manage last\-minute changes and ensure they are executed with minimum disruption.



**Post\-Event Closure** 



* Oversee dismantling and material movement after the event.
* Ensure venue handover is completed smoothly.
* Track pending vendor deliverables, payments, and documentation.
* Conduct post\-event reviews and document learnings for future events.
* Maintain event reports, vendor records, checklists, and operational documentation.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
 * Strong event planning and execution skills.
* Excellent vendor and stakeholder management.
* Strong negotiation and budgeting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple events/projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and crisis\-management abilities.
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines.
* Hands\-on approach to event execution.
* Strong understanding of event production, logistics, AV, fabrication, branding, and venue operations.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace and basic project\-management tools.


 Experience
 * **4–7 years of experience** 
 in event operations, event production, experiential marketing, or event management.
* Experience handling corporate events, brand activations, conferences, launches, exhibitions, or large\-scale experiences is preferred.
* Proven experience in managing vendors, production teams, budgets, and on\-ground execution.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Timely and smooth execution of events.
* Adherence to approved event budgets.
* Vendor performance and cost efficiency.
* Quality of event execution and production.
* Timely completion of pre\-event deliverables.
* Effective management of event\-day issues and escalations.
* Client/stakeholder satisfaction.
* Successful post\-event closure and documentation.

title: Operations Manager - Textiles
description:
\#\# Operations Manager – Textiles \& E\-Commerce Operations
 



  





 \*\*Company:\*\* Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 



 \*\*Location:\*\* Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 \*\*Salary:\*\* ₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month
 



 \*\*Experience:\*\* 2–7 years
 



 \*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full\-time
 



  





 \#\#\# About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on \*\*Operations Manager\*\* who can take ownership of the complete garment production and operational flow.
 



  





 The primary responsibility of this role is to \*\*continuously follow up production from cutting until final packing\*\*, ensuring every stage is completed on time and according to requirement.
 



  





 The person will also be responsible for \*\*sampling follow\-up, stock maintenance, warehouse management, dispatch, and day\-to\-day e\-commerce operations\*\*.
 



  





 This is not a desk\-only coordination role. The candidate should actively follow up with different teams, identify delays, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure work moves from one stage to the next without getting stuck.
 



  





 \#\#\# Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \#\#\#\# Production Follow\-Up – Primary Responsibility
 



  





 \* Take complete responsibility for \*\*daily production follow\-up from cutting to final packing\*\*.
 



 \* Track each production order through:
 



 \*\*Fabric / Material Readiness → Cutting → Stitching → Checking → Finishing → Ironing → Packing → Finished Stock\*\*
 



 \* Maintain clear status of every running production lot/style.
 



 \* Follow up continuously with cutting, stitching, checking, finishing, and packing teams.
 



 \* Ensure planned quantities are completed according to daily and weekly production targets.
 



 \* Identify production delays or bottlenecks early and coordinate with the concerned team to resolve them.
 



 \* Monitor pending quantities at every production stage.
 



 \* Ensure completed production is properly transferred into finished\-goods stock.
 



 \* Coordinate production priorities based on stock availability, marketplace sales, and upcoming requirements.
 



 \* Report important delays, shortages, quality issues, or production risks to management.
 



  





 \#\#\#\# Sampling Follow\-Up
 



  





 \* Take responsibility for \*\*sampling follow\-up from requirement to final approved sample\*\*.
 



 \* Coordinate with the concerned teams for fabric, accessories, cutting, stitching, and finishing of samples.
 



 \* Maintain a proper list of all pending, ongoing, completed, and approved samples.
 



 \* Follow up on new product developments and ensure samples are completed within the required timeline.
 



 \* Track corrections or modifications requested in samples and ensure revised samples are completed.
 



 \* Coordinate approved samples with production teams before bulk production begins.
 



 \* Ensure sample specifications, measurements, colours, construction, and other requirements are properly communicated to production.
 



  





 \#\#\#\# Stock Maintenance \& Inventory Control
 



  





 \* Maintain accurate \*\*raw material, work\-in\-progress and finished\-goods stock\*\*.
 



 \* Ensure all production received into the warehouse is properly counted and recorded.
 



 \* Maintain correct inward, outward, transfer, and adjustment records.
 



 \* Regularly compare \*\*physical stock with system stock\*\* and identify differences.
 



 \* Monitor stock levels SKU\-wise, including size and colour availability.
 



 \* Identify fast\-moving, low\-stock, excess\-stock, and slow\-moving products.
 



 \* Inform management and production teams about products requiring replenishment.
 



 \* Ensure proper storage and organisation so products can be easily located, picked, and dispatched.
 



 \* Prevent stock mismatches, misplaced inventory, and unnecessary accumulation of stock.
 



 \* Maintain proper records for damaged, returned, rejected, and second\-quality products.
 



  





 \#\#\#\# Warehouse \& Dispatch Management
 



  





 \* Take overall responsibility for \*\*warehouse organisation and daily operations\*\*.
 



 \* Supervise picking, checking, packing, invoicing, and dispatch.
 



 \* Ensure customer and marketplace orders are dispatched accurately and on time.
 



 \* Monitor pending orders and ensure there are no avoidable dispatch delays.
 



 \* Coordinate courier and logistics pickups.
 



 \* Ensure the correct SKU, colour, size, and quantity are dispatched against every order.
 



 \* Manage returned products and ensure they are checked, classified, and correctly added back to stock where applicable.
 



 \* Supervise warehouse, packing, and dispatch staff and allocate daily responsibilities.
 



  





 \#\#\#\# E\-Commerce Operations
 



  





 \* Coordinate day\-to\-day operational activities for channels such as \*\*Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, JioMart and the company website\*\*.
 



 \* Monitor marketplace orders and ensure they are processed within required timelines.
 



 \* Coordinate inventory availability across different sales channels.
 



 \* Monitor cancellations, returns, RTOs, replacements, and operational issues.
 



 \* Coordinate with the warehouse and production teams when marketplace stock needs replenishment.
 



 \* Ensure marketplace operational issues affecting dispatch or inventory are followed up and resolved.
 



  





 \#\#\# Daily Monitoring \& Reporting
 



  





 The Operations Manager should always have a clear picture of:
 



  





 \* What is currently under cutting.
 



 \* What is under stitching.
 



 \* What is pending in checking/finishing.
 



 \* What is ready for packing.
 



 \* What production is completed.
 



 \* What sampling is pending.
 



 \* What stock is running low.
 



 \* What stock needs replenishment.
 



 \* What orders are pending dispatch.
 



 \* What operational issues require immediate attention.
 



  





 Maintain simple and accurate daily reports for \*\*production status, sampling status, stock, dispatch, returns and pending issues\*\*.
 



  





 \#\#\# Candidate Requirements
 



  





 \* \*\*2–7 years of experience\*\* in garments, textiles, production, warehouse, e\-commerce operations, or related roles.
 



 \* Experience in the \*\*Tirupur garment/textile industry is strongly preferred\*\*.
 



 \* Good understanding of garment production processes from \*\*cutting to packing\*\*.
 



 \* Strong production follow\-up ability.
 



 \* Experience in \*\*sampling coordination and follow\-up\*\* is preferred.
 



 \* Good understanding of stock maintenance and warehouse operations.
 



 \* E\-commerce marketplace experience is an added advantage.
 



 \* Comfortable using Excel, Google Sheets, ERP/software systems, and online dashboards.
 



 \* Strong follow\-up skills and ability to get work completed on time.
 



 \* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and workers simultaneously.
 



 \* Should be organised, responsible, practical, and capable of taking ownership.
 



 \* Tamil communication is essential; working knowledge of English is preferred.
 



  





 \#\#\# What We Are Looking For
 



  





 The most important quality for this position is \*\*follow\-up and ownership\*\*.
 



  





 The candidate should not simply collect production updates. They should actively ensure that work moves continuously through:
 



  





 \*\*Sampling → Production Planning → Cutting → Stitching → Checking → Finishing → Packing → Stock → Order Processing → Dispatch\*\*
 



  





 If production is delayed, stock is mismatched, a sample is pending, or an order is stuck, the Operations Manager should identify the problem, follow up with the responsible person, and drive it toward completion.
 



  





 \#\#\# Salary
 



  





 \*\*₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month\*\*
 



  





 Salary will depend on experience, garment production knowledge, production follow\-up capability, sampling exposure, stock\-management skills, e\-commerce knowledge, and team\-handling ability.

title: Vendor & Delivery Operations Manager — Contract Staffing
description:
We're hiring someone to own the operational backbone of our contract staffing delivery: the vendor panel, all deployment documentation, and everything that happens between a candidate's selection and their first day at the client.
 



  





 We recently crossed 50 active deployments and are scaling fast. That growth has outpaced our operational structure — this role exists to build it properly.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own the vendor panel end to end: onboarding, agreements, rate negotiation, compliance documentation and performance scorecards
* Set and enforce vendor quality standards, tracking submission\-to\-selection performance by vendor
* Manage all deployment documentation — client onboarding paperwork, background verification, compliance packs — so nothing delays a start date
* Own post\-selection candidate management: offer to onboarding to day one at the client, including joining commitment and follow\-through
* Build repeatable SOPs and tracking so the process scales with headcount



  





**Qualifications** 



* 4–8 years in vendor management, resource management or delivery operations within IT contract staffing or staff augmentation
* Hands\-on experience managing a sub\-vendor panel, including commercial negotiation on rates and terms
* Strong command of deployment documentation and compliance — BGV, client onboarding formalities, contracts
* Experience managing candidates through the offer\-to\-joining window, with a track record of reducing drop\-offs
* Comfortable owning a process independently and improving it, rather than waiting for direction
* Working knowledge of an ATS/HRMS (we run Zoho Recruit and Zoho People)



 You'll thrive here if you've built or run vendor and delivery operations at a growing staffing firm, enjoy bringing structure to a fast\-moving environment, and want ownership of a function rather than a slice of one.
 



  





**Compensation** 




 ₹6–12 LPA, based on experience and the process maturity you bring.

description:

 The Operations Manager will oversee day\-to\-day contact center and customer engagement operations, ensuring smooth delivery of services and adherence to quality standards. Responsibilities include managing teams, monitoring performance metrics, optimizing processes, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to meet client expectations. The role involves resource planning, workload allocation, and troubleshooting operational issues to maintain high service levels and customer satisfaction. The Operations Manager will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, implement best practices, and support training and development of team members. * Proficiency in using CRM tools, contact center technologies, and basic data analysis for reporting and decision\-making.

**Job Description – IT Operations / IT Manager**
**Location: Bangalore\| Experience: 10\+ years \|Team: 5–8 IT professionals \| User base: \~500\-person IT organization**
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500\-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands\-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end\-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5–8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day\-to\-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery.
   

  

* IT Operations, Service Management \& Service Delivery
* 
+ Lead day\-to\-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end\-user technology.
+ Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform.
+ Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction.
+ Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post\-incident reviews.
+ Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities.
+ Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues.
+ Maintain a strong customer\-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users.

* Team Leadership \& People Management
* 
+ Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5–8 IT support and infrastructure professionals.
+ Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues.
+ Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge\-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team.
+ Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous\-improvement\-oriented culture.
+ Coordinate cross\-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives.

* IT Infrastructure, Network \& End\-User Computing
* 
+ Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end\-user devices.
+ Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services.
+ Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services.
+ Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal.
+ Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access\-card coordination with HR.
+ Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand.
+ Maintain disk\-capacity and infrastructure\-health reports and proactively address capacity risks.

* Cloud Management \& Cost Optimization
* 
+ Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable.
+ Support cloud services and customer\-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources.
+ Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps\-style cost optimization.
+ Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management.
+ Balance on\-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership.

* Software, License, Patch \& Configuration Management
* 
+ Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project\-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization.
+ Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central.
+ Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers.
+ Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance.
+ Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones.

* DevOps, Git \& CI/CD Operations
* 
+ Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices.
+ Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable.
+ Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least\-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties.
+ Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams.
+ Lead infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration\-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable.
+ Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.

* Cybersecurity, Risk \& Compliance
* 
+ Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls.
+ Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management.
+ Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
+ Manage endpoint protection and antivirus/EDR platforms such as Cortex and ensure security agents remain healthy and current.
+ Oversee identity and access management, privileged access, access reviews, endpoint security, network security, and incident response.
+ Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and support ISO 27001 certification and audit requirements.
+ Participate in quarterly audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and management reviews.
+ Coordinate cybersecurity incidents, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned.

* Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy \& Governance
* 
+ Define and govern enterprise IT architecture standards, technology reference models, and infrastructure principles.
+ Establish vendor evaluation frameworks and technology selection criteria.
+ Define cloud adoption policies, technology lifecycle standards, and application rationalization roadmaps aligned with business strategy.
+ Partner with C\-suite and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and investment priorities.
+ Present IT performance metrics, risk posture, cybersecurity status, governance outcomes, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership.
+ Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, AIOps, and cloud platforms, and assess their operational and business value.

* AI, AIOps \& Automation
* 
+ Lead adoption of AIOps capabilities such as ML\-based event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and automated first\-line remediation.
+ Drive AI\-powered ITSM capabilities including intelligent ticket classification, AI\-driven routing, NLP\-based resolution recommendations, and predictive SLA\-breach alerts.
+ Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, support processes, monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities.
+ Architect and manage infrastructure for AI workloads, including on\-premises GPU platforms and cost\-optimized cloud AI services where appropriate.
+ Measure operational improvements from AI and automation initiatives, including reduced downtime, faster MTTR, and lower operating cost.

* Proactive Maintenance, Upgrades \& Business Continuity
* 
+ Plan and execute quarterly firmware upgrades for wireless access points and network equipment.
+ Implement and maintain automated OS patching and upgrade cycles for end\-user systems and servers.
+ Perform planned server OS upgrades and maintain application/platform upgrade schedules.
+ Perform quarterly GitLab version upgrades with appropriate validation, backup, rollback, and change\-management controls.
+ Maintain backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience plans for critical services.
+ Use monitoring and capacity data to identify and resolve issues before they impact users or customers.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Operational Governance
* 
+ Develop and maintain monthly IT dashboards covering service uptime, Internet uptime, network bandwidth, patch compliance, license renewals, ticket performance, disk usage, cloud spend, and security posture.
+ Produce monthly SLA and KPI reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.
+ Maintain operational dashboards and trend analysis to identify recurring incidents, capacity risks, cost anomalies, and improvement opportunities.
+ Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset records, service ownership information, escalation matrices, and operational runbooks.
+ Maintain and share access\-card server details with HR in accordance with access governance procedures.

* Procurement, Vendor \& Contract Management
* 
+ Own procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, accessories, network equipment, and technology services.
+ Manage vendor, MSP, telecom, cloud, and technology\-partner relationships.
+ Define and monitor vendor SLAs, KPIs, contracts, renewals, service quality, and operational performance.
+ Lead vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, renewals, and corrective actions in collaboration with procurement and leadership.
+ Ensure third\-party services meet requirements for availability, security, compliance, performance, and cost.

* IT Budget \& Financial Management
* 
+ Own IT CapEx and OpEx planning, forecasting, budget tracking, and financial reporting.
+ Manage cloud spend forecasting and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Optimize software licensing, infrastructure, telecom, support, and vendor costs without compromising service quality or security.
+ Present technology investment proposals and cost\-benefit analysis to leadership.

* Client \& Stakeholder Interaction
* 
+ Participate in client calls and technical discussions as required.
+ Provide service status, operational updates, logs, evidence, and technical information to clients in coordination with relevant teams.
+ Translate technical issues into clear business impact, resolution status, risk, and next steps for non\-technical stakeholders.
+ Build strong relationships with business leaders, customers, vendors, and internal technology teams.


**Preferred Qualifications \& Certifications**
* 
+ ITIL 4 certification.
+ ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor; CISSP or CISM is advantageous.
+ AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications.
+ CompTIA or other infrastructure/security certifications.
+ TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
+ PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent project\-management certification.
+ Terraform, Kubernetes, or DevOps\-related certifications.


**Key Competencies**
* 
+ IT Operations Leadership
+ Infrastructure \& Network Management
+ Cloud \& FinOps
+ IT Service Management \& ITIL
+ Cybersecurity \& Compliance
+ DevOps \& Automation
+ AI/AIOps \& Intelligent IT Operations
+ Enterprise Architecture \& Technology Strategy
+ Vendor \& Contract Management
+ Budget \& Cost Management
+ Problem\-Solving \& Incident Management
+ Customer Service \& Empathy
+ Executive Communication \& Stakeholder Management
+ Proactive Approach \& Continuous Improvement
+ Team Leadership \& People Development


**Key Performance Indicators**
* 
+ IT infrastructure and service availability / uptime.
+ SLA compliance, ticket resolution time, backlog, and user satisfaction.
+ Major incident frequency, MTTR, recurrence, and root\-cause closure.
+ Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance.
+ Cloud spend against budget and measurable cost optimization.
+ Software/license compliance and renewal management.
+ Vendor/MSP performance against contractual SLAs.
+ Audit findings, security compliance, and ISO 27001/ISMS performance.
+ Change success rate and change\-related incidents.
+ Automation/AIOps adoption and measurable reduction in downtime and operational effort.
+ Successful delivery of infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle activities, and technology roadmaps.


**Role Impact**
 The IT Manager / IT Operations Lead is accountable for building a stable, secure, scalable, cost\-effective, and business\-aligned IT environment. The role combines strong operational discipline with strategic technology leadership, proactive service improvement, automation, cybersecurity governance, cloud optimization, and people leadership. The successful candidate will help transform IT into a highly reliable, measurable, customer\-focused, and continuously improving technology function.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**📌 About Us** 




 Posha is building robot kitchens for the future.
 



 Our first product, the Posha Countertop was recognized as one of
 **TIME’s Best Inventions of 2025** 
 and received rave reviews from
 **The Verge** 
 and
 **WIRED** 
 for bringing robotics and AI into everyday kitchens.
 



 We’re a fast\-growing
 **Series A–funded** 
 startup backed by
 **Accel Partners** 
 and we’re just getting started.
 



  





 See it in action: https://youtu.be/Ubd6NkZOEkM?si\=SFex\-isehKHzvZs\_
 



  





**🤔 What can I expect from this role?** 




 Posha is building an AI\-powered automated cooking robot and needs a Supply Chain Manager to own material readiness and supplier strategy through our next phase of growth — someone equally comfortable digging into a BOM with an engineer, negotiating with a critical supplier, and building the systems that prevent the next fire before it starts.
 



  





**🔧 What will my work responsibilities look like if I join Posha?** 




  





 🌐
 **Sourcing \& Procurement** 



* Manage 50\+ vendors across off\-the\-shelf and manufactured components — servo/BLDC motors, actuators, display modules, camera modules, flow sensors, power supplies etc.,.
* Own sourcing of manufactured parts: sheet metal, casting, CNC, injection molding, gear hobbing, PCB fab/PCBA.
* Bring genuine technical fluency in specs, tolerances, and process capability to evaluate quotes, flag DFM issues, and hold real technical conversations with engineering and suppliers.
* Vet and onboard new CMs/vendors via structured RFQ.
* Lead CM transitions and qualification — DVT/PVT, tooling transfer, FAI.
* Build manufacturing partnerships ground\-up, including on\-site visits.



  





 🦾
 **Material Planning \& Readiness** 



* Own material planning across development builds, NPI, and mass production.
* Drive PO placement and tracking with proactive risk visibility.
* Manage safety stock and inventory across raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.



  





 🤝
 **Commercial Negotiation \& Supplier Relationships** 



* Build suppliers as long\-term partners, not transactions.
* Hit cost targets via should\-cost modeling; negotiate piece pricing, tooling/NRE, terms, MOQs, lead times
* Run supplier scorecards on delivery, quality, responsiveness, and financial health.



  





 👀
 **Supplier Risk \& Resilience** 



* Identify BOM single points of failure and build backup sourcing.
* Assess supplier capacity and readiness.
* Mitigate risk from lead times, design changes, and capacity constraints through alternate sourcing and risk buys.



  





 🛠️
 **Engineering Partnership** 



* Partner with Hardware/R\&D on DFM, value engineering, and component selection.
* Align with Finance on costing / cash flow and Ops on demand forecasting.



  





 📊
 **Supplier Quality** 



* Own incoming quality standards, FAI, and vendor qualification end\-to\-end.
* Track PPM, CAPA closure, and audit scores through a scorecard/review cadence.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on quality escapes and drive CAPA to closure.
* Conduct supplier audits and build quality requirements into sourcing decisions upfront.



  





 🤖
 **Systems \& Reporting** 



* Build ERP\-based systems from the ground up for an eagle's\-eye view across procurement, inventory, and vendor performance.
* Maintain BOM traceability, AVL documentation, and build reporting dashboards.



  





 ✅ Requirements
 


* 4\+ years in supply chain/sourcing/manufacturing with hands\-on sourcing across the component and manufactured\-part categories above, backed by real technical knowledge — not just vendor management.
* Engineering background (Mechanical, Electronics, or Industrial) preferred.
* Proven NPI/industrialisation experience, prototype through volume production.
* Exceptional attention to detail and forecasting ability — spots quality/defect/supply risk early, decides on data.
* Strong relationship\-building across people, vendors, and ecosystems in India, China, and the US.
* High\-ownership operator, comfortable with ambiguity and building process from scratch.
* Proven ability to lead/build a team — this role grows into leading one.
* Willingness to travel is required, primarily to China, with periodic travel within India.



  





**🚀 What The World Thinks of Posha** 



* Posha is comparable to Tesla FSD
* “
 *Posha is a fairly good sign that the future is closer than I thought* 
 ” \- The Verge
* *Posha’s tagline is “See dinner cook itself, and it largely lives up to this.”* 
 \- WIRED



  





 🍝
 **Why Posha?** 



* Few organizations offer challenges similar to ours. Building completely autonomous cooking robots requires thinking from first principles and building from ground up.
* We believe that Posha is a generational company with the opportunity to alter the trajectory of how food is cooked inside homes today. This opportunity is parallel to how autonomous cars have made an impact.
* This role will be at the forefront of this opportunity.

title: Central Monitoring Associate Manager
description:
**Job Overview**

Conducts review of the applicable Informatics platform and communicates findings at the country, study, site, subject level. Provides Central monitoring support to the study team and to the client. Requires working knowledge of broader drug development and clinical trials. The role is responsible for the conduct of central monitoring activities in a timely manner. Oversee the trial progress as per the defined plan and notify any changes/risk and escalate as appropriate.

* Performs the Central monitoring activities for multiple studies for customers and ensures accurate tracking and status reporting of studies in their remit.

* Support Manager and leadership in preparation of detailed study risk assessment and in Sponsor presentations / bid defenses.
* Ensures that tracking and status reporting are performed in a timely and accurate manner.

* Supports the Data Expert with Critical Data and Process Definition and EDC design implementation.
* Supports the development of informatics Platform requirements, including design of the visualizations, taking into consideration the data feeds for the study (EDC, laboratory, etc.).
* Collates requirements including prescriptive risk factor mitigation strategies, SDV strategy, study\-specific risk factor definition, variable risk factor trigger levels.
* Draft the Configuration Plan and all other applicable Plans in collaboration with the study team and update these on an ongoing basis including the refinement of visualizations and any edits in line with emerging risk profile and study changes.
* Edits the Central Monitoring and other applicable plans in line with emerging risk profile and study changes.
* Populates the tools, tests variable risk factors, adjusts trigger levels, study specific risk factors and central monitoring parameters.
* Performs ongoing reviews, prepares, and recommends mitigation actions and reviews recommended monitoring levels with project team and ensures that identified issues are followed to resolution.
* Proposes potential changes to monitoring intervention level on behalf of the project team in line with overall strategies.
* Prepares and distributes the Project/Study Reports at intervals during study conduct and at study close out.
* Undertakes Central Monitoring (Site, subject and study level review as applicable) activities to ensure consistency and effectiveness.
* Take responsibility for inspection readiness for activities; support regulatory authority inspections when needed.
* Perform subject level review activities and coordinate with the stakeholders to address the findings if applicable.
* Performs study analytics reviews as per the applicable plans and communicates the findings appropriately.
* Provide data\-driven decisions and communicate these findings proactively and effectively to the key stakeholders.
* Prepares and distributes the Project Quality and Risk Reports at intervals during study conduct and at study close out.
* Performs specialized review of central data review tools, based on specific area of expertise (clinical, data or statistics).
* Implements P3 thinking to identify the need for study scope changes and risk profile changes.
* Provides technical leadership to study teams to ensure effective implementation of the process and tools.
* Evaluates and collates process improvement suggestions and submits to leadership.
* Evaluates and submits ideas and justification for improved systems and tools to leadership.
* Submits ideas to increase sales by positioning central monitoring and Informatics Platform with clients.

Assign and classify tasks to the employees. Supervise, Mentor, and evaluate performance of staff to ensure career development, interpersonal skills, and achievement of Competency standards. Looking after the work force’s HR needs. Assist in recruitment of new staff. Budgeting and scheduling for work force required to perform tasks. Ensure the smooth functioning of department in the organization. Responsible for managing Performance review and issues of direct reports.
* All other duties as needed or assigned.


**Qualifications (Minimum Required)**
* University / college degree from an appropriately accredited institution.
* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.


**Experience (Minimum Required)**
* Minimum of 6\-8 years of relevant clinical research experience in a pharmaceutical company/CRO or other equivalent experience with increasing levels of responsibility in clinical trial related roles e.g., project management, clinical monitoring, data management and informatics

* Global.

**Role Title: Manager Cross Liability and Aggregation** 




**Position Summary:** 




 This role will provide managerial support to Centralized Cross Liability and Aggregation Analysis team members. In support of the broader Centralized Cross Liability team, this role will also monitor the general inbox; assign submissions to team members based on complexity and bandwidth; and report KPIs monthly. Completing complex cross liability scenarios is also substantial part of the role.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 



* Provide managerial support to Centralized Cross Liability and Aggregation Analysis team members.
* Monitor cross liability requests received from Operations in the general inbox and prioritize workload effectively to team based on complexity and bandwidth; and report KPIs monthly.
* Complete a full cross liability analysis for each of the requested accounts. Identify locations that have cross liability exposures that warrant a line setting (LS)adjustment – reviewing risk quality, confirming the appropriate maximum foreseen loss (MFL), documenting underwriting intent, allocating premium and binding the final structure in the system – beyond what Risk Transfer would otherwise have generated.
* Act as a point of contact for operations, underwriting and other functions. In a timely fashion communicate back to the operations cross liability analysis findings for the requested account including any necessary adjustment(s) to reinsurance line settings. Provide technical guidance on line setting approaches, ensuring insurance capacity structures appropriately reflect cross liability, underwriting intent and reinsurance protection Determine line setting diagrams and capacity allocations and communicate line setting instructions to the operations for cross liability capacity impacted locations.
