description:
**Job title:** 
**Business Outcome Lead \- Sub Value Stream**
* The Business Outcome Lead (GCB4\) is accountable for defining, driving, and evidencing measurable outcomes across the IWPB Contact Centre within the Voice Channels and Conversational Banking Valuestream. Operating across AMH, EMEA and US markets, the role owns a balanced scorecard that delivers sustainable improvements in cost/capacity, customer experience (CX) and risk/control uplift.
* This role leads cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Digital, Technology, Data, Finance, Risk/Compliance and Change—focusing teams on outcomes and benefits realisation rather than outputs.


**Opening a world of opportunity**
* HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations. In this role, you’ll help shape and deliver change that improves how customers are served and supported, strengthening resilience and experience across our Contact Centres—work that impacts customers’ everyday lives.
* HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and we’re proud to support an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.


**In This Role, You Will**
**Key accountabilities**
**Own the multi\-market outcomes framework and balanced scorecard**
* Define the outcomes framework across Cost/Capacity, CX, Risk/Control with standardised KPI definitions, baselines, targets, and tolerance thresholds.
* Ensure comparability across markets while allowing calibrated local targets based on regulatory, operating model and customer behaviour differences.
* Establish clear ownership for each KPI and benefit line (global vs market).


**Build and govern the outcome roadmap for Voice \& Conversational Banking**
* Create and maintain a prioritised 12–18 month outcomes roadmap across all in\-scope SVS channels.
* Run quarterly planning and prioritisation, explicitly managing trade\-offs between automation, service levels, customer outcomes and control obligations.
* Identify “build once, leverage many” opportunities and drive replication across AMH/EMEA/US.


**Benefits Definition, Tracking And Sustained Realisation**
* Develop robust business cases for initiatives (capacity release, cost\-to\-serve reduction, demand reduction, conversion/retention where applicable, and risk reduction).
* Implement benefits governance: baselines, benefit methodology, assumptions register, dependency mapping, and post\-go\-live sustainability checks.
* Partner with Finance to ensure benefits are measurable, credible, and audit\-ready (including clear distinction between capacity release and cash savings).


**Channel performance optimisation across SVS scope**
* Accountable for outcome oversight and optimisation across:
* Voice SVS
* AI Enabled Voice \& Chat Services SVS
* Chat Platforms SVS
* Chatbot \& Voicebot SVS
* Including:
* Define channel\-specific KPIs (FCR, AHT/handle time, service level/ASA, chat response times, abandon/timeout, transfer rates, containment/deflection, repeat contacts, rework).
* Drive demand and driver analysis (avoidable contacts, failure demand, bot\-to\-agent transfers, chat\-to\-voice escalation).
* Improve end\-to\-end journeys and handovers (bot → agent, chat → voice) to reduce customer effort and repeat contact.
* Ensure outcomes support customers requiring human assistance, including vulnerable customers, with appropriate guardrails.


**Insight\-led performance governance and decision support**
* Establish a multi\-time\-zone governance cadence (weekly performance pulse, monthly outcomes review, quarterly business reviews).
* Produce executive\-ready reporting: narrative, insights, trend drivers, benefits status, risks/issues, and decisions required.
* Promote consistent data definitions and measurement standards across markets and partners.


**Embed risk, conduct and controls into outcome delivery**
* Work with Risk/Compliance to ensure initiatives strengthen controls (QA, complaints, vulnerability handling, record\-keeping, data privacy; AI governance where relevant).
* Track risk/control uplift alongside efficiency and CX to prevent single\-metric optimisation.
* Ensure evidence is maintained to support audit, regulatory and internal assurance needs.


**Senior stakeholder management and influence (no direct authority)**
* Influence senior stakeholders across the ValueStream and markets to align priorities, secure commitments, and remove blockers.
* Proactively manage dependencies between Operations, Technology, Digital, Data and Change teams; escalate with options, impact assessment and recommendations.


**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge, skills and experience**
**Essential**
* Strong experience in Contact Centre / servicing operations and/or transformation, preferably within financial services.
* Proven outcomes and benefits management capability: KPI design, baselining, benefit sizing, tracking, and sustainability.
* Strong analytical skills: demand/call\-driver analysis, root cause investigation, insight\-to\-action prioritisation.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multi\-market, matrixed organisations and lead through influence.
* Excellent executive communication: concise, decision\-oriented reporting and governance leadership.


**Desirable**
* Experience with conversational banking, chat platforms, chatbots/voicebots, and AI\-enabled servicing.
* Genesys experience/working knowledge (desirable).
* Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, Agile delivery, OKRs/outcome\-based planning.


**Role level / complexity**
* Significant autonomy with accountability for multi\-market outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Shapes priorities and performance management across the Voice Channels and Conversational Banking ValueStream.
* Drives cross\-functional alignment and sustained adoption without direct people management authority.

* Voice Channels \& Conversational Banking ValueStream leadership
* IWPB Contact Centre leadership across AMH, EMEA, US

* Digital Channels, Product, CX/VoC, Data \& Analytics

title: Senior Manager - Order Fulfillment - FC Operations
description:
Overview:

Role Purpose
The Head of Order Fulfilment is responsible for leading end\-to\-end order execution across multiple distribution centers, warehouses, and fulfillment locations, ensuring superior customer service, on\-time delivery, inventory accuracy, Quality and operational excellence. The role drives standardization, process optimization, productivity, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement across the fulfillment network while partnering with Sales, Customer Service, Planning, Transportation, Sourcing, and Operations teams.  

Key Responsibilities
1\. End\-to\-End Order Fulfilment Leadership* Lead the end\-to\-end order fulfilment process from order receipt through Order Shipping.
* Ensure achievement of customer service, OTS (On\-Time Shipment), and order cycle\-time targets.
* Support Establish fulfillment strategies aligned with business growth objectives.
* Drive seamless coordination between planning, inventory, warehousing, transportation, and customer service functions.
* Manage fulfillment performance across multiple Fulfilment Centres warehouses, distribution centers, and third\-party logistics providers.


2\. Multi\-Site Operations Management* Lead fulfillment operations across regional and national distribution networks.
* Standardize processes, operating procedures, and performance metrics across all locations.
* Develop and monitor capacity plans to support volume growth, Month End and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure consistent execution of safety, quality, and compliance standards across sites.
* Conduct regular operational reviews with site leaders to drive accountability and performance.


3\. Customer Service Excellence* Deliver superior customer experience through reliable and accurate order execution.
* Manage customer order prioritization and exception handling during supply constraints.
* Collaborate with commercial teams to improve service levels and customer satisfaction.
* Lead root\-cause analysis of service failures and implement corrective actions.


4\. Inventory and Order Management* Co\-ordinate with planning team on inventory availability and allocation strategies support business requirements.
* Drive inventory accuracy through strong warehouse controls and Physical / cycle counting processes.
* Plan and Optimize order waves, allocation rules, and fulfillment priorities especially during month ends.
* Partner with planning and procurement teams to minimize stock\-outs and excess inventory.


5\. Continuous Improvement and Productivity* Lead Quality initiative and continuous improvement initiatives across fulfillment operations.
* Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, and process simplification, working along with Business Analytical and Projects team.
* Drive labor productivity improvements and cost optimization programs.
* Implement best practices and benchmark performance across industry standards.


6\. Technology, Systems and Digital Enablement* Own fulfillment\-related processes within ERP, WMS, OMS, and transportation management systems.
* Drive adoption of digital tools, automation, analytics, and reporting platforms.
* Improve visibility across the order\-to\-delivery process using real\-time dashboards.
* Support system upgrades, implementations, and Implementation of System integration projects with 3PL partners.


7\. Financial and Cost Management* Manage fulfillment budgets and operational expenses.
* Deliver productivity savings and cost reduction initiatives without compromising service.
* Monitor warehousing, labor and inventory carrying costs.
* Develop business cases for network optimization and capital investments.


8\. People Leadership* Lead and develop regional fulfillment managers, warehouse leaders, and support teams.
* Establish a high\-performance culture focused on accountability and continuous improvement.
* Develop succession plans and capability\-building programs.
* Foster a culture of safety, engagement, and customer focus.


9\. Over all Supply Chain Knowledge* Should possess end\-to\-end supply chain expertise encompassing demand and inventory planning, S\&OP, and network capacity optimization; bulk transportation through fleet management, route optimization, carrier relationships, and freight cost control; warehousing operations including inventory accuracy, storage optimization, productivity, safety, and automation; logistics technology such as ERP, WMS, TMS, OMS, real\-time visibility tools, analytics, AI, and IoT; order fulfillment processes from order receipt to delivery with a focus on OTIF, fill rate, and customer service; and last\-mile delivery involving route efficiency, delivery partner management, customer experience, and reverse logistics. Success in the role requires balancing cost, service, inventory, and operational efficiency while driving continuous improvement, digital transformation, stakeholder collaboration, and high\-performing teams.


Qualifications* Bachelor's degree.
* Master's degree / MBA is desirable in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Operations Management, or related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as APICS (CPIM/CSCP), Six Sigma, Lean, or equivalent preferred.

  

Experience* 15\+ years of progressive supply chain, logistics, distribution, or fulfillment experience.
* Minimum 5\+ years in a senior leadership role managing multi\-site fulfillment operations.
* Proven experience leading large distribution center networks and third\-party logistics providers.
* Strong experience with ERP, WMS, OMS, and supply chain technology platforms.
* Demonstrated success in driving service improvements, productivity gains, and cost optimization.

  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)* OTIF (On\-Time In\-Full) \& Order Fill Rate, Order Cycle Time
* Perfect Order Performance
* Customer Service Level
* Inventory Accuracy
* Warehouse Productivity
* Cost per Order Fulfilled
* Distribution Cost as % of Sales
* Backorder Volume

Critical Competencies
Leadership* Strategic thinking, Inspiring and developing teams, Change management, Stakeholder management


Operational Excellence* Supply chain management, Distribution and warehousing, Inventory management, Process optimization


Business Acumen* Financial management, Data\-driven decision making, Risk management, Customer\-centric mindset

title: Pilot Line Head
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY** 




 The Head of Pilot Line Operations will lead end\-to\-end operations of the pilot manufacturing line, driving the scale\-up of cell assembly processes from development to reliable, repeatable production. This role owns the pilot plant's overall CapEx and OpEx, and is directly accountable for manufacturing throughput, yield performance, and plant safety. The ideal candidate brings strong technical grounding in process and manufacturing engineering combined with proven general\-management ownership of a production facility.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* **Process Scale\-Up:** 
 Lead the scale\-up of cell assembly processes from pilot to production\-representative scale, translating R\&D/process development outcomes into stable, manufactural operations.
* **Pilot Plant P\&L Ownership:** 
 Own and manage the pilot line's overall CapEx and OpEx budgets, ensuring capital deployment and operating spend align with production targets and business priorities.
* **Throughput \& Yield Management:** 
 Set and drive manufacturing throughput and yield targets across the line; identify and eliminate bottlenecks, and continuously improve process capability and equipment utilization.
* **Safety \& Compliance:** 
 Establish and enforce plant safety standards and operating protocols; ensure the pilot line meets all EHS, regulatory, and quality requirements.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** 
 Act as the general manager of the pilot line, coordinating process engineering, equipment/maintenance, quality, and production teams toward shared operational goals.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Drive root\-cause analysis and structured problem solving for process deviations; institutionalize best practices for future scale\-up to full production volumes.
* **Team Building \& Development:** 
 Recruit, mentor, and develop the pilot line team, building organizational capability to support the transition from pilot to full\-scale manufacturing.



**ESSENTIAL CORE QUALIFICATIONS** 



* PhD, Master's, or bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience scaling up cell assembly or comparable manufacturing processes from pilot to production scale.
* Proven track record managing pilot plant or manufacturing facility CapEx/OpEx budgets and overall operational P\&L.
* Strong working knowledge of manufacturing throughput optimization, yield improvement methods, and process capability analysis.
* Solid grounding in industrial safety standards, EHS compliance, and plant operating protocols.
* General\-management experience overseeing multi\-disciplinary operations teams within a manufacturing or pilot\-scale environment.

title: Kitchen Incharge
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sevalaya is a registered charitable trust established in 1988, working across multiple Indian states including Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Telangana. The organization delivers services in education, healthcare, rural development, and welfare, positively impacting over 1 million people. Sevalaya is professionally managed and guided by a dedicated Board of Trustees from diverse professional backgrounds, all committed to social development. The organization promotes the values of “Love All Serve All” and actively engages with the community, including through its social media presence.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Kitchen Incharge will oversee day\-to\-day operations of the kitchen, ensuring timely, nutritious, and hygienic food preparation for beneficiaries and staff. Responsibilities include planning menus, supervising cooking activities, monitoring food quality and portion control, and maintaining cleanliness and safety standards in all kitchen areas. The role involves managing kitchen inventory, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring compliance with food safety guidelines and organizational procedures. The Kitchen Incharge will also train and guide kitchen team members, coordinate meal schedules with program staff, and address feedback related to food service. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Tiruvallur.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Food Preparation and Cooking skills, with the ability to plan and execute large\-scale, nutritious meals.
* Candidates should demonstrate sound knowledge of Hygiene practices and compliance with food safety standards.
* Candidates should have effective Communication skills to coordinate with team members, vendors, and program staff.
* Candidates should exhibit Customer Service orientation, with a focus on respectful interaction and responsiveness to beneficiary needs.
* Experience in institutional or community kitchens, especially in nonprofit or social service settings, is an advantage.
* Ability to manage inventory, control wastage, and maintain records related to food supplies and consumption.
* Basic education with relevant training in culinary arts or hospitality is preferred; local language proficiency is beneficial.
* Strong organizational skills, reliability, and commitment to Sevalaya’s values of service and social development.

title: Manager, TMF Operations
description:
Manager, TMF Operations  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

As a Manager, Trial Master File (TMF) Operations at ICON, you will oversee the management, maintenance, and compliance of the Trial Master File (TMF) for clinical research studies.

  

  

**What You Will Do:**

You will oversee trial master file management workstreams, ensuring deliverables meet quality and timeline expectations.
  

  

Key responsibilities include:


* Managing the TMF Operations team responsible for maintaining the Trial Master File (TMF) across multiple clinical studies, ensuring compliance with GCP and regulatory requirements.
* Overseeing the collection, review, and filing of essential documents, ensuring timely and accurate updates to the TMF throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams, including clinical operations, regulatory affairs, and quality assurance, to ensure TMF completeness and readiness for audits and inspections.
* Developing and implementing TMF management strategies, policies, and procedures to improve efficiency and ensure adherence to industry standards.
* Monitoring TMF quality metrics, identifying areas for improvement, and driving continuous process enhancements.
* Providing leadership and training to TMF staff, fostering a culture of quality and compliance within the team.
* Ensuring readiness of TMF for regulatory audits and client inspections, addressing any findings or gaps in documentation as needed.
  

  

**Your Profile:**

You will have solid trial master file management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.
  

  

Required qualifications and experience:


* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, documentation management, or a related discipline
* Extensive experience in TMF management or clinical operations within the pharmaceutical or clinical research industry.
* Strong understanding of GCP, ICH guidelines, and global regulatory requirements related to TMF management and clinical trial documentation.
* Proven leadership skills, with experience managing and developing teams in a fast\-paced, regulated environment.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to oversee multiple clinical studies and maintain high standards of documentation.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders.

title: Ecommerce Operations Manager
description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Work Arrangement:** 
 Work from Office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Industry:** 
 Fashion, Retail, D2C or E\-commerce
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on
 **E\-commerce Operations Manager** 
 to join our existing e\-commerce team in Hyderabad.
 



 The candidate will work closely with order\-processing, warehouse, retail\-store, catalogue, customer\-support, logistics, finance and technology teams to ensure smooth day\-to\-day e\-commerce operations.
 



 This is a cross\-functional role requiring strong coordination, problem\-solving and follow\-up skills. The candidate will support different teams, monitor execution, resolve operational issues and help improve the overall customer experience.
 



  





 Key ResponsibilitiesOrder and Fulfilment Operations
 


* Monitor the complete order journey, from order placement to successful delivery.
* Process and track orders using
 **Vinculum OMS and Shopify** 
 .
* Coordinate order fulfilment across warehouses and retail showrooms.
* Monitor pending, unfulfilled, delayed, cancelled and failed\-delivery orders.
* Coordinate with stores, warehouses and logistics partners to resolve fulfilment issues.
* Track picking, packing, invoicing, dispatch and delivery timelines.
* Support domestic and international order operations.
* Monitor returns, exchanges, refunds and RTO orders.



  





 Inventory and Omnichannel Operations
 


* Monitor inventory availability and synchronization across Shopify, Vinculum, warehouses and stores.
* Identify inventory mismatches and coordinate with the appropriate teams for resolution.
* Support stock allocation and omnichannel order fulfilment.
* Monitor out\-of\-stock products and inventory\-related order failures.
* Assist teams with inventory reconciliation and stock\-related reporting.
* Escalate recurring inventory or system issues to the relevant stakeholders.



  





 Product Listing and Catalogue Management
 


* Work with the catalogue team to create and update products on Shopify.
* Review product titles, descriptions, images, prices, sizes, variants, tags and collections.
* Ensure product information is complete, accurate and correctly displayed.
* Coordinate with photography, content, merchandising and technology teams to resolve catalogue issues.
* Monitor product activation, deactivation and inventory visibility on the website.
* Conduct regular website checks to identify product and catalogue errors.



  





 Customer Support Coordination
 


* Work with the customer\-support team to resolve order\-related queries and escalations.
* Help resolve concerns related to delivery, cancellations, exchanges, returns and refunds.
* Coordinate with internal teams to provide customers with accurate and timely resolutions.
* Monitor recurring customer complaints and identify their operational root causes.
* Help maintain a consistent and positive customer experience.



  





 Reporting and Process Improvement
 


* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Analyse order, inventory, fulfilment, returns and customer\-support data.
* Track important operational KPIs, including:
* Order fulfilment turnaround time
* Pending and delayed orders
* Cancellation rate
* Return and RTO rate
* Inventory accuracy
* Customer\-query resolution time
* Highlight operational delays, gaps and recurring issues.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and coordinate corrective actions.
* Recommend improvements to reduce errors and improve efficiency.
* Prepare MIS reports and share actionable updates with management.



  





 Mandatory Experience and Skills
 


* **3–5 years of experience in e\-commerce operations.**
* Previous experience working with an
 **e\-commerce company, D2C brand or omnichannel retail business is mandatory** 
 .
* Hands\-on working experience with
 **Vinculum OMS is mandatory** 
 .
* Hands\-on working experience with
 **Shopify is mandatory** 
 .
* **Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are mandatory** 
 .
* Experience in order fulfilment, inventory management, product listing and customer support.
* Good understanding of shipping, returns, exchanges, refunds and RTO processes.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple teams and external partners.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a process\-oriented approach.



  





 Advanced Excel Requirements
 



 The candidate must be proficient in:
 


* PivotTables and PivotCharts
* XLOOKUP and VLOOKUP
* INDEX\-MATCH
* SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and IF formulas
* Data cleaning and reconciliation
* Conditional formatting
* MIS reports and dashboards
* Handling and analysing large datasets



  





 Educational Qualification
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Operations, Supply Chain, Retail Management or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant practical experience in e\-commerce operations will be given significant importance.



  





 Preferred Languages
 



 The candidate should preferably be able to communicate in:
 


* English
* Telugu
* Hindi



  





 Preferred Candidate Profile
 


* Experience in fashion, apparel or lifestyle e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Experience coordinating with retail showrooms and warehouses is preferred.
* Familiarity with omnichannel fulfilment will be beneficial.
* Comfortable working with data, systems and operational reports.
* Collaborative and capable of working effectively with existing teams.
* Proactive in identifying issues, following up and ensuring closure.
* Willing to work from the office in Hyderabad.



  





 Success in This Role
 



 The candidate will be successful by helping the team achieve:
 


* Faster and more accurate order fulfilment
* Better inventory accuracy
* Timely resolution of operational issues
* Accurate and complete product listings
* Reduced cancellations and fulfilment failures
* Better coordination between departments
* Improved customer satisfaction



  





**Important:** 
 This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office position in Hyderabad. Candidates without relevant e\-commerce experience or hands\-on knowledge of
 **Vinculum, Shopify and Advanced Excel** 
 will not be considered.

We want to empower our 6,500\+ employees \- from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries \- to each achieve their potential. Through IQ\-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
   

  

 We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL)** 
 : AGEL is part of the Adani Group’s promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group’s philosophy of Growth with Goodness’, the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility\- scale grid\-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government\- backed corporations. On the back of long\-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar \& wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round\-the\-clock green power to India’s grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Site Head (Small) \- Solar O\&M is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of a small\-scale solar energy site (0\-50 MW), ensuring financial, operational, and safety targets are met consistently. This role includes monitoring budgets, maintaining high standards of safety and compliance, and achieving operational metrics that contribute to the organization’s sustainability and growth objectives. Additionally, the Site Head is responsible for personnel management, asset and inventory optimization, and ensuring adherence to all regulatory and audit standards. The primary goal is to meet and exceed site performance targets while fostering a culture of safety, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Financial Management and Reporting:**
 Track and reconcile monthly budgets versus actuals, providing analyses and justifications for any deviations.
   

  

 Oversee OPEX, CAPEX, and procurement budgets, ensuring alignment with financial targets for the solar site.
   

  

 Ensure timely processing of payments and manage the financial performance to meet revenue and cost targets.
   

  

 Implement SAP comprehensively, including preventive and breakdown maintenance (PM/BM) scheduling, notifications, and issue resolution.
   

  

 Analyze daily interruption records and initiate RCA and CAPA processes to proactively address and eliminate recurring issues, thus improving solar asset reliability.
   

  

**Operational Excellence And Compliance**
 Meet periodic performance metrics specific to solar operations, including Performance Ratio (PR), Capacity Utilization Factor (CUF), Plant Availability (PA), and Grid Availability (GA).
   

  

 Ensure zero repetitive audit observations and address audit points promptly within IMS and MAAS standards.

title: Manager, Cyber Fusion Center
description:
**Job Summary**
 Are you passionate about innovation that transforms everyday products into extraordinary experiences?
   

  

 IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health \& biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
   

  

 Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.
   

  

 The role is based in Hyderabad, India (Hybrid role). Be part of a motivated, passionate, and open\-minded team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
   

  

**Where You’ll Make a Difference**
* Lead and manage the Cyber Fusion Center’s day\-to\-day operations, ensuring effective collaboration across security monitoring, detection engineering, incident response, threat intelligence, and security automation functions.
* Own and manage enterprise email security platforms, including policy tuning, threat detection, phishing defense, reporting, escalation processes, and continuous improvement of email protection capabilities.
* Oversee endpoint security strategy and operations, including endpoint detection and response, policy enforcement, endpoint coverage, exception handling, and integration with broader security operations workflows.
* Manage SIEM capabilities, including log source onboarding, use case development, correlation rules, alert quality, dashboarding, metrics, and continuous improvement of detection coverage.
* Lead SOAR automation strategy, including development and optimization of playbooks, automated enrichment, response workflows, analyst efficiency improvements, and measurable reduction of manual effort.
* Build and mature the threat intelligence program by collecting, analyzing, prioritizing, and operationalizing intelligence to improve detection, prevention, incident response, and executive awareness. Develop operational metrics, executive reporting, and performance indicators to measure detection effectiveness, response readiness, automation value, endpoint coverage, and overall Cyber Fusion Center maturity.
* Plan, coordinate, and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises to test incident readiness, validate roles and responsibilities, identify process gaps, and improve organizational response maturity. Manage the enterprise Incident Response Plan, ensuring it remains current, accurate, tested, aligned with business and regulatory requirements, and continuously improved based on lessons learned.
* Serve as a senior escalation point during high\-priority cybersecurity incidents, coordinating technical response, executive communications, stakeholder alignment, containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident review activities. Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of cybersecurity professionals, fostering accountability, continuous improvement, technical excellence, and a strong security operations culture.
* Partner with IT, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to align cybersecurity operations with enterprise risk management, regulatory expectations, and business priorities. Ensure compliance with requirements mandating security tools on all applicable endpoints, including tracking coverage, identifying gaps, reporting exceptions, and driving remediation with infrastructure and endpoint teams.


**What Makes You The Right Fit**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or any other relevant discipline.
* Minimum 10\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, security operations, incident response, threat detection, or related technology leadership roles.
* 2\-4 years of team leadership experience, managing teams of 10\-15 employees in a high\-performance environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing or leading security operations capabilities, such as a SOC, Cyber Fusion Center, incident response team, detection engineering function, or security platform operations team.
* Hands\-on leadership experience with email security, endpoint security, SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, incident response, and security monitoring technologies.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory expectations, audit requirements, and operational controls related to enterprise security tooling and endpoint protection coverage.
* Proven ability to manage major security incidents, coordinate cross\-functional response, communicate with senior leadership, and drive effective post\-incident improvement actions.
* Experience developing and maintaining incident response plans, runbooks, playbooks, tabletop exercises, escalation procedures, and operational readiness documentation.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences.


**How Would You Stand Out?**
* Relevant industry certification required or strongly preferred, such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, GIAC, CCSP, or other cybersecurity, risk, incident response, or technology leadership certifications.


**Why Choose Us?**
* Multinational and supporting environment
* Health insurance
* Training opportunities
* Learning and development programs


**Important Information Regarding This Position**
 For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.
   

  

 We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity \& expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Assistant Facility Manager - Soft Services
description:
**Job Title**
 Assistant Facility Manager \- Soft Services
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 To manage and ensure effective day\-to\-day delivery of soft facility services, maintaining high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, workplace experience, safety, and employee satisfaction. The role will oversee service partners, monitor performance against SLAs/KPIs, drive continuous improvement, and ensure compliance with company and statutory requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
***Housekeeping \& Workplace Hygiene***
* Manage day\-to\-day housekeeping operations across office and common areas.
* Ensure defined cleaning standards, hygiene levels, and service frequencies are maintained.
* Conduct regular floor inspections and address service gaps proactively.
* Monitor washrooms, pantries, meeting rooms, cafeteria, common areas, and high\-traffic zones.
* Ensure availability of housekeeping consumables and cleaning materials.
* Drive periodic deep cleaning, pest control, façade cleaning, carpet cleaning, and other specialist services.


***Vendor \& Contract Management***
* Manage housekeeping, pantry, cafeteria, pest control, waste management, landscaping, and other soft\-service vendors.
* Monitor vendor manpower deployment, attendance, grooming, training, and productivity.
* Track SLA/KPI performance and initiate corrective actions for service deviations.
* Conduct regular vendor review meetings and maintain performance records.
* Support contract renewals, scope changes, service improvement initiatives, and vendor evaluations.


**Employee Experience \& Workplace Services**
* Ensure a clean, safe, hygienic, and welcoming workplace environment.
* Coordinate employee requests and complaints related to soft services.
* Monitor feedback and implement corrective/improvement actions.
* Support workplace events, employee engagement activities, and special requirements.
* Coordinate seating moves, office transitions, and other workplace activities from a soft\-services perspective.


***Cafeteria \& Pantry Operations***
* Monitor cafeteria and pantry services to ensure hygiene, food quality, service standards, and availability.
* Coordinate with food vendors on menu, service quality, employee feedback, and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with food safety and hygiene requirements.
* Conduct regular inspections and maintain records of observations and corrective actions.


***Waste Management \& Sustainability***
* Ensure proper segregation, collection, storage, and disposal of different waste streams.
* Monitor housekeeping waste handling and vendor compliance.
* Support sustainability initiatives such as waste reduction, recycling, and resource conservation.
* Maintain required documentation and records for waste management activities.


***Pest Control \& Landscaping***
* Monitor pest\-control activities and ensure scheduled treatments are completed.
* Maintain pest\-control records and close observations within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate landscaping services and ensure required standards are maintained in external/common areas.


***Compliance, Safety \& Audits***
* Ensure soft\-service operations comply with company policies, EHS requirements, statutory regulations, and site procedures.
* Participate in internal/external audits and inspections.
* Track and close audit observations within agreed timelines.
* Ensure vendor employees follow PPE, safety, access\-control, and workplace requirements.
* Report incidents, unsafe conditions, and service\-related risks promptly.


***Team Management***
* Supervise and coordinate FM soft\-services staff and vendor teams.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment as per approved staffing levels.
* Conduct daily briefings, toolbox talks, and service reviews.
* Identify training requirements and support capability development.
* Monitor discipline, attendance, grooming, and conduct of service personnel.


***Reporting \& Documentation***
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly operational reports.
* Maintain checklists, inspection reports, attendance records, SLA/KPI reports, and compliance documentation.
* Track complaints, corrective actions, and service improvement initiatives.
* Support preparation of management dashboards and periodic performance reviews.


***Budget \& Procurement Support***
* Monitor soft\-service operational expenses against approved budgets.
* Support procurement of consumables, services, and operational requirements.
* Validate vendor invoices against manpower deployment, service delivery, and contractual terms.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Housekeeping service quality and audit scores
* SLA/KPI compliance
* Employee satisfaction and complaint closure
* Vendor performance and manpower compliance
* Hygiene and sanitation standards
* Cafeteria/pantry service quality
* Audit and statutory compliance
* Timely closure of observations
* Budget adherence and cost optimization
* Incident and safety performance


**Qualification \& Experience**
* Graduate degree/diploma in Facility Management, Hospitality, Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in facilities management, workplace management, hospitality, or a similar environment.
* Experience managing housekeeping, cafeteria/pantry, pest control, waste management, and other soft services.
* Experience in vendor and manpower management.
* Good knowledge of workplace hygiene, safety, and facility\-management practices.
* Good communication, coordination, reporting, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Excel and facility\-management systems is preferred.

title: Assistant Facility Manager - Soft Services
description:
**Job Title**


Assistant Facility Manager \- Soft Services**Job Description Summary**


To manage and ensure effective day\-to\-day delivery of soft facility services, maintaining high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, workplace experience, safety, and employee satisfaction. The role will oversee service partners, monitor performance against SLAs/KPIs, drive continuous improvement, and ensure compliance with company and statutory requirements.**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

***Housekeeping \& Workplace Hygiene***

* Manage day\-to\-day housekeeping operations across office and common areas.
* Ensure defined cleaning standards, hygiene levels, and service frequencies are maintained.
* Conduct regular floor inspections and address service gaps proactively.
* Monitor washrooms, pantries, meeting rooms, cafeteria, common areas, and high\-traffic zones.
* Ensure availability of housekeeping consumables and cleaning materials.
* Drive periodic deep cleaning, pest control, façade cleaning, carpet cleaning, and other specialist services.

***Vendor \& Contract Management***

* Manage housekeeping, pantry, cafeteria, pest control, waste management, landscaping, and other soft\-service vendors.
* Monitor vendor manpower deployment, attendance, grooming, training, and productivity.
* Track SLA/KPI performance and initiate corrective actions for service deviations.
* Conduct regular vendor review meetings and maintain performance records.
* Support contract renewals, scope changes, service improvement initiatives, and vendor evaluations.

***Employee Experience \& Workplace Services***

* Ensure a clean, safe, hygienic, and welcoming workplace environment.
* Coordinate employee requests and complaints related to soft services.
* Monitor feedback and implement corrective/improvement actions.
* Support workplace events, employee engagement activities, and special requirements.
* Coordinate seating moves, office transitions, and other workplace activities from a soft\-services perspective.

***Cafeteria \& Pantry Operations***

* Monitor cafeteria and pantry services to ensure hygiene, food quality, service standards, and availability.
* Coordinate with food vendors on menu, service quality, employee feedback, and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with food safety and hygiene requirements.
* Conduct regular inspections and maintain records of observations and corrective actions.

***Waste Management \& Sustainability***

* Ensure proper segregation, collection, storage, and disposal of different waste streams.
* Monitor housekeeping waste handling and vendor compliance.
* Support sustainability initiatives such as waste reduction, recycling, and resource conservation.
* Maintain required documentation and records for waste management activities.

***Pest Control \& Landscaping***

* Monitor pest\-control activities and ensure scheduled treatments are completed.
* Maintain pest\-control records and close observations within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate landscaping services and ensure required standards are maintained in external/common areas.

***Compliance, Safety \& Audits***

* Ensure soft\-service operations comply with company policies, EHS requirements, statutory regulations, and site procedures.
* Participate in internal/external audits and inspections.
* Track and close audit observations within agreed timelines.
* Ensure vendor employees follow PPE, safety, access\-control, and workplace requirements.
* Report incidents, unsafe conditions, and service\-related risks promptly.

***Team Management***

* Supervise and coordinate FM soft\-services staff and vendor teams.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment as per approved staffing levels.
* Conduct daily briefings, toolbox talks, and service reviews.
* Identify training requirements and support capability development.
* Monitor discipline, attendance, grooming, and conduct of service personnel.

***Reporting \& Documentation***

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly operational reports.
* Maintain checklists, inspection reports, attendance records, SLA/KPI reports, and compliance documentation.
* Track complaints, corrective actions, and service improvement initiatives.
* Support preparation of management dashboards and periodic performance reviews.

***Budget \& Procurement Support***

* Monitor soft\-service operational expenses against approved budgets.
* Support procurement of consumables, services, and operational requirements.
* Validate vendor invoices against manpower deployment, service delivery, and contractual terms.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Housekeeping service quality and audit scores
* SLA/KPI compliance
* Employee satisfaction and complaint closure
* Vendor performance and manpower compliance
* Hygiene and sanitation standards
* Cafeteria/pantry service quality
* Audit and statutory compliance
* Timely closure of observations
* Budget adherence and cost optimization
* Incident and safety performance

**Qualification \& Experience**

* Graduate degree/diploma in Facility Management, Hospitality, Administration, or a related field.
* **5–8 years of experience** in facilities management, workplace management, hospitality, or a similar environment.
* Experience managing **housekeeping, cafeteria/pantry, pest control, waste management, and other soft services**.
* Experience in vendor and manpower management.
* Good knowledge of workplace hygiene, safety, and facility\-management practices.
* Good communication, coordination, reporting, and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Job Title:** 
 AVP– WM Client Management
   

  

**Department** 
 : Wealth Management Operations
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 Wealth Management \- Client Management Operations in ISPL started in 2019, provide back office services for BNP WM Singapore and Hong Kong. Processes include Client Reference Data and Reporting (since September 2019\)

 Client On\-Boarding team’s goal, is to ensure a global and consistent “first service” is rendered to the clients. Ensure practices are adhered to bank’s standard procedures and guidelines with an emphasis in the area of compliance. Keeping abreast with the changes in regulations (site, regional, global, HO), assess its impact.
   

  

 This role requires a strong leader with expertise in client data management, regulatory compliance, name screening, and operational risk mitigation. The incumbent will drive process efficiency, team performance, and adherence to global and local regulations while maintaining audit\-ready records and fostering collaboration with Relationship Managers, Compliance, and Legal teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Client Onboarding Specialists, ensuring high performance, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Set clear team objectives, KPIs, and SLAs aligned with BNP Paribas Wealth Management’s policies and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and implement training programs to enhance team skills.
* Drive continuous improvement in client onboarding processes, including SOP updates, control plans, and automation initiatives.
* Identify process bottlenecks and propose efficiency\-enhancing solutions (e.g., reducing false positives in name screening).
* Support the execution of controls and tasks required in the Client‑Onboarding – Data‑Maintenance \& Banking‑Services process, ensuring that client documentation, data‑capture activities and banking services meet the Bank’s policies, standards and all applicable local legal‑regulatory requirements.
* Perform daily and name‑screening checks (on‑boarding and periodic re‑screening). Keep watch‑lists, match‑thresholds and screening parameters up‑to‑date, investigate alerts, assign risk ratings, document decisions, and promptly escalate high‑risk matches. Maintain complete audit trails and respond to internal‑ and external‑audit queries. Work closely with Relationship Management, Legal and Compliance to resolve exceptions and drive process‑improvement/automation initiatives.
* Provide end‑to‑end support to internal customers for the onboarding of new clients, including linking clients to banking‑service tools (e.g., direct advisory‑desk access, dormant/deceased accounts, block/unblock requests).
* Maintain sound work processes, data‑integrity and the secure storage of client documents (electronic, scanned‑image or paper).
* Stay abreast of regulatory changes (site, regional, global, head‑office) and assess their impact on local workflows (SG/HK).
* Verify that controls are in place for the safe custody of account documentation and for mitigating operational risks arising from user requests to access databases containing sensitive client data, signatures or document images.
* Contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of permanent‑control policies, procedures and control‑plans for daily operations; assist with updating SOPs.
* Comply with regulatory requirements, internal guidelines and operational‑risk procedures; promptly escalate incidents to Management, Permanent‑Control or Compliance as appropriate.
* Report all incidents through the Incident‑Management System and help minimise operational failures (including fraud) by applying regular controls.
* Ensure the integrity of client‑data creation and maintenance while meeting SLA/KPI targets; manage account‑closure processes.
* Prepare regular management reports (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/periodic statistics).
* Provide regional support in line with SG and HK working hours and public‑holiday calendars.
* Work collaboratively within a flexible, transversal team; coordinate with internal partners (WM‑COB SG/HK, Compliance, Legal, Front‑Office, Client‑Onboarding \& Due‑Diligence, and other WMHK/WMSG support teams) to resolve complex cases and maintain a smooth support process.

* Essential knowledge and experience in Client Data Management experience.
* Must possess strong fundamental and technical skills, awareness of operational risk.
* Competent in MS Office tools, particularly MS Excel


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Able to work with large data in excel and suggest process enhancement ideas.
* Knowledge of advanced formulas \& pivot tables in excel is must.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of responsibility for safeguarding the bank’s reputation.
* Proactively seeks root cause solutions to recurring false positive trends.
* Handles high volume alert periods (e.g., sanctions regime updates) while maintaining quality.
* Willing to share knowledge, support peers, and contribute to collective compliance objectives.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Minimum 8\-10 years of experience in Wealth Management, Private Banking, or Client Relationship Management.
* Proven track record in leading teams (3\+ years in a team lead or managerial role).
* Strong understanding of investment products, financial planning, and regulatory compliance.

 Bachelor Degree or equivalent

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Purpose/Overview**
 Operating within an agile, high\-growth packaging facility, the Shift Leader manages shift\-level packaging operations to safely produce Royal Canin products to the highest standards of safety, quality, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 This role is the critical, hands\-on driver of
 **Mars Supply Excellence (MSE)** 
 on the shopfloor. By integrating core MSE pillars (Safety, FMOS, AM, FI, and E\&T) directly into daily single\-line operations, the Shift Leader builds operator capability, drives asset ownership, and ensures the plant scales efficiently to support India's long\-term business growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Daily Operations \& FMOS Pillar**
* Shift Delivery: Lead the single packaging line to execute the production plan on time and in full, optimizing line speed and aiming to maintain an Overall Equipment Effectiveness. Deliver all Safety, Quality and Cost parameters as per the plans.
* FMOS Governance: Serve as the primary floor leader for daily meetings (CP1 and CP2\). Own shift handovers, maintain physical/digital visual boards, and track hourly performance metrics.
* Deviation Management: Rapidly flag operational or performance deviations, implement immediate line adjustments, and escalate systemic technical blocks to the Maintenance Manager and Plant Manager.
* Daily Management System: Lead DMS for the plant.
* B. Safety (MSE Safety Pillar)
* Zero\-Incident Culture: Drive a rigorous safety\-first environment on the floor. Personally execute Daily Safety Confirmations (DSC), lead Safety Conversation Walks (SCW), and enforce Stop\-Assess\-Control (SAC) protocols.
* Q\&FS Compliance: Enforce strict hygiene, GMP\-GHP, and HACCP rules. Immediately isolate and block non\-conforming packaging batches to ensure zero defective products reach the market.
* Audit Readiness: Maintain the packaging floor in a constant "audit\-ready" state for external and internal reviews (ISO, FSSC, QiD).


**Quality ( Quality pillar)**
* Q\&FS Compliance: Enforce strict hygiene, GMP\-GHP, and HACCP rules. Immediately isolate and block non\-conforming packaging batches to ensure zero defective products reach the market.
* Ensure execution of quality control \& Standard Runing condition compliance by operators to deliver Finish Good products Right first time
* In case of deviation: pb solving/root cause analysis
* Apply Quality std in case of blocked products
* Hygiene measures to be implemented.


**Line Ownership \& Autonomous Maintenance (AM)**
* Equipment Ownership: Coach shift operators to treat the single packaging line as their own asset, fostering high levels of pride and care on the floor.
* CIL Standards \& Centerlines: Supervise and verify the execution of daily Clean\-Inspect\-Lubricate (CIL) schedules and strictly monitor equipment Centerlines.
* Abnormality Handling: Establish rapid Abnormality Handling (AH) routines to detect, tag, and resolve minor technical or material defects before they cause critical line breakdowns.


**Problem Solving \& Focused Improvement (FI) (15%)**
* Loss Analysis: Track and analyze packaging floor losses (unplanned downtime, minor stops, material scrap) to prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Operator Troubleshooting: Train and lead shift operators in using basic problem\-solving methodologies (5\-Whys, PDCA, Fishbone) to eliminate chronic line bottlenecks.
* CI Collaboration: Work closely with the Site Maintenance team to implement localized engineering, efficiency\-boosting, and 5S improvement projects.
* Waste control \& optimization Ensure the waste % are as per targets.


**People Management, Education \& Training (E\&T)**
* Shift Leadership: Directly lead, roster, and manage a team of 10 to 12 operators and technicians, managing working hours, overtime, and absenteeism.
* Capability Development: Actively build operator capability using Step\-up\-Cards to develop a multi\-skilled shift workforce. Actively check individual performance to adapt training plan
* Knowledge Capture: Document and transfer on\-the\-floor technical skills through the creation and use of One\-Point Lessons (OPLs) and SOP
* Performance Culture: Conduct honest Performance Development Reviews (PDPs) and drive daily performance accountability using Individual Business Objective (IBO) cards.


**Job Specifications/Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Production) or a related technical/supply chain field.
* 5 to 8 years of manufacturing experience (Food or Pharma)
* Minimum of 3 years of direct people management or shift leadership experience.
* Highly Preferred: Practical experience implementing or sustaining Lean, TPM, or MSE frameworks on the shopfloor.
* Preferred: Good working knowledge of food safety standards (ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP).
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English and local languages. Proficient in MS Excel and operational data entry.

This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring accurate setup, compliant administration, effective cardholder support, and robust operational governance across regions and local entities, often through the supervision and development of a team of Programme Administrators.
   

  

 The Supervisor acts as the primary escalation point and strategic coordination lead between WPP Shared Services, local finance teams, cardholders, Onboarding, Service teams, and Programme Managers. This role combines strategic oversight, advanced operational execution, process development and enforcement, comprehensive user support, and sophisticated system administration.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and oversee the maintenance of cardholder accounts, corporate billing accounts, and programme hierarchies, ensuring data integrity and adherence to global policies.
* Manage and review the monitoring of centrally billed payment processes, ensuring timely settlement, proactive issue identification, and resolution.
* Supervise the administration of complex account updates (e.g., bulk name changes, significant company structure changes, large\-scale hierarchical moves) and ensure operational efficiency.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex guidance on applications, card issuance criteria, credit limits, and transaction limits, ensuring consistent application of policies and risk mitigation.
* Develop and implement strategies to monitor, report, and remediate systemic cardholder delinquency issues, collaborating with relevant stakeholders.
* Lead and project manage rollouts of new divisions, sites, billing accounts, and significant programme expansions, coordinating efforts across multiple internal and external teams.
* Design, deliver, and oversee comprehensive training programs for cardholders and Programme Administrators, fostering continuous improvement and knowledge transfer across the team.
* Mentor and develop a team of Programme Administrators, fostering a culture of high performance, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* Identify, propose, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and cost\-effectiveness within the programme.
* Manage strategic stakeholder relationships with and internal WPP teams, representing the programme in cross\-functional meetings and initiatives.


**What you'll need:**
**Skills \& Competencies**
**Need minimum 8\+ years of experience into Corporate / Commercial Card administration (including team handling)**
**Technical Skills**
* Expert\-level understanding of commercial card processes (T\&E, P Card, Corporate Card), including market best practices, regulatory requirements, and industry trends.
* Advanced proficiency with Card administration, comprehensive reporting, complex applications, and strategic programme maintenance and optimization.
* Deep knowledge of WPP hierarchy setup, MCC controls, advanced card issuance policies, and intricate billing structures, with the ability to interpret and apply these to complex scenarios and guide others.
* Proven ability to manage and ensure data accuracy across multiple integrated systems, driving robust data governance and reporting.
* Experience with data analysis tools (e.g., advanced Excel, Power BI) for reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Exceptional attention to detail with a strong focus on quality assurance, process integrity, and audit readiness.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing diverse stakeholders, negotiating solutions, and delivering clear, concise information to senior management.
* Advanced stakeholder management and negotiation skills, fostering strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external partners.
* Proven ability to lead and champion change initiatives, guiding teams through process transitions effectively and promoting adoption.
* Strategic problem\-solver and critical thinker, capable of resolving complex operational and systemic issues, identifying root causes, and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Strong leadership and team development skills, including mentoring, coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution.
* Robust project management capabilities for programme enhancements, system integrations, and large\-scale rollouts.


**Governance \& Compliance**
* Comprehensive understanding of KYC, complex credit structures, and contracting processes, with the ability to ensure compliance and mitigate operational and financial risks.
* In\-depth knowledge and application of internal cardholder policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards, leading compliance efforts for the programme.
* Experience in developing, implementing, and monitoring governance frameworks and controls to ensure program integrity.

title: Lead - Banking Operation
description:
* **Commission Management \& Accounting**
* Oversee end\-to\-end commission computation, accounting, payment processing, and reconciliation activities.
* Monitor commission\-related schedules, including SCH\-3, BAP, and other compliance reports.
* Ensure timely and accurate commission payouts in accordance with regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Review commission advances, outstanding provisions, and balances through periodic management reviews.
* Prepare GL reports, perform commission account reconciliations, and pass month\-end accounting entries.
* Present periodic MIS and management review reports on commission operations and financial performance.



  




* **Operational Controls \& Payments** 
 Monitor weekly and monthly payout processes and ensure adherence to defined timelines and controls.
* Approve commission and coinsurance settlement payments within delegated authority limits.
* Manage vendor payments, reconcile vendor accounts periodically, and ensure accuracy of payable balances.
* Oversee cheque bounce monitoring and highlight high\-risk trends and counters for management review.



  




* **Coinsurance Management** 
 Monitor coinsurance receivables and payables balances and ensure timely settlement.
* Manage coinsurance accounting and reconciliation processes to minimize solvency impact.
* Review and track outstanding balances with stakeholders and drive timely resolution.



  




* **Regulatory Compliance \& Reporting** 
 Ensure compliance with MISP certification requirements and related regulatory obligations.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of all regulatory, statutory, and compliance reports relating to commission payouts, coinsurance transactions, and IMD onboarding activities.
* Monitor compliance with GST, RCM, TDS, and other applicable tax and regulatory requirements.
* Manage invoicing support and related reporting within defined timelines.



  




* **Financial Governance \& Reconciliations**
* Review M2P and P2M reconciliations and collaborate with stakeholders to reduce outstanding balances.
* Ensure accurate financial reporting, account reconciliations, and operational control mechanisms.
* Strengthen governance through periodic reviews and effective exception management.



  




* **Audit \& Risk Management**
* Coordinate with internal auditors, external auditors, and regulatory authorities to ensure smooth completion of audits.
* Drive timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, SOPs, and risk management frameworks.



  




* **Process Improvement \& Digital Transformation**
* Actively participate in and drive automation and digital transformation initiatives across Banking Operations.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, operational efficiency, and control enhancement.
* Support implementation of system\-driven solutions to reduce manual interventions and improve scalability.



  




* **IMD \& Onboarding Oversight**
* Provide oversight of IMD/Agent onboarding processes to ensure compliance with regulatory and company requirements.
* Monitor onboarding controls, documentation, and process adherence for intermediaries.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
   

  

**Team Overview**
 We are one of India’s leading credit information company with one of the largest collections of consumer information. We aim to be more than just a credit reporting agency. We are a sophisticated, global risk information provider striving to use information for good.
   

  

 We take immense pride in playing a pivotal role in catalyzing the BFSI industry in the country. We got here by tapping into our excitement and passion of wanting to make a difference in the lives of our clients and consumers.
   

  

 We at TransUnion CIBIL are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to a policy of treating all our associates and job applicants equally. Applicants are evaluated on the basis of job qualification \- not race, color, sex / gender, religion, caste, national origin, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other status, whether or not protected. We are committed to taking affirmative action to employ and advance minorities, women, and qualified disabled individuals. We ensure a safe, productive, and harassment\-free workplace for all.
   

  

 What is excitement and passion for us?
   

  

 We define it as a blend of curiosity, ability to unlearn and yet continuously learn, able to connect with meaning and finally the drive to execute ideas till the last mile is achieved. This passion helps us focus on continuous improvement, creative problem solving and collaboration which ensures delivery excellence.
   

  

 Culture and Values
   

  

 Our culture is welcoming, energetic, and innovative. There’s an overall synergy that flows throughout the company, creating a sense of connect, belonging and unity in knowing that we’re all working to achieve the same overall goal. Our core values which we live by every day are integrity, People, Customer, and Innovation.
   

  

 https://www.transunion.com/privacy/global\-job\-applicant
   

  

 Dynamics of the Role
   

  

 This is an exciting time in TransUnion CIBIL. With investments in our people, technology and new business markets, we are redefining the role and purpose of a credit bureau.
   

  

**We Are Looking a Candidates With**
* Experience working in a continuous improvement
* Comfortable working in fast paced environment.
* High degree of responsibility and ownership, strong multitasking, coordination and tenaciously looking for ways to get results.
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast paced environment and deliver as per expectations in terms of timelines an quality
* Self\-starter, ability to work independently, handle ambiguous situations and exercise judgement in variety of situations.
* Strong communication, organizational, verbal \& written skills.
* Supports over vision and strategy of TransUnion CIBIL Operations in support of broader goals.
* Excellent interpersonal (verbal and written) communication skills are required to support working with internal \& external teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and assess \& adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Quick to learn on all processes.
* Work together with other team members for cross training and being a back\-up to other team members if the situation demands.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams in resolving complaints with defined timelines. This job is assigned as On\-Site Essential and requires in\- person work at an assigned TU office location as a condition of employment.


**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Complaint Resolution**
* Responsible for handling and end to end resolution of complaints received on Escalations Channels like RBI, Management, Nodal Officer, Online Grievance Portal etc
* Comprehend, analyze and action complaints received under various escalation channels as per defined process, timelines and quality
* Monitor the escalation process in the organization based on the criteria specified by the organization; suggest ways of improving the existing process to increase consumer satisfaction
* Ensure compliance with established rules to assure that best solutions are executed inclusive of delivery challenges
* Ensure continuous review and analysis of processes and procedures to identify and implement operational efficiency and consumer satisfaction.
* Analyze repeat complains and do root cause analysis of escalation for improving the escalation procedures and ensuring compliance with the corporate and regional escalation policies
* Guide the BPO segment of Transunion CIBIL involved in responding to escalations; ensure minimum TAT for customer escalations and complaint closures
* Follow\-up with members and internal teams for timely resolution
* Timely response on escalation clarification processes and ensure FTR
* Work together with other team members for cross training and being a back\-up to other team members.
* Collaborating with cross functional team in resolving complaints within defined timelines
* Ensure maintenance \& management of records under escalation process.
* Guide the team for exceptional scenarios and ensure smooth functioning of all processes within escalations and grievance operations
* Responsible for overall monitoring of escalation process


**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
**Experience and Skills**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration/ Operations or a related field.
* Minimum 5\-6 years of relevant experience as a part of Grievance Redressal team in BFSI sector
* Candidate must be highly proficient in written communication, ability to handle irate customers, document reviews, complaint analysis and complex complaints
* Proven experience of meeting aggressive TATs with high quality resolution


**TransUnion Overview**
 At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
 **Workforce for Good** 
 , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
   

  

 Be a part of our
 **Workforce for Good** 
 – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting\-edge technology.

**Work Dynamics (Integrated Facilities Management)**
**Role And Responsibilities**
**OVERALL ROLE**
 This position is responsible for technical and contractual quality assurance on behalf of an investment banking client to ensure a number of corporate real estate buildings are compliant to country, regional, global compliance and technical standards.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
**Transforming to the Workspace Team of the future**
* Planned, predictive and corrective works of building systems
* Power down planning, execution
* Quality assurance and monitor outsourced critical works vendors to ensure equipment is maintained at a high standard
* Review the maintenance/service practices of M\&E contractors to deliver quality work practices in line with the manufacturer recommendations, established processes, tools and documentation.
* Engineering regulatory compliance management for the portfolio of buildings, along with compliance to client\-stipulated Engineering Playbooks
* Incident management support including 24/7 on call for incident management in corporate real estate buildings
* Support and assist any installation, commissioning and programming of new office space to ensure plans, designs, scopes and goals are accurate
* Technical reporting submissions for portfolio objectives, regular meetings and portfolio performance
* Governance of as built drawings and OEM information
* Production and management of MOPS/SOPS/EOPS
* Management of lifecycle asset management and UPS component replacement
* Support for engineering standardization tasks across Asia Pacific
* Lead in\-city technical training delivery
* Develop and implement innovation programs and processes that reduce utility costs, increase productivity, produce cost savings and share learnings with the wider team.
* Identify energy saving initiatives and work through to implementation and validation.
* Review of all maintenance reports to ensure maintenance is conducted appropriately and performance issues are actioned


**Client/Stakeholder Management** 
 (in support of the Workspace Technical Lead)
   

  

* Pro\-actively develop and manage Client relationships ensuring that expected service levels are achieved
* Comply with all requirements of the Client contract and meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators
* Deliver an exceptional quality of service to the Client, as reflected by Client feedback
* Actively recover feedback from the end user


**Leadership / Staff Management**

* Proactively manage the team to deliver Delight

**Operations Management**
