* Ensure service deliverables are met with SLA and KPI
* Work with all related parties on timely delivery of all services
* Be responsible for all clients within designated area
* Problem solves \& Resets space on the fly
* Establish direct relationship with the client business units and their neighbourhood community, understand their issues, display confidence and satisfy needs and requirements of all requests
* Continuous Improvement implementation
* Conduct data analysis report when necessary
* Ensure meeting or exceeding SLA/KPI scores
* Generate reports and conduct presentations as per the service delivery requirements and overall account management
* Handling helpdesk service request from users via telephone or email correspondence
* Coordinate with Workspace delivery team to ensure Repair \& Maintenance services, materials, equipment’s and fixtures is attended and completed
* Oversee office premises and delivery of hospitality services for users
* Provide administrative support of issuing work order to vendors as and when required
* Escalate facilities issues to management team when necessary
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects when required


**CANDIDATE SPECIFICATION: KEY SELECTION CRITERIA**
**Ideal Experience**
* Diploma in an Engineering discipline
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant engineering management experience
* Thorough understanding of building services design and engineering management
* Ability to identify and implement opportunities for operational efficiency/improvements and implement agreed solutions
* High energy, flourishes in fast pace, dynamic environments
* Customer centricity
* Comfortable working in a challenging environment as part of a team and is comfortable managing incidents and service failures
* Able to adapt in a fast\-paced working environment and versatile in meeting client changing needs and requirements


**Critical Competencies for Success (with corresponding ‘I am JLL behaviours’)**
**Client Focus \& Relationship Management – ‘I Value my Customers’**
* Demonstrates proactive \& professional approach to customer service and stakeholder engagement
* Has a natural hospitality\-orientated communications acumen
* Ability to interact with a wide range of client staff, including senior levels
* Ability to manage conflict and balance between client and firm requirements
* Has a customer service oriented attitude


**People Management and Team Leadership – ‘I am a Team Player’**
* Ability to lead team effectively, train them well and promote open, constructive and collaborative relationships at all levels


**Program Management \& Organizational Skills – ‘I Am Proactive’**
* Excellent planning \& organizational skills to prioritize work and meet tight deadlines
* Proven ability to manage multiple and complex operational matters on a daily basis


**Problem Solving \& Strategic Thinking – ‘I am Innovative’**
* Capacity to deal with ambiguity and solve complex problems effectively
* Analytical, proven ability to solve problems using a quantitative approach
* Proven ability to employ holistic approaches and looks at long term solutions


**Other Personal Characteristics**
* Natural communicator who enjoys engaging at all levels
* Self\-motivated and confident
* Exhibits honesty \& trustworthiness
* Open to new ideas \& willing to challenge status quo
* Works well with diverse teams from various countries/cultures

title: Deputy Manager, Contract Administration & Management, Tenders
description:
**Job Description**
 The role will manage and coordinate the complete tender lifecycle for government hospitals, institutions and centralized rate contracts. This includes pre\-tender assessment, bid preparation, pricing and approval coordination, tender submission, post\-award activities, supply and delivery monitoring, tender MIS, governance and audit readiness.
   

  

 The position will work closely with Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, QA, Legal, Compliance, Medical and other relevant stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant execution of tender business.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Manage end\-to\-end tender activities, from tender identification and qualification through submission and award.
* Review tender requirements and assess company eligibility, highlighting legal, regulatory and compliance concerns.
* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs for bid preparation, including pricing, volumes, product details, terms and documentation.
* Validate tender pricing and ensure adherence to approved pricing and governance guidelines.
* Complete tender compliance checklists, maintain tender logs and obtain required approvals.
* Ensure timely arrangement and tracking of EMD/Bid Security and Performance Security Deposits.
* Ensure accurate and timely bid submission with complete documentation.
* Maintain records of bid submissions, amendments, cancellations, awards and non\-participation decisions.
* Coordinate post\-award pricing validation, invoicing approvals and additional commitment documentation.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics and QA to ensure timely product allocation, stamping and delivery as per tender commitments.
* Monitor delivery performance and escalate delays, short shipments, quality issues and supply risks.
* Maintain comprehensive tender MIS, including pipeline, win/loss, award and renewal tracking.
* Prepare management reports covering tender performance, sales, margins, pricing adherence, risks and CAPA status.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Support distributor appointment and due diligence for tender\-related activities in coordination with Compliance, Legal and TPRM.
* Ensure distributor participation remains aligned with approved governance and competition\-law requirements.
* Maintain complete tender documentation and records for audit purposes.
* Prepare and maintain the tender audit universe and ensure audit readiness.
* Support internal, global and management\-monitoring audits by preparing evidence packs and tracking CAPA closure.
* Ensure local tender processes and SOPs remain aligned with global tender standards.
* Provide regular tender updates and executive summaries to management, highlighting key accounts, lost tenders, margin trends, operational risks and recommendations.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business Management, Commerce, Pharmacy, Life Sciences or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* Experience in tender management, institutional business, government business, commercial operations or a related pharmaceutical/healthcare environment.
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end tender lifecycle, including bid preparation, pricing, submission, post\-award management and MIS.
* Experience working with multiple cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Exposure to tender compliance, governance, audit and documentation requirements.


**Skills**
* Strong tender management and execution skills.
* Strong understanding of pricing, commercial and contractual processes.
* Excellent cross\-functional coordination and stakeholder management.
* Strong analytical and MIS/reporting skills.
* Good understanding of compliance, governance and audit requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong communication, negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Excel and tender management systems.
* High level of ownership, accountability and integrity.

title: Sys. Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor
description:
**Position Overview**
 TIAA is undertaking AmpliFi, a large\-scale ERP transformation program, and is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Project Manager to assist in managing the Source to Pay (S2P) workstream. This workstream includes the migration of Strategic Sourcing to Oracle, the replacement of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) system from Coupa to Aravo, and the implementation of a new Zip orchestration layer designed to unify and simplify the end\-to\-end sourcing, procurement, and payment experience for business users.
   

  

 This is a highly visible role requiring a proactive self\-starter who can manage complex, interdependent workstreams while communicating clearly and confidently with senior TIAA stakeholders, including steering committee members and executive sponsors. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding of source\-to\-pay processes with the polish and presence needed to lead discussions with senior audiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the project plan, milestones, RAID log, and deliverables for the S2P workstream, spanning Strategic Sourcing (PeopleSoft), TPRM (Aravo), and the Zip orchestration layer.
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, and TPRM teams to define future\-state processes, requirements, and system configurations.
* Coordinate configuration, testing, and validation activities across PeopleSoft Sourcing, Aravo TPRM, and Zip orchestration, ensuring seamless integration and a cohesive end\-to\-end user experience.
* Manage vendor master data cleanup, mapping, and migration activities in close coordination with the Data workstream.
* Proactively identify gaps, dependencies, and risks across the three underlying platforms before they impact timelines, and drive resolution through appropriate program channels.
* Schedule and facilitate S2P status meetings, domain working sessions, workshops, and steering committee updates.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready status reports and presentation materials, and confidently present progress, risks, and decisions to senior TIAA leadership and steering committee members.
* Track, escalate, and drive resolution of risks and issues per program governance standards.
* Coordinate UAT planning and execution with business process owners across sourcing, AP, and TPRM functions.
* Support organizational change management, stakeholder communications, and training for S2P end users, ensuring adoption of new processes and the Zip orchestration experience.
* Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail in tracking deliverables, documenting decisions, and validating configuration and testing outcomes.


**Program\-Level Responsibilities (applicable To All Six Workstream PM Roles)**
* Adhere to AmpliFi program governance, PMO standards, and reporting templates/cadence.
* Participate in cross\-workstream coordination meetings to proactively identify and manage interdependencies with other AmpliFi workstreams.
* Escalate risks and issues through defined program governance channels in a timely manner.
* Support overall cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live stabilization for the S2P domain.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of project management experience, including at least 3 years leading procurement, sourcing, accounts payable, or TPRM transformation initiatives.
* Direct, hands\-on familiarity with at least two of the following: PeopleSoft (Sourcing/Procurement), Coupa, Aravo, Zip, or comparable sourcing, TPRM, or orchestration platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of end\-to\-end source\-to\-pay processes, including strategic sourcing, purchase order creation, three\-way matching, invoice\-to\-pay, and third\-party/vendor risk management, ideally within a large international financial services organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-system, multi\-stakeholder workstreams with significant interdependencies.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and with authority to senior/executive audiences, including experience preparing and delivering steering committee\-level presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and drive alignment across Sourcing, AP, TPRM, Vendor Management, IT, and Data teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business language.
* High attention to detail, particularly in tracking configuration decisions, testing outcomes, and data migration accuracy across multiple platforms.
* Proficiency in project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Teams, SharePoint).
* Ability to work proactively and independently across time zones with global stakeholders (onshore/offshore coordination).
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience with ERP transformation programs, particularly upgrades or replacements involving sourcing, procurement, or TPRM systems.
* Experience with orchestration or workflow layers designed to unify disparate procurement systems into a single user experience.
* Experience working within regulated financial services environments, with an understanding of associated compliance and audit requirements.

description:
Mumbai (India) (09 Sep 2026\) JD1582
   

  

 Apply now
   

  

 The Commercial Relationship Manager is responsible for leading the commercial relationship management function for the Fund Administration business, combining strategic client relationship management with revenue growth responsibility across the Group’s fund administration client portfolio. The role is accountable for developing long\-term partnerships with fund managers, asset managers, investment firms, and institutional clients, ensuring exceptional client experience while proactively identifying opportunities for revenue expansion, cross\-selling, new mandates, and increased client value. The role leads and develops a team of Commercial Relationship Managers who are responsible for managing client relationships, strengthening client engagement, and driving commercial outcomes across their assigned portfolios. The Head acts as the senior escalation point for strategic clients and ensures the business maintains strong executive relationships with key clients. The successful candidate will bring a commercial mindset to client management, combining deep understanding of client businesses, investment strategies, growth plans, fundraising activities, geographic expansion, and operational requirements to identify opportunities where the Group can provide additional value. The role holder is responsible for the management of the Fund team in the set\-up and administration of a number of Alternative investment funds, Estate Succession Planning, Trust Structuring, Advising Family Trust clients and underlying investors.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
**Commercial Leadership \& Revenue Growth**
* Develop and execute the commercial relationship strategy for the Fund Administration business, aligning client management activities with the Group’s revenue growth objectives and strategic priorities
* Own the commercial performance of the client portfolio, driving revenue growth through client retention, cross\-selling, upselling, fee reviews, new fund launches, additional jurisdictions, and expanded service offerings
* Establish commercial targets, monitor portfolio performance, review revenue trends, and implement strategies to maximize client lifetime value and profitability
* Identify opportunities to increase wallet share by understanding client business models, investment strategies, fundraising plans, expansion objectives, and future operational requirements
* Partner with senior management to develop commercial initiatives, market strategies, and growth opportunities across priority client segments


**Strategic Client Relationship Management**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior executives, fund managers, investment professionals, boards, and key decision\-makers across strategic client accounts
* Act as the executive sponsor for key strategic clients, ensuring senior\-level engagement, strong relationship governance, and alignment between client objectives and Group capabilities
* Develop a deep understanding of client businesses, including investment strategies, fundraising activities, portfolio growth, operational challenges, geographic expansion, and future service requirements
* Conduct regular executive business reviews, strategic account meetings, and relationship assessments to strengthen partnerships and identify opportunities for collaboration
* Manage complex client relationships and commercial escalations, coordinating internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution and continued client confidence


**Client Growth Planning \& Portfolio Management**
* Establish a structured client growth planning framework across the relationship management team, ensuring each strategic client has a documented commercial development plan
* Ensure Relationship Managers actively identify growth opportunities, including new funds, additional entities, new jurisdictions, additional services, and increased utilization of existing capabilities
* Review client portfolios regularly to assess revenue opportunities, profitability, relationship strength, service quality, retention risks, and strategic importance
* Develop client segmentation strategies to ensure appropriate focus, resources, and engagement models across different client categories
* Monitor client lifecycle management activities from onboarding through expansion and renewal


**Leadership of Commercial Relationship Management Team**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of Commercial Relationship Managers responsible for managing fund manager and institutional client relationships
* Establish clear objectives, revenue targets, client ownership responsibilities, and performance expectations for the Relationship Management team
* Conduct regular account reviews, pipeline reviews, coaching sessions, and commercial planning meetings to improve team effectiveness
* Build commercial capability within the team by developing skills in relationship management, consultative selling, negotiation, client strategy, and revenue generation
* Promote a culture of accountability, proactive client engagement, continuous improvement, and ownership of commercial outcomes


**Client Experience \& Service Excellence**
* Champion a client\-centric culture across the Fund Administration business, ensuring client experience remains a key strategic priority
* Work closely with Operations, Fund Accounting, Investor Services, Compliance, Finance, and Technology teams to ensure client expectations are understood and effectively delivered
* Monitor service quality, client satisfaction, operational challenges, and recurring issues, ensuring improvement initiatives are implemented where required
* Establish effective communication channels between clients and internal teams to ensure transparency, responsiveness, and service excellence
* Use client feedback and market insights to identify opportunities to improve products, services, and operating models


**Commercial Proposals, Renewals \& Negotiations**
* Lead or support commercial discussions relating to new mandates, contract renewals, pricing reviews, fee negotiations, and expanded service requirements
* Review client agreements, commercial terms, pricing structures, and profitability considerations in collaboration with Finance, Legal, and Operations teams
* Ensure commercial proposals reflect client needs while maintaining appropriate profitability and strategic value for the Group
* Support successful conversion of opportunities generated through Relationship Management, Digital Business Development, and strategic partnerships


**Collaboration with Business Development \& Product Teams**
* Work closely with Digital Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Product Specialists, and senior commercial teams to convert opportunities into sustainable client relationships
* Support targeted campaigns and market initiatives by providing client insights, industry intelligence, and commercial feedback
* Coordinate with product teams to identify opportunities for new service offerings, product enhancements, and market expansion

title: Academy Operations Manager
description:
**Role: Academy Operations Manager** 

**Location:** Mumbai – Lower Parel (The Command Center!)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Urgency:** High – We’re hiring at the speed of Padel!

**About PadelPark: The Academy Revolution**

We are PadelPark, the engine behind India's fastest\-growing sport. We aren't just building courts; we’re building the future of Indian athletes—from budding young stars to adults looking to master the game—through the **McDonald’s Indian Padel Academy** and our elite **MS Dhoni affiliation**. This isn't just a business; it’s a movement to spark a nationwide obsession.

**The Game Plan: Your Role as Academy Operations Manager**

This is a high\-ownership, zero\-excuses role for someone who loves bringing order to chaos and genuinely cares about delivering a world\-class experience — for students, coaches, and venue partners alike. You will be the operational heartbeat of the academy, making sure every court, coach, and class runs exactly as it should.

**Here is what your day\-to\-day looks like:**

* **Own the courts:** Track court utilisation across all venues and make sure every available hour is generating value — through academy sessions or Pay \& Play.
* **Keep the schedule tight:** Publish every coach's weekly schedule on District at least 7 days in advance — no exceptions.
* **Drive Pay \& Play occupancy:** Monitor P\&P slot bookings and work with the team to optimise pricing and app visibility. Low occupancy is a signal, and you will be the first to catch it and act on it.
* **Minimise disruptions:** Keep session reschedules and cancellations to an absolute minimum. When they do happen, own the communication.
* **Resolve venue issues fast:** Any court damage, equipment fault, or facility issue must be fixed within 24 hours. You will be the first call when something goes wrong, and the person who makes sure it does not happen twice.
* **Stay on budget:** Track operational spend at each venue against budget in real time. Flag overspends early — before they become a P\&L problem. You are the first line of financial accountability on the ground.

**Your scoreboard: what success looks like**

You will be measured on a clear set of KPIs that reflect how well the academy is running. No ambiguity — just results.

**Court Utilisation Rate**

% of available court\-hours actually in use across all venues each month

**Schedule Published 7 Days Out**

Every coach's week must be live on District at least 7 days before it begins

**Pay \& Play Occupancy Rate**

% of P\&P slots booked vs. available on the District app

**Reschedule \& Cancellation Rate**

How often confirmed sessions are changed or cancelled — lower is better

**Venue Issues Resolved in 24hrs**

Same\-day or next\-day resolution of any court or facility issue

**Operational Cost vs Budget**

Are we spending what we planned? Tracked per venue, every month

**Who Are We Looking For:** 

* You have got a bachelor's degree and at least 3\+ years of experience in operations, sports management, or a fast\-paced service environment.
* **Bonus points:** If you have worked in a sports academy, fitness studio, or venue operations setup, you are already one smash ahead.
* **You are a natural organiser:** schedules, systems, and checklists are your love language.
* **You are a problem\-solver:** when something breaks (and things always break), you fix it fast and build a system so it never breaks the same way again.
* **You are a communicator:**  coaches, students, vendors, founders: you know how to talk to all of them clearly and calmly.
* **You are data\-driven:**  you track what matters, spot patterns early, and make decisions backed by numbers, not gut feel alone.
* **You are tech\-comfortable:**  CRM tools, scheduling platforms, and spreadsheets do not intimidate you. Familiarity with District or similar apps is a plus.

**Why You’ll Love Being On Our Team**

* **Be a pioneer:** Get in on the ground floor of a company that is literally building the future of sport in India.
* **Join a rocket ship:** Padel is the fastest\-growing sport in the world. You will be at the operational heart of that growth story.
* **Learn and lead:** This is a role where you will be given real ownership from day one — and the space to grow into something bigger.
* **Work hard, play hard:** We are a high\-energy team that believes great work deserves great fun. Court time included.

title: Ops Manager — Purchase Protection (re-scoped from Ops & Strategy
description:
**Ops Manager , Purchase Protection (re\-scoped from Ops \& Strategy)**
=======================================================================

  



**Location:** Mumbai , hybrid, 3 days a week in office (FinOps operates as one unit in Mumbai)


**Experience:** 4–7 years running day\-to\-day operations in e\-commerce, logistics, fintech or insurance


**Reports to:** COO


**Works with:** Rahul Garale (Asst Manager Ops), Shraddha Pisal (Ops Analyst), Aditya Chauhan \& Yash Alva (Data), Kunal Vinayakiya (Partnerships), Finance (Dhivya Vijayakumar, Yashraj Saha)


**About Assurekit**
-------------------


Assurekit is on a mission to protect the internet's GDP.


Every day, billions of dollars in transactions flow through India's digital economy , across marketplaces, payments, logistics, and commerce platforms. But the protection layer that should sit underneath all of it hasn't kept pace. Buyers worry about what arrives at their door. Sellers absorb losses they didn't cause. Platforms carry risk they were never built to hold.


We're building the infrastructure that fixes this , embedded directly into the platforms people already use, invisible until it's needed, and engineered for the speed and scale of digital commerce. Our partners include some of the largest names in the Indian internet and our reach grows every transaction we protect.


We're backed by tier\-1 investors and are building what we believe will become foundational risk infrastructure for the next billion digital consumers.


**Role Summary**
----------------


You will run operations for Assurekit's **purchase\-protection line of business** , the shipping\-protection, RTO\-protection and e\-commerce purchase\-protection programs we operate for platforms such as Shiprocket (ShipSure), GoKwik, Meesho, Pepperfry and Mokobara, with new programs going live every quarter.


This is an **operator's seat, not a strategy seat**. You own the weekly operating loop for every program in the LOB: the data comes in, plans are enrolled, claims are adjudicated and paid on time, settlements reconcile to the rupee with partners and insurers, and each partner gets a clean, on\-time report. When something breaks you fix it, write down why, and change the process so it doesn't break again. Over time you turn that loop into SOPs and automation with Data and Product so the LOB scales without headcount scaling with it.


**What Success Looks Like (first 6 months)**
--------------------------------------------


* Every live purchase\-protection program runs on a documented weekly cadence , enrolment feed claims adjudication settlement partner report , with a named owner for each step and no step dependent on the COO.
* Claims TAT and settlement accuracy are measured per program, reported weekly, and improving; partner escalations drop.
* Partner\-facing reconciliation (proforma invoices, claim payouts, float/deposit tracking with insurers) closes within the agreed cycle every week, with finance sign\-off.
* At least one new program (e.g. Snapmint, Rupifi or Pidge) is taken live on the same playbook without a bespoke process.
* The automation backlog for the LOB is prioritised, specced with Data/Product, and the first two items are shipped.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Run the programs**


* Own enrolment and data ingestion for each program: partner feeds, plan issuance, exception handling, reverse feeds back to the partner.
* Own claims operations end\-to\-end: intake, adjudication against plan rules and loss caps, fraud/anomaly flags, payout instructions, TAT tracking and partner communication.
* Run weekly settlements and reconciliations , partner invoices and payouts, insurer floats and premium remittances, claim reimbursements , and clear breaks with Finance.
* Produce the weekly and monthly partner MIS; run the operating review with each partner's ops counterpart.

### **Build the operating system**


* Write and maintain the program SOPs and launch checklist; apply them to every new program go\-live.
* Define the LOB's operating metrics (enrolment accuracy, claims TAT, settlement variance, escalation volume) and keep the dashboards current with Data.
* Own the LOB's automation backlog: identify the manual steps that don't scale, spec them with Data/Product, and drive them to closure.

 Technical competence like no other

title: Manufacturing Shop Operations Team Manager - Senior
description:
### **Job Summary**



The Senior Manager / Manager – Camshaft Manufacturing Operations is responsible for leading day\-to\-day manufacturing operations for camshafts across QSK, KV, NT, ISX, and other engine platforms at Kothrud Engine Plant. The role focuses on ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality production through effective management of machining processes, manpower, equipment performance, automation systems, and continuous improvement initiatives.



The incumbent will lead operations involving cam milling, grinding, induction hardening, straightening, superfinishing, washing, inspection, and packaging processes while ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets. The role also requires strong coordination with cross\-functional teams including Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain.


### **Key Responsibilities**


**Production \& Operations Management**


* Execute and monitor daily production plans to meet customer delivery schedules and operational targets.
* Ensure smooth operation of manufacturing lines with focus on safety, quality, productivity, and cost optimization.
* Manage manpower deployment, shift planning, absenteeism control, and resource utilization.
* Coordinate with planning, quality, maintenance, and manufacturing engineering teams to minimize downtime and production losses.
* Drive production stability across multiple camshaft variants and engine platforms.
* Lead and manage daily operations of cylinder head machining lines.
* Drive high\-mix, high\-volume production while maintaining flexibility and efficiency.
* Optimize manpower utilization, line balancing, and throughput.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering to ensure seamless operations.


**Equipment \& Process Management**


* Oversee end\-to\-end machining processes including:
* Oversee operation and performance of critical manufacturing equipment including:
* Cam Milling Machines
* Journal \& Cam Lobe Grinding Machines
* Induction Hardening Systems
* Straightening Machines
* Superfinishing Machines
* BHN Testing \& Crack Detection Systems
* Washing, Laser Marking \& Final Inspection Machines
* Ensure adherence to preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for improved equipment reliability.
* Support machine trials, process validation, commissioning, and production ramp\-up activities.
* Monitor process capability and implement corrective actions to sustain process stability.


**Automation \& Manufacturing Systems**


* Support implementation and stabilization of automation systems such as robotic handling, gantry systems, and automated inspection systems.
* Drive CMS (Cummins Manufacturing System) implementation and sustainment across the shop floor.
* Participate in Industry 4\.0 and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve operational visibility and machine utilization.
* Promote data\-based decision\-making through operational reviews and KPI tracking.


**Quality, Safety \& Compliance**


* Ensure adherence to Cummins quality standards and customer requirements.
* Lead root cause analysis and implementation of corrective/preventive actions for process and quality issues.
* Drive reduction in scrap, rework, and customer complaints.
* Ensure compliance with HSE, environmental, ergonomic, and statutory requirements.
* Support audits, VPCR activities, layered process audits, and quality improvement initiatives.


**Team Leadership \& Development**


* Lead and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, and support staff.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, discipline, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct training, skill development, performance reviews, and competency enhancement initiatives.
* Encourage employee involvement in Kaizen, safety, and productivity improvement activities.


**Continuous Improvement \& Cost Optimization**


* Improve OEE, productivity, cycle time, and process efficiency.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, TPM, Kaizen, SMED, and waste elimination.
* Support cost reduction initiatives related to tooling, consumables, utilities, and manpower optimization.
* Participate in CAPEX execution, operational budgeting, and resource planning activities.


**Competencies:**


**Core Competencies**


* Operations Management
* Manufacturing Excellence
* Team Leadership
* Continuous Improvement
* Lean Manufacturing \& TPM
* Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis
* Decision Making
* Collaboration \& Cross\-functional Coordination
* Health, Safety \& Environmental Awareness
* Technical Expertise in Precision Machining


Builds effective teams \- Building strong\-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.



Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.



Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.



Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.



Develops talent \- Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.



Directs work \- Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.



Drives engagement \- Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.



Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.



Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Health, Safety and Environment Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis \- Examines HSE incidents by completing quality, evidence based investigations with accurate root cause analysis, resulting in effective corrective actions, accurate reporting and avoiding repeated incidents.



Continuous Process Improvement \- Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.



Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.


**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**



College, university, or equivalent degree required.



This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.


### **Experience**



Intermediate level of supervisory experience required.


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum 18\+ years of experience in precision machining/manufacturing operations, preferably in camshaft, crankshaft, or powertrain component manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of grinding, milling, induction hardening, inspection systems, and machining operations.
* Experience in managing automated and semi\-automated production environments.
* Hands\-on exposure to robotics, automation systems, and Industry 4\.0 initiatives is preferred.

* A hands\-on entity operations leader with 20\+ years in Telecom, Semiconductor, or Appliance/Electronics
 *companies*

 sales/BD.

* Bachelor's in Business Administration or related field (MBA preferred); fluent English, Mandarin a strong plus.

description:
Location\-Noida/ Gurgaon/ Mumbai/ Bangalore
   

  

 Domain\-B2C supply chain
   

  

 Industry preference\- FMCG/ Electronics
   

  

 Relevant experience\-7\-13 years
   

  

**About Us**
 We’re Adobe’s Product Distribution Operations (PDO) team, and we run the worldwide production, fulfilment and distribution behind Adobe’s physical and point\-of\-sale products — from demand planning all the way to the invoice. We love getting the details right at global scale! Ready to own an operation and keep it running across every region?
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads PDO for the Singapore hub. It is the main point of contact for production, turnkey and distribution, and owns our SAP S/4HANA planning coordinator responsibilities. It suits someone who enjoys both the detail of daily operations and the wider picture of cost, compliance and vendor relationships.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 Day to day, the role runs the flow of orders and shipments worldwide — reviewing demand and supply, and issuing EDI purchase orders to our turnkey partner. When order, shipment or customs questions arise, you’ll resolve them with Sales, Order Management and logistics partners across NA, EMEA, APAC and Japan.
   

  

 On the cost side, the role owns COGS for print, production and distribution, approves freight and vendor invoices, and issues monthly invoices for our entities. It also runs quarter\-end closure, sets excess\-and\-obsolete reserves, reconciles inventory and manages returns.
   

  

 Product launches fill a big part of the year. The role sets up new term license, subscription and POSA SKUs, checks test\-card and link\-map readiness, and partners with the Product, Sales and turnkey teams so every launch lands on schedule.
   

  

 Compliance runs through all of it: SOX controls, tax and environmental reporting for EMEA (Green Dot, EUDR, PPWR), and on\-site vendor audits that confirm modern\-slavery and labour requirements are met.
   

  

 What you’ll bring
   

  

* Solid experience in supply chain, production planning or distribution operations
* Hands\-on SAP (S/4HANA) and EDI order\-to\-cash knowledge
* Comfort managing COGS, freight and invoices
* A careful, accurate approach to compliance and audit (SOX a plus)
* A track record of managing vendors and external partners
* Clear communication across regions and teams


 Bonus points
   

  

 Familiarity with POSA or Livecard fulfilment, Power BI or Tableau reporting, or APAC regional operations is a real plus.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 This is a truly global role with real ownership and a supportive team behind it. We back our people with strong benefits and the freedom to shape how the operation runs as we grow. We’d love to have you on the team — come and build it with us! We can’t wait to see what you’ll do!

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. title: FCS People Leader
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as FCS People Leader at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct. With competitive benefits and opportunities for career advancement, Barclays is a great place to grow your career in the banking industry.
   

  

**Key Critical Skills Required For This Role Include**
* Experience in Team management.
* Knowledge of KYC, AML, Sanctions, Adverse Media, Payment, and customer screening process to ensure adherence to internal policies and regulatory standards.
* Identify and report quality gaps or process deviations, work with relevant teams to drive corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain MIS dashboards and reports related to financial crime controls, customer due diligence, and alert handling.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports for internal stakeholders and compliance leadership.
* Ensure reports reflect accurate status of KYC, AML alerts, and sanctions screening metrics.
* Support the monitoring of transactions and customer data against global sanctions list.
* Assist in maintaining and updating watchlist filtering tools and screening logic.
* Work closely with Screening operations teams to identify and resolve data issues.
* Ensure people related issues are handled.
* Clear understanding of Risk \& Controls.
* Should have basic MS Excel knowledge.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support Screening with day\-to\-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution, making decisions in line with comply with relevant regulatory and industry standards.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Support with day\-to\-day screening initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution through lending technical expertise.
* Execution of screening checks on customers, transactions, and other activities to identify potential risks and comply with regulatory requirements.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate screening processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations for change in screening processes.
* Development and implementation of screening procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on screening performance.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in screening Services.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve screening efficiency and effectiveness.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. description:
**About Our Company**
 Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.
   

  

 Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This is a management role within Global Operations \& Investor Services (GOIS), specifically within Derivative Operations, a global team of 30\+ professionals based across India, the UK and the US. The successful candidate will be accountable for leading the India\-based Derivative Operations capability, providing strong people leadership, operational oversight, product expertise and senior escalation across day\-to\-day middle office and trade support activities. The role requires close partnership with Front Office, Compliance, Technology, Legal, Risk and external counterparties across the full derivative product lifecycle, with a clear focus on control, resilience, stakeholder confidence and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Operational Leadership, Middle Office and Trade Support
   

  

 Provide senior oversight of the end\-to\-end derivative trade lifecycle, from execution and confirmation through clearing, settlement, valuation, lifecycle events and termination.
   

  

 Ensure robust operating standards across trade capture, exception management, lifecycle event processing, collateral and margin activities.
   

  

 Oversee reconciliations with counterparties, clearers, fund accountants, custodians and internal platforms, ensuring timely resolution of breaks and escalation of material issues.
   

  

 Drive disciplined exception management, prioritisation and issue resolution across supported products.
   

  

 Maintain and continuously strengthen the operational control framework, ensuring processes remain scalable, well\-governed and aligned to business, regulatory and risk expectations.
   

  

 Identify, assess and mitigate operational, settlement, valuation, collateral, liquidity and counterparty risks through proactive monitoring, escalation and remediation.
   

  

 Lead root cause analysis for incidents, control events and recurring exceptions, ensuring sustainable remediation, lessons learned and appropriate senior stakeholder communication.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to relevant regulatory obligations, internal policies, service standards and governance requirements across all supported activities.
   

  

 People Management and Strategic Leadership
   

  

 Lead, develop and motivate a high\-performing team of middle office and trade support professionals, building capability, accountability and operational depth across the India\-based function.
   

  

 Translate business priorities into clear team objectives, delivery plans and individual goals, ensuring the team remains responsive to evolving product, client, regulatory and operating model requirements.
   

  

 Manage performance, talent development and succession planning through regular coaching, feedback, objective setting and career development plans.
   

  

 Foster an inclusive, collaborative and delivery\-focused culture centred on operational excellence, ownership, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and strong risk awareness.
   

  

 Act as a senior escalation point for complex operational, valuation, lifecycle, collateral and product\-related matters, bringing together the right stakeholders to drive timely decisions and sustainable outcomes.
   

  

**Experience, Skills And Qualifications Required**
 15\+ years industry experience, ideally within middle office, trade support, derivatives operations or investment operations, with demonstrable progression in leadership scope, complexity and accountability.
   

  

 Proven people leadership experience, including the ability to set strategic direction, define priorities, manage performance and translate business objectives into measurable team and individual outcomes.
   

  

 Strong technical knowledge of the derivative trade lifecycle, market conventions, collateral and margin management, with direct exposure to multiple product types such as OTC derivatives, cleared swaps, futures and options.
   

  

 Sound understanding of the regulatory environment for derivative products, including frameworks such as EMIR, Dodd\-Frank and Uncleared Margin Rules.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence and capability to build trusted relationships regionally and globally.
   

  

 Experience operating within, or overseeing, outsourced service provider models, including interaction with fund accountants, administrators, custodians, brokers and clearing counterparties.
   

  

**Preferred**
 Applied experience using BlackRock Aladdin or comparable investment management, trading, accounting or operations platforms.
   

  

 Experience working with key market infrastructure and strategic vendors such as OSTTRA/Markit, Bloomberg, Tradeweb and familiarity with financial communication networks such as SWIFT and FIX.
   

  

 Knowledge of automation, workflow optimisation, data tools, coding concepts or AI\-enabled solutions would be highly regarded.

title: Subcontracts Delivery Manager - HVDC
description:
**The opportunity**
 The
 **Subcontracts Delivery Manager (SDLM)** 
 is responsible for the commercial, contractual, and operational management of construction and installation subcontracts on major HVDC projects from contract award through to final completion and closeout.
   

  

 The role acts as the primary commercial interface between Hitachi Energy and its subcontractors, ensuring contractual obligations are met while protecting project objectives relating to safety, cost, schedule, quality, and risk.
   

  

 Working closely with Construction, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Cost Control, and Contract Management teams, the SDLM is responsible for proactively managing subcontract performance throughout project execution. This includes administering subcontract agreements, managing variations and change orders, assessing and resolving claims, negotiating commercial matters, monitoring performance, and identifying risks and opportunities that may impact project delivery.
   

  

 A key responsibility of the role is maintaining strong commercial control of subcontract packages. This includes managing payment applications, verifying invoices, tracking costs, preparing reports, supporting cost recovery initiatives, administering contractual changes, and ensuring that all commercial matters are properly documented and managed. The SDLM also plays a key role in the negotiation of final accounts and the successful closeout of subcontracts.
   

  

 The position requires strong stakeholder management and communication skills, as the SDLM regularly interfaces with subcontractors, site management, project leadership, engineers, contract managers, and clients. The ability to negotiate effectively, resolve disputes, manage commercial risk, and maintain strong working relationships is critical to success.
   

  

 Successful Subcontracts Delivery Managers typically possess extensive experience in construction, infrastructure, energy, utilities, or EPC projects, combined with strong knowledge of contract administration, subcontract management, claims management, change control, commercial management, risk management, and project delivery.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Manage subcontracts from award and handover through to completion and final closeout.
* Administer subcontract agreements and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
* Manage variations, change orders, claims, notifications, and contractual correspondence.
* Monitor subcontractor performance, progress, risks, and opportunities.
* Manage payment certification, invoice verification, and cost control processes.
* Support dispute resolution, cost recovery, and final account negotiations.
* Coordinate with project stakeholders to support successful project execution.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, quality standards, health and safety requirements, and company procedures.
* Maintain accurate records, reporting, and commercial documentation.
* Capture lessons learned and contributed to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your background**
**Education \& Experience**
* Relevant third level degree qualification (bachelor’s degree) in Engineering
* 10 Years Experience in heavy / industrial business and preferably in power sector
* Minimum of 5 (five) years in subcontract management experience, this includes commercial, contractual and construction awareness.
* Technical background is advantageous.
* Experience of successfully coordinating and managing multiple subcontracts / tasks effectively.

title: Subcontracts Delivery Manager
description:
**The opportunity**
 The
 **Subcontracts Delivery Manager (SDLM)** 
 is responsible for the commercial, contractual, and operational management of construction and installation subcontracts on major HVDC projects from contract award through to final completion and closeout.
   

  

 The role acts as the primary commercial interface between Hitachi Energy and its subcontractors, ensuring contractual obligations are met while protecting project objectives relating to safety, cost, schedule, quality, and risk.
   

  

 Working closely with Construction, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Cost Control, and Contract Management teams, the SDLM is responsible for proactively managing subcontract performance throughout project execution. This includes administering subcontract agreements, managing variations and change orders, assessing and resolving claims, negotiating commercial matters, monitoring performance, and identifying risks and opportunities that may impact project delivery.
   

  

 A key responsibility of the role is maintaining strong commercial control of subcontract packages. This includes managing payment applications, verifying invoices, tracking costs, preparing reports, supporting cost recovery initiatives, administering contractual changes, and ensuring that all commercial matters are properly documented and managed. The SDLM also plays a key role in the negotiation of final accounts and the successful closeout of subcontracts.
   

  

 The position requires strong stakeholder management and communication skills, as the SDLM regularly interfaces with subcontractors, site management, project leadership, engineers, contract managers, and clients. The ability to negotiate effectively, resolve disputes, manage commercial risk, and maintain strong working relationships is critical to success.
   

  

 Successful Subcontracts Delivery Managers typically possess extensive experience in construction, infrastructure, energy, utilities, or EPC projects, combined with strong knowledge of contract administration, subcontract management, claims management, change control, commercial management, risk management, and project delivery.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Manage subcontracts from award and handover through to completion and final closeout.
* Administer subcontract agreements and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
* Manage variations, change orders, claims, notifications, and contractual correspondence.
* Monitor subcontractor performance, progress, risks, and opportunities.
* Manage payment certification, invoice verification, and cost control processes.
* Support dispute resolution, cost recovery, and final account negotiations.
* Coordinate with project stakeholders to support successful project execution.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, quality standards, health and safety requirements, and company procedures.
* Maintain accurate records, reporting, and commercial documentation.
* Capture lessons learned and contributed to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your background**
**Education \& Experience**
* Relevant third level degree qualification (bachelor’s degree) in Engineering
* 10 Years Experience in heavy / industrial business and preferably in power sector
* Minimum of 5 (five) years in subcontract management experience, this includes commercial, contractual and construction awareness.
* Technical background is advantageous.
* Experience of successfully coordinating and managing multiple subcontracts / tasks effectively.
* Proficient with standard form and bespoke contracts.
* Proficiency in both spoken \& written English language is required.

title: Vice President, Commercial Strategy // Pipeline
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago\-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle\-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
   

  

 The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround \& Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution\-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
   

  

 Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high\-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.\-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long\-term growth in a high\-performance environment.
   

  

 The Commercial Strategy team is responsible for optimizing the firm’s go\-to\-market strategy, commercial operations and business development infrastructure. The team partners closely with firm leadership and practice leaders to drive revenue growth, enhance client engagement, improve pipeline visibility and strengthen decision\-making through technology, data and process optimization. By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion.
   

  

 The Vice President, Pipeline is responsible for the firm's pipeline discipline within the Commercial Enablement (CE) function. Reporting to the local Head of CE, the Vice President, Pipeline will own the opportunity pipeline integrity and the pipeline review rigor across industry verticals. This role institutionalizes pipeline discipline: how opportunities are staged, reviewed and forecast and how risk and aging are surfaced and acted on. This Vice President will turn pipeline data into reliable commercial intelligence for Practice Line Leaders (PLLs) and firm leadership. Success is measured by forecast reliability and the degree to which firm leadership relies on the pipeline as a single source of truth for commercial performance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with senior team members across all practice lines to strategically embed pipeline discipline into firm's commercial cadence
* Own pipeline standards and hygiene, including stage definitions, probability discipline and required data at each stage
* Run pipeline reviews with clarity and accountability, ensuring no opportunity drifts without commentary or next steps
* Track opportunity aging, conversion ratios, stage velocity and forecast accuracy
* Surface pipeline risk signals and data gaps for escalation to the relevant owners
* Produce pipeline dashboards and forecast reporting on a defined cadence for practice line and firm leadership
* Translate pipeline data into actionable commercial intelligence on performance, risk and opportunity
* Support board\-level reporting preparation and ensure pipeline figures are verified with PLLs and opportunity owners
* Coordinate with the Intapp DealCloud Product Manager ensuring pipeline workflows and reporting are well supported by firm systems
* Support business development efforts while maintaining strong relationships with existing clients
* Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Contribute to creating a high\-performing and inclusive culture


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Six plus years in sales operations, revenue operations, pipeline management or a related commercial discipline
* Demonstrated experience running pipeline reviews and forecasting for a senior audience
* Experience operating within professional services, consulting, investment banking or private equity environments (preferably serving U.S. clients)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate pipeline data into commercial insight
* Experience within the middle market private equity and advisory ecosystem is preferred
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, ideally Intapp DealCloud
* Exposure to revenue analytics and forecast governance is preferred
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast\-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high\-pressure environments

 The Leader of the India Business Service Centre (ISC) is the senior leadership role at Lixil's Bengaluru delivery hub. The individual builds and runs a multi\-disciplinary team that provides engineering execution, data management, process governance, and operational support services to R\&D and product functions across Lixil International. The role combines management of the India Business Service Center with active cross\-functional coordination particularly across R\&D Engineering, CAE, PLM, and data management workstreams, ensuring that globally assigned work packages are delivered on time, to standard, and with full traceability.
   

  

 This is a founding leadership position. The individual will shape the operating model, establish the teamculture, and represent the India centre in global programme governance. Beyond the immediate delivery mandate, we are looking for someone who brings maturity in managing professional teams, credibility with senior technical stakeholders in Europe, and the organisational instinct to build something that scales.
   

  

 The position sits within the India Business Service Centre in Bengaluru and requires sustained, proactive coordination with R\&D and product leadership teams across Europe and Asia\-Pacific.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the India Business Service Centre on a day\-to\-day basis: team performance, delivery quality, operating rhythms, and escalation management, serving as the single point of accountability for the centre in India.
* Coordinate delivery across R\&D Engineering, CAE (CFD/FEA), PLM, and data management workstreams:


 track assigned work packages, maintain visibility of milestones and dependencies, and proactively resolve
   

  

 bottlenecks before they impact NPD timelines.
   

  

* Act as the primary interface between India\-based team members and their functional counterparts and


 team leads in Hemer and other global sites, ensuring that context, expectations, and feedback flow clearly
   

  

 in both directions.
   

  

* Own workforce planning and recruitment coordination for the centre: work with HR India and recruitment partners to staff open roles, onboard new hires effectively, and maintain a talent pipeline across the centre's core engineering and operational disciplines.
* Establish and maintain structured onboarding, knowledge transfer, and ways\-of\-working protocols, ensuring that each new team member reaches productive integration with their global counterpart within a defined ramp period.
* Manage the ISC cost centre: plan vs. actual tracking, monthly reporting to Finance India and R\&D leadership, and ongoing cost efficiency tracking against the centre's headcount and delivery benchmarks.
* Ensure centre operations comply with LIPL's internal policies, Lixil International's data security and IP standards, and applicable Indian regulatory requirements, coordinating with Legal, IT, and Facilities as the centre scales.
* Represent the India centre in global R\&D governance forums and senior leadership interactions; prepare structured reporting on centre performance, capacity status, and open risks for the Steering Committee and R\&D leadership distribution.


**Your Profile Required**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* At least 12–15 years of professional experience in R\&D, engineering operations, or technical programme management, with a minimum of 5 years in a team leadership or centre management role.
* Demonstrated experience building or managing a delivery team in an India\-based shared services, GCC, or captive engineering centre context with direct accountability for headcount, quality of output, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Solid working knowledge of mechanical product development processes, including CAD/CAE workflows, PLM


 (product lifecycle management), and stage\-gate NPD execution, sufficient to coordinate effectively with engineers and identify delivery risks.
   

  

* Strong cross\-functional coordination skills: track record of managing delivery across multiple disciplines and time zones, working with counterparts who hold functional authority without direct reporting lines to this role.
* Proficiency with PLM and engineering data management environments (SAP, or equivalent) and comfort with portfolio tracking tools and structured reporting for senior audiences.
* Self\-driven and organised: able to maintain clarity across multiple parallel workstreams, follow through on commitments, and hold others to the same standard without being heavy\-handed.
* Business\-fluent English, written and spoken, clear and direct communicator to represent the India centre credibly in front of senior European stakeholders.


**Desirable**
* Prior experience in the sanitary ware, fittings, consumer durables, or precision mechanical manufacturing industry.
* Familiarity with PLM tools (CAD, ECM etc.), and with SAP ECM/ECN workflows for production documentation.
* Experience coordinating within a multinational or with European R\&D organisations operating across a formal stage\-gate governance structure.
* Exposure to the Karnataka GCC policy landscape and the broader Bengaluru engineering talent market.
* Working knowledge of German is a plus.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Production Supervisor – Dental Chair Manufacturing**

Department

**Production / Manufacturing**

Location

Skyloc Dentec Pvt. Ltd.

Job Type

Full\-Time

1\. Job Summary

Skyloc Dentec Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and responsible **Production Supervisor** to supervise and manage the production activities of dental chairs at our manufacturing unit.

The candidate must have **proven experience in supervising production operations in a manufacturing unit** and should be capable of managing technicians, monitoring production targets, maintaining raw\-material availability, and ensuring that dental chairs are manufactured as per the required quality and production schedule.

The Production Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring that the production team achieves the **specified targets assigned to individual technicians**, while maintaining proper coordination, discipline, quality standards, and timely completion of production work.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Production Supervision

* Supervise the complete production process of **dental chairs** in the manufacturing unit.
* Allocate production work and targets to technicians according to their skills and production requirements.
* Ensure that technicians complete the **specified production targets within the given time frame**.
* Monitor the daily production progress of each technician.
* Maintain daily and monthly production records of technicians.
* Identify delays, production issues, or bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower, tools, machinery, and other production resources.
* Coordinate with management regarding production requirements, progress, and challenges.

B. Technician Management

* Supervise and guide all technicians working in the dental\-chair production unit.
* Ensure that technicians follow the production process and assigned responsibilities properly.
* Monitor individual technician performance against the targets provided.
* Ensure discipline, punctuality, productivity, and proper working practices within the production team.
* Provide technical or operational guidance wherever required.
* Report repeated delays, negligence, poor performance, or failure to achieve assigned targets to management.

C. Raw Material \& Stock Management

* Maintain proper stock of **raw materials, components, consumables, and other items required for manufacturing dental chairs**.
* Regularly check the availability of production materials.
* Maintain proper records of incoming, issued, used, and available raw materials.
* Inform management/purchase department in advance regarding materials that are running low or are required for upcoming production.
* Ensure that production does not stop due to avoidable shortages of raw materials.
* Prevent unnecessary wastage, misuse, or loss of raw materials.
* Coordinate with the purchase/store department for timely procurement and availability of required materials.

D. Quality Control

* Ensure that dental chairs are manufactured according to the company's approved specifications and quality standards.
* Check the quality of work performed by technicians at different stages of production.
* Identify manufacturing defects and ensure that necessary corrections are completed.
* Ensure proper assembly, wiring, tubing, fitting, finishing, and functionality of dental chairs.
* Minimize rejection, rework, material wastage, and production\-related complaints.

E. Production Planning \& Reporting

* Prepare and maintain daily production plans based on company requirements.
* Track the number of dental chairs completed by each technician.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly production reports for management.
* Report target achievement, pending work, material requirements, and production problems.
* Coordinate production priorities according to dispatch, installation, and customer requirements.
* Ensure timely completion of production commitments given by the company.

3\. Required Qualification \& Experience

* Minimum **2–5 years of proven experience in production supervision in a manufacturing unit**.
* Experience in **dental chair manufacturing, medical equipment manufacturing, or similar equipment manufacturing** will be preferred.
* Graduate/Diploma/ITI or equivalent qualification in a relevant technical or manufacturing field will be preferred.
* Must have practical experience in handling and supervising technicians/workers.
* Must have experience in production planning, target allocation, stock monitoring, and production reporting.

Mandatory Requirement

**The candidate must have proven experience in supervising production activities in a manufacturing unit. Candidates without relevant production\-supervision experience will not be preferred.**

4\. Required Skills

* Strong production supervision and team\-management skills.
* Ability to achieve production targets through effective manpower management.
* Good understanding of manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of raw\-material and inventory management.
* Good problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.
* Ability to maintain production records and reports.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work under production deadlines.
* Responsible, disciplined, and result\-oriented approach.
* Basic computer knowledge, especially MS Excel/Google Sheets, will be preferred.

5\. Performance Expectations

The Production Supervisor will be expected to:

* Achieve the production targets assigned by management.
* Ensure technicians complete their assigned targets within the specified timeline.
* Maintain adequate stock of required raw materials.
* Minimize production delays and material wastage.
* Maintain required quality standards of dental chairs.
* Maintain accurate production and stock records.
* Ensure proper discipline and productivity of the production team.
* Immediately report any major production, material, quality, or manpower issue to management.

6\. Accountability

The Production Supervisor shall be accountable for the **overall production output, technician productivity, availability of raw materials, production quality, and timely completion of assigned manufacturing targets**.

Any shortage of raw material due to failure to monitor stock levels, avoidable production delays, repeated failure to achieve assigned targets, or negligence in production supervision may be reviewed by the management.

About Skyloc Dentec Pvt. Ltd.

**Skyloc Dentec Pvt. Ltd.** is engaged in the manufacturing and supply of dental equipment, including dental chair units and related dental products. The company focuses on providing reliable, quality\-oriented, and professionally manufactured dental solutions.

description:

Domain\-B2C supply chain
  
Industry preference\- FMCG/ Electronics
  
Relevant experience\-7\-13 years
  
About us
  
We’re Adobe’s Product Distribution Operations (PDO) team, and we run the worldwide production, fulfilment and distribution behind Adobe’s physical and point\-of\-sale products — from demand planning all the way to the invoice. We love getting the details right at global scale! Ready to own an operation and keep it running across every region? About the role
  
This role leads PDO for the Singapore hub. It is the main point of contact for production, turnkey and distribution, and owns our SAP S/4HANA planning coordinator responsibilities. It suits someone who enjoys both the detail of daily operations and the wider picture of cost, compliance and vendor relationships. What you’ll do
  
Day to day, the role runs the flow of orders and shipments worldwide — reviewing demand and supply, and issuing EDI purchase orders to our turnkey partner. When order, shipment or customs questions arise, you’ll resolve them with Sales, Order Management and logistics partners across NA, EMEA, APAC and Japan.
  
On the cost side, the role owns COGS for print, production and distribution, approves freight and vendor invoices, and issues monthly invoices for our entities. It also runs quarter\-end closure, sets excess\-and\-obsolete reserves, reconciles inventory and manages returns.
  
Product launches fill a big part of the year. The role sets up new term license, subscription and POSA SKUs, checks test\-card and link\-map readiness, and partners with the Product, Sales and turnkey teams so every launch lands on schedule.
  
**Compliance runs through all of it:** SOX controls, tax and environmental reporting for EMEA (Green Dot, EUDR, PPWR), and on\-site vendor audits that confirm modern\-slavery and labour requirements are met. What you’ll bring
  
Solid experience in supply chain, production planning or distribution operations
  
Hands\-on SAP (S/4HANA) and EDI order\-to\-cash knowledge
  
Comfort managing COGS, freight and invoices
  
A careful, accurate approach to compliance and audit (SOX a plus)
  
A track record of managing vendors and external partners
  
Clear communication across regions and teams Bonus points
  
Familiarity with POSA or Livecard fulfilment, Power BI or Tableau reporting, or APAC regional operations is a real plus. What we offer
  
This is a truly global role with real ownership and a supportive team behind it. We back our people with strong benefits and the freedom to shape how the operation runs as we grow. We’d love to have you on the team — come and build it with us! We can’t wait to see what you’ll do!
