title: Assistant Manager - SC Agro
description:
**Overview**
 Responsible for driving Contract Farming (CF) operations across the Hooghly, West Midnapore \& Jhargram geography to ensure sustainable procurement of quality potatoes for Lay's and Uncle chips. The role is accountable for expanding the farmer base, strengthening procurement networks, managing storage operations, and ensuring uninterrupted supplies to manufacturing plants while building strategic partnerships with farmers, aggregators, cold storages, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Contract Farming Development
* Lead the expansion and execution of Contract Farming programs across Hooghly, West Midnapore \& Jhargram.
* Identify and develop new potato\-growing clusters, multiplication pockets, and farmer networks to increase program penetration and ensure long\-term supply sustainability.
* Drive seed sales, farmer enrolment, and adoption of recommended agronomic practices (POP) through regular field engagement.
* Ensure timely seed distribution, crop monitoring, and technical advisory to achieve quality and productivity targets.
* Strengthen relationships with farmers, aggregators, FPOs, cooperatives, and channel partners to improve farmer retention and program scalability.
* Procurement \& Supply Assurance
* Own regional procurement targets for both Contract Farming (CF) and Non\-Contract Farming (NCF) potatoes within approved commercial and quality specifications.
* Ensure uninterrupted month\-wise and season\-wise supply of potatoes from Hooghly, West Midnapore \& Jhargram to manufacturing plants.
* Monitor crop quality parameters including TPoD, solids, reducing sugars, and chip\-grade specifications.
* Develop market intelligence on crop acreage, arrivals, pricing trends, competitor activities, and procurement opportunities to support commercial decision\-making.
* Drive chip\-grade procurement programs while ensuring quality compliance and minimizing pilferage.
* Cold Storage \& Inventory Management
* Identify, onboard, and manage strategic cold storage partners across Hooghly, West Midnapore \& Jhargram.
* Lead long\-storage planning, inventory monitoring, quality management, and phased evacuation to ensure uninterrupted plant supplies throughout the storage season.
* Work closely with storage operators, transport partners, and manufacturing teams to optimize inventory utilization and minimize storage losses.
* Stakeholder \& Government Engagement
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Agriculture and Horticulture Departments, Mandi Boards, district administration, and other government agencies across Hooghly, West Midnapore \& Jhargram.
* Partner with FPOs, cooperatives, research institutions, and local organizations to strengthen farmer engagement and expand Contract Farming initiatives.
* Organize farmer meetings, field demonstrations, extension programs, and government\-led initiatives to enhance program visibility and adoption.
* Operational Excellence \& Compliance
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement processes, statutory requirements, and documentation standards.
* Oversee seed sale documentation, procurement records, mandi tax compliance, transportation documentation, and audit readiness.
* Establish and monitor field quality laboratories, cook tests, and procurement quality protocols.
* Promote adoption of digital agriculture tools, satellite\-based crop monitoring, precision farming, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Ensure operational discipline among aggregators, transporters, cold storage partners, and suppliers.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Lead and develop the regional Agro team through coaching, mentoring, and technical capability building.
* Support implementation of an effective extension model to strengthen farmer connect and improve field execution.
* Foster a high\-performance culture through structured reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic \& Sustainability Initiatives
* Drive sustainability initiatives including Sustainable farming practices (SFP), regenerative agriculture, and other resource\-efficient farming practices across the region.
* Support R\&D initiatives involving new potato varieties, agronomic practices, crop protection molecules, and field demonstrations.


**Qualifications**
 Experience \& Qualifications
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture (B.Sc. Agriculture) is preferable.
* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Marketing, or Supply Chain is preferred.


**Experience**

* Strong experience working with potato farming ecosystems, cold storage operations, and farmer engagement in North Bengal, Bihar, or similar geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage government stakeholders, FPOs, traders, transporters, and cold storage partners.

title: Senior Merchandise Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Buyer \& Order Management** 



* Handle day\-to\-day communication and coordination with international buyers.
* Understand buyer requirements, specifications, quality standards, and critical timelines.
* Manage orders from development/concept stage through shipment.
* Review tech packs, specifications, BOM, measurement charts, artwork, and buyer comments.
* Ensure all buyer requirements are clearly communicated to the concerned internal teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with buyers and buying offices.



**2\. Product Development \& Sampling** 



* Coordinate development of samples, including proto, fit, size set, PP and shipment samples.
* Follow up on sample approvals and buyer comments.
* Coordinate with design, pattern, sampling, and technical teams to ensure timely development.
* Identify and resolve product development issues at an early stage.



**3\. Costing \& Pricing** 



* Prepare and review garment costing based on fabric, trims, CM, washing, printing, embroidery, packing, and other applicable costs.
* Negotiate prices with buyers and suppliers while maintaining company margins.
* Monitor changes in material costs and their impact on order profitability.
* Ensure commercial feasibility before order confirmation.



**4\. Production Coordination** 



* Coordinate with production planning, sourcing, stores, quality, and factory teams to ensure smooth execution of orders.
* Monitor T\&A (Time and Action) calendars and ensure adherence to critical milestones.
* Follow up on fabric and trims booking, approvals, cutting, sewing, finishing, packing, and shipment.
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action proactively.
* Conduct regular order status reviews with relevant departments.



**5\. Fabric \& Trim Management** 



* Coordinate fabric and accessory development and approvals.
* Ensure timely submission and approval of lab dips, strike\-offs, print/embroidery samples, trims, and other components.
* Follow up with sourcing and suppliers for timely delivery of materials.
* Ensure materials are in line with approved standards and buyer requirements.



**6\. Quality \& Compliance** 



* Work closely with the QA/QC team to ensure products meet buyer quality standards.
* Monitor quality issues during development and production and ensure timely corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with buyer\-specific requirements, testing standards, packaging specifications, and inspection procedures.



**7\. Shipment \& Commercial Coordination** 



* Monitor shipment schedules and ensure orders are ready within the committed timeline.
* Coordinate with commercial/logistics teams for documentation and shipment execution.
* Ensure packing, carton markings, shipping marks, and documentation comply with buyer requirements.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve shipment\-related issues.



**8\. Team Management** 



* Guide and supervise merchandising executives/merchandisers.
* Allocate accounts and responsibilities effectively.
* Review team performance, order status, and critical issues.
* Support team members in resolving buyer and production\-related challenges.
* Train and develop junior merchandising team members.

title: Manufacturing Operations Manager - India
description:
Sola Wood Flowers is hiring a Manufacturing Operations Manager to run operations at our Kolkata production facility.


On a Saturday morning somewhere in America, a bride walks down the aisle holding flowers made by hand on your floor. There is no re\-ship date for a wedding. Getting that right, every day, at scale, is what this job is.

**Who we are**


Sola Wood Flowers makes affordable, eco\-friendly wooden flowers. Every piece is handcrafted, and our flowers now show up in more than 6% of American weddings each year. We are building a modernized, vertically integrated platform north of $100M across DTC, owned retail, and wholesale, and India is central to how we grow.

**Before you apply**


This is not a desk job and it is not a reporting job. You lead from the floor, next to your supervisors, while the work is happening. The pace is real. If you are looking for a low\-stress 9\-to\-5, we would rather tell you now.

**Your responsibilities**

* Own day\-to\-day operations of the Kolkata facility: output, quality, people, and process.
* Deliver volume and lead\-time targets. Every wedding order ships on time. Fixed date, no do\-over.
* Grow your supervisors. The mark of a great operations leader is a floor that performs without them.
* See the bottleneck coming before it costs a ship day.
* Practice lean and kaizen daily. Cut waste, raise throughput, improve unit economics as we scale.

**What you bring**

* Real experience running manufacturing or production operations, ideally in handcrafted, labor\-intensive settings.
* A track record of managing large teams.
* A data\-driven working style. Excel/Sheets fluency will come up in the interview.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.
* On\-site daily in Kolkata.
* Able to provide references.

**What you get**


Ownership, not a warm seat. Smart people, low drama, and a clearly defined compensation philosophy. You win when we win.

**The hiring process**


A short intro conversation, then a longer technical interview on production operations. We will not waste your time or ours on a mishire. Your KPIs and targets are agreed together up front, so you always know how you are doing. We run on EOS/Traction (Scaling Up and OKRs adjacent). Average time from first interview to decision: about 8 to 10 days.


Apply now \- we read every application :)

title: National Logistics Manager
description:
**Company Description** 

 Mehta Excel Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015
 





 certified company providing end\-to\-end 3PL services across India. With over 35
 





 years of experience since its establishment in 1972, the company delivers
 





 integrated Supply Chain solutions, including logistics, transportation, and
 





 warehousing. Mehta Excel manages warehouse operations for leading organizations
 





 in FMCG, chemicals, white goods, pharma, and e\-commerce sectors. Guided by a
 





 strong belief in talent, determination, and hard work, the company focuses on building
 





 mutually beneficial, long\-term business relationships as a trusted logistics
 





 and distribution partner.
 




  





**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**1\. POSITION DETAILS** 




**Position:** 
  National Logistics Manager
 



**Function:** 
  Supply Chain / Logistics / Warehousing \& Distribution
 



**Level:** 
  Senior Management
 



**Location:** 
  Ahmedabad
 



**Reporting To:** 
  Directors
 



**Direct Reports:** 
  Distribution Centre Managers / Regional Operations Managers
 



**Team:** 
  DC Operations, Warehouse Operations, Process Excellence, WMS/SAP Operations and Project Implementation Teams
 



**Geographical Responsibility:** 
  Multiple Distribution Centres across India
 



**Travel Requirement:** 
  Extensive travel across India
 



**Nature of Role:** 
  Strategic \+ Technical \+ Operational \+ Project Implementation
 



**2\. ROLE PURPOSE** 




 The National Logistics Manager will be responsible for providing 
 **national\-level leadership for large\-scale FMCG warehousing and distribution operations** 
 , covering multiple Distribution Centres (DCs) located across different geographical regions of India.
 



 The role requires a 
 **highly experienced, technically strong, process\-oriented and hands\-on logistics professional** 
  who has demonstrated the ability to manage complex, high\-volume FMCG distribution operations while simultaneously driving productivity, technology adoption, warehouse engineering, process standardisation and cost optimisation.
 



 The incumbent will have overall responsibility for ensuring that all Distribution Centres operate at the required levels of 
 **service, productivity, inventory accuracy, safety, quality and cost efficiency** 
 .
 



 This position is not intended to be a conventional 
 **review, reporting or MIS\-driven logistics management role** 
 .
 



 The organisation is looking for a professional who is capable of moving between:
 


* Warehouse operation as per client KPIs
* Warehouse engineering
* Warehouse design
* Warehouse sizing
* Material\-flow analysis
* Racking design
* Process engineering
* SAP
* WMS
* Inventory management
* Productivity analysis
* Cost optimisation
* FMCG distribution
* New project implementation
* Operational troubleshooting
* Team leadership
* Client management
* On\-ground execution



 The candidate should be able to 
 **analyse an operation, understand what is actually happening on the warehouse floor, identify the root cause of inefficiencies, design an improved operating model and personally drive its implementation** 
 .
 



 A critical component of the role will be the implementation of new projects. For new warehouses or customer transitions, the incumbent is expected to participate from the earliest stage of 
 **data analysis, solution design, warehouse sizing and layout development** 
 , through implementation, go\-live and stabilisation.
 



 The individual must therefore be willing to spend significant time at project locations during implementation and remain at the location until the operation is adequately stabilised and agreed service and productivity levels are consistently achieved.
 



**3\. CORE OBJECTIVE OF THE ROLE** 




 The primary objective of the National Logistics Manager is to build and manage a 
 **high\-performing, technology\-enabled, process\-driven and scalable national distribution network** 
 .
 



 The role will focus on six fundamental outcomes:
 



**1\. Operational Excellence** 




 Ensure that every DC delivers consistent, reliable and efficient operations with strong service levels.
 



**2\. Warehouse Engineering** 




 Design and optimise warehouses based on data, material characteristics, storage requirements, throughput and future business needs.
 



**3\. Technology Excellence** 




 Ensure effective utilisation of SAP and WMS to control, monitor and improve warehouse operations.
 



**4\. Productivity \& Cost Optimisation** 




 Continuously improve manpower productivity, space utilisation, equipment productivity, throughput and cost efficiency.
 



**5\. Project Implementation** 




 Successfully design, implement, launch and stabilise new warehouses and logistics projects.
 



**6\. Leadership** 




 Build a strong team of DC Managers and operational leaders capable of independently managing high\-volume operations while maintaining consistent national standards.
 



**4\. ORGANISATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY** 




 The National Logistics Manager will operate at a national level and will have direct responsibility for the performance of multiple Distribution Centres.
 



 The National Logistics Manager will therefore be responsible for establishing a clear management framework covering:
 


* Operational KPIs
* Productivity benchmarks
* Cost benchmarks
* Inventory controls
* Process standards
* Technology utilisation
* Safety standards
* Customer service standards
* Review mechanisms
* Corrective\-action processes
* Continuous improvement



 The incumbent must ensure that DC Managers do not operate as independent silos.
 



 The objective is to create a 
 **common national operating philosophy** 
 , supported by standard processes and measurable performance standards.
 



**5\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**A. NATIONAL DISTRIBUTION CENTRE OPERATIONS** 




 The National Logistics Manager will have overall responsibility for the operational performance of all Distribution Centres under his/her control.
 



 Responsibilities will include:
 


* Provide overall leadership to multiple DC operations across India.
* Ensure that each DC operates in accordance with defined SOPs, customer requirements and business objectives.
* Establish common operating standards across all locations.
* Set clear operational KPIs for DC Managers.
* Review performance against agreed targets.
* Identify underperforming locations and drive structured corrective actions.
* Ensure that operational issues are addressed at root\-cause level rather than through temporary firefighting.
* Ensure that operational practices remain scalable as business volumes increase.
* Review throughput capacity and identify potential capacity constraints before they affect customer service.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of available warehouse space.
* Monitor manpower deployment and productivity.
* Monitor material handling equipment utilisation.
* Review inbound and outbound performance.
* Monitor dock utilisation and vehicle turnaround time.
* Ensure proper coordination between warehouse and transportation operations.
* Improve order fulfilment and dispatch reliability.
* Ensure adherence to customer\-specific service\-level agreements.
* Establish mechanisms for early identification of operational exceptions.
* Ensure that operational escalations are resolved within defined timelines.
* Conduct periodic operational audits across locations.
* Identify best practices from individual DCs and replicate them across the network.
* Establish a culture of operational discipline and accountability.



 The National Logistics Manager should not limit performance review to headline numbers.
 



 The incumbent should be capable of drilling down from a national KPI into:
 


* Shift\-level performance
* Process\-level performance
* SKU\-level issues
* Manpower productivity
* Equipment utilisation
* Picking productivity
* Dock productivity
* Inventory accuracy
* Order profile
* Volume profile
* Exception transactions
* System issues
* Process deviations

title: Sr. Manager:- Purchase
description:
Major Purpose of the Job
 



 To strategically source and procure raw materials required for
 **New Product Development (NPD) and R\&D activities** 
 , ensuring timely availability, competitive cost, quality compliance, and uninterrupted support to product development and launch timelines.
 



 The role will be responsible for coordinating with R\&D, F\&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Control, Quality Assurance and other stakeholders to ensure that procurement activities do not cause delays in NPD development, regulatory submissions, or product launches.
 



 Key Responsibility Areas
 



 1\. NPD Launch \& R\&D Support
 


* Source and procure raw materials required for NPD, R\&D trials, registration batches and commercial launch activities.
* Ensure timely availability of materials in line with NPD and product launch timelines.
* Coordinate closely with R\&D, F\&D, QA/QC, RA and SCM teams to understand material requirements and timelines.
* Ensure there are
 **no procurement\-related delays** 
 impacting NPD development or product launch.



 2\. Regulatory \& Documentation Support
 


* Ensure timely availability of complete vendor and material documentation required for
 **Regulatory Affairs (RA) and F\&D** 
 activities.
* Coordinate with suppliers for specifications, COA, manufacturing details, regulatory documents, declarations and other required documents.
* Support RA/F\&D teams in regulatory filing and dossier submission requirements.
* Ensure supplier documentation is accurate, complete and available within agreed timelines.



 3\. Alternate Vendor Development
 


* Identify and develop
 **alternate/backup vendors** 
 for critical raw materials to reduce supply\-chain dependency and business risk.
* Work with QA/QC and technical teams for vendor qualification and approval.
* Develop alternate sources for cost optimization and supply continuity.
* Maintain a robust approved vendor base for critical and strategic materials.



 4\. Cost Saving \& Commercial Negotiation
 


* Negotiate with suppliers to achieve
 **cost savings and commercially competitive procurement** 
 .
* Identify opportunities for price reduction through alternate sourcing, volume negotiation, payment terms, logistics optimization and contract negotiations.
* Generate and track procurement savings against approved targets.
* Benchmark supplier pricing and market trends to ensure competitive sourcing.



 5\. Quality \& Regulatory Compliance
 


* Ensure procurement activities comply with applicable
 **GMP, quality, regulatory and company requirements** 
 .
* Work closely with QA/QC to minimize material rejection due to quality\-related issues.
* Coordinate with vendors for corrective actions and resolution of quality issues.
* Support vendor audits, qualification and documentation requirements.
* Provide procurement support for vendor\-related
 **audit and dossier submission activities** 
 .



 6\. PR \& PO Management
 


* Ensure Purchase Requisitions (PRs) are processed and converted into POs within defined timelines.
* **No PR should remain open for more than 7 days** 
 , except for:
* Scheduled items
* Bulk items
* Solvents
* High\-value items
* PRs specifically kept on hold by SCM/R\&D
* Ensure timely follow\-up with stakeholders and suppliers for PO execution.



 7\. Open PO \& Delivery Management
 


* Monitor open POs and ensure timely delivery of materials.
* Drive closure of open POs and ensure that
 **open POs beyond 90 days from the committed/delivery date are minimized** 
 , except for annual contracts and campaign\-based products.
* Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve delivery delays.
* Maintain regular follow\-up and escalation for overdue purchase orders.



 8\. SAP \& Procurement Data Management
 


* Ensure accurate and timely updating of procurement transactions in
 **SAP** 
 .
* Ensure
 **no PR remains open for more than 90 days in SAP** 
 , except for approved/exempted cases.
* Maintain accurate PR, PO, delivery and vendor\-related records.
* Ensure procurement MIS and reports are updated regularly.

title: Manufacturing Operations Manager
company: TAARK ELECTRIC VEHICLES & EQUIPMENTS PVT LTD
description:
**1\. About TAARK** 

 TAARK Electric Vehicles \& Equipments Pvt Ltd designs and manufactures electric vehicles for industrial material transportation and commercial last\-mile applications. Our vehicles work in brick industries, textile mills, cement plants, agro industries, poultry farms, educational institutions, hospitals and commercial fleets.
 



 Our range covers industrial electric load carriers, brick transportation EVs, L5 commercial electric vehicles, electric tippers, electric forklifts, material handling solutions and customised application vehicles.
 



 We are an engineering\-first company. We do not compete on price. We compete on reliability, application engineering and after\-sales support, for customers who measure return on investment in tonnes moved per rupee spent.
 



  




**2\. Why this role exists** 

 Our products work and our customers repeat\-order. Manufacturing is now the constraint.
 



 We need one person to own the entire plant — planning, production, supply chain, quality and dispatch — and to build the systems that let us raise output without losing the reliability our customers buy us for.
 



**This is not a caretaker role.** 
 Much of what you need does not exist yet. You will build it. You will report directly to the Founder and carry full operating authority over the plant. There is no layer between you and the decision.
 



  




**3\. Scope of the role** 
**Part A \- Direct ownership** 

*You own these functions and you own the outcome.* 



**3\.1 Production Planning \& Control** 


 •  
 
 Own the monthly and weekly production plan; publish it and hold the plant to it.
 




 •  
 
 Maintain a rolling 90\-day capacity plan against the sales order book.
 




 •  
 
 Run a daily production meeting with a written agenda and closed action points.
 




 •  
 
 Own on\-time delivery as a measured number, reported weekly to the Founder.
 




 •  
 
 Establish routing, cycle times and standard man\-hours for every model.
 



  




**3\.2 Manufacturing \& Shop Floor** 


 •  
 
 Own output, quality and safety across fabrication, assembly, wiring, painting and testing.
 




 •  
 
 Implement and sustain 5S across all work centres, audited monthly with scores.
 




 •  
 
 Drive Kaizen against a target number of improvements implemented per quarter — implemented, not suggested.
 




 •  
 
 Balance line loading and reduce work\-in\-progress.
 




 •  
 
 Own plant safety: PPE compliance, machine guarding, incident reporting and corrective action.
 




 •  
 
 Maintain machine and equipment uptime through preventive maintenance schedules.
 



  




**3\.3 Supply Chain \& Vendor Development** 


 •  
 
 Own procurement of fabricated, machined, bought\-out and electrical items.
 




 •  
 
 Develop and qualify vendors; move every critical part from single source to dual source.
 




 •  
 
 Negotiate on total cost — price, payment terms, lead time and rejection rate — not price alone.
 




 •  
 
 Control inventory: set and hold reorder levels, minimum\-maximum stock and inventory days.
 




 •  
 
 Run vendor rating on quality, delivery and responsiveness, reviewed quarterly with the vendor present.
 




 •  
 
 Eliminate line stoppages caused by material shortage.
 



  




**3\.4 Quality Systems** 


 •  
 
 Own the ISO 9001:2015 /IATF quality management system: documentation, internal audits, management review, certification and surveillance audits.
 




 •  
 
 Write and enforce SOPs and work instructions for every major assembly.
 




 •  
 
 Establish incoming, in\-process and final inspection with recorded data.
 




 •  
 
 Own product traceability — batch and serial records linking each vehicle to its battery, motor, controller and critical bought\-out parts.
 




 •  
 
 Lead root cause analysis on every field failure and customer complaint; implement corrective and preventive action, and verify six months later that it held.
 




 •  
 
 Own rejection and rework cost as a measured number.
 



  




**3\.5 Dispatch \& Logistics** 


 •  
 
 Ensure every vehicle leaves the plant fully tested, documented and complete.
 




 •  
 
 Own pre\-dispatch inspection and sign\-off.
 




 •  
 
 Manage dispatch documentation, transporter selection and delivery commitments to customer and dealer.
 




 •  
 
 Coordinate with the service team on installation, commissioning and warranty support.
 



  




**Part B \-Review and oversight** 

*You do not own these functions. You review their interface with manufacturing, raise issues early, and escalate to the Founder where they threaten output, cost or quality.* 





 •  
 
**Sales \& Marketing \-** 
 Order pipeline against the production plan, delivery commitments made to customers, and complaints entering the plant.
 




 •  
 
**Accounts \-** 
 Material cost, inventory valuation, and vendor payment cycles where they affect supply continuity.
 




 •  
 
**New Product Development \-** 
 Design for manufacturability, prototype\-to\-production transfer, and engineering change control.
 



  




**Part C\- People and second line** 


 •  
 
 Build the plant organisation: supervisors, planners, quality inspectors and stores.
 




 •  
 
 Establish a skill matrix and a training plan for operators and technicians.
 




 •  
 
 Set and hold daily and weekly performance review discipline.
 


* **Identify and develop your own successor.** 
 This is a stated objective of the role and it will be reviewed, not an afterthought.


- 

**Who we are looking for** 
**Essential** 


 •  
 
 10–16 years in discrete manufacturing — fabrication and assembly. Automotive, EV, industrial equipment, material handling, machine building or capital goods.
 




 •  
 
 At least 3 years with full ownership of a plant or a major manufacturing function.
 




 •  
 
 A demonstrated record of building systems where none existed — SOPs written, QMS implemented, planning discipline established. We will ask for specifics.
 




 •  
 
 Working command of ISO 9001:2015\. Internal auditor or Management Representative experience preferred.
 




 •  
 
 Practical command of lean manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, root cause analysis and preventive action — applied on a floor, not attended in a classroom.
 




 •  
 
 Vendor development experience across a base of 50 or more suppliers.
 




 •  
 
 Able to read engineering drawings and hold a technical conversation with design, vendors and customers.
 




 •  
 
 BE / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Automobile Engineering. Exceptional diploma holders with a strong track record will be considered.
 




 •  
 
 Fluent in Tamil and English.
 




 •  
 
 Willing to work on\-site in Coimbatore, full time.
 



  




**Preferred** 


 •  
 
 Low\-volume, high\-mix vehicle or machine build \- chassis, wiring harness, hydraulics, sub\-assembly.
 




 •  
 
 Exposure to EV systems: battery packs, motor controllers, traction motors, BMS.
 




 •  
 
 Experience carrying a plant through a step change in output.
 




 •  
 
 ERP implementation or migration experience.
 



  




**4\. What this role is not** 


 •  
 
 This is not an established system to maintain. You will build the system.
 




 •  
 
 This is not a large plant with deep functional teams. You will be on the floor, daily.
 




 •  
 
 This is not a role where you wait for headcount before delivering. Build with what exists, then earn the addition.
 




 •  
 
 We do not match large\-OEM compensation. What we offer instead is complete authority, a direct line to the Founder, and ownership of an outcome that stays yours.
 



  




**5\. What we offer** 


 •  
 
 Complete operating authority over the plant, reporting directly to the Founder \& Director.
 




 •  
 
 Fixed CTC of ₹10–14 LPA based on experience and demonstrated track record, plus a performance\-linked variable against the Key Result Areas.
 




 •  
 
 A written 90\-day mandate and a quarterly review, so you always know where you stand.
 




 •  
 
 The chance to build the manufacturing backbone of a company intent on becoming one of India’s most respected industrial electric mobility manufacturers.
 



  




**6\. How to apply** 

 Send your resume to
 **karthick@taark.in , taarkhr@gmail.com** 
 with the subject line
 **Manager/Senior Manager/Assistant General Manager\-Manufacturing Operations** 
 .

title: E-commerce operations Supervisor
description:
E\-Commerce Operations Supervisor
 
**Company:** 
 Robinbosky
 



**Location:** 
 Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹15,000 – ₹28,000 per month
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **E\-Commerce Operations Supervisor** 
 to manage the daily execution of our online sales operations across multiple marketplaces and our own website.
 



 The role involves supervising the complete order flow from
 **order receipt and stock verification to picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and stock reconciliation** 
 .
 



 The candidate should be comfortable working with marketplace dashboards, coordinating with warehouse and dispatch teams, following up pending orders, and ensuring that daily e\-commerce operations run accurately and on time.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesE\-Commerce Order Operations
 * Manage daily orders from platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho,Firstcry, JioMart and Shopify / company website** 
 .
* Monitor new, pending, packed, shipped, cancelled, returned, and replacement orders.
* Ensure every order is processed within the required marketplace SLA.
* Coordinate with warehouse staff for picking, checking, packing, and dispatch.
* Follow up until all daily orders are completely dispatched.
* Ensure the correct
 **SKU, size, colour, quantity, invoice and shipping label** 
 are used for every order.
* Identify and resolve order\-processing delays before they affect marketplace performance.


 Stock \& Inventory Coordination
 * Maintain accurate stock availability for e\-commerce products.
* Coordinate with warehouse and production teams when stock is low or unavailable.
* Monitor SKU\-wise, size\-wise, and colour\-wise stock.
* Help reconcile physical inventory with system and marketplace stock.
* Identify stock mismatches, overselling risks, unavailable SKUs, and inventory errors.
* Ensure inward and outward stock movements are properly recorded.
* Coordinate finished\-goods stock received from production with marketplace requirements.


 Packing \& Dispatch Supervision
 * Supervise daily picking and packing operations.
* Ensure products are properly checked before packing.
* Verify quantity, size, colour, quality, packaging, invoice, and shipping labels.
* Ensure marketplace and website orders are dispatched within cut\-off timings.
* Coordinate courier and marketplace pickup schedules.
* Follow up on missed pickups, delayed shipments, failed dispatches, and logistics issues.
* Maintain clear records of orders pending dispatch and reasons for delay.


 Returns, RTO \& Replacement Management
 * Track marketplace returns, RTOs, customer returns, and replacements.
* Coordinate returned\-product receiving and verification.
* Ensure returned items are checked for condition and correctly classified.
* Coordinate restocking of saleable returned products.
* Maintain records for damaged, rejected, missing, or non\-saleable returns.
* Escalate unusual return or RTO patterns to management.


 Marketplace Operations
 * Monitor marketplace operational dashboards daily.
* Check order defects, cancellations, late dispatches, return issues, and account\-health related operational alerts.
* Coordinate resolution of basic marketplace operational issues.
* Maintain product availability and inventory wherever required.
* Follow up internally on issues affecting marketplace order fulfilment.
* Coordinate with senior management when marketplace support escalation is required.


 Team Supervision
 * Supervise warehouse staff involved in e\-commerce picking, packing, checking, and dispatch.
* Allocate daily work based on order volume and priority.
* Ensure work is completed accurately and within timelines.
* Maintain discipline, productivity, and cleanliness in the e\-commerce packing and dispatch area.
* Train team members on correct picking, packing, SKU identification, and dispatch procedures.


 Daily Monitoring
 
 The E\-Commerce Operations Supervisor should have a clear status every day on:
 


* Total orders received
* Orders processed
* Orders pending
* Orders packed
* Orders dispatched
* Orders delayed
* Stock shortages
* Marketplace cancellations
* Returns and RTOs
* Pending replacements
* Courier pickup issues
* Stock mismatches
* Operational issues requiring escalation


 Candidate Requirements
 * Experience in
 **e\-commerce operations, warehouse, order processing, dispatch, inventory, or marketplace operations** 
 .
* Experience handling marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho or similar platforms is preferred.
* Good understanding of order processing, inventory, picking, packing, and dispatch.
* Comfortable using computers, Excel / Google Sheets, marketplace dashboards, and inventory software.
* Strong attention to detail, especially with SKU, size, colour, quantity, and stock accuracy.
* Good follow\-up and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to supervise a small operational team.
* Should be comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment with daily dispatch deadlines.
* Tamil communication is essential; basic working English is preferred.


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We need someone who takes ownership of the full daily e\-commerce execution cycle:
 



**Orders → Stock Check → Picking → Checking → Packing → Dispatch → Tracking → Returns → Stock Reconciliation** 




 The candidate should not simply update order status. If an order is stuck, stock is missing, a pickup is delayed, or a return is unresolved, they should actively follow up and make sure the issue reaches closure.
 


 Salary
 
**₹15,000 – ₹28,000 per month** 




 Salary will be based on e\-commerce marketplace experience, inventory knowledge, dispatch handling, team\-management ability, and overall operational capability.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Strategy and Transactions (SaT) – Valuation, Modelling \& Economics (VME) – Business Valuations – Senior**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Leading a team of VME professionals focusing on business valuations competency who are engaged in performing enterprise and asset valuations for Middle East and North African (MENA) EY Clients.
* Managing client relationship with various user offices across MENA region and supporting team leads with business development initiatives of the firm.
* Liaising with the onshore team and capable of acting as a single point of contact in project execution and delivery.
* Being responsible for acting as a counsellor/mentor up to 3 team members and responsible for their career growth within the firm.
* Capability to take lead in performing valuations, develop and review valuation models for purposes including financial accounting and reporting purposes; feasibility study; corporate transactions.
* Stay abreast with current business and economic developments relevant to the client's business.
* Demonstrating in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.
* Use current technology and tools to innovate and enhance the effectiveness of services provided and act as a leader in adopting new tools and techniques.
* Work in a highly regarded team, which values collaboration, respect and knowledge sharing.
* Work in close collaboration with other Strategy and Transaction teams and the wider firm.


**What we look for:**
* You have an agile, growth\-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We’re looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
* You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers that build a better working world.
* You are inclusive. We’re looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.
* You are highly motivated. We’re looking for candidates who are highly motivated, analytical, logical thinkers with a passion in providing financial solutions and have a very strong attention to detail. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our client’s goals.


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* CA / ACCA / CFA or MBA – Finance (preferably from a premier institute) with a good academic background (in the order of highest qualification preference)
* 4 to 8 years of related work experience
* Experience with a Big\-4 in similar role or with an industry leading venture capital, investment bank, commercial bank, or a national accounting firm is a must
* Demonstrated aptitude in quantitative and qualitative analysis
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and communication skills
* A strong work ethic and the ability to adapt to new challenges in a collaborative team environment
* A strong desire to continually develop themselves and others
* Ability to successfully manage engagements including the work of junior team members and quality of support
* Ability to provide best practice guidance to team members to ensure the completion of work deliverables at the highest level of quality
* Working knowledge in MS Excel with VBA skills and exposure to various Analytics tools including Spotfire, Tableau, Altryx is preferred
* General PC proficiency including Word, and PowerPoint


 We would expect you to be available to travel outside of your assigned office location at least 50% of the time, plus commute within the region to other GDS locations on a short or long\-term basis, whenever required.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across multiple locations globally and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: IT Service Delivery Manager (Looking For Immediate Joiner)
description:
The IT Service Delivery Manager is a senior leadership role responsible for the end-to-end delivery and performance of IT Service Desk outsourcing engagements across global regions. Operating at the intersection of client service excellence and operational execution, this individual leads multidisciplinary teams distributed across geographic time zones ensuring continuous 24x7 service delivery in full compliance with contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs). A critical dimension of this role is the ability to bridge communication between U.S.-based solution strategy, architecture, and client relationship teams and the delivery workforce based in India. The ideal candidate brings deep familiarity with how U.S. enterprise clients communicate, escalate, and define success and is skilled at translating that context into actionable guidance for in-country delivery teams. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Service Delivery & SLA Governance Own end-to-end delivery accountability for IT Service Desk outsourcing engagements, ensuring all contractual SLA and KPI targets are consistently met or exceeded. Lead the operational cadence across 24x7 global shifts, including escalation protocols, incident response, and service continuity planning. Drive continuous improvement initiatives analyzing ticket trends, CSAT data, and operational metrics to optimize team performance and reduce service failure risk. Oversee SLA reporting, monthly/quarterly business reviews, and executive-level client communications related to performance and outcomes. 
 Team Leadership & Global Operations Directly manage and mentor Service Desk Team Leads and shift supervisors across global locations, building a high-performance delivery culture. Serve as the operating authority across geographically distributed teams in India, ensuring seamless shift handoffs, knowledge transfer, and consistent quality standards. Define workforce planning strategies — including headcount modeling, scheduling, and cross-training — to maintain coverage across all contracted service windows. Lead talent development, performance management, and succession planning for delivery staff at all levels. 
 U.S. Client Interface & Communication Translation Act as the primary operational liaison between U.S.-based client stakeholders, solution architects, and strategy teams — and the India-based delivery organization. Interpret and translate U.S. client communication styles, escalation sensitivities, and cultural expectations into clear, actionable direction for local delivery teams. Participate in U.S. client-facing meetings, including kick-off sessions, service reviews, escalation calls, and contract renewals, representing the global delivery organization. Proactively identify gaps in client understanding or expectation alignment and implement communication strategies to close them. 
 Outsourcing Contract & Stakeholder Management Develop deep fluency in all active outsourcing contracts — understanding scope, SLA structures, penalty clauses, exclusions, and change management terms. Collaborate with sales, pre-sales, and solution teams in the U.S. during the pursuit and transition phases of new engagements. Manage risk escalations and governance processes with both the client and internal leadership, maintaining trust and transparency at all stakeholder levels. Support pricing, scope changes, and renewal discussions by providing delivery data, trend analysis, and operational insight. 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 
 Experience & Background Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in the IT industry, with the majority in IT consulting, managed services, or IT systems integration environments. Demonstrated career progression from IT Service Desk Team Lead to Service Delivery Manager in an outsourcing context — with verifiable team lead tenure. Hands-on experience managing large-scale, global 24x7 IT Service Desk engagements with resources distributed across multiple geographies. Proven experience delivering against complex, multi-tiered outsourcing SLAs in enterprise-class client environments. 
 Technical & Domain Knowledge Senior-level proficiency in ITSM frameworks including ITIL — particularly Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Level Management. Deep familiarity with Service Desk tooling platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management) and workforce management systems. Strong command of outsourcing SLA structures — including design, measurement, reporting, and contractual interpretation. Experience with service transition and transformation — including knowledge of onboarding clients, building runbooks, and managing go-live risk. 
 Leadership & Communication Exceptional ability to lead, influence, and develop geographically dispersed, multidisciplinary teams without direct co-location. Demonstrated cultural intelligence and communication adaptability — specifically in bridging U.S. enterprise client expectations with India-based delivery execution. Executive presence with the ability to present to and engage with senior stakeholders on both the client and internal sides. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience in formal client reporting, RCA documentation, and executive briefings. 

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher; PMP or PRINCE2 a strong plus. Experience working directly with IT consulting firms, IT staffing integrators, or systems integrators in a multi-client delivery capacity. Familiarity with pre-sales processes — including supporting solutioning, contributing to proposals, or participating in client discovery sessions. Prior experience in a role that required frequent collaboration with U.S.-based or globally distributed solution strategy and architecture functions. Exposure to AI-augmented service desk tools, automation platforms (e.g., RPA), or shift-left / self-service strategies. 
 SUCCESS PROFILE — WHAT SETS THE BEST APART The ideal candidate is not simply an operations manager — they are a cross-cultural leader who understands that the distance between a client in the U.S. and a delivery team in India is not just geographic. It is contextual, communicative, and cultural. The best candidates will demonstrate: A track record of building delivery teams that consistently beat SLA targets while maintaining high CSAT scores. The ability to walk into a U.S. client QBR and earn credibility with C-suite stakeholders — then turn around and coach an India-based team lead on how to interpret and act on that feedback. An instinct for risk — knowing when to escalate, when to problem-solve quietly, and when to bring leadership in. A continuous improvement mindset backed by operational data — not intuition alone.

We are looking for an experienced, responsible and energetic Centre Head who can take complete ownership of the centre and oversee everything that happens across the facility. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overall operations, team management, customer experience, service quality, staff training, sales, inventory, hygiene, administration and the smooth functioning of all wellness services. Key Responsibilities Take complete ownership of the day-to-day operations of the entire wellness centre. Ensure the centre operates smoothly, efficiently and professionally at all times. Manage, supervise, train, motivate and develop the entire team. Allocate duties and ensure proper staffing across different services and activities. Train employees on customer service, professional behaviour, service standards and SOPs. Monitor staff performance, attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline and productivity. Ensure proper coordination between therapists, beauty staff, yoga instructors, reception and other team members. Oversee the complete customer journey, from enquiry and booking to service completion and follow-up. Ensure every customer receives a high-quality, personalised and welcoming experience. Manage inventory, stock consumption, purchases and wastage. Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for the centres operational requirements. Identify opportunities for new services, packages, memberships and other revenue-generating activities. Ensure all centre SOPs, policies and processes are properly implemented and followed. Conduct regular team meetings and communicate daily priorities and expectations. Maintain a professional, positive and disciplined working environment. Maintain proper records and daily operational reports. Identify operational problems and resolve them quickly and effectively. Handle unexpected operational situations and emergencies responsibly. Keep the owners/management regularly updated on sales, staff, customers, inventory, expenses and overall centre performance. Work closely with the owners to improve operations, customer experience and business performance. Take complete responsibility for ensuring that everything happening inside the centre is managed properly and professionally. Take on additional responsibilities as the centre expands and introduces new wellness services and activities. What We Are Looking For Previous experience in wellness, spa, beauty, hospitality, fitness or premium service operations. Experience as a Centre Head, Centre Manager, Spa Manager, Wellness Manager, Salon Manager, Operations Manager or similar role will be preferred. Strong leadership and people-management skills. Excellent customer-handling and communication skills. Strong organisational and problem-solving abilities. Ability to train, motivate and manage a team independently. Sales-oriented mindset with the ability to drive bookings and revenue. Understanding of customer experience and premium service standards. Knowledge of inventory and day-to-day operational management. Professional, mature and responsible approach to managing people and operations. Honest, organised, hardworking and proactive. Ability to work in a fast-paced wellness environment. Strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently without constant supervision or micromanagement

title: Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT ZAILLOR 
 Zaillor is an early-stage AI visibility company helping businesses become more discoverable, understandable, citable, and recommendable across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and other AI-led search experiences. Its offerings span a free AI Visibility Score, detailed visibility reports, and managed AI SEO/AEO implementation, including prompt monitoring, citation work, structured data, and recurring reporting. 
 ROLE OVERVIEW 
 The Operations Manager is a hands-on AI visibility implementation lead role. You will use Codex and Claude Code at a medium-to-advanced level, together with Zaillor's proprietary agents, to research, create, implement, and QA client deliverables such as schemas, robots.txt, llms.txt, AI-citable content, implementation briefs and others. You will apply AEO methodology in practice, guide clients through the implementation journey, answer their questions clearly, and keep every workstream moving with a high bar for detail and accuracy. 
 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Client Delivery, AI Visibility & Technical Implementation Own multiple client workstreams from onboarding and kickoff through implementation, QA, reporting, and closure; keep timelines, owners, dependencies, and follow-ups visible and on track. Use Codex and Claude Code at a medium-to-advanced level, plus Zaillor's proprietary agents, to accelerate research, analysis, implementation, documentation, and client delivery without compromising quality. Apply AEO methodology to diagnose entity clarity, answerability, citation readiness, content structure, source quality, crawlability, and the signals that influence how AI systems understand and cite a brand. Create accurate, implementation-ready client deliverables, including JSON-LD schemas, robots.txt, llms.txt, internal-linking and architecture recommendations, technical tickets, content briefs, FAQs, and AI-citable content. Implement or coordinate technical changes across crawlability, indexation, redirects, canonicals, XML sitemaps, JavaScript rendering, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals, structured data, AI crawler access, CDN/hosting/WAF settings, and migrations; verify every change after release. Guide clients through the full implementation journey: explain findings in plain language, answer questions, set expectations, secure inputs and approvals, and communicate risks, decisions, next steps, and outcomes clearly. Apply rigorous detail and accuracy checks to every deliverable, recommendation, URL, schema property, directive, and content claim before it reaches the client; correct issues quickly and document the final state. Track organic and AI signals using GSC, GA4, crawl platforms, SEO suites, spreadsheets, and AI visibility tools; improve SOPs, QA systems, reporting formats, and lightweight tools or automations as Zaillor scales. 

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 Multiple client programs move from diagnosis to implementation with clear ownership, timely follow-through, and predictable communication. • Schemas, robots.txt, llms.txt, content, briefs, and technical recommendations are accurate, implementation-ready, and fully QA-checked. Clients understand the AEO plan, receive clear answers to their questions, and know what happens next at every stage. Client visibility, source inclusion, citation frequency, AI referrals, and relevant organic outcomes improve over time where measurable. Codex, Claude Code, and Zaillor's proprietary agents are used thoughtfully to increase speed, coverage, and consistency without reducing judgment or accuracy. Repeatable workflows, SOPs, templates, and tools make high-quality delivery easier as the client portfolio grows. 

 WHO SHOULD APPLY 
 Hands-on, medium-to-advanced experience using Codex and Claude Code; able to learn and operate Zaillor's proprietary agents as part of daily client delivery. Practical experience with AEO/GEO methodology and a strong understanding of how content, entities, structure, sources, schema, and crawlability affect AI citations. Strong working knowledge of technical SEO, including crawl/indexation fundamentals, redirects, canonical tags, structured data/schema, internal linking, and website architecture. Able to create AI-citable content and implementation-ready recommendations, with an exceptional eye for detail and accuracy across technical and written deliverables. Comfort with Google Search Console, GA4, crawl tools, SEO platforms, spreadsheets, dashboards, and AI visibility tools; basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript understanding is expected. Confident speaking with clients, explaining technical findings clearly, handling questions, setting expectations, and managing several client workstreams at once. Dependable, proactive, and comfortable working on-site from Greater Noida West with a fast-moving startup team. 
 GOOD TO HAVE 
 Experience in an SEO agency, B2B SaaS, technology company, or client-facing delivery environment. Hands-on exposure to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, or similar CMS platforms; site migrations, redirect mapping, log analysis, Core Web Vitals, or JavaScript-heavy sites. Familiarity with entity SEO, digital PR/off-page authority, AI crawler controls, CDN/WAF configuration, llms.txt, Markdown publishing, or agent-friendly website practices. Ability to develop lightweight tools, scripts, no-code automations, or API workflows that make recurring research, QA, and delivery tasks faster. 
 WHY JOIN ZAILLOR 
 Own real client AI SEO/AEO programs and work closely with the founders from day one. Solve practical problems at the intersection of AI search, technical SEO, content, analytics, and website technology. Help shape the SOPs, QA systems, reporting rhythms, and delivery playbooks that will scale with the company. Build broad, hands-on experience in operations, technical implementation, client delivery, and process design

title: Warehouse Operations Manager
description:
🚨 URGENT HIRING – QUICK COMMERCE WAREHOUSE OPERATIONS \| BENGALURU
   

  

 📍 Location: Ekrajapura, Hoskote, Bengaluru, Karnataka
   

  

 We are looking for 5 highly experienced Warehouse Operations Managers for an immediate requirement:
   

  

 🔹 Inbound Manager – 1
   

 🔹 Putaway Manager – 1
   

 🔹 Inventory Manager – 1
   

 🔹 Picking Manager – 1
   

 🔹 Dispatch Manager – 1
   

  

 Candidate Profile:
   

 ✅ Strong Quick Commerce / E\-Commerce warehouse experience
   

 ✅ Flipkart , Amazon , Zepto , BlinkIT warehouseing experience strongly preferred
   

 ✅ Hands\-on experience in high\-volume fulfilment operations
   

 ✅ Strong knowledge of WMS, SLA/KPI management \& MIS
   

 ✅ Experience managing large blue\-collar teams and shift operations
   

 ✅ Strong understanding of productivity, inventory accuracy, RCA/CAPA \& process controls
   

 ✅ Should be capable of taking independent functional ownership from Day 1
   

  

 🎓 Qualification: Graduate / B.Tech / MBA / PG in Operations, Supply Chain or Logistics preferred
   

  

 ⚡ Interview: Immediate / Today
   

 ⚡ Joining: Immediate / Next Day Preferred
   

  

  

 Requirement: 5 Managerial Positions – 1 person for each function
   

 Positions: Inbound Manager \| Putaway Manager \| Inventory Manager \| Picking Manager \| Dispatch Manager
   

 Interview: Immediate / Today
   

 Joining: Immediate / Next Day Preferred
   

 Compensation: Competitive – salary will be considered appropriately for the right candidate
   

  

 Candidate Profile – Strong Preference
   

  

 We are looking for highly qualified and experienced warehouse professionals with strong exposure to Quick Commerce / E\-Commerce fulfilment operations.
   

  

 Candidates with prior Flipkart / Flipkart Minutes warehouse operations experience will be strongly preferred.
   

  

 Candidates should have hands\-on exposure to high\-volume warehouse operations, WMS, manpower management, productivity \& KPI management, process compliance and shift operations.
   

  

 Preferred Qualification: Graduate / B.Tech / MBA / PG in Operations, Supply Chain or Logistics, with strong analytical, operational and people\-management capabilities.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 1\. INBOUND MANAGER
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- End\-to\-end ownership of inbound warehouse operations.
   

 \- Manage vehicle reporting, dock planning, unloading, GRN and inward processing.
   

 \- Ensure timely receiving, quantity/quality verification and system updates.
   

 \- Manage SKU segregation, staging and handover for putaway.
   

 \- Control Inbound TAT and Dock\-to\-Stock time.
   

 \- Coordinate with vendors, transporters, customer teams and internal departments.
   

 \- Manage manpower deployment based on hourly/daily inbound volumes.
   

 \- Monitor shortages, excesses, damages and inbound discrepancies.
   

 \- Ensure WMS/system transactions are completed accurately and on time.
   

 \- Drive productivity, safety, 5S and process compliance.
   

  

 Key KPIs: Inbound TAT \| Dock\-to\-Stock \| GRN Accuracy \| Productivity \| Damage/Shortage \| Pending Inward \| Manpower Productivity
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. PUTAWAY MANAGER
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- End\-to\-end responsibility for putaway operations after inbound receipt.
   

 \- Ensure fast and accurate movement of inventory from staging to assigned storage locations.
   

 \- Optimize bin/location utilization based on SKU velocity, dimensions and storage strategy.
   

 \- Monitor WMS\-directed putaway and ensure physical vs. system location accuracy.
   

 \- Prevent putaway backlog and maintain agreed SLA.
   

 \- Coordinate closely with Inbound, Inventory and Picking teams.
   

 \- Plan manpower and MHE deployment according to volume.
   

 \- Manage high\-velocity SKU replenishment and storage availability.
   

 \- Ensure adherence to FIFO/FEFO wherever applicable.
   

 \- Drive productivity, safety, 5S and process discipline.
   

  

 Key KPIs: Putaway TAT \| Putaway Productivity \| Location Accuracy \| Putaway Backlog \| Space Utilization \| Damage Rate \| SLA Adherence
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. INVENTORY MANAGER
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- Complete ownership of inventory accuracy and inventory control.
   

 \- Ensure physical inventory matches WMS/system inventory.
   

 \- Manage cycle counts, perpetual inventory, stock audits and reconciliation.
   

 \- Investigate inventory variances, shortages, excesses and wrong\-bin cases.
   

 \- Control damaged, blocked, returned and non\-saleable inventory.
   

 \- Conduct RCA for recurring inventory discrepancies and implement CAPA.
   

 \- Monitor ageing inventory and overall inventory health.
   

 \- Coordinate with Inbound, Putaway, Picking and Dispatch functions.
   

 \- Maintain audit\-ready inventory records and reports.
   

 \- Drive bin accuracy and process compliance across the warehouse.
   

  

 Key KPIs: Inventory Accuracy \| Bin Accuracy \| Cycle Count Compliance \| Shrinkage \| Inventory Variance \| Damage \| Reconciliation TAT
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. PICKING MANAGER
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- End\-to\-end management of picking operations for a high\-volume Quick Commerce fulfilment operation.
   

 \- Ensure orders are picked accurately within defined SLA/cut\-off.
   

 \- Manage wave/batch/order picking as applicable through WMS.
   

 \- Plan picker deployment according to hourly order volumes and peak requirements.
   

 \- Monitor picker productivity and picking accuracy in real time.
   

 \- Ensure replenishment of fast\-moving SKUs to avoid picking disruption.
   

 \- Control wrong picks, short picks, missed picks and damaged\-product cases.
   

 \- Coordinate closely with Inventory, Putaway and Dispatch teams.
   

 \- Handle peak/festive volumes with appropriate manpower and shift planning.
   

 \- Drive productivity improvement without compromising quality or safety.
   

  

 Key KPIs: Units Picked per Hour \| Picking Accuracy \| Order SLA \| Short/Miss Pick \| Productivity \| Replenishment Availability \| Backlog
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. DISPATCH MANAGER
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- End\-to\-end ownership of dispatch operations.
   

 \- Ensure order consolidation, staging, verification and timely dispatch.
   

 \- Manage dispatch docks and vehicle/route\-wise loading.
   

 \- Ensure system closure and documentation before vehicle departure.
   

 \- Coordinate with transport, last\-mile and internal operations teams.
   

 \- Control order misses, wrong dispatches, damages and loading discrepancies.
   

 \- Plan manpower and dock capacity according to dispatch waves/volume.
   

 \- Ensure strict adherence to dispatch cut\-off and SLA.
   

 \- Monitor pending orders and take immediate corrective action.
   

 \- Ensure safe loading, dock discipline, 5S and compliance.
   

  

 Key KPIs: On\-Time Dispatch \| Dispatch Accuracy \| Order Backlog \| Loading TAT \| Vehicle TAT \| Damage/Misroute \| Manpower Productivity
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 COMMON COMPETENCIES REQUIRED
   

  

 Candidates should demonstrate:
   

  

 \- Strong Quick Commerce / E\-Commerce warehouse experience
   

 \- Hands\-on knowledge of WMS and warehouse system transactions
   

 \- Experience managing high\-volume fulfilment operations
   

 \- Strong manpower and shift\-management capability
   

 \- Ability to manage large blue\-collar teams and supervisors
   

 \- KPI/SLA\-driven approach
   

 \- Strong Excel/MIS and data\-analysis capability
   

 \- RCA and CAPA methodology
   

 \- Process improvement and productivity enhancement
   

 \- Strong inventory and operational controls
   

 \- EHS, 5S and warehouse safety awareness
   

 \- Ability to perform under high\-pressure and peak\-volume situations
   

 \- Strong leadership, coordination and problem\-solving capabilities
   

  

 Preferred Candidate
   

  

 Quick Commerce warehouse experience will be given strong preference.
   

  

 Candidates currently working in Quick Commerce, E\-Commerce Fulfilment Centres, Dark Stores or other large high\-throughput warehouse operations are preferred.
   

  

 Prior experience with Flipkart / Flipkart Minutes operations will be a significant advantage.
   

  

 IMMEDIATE REQUIREMENT
   

  

 Candidates must be operationally strong and capable of independently taking ownership of their respective departments from Day 1\.
   

  

 Interview: Immediate / Today
   

 Expected Joining: Immediate / Next Day Preferred
   

 Location: Ekrajapura, Hoskote, Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Customer Support Operations Manager
description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (in\-office)
 



**Function:** 
 Customer Experience \& Operations
 



**Reports to:** 
 Operations Lead / Founders
 



  





 Earthful is a plant\-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. This role owns the floor — the daily reality of every customer ticket, every escalation, and every delivery issue that reaches us. If you're the kind of person who can't leave a problem half\-solved, this is built for you.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This role owns Earthful's customer support floor end to end — staffing and shift scheduling, real\-time performance management, and the daily resolution of 300\+ tickets across every channel we support. You'll personally step in during volume spikes, personally resolve every low\-CSAT escalation, and own the SOPs that keep both human agents and AI chat agents consistent. You'll work closely with HR on staffing, with 3PL partners on delivery issues, and with Supply Chain, Product, Marketing, and Tech on recurring problems that need a cross\-functional fix.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Staffing, Scheduling \& Attendance** 




 • Plan the executive shift schedule for the month, ensuring appropriate staffing across all days of the week, including government holidays
 



 • Track shift attendance and breaks; flag exceptions (no\-shows, tardiness, adherence gaps) to management and HR
 



 • Coordinate with HR on staffing, leave, and attendance matters
 



  





**Floor \& Performance Management** 




 • Run a daily huddle with the team at 9:30 to review floor performance and set the day's priorities
 



 • Conduct hourly check\-ins and monitor performance reports for real\-time visibility into CX throughput
 



 • Monitor executive workload and productivity; personally step in during volume spikes or escalations, and handle cases directly when volume is high or floor bandwidth is low
 



 • Manage ticket flow and assign in\-office/out\-of\-office cases to agents on shift
 



 • Manage inbound call volume and missed calls
 



  





**Ticket \& Case Operations** 




 • Own end\-to\-end resolution and correct categorization of the daily ticket volume (300\+ cases/day) across all channels
 



 • Monitor and support executives across CX Ops workstreams — inbound tickets (WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, IG \& FB Comments, Email, Messenger), inbound calls, RCA documentation, and R\&D query inputs
 



 • Coordinate with the Social Media \& Marketing teams to ensure queries and messages from all social media campaigns and initiatives are addressed appropriately
 



 • Oversee order management — cancellations, address updates, profile changes, item changes, returns, and refunds
 



 • Review refund and replacement requests to confirm SOPs were followed, and process refunds after validation
 



 • Ensure customer\-reported issues (damaged orders, partial delivery, quality issues) are documented accurately and escalated to QA/Operations on time
 



 • Monitor delayed and fake\-delivery cases, coordinating with 3PL partners and the NDR executive to ensure timely delivery
 



 • Monitor engagement platforms (YouTube, Instagram, Marketplaces, JudgeMe, Kwik Engage) to ensure executive replies are timely, on\-brand, and complete
 



  





**Quality Assurance \& SOP Compliance** 




 • Conduct regular SOP audits across CX Ops, Logistics, OMS, and Engagement to check compliance and spot gaps
 



 • Audit resolved cases for SOP adherence, tone, accuracy, and resolution quality; share structured feedback with executives weekly
 



 • Personally contact every customer who leaves a 1–2 star CSAT rating and ensure they get proper resolution
 



  





**SOP Development \& Training** 




 • Create and maintain SOPs for all workflows; update them in response to policy changes, product updates, or recurring escalation patterns
 



 • Review RCA and R\&D inputs from executives and feed learnings back into the SOPs
 



 • Train new and existing executives on processes, tools, and escalation protocols; maintain training documentation
 



 • Use existing SOPs and documentation to train the AI chat agents so AI\-handled queries meet the same standards
 



  





**Reporting \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Prepare weekly performance reports (FRT, ART, AHT, CSAT, NPS, etc.) and present week\-on\-week progress to management
 



 • Work with the QA team to ensure cases are documented accurately (issue, batch number, images) and that proper RCA is performed
 



 • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders on escalated issues requiring multi\-team resolution
 



 • Coordinate with Supply Chain, Product, Marketing, and Tech to report repeated issues, escalate new ones, and fold resolutions back into SOPs
 



 • Collaborate with the CRM and other external partners, report tool issues, and evaluate new tools for CX operations
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • Prior experience managing a customer support/CX floor team, ideally in a D2C, e\-commerce, or BPO/contact\-center environment
 



 • Comfortable personally owning high ticket volume without losing SOP discipline or attention to detail
 



 • Experience with omnichannel support tools — WhatsApp Business, Instagram/Messenger, email ticketing systems, CRM platforms
 



 • Experience creating and maintaining SOPs, and training a team against them
 



 • Comfortable with real\-time floor management — daily huddles, hourly check\-ins, personally jumping in during volume spikes
 



 • Data\-driven — comfortable tracking and reporting FRT, ART, AHT, CSAT, and NPS
 



 • Experience coordinating with 3PL/logistics partners on delivery issues is a strong plus
 



 • A genuine discomfort with unresolved problems — someone who chases an issue until it's actually fixed, not just logged
 



 • Comfortable with the working pattern: Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, alternate Saturdays off

title: Operations Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION –

OPERATIONS MANAGER Company: Deccan Clap India Pvt. Ltd.

Designation: Operations Manager Department: Operations Reporting To: Senior Management JOB SUMMARY The Operations Manager will be responsible for managing and monitoring day\-to\-day field operations, coordinating with Field Executives, ensuring timely site visits, resolving operational issues, and handling escalations. The primary responsibility is to ensure that all assigned customer site visits are completed on time and that Field Executives properly communicate site status, customer requirements, issues, and completion updates to the Operations Team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1\. FIELD EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT **Daily follow\-up with Field Executives regarding assigned site visits.**  Monitor Field Executive schedules and ensure timely arrival at customer locations. **Track site visit status from assignment until completion.**  Ensure Field Executives provide proper updates before, during, and after site visits. **Coordinate with Field Executives for rescheduled, delayed, or cancelled visits.**  Monitor attendance, availability, workload, and field performance. 2\. SITE VISIT MONITORING **Maintain continuous follow\-up on all scheduled site visits.**  Ensure no assigned lead or site visit is missed without proper communication. **Check whether the Field Executive has contacted the customer before visiting.**  Monitor customer arrival and site visit completion status. **Ensure reports, photographs, observations, and other required site information are properly submitted after the visit. 3\. ESCALATION \& ISSUE MANAGEMENT**  Handle operational issues raised by Field Executives and customers. **Immediately identify and escalate critical issues to the concerned senior management.**  Coordinate with the relevant departments to resolve customer complaints and site\-related issues. **Follow up until the issue is completely resolved.**  Maintain proper records of escalations and their resolution status. **Ensure repeated operational problems are identified and corrective action is taken. 4\. CUSTOMER COORDINATION**  Support Field Executives in handling customer\-related operational issues. **Coordinate regarding site access, timing changes, customer availability, and other requirements.**  Ensure customers receive proper communication regarding delays or changes in site visits. **Take ownership of critical customer escalations until closure. 5\. DAILY OPERATIONS CONTROL**  Monitor daily site visit schedules and operational activities. **Prepare and maintain daily operations status.**  Track pending, completed, delayed, cancelled, and rescheduled site visits. **Ensure proper coordination between Inside Sales, Follow\-up Team, Field Executives, Reports Team, and Management.**  Identify gaps in the operational process and recommend improvements. 6\. TEAM PERFORMANCE MONITORING **Monitor Field Executive productivity and site visit completion.**  Identify repeated delays, communication gaps, customer complaints, or performance issues. **Provide regular feedback to Field Executives.**  Ensure team members follow company SOPs and operational procedures. **Support management in improving field team efficiency. 7\. REPORTING**  Prepare daily/weekly operations reports. **Maintain records of site visits, pending cases, escalations, complaints, and resolutions.**  Provide management with regular updates on operational performance. **Highlight critical cases that require immediate management attention. 8\. PROCESS \& SOP COMPLIANCE**  Ensure all Field Executives follow the company's operational SOPs. **Monitor proper lead handling, site scheduling, customer communication, and completion procedures.**  Implement operational instructions given by management. **Suggest improvements to reduce delays, complaints, and operational errors. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**  Timely completion of scheduled site visits. **Minimum pending and missed site visits.**  Effective follow\-up with Field Executives. **Fast resolution of operational escalations.**  Reduction in customer complaints. **Proper daily status updates.**  Field Executive productivity and discipline. **Compliance with company SOPs.**  Effective coordination between departments. **Customer satisfaction and successful issue closure. REQUIRED SKILLS**  Strong communication and coordination skills. **Good leadership and team\-management abilities.**  Strong follow\-up skills. **Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.**  Ability to handle multiple site operations simultaneously. **Ability to manage escalations professionally.**  Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and reporting. **Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.**  Strong ownership and accountability. CANDIDATE PROFILE The ideal candidate should be proactive, responsible, disciplined, and highly organized, with the ability to continuously follow up with Field Executives and ensure that every site visit and operational issue is properly tracked until completion. The Operations Manager must take ownership of operational activities and ensure smooth coordination between the Field Team, Inside Sales, Follow\-up Team, Reports Team, and Senior Management.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹26,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

+ Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR, Biacore instruments)
+ Bio\-Layer Interferometry (BLI, Octet instruments)
