* At least 3 years of experience managing teams or scientific groups.
* Demonstrated experience working in a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or research services environment.
* Proven track record of supporting external clients and managing multiple projects.
* Experience contributing to business development and scientific proposal generation.


**Technical Expertise**
**Strong Expertise In**
* Biomolecular interaction analysis (Protein\-protein, protein\-small molecule, DNA/RNA\-small molecule, peptide\-protein)
* Binding kinetics and affinity determination
* Protein/Antibody stability and developability assessment
* Aggregation and formulation characterization
* Mechanism\-of\-action investigations
* Antibody and biologics characterization


**Hands\-on Experience With**
* Biacore SPR platforms
* Octet BLI systems
* NanoTemper instruments


**Knowledge Of**
* Biologics discovery and development

* ADCs, bispecifics, peptides, and novel therapeutic modalities

 As a Senior Area Process Management Professional, you'll be at the forefront of optimizing our supply chain operations, driving process excellence and sustainability across our global network. Your work will directly impact our ability to deliver treatments to patients who depend on us.

title: Manager II, Risk, Risk Mining
description:
**Description**
 Join a high\-impact team at the forefront of global compliance innovation, where you'll shape how Amazon navigates complex regulatory landscapes across international markets. As we scale marketplace facilitator obligations across various jurisdictions, we're building the future of fraud and abuse detection in the tax compliance context—orchestrating real\-time risk detection to catch sophisticated fraud patterns, and creating adaptive governance frameworks that stay ahead of evolving regulations. You'll be part of the risk investigations team for risk mining work related to tax fraud, as well as supporting cross\-functional core capabilities (e.g. holistic risk detection across tax, compliance and general bad actor abuse).
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The Tax Compliance Operations team is seeking an exceptional Manager III, Risk Management (Tax Fraud) to lead a specialized investigations team focused on identifying and disrupting sophisticated tax fraud schemes across Amazon's marketplace. This role sits at the critical intersection of tax compliance, fraud detection, and product innovation, with direct visibility to senior leadership as we transform Amazon's approach from reactive compliance to proactive risk intelligence. This role operates at the intersection of organizational transformation, technical and science product development, and cross\-functional leadership to combat bad actor fraud and abuse, driving critical decisions about compliance risk controls and platform architecture. This role requires navigating complex stakeholder landscapes across 5\+ VP organizations while balancing regulatory requirements, technical constraints, and seller experience.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role with heavy emphasis on "player"—you will personally conduct complex, high\-stakes investigations (e.g. representing investigations team on decision making panels across tech, science and product) while building risk team capability.
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end fraud investigations from initial detection through enforcement action, with explicit focus on extracting generalizable patterns that can be automated
   

  

 Analyze every investigation through the lens of "how do we prevent this at scale?"—identifying the technical controls, data signals, and model features that would have caught this earlier
   

  

 Prepare detailed investigation reports that include both case\-specific findings and broader pattern insights with specific recommendations for Product/Tech/Science teams
   

  

 Establish and maintain tight feedback loops: weekly syncs with Science teams on model performance, bi\-weekly reviews with Product on prevention features, monthly deep\-dives with Tax on policy implications
   

  

 Develop metrics and dashboards that track fraud trends, investigation outcomes, detection model efficacy, and time\-to\-implementation for investigation\-driven improvements
   

  

 Lead incident response for high\-impact fraud events, coordinating cross\-functional teams to contain exposure and rapidly deploy preventive measures
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Early Pattern Detection \& Adaptive Intelligence
   

  

 Identify emerging abuse patterns at their earliest stages—detecting signals before they scale into significant damage to Amazon or our customers
   

  

 Lead investigations into sophisticated tax evasion schemes including VAT fraud, shell company abuse, customs manipulation, and identity misrepresentation
   

  

 Develop and deploy advanced detection models leveraging internal transaction data, seller behavior patterns, and behavioral signals to identify high\-risk actors before they cause harm
   

  

 Continuously refine detection logic by feeding investigation learnings back to Science teams, ensuring models evolve faster than fraudster tactics
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of auditing business processes, risk mitigation, program compliance or internal audits experience
* 5\+ years of work in relevant industries such as law, customer service, investigations, risk, compliance or project management experience
* 5\+ years of customer service experience
* Experience in audits related to business processes, risk mitigation, program compliance, or internal audits
* Experience in customer service
* Experience working in relevant industries such as law, customer service, investigations, risk, compliance or project management
* Experience with all Microsoft Office applications
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certification such as CAMS, CRCM, or CRP
* Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions and implement effective solutions
* Experience working in risk, fraud or compliance organizations
* Master's degree or equivalent

 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80\+ million customers get more from their money every day.
   

  

 As we continue our lightning\-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000\+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Outsourcing team is responsible for managing and overseeing outsourcing risks and other third\-party arrangements, including regulatory obligations, operational resilience, and exit strategies.
   

  

 We’re looking for an Outsourcing Manager to assist our Wealth \& Trading team in managing ongoing supplier and intra\-group relationships. You’ll be collaborating with Compliance, Risk, and service delivery teams to ensure proper documentation and regulatory reporting deliverables related to third\-party management.
   

  

 Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Identifying activities for outsourcing and finding the correct partners
* Managing the complete vendor lifecycle, including due diligence, onboarding, agreements, renewals, off\-boarding, and exit plans
* Managing third\-party risk activities, including onboarding, due diligence, risk assessments, and ongoing vendor monitoring
* Implementing policies and operating models for third\-party and supply chain risk management
* Defining, monitoring, and ensuring that required outsourcing SLAs are met and enforced
* Liaising with internal stakeholders on outsourcing matters within group entities
* Overseeing internal governance processes for outsourcing approvals and vendor lifecycle changes
* Providing clear guidance for staff on third\-party risk management procedures, risk assessments, and their ongoing accountability
* Ensuring regulatory compliance
* Preparing regular reports to senior management on the status of outsourcing activities, the risks, compliance, and performance metrics


**What You'll Need**
* 3\+ years of experience in an outsourcing or third\-party risk management role
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as finance, business administration, or economics
* An excellent understanding of outsourcing and business resilience regulations in retail financial services
* A proven ability to develop service management frameworks and conduct ongoing outsourcing risk assessments
* Fluency in English


**Nice to have**
* A risk management qualification
* Experience with investments or trading activities, such as working with external brokers or custodians
* Executive and board\-level interaction experience

title: EPMO Lead
description:
EPMO Lead / Manager \- Project Management Office \| Vantrock Real Assets \| Mumbai
 



 Build, institutionalise and lead the EPMO. The framework, the standards and the stage gates do not exist yet \- whoever takes this seat writes them. We also want a specific career arc: started on the developer or contractor side, carried a site, then moved into consulting. Depth first, structure second.
 




 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain \- first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



 The platform was founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built every platform he led as if it were his own \- three times over, on other people's capital. This is the fourth build, on his own. Across his career that record runs to 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor, over 2,000 acres acquired and all of them litigation\-free, and more than 200 buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms. The board is chaired by Shailesh V. Haribhakti. The platform runs on Vantrock Intelligence, its own AI\-native operating layer.
 




 ROLE PURPOSE
 




 Build, institutionalise and lead the EPMO, providing portfolio\-level visibility across real estate, construction and business improvement initiatives. The role will establish sustainable governance and decision\-making practices that improve delivery outcomes.
 



 Ground breaks on the first 2 million sq ft of a 10 million sq ft pipeline in January 2027, which is why the governance has to exist before then rather than after.
 




 CONSTRUCTION PORTFOLIO AND EPMO GOVERNANCE
 




 \- Establish the EPMO governance framework, operating rhythm, standards, tools, reporting formats, stage gates and escalation protocols across the real estate and construction portfolio.
 



 \- Consolidate and review portfolio information across design, statutory approvals, procurement, construction, facilities management and operations, covering scope, schedule, cost, cash flow, quality, safety and milestones.
 



 \- Prepare executive dashboards highlighting portfolio health, trends, delivery risks, exceptions and decisions required.
 



 \- Challenge project schedules, budgets, forecasts and progress data to identify delays, cost pressures and corrective actions.
 



 \- Facilitate leadership reviews, drive closure of decisions, risks, issues and actions, and support portfolio prioritisation and sequencing.
 



 \- Coordinate across design, statutory approvals, procurement, contracts, construction, finance, sales, facilities management, operations and technology.
 



 \- Manage PMCs, design consultants, technical advisers and other outsourced providers, including appointments, scope, performance, deliverables, variations, claims and contractual obligations.
 



 \- Coach project teams on governance, reporting, risk management and problem\-solving.
 




 TRANSFORMATION AND STRATEGIC INITIATIVES
 




 \- Lead transformation, operational excellence, process improvement, cost optimisation, digital enablement and other enterprise improvement initiatives.
 



 \- Translate business priorities into structured projects with clear objectives, workplans, ownership, benefits and success measures.
 



 \- Identify process, control and efficiency gaps; develop practical solutions and support implementation through stabilisation.
 



 \- Track benefits realisation and measurable operational, financial and customer outcomes.
 



 \- Manage cross\-functional initiatives outside the core construction portfolio, as assigned by leadership.
 




 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS
 




 \- 10 to 12 years of professional experience in real estate development, construction or capital projects.
 



 \- Proven experience monitoring a portfolio of multiple construction projects, including project controls, management reporting and risk governance.
 



 \- Working experience across design coordination, statutory approvals, procurement, construction, facilities management and operations.
 



 \- Experience in transformation, operational excellence, process improvement, cost optimisation, digital or other enterprise improvement initiatives.
 



 \- Consulting, advisory, programme management or project management firm experience is strongly preferred.
 



 \- Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or a related discipline. Civil is read first.
 



 \- MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred; recognised project management certifications, such as PMP, would be an added advantage. Among postgraduate qualifications the ones we know well are NICMAR (ACM, APM, REUIM), the RICS School of Built Environment, CEPT, an IIT or NIT M.Tech, and the NMIMS MBA (Tech.) Civil Engineering with Operations Management. Separately, an MBA in Finance, a CFA or CA is an added advantage.
 




 CORE SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
 




 \- Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end real estate and development lifecycle.
 



 \- Ability to analyse project and portfolio data, identify issues and translate findings into practical management actions.
 



 \- Sound knowledge of project controls, scheduling, cost monitoring, risk management and governance.
 



 \- Commercial and contract management capability across procurement, consultant engagements, variations and claims.
 



 \- Structured problem\-solving and process improvement capability.
 



 \- Strong stakeholder management, communication, executive presentation and report\-writing skills.
 



 \- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI, scheduling tools or portfolio management platforms is preferred.
 



 \- Ability to apply AI tools for analysis, reporting, workflow automation, research and decision support.
 




 THE CAREER SHAPE, AND THIS ONE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE
 




 We are looking for a specific arc, in a specific order. You started on the developer's or the contractor's side. You carried responsibility on a site, and you know what a delay costs because you have been the person who had to explain it. Then you moved into consulting, advisory or programme management, where you learned to structure a problem, write for an executive, and hold more than one project in your head at a time.
 



 The order matters more than either half. Someone who has only ever consulted can build a governance framework nobody on the ground respects, because it asks for things a site cannot give. Someone who has only ever been on site can hold a project but not a portfolio. We want depth first and structure second, and we want both.
 



 Bring the first half in detail. We will ask which projects, what your scope was, what went wrong on your watch and what it cost. This sits alongside the preference for consulting and advisory experience above rather than against it. We want both, and in that order.
 




 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 Deliberately small, no departments. Every seat carries a real mandate. The doctrine before any addition is outsource first, then automate, then hire, and it applies here directly: collection, chasing, formatting and routine reporting go to Vantrock Intelligence, and you are expected to keep pushing work in that direction rather than defending it as your own. What stays with you is judgement.
 




 THE WORK IS YOURS TO DO
 




 We are not building an army. You do the work rather than receive, route and report on it. The coordination, inside the platform and outside it with consultants, agencies, lenders and authorities, is done by you in person, on the phone and on site. You run your own tech stack rather than specifying it for someone else. Seniority changes what you are accountable for, not whether you roll up your sleeves.
 




 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 Two requirements stand behind that and apply to every seat here. AI proficiency: every candidate takes the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, supervised, regardless of seniority. Partner command: consultants, contractors, auditors, valuers, law firms and system vendors do a great deal of Vantrock's work, and everyone here is expected to command that work rather than defer to it.
 




 COMPENSATION
 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity, with performance\-linked incentives and ESOPs. We discuss numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 




 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 An AI interview, reviewed before your CV. The AI Proficiency Test. A supervised Excel and PowerPoint round on real, messy project data: build the one\-page pack and defend the numbers you chose to show. Two references. Five working days to hear back, and every conversation is confidential.
 




 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com, subject line "VR\-46 EPMO Lead \- \[your name]". Four things: your CV, with the site half of your career set out as clearly as the advisory half; one artefact you personally built \- a portfolio dashboard, executive review pack, risk register or benefits tracker \- with three sentences on what was hard about it; your current fixed compensation, expectation and notice; and one short paragraph about a number you challenged that turned out to be wrong, and how you knew. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform.

title: Collection Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Kotak Mahindra Prime Limited (KMPL), a subsidiary of Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited, is one of India’s leading car finance companies, operating since 1996\. KMPL offers financing for new and pre\-owned passenger cars and two\-wheelers to retail customers, along with wholesale financing solutions for automobile dealerships. The company has strong preferred financier relationships and tie\-ups with multiple automobile manufacturers across India. KMPL has expanded its offerings to include Loans Against Property for both commercial and residential real estate, supporting business and personal financial needs. Its retail distribution network spans 134 branches across 24 states, supported by a wide network of marketing associates and agencies nationwide.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Collection Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in New Delhi. The role involves managing and monitoring collections for retail and dealer financing portfolios, ensuring timely recovery of outstanding dues while maintaining positive customer relationships. The Collection Manager will analyze delinquency trends, allocate accounts to collection teams or agencies, and track performance against collection targets. Responsibilities include coordinating with internal stakeholders such as credit, operations, and sales, implementing collection strategies and remediation plans, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and company policies. The role also requires preparing collection reports and dashboards, recommending process improvements, and supporting resolution of disputes or escalations in a professional, customer\-centric manner.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong collections management skills, including portfolio monitoring, recovery planning, and performance tracking.
* Proficiency in negotiation, conflict resolution, and customer communication to manage overdue accounts effectively.
* Ability to analyze data, interpret delinquency and risk trends, and prepare accurate MIS and collection reports.
* Knowledge of retail lending, automobile finance, and Loans Against Property processes and documentation.
* Familiarity with regulatory guidelines, internal compliance standards, and ethical collection practices.
* Capability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and manage external collection agencies or partners.
* Comfort with using collection and banking software systems, spreadsheets, and basic MS Office tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, commerce, business administration, or a related field; relevant experience in collections or credit control is highly preferred.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work under time\-sensitive targets in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and local languages, with a professional, customer\-focused mindset.

title: Partner Operations Manager - Partner Ecosystem
description:
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India (other India locations considered)
 



**Engagement:** 
 Contract to Hire (conversion after 3 months)
 



**Work Model:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Partner Operations Manager to run that ecosystem operationally: partner program compliance, certification and competency tracking, co\-sell and deal registration, marketplace listings, partner enablement logistics, joint pipeline reporting, and partner performance governance. This is an execution role with executive visibility. You will work across sales, solutions, delivery, marketing, finance, and legal, and you will be the person leadership turns to for a single trusted view of partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline.
 



 The role begins as a three\-month contract engagement. Conversion to a permanent position follows successful completion of that period against the milestones set out below.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Run the day\-to\-day operations of the Context66 partner program across cloud, data platform, graph, AI model, security, and channel partners.
* Own partner program compliance: tier requirements, certification and competency targets, renewals, audits, and partner portal hygiene across every active relationship.
* Manage co\-sell and deal registration end to end, including submission, approval tracking, opportunity mapping, and escalation of stalled registrations.
* Build and maintain the partner pipeline reporting layer covering sourced, influenced, and co\-sell revenue, with clean attribution rules agreed with sales and finance
* Administer marketplace listings and private offers on hyperscaler and platform marketplaces, coordinating pricing, metering, legal terms, and transaction reconciliation
* Track and drive certification attainment across delivery teams, maintaining a live skills and credentials inventory mapped to partner tier requirements
* Coordinate partner enablement logistics: training calendars, joint workshops, demo readiness, accelerator briefings, and sales enablement sessions
* Manage Market Development Funds and co\-marketing budgets, including request submission, claim
* documentation, spend tracking, and proof\-of\-execution reporting
* Prepare partner QBR materials, scorecards, and business reviews with clear performance metrics and agreed follow\-through actions
* Coordinate partner agreements, renewals, and onboarding with legal, finance, and procurement, maintaining a central repository of executed contracts and obligations
* Maintain the partner collateral pipeline, working with the GTM team to keep joint one\-pagers, solution briefs, and reference architectures current and brand\-compliant
* Establish the operating cadence of partner reviews, pipeline reviews, certification reviews, and escalation paths, and hold the organization to it.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




**First 30 days:** 
 Complete partner inventory published: every active and prospective partner, current tier,
 



 contract status, named counterpart, and compliance gap. Baseline view of partner\-sourced and
 



 influenced pipeline established in CRM.
 



**First 90 days** 
 : Deal registration and co\-sell process operating on a defined SLA with owners and escalationpaths. Attribution model agreed with sales and finance and live in CRM. Certification plan built against partner tier requirements with named owners and target dates. Marketplace listing work
 



 initiated for the top two priority partners.
 



**First 180 days:** 
 Partner QBR cadence running on schedule with published scorecards. Marketplace listings live for priority partners. MDF pipeline actively managed with claims submitted and tracked.
 



 Measurable growth in partner\-sourced pipeline and improved tier standing across at least two priority partners.
 



  





**Must\-Have:** 




 6–10\+ years in partner operations, alliance operations, channel operations, or sales operations
 



 Direct hands\-on experience with at least one major partner program such as AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, or Snowflake
 



 Strong CRM discipline, ideally Salesforce, including opportunity hygiene, reporting, and attribution logic
 



 Advanced spreadsheet and reporting skills, with a proven track record managing deal registration and co\-sell workflows.
 



 Experience with partner portals and PRM tooling, and marketplace/private offer experience on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Marketplace
 



 MDF and co\-marketing fund administration, and certification/competency tracking at organizational scale
 



 Comfort working across US and India time zones with US\-based sales and solutions leadership.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have:** 




 Exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, Neo4j, MongoDB, Rubrik, Anthropic, or OpenAI partner programs
 



 Working knowledge of data, AI, and enterprise architecture terminology sufficient to brief partners credibly
 



 Experience building partner dashboards in BI tools, and familiarity with AI\-assisted productivity tooling
 



 Prior experience standing up a partner program from an early stage
 



  





**Soft Skills and Culture Fit** 




 Highly organized and detail\-obsessed. Follow\-through driven, and comfortable chasing accountability across senior stakeholders. Clear written communicator. Data\-disciplined. Calm under deadline pressure. Startup mindset with a strong ownership bias.
 



  





**Industry and Domain Exposure** 




 Experience operating a technology partner or alliance program at a services firm, system integrator, ISV, or platform vendor. Exposure to enterprise Data, AI, or cloud ecosystems is expected. Familiarity with services\-led selling motions, where the partner relationship drives both influenced revenue and delivery capability, is strongly preferred.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
**About Revolut**
 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80\+ million customers get more from their money every day.

**About The Role**
 At Revolut, Operations means problem\-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

title: Logistics Manager - D2C

**About the Role** 




 The last mile is where the brand promise is kept — the moment a parent actually receives what they ordered. As Last\-Mile Executive, you own delivery performance end\-to\-end across D2C and marketplaces: making sure every order reaches families on time, in full, and at the right cost — and when something goes wrong, you catch it and fix it fast. This is a hands\-on, numbers\-first role with real ownership of the courier network and delivery experience.

* Coordinate with warehouse/fulfilment, CX and finance on dispatch handover, delivery exceptions and COD reconciliation.

* Data\-driven — strong Excel/Google Sheets; comfortable with courier panels, tracking tools and building reports.
* Sharp coordination, urgency and problem\-solving; calm and clear under escalation.

title: Head of Operations
description:
In brief:
 



  a. Vendor Onboarding
 



  b. Fulfilment – Asset Liquidation
 



  c. Fulfilment – Marketplace
 



  d. Logistics/Labour/Hub Management
 



  e. Supply \& Demand Planning — Schedules \& Approvals
 



  





 Extended:
 



 1\. Target vs. Achievement Tracking
 



 – Own the tracking of targets vs. achievement — zone\-wise, vendor\-wise, client\-wise, and material\-wise — and report gaps before they're asked for.
 



 – Own quality control — ensure material grading and vendor output meet Veloce's standard across zones.
 



  





 2\. Vendor Network — Zone Wise
 



 – Ensure every zone's vendor visiting schedule stays on track — through your Field Coordinators and Executives, not just on paper.
 



 – Track vendors met, onboarded, and activated, zone by zone — and close the gap between onboarded and activated.
 



 – Ensure vendors are onboarded onto and activated on the Bidding App across all zones.
 



  





 3\. Fulfilment
 



 – Own pickup schedule adherence for Asset Liquidation across all zones, executed through the field team.
 



 – Own dispatch schedule adherence for Marketplace across all zones, executed through the field team.
 



 – Ensure fulfilment proofs — photos, weight ticket, vehicle number, unloading/GRN confirmation — are collected on every pickup and dispatch.
 



  





 4\. Vendor Management
 



 – Ensure debit notes, vendor ledgers, and payables are accurate and current across the vendor base.
 



 – Run margin checks regularly — catch and flag margin erosion before it compounds.
 



  





 5\. Team
 



 – Own hiring for the field team — Vendor Managers, Field Coordinators, Field Ops Executives — as it scales.
 



 – Own training — About Veloce, Bidding App, Material Knowledge, Veloce Price Index, Emails, Gsheet, and WhatsApp update discipline — for every new hire and refreshed for the existing team.
 



 – Keep visiting schedules on track using Trackwick / field tracking tools; review adherence, not just attendance.
 



 – Review and approve travel allowance claims across the team.
 



 – Ensure daily opening and closing calls happen across the team — every zone, every day.
 



  





 6\. Field Work — Your Own
 



 – You stay close to the ground, not just the dashboard.
 



 – Meet key vendors in other zones at least once a quarter.
 



 – Personally train every new hire before handing them to the field.
 



  





 7\. Reports
 



 – Own the reporting cadence to the co\-founder — daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly — covering targets, achievement, and exceptions.
 



  





 8\. Communications
 



 – Be proactive — flag risks and misses before they're asked about, not after.
 



 – Keep the co\-founder and the wider team fully informed; over\-communicate as the team grows, rather than assume alignment.
 



  





 9\. Hunting \& Farming
 



 – Own and keep current the approach, negotiation, and closure guides the field team uses to acquire new vendors (hunting).
 



 – Own the vendor retention and account maintenance playbook (farming) — existing vendors stay active, not just onboarded.
 



  





 10\. Training Sessions
 



 – Run monthly and quarterly training sessions for the field team — refresh material knowledge, pricing index, and process discipline.
 



  





 11\. Logistics, Labour \& Warehouse — Through the Team
 



 – Ensure the transporter network across zones is reliable — rate, redundancy, and on\-time performance — managed through your team, escalated to you on exceptions.
 



 – Ensure labour planning at hubs and pickup/loading sites is done ahead of schedule, with no last\-minute shortfalls.
 



 – Ensure hub/warehouse operations — stock accuracy, documentation, audit\-readiness — are on track across sites.
 



 – Own supply \& demand planning — consolidate vendor availability against buyer orders and AL leads into a rolling schedule; bring it to the co\-founder for approval.
 



 – Publish the weekly schedule of all pickups and dispatches every Monday by 10 AM, and own adherence tracking against it.

**About BASF**

description:

title: Operations Manager – Alcobev Manufacturing & Distribution (engineering)
description:
**Industry:** Alcohol Manufacturing / Alcobev  
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site  
**Experience:** 4–15\+ Years  
**Preferred Background:** Engineering, Retired Army / Navy – JCO, Senior NCO or Officer  
**Reporting To:** Management / Senior Management

About the Role

We are looking for a highly disciplined and experienced **Operations Manager** to take ownership of the **end\-to\-end operations, logistics, excise coordination, dispatch and distribution** of our Alcohol Manufacturing / Alcobev business.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth movement of finished alcohol products **from manufacturing and finished\-goods storage through dispatch, transportation, CSD and retail distribution**.

This is a hands\-on role requiring strong **operational discipline, documentation, compliance awareness, transportation control, inventory management and field coordination**.

The ideal candidate will preferably come from a **retired Army or Navy background** and should be comfortable taking complete ownership of operations, coordinating multiple teams and handling operational issues independently.

Key Responsibilities1\. End\-to\-End Alcobev Operations

* Oversee daily operations related to **finished goods, warehousing, dispatch, transportation and distribution**.
* Coordinate between Manufacturing, Warehouse, Excise, Sales, Transporters, Distributors, CSD and Retail channels.
* Ensure products are moved from the plant to the required destination **safely, legally and on time**.
* Establish strong operational discipline, reporting systems and accountability.

2\. Excise \& Statutory Compliance

The candidate must have **strong practical knowledge of excise\-related operations and documentation for alcoholic beverages**.

* Understand the **excise requirements, procedures, permits, passes and documentation** applicable to alcohol movement.
* Coordinate with the company's Excise team/consultants and relevant authorities wherever required.
* Ensure all required documentation is completed before dispatch and transportation.
* Maintain proper records related to **production, stock, dispatch, transportation and movement of alcoholic products**.
* Ensure dispatches are made only after all required statutory/excise documentation and approvals are in place.
* Keep track of state\-specific requirements affecting the movement and sale of alcoholic beverages.
* Ensure operational teams follow applicable excise rules, company SOPs and statutory requirements.

3\. State\-Wise Alcohol Labelling \& Packaging Compliance

* Have practical understanding of **state\-wise alcohol labelling requirements** across India.
* Ensure the correct **labels, declarations, MRP, statutory markings and packaging requirements** are used for the relevant state/market.
* Coordinate with Production, Packaging, Excise and Sales teams regarding state\-specific product requirements.
* Maintain awareness of changes in state\-wise excise/labelling requirements and communicate them to relevant teams.
* Ensure incorrect or non\-compliant stock is not dispatched.

**Knowledge of state\-wise alcohol labels and regulatory requirements across India is strongly preferred.**

4\. Transportation \& Route Management

* Plan and coordinate transportation of finished products from the manufacturing plant to warehouses, distributors, CSD locations and retail markets.
* Coordinate with **transporters, drivers, distributors and logistics partners**.
* Track vehicles from **dispatch to final delivery**.
* Monitor vehicle location, route, delivery status and delays.
* Maintain proper dispatch and delivery tracking systems.
* Understand major transportation routes and logistics movement across different states/markets.
* Plan efficient routes while considering distance, delivery schedules, operational risks and applicable restrictions.
* Immediately escalate delays, vehicle breakdowns, route deviations, accidents or other issues.

5\. Dispatch \& Delivery Control

* Verify dispatch quantities, product details, documentation and vehicle details before loading.
* Ensure proper loading, sealing and handling of finished alcohol products.
* Track every shipment until **successful delivery**.
* Obtain and maintain proof of delivery and relevant delivery documentation.
* Investigate shortages, damages, breakages, pilferage or discrepancies reported during delivery.
* Coordinate with the Warehouse and Accounts teams to resolve delivery\-related discrepancies.

6\. Quality Check – Before \& After Delivery

* Coordinate with the relevant Quality/Production team to ensure finished products are properly checked before dispatch.
* Verify **product condition, packaging, bottles, labels, cartons and batch details** before dispatch.
* Ensure damaged, incorrectly labelled or questionable stock is not dispatched.
* After delivery, monitor complaints relating to **damage, leakage, breakage, incorrect quantity, packaging or product condition**.
* Coordinate with Quality, Warehouse and Sales teams to investigate delivery\-related quality issues.
* Maintain records of complaints, damages, shortages and corrective actions.

7\. Warehouse \& Inventory Control

* Monitor finished\-goods inventory and stock movement.
* Ensure accurate records of **opening stock, production receipts, dispatches, returns, damages and closing stock**.
* Prevent pilferage, unauthorized movement, stock loss and inventory discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Warehouse teams for proper stacking, identification and stock rotation.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of alcohol products as per company procedures.

8\. CSD \& Retail Distribution

* Coordinate operations for distribution through **CSD (Canteen Stores Department) and retail channels**.
* Ensure correct products, quantities, labels and documentation are supplied to respective markets.
* Coordinate with distributors and logistics partners for timely deliveries.
* Monitor pending orders, dispatches, deliveries and market requirements.
* Ensure operational issues affecting CSD or retail supply are resolved quickly.

9\. Vendor \& Transporter Management

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with transporters and logistics vendors.
* Negotiate and monitor transportation arrangements in coordination with management.
* Monitor transporter performance, delivery timelines and operational discipline.
* Maintain transporter records, vehicle details and performance history.
* Take corrective action in cases of repeated delays, route deviations, poor handling or delivery issues.

10\. Operational Discipline \& Team Management

* Supervise warehouse, dispatch, logistics and support staff.
* Establish clear reporting structures and daily responsibilities.
* Ensure employees follow company SOPs and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular reviews of pending deliveries, stock, vehicles and operational issues.
* Maintain discipline, accountability and timely reporting.
* Train and guide staff on operational procedures and documentation.

11\. Crisis Management \& Risk Control

* Handle operational emergencies including **vehicle breakdowns, delivery delays, route issues, stock discrepancies, documentation problems and other logistics challenges**.
* Develop contingency plans for critical shipments.
* Take quick and practical decisions during operational disruptions.
* Identify risks relating to transportation, inventory, pilferage and compliance.
* Escalate serious issues to management immediately.

MIS \& Reporting

The Operations Manager will maintain and review:

* Daily dispatch report
* Stock movement report
* Vehicle tracking report
* Pending delivery report
* Delivery status / POD report
* Transporter performance report
* Warehouse stock report
* Damage / shortage report
* State\-wise dispatch report
* Excise documentation status
* CSD supply status
* Retail distribution status
* Operational issue and escalation report

Candidate ProfilePreferred Background

* **Retired Army / Navy personnel – JCO / Senior NCO / Officer preferred.**
* Strong experience in **operations, logistics, transportation, administration, supply chain or warehouse management**.
* Experience in **Alcobev / Alcohol Manufacturing / Distillery / FMCG / Beverage Distribution** will be strongly preferred.
* Experience handling operations across multiple locations or states will be an advantage.

Must\-Have Knowledge

The candidate should have practical knowledge of:

* **Alcohol manufacturing / Alcobev operations**
* Excise procedures and documentation
* Alcohol movement permits/passes and statutory documentation
* State\-wise alcohol labelling requirements
* CSD and retail distribution
* Finished\-goods warehouse management
* Transportation and vehicle tracking
* Route planning and logistics
* Stock and inventory control
* Dispatch and delivery management
* Product/packaging checks before dispatch
* Delivery\-related quality and quantity checks
* Vendor and transporter management
* MIS and operational reporting

Key Skills \& Competencies

* Strong leadership and discipline
* Excellent logistics and operational planning
* Strong follow\-up and coordination
* Excise and compliance awareness
* Inventory and warehouse control
* Transportation management
* Route planning and vehicle tracking
* Vendor and transporter management
* Crisis management
* Problem\-solving
* Strong documentation skills
* High integrity and accountability
* Ability to work independently and take ownership

Important Candidate Requirement

This is **not a general office\-based Operations Manager position**.

We are specifically looking for a person who can **take complete operational ownership of an Alcobev business**, including:

**Manufacturing → Finished Goods → Quality Check → Excise Documentation → Warehouse → Dispatch → Transportation → Vehicle Tracking → CSD / Retail Delivery → Delivery Verification → Stock Reconciliation**

The candidate should be comfortable working with **plant teams, warehouse teams, transporters, distributors, CSD, retail partners, excise\-related teams and senior management**.

**Strong knowledge of alcohol excise procedures, state\-wise labelling requirements and transportation/documentation of alcoholic beverages is highly preferred.**

Working Conditions

* Full\-time, on\-site role.
* Mumbai\-based role with coordination with manufacturing plants, warehouses, distributors and transporters.
* May require travel to plants, warehouses, markets or other operational locations.
* May require coordination outside standard working hours depending on dispatches, transportation and operational requirements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their **updated CV on WhatsApp to HR**.

**HR WhatsApp: 8788339043**

Please mention **“Operations Manager – Alcobev”** while sending your CV.

Pay: ₹15,379\.29 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
The Books and Records Oversight team within Markets Operations primary objective is to strengthen the books and records discipline and control framework within Markets Operations. The function has been recently created within Markets Operations to drive remediation efforts and the adoption of strong accounting practices as part of firm\-wide policies and programs. The candidate requires solid accounting and financial background combined with a good understanding of operational processes and will lead Markets Operations’ engagement with the Finance department and at firm\-wide forums on accounting related matters. Other objectives will be to 1\) develop robust quality control around balance sheet substantiation for accounts owned by Markets Operations and 2\) work with the Markets Operations’ leadership team to develop strong books and records / accounting knowledge across Markets Operations via the deployment of training and standards.
   

  

 Markets Operations is a global organization with a presence in over 60 Countries, covering post execution capabilities spanning product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of products and services including Fixed Income, Equity, Commodities and Syndicates. We are part\-way through a multi\-year journey to deliver a future state of Operations, encompassing end to end target operating model, controls design and uplift, technology transformation, data and process re\-engineering.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Strategic Delivery:**
 This role will be critical in driving the strategic delivery of key initiatives and continuous improvements across the Books and Records function. This includes translating broader organizational goals into actionable plans, ensuring the effective implementation of new processes and technologies, and embedding best practices to achieve long\-term operational excellence and control enhancement. The Director will proactively identify strategic opportunities to optimize our framework, champion innovation, and ensure that all efforts contribute to a resilient, efficient, and forward\-looking Markets Operations environment.
   

  

**Lead and Oversee:**
 Work with line Operations teams to ensure all the correct metrics and controls are in place, with regular reviews to ensure monitoring remains relevant and effective.
   

  

 Work with Finance colleagues to ensure that balance sheet substantiation is complete and that controls are designed effectively.
   

  

 Foster a good understanding of accounting practices/processes within the wider Markets Ops team, bridging the link between the movement of cash with how this is recorded on Citi’s books and records.
   

  

 Partner closely with Business partners and Transformation teams on new initiatives/projects to ensure that financial controls are robustly considered and implemented.
   

  

 Oversee and co\-ordinate all account owner activity across Markets Operations. Includes but not limited to:
   

  

 Understand and maintain Operations chart of accounts.
   

  

 Set a framework to ensure consistent roles and responsibilities for all Markets Ops staff as it pertains to how we control our account population and reconciliations requirements.
   

  

 Work with Markets Ops global functional managers to understand reasons for exceptions and breaks, ensuring issues are escalated timely, fixed at the root cause and look across for similar themes.
   

  

 Ensure well defined and documented processes are in place for reserve calculations across Markets Operations. Identify opportunities to reduce aged exceptions to reduce reserves.
   

  

 Review account ownership to ensure that the proofing processes are standard in their application and where relevant centralize these processes to drive efficiencies.
   

  

 Partnership with other functions to support a strong end to end control environment:
   

  

 Work with Finance and Operations Risk \& Control to ensure Markets Operations are compliant with relevant policies and standards.
   

  

 Partner with Balance Sheet Control and risk reporting to support accurate and timely exceptions reporting.
   

  

 Work with Front office to ensure upstream data and processes are understood and robust so as to prevent downstream issues from occurring.
   

  

 Work with counterparts across the Centralized Operations team to promote consistency and common standards.
   

  

**Drive progress on areas of improvement:**
 Work with Technology and internal partners to build a standard mechanism to accrue for and then pay/receive interest between internal desks/accounts across all products in Markets.
   

  

 Implement best practices to ensure reconciliations are correctly designed and compliant with relevant standards and controls.
   

  

 Promote development and retention of account and reconciliation SME’s across the group.
   

  

 Strengthen issue management processes, ensure emerging risks are correctly escalated with the appropriate level of urgency.
   

  

 Lead and oversee Markets Operations’ involvement in firm\-wide programs related to accounting and book and records matters (e.g. Strategic Ledger). Represent Markets Operations at firmwide governance forums such as the Enterprise Design Authority.
   

  

**Experience:**
 15\+ years relevant experience.
   

  

 Industry expertise in financial accounting and the operational aspects of books and records management and account management.
   

  

 Experience as finance professional / background / degree and working experience in Technology creating products set up, UAT working with Finance / Market Ops people and understanding of products will be valuable.
   

  

 Articulates clearly how risk technology supports unit's business, as well as the issues due to gaps between the current technology and known business requirements.
   

  

 Consistently reads different situations accurately and takes appropriate action to gain senior colleague/ client commitment.
   

  

 Ability to measure and assess the impact of stress shocks including fat\-tailed risks.
   

  

 Well\-versed in reviewing the dimensions of franchise risk.
   

  

 Strong Leadership skills\-Operates as a leader.
   

  

 Serves as a point of escalation for key issues or time sensitive decisions.
   

  

 Acts decisively in high risk scenarios, assessing a situation based on available data, experience, intuition, and judgment.
   

  

 Ability to respond to challenges with creative solutions, adapts to changing business needs.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to make sound judgment calls on issues that can be both quantitative and qualitative in nature.
   

  

 Able to manage issues associated with operational risk capital, in partnership with the business, Finance and the Risk organization.
   

  

 Acts as a role model for managing people, coaching, and serving as a mentor.
   

  

 Excellent Communications skills verbal \& written. Active listening skills.
   

  

**Qualifications:**
 Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred.

title: Director Strategic Sourcing & Supply Chain
description:
Director\- Supply Chain
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



**Location: Pune, India (Global Role)** 




 Industry: Electric Mobility / Automotive
 



  





**About Zeno** 




  





 An unprecedented energy transition has begun. To meet 2040 net zero goals, over 2 billion electric two\-wheelers (motorcycles) must be sold and $11 trillion in fuel consumption replaced. Zeno is building a tech platform to electrify this two\-wheeler market, currently responsible for more than 4% of the world’s GHG emissions. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition and democratize the benefits across Africa, India, and Latin America. With a focus on East Africa as a starting point, Zeno is building a new energy ecosystem with ground\-up development of a fundamentally better electric motorcycle and associated battery swap network to drive a better experience for our customers.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  





 As the Director of Strategic Sourcing \& Supply Chain, you will lead Zeno’s sourcing \& supply chain strategy for us, driving end\-to\-end planning, procurement, and production support . Your role will be strategic, operational, and deeply cross\-functional.
 



  





**• Strategic Supply Chain Leadership** 




 o Develop and execute the supply chain strategy aligned with Zeno’s growth plans for motorcycle, battery, Swap Stations, and fast charger products, as well as spares.
 



 o Build scalable processes that balance cost, quality, lead time, and risk.
 



  





**• Procurement \& Vendor Management** 




 o Own sourcing establishing and maintaining partnerships with local and global suppliers.
 



 o Negotiate contracts, drive cost optimization, and manage quality / supplier risk.
 



 o Implement performance metrics for suppliers and develop continuous improvement programs.
 



  





**• Inventory \& Materials Planning** 




 o Oversee inventory planning for raw materials, sub\-assemblies, and finished goods to minimize working capital.
 



 o Design and implement demand forecasting models to support production and swap\-station needs.
 



 o Ensure accurate inventory systems, cycle counts, and stock reconciliations. Strong ERP experience.
 



  





**•Manufacturing \& Quality Support** 




 o Ultimate ownership and responsibility for ensuring production is not blocked by material shortages.
 



 o Work closely with Engineering and Production teams to support build plans, product launches, and quality requirements.
 



 o Ensure supply chain is responsive to changes in product design or demand, including new motorcycle models or battery technologies.
 



  





**•Risk Management \& Compliance** 




 o Identify supply chain risks (geopolitical, regulatory, logistical) and develop mitigation strategies.
 



 o Ensure compliance with local regulations, import/export policies, and sustainability standards.
 



  





**• Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** 




 o Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing supply chain team (procurement, planning, logistics).
 



 o Collaborate with cross\-functional leadership (Engineering, Operations, Finance, Service) to align supply chain goals with business priorities.
 



 o Report regularly on key supply chain KPIs, cost, inventory turnover, lead times, supplier performance, etc.
 



  





**What You’ll Bring** 




 • Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in Engineering / MBA in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field
 



 • At least 15\-20 years of supply chain experience, with 5\+ years in leadership (preferably in automotive, EV, or manufacturing).
 



 • Deep experience in procurement, planning, inventory management, and distribution.
 



 • Experience working with global suppliers and manufacturing
 



 • Strong negotiation skills and experience contracting with component manufacturers.
 



 • Analytical mindset, comfortable with forecasting, financial planning, and supply chain KPIs.
 



 • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup / scale\-up environment.
 



 • Passion for sustainability, mobility, and transforming transportation in emerging markets.
 



 • Odoo ERP experience nice to have
 



  





**Why Join Zeno** 




 • Be part of a mission\-driven company electrifying the two\-wheeler market in Emerging markets.
 



 • High impact role: you will directly shape how our products are sourced, built, and distributed.
 



 • Collaborative, cross\-functional team working at the intersection of engineering, operations, and sustainability.
 



 • Competitive compensation and benefits (tailor to your company’s package)
 



 • Opportunity for personal growth, leadership, and driving innovation in a high\-growth industry.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**Procurement Manager** 



  


**A Fortune 200 company building its Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India** 



  


**Location:** 
 Pune, India — hybrid
 


  


**About the Company** 



  


 A Fortune 200 global organisation is setting up its Global Capability Centre in India and has partnered with Flexiple to hire its founding procurement team. This is a ground\-floor seat at a company investing seriously in India, with the scope to shape how buying runs from day one. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 


  


**Role Overview** 



  


 As a Procurement Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end purchasing cycle across categories \- from demand intake to purchase order \- and build the buying processes the centre will scale on. You will balance cost, quality, and delivery while giving leadership a clear view of spend.
 


  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  


**Sourcing \& Buying** 



  

* Run sourcing, RFQs, and supplier selection across direct and indirect categories
* Negotiate price, terms, and delivery to hit cost and savings targets
* Manage the purchase order cycle from requisition to goods receipt


  


**Supplier \& Spend** 



  

* Build and maintain a reliable supplier base and track performance
* Report on spend, savings, and category trends for leadership reviews
* Tighten procurement policy, controls, and approval workflows


  


**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



  

* 3 to 7 years in procurement, purchasing, or sourcing roles
* Strong negotiation skills and a cost\-and\-quality mindset
* Comfort with ERP or procurement tools and spend reporting
* Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote\-work setup


  


**Preferred Qualifications** 



  

* Experience standing up procurement processes in a new team or centre
* Exposure to a GCC, shared\-services, or large multinational environment
* A degree in supply chain, engineering, or business, or a relevant certification


  


**What We Offer** 



  

* A founding procurement role at a global organisation's India centre
* Remote\-friendly, pan\-India hiring with long\-term placement
* Direct exposure to leadership and a high\-ownership mandate
* One application considered for this and future matched roles


  


**Hiring Process** 



  


 HR Screening → Assignment → Leadership Round 1 → Leadership Round 2 → Culture Fit

title: Non-Financial Risk (NFR) Lead
description:
**Why Mizuho** 




 At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.
 



  





 It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 The Non\-Financial Risk (NFR) team supports the Mizuho U.S. Operations (MUSO) risk management framework through risk governance, analytics, controls, reporting and execution. Mizuho Pune is being developed as an integrated extension of the global NFR and wider Risk organization, providing scalable, follow\-the\-sun risk management capabilities across MUSO’s Corporate \& Investment Bank (CIB).
 



  





 The NFR Lead will establish and lead the Pune NFR capability, provide local risk oversight, and partner with global NFR leadership, MUSO Risk, Business and Pune leadership to identify emerging risks, strengthen governance, and drive timely escalation and remediation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Build and Lead the Pune NFR Capability** 




 \* Establish and lead the NFR capability in Mizuho Pune, including operating model, processes and ways of working.
 



  





 \* Build and lead a high\-performing Pune NFR team and help evolve Mizuho Pune into an active risk\-management hub.
 



 \* Act as the senior NFR point of contact for the Pune site, ensuring effective connectivity with MUSO and global NFR teams.
 



  





**Risk Oversight, Review and Challenge** 




 \* Provide first\-level review and challenge of key NFR information, including risk appetite metrics, risk events, RCSA results, KRIs and other risk indicators.
 



 \* Use portfolio\-level analytics to identify trends, anomalies, concentrations and areas requiring management attention.
 



 \* Support RCSA transformation, quality assurance and review of areas where risk may be under\-assessed or control outcomes indicate emerging concerns.
 



 \* Coordinate risk actions, escalations and remediation to ensure timely closure and effective management oversight.
 



  





**Governance, Reporting and Stakeholder Engagement** 




 \* Support the development of NFR policies, governance frameworks, KRI reporting, management information and senior stakeholder packs.
 



 \*Prepare and deliver risk insights, thematic analyses and management reporting to support senior management decision\-making
 



  





**Transformation, Analytics and Innovation** 




 \* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring governance, reporting and control processes.
 



 \* Enhance analytical capabilities, data utilization and reporting tools to strengthen risk identification, monitoring and decision\-making
 



 \* Explore the controlled use of AI and advanced analytics to improve risk identification, analysis and reporting, ensuring outputs remain explainable, controlled and auditable.
 



  





**Experience \& Skills:** 




  





**Required:** 




  





 \* 17\+ years of experience in Non\-Financial Risk, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, Risk Reporting or a related risk management functions within a global financial institution.
 



 \*Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
 



 \* Strong understanding of RCSA, risk events, risk appetite, KRIs, operational risk governance and risk reporting.
 



 \*Experience in leading and developing teams, including developing and managing talent
 



 \* Experience in risk analysis, portfolio review, risk assessment challenge and senior stakeholder engagement.
 



 \* Ability to translate risk data and trends into clear, actionable risk insights.
 



 \* Demonstrated ability to establish new processes, operating models or capabilities.
 



 \* Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



  





**Preferred:** 




  





 \* Experience supporting CIB, Markets and/or Banking businesses.
 



 \* Experience with global follow\-the\-sun operating models or India\-based risk capability build\-out.
 



 \* Experience in RCSA transformation, portfolio analytics, reporting automation or AI\-enabled risk processes.
 



  





**Success in the Role:** 




  





 Success will be measured by the ability to build a sustainable Mizuho Pune NFR capability that provides effective local coverage, delivers high\-quality first\-level review and challenge, produces reliable risk reporting, supports governance and automation, and operates as an integrated extension of MUSO and the global NFR team.
 



  





**Company Overview:** 




  





 Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high\-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.
 



  





 Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.
 



  





 Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.
 



  





 Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
 



  





 Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Senior Production Officer or Assistant Producer Manager  - Detergent/Powder Plant
description:
Senior Production Officer / Assistant Production Manager
   

  

 📍 Location: Sonipat, Haryana \| 🏭 Industry: Detergent Manufacturing
   

  

 \| Plant \| Detergent Plant \|
   

 \| Company \| Vital Hime Kare \|
   

 \| Experience \| Minimum 6 Years \|
   

 \| Salary \| Up to ₹7 LPA \|
   

 \| Notice Period \| 20 Days \|
   

 \| Location \| Sonipat, Haryana \|
   

  

 ⚠️ Mandatory Criterion: If you haven't worked in a detergent plant before, do not apply.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced production professional to lead shop\-floor operations at our detergent plant in Sonipat. The incumbent will be responsible for end\-to\-end production planning, process control, manpower management, and quality adherence across powder, cake/bar, and liquid detergent lines.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \- Process Operations: Oversee slurry preparation, sulphonation, and spray\-drying tower operations; manage post\-dosing, perfume/oil dosing, and blending stages to maintain consistent product quality.
   

 \- Line Management: Handle powder production lines, detergent cake \& bar lines, and packing sections — ensuring output meets daily production plan targets.
   

 \- Yield \& Consumption Control: Monitor raw\-material consumption norms, minimize wastage, and drive batch yield improvements across all products.
   

 \- Shift \& Manpower Handling: Manage shift\-wise workforce deployment, training, discipline, and productivity on the shop floor.
   

 \- Quality \& Compliance: Coordinate with the QC team on in\-process checks, batch approvals, and finished\-goods testing; ensure compliance with BIS standards and internal quality parameters.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
**About Vecmocon**
 Vecmocon incubated at IIT Delhi in 2016\. We are a complete tech stack ecosystem to make electric vehicles intelligent, safer \& smoother to drive. We specialize in providing OEMs with high\-quality, locally manufactured components for electric vehicles, including Battery Management Systems (BMS), chargers, vehicle intelligence module, FOTA, software diagnostics etc.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Logistics Manager** 
 to manage and oversee the company’s
 **domestic and international logistics operations** 
 . The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end movement of materials, components, finished goods, and equipment, including transportation, import/export, documentation, customs coordination, vendor management, and logistics cost optimization.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in
 **domestic transportation as well as international shipments, import/export processes, freight forwarding, customs, and logistics documentation** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Domestic Logistics
   

  

* Manage end\-to\-end inbound and outbound domestic logistics operations.
* Plan and coordinate transportation of materials, components, and finished goods across locations.
* Coordinate with transporters, courier partners, and logistics service providers.
* Monitor shipment schedules, delivery timelines, PODs, and transportation costs.
* Ensure timely movement of materials while maintaining cost efficiency.
* Resolve transportation, delivery, and shipment\-related issues.


 International Logistics \& Import/Export
   

  

* Manage international import and export shipments from booking to final delivery.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, airlines, and overseas vendors/customers.
* Handle air, sea, and courier shipments based on business requirements.
* Manage import/export documentation including Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading/Airway Bill, Certificate of Origin, Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, and other required documents.
* Coordinate customs clearance and ensure timely clearance of shipments.
* Ensure compliance with applicable import/export regulations, customs requirements, and trade documentation.
* Track international shipments and proactively resolve delays or clearance issues.


 Logistics Operations \& Planning
   

  

* Plan logistics requirements based on procurement, production, sales, and project schedules.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Stores, Production, Finance, Sales, and other internal teams.
* Monitor inventory movement and ensure timely availability of materials.
* Maintain accurate shipment and logistics records.
* Develop and maintain logistics SOPs and processes.


 Vendor \& Cost Management
   

  

* Manage relationships with transporters, freight forwarders, customs brokers, courier companies, and other logistics vendors.
* Negotiate freight rates and service terms with logistics partners.
* Evaluate vendor performance based on cost, service quality, delivery timelines, and reliability.
* Identify opportunities for freight cost reduction and logistics optimization.
* Verify logistics invoices and coordinate with Finance for timely payment processing.


 Compliance \& Documentation
   

  

* Ensure proper documentation and compliance for all domestic and international shipments.
* Maintain records related to imports, exports, customs, freight, insurance, and transportation.
* Coordinate with Finance and relevant teams for documentation required for payments, customs, and audits.
* Ensure adherence to company policies and applicable statutory requirements.


 Team Management \& Reporting
   

  

* Lead and manage the logistics team and allocate responsibilities effectively.
* Monitor daily logistics activities and operational performance.
* Prepare and present logistics MIS and reports covering shipment status, freight costs, delays, vendor performance, and other key metrics.
* Establish and track KPIs for logistics operations.
* Drive continuous improvement in logistics processes and turnaround time.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Commerce, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in domestic and international logistics.
* Strong knowledge of import/export processes and customs clearance.
* Experience working with freight forwarders, CHA/customs brokers, transporters, and courier partners.
* Good understanding of air and sea freight operations.
* Strong knowledge of logistics and import/export documentation.
* Good understanding of Excel, ERP systems, and logistics MIS.
* Strong negotiation, coordination, and vendor management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in manufacturing, automotive, EV, electronics, battery, or engineering industries will be preferred.
* Experience handling time\-sensitive and high\-value technical/electronic components will be an advantage.
* Exposure to ERP\-based inventory and logistics processes is preferred.
