title: Customer Care Excellence and Training Lead
description:
**About The Role**
 At Heads Up For Tails, customer care should never feel like a call centre.
   

  

 Every person contacting us is someone who loves their pet. Their question may be about a delayed order, refund, exchange or change of address—but behind that transaction may be worry, disappointment or concern for an animal they love.
   

  

 We are looking for someone to help us build a customer care team that resolves issues efficiently while making every customer feel heard, reassured and genuinely cared for.
   

  

 This person will bring the HUFT Care Code to life across calls, chats and other customer touchpoints. They will work closely with agents and leaders every day—listening to conversations, training the team, giving feedback, raising the hiring bar and ensuring that empathy, warmth and ownership become consistent behaviours.
   

  

 This is not a classroom\-training role. It is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working closely with people and improving the quality of real customer interactions.
   

  

**What You Will OwnBring the HUFT Care Code to Life**
* Translate the HUFT Care Code into simple, observable everyday behaviours.
* Ensure that customer interactions reflect understanding, pet acknowledgement, empathy, ownership, resolution and warmth.
* Help the team build meaningful connections without making conversations unnecessarily long or scripted.
* Create practical examples of transactional versus high\-touch care.
* Build a library of excellent calls, chats, responses and coaching examples.


**Train and Coach the Team**
* Design and conduct onboarding and ongoing training for call and chat teams.
* Use real HUFT interactions, role plays and customer situations rather than only presentations.
* Coach agents individually based on their actual calls and chats.
* Help agents listen for the real concern behind the stated query.
* Teach the team to communicate limitations honestly without sounding indifferent.
* Build capability in empathy, personalisation, de\-escalation, ownership, clear commitments and thoughtful closure.
* Create individual development plans where required.
* Recognise and celebrate examples of exceptional care.


**Develop Customer Care Leaders**
* Coach team leaders to look beyond productivity, queues and ticket closure.
* Teach leaders to evaluate interactions using the HUFT Care Score.
* Help them identify the strongest moment and biggest missed moment in every interaction.
* Improve the quality of feedback leaders give their teams.
* Observe leaders conducting coaching sessions and give them feedback.
* Build a regular call and chat calibration rhythm.
* Ensure leaders can independently uphold the standard across shifts and teams.


**Own Quality and Continuous Improvement**
* Regularly review calls, chats, complaints and escalations.
* Use the six dimensions of the HUFT Care Score to identify individual and team\-level patterns.
* Track whether coaching is translating into changed behaviour.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and bring them to the relevant internal teams.
* Distinguish between agent failures and problems caused by policies, processes, technology, fulfilment or unclear information.
* Partner with customer care operations to improve processes that repeatedly create poor customer experiences.
* Work with the technology team to strengthen and calibrate the AI Call\-Care Coach.
* Ensure AI\-generated feedback remains fair, specific, useful and grounded in real evidence.


**Raise the Hiring Bar**
* Partner with HR to define the behavioural profile for customer care roles.
* Help design voice tests, written assessments and live role plays.
* Participate in final interviews for customer care candidates.
* Assess candidates for warmth, listening, empathy, clarity, judgment, ownership and openness to feedback.
* Help identify people who may not have traditional call\-centre experience but naturally understand thoughtful service.
* Ensure new hires meet the HUFT standard before they begin independently handling customers.


**Improve Customer Journeys**
* Study common customer situations such as delayed orders, refunds, exchanges, product concerns and grooming complaints.
* Help develop model approaches for handling these situations with greater care.
* Reduce unnecessary repetition and effort for customers.
* Strengthen follow\-through so customers do not have to repeatedly chase HUFT.
* Work with internal teams to close recurring gaps in policies, information and ownership.
* Ensure urgent pet\-safety and emotionally sensitive situations are recognised and escalated correctly.


**What This Role Does Not Own**
 The Customer Care Operations team will continue to own:
   

  

* Daily queue and roster management.
* Staffing and shift allocation.
* Call volumes and response\-time management.
* Day\-to\-day ticket allocation.
* Operational SLAs.
* Routine reporting and administration.


 This role will work closely with the operations team but will primarily own the quality, capability and consistency of customer care.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
* Strong experience in customer experience, service excellence, quality, training or coaching.
* Experience working closely with call, chat, hospitality, retail or premium\-service teams.
* Exceptional listening and communication skills.
* The ability to recognise the difference between scripted politeness and genuine empathy.
* A natural ability to coach people without shaming or discouraging them.
* Strong judgment in difficult or emotionally sensitive situations.
* Comfort giving clear, direct and constructive feedback.
* The ability to balance warmth with accuracy and operational discipline.
* Strong facilitation and role\-play skills.
* Comfort working with data, quality scorecards and customer feedback.
* The ability to identify patterns across multiple customer interactions.
* High ownership and willingness to work hands\-on with the team.
* Genuine respect for pets and the people who love them.


 Prior experience in the pet\-care industry is not necessary. A willingness to understand the emotional relationship between people and their pets is essential.
   

  

**The Kind Of Person Who Will Thrive Here**
 You may be right for this role if:
   

  

* You notice not only what someone says, but what they may be worried about.
* You believe a correct answer can still be delivered poorly.
* You can hear a conversation and identify the exact moment when trust was built or lost.
* You enjoy helping people become better at their work.
* You are patient enough to coach repeatedly, not just conduct one training session.
* You care about language, tone and follow\-through.
* You can be warm without avoiding difficult feedback.
* You believe service excellence is built through hundreds of small, consistent behaviours.


**How Success Will Be Measured**
 Success in this role will include:
   

  

* Improvement across the six dimensions of the HUFT Care Score.
* More calls and chats demonstrating genuine empathy, warmth and ownership.
* Fewer repeat contacts caused by unclear communication or broken commitments.
* Stronger handling of complaints and emotionally sensitive situations.
* Better consistency across agents, teams and shifts.
* Improved coaching quality among customer care leaders.
* New hires meeting the HUFT care standard.
* Customer feedback that reflects feeling heard, helped and cared for.
* Clear customer insights being shared with the wider business and acted upon.


**Why This Role Matters**
 Customer care is often where a company’s values are tested most.
   

  

**We Want Customers To Leave An Interaction Feeling**
 “This person understood me, cared about what happened next and did not leave me to chase HUFT again.”
   

  

 Your role will be to make that feeling consistent—not occasional.
   

  

 Skills: coaching,training,customer care

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mettcover® is a leading cold chain solutions provider specializing in innovative passive thermal packaging designed for performance and reliability. With over 11 years of expertise, the company is one of the largest manufacturers of highly researched and performance\-tested thermal packaging products, serving global brands across pharmaceuticals, FMCG, logistics, chemicals, electronics, and more. Its product portfolio includes advanced solutions such as pallet and box shippers, thermal covers, blankets, quilts, temperature data loggers, and PCM\-based thermal systems. Mettcover® leverages end\-to\-end technology integration, strong research\-driven methodologies, and a dedicated R\&D team to ensure optimal temperature control and minimize excursions during transit. Supported by an ISO, GMP, and CE\-compliant manufacturing facility, Mettcover® is committed to high\-quality standards, continuous innovation, and exceptional customer service.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Procurement Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based at Mettcover®’s facility in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end procurement activities, including sourcing materials and services, evaluating and onboarding suppliers, and ensuring timely availability of inputs for manufacturing and operations. Day\-to\-day tasks include conducting market research, soliciting and comparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and preparing, reviewing, and maintaining procurement contracts and purchase orders. The Procurement Manager will collaborate closely with operations, production, finance, and quality teams to align procurement plans with business needs, optimize costs, and maintain compliance with company policies and relevant regulations. The role also involves monitoring supplier performance, maintaining accurate procurement records, identifying process improvements, and supporting strategic initiatives to strengthen the supply base for Mettcover®’s cold chain packaging solutions.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Procurement and Supplier Evaluation skills, with experience in sourcing, vendor selection, and supplier performance monitoring.
* Proficiency in Contract Negotiation and Contract Management, including drafting, reviewing, and administering procurement agreements.
* Solid Analytical Skills to assess cost, quality, risk, and market trends, and to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Experience in manufacturing or supply chain environments, preferably within packaging, cold chain, or related industries.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams, build constructive supplier relationships, and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency with procurement or ERP systems and standard office tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications in procurement or supply chain are an advantage.
* Knowledge of relevant compliance standards and basic understanding of ISO, GMP, or similar quality frameworks is beneficial.

title: Production Supervisor – Textiles
description:
Company : Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 



 Location : Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 Salary : ₹16,000 – ₹25,000 per month
 



 Experience : 2–7 years
 



 Employment Type : Full\-time
 



  





 \#\#\# About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on \*\*Production Supervisor – Textiles\*\* to supervise and follow up the complete garment production process on a daily basis.
 



  





 The primary responsibility is to ensure that production moves smoothly from:
 



  





 \*\*Cutting → Stitching → Checking → Finishing → Ironing → Packing\*\*
 



  





 The candidate should be active on the production floor, regularly follow up with workers and departments, identify delays early, and ensure production targets are completed on time with the required quality.
 



  





 \#\#\# Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Supervise and follow up \*\*daily garment production from cutting to final packing\*\*.
 



 \* Track every running style, colour, size, and production lot through each stage.
 



 \* Follow up with cutting, stitching, checking, finishing, ironing, and packing teams.
 



 \* Ensure planned production quantities are completed according to daily and weekly targets.
 



 \* Monitor pending quantities at every production stage.
 



 \* Identify production delays, bottlenecks, and manpower shortages and immediately follow up for resolution.
 



 \* Ensure work does not remain pending unnecessarily between departments.
 



 \* Maintain clear production status for each running order.
 



 \* Coordinate priorities based on production plans, stock requirements, and urgent orders.
 



 \* Ensure correct styles, colours, sizes, measurements, and quantities are being produced.
 



 \* Monitor production quality during each stage instead of waiting until final checking.
 



 \* Coordinate rework or corrections wherever quality problems are identified.
 



 \* Ensure finished products are properly checked, packed, counted, and handed over to the warehouse.
 



 \* Compare planned quantity, produced quantity, rejected quantity, and pending quantity.
 



 \* Monitor production wastage and help reduce avoidable rework and rejection.
 



  





 \#\#\# Sampling \& New Style Follow\-Up
 



  





 \* Follow up on \*\*samples and new product developments\*\* when required.
 



 \* Coordinate cutting, stitching, checking, and finishing of samples.
 



 \* Ensure sample corrections are completed properly before bulk production.
 



 \* Understand approved sample requirements before production begins.
 



 \* Communicate important construction, measurement, and quality requirements to the production team.
 



 \* Ensure bulk production follows the approved sample.
 



  





 \#\#\# Production Planning \& Follow\-Up
 



  





 \* Understand daily and weekly production requirements from management.
 



 \* Allocate priorities to production teams accordingly.
 



 \* Maintain a simple daily production tracking report.
 



 \* Keep management updated about completed, pending, and delayed production.
 



 \* Highlight material shortages or operational problems before they affect production.
 



 \* Coordinate with stores and warehouse teams for required materials and finished\-goods movement.
 



  





 \#\#\# Worker \& Floor Supervision
 



  





 \* Supervise workers involved in different production stages.
 



 \* Allocate work based on production priority and manpower availability.
 



 \* Follow up continuously until assigned work is completed.
 



 \* Ensure workers maintain productivity, quality, and discipline.
 



 \* Maintain proper workflow and cleanliness on the production floor.
 



 \* Coordinate between departments to avoid idle time and unnecessary waiting.
 



 \* Escalate recurring productivity or quality issues to management.
 



  





 \#\#\# Quality Control
 



  





 \* Ensure garments meet required standards for:
 



  





 \* Measurements
 



 \* Stitching quality
 



 \* Fabric quality
 



 \* Colour
 



 \* Finishing
 



 \* Thread trimming
 



 \* Ironing
 



 \* Packing
 



 \* Identify defects early and arrange correction before large quantities are completed.
 



 \* Reduce rejection, alteration, and rework wherever possible.
 



  





 \#\#\# Daily Production Monitoring
 



  





 The Production Supervisor should always know:
 



  





 \* What is currently under cutting
 



 \* What is under stitching
 



 \* What quantity is pending
 



 \* What is under checking and finishing
 



 \* What requires rework
 



 \* What is ready for packing
 



 \* What production has been completed
 



 \* What is delayed and why
 



 \* What quantity has been handed over to finished stock
 



  





 \#\#\# Candidate Requirements
 



  





 \* \*\*Minimum 2 years and maximum 7 years of relevant experience\*\*.
 



 \* Experience in garments, knitwear, textiles, production, or manufacturing supervision.
 



 \* Tirupur garment or knitwear industry experience is strongly preferred.
 



 \* Good understanding of the garment production process from \*\*cutting to packing\*\*.
 



 \* Strong production follow\-up ability.
 



 \* Ability to supervise workers and coordinate multiple departments.
 



 \* Good understanding of garment quality and basic measurement requirements.
 



 \* Ability to identify production delays and take corrective action.
 



 \* Basic knowledge of production reports, Excel, or Google Sheets is preferred.
 



 \* Should be practical, organised, responsible, and comfortable working directly on the production floor.
 



 \* Tamil communication is essential.
 



  





 \#\#\# What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We need someone who does not simply collect production updates.
 



  





 The Production Supervisor should actively drive the production cycle:
 



  





 \*\*Cutting → Stitching → Checking → Finishing → Packing → Finished Stock\*\*
 



  





 If production is delayed at any stage, the supervisor should identify where it is stuck, follow up with the concerned person, and ensure the work moves forward.
 



  





 Strong \*\*follow\-up, floor control, production knowledge, and accountability\*\* are the most important qualities for this role.
 



  





 \#\#\# Salary
 



  





 \*\*₹16,000 – ₹25,000 per month\*\*
 



  





 Salary will be decided based on textile production experience, garment knowledge, team\-handling ability, production follow\-up skills, and overall capability.

description:

 Job Description - IT Operations / IT Manager

 About the Role We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5-8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day-to-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery. 
 1. IT Operations, Service Management & Service Delivery Lead day-to-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end-user technology. Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform. Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction. Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident reviews. Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities. Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues. Maintain a strong customer-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users. 2. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5-8 IT support and infrastructure professionals. Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues. Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team. Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous-improvement-oriented culture. Coordinate cross-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives. 3. IT Infrastructure, Network & End-User Computing Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end-user devices. Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services. Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services. Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal. Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access-card coordination with HR. Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand. Maintain disk-capacity and infrastructure-health reports and proactively address capacity risks. 4. Cloud Management & Cost Optimization Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable. Support cloud services and customer-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources. Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps-style cost optimization. Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management. Balance on-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership. 5. Software, License, Patch & Configuration Management Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization. Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central. Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers. Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance. Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones. 6. DevOps, Git & CI/CD Operations Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices. Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable. Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties. Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams. Lead infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable. Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. 7. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls. Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management. Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities. Manage endpoint protection and antivirus/EDR platforms such as Cortex and ensure security agents remain healthy and current. Oversee identity and access management, privileged access, access reviews, endpoint security, network security, and incident response. Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and support ISO 27001 certification and audit requirements. Participate in quarterly audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and management reviews. Coordinate cybersecurity incidents, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned. 8. Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy & Governance Define and govern enterprise IT architecture standards, technology reference models, and infrastructure principles. Establish vendor evaluation frameworks and technology selection criteria. Define cloud adoption policies, technology lifecycle standards, and application rationalization roadmaps aligned with business strategy. Partner with C-suite and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and investment priorities. Present IT performance metrics, risk posture, cybersecurity status, governance outcomes, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, AIOps, and cloud platforms, and assess their operational and business value. 9. title: Manager Workforce Management - Dialer
description:
Position Summary The Operations Dialer Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring, and continuous optimization of outbound and inbound dialing strategies supporting first-party credit card collections. This role serves as a key liaison between Collections Operations, Workforce Management, Analytics/MIS, Compliance, Technology, clients, and third-party vendors, ensuring that account inventory, staffing, contact strategies, dialer capabilities, and business objectives are aligned to maximize collections performance while maintaining operational and regulatory compliance. The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to act as a subject matter expert in dialer strategy and collections operations, capable of representing the organization in discussions with clients, technology providers, telecommunications vendors, and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate has strong experience in first-party credit card collections, understands delinquency-stage strategies and customer segmentation, and has hands-on knowledge of the LiveVox contact center and dialer platform. --- Key Responsibilities Dialer Strategy & Management Develop and execute daily, weekly, and monthly dialing strategies for first-party credit card collection portfolios. Configure and manage LiveVox campaigns, services, skill groups, dialing modes, account segmentation, and contact strategies. Determine appropriate dialing treatments based on delinquency stage, account risk, customer behavior, historical contactability, payment likelihood, and operational priorities. Optimize predictive, automated, manual, and agent-initiated dialing strategies based on portfolio requirements. Manage account penetration and attempt strategies to balance contact rates, collections performance, customer experience, and regulatory requirements. Evaluate campaign performance throughout the day and make real-time adjustments based on staffing, account inventory, penetration, contact rates, and collection results. Coordinate campaign reruns, prioritization strategies, and reassignment of account inventory when necessary. Identify opportunities to improve contact efficiency while reducing unnecessary or low-value dialing activity. --- Collections Operations Support collection strategies across various stages of delinquency, including early-stage, mid-stage, and late-stage credit card collections. Demonstrate working knowledge of key collections concepts, including: o Days Past Due and delinquency buckets o First Payment Default o Promise to Pay o Right Party Contact o Payment conversion o Account penetration o Customer contactability o Risk segmentation o Roll rates and forward flow Partner with Operations leadership to translate portfolio and client objectives into actionable dialer strategies. Identify opportunities to increase successful customer contacts and payment conversions without unnecessarily increasing dialing volume. Evaluate account inventory, staffing, agent utilization, and strategy performance to determine whether performance gaps are driven by manpower, account quality, contactability, dialer strategy, or operational execution. Provide recommendations to Operations leaders regarding staffing allocation, campaign priorities, account treatment, and contact strategy. --- Client, Vendor & Stakeholder Management Serve as a primary point of contact and dialer subject matter expert during discussions with clients, Operations leaders, technology teams, and third-party vendors. Participate in client meetings, business reviews, strategy sessions, and performance discussions related to collections and dialer performance. Present dialer performance, trends, strategy results, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Translate complex dialer and operational data into clear business insights appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences. Work directly with clients to understand portfolio objectives, performance expectations, strategy requirements, and operational priorities. Partner with Operations stakeholders to ensure dialer strategies support frontline execution and overall collections objectives. Coordinate with vendors supporting: o Dialer and contact center technology o Telecommunications services o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Phone intelligence and contactability o Data and analytics solutions Manage vendor-related issues, enhancement requests, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation activities. Evaluate proposed vendor solutions and new technologies based on operational value, cost, expected performance improvement, and implementation requirements. Coordinate testing and validation of new vendor features or dialer capabilities prior to production deployment. Escalate vendor performance, system, or service issues when necessary and track issues through resolution. Maintain productive relationships with clients and vendors while balancing operational requirements, technical limitations, compliance considerations, and business objectives. Support client inquiries and investigations involving dialer behavior, contact strategies, campaign configurations, or performance results. --- Performance Management & Analytics Monitor and analyze dialer and collections KPIs, including: o Attempts o Live Voice / Connect Rate o Right Party Contact Rate o RPC per Attempt o Promise to Pay Rate o Payment / Collection Rate o Contact-to-Payment Conversion o Accounts Worked o Penetration Rate o Average Handle Time o Talk Time o Wrap Time o Agent Occupancy o Idle / Ready Time o Abandonment Rate o Answering Machine Detection performance Perform trend, segmentation, and comparative analysis to identify opportunities for campaign optimization. Evaluate performance by delinquency segment, risk level, account population, time of day, agent group, site, and dialing strategy. Develop or support forecasting models for dialing volume, staffing requirements, contact rates, and expected collection outcomes. Conduct root-cause analysis when operational or client performance targets are missed. Develop clear recommendations and action plans based on analytical findings. Prepare performance summaries, dashboards, and executive-level presentations for internal leadership and clients. --- LiveVox Administration & Optimization Maintain strong working knowledge of LiveVox functionality, including: o Campaign and service configuration o Dialing strategies o Skill groups o Contact lists o Agent routing o Predictive dialing o Answering Machine Detection o Call disposition and result codes o Caller ID and branded calling solutions o Campaign pacing o Contact attempt controls o Reporting and Call Detail Records Troubleshoot campaign and dialing issues in coordination with Technology teams, LiveVox support, and other external vendors. Validate dialer configuration changes before implementation. Monitor system behavior to identify potential inefficiencies, routing issues, pacing concerns, or unusual contact patterns. Coordinate with LiveVox and other technology partners on platform enhancements, defects, upgrades, and new functionality. Support User Acceptance Testing and production validation for changes affecting dialer operations. --- Compliance & Risk Management Ensure dialing strategies comply with applicable company policies and regulatory requirements governing consumer communications and collections. Partner with Compliance, Legal, clients, and technology teams when implementing changes that may affect dialing frequency, calling windows, customer consent, contact treatment, or caller identification. Maintain appropriate controls around account attempts, contact frequency, time zones, phone number treatments, and calling hours. Monitor dialing activity for potential compliance risks and escalate concerns when necessary. Support audits and investigations involving dialer activity, customer contact attempts, and campaign configurations. Ensure changes requested by Operations, clients, or vendors are evaluated for potential compliance and customer-experience impact prior to implementation. --- Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as the primary dialer strategy partner for Operations leadership. Collaborate closely with: o Collections Operations o Client Leadership o Workforce Management o Business Analytics / MIS o Quality Assurance o Compliance o Information Technology o Telecommunications teams o LiveVox and other technology vendors Coordinate staffing and dialer capacity to ensure available agents are effectively utilized. Communicate strategy changes, campaign priorities, and performance expectations to Operations teams. Facilitate discussions between technical and operational stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions are practical and aligned with business objectives. Participate in performance reviews, client business reviews, strategy meetings, project discussions, and executive presentations. Influence stakeholders across multiple departments even when direct reporting relationships do not exist. --- Continuous Improvement Conduct controlled tests of new dialing strategies, account segmentation approaches, contact frequencies, campaign schedules, and dialing technologies. Measure pre- and post-implementation results to determine strategy effectiveness. Develop business cases for new dialer capabilities, vendor solutions, or process improvements. Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting. Develop repeatable processes, dashboards, and decision frameworks for dialer management. Partner with clients and vendors to identify emerging opportunities to improve customer contactability and collection performance. Stay informed about emerging technologies affecting collections, including: o AI call screening o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Predictive analytics o Customer contact optimization o Alternative communication channels o Phone intelligence and contactability solutions --- Required Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Analytics, or related field preferred. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in credit card collections, consumer finance, or contact center operations. Experience supporting or managing first-party credit card collections strongly preferred. Hands-on experience with LiveVox or a comparable predictive dialer/contact center platform. Experience interacting directly with clients, external vendors, and Operations stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to lead strategy and performance discussions with both internal and external business partners. Strong understanding of credit card delinquency and collections processes. Experience developing or managing outbound dialing strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel. Experience interpreting large operational datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and business requirements to technical teams. --- Preferred Qualifications Experience managing multiple collection segments or delinquency buckets. Experience with SQL and Snowflake or similar data warehouse platforms. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools. Knowledge of Workforce Management concepts including staffing, occupancy, shrinkage, and interval-level capacity planning. Experience with automated reporting and campaign performance dashboards. Experience working with multiple contact center locations or outsourced operations. Experience participating in client-facing business reviews and operational strategy meetings. Experience managing technology or telecommunications vendor relationships. Knowledge of branded caller identification, STIR/SHAKEN, call authentication, and telecommunications concepts. Familiarity with predictive analytics, customer segmentation, and payment likelihood models. Experience conducting vendor evaluations, pilots, testing, and implementation projects. --- Core Competencies Strategic Thinking Translates collections and client objectives into practical account and dialing strategies. Client & Stakeholder Management Builds credibility with clients, Operations leaders, technical teams, and vendors while effectively balancing competing priorities. Vendor Management Works effectively with external technology and service providers to resolve issues, evaluate solutions, and implement improvements. Analytical Decision-Making Uses data to identify performance gaps, opportunities, and appropriate corrective actions. Operational Leadership Understands the relationship between staffing, agent behavior, account inventory, technology, and collection performance. Technical Dialer Knowledge Comfortable working directly with LiveVox configurations, campaign performance, troubleshooting, and call-level data. Collections Expertise Understands the customer lifecycle, delinquency progression, contact strategies, and payment behavior within first-party credit card collections. Compliance Awareness Maintains strong controls around customer communication practices and dialing activity. Communication & Influence Able to clearly explain technical and analytical findings to frontline Operations, clients, vendors, and executive audiences. --- Key Performance Indicators Success in this role may be measured through: Improvement in Right Party Contact Rate Payment / Collection conversion Promise to Pay performance Account penetration Contact efficiency per dialing attempt Agent occupancy and utilization Dialer capacity utilization Reduction of unnecessary or unproductive attempts Achievement of portfolio and client collection targets Compliance with dialing and customer-contact requirements Effectiveness of strategy tests and continuous improvement initiatives Timely resolution of dialer and vendor-related issues Successful implementation of client and vendor initiatives Quality and effectiveness of stakeholder communication and recommendations --- Position Objective The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to ensure that the right accounts are contacted, through the right strategy, at the right time, with the appropriate level of effort and available staffing, while effectively representing the organization s dialer strategy with internal Operations stakeholders, clients, and technology partners. The role continuously balances five priorities: Collections Performance | Contact Efficiency | Agent Utilization | Compliance | Client & Stakeholder Alignment

title: IT Operations - Manager
description:
Were proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work , a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. 
 
 Job Description - IT Operations / IT Manager 
 Location: Bangalore| Experience: 10+ years |Team: 5-8 IT professionals | User base: ~500-person IT organization 
 About the Role We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5-8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day-to-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery. 
 1. IT Operations, Service Management & Service Delivery Lead day-to-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end-user technology. Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform. Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction. Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident reviews. Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities. Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues. Maintain a strong customer-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users. 2. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5-8 IT support and infrastructure professionals. Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues. Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team. Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous-improvement-oriented culture. Coordinate cross-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives. 3. IT Infrastructure, Network & End-User Computing Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end-user devices. Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services. Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services. Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal. Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access-card coordination with HR. Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand. Maintain disk-capacity and infrastructure-health reports and proactively address capacity risks. 4. Cloud Management & Cost Optimization Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable. Support cloud services and customer-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources. Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps-style cost optimization. Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management. Balance on-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership. 5. Software, License, Patch & Configuration Management Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization. Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central. Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers. Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance. Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones. 6. DevOps, Git & CI/CD Operations Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices. Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable. Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties. Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams. Lead infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable. Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. 7. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls. Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management. Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities. Manage endpoint protection and antivirus/EDR platforms such as Cortex and ensure security agents remain healthy and current. Oversee identity and access management, privileged access, access reviews, endpoint security, network security, and incident response. Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and support ISO 27001 certification and audit requirements. Participate in quarterly audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and management reviews. Coordinate cybersecurity incidents, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned. 8. Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy & Governance Define and govern enterprise IT architecture standards, technology reference models, and infrastructure principles. Establish vendor evaluation frameworks and technology selection criteria. Define cloud adoption policies, technology lifecycle standards, and application rationalization roadmaps aligned with business strategy. Partner with C-suite and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and investment priorities. Present IT performance metrics, risk posture, cybersecurity status, governance outcomes, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, AIOps, and cloud platforms, and assess their operational and business value. 9. AI, AIOps & Automation Lead adoption of AIOps capabilities such as ML-based event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and automated first-line remediation. Drive AI-powered ITSM capabilities including intelligent ticket classification, AI-driven routing, NLP-based resolution recommendations, and predictive SLA-breach alerts. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, support processes, monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities. Architect and manage infrastructure for AI workloads, including on-premises GPU platforms and cost-optimized cloud AI services where appropriate. Measure operational improvements from AI and automation initiatives, including reduced downtime, faster MTTR, and lower operating cost. 10. Proactive Maintenance, Upgrades & Business Continuity Plan and execute quarterly firmware upgrades for wireless access points and network equipment. Implement and maintain automated OS patching and upgrade cycles for end-user systems and servers. Perform planned server OS upgrades and maintain application/platform upgrade schedules. Perform quarterly GitLab version upgrades with appropriate validation, backup, rollback, and change-management controls. Maintain backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience plans for critical services. Use monitoring and capacity data to identify and resolve issues before they impact users or customers. 11. Monitoring, Reporting & Operational Governance Develop and maintain monthly IT dashboards covering service uptime, Internet uptime, network bandwidth, patch compliance, license renewals, ticket performance, disk usage, cloud spend, and security posture. Produce monthly SLA and KPI reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders. Maintain operational dashboards and trend analysis to identify recurring incidents, capacity risks, cost anomalies, and improvement opportunities. Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset records, service ownership information, escalation matrices, and operational runbooks. Maintain and share access-card server details with HR in accordance with access governance procedures. 12. Procurement, Vendor & Contract Management Own procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, accessories, network equipment, and technology services. Manage vendor, MSP, telecom, cloud, and technology-partner relationships. Define and monitor vendor SLAs, KPIs, contracts, renewals, service quality, and operational performance. Lead vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, renewals, and corrective actions in collaboration with procurement and leadership. Ensure third-party services meet requirements for availability, security, compliance, performance, and cost. 13. IT Budget & Financial Management Own IT CapEx and OpEx planning, forecasting, budget tracking, and financial reporting. Manage cloud spend forecasting and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Optimize software licensing, infrastructure, telecom, support, and vendor costs without compromising service quality or security. Present technology investment proposals and cost-benefit analysis to leadership. 14. Client & Stakeholder Interaction Participate in client calls and technical discussions as required. Provide service status, operational updates, logs, evidence, and technical information to clients in coordination with relevant teams. Translate technical issues into clear business impact, resolution status, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders. Build strong relationships with business leaders, customers, vendors, and internal technology teams. Preferred Qualifications & Certifications ITIL 4 certification. ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor; CISSP or CISM is advantageous. AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications. CompTIA or other infrastructure/security certifications. TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification. PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent project-management certification. Terraform, Kubernetes, or DevOps-related certifications. Key Competencies IT Operations Leadership Infrastructure & Network Management Cloud & FinOps IT Service Management & ITIL Cybersecurity & Compliance DevOps & Automation AI/AIOps & Intelligent IT Operations Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy Vendor & Contract Management Budget & Cost Management Problem-Solving & Incident Management Customer Service & Empathy Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management Proactive Approach & Continuous Improvement Team Leadership & People Development Key Performance Indicators IT infrastructure and service availability / uptime. SLA compliance, ticket resolution time, backlog, and user satisfaction. Major incident frequency, MTTR, recurrence, and root-cause closure. Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance. Cloud spend against budget and measurable cost optimization. Software/license compliance and renewal management. Vendor/MSP performance against contractual SLAs. Audit findings, security compliance, and ISO 27001/ISMS performance. Change success rate and change-related incidents. Automation/AIOps adoption and measurable reduction in downtime and operational effort. Successful delivery of infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle activities, and technology roadmaps. Role Impact The IT Manager / IT Operations Lead is accountable for building a stable, secure, scalable, cost-effective, and business-aligned IT environment. The role combines strong operational discipline with strategic technology leadership, proactive service improvement, automation, cybersecurity governance, cloud optimization, and people leadership. The successful candidate will help transform IT into a highly reliable, measurable, customer-focused, and continuously improving technology function. 
 Required Skills IT Infrastructure cybersecurity, compliance IT service management vendor management end-user computing compliance devops

title: Treasury Manager
description:
Job Summary Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. The Role As our International Treasury Manager, you will shape and safeguard Everpures financial foundation across international entities. Partnering closely with Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Legal, Payroll and Accounts Payable, you will lead regional cash management, optimize intercompany liquidity, and scale high-impact banking infrastructure. You will leverage AI-enabled tools and automated workflows to transform cross-border financial operations into a seamless, high-performing growth engine. This role offers the unique opportunity to drive capital efficiency, mitigate risk, and directly fuel Everpures global expansion. What You'll Do Optimize Global Liquidity & Capital: Mastermind regional cash optimization strategies and intercompany funding structures to maximize capital efficiency, execute short-term investments, and minimize idle liquidity across international entities. Lead Banking Relationships & Governance: Serve as the strategic operational lead for international financial institutions, managing account lifecycles, user access controls, and periodic KYC compliance to maintain robust financial governance. Build Predictive Cash Models & Trade Finance: Develop high-accuracy liquidity forecasts and deploy AI-assisted analytics to evaluate cash variance, while managing Letters of Credit (LCs) to ensure trade compliance and support business scale. Drive Cross-Functional Excellence & Compliance: Partner with Accounting, FP&A, and Tax to execute month-end close reconciliations, support financial audits, and continuously automate treasury processes for maximum organizational speed. What You Bring Treasury Expertise: 6+ years of progressive corporate treasury experience managing complex international cash operations, intercompany liquidity, and trade finance within a global enterprise environment. Systems & Automation Mastery: Technical proficiency in ERP platforms, Treasury Management Systems (TMS), and AI-driven automation tools to modernize workflows, reporting, and forecasting accuracy. Strategic Collaboration & Execution: Outstanding analytical and cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of translating financial insights into actionable outcomes alongside Legal, Tax, and Accounting partners. Work Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: Manager Workforce Management - Dialer
description:
Position Summary The Operations Dialer Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring, and continuous optimization of outbound and inbound dialing strategies supporting first-party credit card collections. This role serves as a key liaison between Collections Operations, Workforce Management, Analytics/MIS, Compliance, Technology, clients, and third-party vendors, ensuring that account inventory, staffing, contact strategies, dialer capabilities, and business objectives are aligned to maximize collections performance while maintaining operational and regulatory compliance. The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to act as a subject matter expert in dialer strategy and collections operations, capable of representing the organization in discussions with clients, technology providers, telecommunications vendors, and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate has strong experience in first-party credit card collections, understands delinquency-stage strategies and customer segmentation, and has hands-on knowledge of the LiveVox contact center and dialer platform. --- Key Responsibilities Dialer Strategy & Management Develop and execute daily, weekly, and monthly dialing strategies for first-party credit card collection portfolios. Configure and manage LiveVox campaigns, services, skill groups, dialing modes, account segmentation, and contact strategies. Determine appropriate dialing treatments based on delinquency stage, account risk, customer behavior, historical contactability, payment likelihood, and operational priorities. Optimize predictive, automated, manual, and agent-initiated dialing strategies based on portfolio requirements. Manage account penetration and attempt strategies to balance contact rates, collections performance, customer experience, and regulatory requirements. Evaluate campaign performance throughout the day and make real-time adjustments based on staffing, account inventory, penetration, contact rates, and collection results. Coordinate campaign reruns, prioritization strategies, and reassignment of account inventory when necessary. Identify opportunities to improve contact efficiency while reducing unnecessary or low-value dialing activity. --- Collections Operations Support collection strategies across various stages of delinquency, including early-stage, mid-stage, and late-stage credit card collections. Demonstrate working knowledge of key collections concepts, including: o Days Past Due and delinquency buckets o First Payment Default o Promise to Pay o Right Party Contact o Payment conversion o Account penetration o Customer contactability o Risk segmentation o Roll rates and forward flow Partner with Operations leadership to translate portfolio and client objectives into actionable dialer strategies. Identify opportunities to increase successful customer contacts and payment conversions without unnecessarily increasing dialing volume. Evaluate account inventory, staffing, agent utilization, and strategy performance to determine whether performance gaps are driven by manpower, account quality, contactability, dialer strategy, or operational execution. Provide recommendations to Operations leaders regarding staffing allocation, campaign priorities, account treatment, and contact strategy. --- Client, Vendor & Stakeholder Management Serve as a primary point of contact and dialer subject matter expert during discussions with clients, Operations leaders, technology teams, and third-party vendors. Participate in client meetings, business reviews, strategy sessions, and performance discussions related to collections and dialer performance. Present dialer performance, trends, strategy results, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Translate complex dialer and operational data into clear business insights appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences. Work directly with clients to understand portfolio objectives, performance expectations, strategy requirements, and operational priorities. Partner with Operations stakeholders to ensure dialer strategies support frontline execution and overall collections objectives. Coordinate with vendors supporting: o Dialer and contact center technology o Telecommunications services o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Phone intelligence and contactability o Data and analytics solutions Manage vendor-related issues, enhancement requests, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation activities. Evaluate proposed vendor solutions and new technologies based on operational value, cost, expected performance improvement, and implementation requirements. Coordinate testing and validation of new vendor features or dialer capabilities prior to production deployment. Escalate vendor performance, system, or service issues when necessary and track issues through resolution. Maintain productive relationships with clients and vendors while balancing operational requirements, technical limitations, compliance considerations, and business objectives. Support client inquiries and investigations involving dialer behavior, contact strategies, campaign configurations, or performance results. --- Performance Management & Analytics Monitor and analyze dialer and collections KPIs, including: o Attempts o Live Voice / Connect Rate o Right Party Contact Rate o RPC per Attempt o Promise to Pay Rate o Payment / Collection Rate o Contact-to-Payment Conversion o Accounts Worked o Penetration Rate o Average Handle Time o Talk Time o Wrap Time o Agent Occupancy o Idle / Ready Time o Abandonment Rate o Answering Machine Detection performance Perform trend, segmentation, and comparative analysis to identify opportunities for campaign optimization. Evaluate performance by delinquency segment, risk level, account population, time of day, agent group, site, and dialing strategy. Develop or support forecasting models for dialing volume, staffing requirements, contact rates, and expected collection outcomes. Conduct root-cause analysis when operational or client performance targets are missed. Develop clear recommendations and action plans based on analytical findings. Prepare performance summaries, dashboards, and executive-level presentations for internal leadership and clients. --- LiveVox Administration & Optimization Maintain strong working knowledge of LiveVox functionality, including: o Campaign and service configuration o Dialing strategies o Skill groups o Contact lists o Agent routing o Predictive dialing o Answering Machine Detection o Call disposition and result codes o Caller ID and branded calling solutions o Campaign pacing o Contact attempt controls o Reporting and Call Detail Records Troubleshoot campaign and dialing issues in coordination with Technology teams, LiveVox support, and other external vendors. Validate dialer configuration changes before implementation. Monitor system behavior to identify potential inefficiencies, routing issues, pacing concerns, or unusual contact patterns. Coordinate with LiveVox and other technology partners on platform enhancements, defects, upgrades, and new functionality. Support User Acceptance Testing and production validation for changes affecting dialer operations. --- Compliance & Risk Management Ensure dialing strategies comply with applicable company policies and regulatory requirements governing consumer communications and collections. Partner with Compliance, Legal, clients, and technology teams when implementing changes that may affect dialing frequency, calling windows, customer consent, contact treatment, or caller identification. Maintain appropriate controls around account attempts, contact frequency, time zones, phone number treatments, and calling hours. Monitor dialing activity for potential compliance risks and escalate concerns when necessary. Support audits and investigations involving dialer activity, customer contact attempts, and campaign configurations. Ensure changes requested by Operations, clients, or vendors are evaluated for potential compliance and customer-experience impact prior to implementation. --- Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as the primary dialer strategy partner for Operations leadership. Collaborate closely with: o Collections Operations o Client Leadership o Workforce Management o Business Analytics / MIS o Quality Assurance o Compliance o Information Technology o Telecommunications teams o LiveVox and other technology vendors Coordinate staffing and dialer capacity to ensure available agents are effectively utilized. Communicate strategy changes, campaign priorities, and performance expectations to Operations teams. Facilitate discussions between technical and operational stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions are practical and aligned with business objectives. Participate in performance reviews, client business reviews, strategy meetings, project discussions, and executive presentations. Influence stakeholders across multiple departments even when direct reporting relationships do not exist. --- Continuous Improvement Conduct controlled tests of new dialing strategies, account segmentation approaches, contact frequencies, campaign schedules, and dialing technologies. Measure pre- and post-implementation results to determine strategy effectiveness. Develop business cases for new dialer capabilities, vendor solutions, or process improvements. Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting. Develop repeatable processes, dashboards, and decision frameworks for dialer management. Partner with clients and vendors to identify emerging opportunities to improve customer contactability and collection performance. Stay informed about emerging technologies affecting collections, including: o AI call screening o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Predictive analytics o Customer contact optimization o Alternative communication channels o Phone intelligence and contactability solutions --- Required Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Analytics, or related field preferred. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in credit card collections, consumer finance, or contact center operations. Experience supporting or managing first-party credit card collections strongly preferred. Hands-on experience with LiveVox or a comparable predictive dialer/contact center platform. Experience interacting directly with clients, external vendors, and Operations stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to lead strategy and performance discussions with both internal and external business partners. Strong understanding of credit card delinquency and collections processes. Experience developing or managing outbound dialing strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel. Experience interpreting large operational datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and business requirements to technical teams. --- Preferred Qualifications Experience managing multiple collection segments or delinquency buckets. Experience with SQL and Snowflake or similar data warehouse platforms. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools. Knowledge of Workforce Management concepts including staffing, occupancy, shrinkage, and interval-level capacity planning. Experience with automated reporting and campaign performance dashboards. Experience working with multiple contact center locations or outsourced operations. Experience participating in client-facing business reviews and operational strategy meetings. Experience managing technology or telecommunications vendor relationships. Knowledge of branded caller identification, STIR/SHAKEN, call authentication, and telecommunications concepts. Familiarity with predictive analytics, customer segmentation, and payment likelihood models. Experience conducting vendor evaluations, pilots, testing, and implementation projects. --- Core Competencies Strategic Thinking Translates collections and client objectives into practical account and dialing strategies. Client & Stakeholder Management Builds credibility with clients, Operations leaders, technical teams, and vendors while effectively balancing competing priorities. Vendor Management Works effectively with external technology and service providers to resolve issues, evaluate solutions, and implement improvements. Analytical Decision-Making Uses data to identify performance gaps, opportunities, and appropriate corrective actions. Operational Leadership Understands the relationship between staffing, agent behavior, account inventory, technology, and collection performance. Technical Dialer Knowledge Comfortable working directly with LiveVox configurations, campaign performance, troubleshooting, and call-level data. title: Head of Managed IT Services India
description:
Head of Managed IT Services India 
 Location: Chennai (preferred)
 Level: Director / AVP
 Employment: Full-time
 Reporting to: CEO / Managing Director
 Team: Service Delivery, Service Desk, Infrastructure/NOC and People Operations
 Working Hours: Must have daily overlap with US Eastern Time (approximately 7:30 PM11:30 PM IST)
 Travel: 2 to 3 trips to the US in the first year, plus occasional travel in India
 About the Role 
A 10-year-old health tech company is building a new managed IT Services delivery centre in India to support mid-sized companies and nonprofit organisations in the US.
We are looking for a senior leader who can build this operation from the ground up, hire the team, set up processes, launch the first client, and then manage the business as it grows.
This is not a traditional IT operations manager role. The person will be responsible for building a high-quality service organisation that US clients can trust with their day-to-day IT operations.
 Roles and Responsibilities: 
 1. Build the India IT Services Centre 
 Design the overall operating model for the India delivery centre. Decide the team structure, responsibilities, working shifts and staffing requirements. Select and implement the required IT service management and monitoring tools. Set up the required office infrastructure, security controls and business continuity arrangements. Establish relationships with local IT service partners who can provide on-site support for US clients. Create clear service processes, escalation procedures and operating guidelines. 2. Build and Lead the Team 
The initial team is expected to include:
 Service Desk Lead IT Support Engineers Level 1 and Level 2 Network / Infrastructure Engineer Microsoft 365 / Intune specialist NOC / Monitoring Engineer Cloud / Backup support Service Delivery Manager HR / Recruitment support Key responsibilities include:
 Hire the initial team. Define job descriptions and selection criteria. Create practical technical assessments and interview processes. Develop an onboarding and training programme. Ensure adequate backup resources for critical skills. Manage employee retention, especially for US-shift roles. Build a talent pipeline for future growth. 3. Launch and Transition the First Client 
The successful candidate will lead the transition of the first US client into companys managed IT services.
This includes:
 Understanding the client's existing IT environment and processes. Planning the transition from the current service provider/team to the company. Creating documentation, operating procedures and knowledge-transfer plans. Conducting testing before taking responsibility for live IT operations. Ensuring the team is ready before the client goes live. Managing major incidents and escalations during the transition. Clearly defining what Aigilx will and will not support. Important: The candidate must be comfortable managing a client transition from the beginning through to stable day-to-day operations.
 4. Manage Service Quality 
Once the centre is operational, the Head will be responsible for service quality and client satisfaction.
Key measures include:
 SLA performance meeting agreed response and resolution times. Customer satisfaction (CSAT). First-contact resolution. Ticket resolution time. Reopened tickets. Successful IT changes. Backup and recovery testing. Major incident management. The leader will regularly review performance with US clients and take corrective action where required.
 5. Manage Security and Compliance 
The candidate must ensure that employees follow strong IT security practices, including:
 Appropriate access controls. Limited administrative access. Secure handling of client information. Regular review of employee access. No use of personal devices for sensitive client information. Compliance with applicable Indian employment and data-protection requirements. Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, healthcare or HIPAA-related environments will be an advantage.
 6. Manage the Business and P&L 
This is also a business leadership role.
The candidate will:
 Own the financial performance of the India delivery unit. Manage staffing costs and utilisation. Monitor profitability. Help develop pricing for IT services. Support proposals and presentations for US clients. Work with the sales team to win new business. Grow the operation after the first client is stable. Ensure the business does not hire significantly ahead of confirmed client demand. What We Are Looking For 
 Must-Have Experience 
The ideal candidate should have:
 Experience 
 12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, IT service management or managed IT services. At least 6 years of experience managing an IT delivery operation serving US or UK clients from India. Experience working in an MSP, GCC, captive centre or similar IT services organisation. Experience building or significantly expanding an IT delivery team. Experience taking at least one client from transition/implementation to stable operations. Experience managing US-shift/night-shift teams. Experience managing service delivery, client escalations and operational performance. Technical Understanding 
The person does not necessarily need to be the strongest hands-on engineer but must understand the major IT areas being delivered.
They should have good working knowledge of:
 Microsoft 365 Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory Microsoft Intune End-user IT support Networks and firewalls VPN IT monitoring / NOC operations Backup and disaster recovery Azure or AWS IT service management / ITIL Experience with technologies such as Fortinet and Veeam is useful.
 Leadership & Business Skills 
Look for candidates who can demonstrate:
 Strong people leadership. Client management skills. Excellent spoken and written English. Experience dealing directly with US senior IT leaders. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to manage high-pressure incidents. Experience managing budgets and operational costs. Understanding of utilisation, profitability and pricing. Ability to build processes and operating discipline. Strong documentation and governance mindset. Preferred Experience 
These are good-to-have, not mandatory :
 Healthcare or nonprofit IT services experience. HIPAA-aware environments. SOC 2 or ISO 27001 implementation experience. Experience managing third-party IT vendors/specialists. P&L ownership. Existing professional network/talent pool in Chennai or Hyderabad. Education 
 Minimum: Bachelors degree in engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
 Preferred certifications: 
 ITIL Microsoft certifications Fortinet Veeam PMP/PRINCE2 is an advantage, particularly for transition/project management.
An MBA is an advantage but is not a substitute for relevant IT delivery experience.
 Ideal Candidate will be Someone who: 
 Has built and operated an IT services centre , rather than only managed an existing team. Is comfortable working with US clients and US working hours. Can communicate confidently with senior US stakeholders. Takes ownership when there is a major client issue. Builds strong processes and documentation. Can say No when a client asks for work outside the agreed scope. Understands both technology and business. Can build a team that eventually operates without depending on the Head for every decision. Is comfortable being hands-on during the initial setup but can gradually move into a leadership role. First-Year Success Measures 
The successful candidate is expected to achieve the following:
 First 30 days 
 Finalise operating model and team structure. Identify required tools. Create hiring plan. Prepare first-client transition plan. First 60 days 
 Key leadership positions hired. IT service management system ready. Shift structure established. Local service partners identified. First 90 days 
 Core team in place. Team training completed. Major incident simulation completed. Ready for first client launch. By Month 6 
 First client operating successfully. SLA and service-quality targets achieved. Customer satisfaction of approximately 4.2/5 or higher. Annualised attrition below 18%. By Month 12 
 India unit has clear P&L visibility. SOC 2 preparation underway. Second client contracted or close to signing. Delivery centre can operate effectively without depending on the Head every day. 
 
 Compensation 
Best in the Industry
US travel will be part of the role, particularly during the first year.
