 Style Union
 **Location:** 
 Mumbai / On\-site
 **Experience:** 
 4–5 years
 **Reports to:** 
 Head of Ecommerce
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 


 About Style Union
 
 Style Union is a fast fashion D2C brand with 100\+ stores across India and a growing online business. 
 



 We operate a full\-price model with no marketplace presence and no cash on delivery. Fulfilment reliability, catalogue quality and post\-purchase experience are therefore central to the performance of the business.
 


 The Role
 
 The Head of E\-commerce Operations owns the operating infrastructure of the online business: the platforms that run it, the metrics that measure it, the cost base that shapes it, and the teams that deliver catalogue and customer service.
 



 This is an ownership role covering both systems and people. The role holder is expected to manage execution teams and vendor relationships rather than carry out day\-to\-day execution personally, while remaining close enough to the detail to intervene when required.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**Systems and Platform Operations** 



* Own the e\-commerce systems stack across shipping and logistics, omnichannel order management, CRM and loyalty, and payments
* Manage breakages and escalations through to resolution with internal teams and platform vendors
* Maintain inventory sync accuracy across channels, and keep order processing, delivery, RTO and cost per shipment within agreed targets
* Identify recurring failure points and implement structural fixes rather than repeated manual correction



**Commercials and P\&L** 



* Set monthly operating goals and budgets for the function
* Optimise costs across the e\-commerce P\&L and monitor profitability at unit and channel level
* Ensure all invoices and provisions are accurately accounted for, and track spends against budget
* Report variances with root cause and corrective action



**Catalogue Oversight** 



* Manage the catalogue execution team and hold accountability for cataloguing timelines, ensuring launches go live on schedule
* Set and enforce quality standards for imagery, copy, attributes and product information
* Review output for consistency and accuracy, and drive continuous improvement in site and product presentation
* Coordinate with merchandising, creative and buying teams to align catalogue readiness with launch calendars



**Customer Service Oversight** 



* Manage the customer service team, including workflows, SLAs, escalation paths and quality standards
* Own final escalations and exceptions that cannot be resolved at the team level
* Analyse complaint and ticket data to identify recurring issues, and address them at source by working with the relevant internal teams and vendors
* Reduce repeat contact volume through better processes, clearer customer communication and upstream fixes to fulfilment, catalogue and payment issues
* Maintain reporting on resolution times, contact drivers and customer satisfaction



**Performance and Analytics** 



* Track and analyse core metrics including sales, orders, traffic, conversion, AOV, ROAS, returns, RTO and fulfilment performance
* Conduct regular performance reviews and translate findings into defined actions and owners
* Maintain reporting for the leadership team



**Bulk Orders (Unitees)** 



* Manage bulk and customisation orders end to end, covering pricing, inventory allocation, production coordination, delivery and invoicing
* Coordinate with production and warehouse teams to meet committed timelines


 Requirements
 * 4–5 years of experience in e\-commerce operations, at a D2C brand or within the e\-commerce function of a consumer company
* Experience in apparel or fashion preferred
* Working knowledge of e\-commerce and logistics platforms
* Experience managing execution teams, with the ability to set standards, review output and hold a team to timelines
* Experience owning an operating budget or P\&L line, including cost optimisation and spend tracking
* Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and experience working with dashboards and raw data
* Experience managing external vendors against defined SLAs and commercial terms
* Structured approach to problem\-solving and process design
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with evolving processes


 Preferred
 * Experience with omnichannel inventory or store\-to\-online fulfilment models
* Exposure to catalogue or content operations at scale


 What We Offer
 * Direct ownership of a core function within a growing business, close working exposure to the founding team, and scope to shape processes and systems as the online business scales.

 The Estate Operations Manager is responsible for coordinating and overseeing all non\-technical, non\-kitchen operational functions at the property.
 



 The incumbent owns the remaining estate functions — horticulture, security, billing \& admin, procurement, and staff housing — ensuring the property runs to the highest standards of order, discipline, and care.
 



 The ideal candidate is a retired or ex\-serviceman who brings military\-grade discipline, logistics capability, and people management experience to a demanding, high\-standards residential estate environment
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**1\. Horticulture \& Landscaping** 



* Oversee all gardens, lawns, plantations, water features, and outdoor spaces at Pine Drive
* Manage the horticulture team — roster, task allocation, performance



**2\. Security Management** 



* Own the end\-to\-end security protocol for Pine Drive — gate management, visitor log, CCTV oversight
* Manage the security guard roster, shift schedules, and leave planning
* Conduct regular mock drills, brief the security team on protocols
* Liaise with local authorities when required

* Manage petty cash and maintain accurate expense records

**4\. Procurement \& Vendor Management** 



* Own procurement for all estate consumables, horticulture supplies, security equipment, and staff quarters requirements

**5\. Staff Housing \& Stay Management** 



* Manage all on\-site staff quarters — allocation, maintenance, cleanliness, and discipline

title: Hotel Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager – F\&B \& Bar

**Property:** Suburban Residency  
**Location:** Kanjikuzhi, Kottayam, Kerala  
**Category:** 3\-Star Hotel  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** General Manager / Managing Partners

**About Suburban Residency**

Suburban Residency is a 3\-star hotel offering guest rooms, serviced apartment\-style accommodation, restaurants, bar and lounge operations, conference facilities and banquet venues. Its hospitality operations include KL05\-1949, Lattice Family Restaurant, Obsidian Executive Lounge, Courtyard Banquet Hall and Orchid Conference Hall.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager \| Senior F\&B Manager will lead the hotel’s day\-to\-day operations, with primary responsibility for restaurants, bar and lounge operations, banquets, food production coordination, rooms support and guest experience.

This is a hands\-on leadership position requiring strong knowledge of food and beverage operations, alcoholic\-beverage service, bar inventory, banquet execution, revenue management, cost control, statutory compliance and team development.

The successful candidate must demonstrate an owner’s mindset, maintain a visible presence during operations and take end\-to\-end responsibility for service quality, revenue, profitability, compliance and guest satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Overall Hotel Operations**

* Oversee daily operations across restaurants, bar, executive lounge, banquets, rooms and guest\-service areas.
* Conduct daily operational briefings covering room occupancy, restaurant reservations, bar business, banquet functions, staffing and VIP requirements.
* Coordinate effectively with F\&B service, bar, kitchen, front office, housekeeping, maintenance, security, purchase, stores, HR and accounts.
* Maintain a visible presence during peak dining hours, bar operations, weekends and major events.
* Ensure all operational areas are clean, properly staffed and ready for service.
* Resolve service failures, operational delays and guest complaints promptly.
* Maintain effective opening, shift\-handover and closing procedures.
* Act as the senior operational representative when the General Manager or owners are unavailable.

**2\. Restaurant and Food\-Service Operations**

* Lead the day\-to\-day operation of the hotel’s restaurants, room service and banquet food service.
* Ensure approved service standards, menus, recipes, portion controls and presentation guidelines are consistently followed.
* Work closely with the Executive Chef to maintain food quality, consistency and timely service.
* Monitor table turnaround time, order accuracy, guest waiting time and overall dining experience.
* Ensure correct POS billing and authorization of discounts, voids, cancellations, complimentary items and settlements.
* Improve restaurant covers, average guest spending, table utilization and outlet profitability.
* Develop weekday dining programs, chef\-led experiences and other initiatives that do not rely exclusively on discounts.
* Support menu engineering, pricing reviews and the introduction of new dining concepts.

**3\. Bar and Beverage Operations**

* Take complete operational responsibility for the hotel’s bar, lounge and alcoholic\-beverage service.
* Ensure the bar operates strictly within the conditions of the hotel’s applicable licences, approved timings and Kerala Excise requirements.
* Ensure alcoholic beverages are served only to legally eligible guests and in accordance with responsible\-service practices.
* Prevent service to intoxicated guests and ensure bar employees are trained to handle such situations professionally.
* Ensure compliance with declared dry days, permitted service areas, operating restrictions and all directions issued by the relevant authorities.
* Maintain strict controls over liquor receiving, storage, bottle issuance, opening stock, closing stock, transfers, sales, breakage, wastage and empty bottles.
* Ensure that liquor stock registers, purchase records, permits, invoices and statutory records are accurate and current.
* Conduct daily verification of high\-value and fast\-moving beverage items.
* Monitor standard pouring measures, cocktail recipes, yields and beverage presentation.
* Investigate bottle\-level and system\-level stock variances immediately.
* Control unauthorized consumption, complimentary beverages, substitutions, spillage and pilferage.
* Ensure every beverage served is entered and billed correctly through the approved POS system.
* Monitor beverage cost, pour cost, gross margin, product mix and average beverage spend per guest.
* Develop beverage menus, signature drinks, premium selections and food\-and\-beverage pairings with management.
* Coordinate with approved vendors while ensuring purchases are made only through legally authorized channels.
* Ensure responsible brand promotions without compromising legal requirements or the hotel’s positioning.
* Maintain appropriate security, key control and restricted access to liquor\-storage areas.
* Ensure safe guest departure procedures and coordinate assistance when a guest should not drive.
* Keep the bar, glassware, equipment, counters, storage areas and service stations clean and properly maintained.

**4\. Banquet and Event Management**

* Oversee banquet enquiries, site visits, quotations, proposals, confirmations, advance collections and event execution.
* Review event requirements, including guest count, menu, seating, bar requirements, beverage packages, décor, audiovisual equipment, parking and timelines.
* Ensure liquor service at banquet functions complies with all applicable licence conditions and management approvals.
* Prevent unauthorized liquor, outside alcohol or unapproved beverage service within hotel premises.
* Coordinate with the Chef, bar, banquet service, housekeeping, maintenance, security and accounts teams.
* Conduct pre\-event briefings and post\-event reviews for major functions.
* Ensure banquet halls are prepared, inspected and handed over on time.
* Monitor final guest counts, additional consumption, bar billing and payment collection.
* Build relationships with event planners, corporate clients, institutions and local organizations.
* Improve banquet enquiry conversion and function profitability.

**5\. Revenue and Business Development**

* Prepare restaurant, bar, banquet and departmental revenue targets in consultation with management.
* Monitor daily sales, covers, average\-per\-cover, beverage spend, banquet enquiries, conversion rates and room occupancy.
* Develop practical strategies to increase weekday restaurant and bar business.
* Build relationships with corporate companies, travel partners, event planners and local organizations.
* Create dining, lounge, entertainment and beverage\-led experiences consistent with the hotel’s brand and legal requirements.
* Review competitor offerings, market demand, beverage trends and guest preferences.
* Identify opportunities for upselling premium beverages, pairings, group dining, celebrations and events.
* Submit daily, weekly and monthly performance reports with corrective action plans.

**6\. Cost Control and Inventory Management**

* Work with the Chef, Purchase, Stores, Bar and Accounts teams to control food cost, beverage cost and operating expenses.
* Review purchase requests, approved vendor quotations, stock levels and high\-value items.
* Ensure goods are properly received, counted or weighed, quality\-checked, documented and entered into the relevant systems.
* Maintain separate and secure controls for alcoholic beverages.
* Monitor food portions, beverage pouring measures, yields, wastage, spoilage, breakage and pilferage.
* Participate in daily beverage checks and monthly physical inventory verification.
* Investigate inventory and POS variances and implement corrective measures.
* Review menu pricing, product margins, slow\-moving items and item\-wise profitability.
* Control casual labour, overtime and departmental expenses without compromising service.
* Ensure daily purchase, receiving, stock\-transfer and consumption entries are completed and posted.

**7\. Team Leadership**

* Lead and motivate restaurant, bar, banquet and operational teams.
* Prepare duty rosters based on room occupancy, expected covers, bar business and scheduled events.
* Ensure adequate staffing during peak hours while controlling manpower costs.
* Conduct training in food service, beverage knowledge, responsible alcohol service, upselling, billing, hygiene and guest handling.
* Ensure bartenders understand standard recipes, pouring measures, stock controls and closing procedures.
* Establish clear responsibilities and measurable performance expectations.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline and workplace conduct.
* Coach supervisors and team leaders to take ownership of their departments.
* Coordinate with HR on recruitment, onboarding, training, appraisals and disciplinary matters.
* Build a culture of integrity, accountability, teamwork and guest\-first service.

**8\. Guest Experience**

* Engage with restaurant, bar, banquet and resident guests to obtain feedback.
* Handle complaints calmly, fairly and promptly.
* Record recurring issues and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure dietary requirements, allergies and special requests are accurately communicated.
* Build relationships with regular guests, corporate clients and event organizers.
* Encourage satisfied guests to provide genuine feedback and online reviews.
* Ensure the bar environment remains professional, comfortable and safe for all guests.

**9\. Quality, Safety and Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI, Kerala Excise, fire\-safety, health, labour and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Display required licences and notices in the designated locations.
* Maintain operational records, inspection files, checklists and licence\-related documentation.
* Immediately report any licence, stock, billing, safety or compliance concern to the General Manager and Managing Partners.
* Cooperate professionally with authorized government inspections.
* Ensure kitchen hygiene, bar hygiene, pest control, cleaning and waste\-management standards are maintained.
* Conduct routine inspections of restaurants, bars, kitchens, banquet halls, stores and guest areas.
* Implement immediate corrective action when safety, hygiene or compliance gaps are identified.
* Ensure employees understand emergency, fire\-safety and incident\-reporting procedures.

**10\. Maintenance and Asset Protection**

* Coordinate the resolution of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, kitchen\-equipment and bar\-equipment issues.
* Ensure preventive maintenance schedules are followed.
* Protect furniture, bar equipment, kitchen equipment, crockery, cutlery, glassware, linen and other hotel assets.
* Monitor public areas, parking, elevators, stairways, washrooms and back\-of\-house areas.
* Report recurring equipment failures and capital\-replacement requirements to management.
* Ensure liquor stores, bars and cash\-handling areas remain secured.

**Daily Non\-Negotiables**

* Conduct the daily operations briefing.
* Review room occupancy, dining reservations, bar bookings, functions and VIP requirements.
* Inspect restaurants, bars, kitchens, banquet halls, guest areas and washrooms.
* Verify bar opening stock, closing stock, sales, breakage and variances.
* Confirm compliance with permitted service timings and applicable restrictions.
* Review staffing and adjust deployment based on expected business.
* Monitor food quality, beverage quality, service speed and guest feedback.
* Verify major discounts, voids, complimentary items and billing exceptions.
* Review purchases, stock availability, wastage and critical shortages.
* Ensure daily inventory, purchase and stock\-transfer entries are completed and posted.
* Follow up on maintenance, safety, hygiene and compliance issues until closure.
* Submit an accurate end\-of\-day operations and performance report.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be evaluated against:

* Total F\&B and banquet revenue
* Restaurant and bar sales achievement
* Weekday and weekend business growth
* Restaurant covers and average\-per\-cover
* Average beverage spend per guest
* Beverage mix and premium\-product sales
* Banquet enquiry conversion rate
* Food\-cost and beverage\-cost percentages
* Liquor stock accuracy and variance
* Wastage, spillage, spoilage and breakage
* POS and physical\-stock reconciliation
* Guest satisfaction and complaint\-resolution time
* Service speed and order accuracy
* Staff productivity, attendance and retention
* Hygiene, safety and statutory\-compliance results
* Timeliness and accuracy of operational reporting
* Departmental profitability

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Food and Beverage Management or a related discipline.
* Additional certification in bar management, beverage service, food safety, cost control or hotel operations will be an advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of restaurant POS, hotel PMS, inventory systems and Microsoft Office.
* Working knowledge of liquor inventory, beverage costing, responsible alcohol service and applicable Kerala hospitality requirements.

**Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in hotel, restaurant and bar operations.
* At least 3 years in an Operations Manager, Senior F\&B Manager, F\&B Manager or comparable leadership position.
* Experience managing multiple restaurants, a licensed bar and banquet operations is essential.
* Experience in a 3\-star or higher\-category hotel will be preferred.
* Proven experience in revenue generation, liquor controls, inventory management, cost reduction and team leadership is required.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong operational ownership and hands\-on leadership
* Restaurant, bar and banquet management expertise
* Sound alcoholic\-beverage and bar\-service knowledge
* Beverage costing and liquor\-inventory control
* Commercial and financial awareness
* Revenue generation and business development
* Menu engineering and product\-mix management
* Banquet planning and event execution
* Guest complaint handling and service recovery
* Vendor coordination and negotiation
* Team development and performance management
* Sound decision\-making under pressure
* Attention to detail and consistent follow\-through
* High personal integrity
* Clear written and verbal communication

**Language Requirements**

* Fluency in Malayalam and English is required.
* Working knowledge of Hindi will be an advantage.

**Personal Attributes**

The ideal candidate must be:

* Responsible, disciplined and dependable
* Visible and actively involved in operations
* Guest\-focused and service\-oriented
* Commercially aware and cost\-conscious
* Honest and highly reliable in handling liquor stocks and revenue
* Calm and decisive during busy operations
* Willing to take ownership beyond formal departmental boundaries
* Capable of working closely with owners and department heads
* Focused on solutions, timely execution and measurable results

**Working Conditions**

* This is a hands\-on operational leadership position.
* The employee must be available during peak restaurant and bar periods, weekends, holidays and major banquet functions.
* Working hours and weekly off will be scheduled according to operational requirements.
* The position requires regular movement across restaurants, bar, banquet halls, rooms, kitchens, stores and public areas.

**Application Requirements**

Interested candidates should submit an updated résumé stating:

* Current position and employer
* Restaurant, bar and banquet experience
* Current salary
* Expected salary
* Notice period
* Earliest joining date
* Professional references

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager – Vigoure MMA \& Fitness** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Department:** 
 Operations
 



**Reports To:** 
 Management / Director
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**About Vigoure** 




 Vigoure MMA \& Fitness is a premium martial arts and fitness brand focused on delivering high\-quality training through professional coaching, structured programs, and a strong customer experience.
 



 We are looking for a
 **hands\-on Operations Manager** 
 who can take ownership of day\-to\-day centre operations, manage our coaching team, resolve operational issues, and ensure that every Vigoure centre functions smoothly and consistently.
 



**Role Overview** 




 The Operations Manager will primarily be responsible for
 **managing coaches, handling coach\-related issues, ensuring smooth centre operations, and resolving day\-to\-day operational problems.** 




 This role requires someone who is highly accountable, proactive, people\-oriented, and capable of taking quick decisions when issues arise.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working directly with coaches, centre teams, customers, and management, while ensuring that operational standards are consistently maintained across all centres.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Coach Management** 



* Manage and coordinate the coaching team across Vigoure centres.
* Ensure coaches report on time and follow assigned schedules and responsibilities.
* Monitor coach attendance, punctuality, grooming, behaviour, and professionalism.
* Handle coach grievances, conflicts, performance issues, and operational concerns.
* Ensure proper coach allocation and availability for all classes.
* Arrange replacements for coaches in case of leave, absence, or emergencies.
* Monitor coach workload and ensure effective utilization of coaching resources.
* Conduct regular check\-ins with coaches to understand and resolve issues.
* Escalate serious performance, behavioural, or disciplinary issues to management.
* Ensure coaches follow Vigoure’s SOPs, training standards, and customer\-service expectations.



**2\. Centre Operations** 



* Take overall responsibility for the smooth day\-to\-day functioning of assigned Vigoure centres.
* Ensure centres are ready and operational before the first class of the day.
* Monitor cleanliness, hygiene, equipment, ambience, music, lighting, and overall centre standards.
* Identify operational gaps and ensure they are resolved quickly.
* Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, vendors, and other support staff.
* Ensure equipment and facilities are maintained properly.
* Monitor centre requirements and raise purchase/maintenance requests when necessary.
* Ensure all centre SOPs and operational processes are followed consistently.



**3\. Issue Handling \& Problem Resolution** 



* Act as the first point of escalation for day\-to\-day operational issues.
* Quickly identify problems and take ownership until they are completely resolved.
* Handle issues involving coaches, customers, centre staff, schedules, equipment, facilities, and vendors.
* Coordinate between departments whenever an issue requires cross\-functional resolution.
* Ensure issues are not simply reported but actually closed within the expected timeline.
* Maintain an issue tracker and regularly follow up on pending issues.
* Escalate critical issues to management with the relevant facts and recommended solutions.



**4\. Customer Experience** 



* Ensure customers receive a consistent and professional experience across centres.
* Monitor recurring customer complaints and identify their root causes.
* Coordinate with the sales/customer service teams when operational intervention is required.
* Handle escalated customer issues related to coaching, classes, centre operations, or service quality.
* Ensure corrective action is taken to prevent recurring complaints.



**5\. Discipline \& SOP Compliance** 



* Ensure coaches and centre teams follow company policies and SOPs.
* Monitor adherence to schedules, attendance, reporting, dress code, conduct, and operational procedures.
* Identify negligence, repeated violations, or misconduct and report them to management.
* Ensure all operational checklists and reports are completed accurately and on time.
* Conduct regular centre audits and identify areas requiring improvement.



**6\. Team Coordination** 



* Coordinate with HR regarding coach hiring requirements, onboarding, attendance, leave, and disciplinary matters.
* Coordinate with Sales and CRM teams to ensure operational commitments made to customers are fulfilled.
* Coordinate with Marketing and other departments whenever centre\-level execution is required.
* Work closely with management to implement new processes, systems, and operational initiatives.



**7\. Reporting \& Accountability** 




 The Operations Manager will be responsible for maintaining regular reports covering:
 


* Coach attendance and punctuality
* Coach availability and replacements
* Centre operational issues
* Customer complaints and resolutions
* Maintenance and facility issues
* Equipment requirements
* SOP compliance
* Pending operational issues
* Major incidents and escalations
* Centre\-wise operational performance



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




 The performance of the Operations Manager will primarily be measured on:
 


* **Coach attendance and punctuality**
* **Coach retention and discipline**
* **Speed of resolving operational issues**
* **Closure rate of pending issues**
* **Centre readiness and operational standards**
* **Reduction in recurring operational problems**
* **Customer complaints related to operations/coaches**
* **SOP compliance across centres**
* **Effective coach utilization and scheduling**
* **Overall smooth functioning of centres**



**Candidate Profile** 




**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 3–6 years of experience in operations, fitness, sports, hospitality, gyms, academies, or a similar people\-intensive business.
* Strong people\-management and communication skills.
* Experience managing frontline teams is highly preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.
* Ability to handle conflicts and difficult conversations professionally.
* Highly organized with strong follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working across multiple locations.
* Strong ownership mentality — should not wait for management to solve routine operational problems.
* Good working knowledge of Google Sheets / Excel and basic reporting.



**Preferred** 



* Experience in a fitness centre, gym, martial arts academy, sports academy, hospitality, or multi\-location service business.
* Experience managing coaches, trainers, instructors, or frontline staff.
* Understanding of class\-based businesses and customer experience.
* Willingness to travel between Vigoure centres as required.



**Personal Attributes We Are Looking For** 




 The right candidate should be:
 


* **Highly accountable**
* **Proactive rather than reactive**
* **Strong at handling people**
* **Firm but fair**
* **Excellent at follow\-ups**
* **Solution\-oriented**
* **Calm under pressure**
* **Detail\-oriented**
* **Good at identifying problems before they become major issues**
* **Comfortable taking ownership without constant supervision**



**Most Important Requirement** 




**We are looking for someone who takes ownership.** 




 If a coach doesn’t show up, a centre has an operational problem, a customer has an unresolved issue, equipment is not working, or a team member is not following SOPs, the Operations Manager should
 **identify the issue, coordinate the solution, follow it through, and ensure closure** 
 — rather than simply informing management that there is a problem.

title: MANAGER FASTENERS
description:
Position:
 **Fasteners Manager** 




 Location: Bengaluru, India
 



 Function: Fastener Manufacturing \& Quality
 



 Reports to: Engineering Manager
 



  





**Role Summary** 




  





 PennAero is recruiting a Fasteners Manager for its Bengaluru operations to own the manufacturing, quality, and delivery performance of aerospace fastener product lines (bolts, rivets, lockbolts, blind fasteners, and related hardware manufactured to MS, NAS, AN, and customer\-proprietary specifications). The role owns the fastener value stream from raw\-material release through finishing, special processing, and final inspection, and is directly accountable for AS9100/Nadcap\-compliant quality outcomes and on\-time delivery. This is a people\-leadership role: the incumbent will lead a team of 4\-5 process/quality engineers or shift supervisors and serve as the site's technical authority on fastener manufacturing.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and develop a team of 4\-5 fastener process engineers, quality engineers, or shift supervisors, including workload planning, coaching, and performance management.
* Own production planning and throughput for fastener manufacturing cells (heading/forming, thread rolling, heat treatment, plating/coating, and finishing), meeting rate, cost, and on\-time\-delivery targets.
* Ensure fastener product conformance to applicable specifications (NAS, MS, AN, BAC, customer\-proprietary) and to AS9100/Nadcap special\-process requirements (heat treat, plating, non\-destructive testing).
* Maintain full lot traceability from raw material melt/heat through finished part, supporting customer and regulatory audits and AS6174 counterfeit\-parts prevention requirements.
* Drive root\-cause investigation and corrective/preventive action for fastener non\-conformances, scrap, and customer returns; own escalation of critical quality issues.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance on first\-article inspection, PPAP/FAI documentation, SPC data, and Nadcap audit readiness for special processes.
* Manage supplier and subcontractor relationships for outsourced special processes (plating, heat treat, NDT) where applicable, including qualification and performance monitoring.
* Lead continuous\-improvement and cost\-reduction initiatives across the fastener line (cycle time, tool/die life, yield, rework reduction).
* Support new part introduction and program ramp activities, including process qualification for new fastener part numbers and materials (titanium, Inconel/A286, corrosion\-resistant steel, aluminum).
* Report fastener line KPIs (OTD, first\-pass yield, scrap, audit findings) to plant leadership and support monthly operating reviews.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Experience** 



* Minimum 7 to 10 years of progressive experience in fastener or precision\-hardware manufacturing, with meaningful exposure to aerospace\-grade fasteners (bolts, rivets, lockbolts, or blind fasteners).
* At least 3\-5 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity, having directly led a team (this role: 4\-5 direct reports).
* Hands\-on exposure to fastener\-specific manufacturing processes: cold heading/forming, thread rolling, heat treatment, and plating/coating.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and Nadcap requirements as applied to special processes and fastener manufacturing.



**Education \& Technical Skills** 



* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical, Metallurgical, Production, or a related engineering discipline.
* Familiarity with aerospace fastener specifications (NAS, MS, AN, BAC) and material standards for titanium, nickel alloys, CRES, and aluminum fasteners.
* Understanding of GD\&T, SPC/statistical methods, and root\-cause/corrective\-action tools (8D, fishbone, 5\-why).
* Exposure to ERP/MES systems for production scheduling and traceability.








**What PennAero Offers** 




  





 PennAero is a house\-of\-brands aerospace manufacturing platform (Allfast, Monogram, Briles, Mac Fasteners, TFI, Martinic, RSA, Weldmac, TAG, PMI, American Drilling, LubeCo, Structures) supplying structural fasteners, precision components, and assemblies to Boeing, Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Pratt \& Whitney, Safran, and other major OEMs. This role sits close to the core of PennAero's fastener business and offers direct visibility into how the group's fastener brands (Allfast, Monogram, Mac Fasteners) run production at scale.

title: Credit Risk Operations Team Lead
description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The credit risk operations team plays a critical role in ensuring a healthy financial ecosystem for businesses around the world. This team will directly impact the company's bottom line and growth capabilities by supporting new and emerging businesses. The Credit Operations team is responsible for conducting credit risk assessments, underwriting small and mid\-size users, and proposing mitigation strategies that enable Stripe to take smart risks for our users.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 In this role, you will manage and develop a group of Credit Risk Operations Associates that are focused on commercial credit underwriting and risk mitigation. The Credit Risk Operations Team Lead will cultivate the engagement of their team members while guiding them to be the best they can be, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and advocacy within the organization. This means helping to set team goals, and using metrics to efficiently measure and guide team performance in pursuit of those goals. To be a fit, you will have a strong operations mindset, possess a deep understanding of commercial credit risk, be able to move quickly, and be passionate about delivering an incredible user experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage, coach, and develop a new team of in\-office Credit Risk Operations Associates
* Execute on commercial credit underwriting frameworks that allow your team to evaluate business models and financial statements of successful venture\-backed startups to established entities
* Guide your team to identify commercial credit risk and propose risk mitigation strategies
* Drive strong operational delivery and process improvement helping to maintain credit risk tolerance and balance credit loss and customer experience
* Build a great culture and ensure team members are happy, effective, and growing in their career
* Set clear goals and direction, and provide regular feedback on team members’ performance
* Be data\-driven in your analysis of performance, and in your decision making
* Transmit and foster our values, serving as a beacon of Stripe’s user\-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment
* Manage operational performance to deliver KPIs
* Manage capacity and scheduling to ensure adequate coverage
* Help resolve roadblocks and issues as they arise
* Act as a point of escalation for complex credit underwriting reviews


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* A minimum of 6\+ years of experience with commercial credit underwriting, financial statement analysis, risk modeling and cash flow forecasting
* The ability to transform business and financial data into a cohesive narrative that outlines potential credit risks and presents dynamic mitigation strategies
* At least 2\+ years of direct people management experience
* Leadership skills, strong analytical abilities, and excellent communication skills are essential
* An ability to partner effectively with internal globally distributed stakeholders
* Strong operational background including new process launches and service delivery
* Skill and credibility doing the core work of a user facing team with a high bar for quality, and a willingness to lead by example
* Passion for process improvement and innovation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree/diploma in Finance or Accounting, or a related field
* Experience in payments, e\-commerce, or fintech mitigating credit risk
* Experience in building and scaling new teams


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

title: Client Implementation & Service - Assistant Manager

* Monitor daily reconciliations and ensure alignment with custodian records
* Track and monitor end\-to\-end processes related to Investment Management Agreements and Transition Analysis

* Act as a subject matter expert across Tax Operations processes, ensuring consistent application of best practices
* Analyze existing workflows to identify inefficiencies and implement scalable process improvements
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, focusing on automation, accuracy, and operational efficiency
* Partner with Technology, Portfolio Management, and Client Service teams to support strategic initiatives and business growth
* Lead or contribute to projects related to process optimization, system enhancements, and operational risk mitigation
* Develop a forward\-looking, strategic perspective on operations to support platform evolution and scalability



  
 



**What You’ll Bring** 



* Undergraduate degree
* 7\-10 years of experience in a financial services institution (prior leadership or mentorship experience preferred)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Demonstrated ability to think strategically and improve processes
* Proficiency in Excel and Outlook
* Salesforce experience a plus
* Python or automation experience a plus

 Location: Bangalore

 Salary: ₹4–5 Lakhs Per Annum
 



 Incentives: Opportunity to earn up to ₹30,000 per month as performance incentives
 



 Experience: 5\-7 Years
 



  





 About the Company
 



 Maiz Mexican Kitchen is a fast\-growing QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) brand focused on delivering exceptional food, operational excellence, and outstanding guest experiences. With aggressive expansion plans across multiple cities, we are building strong leaders and scalable systems to drive the next phase of growth.
 



  





 Job Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced and performance\-driven Restaurant General Manager to lead one of our high\-volume restaurants in Bangalore with monthly sales of ₹60 Lakhs to 70 Lakhs
 



 The ideal candidate must have strong QSR operational experience and should have worked with reputed brands such as KFC, Burger King, McDonald’s, or Domino’s. The candidate should possess strong leadership capabilities, operational expertise, team management skills, and the ability to drive sales, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
 



 The candidate must be based in Bangalore.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Operational Excellence
 



 Manage end\-to\-end restaurant operations while ensuring adherence to company SOPs, food safety standards, guest service benchmarks, and operational efficiency.
 



 Team Leadership \& Development
 



 Lead, coach, and develop Shift Managers and restaurant teams to build a high\-performance culture. Ensure proper training, motivation, discipline, and team engagement at the store level.
 



 Sales \& Profitability
 



 Drive store sales and profitability through effective labour management, inventory control, food cost management, and operational planning.
 



 Guest Experience
 



 Ensure exceptional customer service standards are maintained consistently. Handle guest concerns professionally and work towards improving overall guest satisfaction scores.
 



 Compliance \& Food Safety
 



 Ensure compliance with all food safety, hygiene, audit, and statutory requirements. Maintain cleanliness, safety, and brand standards across all operational areas.
 



 Inventory \& Cost Control
 



 Monitor inventory, wastage, variance, and ordering processes to maintain optimum stock levels and minimize losses.
 



 Reporting \& Performance Tracking
 



 Track and analyse store KPIs including sales, labour cost, food cost, customer feedback, productivity, and operational performance.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 Education
 



 Graduate preferred. Relevant operational experience in QSR industry will also be considered.
 



 Experience
 



 5–7 years of experience in the QSR industry with at least 2–3 years in a Restaurant General Manager or equivalent leadership role.
 



 Candidates with prior experience in KFC, Burger King, McDonald’s, or Domino’s will be preferred.
 



  





 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Strong leadership and team management skills
* Excellent operational and people management abilities
* Strong understanding of QSR operations and customer service
* Experience in handling high\-volume restaurants
* Knowledge of inventory management, labour control, and cost management
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment



  





 Other Requirements
 


* Willingness to work flexible shifts, weekends, and holidays
* Ability to handle pressure in high\-sales environments
* Strong ownership mindset and operational discipline



  





 Why Join Maiz Mexican Kitchen?
 


* Competitive salary and strong earning potential
* Performance\-based monthly incentives
* Fast\-growing and dynamic work culture
* Opportunity to lead a high\-volume flagship operation
* Career growth within an expanding QSR brand

title: Tooling Manager
description:
**Tooling Manager** 




  





***Location: Bengaluru, India***




 Function: Manufacturing Engineering
 



 Reports to: Engineering Manager
 



  





**Role Summary** 




  





 PennAero is recruiting a Tooling Manager for its Bengaluru operations to own tooling, fixtures, and gauging across aerospace machining, forming, and assembly processes. The role carries end\-to\-end accountability for tool design support, tool room operations, preventive maintenance and calibration, and continuous\-improvement of tooling that keeps production lines running to takt while holding aerospace tolerance and traceability requirements.
 



  





 This is a people\-leadership role: the incumbent will build and run a team of 4\-5 tool room engineers/technicians and act as the technical escalation point for tooling issues on the shop floor.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and develop a team of 4\-5 tooling engineers, toolmakers, and technicians, including workload planning, skills development, and performance management.
* Own the design review, fabrication, qualification, and lifecycle management of production tooling, jigs, fixtures, and gauges used in machining, forming, drilling, and assembly of aerospace components.
* Establish and run preventive maintenance, calibration, and re\-certification schedules for all tooling and gauging, maintaining full traceability records to satisfy AS9100 and customer/OEM audits.
* Resolve tooling deviations and non\-conformances through root\-cause analysis, corrective/preventive action, and cross\-functional coordination with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Production.
* Manage the tool room's inventory, spares, and tooling procurement, including supplier qualification and cost/lead\-time negotiation for outsourced tooling fabrication.
* Drive tooling standardization, cost\-reduction, and lean initiatives (reduced changeover time, tool life improvement, low\-cost automation) in support of production rate and margin targets.
* Review engineering drawings, GD\&T call\-outs, and process routings to specify or modify tooling for new part introductions and design changes.
* Own tooling\-related documentation: work instructions, control plans, calibration certificates, and first\-article inspection support for new/modified tooling.
* Ensure the tool room complies with EHS standards and supports a safe, 5S\-organized work environment.
* Report tooling KPIs (availability, calibration compliance, tool life, cost per part) to plant leadership and support monthly operating reviews.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in tooling/tool room engineering or management within a precision manufacturing environment; aerospace, defense, or automotive Tier 1 experience strongly preferred.
* At least 3\-5 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity, having directly led a team (this role: 4\-5 direct reports).
* Demonstrated experience with fixture/jig design, press tooling, machining fixtures, gauge design, and tool calibration programs.
* Working knowledge of AS9100/Nadcap quality system requirements and aerospace traceability expectations.



  





**Education \& Technical Skills** 




  




* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Tool \& Die, or a related engineering discipline (ME/M.Tech is an advantage).
* Proficiency in CAD/CAM tools (CATIA, Unigraphics/NX, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD) and strong GD\&T interpretation skills.
* Familiarity with CNC machining, sheet metal forming, drilling/fastening processes, and associated tooling.
* Strong analytical, root\-cause problem\-solving, and project management capability.








**What PennAero Offers** 




  





 PennAero is a house\-of\-brands aerospace manufacturing platform (Allfast, Monogram, Briles, Mac Fasteners, TFI, Martinic, RSA, Weldmac, TAG, PMI, American Drilling, LubeCo, Structures) supplying structural fasteners, precision components, and assemblies to Boeing, Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Pratt \& Whitney, Safran, and other major OEMs. Joining the Bengaluru team offers the opportunity to build tooling capability supporting new program ramps, with direct visibility to plant leadership.

title: General Manager & Head - Medical Services
description:
* Clinical Governance \& Integration
* Provide unified leadership across all medical and allied clinical services.
* Ensure multidisciplinary, pathway\-based care delivery across specialties.
* Drive standardisation of clinical practices with cross\-clinical judgment.
* Multidisciplinary Decision\-Making \& Tumor Boards
* Establish governance frameworks for tumour boards and other MDT forums.
* Ensure structured case discussions, documented decisions, and follow\-through.
* Monitor clinical adherence to MDT recommendations and impact on outcomes.
* Clinical Committees Leadership
* Provide medical leadership and oversight to key committees, including:
* Mortality \& Morbidity (M\&M)
* Hospital Infection Control (HIC)
* Operation Theatre Committee
* Antimicrobial Stewardship Program (AMSP)
* Pharmacy \& Therapeutics Committee (PTC)
* Credential \& Privilege (C\&P) Committee
* Transfusion Committee
* Cardio\-Radiological \& Clinico\-Pathological Meetings
* Ensure decisions translate into practice change, not just minutes.
* Lead corrective actions based on infection trends, ICU performance, and adverse events.
* Ensure committee deliberations translate into policy, practice change, and measurable improvement.
* Clinical Outcomes \& Quality Performance
* Define, track, and review clinical outcome metrics across oncology and allied specialties:
* Survival \& response indicators (where applicable)
* HAI rates, antimicrobial usage patterns, resistance trends
* ICU outcomes (mortality, LOS, ventilator\-associated events)
* Complication and toxicity trends
* Infection, transfusion, and medication outcomes
* Lead corrective actions and improvement plans based on outcomes data.
* Clinical Pharmacology Oversight
* Ensure integration of Clinical Pharmacology into treatment planning.
* Support rational drug use, protocol adherence, dose optimization, and safety.
* Coordinate with PTC for formulary decisions and protocol updates.
* Family Meetings \& Care Communication
* Establish structured Family Meeting frameworks for complex oncology cases.
* Ensure coordinated participation of treating teams, nursing, psycho\-oncology, and support services.
* Provide medical leadership to the Antimicrobial Stewardship Program (AMSP).
* Guide formulary control and antimicrobial restriction policies.
* Uphold transparency, empathy, and ethical communication in decision\-making.
* Visiting Consultant \& Full\-time Faculty Management
* Oversee onboarding, credentialing, privileging, and performance review of:
* Visiting Consultants
* Full\-time and empanelled doctors
* Outsourced full\-time consultants
* Define scope of practice, coverage models, and accountability mechanisms.
* Address professional conduct, performance gaps, and clinical conflicts.
* Operation Theatre (OT) Clinical Governance
* Provide clinical governance for Operation Theatre services, including:
* OT utilization, scheduling, and case prioritization
* Surgical safety practices and checklist compliance
* Infection prevention and asepsis in OT
* Address surgeon\-related workflow conflicts and ensure optimal use of OT resources
* Coordinate with anesthesia, nursing, CSSD, and biomedical teams
* ICU \& Critical Care Oversight
* Provide medical leadership for ICU and critical care services.
* Ensure:
* Appropriate admission, triage, and escalation protocols
* Multidisciplinary ICU rounds and care planning
* Alignment of ICU practices with oncology and transplant needs
* Review ICU outcomes, mortality trends, and critical incidents.
* Medical \& Paramedical Recruitment
* Actively participate in recruitment of:
* Doctors (all specialties)
* Paramedical and allied clinical professionals
* Define role expectations, skill requirements, and onboarding standards.
* Support retention and professional growth strategies.
* Biomedical Engineering \& Clinical Equipment Oversight
* Lead and own the clinical evaluation and justification of all medical Capex, including:
* Oncology equipment (LINACs, brachytherapy, imaging, infusion systems, BMT infrastructure)
* Diagnostic platforms (Radiology, Laboratory, Pathology, Blood Centre)
* ICU, OT, dialysis, transplant, and specialty clinical equipment
* Work closely with Biomedical Engineering, Finance, Procurement, and Leadership to:
* Define clinical specifications
* Validate technology suitability for oncology and tertiary care
* Ensure alignment with service line strategy and patient outcomes
* Participate in annual and long\-term Capex planning for:
* New service lines
* Capacity expansion
* Technology refresh cycles
* Clinical urgency
* Oncology program growth


**Qualifications**
 MBBS with MHA or MBA in Hospital Management
   

  

 Must have skills
   

  

* Strong Clinical Governance \& Medical Leadership skills
* Strong knowledge of Hospital Quality, Patient Safety \& Clinical Outcomes
* Experience in ICU, OT and Critical Care clinical oversight
* Strong Clinical Risk Management and Incident Review capabilities
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and conflict\-resolution skills


 Good to have skills
   

  

* Knowledge of NABH, JCI and other healthcare accreditation standards
* Experience in hospital policy development and clinical protocol standardization
* Strong presentation, documentation and report\-writing skills

title: IT Infrastructure Process Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, which provides a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. It has been producing several immunoassays based on different technologies since 25 years, and keeps growing its catalogue portfolio with novel assays and applications to cover the food industry necessities of analysing chemical contaminants in ingredients and finished products. Applications need to be fast, easy, reliable and possibly safe for the personnel involved in routine implementation of analysis.  Strong problem\-solving and ready to take owner

description:
We are looking for a strategic, consumer\-led, and commercially strong Merchandiser to lead the Women’s Tops category and Digital business across Men’s \& Women’s for the India market. This role will shape category strategy, build seasonal assortments, define product and price architecture, and drive business performance across channels. Working closely with Design, Product Development, Planning, Sourcing, Marketing, VM, and Retail, you will translate consumer insights, fashion trends, and business opportunities into compelling, differentiated, and profitable assortments. With a strong focus on premiumization, innovation, digital relevance, and productivity, this role offers an opportunity to shape future growth for the category and the digital business.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Define the strategic direction, consumer proposition, and growth agenda for Women’s Tops and Digital across Men’s \& Women’s.
* Own seasonal assortment planning and line architecture, balancing core, seasonal fashion, premium, innovation, and commercial volume drivers across channels, consumers, price tiers, and key doors.
* Translate consumer insights, fashion trends, fit preferences, fabric trends, and occasion needs into relevant and commercially successful product assortments.
* Partner with Design and Product teams to develop differentiated product propositions through fabrication, silhouette, fit, wash, branding, finish, and construction.
* Build and scale strategic platforms including premiumization, linen, technology\-led products, India\-specific propositions, and emerging growth opportunities.
* Own the Digital assortment strategy across Men’s \& Women’s, developing a differentiated product and price mix to drive digital growth, productivity, newness, and full\-price realization.
* Own pricing architecture and margin targets, using business analytics to drive revenue, margin, sell\-through, inventory productivity, and profitability.
* Monitor business performance and drive timely in\-season actions including buy adjustments, replenishment, markdowns, exit strategies, and inventory optimization.
* Develop a strong understanding of the Indian fashion market and digital consumer, using competitor, pricing, product, and trend insights to identify opportunities and strengthen category relevance.
* Lead seasonal Go\-To\-Market execution from concept to launch, ensuring strong alignment across Design, Product Development, Planning, Sourcing, Marketing, VM, and Retail.
* Present category strategies, seasonal direction, business performance, and key actions to senior leadership, influencing decisions through strong commercial and consumer insights.
* Develop the Assistant Merchandising team by building strong commercial, consumer, analytical, and product capabilities while fostering ownership, accountability, and collaboration.


**About You**
* Experience \& Background: 9–12 years of experience in Buying, Merchandising, Category Management, or related commercial roles within fashion, apparel, or lifestyle retail.
* Category \& Merchandising Expertise: Strong experience in end\-to\-end seasonal merchandising, assortment planning, line architecture, and category strategy.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to drive revenue, margin, sell\-through, full\-price realization, inventory productivity, and overall category profitability.
* Consumer \& Fashion Orientation: Strong understanding of consumer behavior, fashion trends, product propositions, and market dynamics, particularly within women’s apparel.
* Digital \& Omnichannel Understanding: Experience across multiple retail channels including EBO, LFS, MBO, and Digital/E\-commerce, with a strong understanding of digital consumer behavior and online merchandising.
* Product \& Innovation Mindset: Strong understanding of product development and the ability to identify and build new platforms, premium propositions, and differentiated product opportunities.
* Analytical \& Strategic Thinking: Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business and consumer data into clear strategic actions.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to work collaboratively with Design, Product Development, Planning, Sourcing, Marketing, VM, and Retail teams.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication, influencing, and presentation skills with the confidence to engage and influence senior leadership.
* People Leadership: Experience developing teams and creating a culture of ownership, accountability, fact\-based decision\-making, and collaboration.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Fashion, Business, Retail, Buying, Merchandising, or a related field. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification would be an advantage.

description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .


**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.  



  

**Purpose and Scope:**  

  

This position executes FP\&A operations for its FBP and business customers. This role heavily collaborates with business operations members, the COE, Systems and Reporting teams to deliver high quality, on time services.


It provides high quality reporting results effectively for all FBPs with insights and recommended actions from FBPs. Meanwhile, it provides systematic variance analysis \& additional fundamental analysis support to FBPs \& Business, which are relevant to the sustainability of the operation.


It operates the execution of the financial planning process, supporting the business to input their planning information, coordinating with the FBPs to review plans with business leaders and make necessary adjustments to the plan based on feedback.


It supports accounting operations collaborating with GBS e.g., accruals entries etc to ensure monthly/quarterly/yearly closing is complying with financial and fiscal requirements, in line with relevant control frameworks.


**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**  

  

**Month\-end Close:**

* Collaborate with GBS to ensure accurate reporting of management accounts, timely and in compliance with corporate policies and statutory requirements.
* In collaboration with the COE systems team validate data in financial systems for accuracy and compliance.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs to analyse variances between actual results and budget/forecasts, providing insights and recommendations, which includes detailed review and analysis of OPEX and headcounts.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs through conducting monthly and ad\-hoc financial analyses – provide key highlights on costs, headcounts tracking and cost efficiency analysis.
Prepare financial reports and dashboards for management.  
* 

  

**Forecasting \& Budgeting:**

* Responsible for the development of various forecasting \& budgeting templates / consolidation templates and management reporting.
* Support the implementation and roll out of financial reporting tool and system, as \& when applicable.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs in the development of annual budget, quarter forecasting as well as mid\-term plan.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs in analysing financial trends and performance metrics to allow FBPs to provide actionable insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Assist business and FBPs in the creation of various financial scenarios model to support the development of business case to support strategic decision\-making and risk management.
* Work closely with COE system team to ensure data accuracy and integrity in the financial systems.

**Compliance:**

* Embed Compliance Culture, ensuring Integrity in Action is actively applied in all initiatives, and proactively address non\-compliance.
* Ensure a culture of Ethics and Compliance; lead by example and incorporate cross\-cultural perspectives when addressing challenging situations.

**Others:**

• Support Coordination with relevant stakeholders to validate financial calendar and required system adjustments before official release.


  
**Required Qualifications:**

* BS/BA in Finance / Accounting / Economics or related discipline
* MBA and / or CPA / CIMA and / or equivalent certificates (or qualified by experience)
* English conversational and business English
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Profound work experience in planning and budgeting in Pharma industry
* Solid working knowledge of accounting and internal control standards
* Experience with ERP systems
* Experience with planning tools
* Strong Microsoft word, PowerPoint skills and Advanced Excel
* Solid experience in matrix environment
* Solid organization, project, and change management skills
* Demonstrated initiative and creativity in pioneering new approaches and ways of working.
* Experience and demonstrated aptitude leveraging enterprise\-grade finance data / reporting systems.
* Solid communication skills and ability to influence with various management levels.
* Profound financial analysis skills, coupled with ability to communicate meaning from data.
Profound teamwork and partner behaviours  
* 

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility  



**What awaits you at Astellas?**  



* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like\-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real\-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**  

**Values:** Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.


**Behaviors:** We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
Rotork is the market\-leading global flow control and instrumentation company, helping our customers manage the flow or liquids, gases and powders across many industries worldwide.
   

  

 Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Job:**
 Logistics Engineering is the process of:
   

  

* Data purification \& analysis of the Plan for Every Part (PFEP)
* Warehouse storage design \& Assembly Point\-of\-Use (POU) design
* Machinery \& equipment design and procurement
* Workforce \& equipment planning
* Logistics process design
* Inventory transfer \& rearrangement planning
* Integration of supply chain requirements into warehouse design.


 What is the Warehouse Strategy
   

  

* To deliver world class warehouse processes and an empowered culture using Rotork core principles. With global governance and visual reporting
* To create standardised processes in all Rotork plant’s and selling entities
* Improve efficiency and create global reporting for all plants and selling entities where applicable
* Strategy is broken down into 6 modules
+ Warehouse Blueprint
+ Cycle count
+ Reporting and Governance
+ Warehouse Transformation
+ Warehouse Safety
+ D365 Deployment


 Benefits of Warehouse Strategy
   

  

* Reduction of production downtime, through the deployment of cycle count for inventory accuracy and improved efficiency through intelligent layout of warehouses
* Review of packaging to improve sustainability and minimise space required for shipping to reduce costs
* Capturing of warehouse operations with the tools required to carry out improvements
* Standardised processes throughout the group to drive relatable metrics for site comparisons
* Better inventory management: With a detailed understanding of each part and component required for manufacturing, supply chain organizations can reduce inventory carrying costs and minimize the risk of stockouts through PFEP.


**Key Responsibilities and Outcomes:**
* Execute the Site Logistics Transformation for sites including selling entities in APAC
* Deployment and governance of cycle count in APAC factories
* Deliver and support the Global warehouse strategy across APAC sites
* Work with 3rd parties to provide warehouse storage and designs to optimise storage
* Support sites with training on key processes to ensure smooth transition. E.g. Cycle Count, warehouse systems
* Utilise the PFEP workbook to implement Logistics development programmes to deliver ongoing efficiency targets such as supplier development, packaging initiatives, automation and general Lean Continuous Improvement practices.
* Execute Rotork Business System Audits, develop GAP analysis detail and deliver \& execute a programme to remove gaps.
* Provide knowledge transfer \& continued support for business processes to Rotork Factory sites and selling entities
* Work with Subject Matter Experts to define/validate/sign off requirements/deliverables to ensure our solution meets design intentions.
* Carry out site assessments before and during their warehouse journey to identify progress and blockages to transition
* Maintain and develop business process maps for Logistics operations.


**Qualifications**
**Essential**
* Minimum 5 years working in Logistics/Warehouse management and Logistics Engineering.
* Experience of manufacturing material management and replenishment procedures.
* Comfort working in a high\-pressure environment, in agile and dynamic way to tackle unexpected \& emerging issues.
* Demonstrable track record, and sufficient gravitas and experience, to deliver positive, high impact business outcomes and change.
* Experience managing senior internal \& external stakeholders to provide information, drive decisions and resolve issues.


**Desirable**
* Rotork Operations Experience
* Experience of D365

**Job Summary**
 Functions as the primary strategic business leader of the property with responsibility for all aspects of the operation, including guest and employee satisfaction, human resources, financial performance, sales and revenue generation and delivering a return on investment to both Marriott International and property ownership. Verifies implementation of service strategy and initiatives with the objective of meeting or exceeding guest expectations, increased profit and market share. Holds property leadership team accountable for strategy execution, and guides their individual professional development. The position verifies that sales engines are leveraged and initiates independent and proactive sales activities, when appropriate, to generate demand. Verifies that the objectives and goals of Marriott and property owners work together to achieve brand positioning and success. Builds owner loyalty through proactive communication, setting and managing expectations and delivering solid business results. The position is actively involved in the local community and builds strong relationships with local officials, businesses, and customers.
   

  

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**
* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years’ experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, finance and accounting, or related professional area.


 OR
   

  

* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years’ experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, finance and accounting, or related professional area.


**Preferred:**
* General Manager experience in limited or full\-service property.
* Ability and willingness to work flexible hours including weekends, holidays and late nights.
* Property industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.


**JOB SPECIFIC TASKS**
**Business Strategy Development**
 Stays current with industry trends and monitors strengths and weakness of competition; explores new business opportunities; develops business plans designed to maximize property customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share; ensures property business plans are aligned with the hotel’s business strategies; translates Marriott global strategic plan into one that can be executed on property.
   

  

**Business Strategy Execution**
 Executes business plans designed to maximize property customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share; ensures that property business plans and employees are aligned with business strategies; holds property leadership team accountable for successful delivery of business plans; experiments with new ideas and takes calculated risks to improve guest satisfaction and profitability; evaluates the success of property business strategies to inform future business plan enhancements; continually ensures business plans and actions have a positive impact on property performance.
   

  

**Sales and Marketing**
 Works closely with Sales and Marketing team to develop revenue generating strategies for property; identifies new business leads, develops tailored sales approach, and actively pursues leads with Sales and Marketing team; validates that sales and marketing strategy is aligned with brand strategy and is effectively executed against established goals; verifies that property leaders understand and leverage Marriott demand engines to full potential; augments guest preference for property through booking ease and quality interactions with sales force.
   

  

**Talent Management and Organizational Capability**
 Creates a cohesive and high\-performance Executive Committee that continuously strives for positive results and improvement; coaches Executive Committee by providing specific feedback and holds them accountable for performance; creates learning and development opportunities for employees; creates and effectively executes development plans for both direct reports based on their individual strengths, development needs, and career aspirations; ensures all managers are doing the same for their direct reports; identifies resource needs to strengthen property team; creates succession plans for future job openings; actively supports the staffing process; ensures effective work processes, systems and teamwork are in place to maximize individual and overall property performance.
   

  

**Business Information Analysis**
 Reviews business related data such as market share, financial performance, inventory, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction; analyzes business information to proactively address changing market conditions, ensure property operates within budgetary guidelines, and achieves profit margin goals; uses business information to identify indicators of product and service successes and opportunities for improvement; integrates business information into business plans.
   

  

**Employee and Labor Relations**
 Verifies that all employees are treated fairly, and with respect; builds rapport with employees by fostering an environment of open communication and spending time with employees on the frontlines; makes self\-available to employees (“open door policy”); verifies that pay and benefits are appropriate for labor market; celebrates the success of employees in a public way; works with Human Resources to maximize employee engagement and monitor local labor environment to address issues as needed.
   

  

**Revenue Management**
 Works with Revenue Management team to develop effective pricing strategies, balancing seasonality, economy, customer segments, property objectives and customer satisfaction; established revenue strategy that supports the hotel’s positioning in local market; ensures demand forecasting and sound revenue practices are in place to maximize yield; identifies ways to grow occupancy, RevPAR, and market share by researching and staying aware of competitor strategies; controls labor and capital expenses.
   

  

**Owner Relations**
 Builds strong rapport with property owners through proactive and on\-going communication; keeps owner informed of brand initiatives and guest experiences; provides owners with in\-depth analysis of property performance, incorporating guest, financial and employee business data; manages an effective balance between owner interests and Marriott brand interests and develops solutions that create value for both; develops and effectively promotes ideas for improving property service and profitability to ownership.
   

  

**Customer and Public Relations Management**
 Interacts with guests and other customers on a frequent basis to obtain feedback about their experiences on property; utilizes guest/customer feedback to recognize outstanding employee service performance and improve service delivery; emphasizes and holds leadership team accountable for addressing service failures or potential service failures, and for developing innovative ways to exceed guest expectations; establishes presence in the market by actively promoting an exemplary property/brand image, involving oneself in the local community, and by developing strategic alliances with local officials, businesses, and customers; anticipates needs of large groups or high profile guests in order to deliver flawless service; verifies that products, services, and events attain the appropriate publicity (“PR buzz”).
   

  

**Company/Brand Policy, Procedures, And Standards Compliance**
 Verifies property compliance with legal, safety, operations, labor, and Marriott brand product and service standards; conducts both routine and short\-notice quality assurance audits with specific departments; holds employees accountable for performing audits on a regular basis; conducts detailed walk\-throughs to ensure building, public areas, kitchen, and grounds are well\-maintained, safe, and meet or exceed guest expectations; validates that employees are appropriately trained and performing to standard.
