title: GENERAL MANAGER / DGM
description:
**Designation** 




 Deputy General Manager / General Manager – Production
 



  





**Function / Department** 




 Manufacturing Operations – Production
 



  





**Location** 




 MEPZ\-SEZ, Tambaram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
 



  





**Grade Level** 




 DGM / GM (Senior Leadership Band)
 



  





**Experience Required** 




 18 – 22 years, with mandatory aerospace manufacturing industry experience
 



  





**Qualification** 




 B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering (essential);
 



  





**ROLE OBJECTIVE** 




 The Deputy General Manager / General Manager – Production will lead and be accountable for the total production operations of PMI Engineering Exports across its three manufacturing units at MEPZ\-SEZ, Chennai. The role carries full ownership of on\-time delivery, quality, cost, safety, and productivity in an AS9100 Rev D–certified, 100% export\-oriented aerospace precision\-manufacturing environment. The incumbent will translate the organisation's operating plan into disciplined shop\-floor execution, drive a culture of continuous improvement, and represent Production at the executive and PennAero Group level.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Production \& Operations Management** 



* **Operational Ownership:** 
 Own end\-to\-end production operations across all three manufacturing units (PMIE, PMIG\-1, PMIG\-2\), ensuring on\-time delivery, output targets, and yield performance against the master production schedule.
* **Production Planning:** 
 Drive daily, weekly, and monthly production planning in coordination with PPC, translating customer order books and export commitments into achievable line\-level plans.
* **Process Leadership:** 
 Direct precision machining, gear manufacturing (hobbing, shaping, grinding), heat\-treatment, and assembly operations to meet aerospace tolerance and surface\-integrity requirements.
* **Throughput \& OEE:** 
 Optimise capacity utilisation, cycle times, and equipment effectiveness (OEE) across CNC, turning cells, and gear\-manufacturing lines, resolving bottlenecks proactively.



**Quality, AS9100 \& Aerospace Standards** 



* **AS9100 Compliance:** 
 Ensure full compliance with AS9100 Rev D and customer\-specific quality requirements, embedding first\-time\-right and zero\-escape discipline on the shop floor.
* **Quality Governance:** 
 Partner with Quality to close NCRs, drive root\-cause / corrective action (8D, CAPA), and sustain audit\-readiness for customer, regulatory, and certification audits.
* **Traceability \& FAI:** 
 Uphold configuration control, traceability, FAI (first article inspection), and special\-process controls consistent with aerospace standards.



**Compliance, Export\-Control \& Safety** 



* **Export\-Control \& SEZ:** 
 Maintain awareness of and adherence to ITAR / EAR export\-control obligations, MEPZ\-SEZ / EOU customs procedures, and controlled\-technology handling requirements.
* **Safety \& Statutory:** 
 Enforce EHS standards, machine\-safety protocols, and statutory factory compliance across all production areas.



**Continuous Improvement \& Cost** 



* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Lead Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and TPM initiatives to reduce waste, scrap, and rework while improving cost per unit and delivery reliability.
* **Modernisation:** 
 Champion automation, digitisation, and shop\-floor data initiatives to strengthen real\-time production visibility and decision\-making.
* **Cost \& Productivity:** 
 Drive cost\-control, budget adherence, and productivity improvement targets aligned to the annual operating plan.



**People Leadership \& Collaboration** 



* **Team Leadership:** 
 Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing production organisation; drive skill development, multi\-skilling, and succession within the shop\-floor talent pipeline.
* **Performance Culture:** 
 Set and cascade KRAs / KPIs, manage performance, and foster a culture of accountability, discipline, and engagement across shifts.
* **Cross\-Functional:** 
 Collaborate cross\-functionally with Engineering, Quality, SCM, Maintenance, and HR to deliver integrated operational outcomes.



**Reporting \& Governance** 



* **MIS \& Reporting:** 
 Provide accurate, board\-ready production MIS, dashboards, and performance reviews to the Executive Director and CEO.
* **Group Interface:** 
 Represent Production in operational reviews with PennAero Group leadership and support group\-level reporting requirements.



**QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE** 



* **Education:** 
 B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, or Industrial Engineering is essential.
* **Experience:** 
 18 – 22 years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, with leadership responsibility for production at DGM / GM level.
* **Aerospace (Must\-Have):** 
 Mandatory hands\-on experience within the aerospace manufacturing industry — precision machining, gear / precision components, or aerospace fasteners — in an AS9100\-certified environment.
* 8\+ years of experience in Production Planning.
* 8\+ years of experience in Aerospace Manufacturing.
* 8\+ years of experience contributing to organisational Strategy.



**KEY COMPETENCIES \& ATTRIBUTES** 



* Deep expertise in aerospace precision manufacturing, gear / precision\-component production, and AS9100\-governed operations.
* Strong command of production planning, capacity management, and shop\-floor execution in a high\-mix, export\-oriented environment.
* Excellent leadership, cross\-functional collaboration, and people\-development capability across large blue\-collar teams.
* Sound working knowledge of ITAR / EAR export\-control frameworks and SEZ / EOU regulatory compliance.
* Strong analytical, decision\-making, and executive communication skills, with the ability to represent Production at Group level.

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




 Simpsons employs about 1000 engineering and management personnel at its modern manufacturing facilities located in Chennai and Kumbakonam. These plants with their state of the art equipment manufacture. Currently manufacture more than 1,75,000 diesel engines a year for nearly 200 applications catering to domestic as well as export markets.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Position Overview The Sourcing \& Development Manager will lead sourcing, supplier development, product development, and commercial execution activities to ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality, cost\-effective, and market\-relevant products. The role will manage the complete sourcing and development lifecycle, from identifying suitable suppliers and evaluating capabilities to coordinating product development, negotiating commercial terms, and supporting successful production execution. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in supplier management, sourcing strategy, product development, cost optimization, quality coordination, and cross\-functional collaboration. This position requires a commercially aware professional who can build reliable supplier partnerships while meeting organizational expectations for quality, cost, delivery, compliance, and innovation.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Key Responsibilities**



  




* **Sourcing Strategy and Supplier Management**
* Develop and implement sourcing strategies aligned with business requirements, product specifications, budget objectives, and delivery timelines.
* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop qualified suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Conduct supplier capability assessments covering capacity, technical expertise, quality systems, lead times, scalability, and commercial competitiveness.
* Maintain a strong and diversified supplier base to support business continuity, cost efficiency, and supply\-chain resilience.
* Build and manage long\-term relationships with suppliers, vendors, manufacturers, and other external partners.
* Monitor supplier performance using measurable indicators such as quality, cost, delivery, responsiveness, compliance, and service levels.
* Lead supplier improvement initiatives and collaborate with partners to resolve recurring performance issues.



  




* **Product Development and Commercial Execution**
* Manage product development activities from initial concept, specification, and sampling through approvals and production readiness.
* Work closely with design, merchandising, engineering, quality, production, planning, and sales teams to ensure product requirements are clearly defined and executed.
* Review product specifications, technical requirements, samples, prototypes, and development timelines.
* Coordinate development milestones and ensure timely completion of approvals, revisions, testing, and final sign\-offs.
* Support the evaluation of alternative materials, components, manufacturing processes, and suppliers to improve product performance and commercial viability.
* Ensure that products are developed in line with quality standards, customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and organizational guidelines.



  




* **Costing and Negotiation**
* Prepare and review product costing, supplier quotations, commercial proposals, and cost\-breakdown analyses.
* Lead negotiations related to pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, tooling, lead times, logistics, and other commercial conditions.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities through supplier negotiations, value engineering, material optimization, process improvements, and alternate sourcing.
* Balance cost objectives with quality, delivery, technical requirements, and long\-term supplier sustainability.
* Track development and sourcing budgets and provide timely updates on cost performance and commercial risks.



  




* **Quality, Compliance, and Risk Management**
* Partner with quality and technical teams to establish and maintain product and supplier quality standards.
* Coordinate testing, inspections, corrective actions, and approval processes as required.
* Ensure suppliers comply with applicable legal, ethical, environmental, safety, and organizational requirements.
* Identify sourcing and development risks related to capacity, raw materials, quality, delivery, compliance, and market volatility.
* Develop mitigation plans and maintain appropriate contingency options for critical products and suppliers.
* Support audits, supplier reviews, and continuous\-improvement programs.



  




* **Planning, Reporting, and Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Create and maintain sourcing, development, sampling, and production timelines.
* Track project progress, identify delays or dependencies, and implement corrective actions to protect delivery commitments.
* Prepare regular reports on supplier performance, development status, costing, savings, risks, and key project milestones.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders across different functions and organizational levels.
* Lead or participate in supplier meetings, product reviews, development reviews, and cross\-functional decision\-making forums.
* Maintain accurate sourcing records, supplier documentation, product data, costing information, and approval history.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **Experience Required**



 12 \- 15 years of relevant professional experience in sourcing, procurement, supplier management, product development, manufacturing, or a related function.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* **Required Qualifications and Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Procurement, Business Administration, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing, or a related discipline.
* 12 \- 15 years of relevant experience in sourcing, supplier management, procurement, product development, or manufacturing operations.
* Strong understanding of sourcing processes, supplier evaluation, product development, cost analysis, negotiation, and supply\-chain management.
* Proven ability to manage multiple products, suppliers, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.

* Excellent communication, presentation, influencing, and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Role Overview**

**Manager – Financial Operations**

The Manager, Financial Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of all finance activities processed through the organisation's Workday/ERP platform. The role acts as the global process owner for Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and direct oversight of UK Payroll processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing, timely financial reporting, strong controls, and optimal use of Workday/ERP capabilities.


The successful candidate will be a strong people leader with the ability to develop high\-performing teams, build organisational capability, and drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.


**Core Duties/Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:


**Operational Leadership \& Process Ownership**

* Lead the delivery of finance operations across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and Payroll processes.
* Own operational performance, ensuring delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Ensure standardised, efficient, and well\-controlled end\-to\-end finance processes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues and process exceptions.

**People Management**

* Lead, develop, and motivate a high\-performing Finance Operations team.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and career development opportunities to enhance capability and engagement.
* Drive talent management, succession planning, and skills development to ensure long\-term organisational resilience.

**Accounts Payable Operations**

* Oversee invoice processing, payment execution, employee expenses, and supplier account management.
* Ensure timely supplier payments and effective resolution of payment\-related issues.
* Maintain strong AP controls, compliance, and governance standards.
* Act as the functional owner for Workday Accounts Payable processes and enhancements.

**Record\-to\-Report Operations**

* Ensure timely and accurate journal processing and financial accounting activities.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalisation, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
* Manage balance sheet reconciliations, bank reconciliations, and prepayment accounting.
* Support statutory, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvements across RTR processes to improve efficiency, control, and reporting quality.

**Procurement Operations**

* Manage Purchase Order (PO) support processes.
* Oversee supplier onboarding activities and vendor master governance.
* Support procurement compliance and policy adherence.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive efficient purchasing processes.
* Support supplier negotiations and process optimisation initiatives.

**Payroll Operations (UK)**

* Oversee UK payroll processing, validation, reconciliations, and payroll accounting activities.
* Ensure payroll operations are delivered accurately, compliantly, and on time.
* Review payroll journals, controls, and exception management processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of payroll queries and exceptions.
* Partner with HR and external providers to maintain a high\-quality payroll service.

**Workday/ERP Governance \& Optimisation**

* Act as the Finance SME for Workday/ERP processes and functionality.
* Drive maximum utilisation of system capabilities through automation and process standardisation.
* Partner with Technology and Business teams on system enhancements and process changes.

**Performance Management \& Reporting**

* Develop and maintain KPI dashboards and operational reporting.
* Monitor productivity, service levels, quality, and control metrics.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide regular management information to Finance leadership.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Simplify workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support Finance transformation and change initiatives.

**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:


**EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong experience across Finance Operations, Shared Services, or Financial Accounting environments.
* End\-to\-end knowledge of Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Fixed Assets, and UK Payroll processes.
* Experience of operating and optimising ERP platforms, preferably Workday.
* Strong understanding of Month\-End and year\-end financial close processes.
* Experience delivering operational excellence, automation, and process transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple functions and levels.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to lead change and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.

**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**

* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA) or equivalent

* Fluent English: written and spoken.

**Qualification:** MBBS with MBA / Hospital Administration / Healthcare Management exposure preferred  
**Experience:** Preferably 3–7\+ years in clinical practice, hospital/clinic operations, healthcare administration or multidisciplinary healthcare management

Role Overview

BM Elite International Clinic is looking for an **MBBS doctor with healthcare management exposure** who can combine clinical understanding with strong operational and administrative capabilities.

The role is designed for a doctor who can function as the **clinical\-operational link between consultants, patients, nursing staff, front office, management, marketing and business development teams**.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth day\-to\-day clinical operations, maintaining quality of patient care, improving patient experience, coordinating multiple specialties, strengthening follow\-up systems and supporting the management in improving overall clinic performance.

This is not a routine Medical Officer position. The role requires a combination of **medical knowledge, coordination, leadership, healthcare management and operational responsibility**.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Coordination

* Coordinate clinical activities across all specialties within BM Elite International Clinic.
* Conduct preliminary patient assessment and review medical history when required.
* Guide patients to the appropriate specialty or consultant.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary treatment plans involving more than one department.
* Review investigations and ensure reports reach the concerned treating doctor.
* Track patients requiring further investigations, procedures or follow\-up.
* Ensure continuity of care between consultations, investigations, procedures and follow\-up.
* Assist consultants in coordinating complex or multidisciplinary patients.
* Ensure proper handover between clinical departments.

Clinic Operations

* Oversee daily clinical operations of the centre.
* Ensure smooth coordination between doctors, nursing staff, technicians, front office and administration.
* Monitor consultation schedules, procedure schedules and patient flow.
* Identify operational delays and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure proper utilisation of consultation rooms and procedure facilities.
* Coordinate consultant availability and clinic schedules.
* Support management in developing and implementing operational SOPs.
* Ensure timely opening and functioning of all clinical services.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest practical improvements.

Patient Journey Management

* Monitor the complete patient journey from enquiry to consultation, treatment and follow\-up.
* Ensure that patients receive appropriate counselling and clear information regarding their treatment plan.
* Coordinate appointments, procedures and investigations.
* Ensure high\-value or complex patients receive appropriate coordination.
* Track patients who have been advised procedures but have not yet proceeded.
* Monitor patient follow\-up compliance.
* Address patient concerns and coordinate appropriate resolution.
* Escalate clinical concerns to the treating consultant or Medical Director.
* Maintain a premium and professional patient experience.

Clinical Documentation \& Governance

* Ensure proper maintenance of medical records.
* Monitor completion of consultation notes, procedure records and consent forms.
* Ensure that required investigations are documented before procedures.
* Support implementation of clinical protocols and SOPs.
* Monitor infection\-control and clinical safety practices.
* Participate in clinical audits and quality\-improvement activities.
* Ensure confidentiality and ethical handling of patient information.
* Support incident reporting and corrective\-action systems when required.

Healthcare Management

* Assist management in planning and implementing new clinical services.
* Evaluate workflow and recommend improvements in efficiency.
* Help develop structured patient programmes and treatment pathways.
* Coordinate between different departments for integrated treatment packages.
* Participate in staff training and performance improvement.
* Assist with manpower planning and duty allocation where required.
* Monitor utilisation of clinical facilities and resources.
* Support management in improving productivity and patient throughput.

Business \& Performance Coordination

The role is not intended to be a pure sales role; however, the candidate should understand the business side of healthcare operations.

Responsibilities include:

* Monitor consultation\-to\-treatment conversion.
* Identify reasons for patient drop\-off.
* Coordinate with counselling and patient\-care teams regarding pending treatment decisions.
* Review department\-wise patient flow.
* Support management in monitoring revenue\-generating clinical services.
* Analyse operational and patient\-conversion trends.
* Coordinate with marketing and business\-development teams regarding leads requiring clinical input.
* Ensure marketing\-generated enquiries are appropriately directed to the concerned specialty.
* Assist in developing clinically appropriate treatment packages.
* Provide management with feedback regarding patient demand and emerging service opportunities.

Consultant \& Team Coordination

* Act as an operational link between consultants and management.
* Coordinate visiting consultants and specialty clinics.
* Ensure consultant requirements are communicated to the relevant departments.
* Assist in resolving routine coordination issues between departments.
* Conduct or participate in daily/weekly operational meetings.
* Ensure responsibilities assigned to staff are followed up.
* Support nursing, front office and patient\-care teams with clinical clarification where appropriate.
* Promote teamwork and accountability across the clinic.

MIS \& Management Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Track key indicators including:
* Total consultations
* New and follow\-up patients
* Procedures advised
* Procedures performed
* Pending procedures
* Patient follow\-ups
* Conversion rates
* No\-shows and cancellations
* Patient complaints
* Department\-wise activity

* Data interpretation

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.



We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.



Are you curious about being part of our growth story while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.


**Iron Mountain is seeking a highly experienced and motivated** **Regional Head \- DC Construction** **to join our Business Function/Department team.**


**In this role, you will be responsible for leading the end\-to\-end planning, design coordination, execution, commissioning, and defect\-free handover of large\-scale, multi\-million\-dollar hyperscale and enterprise data center infrastructure projects.**


**You will lead a multidisciplinary team of engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operations professionals, driving operational excellence and rigorous risk management throughout the entire project lifecycle.**


**What You’ll Do**


**In this role, you will:**


* **Project Leadership \& Governance:** **Drive end\-to\-end delivery of greenfield and brownfield data center projects exceeding $100M USD, establishing robust governance structures to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget metrics.**
* **Design \& Engineering Coordination:** **Oversee design development from concept to Issued for Construction (IFC), coordinating complex architectural, structural, civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP), and Information and Communications Technology (ICT) disciplines to meet Tier III and Tier IV requirements.**
* **Infrastructure Construction \& Commissioning Management:** **Direct all site execution and testing activities—including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and Level 1–5 commissioning—ensuring seamless operational readiness and transition to the operations team.**
* **Commercial, Risk, \& Stakeholder Management:** **Oversee project budgets, cost controls, change orders, and risk registers while managing strategic relationships with clients, consultants, Project Management Companies (PMCs), Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contractors, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and regulatory authorities.**
* **Health, Safety, Environment \& Quality Assurance:** **Champion a "Zero Harm" culture and enforce rigorous Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) standards and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) regulations across all concurrent project programs.**


**What You’ll Bring**

description:
**Description**
 The Senior Operations Manager owns the operational excellence of our India site within Frontier AI (Knowledge Fulfillment Engine Org). Leading a multi\-layered organization of 500\+ data associates, this role demands a leader who combines strategic vision with relentless execution — someone who can simultaneously architect the future state of site operations while delivering flawless daily execution against challenging SLAs.
   

  

 This is not a maintenance role. The successful candidate will challenge the status quo, eliminate inefficiency, raise the performance ceiling, and leave the operation materially stronger than they found it. This role requires comfort with ambiguity, the ability to context\-switch between strategic planning and tactical problem\-solving, and the judgment to know which mode a situation demands. Regular engagement with senior leadership on strategy, risk, and performance is expected.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end operational P\&L for the HYD site, driving measurable improvements in cost\-per\-unit economics while maintaining or exceeding quality SLAs across all active programs.
* Drive workforce planning in partnership with Finance, aligning labor capacity models to demand forecasts and managing flex strategies (overtime, cross\-training, temporary labor) to maintain SLA compliance during volume fluctuations.
* Define and execute a multi\-year operational strategy for Data Services at the site, anticipating shifts in program volume, automation adoption, and workforce composition, and proactively positioning the site to absorb new workstreams.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Engineering, Product, and Program teams to define tooling requirements, influence product roadmaps based on operational friction data, and validate feature releases through structured UAT processes.
* Own the site's quality ecosystem — establishing closed\-loop mechanisms where defect root causes are identified, corrective actions are implemented within one sprint cycle, and systemic patterns are escalated with data\-backed proposals to Engineering and Product teams.
* Architect scalable processes that reduce dependency on headcount growth, leveraging automation, tooling improvements, and workflow redesign to deliver throughput gains quarter over quarter without proportional cost increases.
* Build and lead a high\-performing leadership team (Operations Managers, Team Managers), setting differentiated performance expectations, calibrating talent rigorously, and maintaining a ready\-now succession pipeline for all critical roles.
* Champion a data\-driven culture where every operational decision is grounded in statistical analysis, A/B testing of process changes is standard practice, and anecdotal reasoning is challenged.
* Build and sustain an engagement model that delivers measurable year\-over\-year improvement in associate retention and engagement scores, with specific interventions tied to root\-cause analysis of attrition drivers.
* Serve as the site's executive voice to senior leadership — translating operational data into strategic narratives, owning regular business review inputs, drafting strategic papers for director\-level decision forums, and proactively surfacing risks with mitigation plans.
* Operate as a force multiplier across the cluster, sharing best practices, standardizing processes across sites, and contributing to org\-wide mechanisms that raise the performance ceiling for peer sites.

 Job Title: Production support Lead
   

  

 Position: Senior Software Engineer/Lead
   

  

 Experience: 7 \-12 Years
   

  

 Category: Software Development/ Engineering
   

  

 Shift: General
   

  

 Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
   

  

 Position ID:
   

  

 Employment Type: Full Time
   

  

 Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
   

  

 Position Description:
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Production Support / SRE Lead to lead L2/L3 production support operations for a highly available, microservices\-based environment. The role requires strong technical expertise across cloud, container platforms, application technologies, databases, monitoring, automation, and incident management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and operational excellence of production systems while leading and mentoring a team of production support engineers.
   

  

 The candidate should be comfortable navigating multiple technologies and working closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, QA, and business stakeholders to resolve critical production issues and continuously improve platform reliability.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the triage, investigation, and resolution of complex L2/L3 production incidents in a microservices environment while ensuring adherence to SLA/SLO requirements.
* Lead and mentor a team of production support engineers, manage shift rosters, prioritize workloads, and foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and accountability.
* Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability strategies to proactively identify bottlenecks, anomalies, performance issues, and potential system failures.
* Drive detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical P1/P2 incidents and work closely with Development, Architecture, DevOps, and other technical teams to identify permanent fixes and prevent recurrence.
* Promote SRE practices and identify operational toil and repetitive manual activities, driving automation initiatives such as auto\-remediation scripts, automated health checks, monitoring improvements, and operational tooling.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact during major incidents and provide clear, timely, and accurate updates to stakeholders, Delivery Managers, and leadership.
* Collaborate with DevOps and CI/CD teams to support seamless production deployments, blue/green deployments, canary releases, rolling deployments, and zero\-downtime transitions.
* Monitor production systems proactively and identify application, infrastructure, database, and integration\-related issues before they impact customers.
* Analyze system performance, availability, capacity, logs, metrics, and traces to identify and resolve production issues.
* Drive continuous improvement of production support processes, monitoring capabilities, incident response, automation, and system reliability.

We are seeking a Manager, Central Monitoring, Data Analysis to join our Global Clinical Trial Services team. In this role, you will oversee centralized monitoring activities for global and complex clinical trials and support the configuration, execution, and maintenance of Risk\-Based Quality Management (RBQM) platforms. You will leverage your programming and analytical expertise to create customized analyses, automate workflows, integrate data systems, and deliver actionable insights that support informed decision\-making and optimize clinical trial performance. You may also oversee multiple studies within an assigned therapeutic area, lead process\-improvement initiatives, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and industry partners to advance central monitoring capabilities.

 Hyderabad, India (hybrid)

* Act as a subject\-matter expert for the configuration, implementation, and execution of Central Monitoring RBQM platforms across studies.
* Maintain Regeneron Central Monitoring Key Risk Indicator and Quality Tolerance Limit libraries to ensure consistent deployment across studies and alignment with regulatory requirements.
* Configure studies within an RBQM platform by partnering with functional and cross\-functional stakeholders to develop Central Monitoring configuration specifications.
* Provide operational expertise, training, and guidance, serving as an escalation point for issues related to the Central Monitoring RBQM platform.
* Conduct central monitoring reviews as required, including recurring data refreshes and troubleshooting execution errors in support of Study Central Monitors.
* Apply programming expertise to support Central Monitoring data analysis, automation, reporting, and system integration.
* Interpret and present Key Risk Indicator and Key Performance Indicator data to support informed decision\-making.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of technologies, systems, processes, and training materials that support Central Monitoring and RBQM.
* Represent Central Monitoring in process\-improvement initiatives and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee multiple studies within an assigned therapeutic area, as applicable, and contribute to innovation in central monitoring capabilities.
* Travel up to 25%, as required.


**This Role Requires**
* At least 7 years of relevant biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience. Experience in Central Monitoring, site monitoring, or data management is preferred.
* A minimum of 2 years of direct experience with RBQM systems.
* Technical expertise in database design, system configuration, and report development, with experience managing RBQM or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or SAS, with the ability to develop scripts for data analysis, automation, and system integration.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, including experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.
* Working knowledge of the clinical drug\-development process, including ICH and GCP guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.

title: Export Manager
description:
Job Description – Export Manager
 



  





**Position Details** 




 ·        Position: Export Manager
 



 ·        Experience: 12–15 Years
 



 ·        Location: Mumbai
 



 ·        Department: International Business / Exports
 



 ·        Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 ·        We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Export Manager to lead and manage the company’s international trade operations and global business development.
 



 ·        The role involves overseeing end\-to\-end export processes including market expansion, export documentation, regulatory compliance, logistics coordination, and distributor management.
 



 ·        The Export Manager will be responsible for developing international markets, managing export logistics, ensuring regulatory compliance, and building strategic partnerships with overseas distributors and retailers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities – Export Operations \& Compliance** 




 ·        Manage the complete export cycle including pre\-shipment and post\-shipment documentation and logistics coordination.
 



 ·        Ensure compliance with global regulatory standards such as FSSAI, USFDA, EU food regulations, and other international market requirements.
 



 ·        Coordinate with Custom House Agents (CHA), freight forwarders, shipping lines, customs authorities, and banks for smooth export operations.
 



 ·        Handle export documentation through DGFT, ICEGATE, and other EXIM platforms.
 



  





**International Business Development** 




 ·        Identify and develop new international markets and distribution channels to expand the company’s global presence.
 



 ·        Establish relationships with overseas distributors, importers, retail chains, and key accounts.
 



 ·        Manage B2B and B2C export sales across international markets.
 



 ·        Participate in international trade exhibitions and food expos to promote products and generate new leads.
 



  





**Distributor \& Key Account Management** 




 ·        Appoint and manage country\-wise distributors and channel partners.
 



 ·        Maintain strong relationships with international clients, retailers, and distributors.
 



 ·        Monitor distributor performance and ensure achievement of sales targets and market penetration.
 



  





**Export Logistics \& Supply Chain Coordination** 




 ·        Plan and coordinate shipment schedules via air and sea (FCL/LCL).
 



 ·        Negotiate freight rates with shipping lines, freight forwarders, and logistics partners.
 



 ·        Liaise with production, inventory, and quality teams to ensure timely order fulfillment and dispatch.
 



 ·        Ensure export packaging compliance and labeling according to destination country regulations.
 



  





**Regulatory \& Product Compliance** 




 ·        Coordinate product registration with overseas regulatory authorities such as FDA and other food safety agencies.
 



 ·        Strong understanding of Western markets such as the US, UK, Australia, and Canada, along with knowledge of export compliance requirements for food and beverage products from India to these countries.
 



 ·        Ensure export packaging, labeling, and product specifications meet country\-specific legal requirements.
 



 ·        Maintain documentation related to product approvals, certifications, and compliance standards.
 



  





**Export Incentives \& Financial Coordination** 




 ·        Manage government export incentive schemes including Duty Drawback, MEIS/RoDTEP, EPCG, and Advance Authorization.
 



 ·        Coordinate with finance and banking partners for Letter of Credit (LC), payments, and subsidy claims.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 ·        Master’s Degree / MBA in International Business, Marketing, or EXIM Management.
 



 ·        Minimum 10–12 years of experience in export operations or international business, preferably in FMCG or food products.
 



 ·        Proven track record in international sales, distributor development, and export logistics management.

title: Customer Manager
description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 We’re on the lookout for an enthusiastic and customer\-focused Customer Manager who lives and breathes home furnishing. This is your chance to lead an energetic team, introduce IKEA to new customers, drive success in a new market, and create a meaningful and locally relevant shopping experience.
   

  

 • Minimum 5 years of leadership experience with a proven track record in developing and leading high\-performing teams.
   

 • Experience in driving customer satisfaction and delivering business results in a customer\-focused environment.
   

 • Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and conflict management skills, with the ability to lead through change and complexity.
   

 • Good understanding of IKEA business, values, and ways of working, with experience in a fast\-paced, multichannel retail environment.
   

 • Good knowledge of P\&L, budget management, cost control, and resource optimization.
   

 • Good knowledge of Food, Hospitality, Retail Operations, or Customer Service management.
   

 • Proven ability to create and deliver an excellent customer experience, utilizing customer insights and feedback to drive continuous improvement.
   

 • Good understanding of talent management, including recruitment, succession planning, coaching, and development.
   

 • Experience in leading organizational change and implementing improvement initiatives.
   

 • Good knowledge of legal compliance requirements, contracts, and vendor/third\-party management.
   

 • Understanding of health, safety, security, and food safety requirements, with the ability to act as a key contact for authorities and external stakeholders.
   

 • Knowledge of food operations, food quality standards, and food business performance management.
   

 • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functions.
   

 • Passion for people, food, and creating positive customer experiences that strengthen business performance and customer loyalty.
   

 • Good analytical and communication skills
 



  





**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





 To lead the Customer Relations and IKEA Food functions by driving commercial growth, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction across all channels. The role is accountable for maximizing sales, profitability, and business performance in line with local, national, and global frameworks, while ensuring a safe, high\-quality, and rewarding customer experience. Through customer insights, feedback, and emerging consumer trends, the role continuously improves customer journey, strengthens customer loyalty, and develops recommendations that support sustainable business growth and operational effectiveness. The role also ensures compliance with food safety, health, safety, and security requirements for customers and co\-workers.
   

  

 • Drive a customer\-focused culture throughout the complete market and secure an overall inspiring shopping experience where it is always for customers easy to shop.
   

 • Influence the unit management team with customer insights that will allow it to base business decisions on customer expectations.
   

 • Responsible for identifying and removing hindrances to secure an easy buying experience, a positive shopping experience and easy payment and after\-sales fulfilment.
   

 • Support commercial initiatives and priorities before, during and after the shopping experience.
   

 • Establish and maintain service agreements with internal stakeholders (including customer support) and external partners to protect operational standards and help safeguard the IKEA culture.
   

 • Plan and determine which departmental resources and investments are required to achieve operational excellence in balance with customer expectations.
   

 • Secure and monitor the department is working according to internal, global and national rules and policies, IKEA best practise and in accordance with local legislation. Collect and synthetize consumer, customer, brand and internal data to contribute with recommendations and decisions to improve and to develop customer service.
   

 • Provide relevant consumer and customer insights to the store team to initiate and support problem solving and find solutions to improve customer shopping experience.
   

 • Responsible for the development of excellence in the customer experience including all services and HCS / Pulse CX.
   

 • Champion the delivery of a seamless, convenient and rewarding end to end shopping experience to maximize conversion and selling more across all channels
   

 • Actively cooperate with all key stakeholders within commercial and beyond to secure integration, common focus and to maximize impact for our customers.
   

 • Responsible for customer experience in the store, seamless and convenient check\-out and IKEA Food business (Swedish bite)
   

 • Contributes to the implementation of global and national food safety compliance standards to secure a safe environment for customers and co\-workers.
   

 • Ensure that retail foundations and sales steering tools, food safety and Swedishness are in place to optimize commerciality
   

 • Contribute to the creation and implementation of the IKEA Retail Food business plan and food action plans
   

 • Ensure the customer focus and relevant business plans relate and create the local action plan accordingly that is operationally implemented and fulfilled.
   

 • Lead, coach, develop the full team promoting individual growth and competence and secure a high performing team and a strong collaboration across the store.
   

 • Ensure the building of business competence by supporting managers, leaders and team members in setting and working on relevant goals and agreed development plans.
   

 • Identify and develop the talents in the unit and within the department to secure succession planning.
   

 • Establish and maintain service agreements with internal stakeholders, across the market, with SO, RCMP and external partners to develop efficient operational processes and promote IKEA culture and values.
   

 • Secure and monitor the department is working according to internal, global and national rules and policies, IKEA best practice and in accordance with local legislation.
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 To drive sales growth and sustained long\-term profitability, by providing an outstanding shopping experience and establishing and retaining a life\-long relationship with existing and new customers. This is achieved by working in partnership with our customers and other functions to:
   

  

 • Secure an easy buying process from home to home
   

 • Understand and match customers’ needs and expectations now and in the future.
   

 • Secure always strong customer focus as priority.
   

 The aim is to motivate our customers to shop with us more frequently because they trust us to make their shopping experiences successful and their visits worthwhile. Being the voice of the customers in the store and secure that all store team members understand the importance of our customer centric approach. Every customer counts.
   

  

 Let’s create the future of home furnishing together! ❤
   

  

 WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
   

 At IKEA we value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are committed to providing coworkers with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We encourage individualism and invite you to come join our team and be yourself with us! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

 Guest Experience

 Compliance \& Food Safety

 Inventory \& Cost Control

* Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution.

* Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place

* Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
* Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe.
* Promote WSP in India Vision and Values \- see below.
* Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business


**Technical and Project Management**
* Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
* Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
* Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
* Promote technical excellence in all our projects
* Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
* Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement


**Commercial**
* Implement the project delivery systems and structures
* Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
* Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
* Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

* The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record.
* The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Head of Operations to lead and optimize our end\-to\-end warehouse, logistics, inventory, procurement, and supply chain operations. Lead and manage end\-to\-end warehouse operations across multiple locations.

Develop warehouse processes to improve productivity, space utilization, and inventory accuracy.

Ensure timely inward, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, and returns management.

Maintain warehouse SOPs and operational compliance.

**Supply Chain Management**

Manage the complete supply chain from procurement to customer delivery.

Coordinate with manufacturers, vendors, transporters, and distributors.

Optimize logistics costs and improve service levels.

Develop strategies to reduce operational expenses and improve efficiency.

**Inventory Management**

Ensure inventory accuracy of 99% or above.

Monitor stock ageing, slow\-moving inventory, and inventory reconciliation.

Plan inventory based on demand forecasting.

Conduct periodic stock audits and cycle counts.

**Order Fulfillment**

Ensure timely processing of B2B, B2C, D2C, Marketplace, and Quick Commerce orders.

Monitor order fulfillment KPIs and customer service levels.

Improve dispatch timelines and reduce delivery TAT.

**Vendor \& Procurement Management**

Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service agreements.

Evaluate vendor performance through defined KPIs.

Manage procurement planning and inventory replenishment.

**Process Improvement**

Identify operational bottlenecks and implement automation wherever possible.

Develop SOPs and continuous improvement initiatives.

Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and cost optimization projects.

Implement best practices across operations.

**Team Management**

Lead warehouse, logistics, planning, inventory, and customer support teams.

Define KRAs and KPIs for team members.

Conduct regular performance reviews and training sessions.

Build a high\-performance operations culture.

**Technology \& Reporting**

Manage ERP, WMS, OMS, and inventory management systems.

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.

Monitor operational dashboards and performance metrics.

Ensure accurate reporting and data\-driven decision\-making.

Warehouse Productivity

Order Accuracy

Customer Satisfaction

On\-Time Delivery

Overall Operational Cost Optimization

Experience

12–15\+ years of experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Warehouse, or Logistics Management.

Experience in Cosmetics, FMCG, Retail, E\-commerce, or Consumer Goods industry preferred.

Proven experience managing multi\-location warehouse operations and large teams.

Warehouse Operations

Inventory Planning \& Control

description:
The Assistant Manager – Business Operations, Ecommerce (B2B) will be responsible for managing and executing end\-to\-end ecommerce business operations for key B2B/ecommerce partners. The role involves close coordination with external partners, internal stakeholders, warehouse teams, distributors, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth order processing, timely deliveries, efficient returns management, accurate reporting, and effective vendor portal operations.  

  

The position requires strong operational capabilities, attention to detail, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously in a fast\-paced ecommerce environment.**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. End\-to\-End Order Management**

* Manage the complete order lifecycle, from stock offering and order confirmation to purchase order processing, system entry, distributor coordination, and final delivery.
* Ensure timely and accurate processing of partner purchase orders and coordinate with relevant internal and external stakeholders for order fulfilment.
* Monitor order status and proactively identify and resolve operational issues or delays.

**2\. Partner and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as a key point of contact for assigned ecommerce and B2B partners for day\-to\-day operational requirements.
* Coordinate regularly with internal teams, distributors, warehouse teams, logistics partners, and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of business operations.
* Maintain effective communication with partners and ensure timely resolution of operational queries and concerns.

**3\. Vendor Portal Operations**

* Manage and execute day\-to\-day activities across partner/vendor portals.
* Ensure timely updates, order processing, document uploads, and adherence to partner\-specific operational requirements.
* Monitor portal\-related activities and resolve discrepancies in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

**4\. Slot Planning and Delivery Coordination**

* Plan and schedule delivery slots in coordination with ecommerce partners, warehouse teams, and logistics stakeholders.
* Ensure all required supporting documents and information are shared accurately and within the required timelines.
* Monitor slot adherence and support timely execution of deliveries.

**5\. Returns Management**

* Manage the end\-to\-end returns process for assigned partners.
* Ensure timely creation and processing of Return to Vendor (RTV) documents in the internal system.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and partners to ensure accurate documentation and timely closure of return transactions.
* Maintain proper records and trackers for all returns\-related activities.

**6\. Reporting and Business Tracking**

* Prepare and maintain regular operational reports and trackers, including:
	+ Order Tracker
	+ Returns Tracker
	+ Sales Tracker
	+ Partner\-wise operational reports
* Ensure data accuracy, timely updates, and effective tracking of key operational activities.
* Support the team with analysis and reporting requirements as required.

**7\. ERP and System Operations**

* Learn and effectively manage relevant activities on **GARPAC, Skechers' ERP system**.
* Ensure accurate and timely system transactions and documentation.
* Develop a strong understanding of internal systems and processes to support efficient ecommerce operations.

**8\. Process Improvement**

* Identify operational gaps, process inefficiencies, and recurring issues.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to improve processes, enhance operational efficiency, and strengthen controls.
* Support the implementation of standardized processes and best practices across assigned ecommerce partners.

**Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualification**

* Postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related discipline preferred. Graduates with relevant experience and skills may also be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum **4–5 years of relevant experience** in Ecommerce Operations, B2B Operations, Order Management, Supply Chain Operations, or a similar business operations role.
* Experience in managing ecommerce marketplaces, key accounts, vendor portals, order fulfilment, or partner operations will be preferred.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end ecommerce and business operations.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint**.
* Ability to prepare and maintain operational reports, trackers, and MIS.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Good understanding of order management, delivery coordination, returns, and vendor/partner portal operations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.
* Willingness and ability to learn and operate internal ERP systems, including GARPAC.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and process orientation.

**Key Attributes**

* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
* Proactive approach towards identifying and resolving operational issues.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong sense of urgency and commitment to timelines.
* Customer and partner\-focused mindset.

**About Skechers**


Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Core Operations - Assistant Vice President
description:
**About the role**

We are hiring an **Assistant Vice President (AVP)** to support the end\-to\-end business design, deployment and operational transition of the **Direct Custody model** for **Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands \& Germany and other T2S markets** . The role will translate complex client, market and infrastructure requirements into scalable target operating models, technology solutions, controls and implementation plans across securities settlement, cash and FX support, corporate actions, income, reconciliation and client/account setup.


The successful candidate will operate as a senior business\-design lead within the Direct Custody Business Design \& Deployment team, partnering with Product, Operations, Technology, Vendors, Market Infrastructures and Control Functions. Following implementation, the role may support subsequent market launches or transition into the relevant BAU Direct Custody operations.


**Why this role is important to us**

State Street is progressing a strategic transformation from sub\-custodian arrangements to direct market participation across key markets. Project requires a coordinated operating model across T2S direct markets, non\-direct and sub\-custodian routes, multiple client archetypes, account structures and market\-specific exception mechanisms.


This role is critical to:


* **Delivering controlled direct\-market implementation** through robust business analysis, requirements definition, solution design, testing and operational readiness.
* **Creating a scalable and integrated service model** across settlement and market\-facing activities, while aligning upstream processing with the existing operating model.
* **Managing client and market\-specific complexity** by distinguishing standard custody processing from exceptions requiring operating\-model, technology and control closure.
* **Building sustainable internal capability** through documented processes, training, knowledge transfer and reduced dependency on temporary project structures.

**Key responsibilities (Direct Custody aligned)**

**Market, Client and Account\-Structure Analysis**

* Analyse market rules, clients, transaction volumes, operating locations and service requirements across Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and associated non\-direct routes.
* Assess requirements for the different client archetypes and local market participants.
* Define operational requirements for Cash \& Securities Account structures
* Review existing roles and responsibilities and identify functional, process, control and ownership deltas against the target Direct Custody model.

**Target Operating Model and End\-to\-End Process Design**

* Design target\-state processes aligned to State Street capabilities and the Direct Custody Target Operating Model across settlement, cash and liquidity, corporate actions, income, reconciliation and client servicing.
* Develop scalable process flows for T2S direct markets, including Euronext Securities Milan, Clearstream Banking Frankfurt and ESES markets, and define interfaces with non\-direct or sub\-custodian routes.
* Define operating models for traditional OTC activity, ONEX flows, and applicable settlement or netting types
* Identify process dependencies, hand\-offs, exception ownership, service\-level requirements and escalation paths across internal and external parties.

**Market\-Specific Mechanisms and Exception Design**

* Define requirements, operating controls and design for market specifics like auto\-collateralisation, auto\-borrowing French registration and deregistration \& corresponding market notifications.
* Define requirements, operating controls and design for client specifics like pool creation and specialised Hold \& Release processing, including control points, eligibility logic and operational ownership.
* Support portfolio\-transfer design and market\-specific position reflection or rebuild requirements.

**Business Requirements, Technology and Vendor Engagement**

* Lead the preparation and review of business requirements, process maps, functional specifications and traceability across business, technology and vendor deliverables.
* Evaluate vendor and application capabilities, identify functional and integration gaps, and define remediation or target\-state solutions.
* Partner with Technology and vendors to drive solution design, interface requirements, data mapping, messaging, workflow and exception\-management capabilities.
* Review and approve vendor Functional Solution Documents and ensure the proposed design meets business, operational, control and market requirements.
* Maintain disciplined scope, dependency, decision and issue management, with clear impact assessment and escalation to governance forums.

**Testing, Operational Readiness and Implementation**

* Develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering standard processing, client/market variants, exceptions, controls and end\-to\-end integration.
* Coordinate system integration testing, market testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, remediation validation and regression testing.
* Own business\-readiness assessments across operating procedures, staffing, access, static data, connectivity, controls, reporting and contingency arrangements.
* Support go\-live and client\-conversion decisions through evidence\-based readiness reporting, risk assessment and stakeholder sign\-off.
* Provide implementation support, stabilisation oversight and structured handover into the Direct Custody BAU organisation.

**Risk, Controls, Compliance and Operational Resilience**

* Embed robust risk, compliance and governance requirements within the target operating model and solution design.
* Support operational resilience and business\-continuity readiness, including critical process identification, recovery requirements and BCP knowledge transfer.
* Coordinate business\-function, control and organisational\-framework setup, together with risk assessments and evidence requirements.
* Define access, security and identity\-governance requirements and ensure appropriate role design, approvals and segregation of duties.
* Ensure regulatory, market\-infrastructure and connectivity requirements are identified, documented and addressed before implementation.

**Procedures, Training and Knowledge Transfer**

* Review existing procedures and Business Process Maps to determine applicability and gaps for new Direct Custody functions.
* Develop and maintain market\- and application\-specific SOPs, control procedures, operating guides and process documentation aligned to the Target Operating Model.
* Design and deliver training on market structures, applications, operating processes, exceptions and controls for implementation, BAU and BCP teams.
* Institutionalise knowledge through structured handover, cross\-training and reusable artefacts that support future Direct Custody market launches.

**Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

* Lead assigned workstreams and provide day\-to\-day direction, quality oversight and subject\-matter support to analysts and project resources.
* Partner across Product, Operations, Technology, Vendors, Market Agents, Risk, Compliance, Client Service and other internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate workshops, drive decisions, challenge gaps constructively and communicate complex operational matters clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Act as an escalation point for business\-design and readiness issues, ensuring risks, dependencies and decisions are transparent and resolved promptly.
* Promote standardisation, automation, operational resilience and continuous improvement across the regional and global Direct Custody operating model.

**Operational analytics and reporting**

* Build and maintain implementation dashboards covering requirements, design decisions, gaps, testing, defects, controls, training and operational\-readiness milestones.
* Produce concise management reporting on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, remediation actions and readiness status.
* Support capacity, footprint and workforce planning for phased market delivery and transition into BAU operations.
* Use post\-implementation metrics and root\-cause analysis to identify opportunities for control enhancement, process standardisation and automation.

**Qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Technology or a related discipline; a master’s degree, MBA or relevant professional qualification is advantageous.
* Typically, 10\-12 years of experience in securities services, custody, post\-trade operations, business analysis, operating\-model design or complex transformation delivery, with experience leading workstreams and stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of securities settlement, cash and liquidity, reconciliation, corporate actions and income processes within a global custody or direct custody environment.
* Practical understanding of T2S, European CSD/ICSD models, Dedicated Cash Accounts, settlement messaging, market cut\-offs and exception management.
* Experience producing business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, test scenarios, SOPs, training materials and senior\-management reporting.
* Demonstrated experience in vendor engagement, application assessment, testing, implementation readiness, risk and control design, and operational handover.
* Strong communication, structured problem\-solving and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to convert complex market requirements into clear and implementable solutions.
* Working knowledge of SWIFT settlement and cash messaging and ISO 20022 is preferred

description:

title: Plant Manager
description:
**About this Position** 
 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Plant Manager to lead our manufacturing operations at our Kurkumbh plant. This role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end plant operations, driving operational excellence, ensuring compliance with safety, quality and regulatory requirements, and delivering business performance objectives.
   

  

 The incumbent will play a critical leadership role in developing manufacturing capabilities, fostering a high\-performance culture, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to achieve world\-class operational standards.
   

  

**What You´ll Do**
* Lead all plant operations, including, production, maintenance, engineering, quality
* Develop and execute long\-term manufacturing strategies aligned with business growth objectives.
* Deliver plant performance KPIs related to safety, quality, cost, delivery and productivity.
* Drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies. Ensure compliance with all legal, regulatory and Henkel corporate standards related to Safety, Health, Environment.
* Lead workforce planning, capability development and succession planning for plant employees.
* Serve as the primary company representative for local authorities, statutory bodies and employee unions/councils.
* Manage plant budgets, investment planning, CAPEX projects and fixed asset management.
* Drive implementation of Henkel Production System (HPS) initiatives and improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Foster a culture of accountability, engagement, innovation and high performance across the plant.


**What makes you a good fit**
* B.Tech Chemical/Mechanical Engineering, preferably from a Tier 1 and Tier 2 college. MBA will be an added advantage
* Minimum 10years of industry experience
* Experience of leading production in a large site (1000\+ manpower) or leading production in a small/mid size plant (30\-60 employees) in Batch process manufacturing
* Certification of Lean Six Sigma (Greenbelt) is expected.
* Industry experience in Pharma (API), Specialty Chemicals is highly preferred. FMCG can also be considered from industry where hygiene is important.
* Strong communication and presentation skills along with ability to engage the shop floor.
* High energy, pro\-active individual with strong stakeholder management abilities.


**Some perks of joining Henkel**
* Diverse national and international growth opportunities
* Global wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
* Gender\-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks
* Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares
* Best\-in\-class Group Medical Insurance policy covering employee, spouse and up to 2 children
* Competitive accident and term life policies for up to 3 times annual gross salary
* Progressive OPD policy of INR 30,000 for employee, spouse and up to 2 children


 At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We look for a diverse team of individuals who possess different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and mindsets.

title: Deputy Plant Manager
description:
**About JLG, an Oshkosh company**

**JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.**

**Job Summary**


The Deputy Plant Manager is a key member of the Pune site leadership team, responsible for supporting the safe, efficient and effective operation of the manufacturing facility.


Working closely with the Plant Manager, the role will lead day\-to\-day manufacturing performance while playing a key role in the continued growth and development of the Pune operation. The successful candidate will help build the people, processes, capabilities and infrastructure required to support a rapidly growing manufacturing facility, with a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost and customer satisfaction.


This is an opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to make a significant impact within a growing operation and a global manufacturing organisation.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Support the Plant Manager in the overall leadership and management of the Pune manufacturing facility, assuming site leadership responsibilities as required.
* Lead manufacturing operations to achieve targets across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost and employee engagement.
* Monitor production performance, labour, capacity, materials and operating costs, taking timely action to address performance gaps.
* Establish strong daily and weekly operating disciplines, performance measures and accountability processes.
* Play a key role in scaling the Pune facility to support future business growth, including workforce, capacity, equipment, layout and infrastructure requirements.
* Support the introduction and industrialisation of new products, manufacturing processes, equipment and production capabilities.
* Champion a strong safety and quality culture and ensure compliance with company standards and applicable requirements.
* Drive Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement and structured problem solving to improve operational performance.
* Support capital investment planning and business cases for equipment, technology and infrastructure required to support growth and productivity.
* Develop and coach manufacturing leaders, supervisors and team members, building the capability required for a growing organisation.
* Partner closely with HR on workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, employee engagement and talent development.
* Work collaboratively with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, HR and other functions to deliver business objectives.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to share best practices and support broader operational initiatives.
* Provide clear updates to senior leadership on plant performance, priorities, risks and improvement actions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading manufacturing operations and delivering improvements across safety, quality, delivery, cost and productivity.
* Strong understanding of Lean manufacturing, continuous improvement and structured problem solving.
* Experience leading teams through operational growth, change or increasing manufacturing complexity.
* Strong communication, people leadership, analytical and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and within a global organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within a global or multinational manufacturing organisation.
* Experience in heavy equipment, automotive, industrial machinery, off\-highway or another complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting the start\-up, expansion or significant scaling of a manufacturing operation.
* Experience with new product introduction, industrialisation or capacity expansion.
* Experience developing manufacturing leaders and building high\-performing teams.

**Oshkosh Leadership Traits**


The successful candidate will demonstrate the Oshkosh Leadership Traits through the way they lead people, manage the operation and support the growth of the business.

**Inspires Vision and Purpose \-** Connects day\-to\-day priorities to the broader business direction and creates energy around the future of the Pune operation.

**Instills Trust \-** Leads with honesty, integrity and transparency, follows through on commitments and builds dependable relationships.

**Fosters Engagement \-** Empowers people, develops capability, recognises contribution and creates an environment where teams are motivated to perform at their best.

**Cultivates Innovation \-** Challenges the status quo, encourages new and better ways of working and uses diverse perspectives and technology to improve performance.

**Customer Focus \-** Builds customer ownership throughout the operation and ensures manufacturing decisions support evolving customer needs and expectations.

**Drives Results \-** Creates accountability and urgency, removes barriers and consistently delivers meaningful results, even in challenging circumstances.

**Working Conditions**

* Based at the Pune manufacturing facility, with a strong presence required within manufacturing and operational areas.
* Flexibility to support operational requirements outside normal working hours when required.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required.
