title: Head of Retail
description:
**LENSKART** 




*Job Description* 




**Retail Leader** 




**Mission Brief** 




 Lenskart's offline retail network is one of the largest and fastest\-scaling in the world — thousands of stores across metros, Tier 2/3 India, and international markets, staffed by tens of thousands of frontline team members. This role owns a defined slice of that network.
 



 You will build the operating discipline that lets every store under your charge deliver a consistent, premium, tech\-enabled customer experience, while driving revenue and profitability with rigor. This is a P\&L\-owning, people\-leading, systems\-thinking role — for leaders who see retail not as a set of stores but as a network that gets smarter with every data point.
 



**Core Mandate** 




**1\. P\&L Ownership \& Revenue Growth** 



* **Revenue Ownership:** 
 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for the assigned store network — revenue, margin, and store\-level profitability across company\-owned and franchise stores.
* **Planning:** 
 Build and execute the network's strategic business plan, Annual Operating Plan, and financial forecasts, aligned to the broader retail strategy.
* **Performance Management:** 
 Track footfall conversion, ATV, ABS, NPS, repeat rate, and store\-level profitability through real\-time dashboards to drive decisions at speed.
* **Turnaround:** 
 Diagnose underperforming stores, identify root causes, and drive rapid turnaround plans — including restructuring or exits where required.
* **Growth:** 
 Identify and execute expansion opportunities within the network — new store openings, mall/high\-street partnerships, and franchise collaborations.



**2\. Retail Operations \& Customer Experience** 



* **Operational Excellence:** 
 Establish and drive best\-in\-class store operating standards — opening/closing SOPs, visual merchandising, inventory management, and customer service protocols.
* **Experience Ownership:** 
 Be the single point of accountability for how every store in the network feels — ensuring a consistent, premium brand experience across metros, Tier 2, and Tier 3 markets.
* **Tech\-Enabled Retail:** 
 Drive adoption of Lenskart's retail technology stack — virtual try\-on, AI\-powered lens recommendations, computer vision\-based eye testing, and omnichannel (online\-to\-offline, BOPIS) — to make every store visit smarter and more personalized.
* **Eye Test Quality:** 
 Ensure eye tests across the network meet the highest standards of accuracy, patient care, and regulatory compliance.
* **Insight\-Led Iteration:** 
 Act on customer feedback, mystery shopping audits, and real\-time NPS data to continuously elevate the in\-store experience.



**3\. Cost \& Efficiency Management** 



* **Cost Discipline:** 
 Maintain operational costs within budget while optimizing manpower costs across the network.
* **Inventory Control:** 
 Implement inventory control mechanisms to minimize shrinkage and pilferage.
* **Automation:** 
 Champion process automation — POS optimization, AI\-driven CRM, smart queue management — to boost in\-store efficiency.



**4\. People Leadership \& Culture** 



* **Talent Development:** 
 Lead, mentor, and develop Area/Cluster/Zonal Managers, Store Managers, and frontline teams — building a leadership pipeline and succession bench.
* **Hiring \& Retention:** 
 Build a world\-class retail talent pipeline through structured hiring, onboarding, L\&D, and career pathing that retains top performers.
* **Culture:** 
 Foster a high\-performance, customer\-first culture with clear accountability, recognition frameworks, and incentive structures; reduce attrition through strong ground\-level connect.
* **Alignment:** 
 Embed the Lenskart Way into every aspect of retail execution — agility, ownership, and customer obsession — while aligning network\-level goals to the broader retail strategy.



**5\. Cross\-Functional Impact** 



* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** 
 Partner with Marketing on hyperlocal campaigns and store activations; collaborate with Product, Tech, and Supply Chain to ensure inventory availability, assortment planning, and in\-store tech deployment.
* **Representation:** 
 Represent the retail network in leadership reviews and, at senior scope, in broader business discussions.



**Qualifications \& Skills** 



* **Experience:** 
 7\+ years of progressive leadership experience in offline/physical retail, with direct P\&L accountability — multi\-unit, multi\-city (and ideally multi\-geography) operations. Seniority and scope expand with the size of the portfolio.
* **Technical Fluency:** 
 Strong comfort with data, real\-time dashboards, and tech\-enabled retail operations; ability to think in systems and demand data\-driven outcomes from teams.
* **Leadership:** 
 Strong P\&L management, people leadership, and the ability to translate broader business strategy into ground\-level execution.
* **Mindset:** 
 Customer\-centric mindset, agility in a fast\-paced high\-growth environment, and willingness to travel extensively across the assigned network.
* **Education:** 
 MBA from a Tier 1 institution preferred. Backgrounds in organized retail, D2C, QSR, fashion, or lifestyle brands are a strong plus.



**Why Join Us?** 




 Lead a critical piece of one of India's largest and fastest\-growing offline retail networks, at the intersection of physical retail and AI\-driven technology. Lenskart is a founder\-led, newly\-listed (NSE: LENSKART) company with a bias for speed and impact — decisions move fast here, and so does your career. Whether the mandate is a single circle or a national portfolio, you will be building the system that makes retail smarter, store by store.

******JOB PURPOSE******
 Acts as GMR’s–operator technical authority for terminal planning across a portfolio of airports, defining processor capacities, translating traffic forecasts, preparing a design day flight schedule and calculating the peak hour passengers, reviewing consultant outputs and preparing terminal configuration layout plans to ensure capacity can accommodate demand, enable operational efficiency, meets regulatory compliance, cost effectiveness, and lifecycle scalability. Prepare project deliverables including written reports and drawing submissions.
   

  

****ORGANISATION CHART****
 Sector Head Master Planning \-\-\> AGM\- Terminal Planning
   

  

****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Terminal Capacity Planning \& Passenger Processing**
* Develop terminal processor capacities based on traffic forecasts, design day schedules, and peak\-hour analysis
* Define capacity and space requirements for check\-in, security, immigration, gates, baggage reclaim, and arrivals processing
* Establish processing rates, queue allowances, and area standards aligned with service level targets
* Ensure alignment between processor sizing, circulation space, and total terminal footprint
* Prepare terminal processor simulations with CAST and/or AirTOP Terminal programs
* Processor capacities approved within ±5% of validated peak demand
* Compliance with current IATA ADRM Level of Service standards for all key processors
* Consistency between demand forecasts, processor sizing, and terminal GFA
* Validate terminal planning configurations through simulation models


**Traffic Forecast Translation \& Peak Analysis**
* Translate traffic demand forecasts into terminal planning parameters
* Identify peak hour, busy hour, and design hour volumes for domestic and international operations
* Review and validate consultant\-provided peak analysis assumptions
* Balance capacity provisions against CAPEX, OPEX, and land constraints
* Peak\-hour definitions accepted by stakeholders without major rework
* Planning assumptions endorsed by finance and operations teams
* Optimized capacity solutions aligned with cost and land constraints


****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Additional Details****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Consultant Management \& Submission Review**
* Act as GMRs technical representative for terminal planning consultants
* Review and validate capacity models, processor calculations, and LoS analysis
* Identify overdesign, under\-capacity, or misalignment with forecasts
* Provide formal technical comments and recommendations
* 100% of consultant submissions reviewed within agreed timelines
* Reduced rework cycles on terminal planning submissions
* Early identification and mitigation of planning and capacity risks


**Landside \& Curbside Planning**
* Review terminal curbside demand estimates and modal split assumptions
* Validate dwell times, curb lengths, and forecourt layouts
* Coordinate landside planning with traffic engineering and operations teams
* Curbside sizing aligned with peak demand and modal split targets
* Reduced congestion events during peak periods
* No. of audits findings closed


**Operational Integration \& Compliance**
* Integrate inputs from security, immigration, baggage, ORAT, and airport operations
* Ensure layouts support efficient staff movement, maintainability, and automation
* Ensure compliance with IATA ADRM, ICAO SARPs, and national regulatory requirements.
* Post\-opening processor performance meets defined service targets
* Zero major regulatory non\-compliances
* Demonstrated reduction in long\-term operating costs and complexity


****EXTERNAL INTERACTIONS****
* Terminal planning consultants, architects, engineers, regulators, airlines, and security and border control agencies


****INTERNAL INTERACTIONS****
* Airport operations, ORAT, security, landside and connectivity, engineering, finance, and project delivery teams


****FINANCIAL DIMENSIONS****
 Terminal development CAPEX portfolios; lifecycle cost optimization across multiple airports
   

  

******OTHER DIMENSIONS******
* Multiple terminals and airports; cross\-functional and multi\-stakeholder coordination
* Preparing written reports and drawing deliverables for airport projects


******EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS******
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Airport Planning, Engineering, Urban Planning, Transportation or related discipline


******RELEVANT EXPERIENCE******
 7–15\+ years of increasing responsibility in airport terminal planning or airport development experience
   

  

****COMPETENCIES****
* Passenger Flow Management (Proficient)
* Passenger facility Management (Proficient)
* Terminal Operations Processes (Proficient)
* Aviation Regulations and Standards (Proficient)
* Design Thinking and Knowledge of AI, ML Technologies (Proficient)
* Performance Monitoring and Reporting (Proficient)
* Crisis and Emergency Management (Proficient)
* Financial budgeting and Resource Planning (Practitioner)
* Stakeholder Management (Internal and External) (Proficient)
* Customer Service Excellence and Complaints Management (Proficient)
* Problem Solving \& Analytical Thinking
* Strategic Orientation
* Capability Building
* Entrepreneurship
* Social Awareness
* Personal Effectiveness
* Networking
* Stakeholder Focus
* Teamwork \& Interpersonal influence
* Execution \& Results
* Planning \& Decision Making

title: Farm Manager
description:
**🌿 FARM MANAGER — JALSA FARMS** 




 Luxury Wedding • Staycation • Events • Photoshoots \| Chhatarpur, Delhi
 



  





 Jalsa Farms is a luxury private estate in Chhatarpur, Delhi, hosting weddings, intimate celebrations, staycations, photoshoots and private events.
 



  





 We’re looking for a smart, proactive and well\-spoken Farm Manager who can manage client communication \+ property operations \+ on\-ground coordination.
 



  





 ✨ What You’ll Do
 



  





**CLIENT MANAGEMENT** 




  





 Handle the first conversation with potential clients
 



 Respond to Instagram DMs, WhatsApp enquiries and calls
 



 Understand client requirements and explain the property, packages and offerings
 



 Schedule and coordinate property visits
 



 Follow up with leads and help convert enquiries into bookings
 



 Maintain client details, enquiries and follow\-ups
 



  





**CONTRACTS \& BOOKINGS** 




  





 Prepare and share booking quotations and contracts
 



 Coordinate advance payments and booking documentation
 



 Ensure all client requirements are properly recorded and communicated to the team
 



  





**PROPERTY MANAGEMENT** 




  





 Be responsible for the day\-to\-day presentation and upkeep of the property
 



 Coordinate with housekeeping, security, maintenance, vendors and staff
 



 Ensure the property is event\-ready and guest\-ready
 



 Conduct property checks before and after events
 



 Coordinate with clients/vendors during events and resolve issues quickly
 



  





**CONTENT \& SOCIAL MEDIA** 




  





 Click behind\-the\-scenes photos and videos of events, preparations and property moments
 



 Capture natural BTS content for Instagram/Reels
 



 Help create a regular flow of fresh content from the property
 



 Identify interesting moments/opportunities for Jalsa Farms' social media
 



  





**👩🏻‍💼 We’re Looking For** 




 Excellent communication and people skills
 



 Confident speaking with premium/luxury clients
 



 Well\-groomed, presentable and professional
 



 Strong WhatsApp \+ Instagram communication skills
 



 Good organisational and follow\-up skills
 



 Comfortable using Google Sheets/Docs and basic office tools
 



 Good eye for aesthetics and content
 



 Someone who is proactive and can independently handle situations
 



 Prior experience in hospitality, events, luxury properties, wedding planning or client servicing is a plus
 



 Must be comfortable working on\-site at Chhatarpur, Delhi
 



  





**💼 Role** 




 Position: Farm Manager – Jalsa Farms
 



 Location: Chhatarpur, Delhi
 



 Type: Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Experience: 1–4 years preferred
 



 Salary: ₹20,000–₹30,000/month (depending on experience)
 



  





**The Ideal Person** 




 This is not just a desk job.
 



  





 We need someone who can speak to a client in the morning, coordinate a property visit in the afternoon, make sure the lawn is event\-ready, and capture a great BTS Reel in the evening.
 



  





 If you're people\-oriented, organised, energetic, aesthetically inclined and take ownership, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 To apply: Send your CV \+ a short introduction \+ Instagram profile.

title: Executive Sous Chef - Events
description:
**Organization\- Andaz Delhi**
**Summary**
**Operational**
* Ensures that all company minimum brand standards have been implemented, and that optional brand standards have been implemented where appropriate.
* Monitors all operations, especially during peak business periods, working through the respective Head of Department to make adjustments where necessary.
* Assists in making sure that all Touches of Hyatt and the Food and Beverage Top 20 are implemented.
* Ensures that the Culinary Departments respond to the results of the Consumer Audit and to ensure that the relevant changes are implemented.
* Work closely with other management personnel in a supportive and flexible manner, focusing on the overall success of the hotel and the satisfaction of hotel guests.
* Ensures that culinary employees work in a supportive and flexible manner with other departments, in a spirit of “We work through Teams”.
* Ensures that all employees are up\-to\-date with the availability of seasonal and new products on the market.
* Tastes and monitors the food products served throughout the operation, providing feedback where appropriate.
* Works with the Materials Manager in the procurement of the best product for the best price and in the management of the relevant areas of the Commissary Kitchen.
* Works closely with the Stewarding Manager to ensure that hygiene standards are maintained and that operating equipment is cared for to maximize its useful life and to minimize breakage.


**Administrative**
* Ensures that culinary activities are aligned with the respective Corporate Strategy, and that the Hotel Actions have been implemented where appropriate.
* Represents the Food Culinary function on the hotel's Executive Committee in the absence of Executive Chef.
* Assists in overseeing the preparation and update of individual Departmental Operations Manuals.
* Conducts regular communications meetings and ensures that departmental briefings and meetings are effective and conducted as necessary.
* Ensures the smooth operation of the Culinary Departments in the absence of the Executive Chef.


**Financial**
* Maximizes employee productivity through the use of multi\-skilling, multi\-tasking and flexible scheduling to meet the financial goals of the business as well as the expectations of the guests.
* Assists to ensure that Banquets profit is operated in line with maximizing profit while delivering on the brand promise.
* Assists to ensure that each cost centre (e.g. Stewarding) operates with the lowest possible cost structure while also delivering on the brand promise to the guest.
* Assists in the preparation of the Annual Business Plan for Food and Beverage.
* Assists in monthly reforecast, involving the respective Heads of Department as appropriate.
* Assists in proactively managing costs based on key performance indicators, working through the respective Heads of Department as appropriate.
* Ensures that all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to financial record keeping, money handling and licensing are adhered to.
* Assists in the inventory management and ongoing maintenance of hotel operating equipment and other assets.
* Assists with the input and oversight of product specifications, recipes and other data as required, supporting the smooth operation of Materials Management and Cost Audit functions.


**People**
* Oversees and assists in the recruitment and selection of all Food and Beverage employees. Ensures that Kitchen managerial employees follow hotel guidelines when recruiting and use a competency\-based approach to selecting their employees.
* Oversees the punctuality and appearance of all Food and Beverage employees, making sure that they wear the correct uniform and maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, according to the hotel and department’s grooming standards.
* Maximizes the effectiveness of Heads of Department by developing each of their skills and abilities through the appropriate training, coaching, and/or mentoring.
* Conducts annual Performance Development Discussions with employees and supports them in their professional development goals
* Ensures effective training programmes for employees in coordination with the Training Manager and their Departmental Trainers.
* Encourages employees to be creative and innovative, challenging and recognizing them for their contribution to the success of the operation.
* Oversees the preparation and posting of weekly work schedules in each department, making sure that they reflect business needs and other key performance indicators.
* Supports the implementation of The People Philosophy, demonstrating and reinforcing Hyatt’s Values and Culture Characteristics.
* Ensures that all employees have a complete understanding of and adhere to employee rules and regulations.
* Ensures that employees follow all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to fire and hazard safety, and security.


**Other Duties**
* Attends and contributes to all training sessions and meetings as required.
* Is knowledgeable in statutory legislation in employee and industrial relations.
* Exercises responsible management and behaviour at all times and positively representing the hotel management team and Hyatt International.
* Maintains strong, professional relationship with the relevant representatives from competitor hotels, business partners and other organisations.
* Reads the hotel's Employee Handbook and have an understanding of and adhere to the hotel's rules and regulations and in particular, the policies and procedures relating to computer resources, fire, hygiene, health and safety.
* Ensures high standards of personal presentation and grooming.
* Responds to changes in the Food and Beverage function as dictated by the industry, company and hotel.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in similar position.
* Ideally with a relevant degree or diploma in Hospitality or Tourism management.
* Excellent problem solving and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrate a growth mindset
* Coach, mentor \& Empower T.E.A.M.

title: GM - Master Planning -
description:
******JOB PURPOSE******
 The Head – Airports Master Planning is responsible for monitoring, reviewing, and supporting the execution of the long\-term development roadmap for the airports. The role translates strategic growth objectives into integrated masterplans covering terminals, airside and cityside infrastructure. It involves reviewing technical assumptions, coordinating with cross\-functional teams, ensuring regulatory alignment, and tracking phased implementation. The position also provides planning support for commercial and connectivity projects, while maintaining documentation, compliance oversight, and reporting to leadership and regulatory bodies.
   

  

****ORGANISATION CHART****
 Sector Head\- Master Planning (Infra Planning \& Dev) \-\-\> Head\- Airports Master Planning
   

  

****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Strategic \& Technical Master Planning**
* Formulate \& implement comprehensive airport master plans including phased development aligned with forecasted air traffic, business objectives, and long\-term operational needs.
* Facilitate integration of airside, terminal, and landside planning with commercial, cargo, and support infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the sector head to periodically update the master plan to reflect demand growth, policy shifts, technological changes, and land availability.
* Monitor and advise on height restrictions, radar/NAVAID protection, and ICAO Annex 14 compliance in and around the airport.
* Adherence to Master Plan provisions


**Aeronautical Planning\- Technical Aspects**
* Plan and optimize runway orientation, length, and configuration based on wind analysis, airspace constraints, and operational requirements.
* Define taxiway network layout (parallel, rapid\-exit, loop, cross, and connecting taxiways) for operational efficiency and minimal aircraft taxi time.
* Design apron layouts to accommodate a range of aircraft types (Code C to Code F), including remote stands, contact gates, and GSE movement corridors.
* Conduct Obstacle Limitation Surface (OLS) and Protected Surface Analysis in line with ICAO Annex 14 and DGCA CARs.
* Evaluate airspace design, flight procedures, and coordinate with AAI for integration into regional air navigation planning.
* Analyze aircraft movement forecasts to assess runway and taxiway capacity using simulation tools (e.g., SIMMOD, CAST).
* Plan airside safety zones including RESA, Runway Strip, Taxiway Strips, and Blast Pads as per regulatory norms.
* Accuracy of aeronautical planning aspects
* Adherence to statutory guidelines
* No. of non\-compliance cases


**Capacity Planning \& Forecasting**
* Lead traffic forecasting for passenger, cargo, and aircraft movements using data modeling and scenario\-based forecasting.
* Conduct infrastructure capacity assessments across airside (runway, taxiway, apron), terminal (check\-in, security, immigration), and landside (access roads, parking).
* Define and validate Level of Service (LoS) standards and saturation triggers for timely expansion planning.
* Accuracy of capacity assessments


**Land Use \& Zoning**
* Optimize zoning for aeronautical, commercial, cargo, and support functions to ensure flexibility and expansion potential.
* Coordinate with urban planners and city authorities for off\-airport zoning, land acquisition, and access planning.
* Adherence to land zoning guidelines


**Design Coordination \& Implementation Support**
* Review and approve spatial layouts, concept designs, and design briefs from architects and engineering consultants.
* Drive embedding of master planning principles in detailed design and execution phases.
* Lead planning reviews during construction to address changes, phasing adjustments, or technical deviations.
* Adherence to master planning principles


****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Additional Details****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Regulatory \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Liaise with DGCA, MoCA, ICAO, AAI, BCAS, and other regulators for approvals and compliance.
* Interface with internal teams (Engineering, Commercial, Operations, Safety, ESG) to ensure alignment.
* Collaborate with airline partners, cargo operators, ground handlers, and concessionaires for infrastructure planning inputs.
* Stakeholder Satisfaction Score


**Innovation, Benchmarking \& Sustainability**
* Benchmark global best practices in airport master planning, modular terminal designs, aerodrome safety, and capacity building.
* Promote sustainable airport design, including integration of solar energy, green buildings, and efficient multimodal connectivity.
* Incorporate digital tools (e.g., BIM, GIS, digital twins) into the planning process for visualization and impact analysis.
* Innovation adoption rate


**Documentation, Compliance Review \& Reporting**
* Maintain, review, and update all master planning documents, including layouts, planning briefs, strategy decks, feasibility reports, and SOPs.

******EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS******

title: Senior Production Executive / Assistant Production Manager
description:
Assistant Production Manager / Production Manager – Food Manufacturing

**Industry:** Packaged Foods / FMCG Manufacturing

We are looking for a hands\-on production professional with relevant experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, cereals, snacks or similar food manufacturing**.

This role is not just for production supervision. The person should be capable of gradually taking ownership of **production planning, manpower, output, wastage, process control and daily factory execution**.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and execute **daily and weekly production plans** based on orders, inventory and dispatch requirements.
* Manage shop\-floor production across **mixing, dough preparation, forming, baking, cooling and packing** operations.
* Ensure achievement of **planned output, productivity and dispatch commitments**.
* Allocate manpower effectively across production lines and shifts.
* Monitor and control **yield, wastage, rework, breakage and process losses**.
* Track **plan vs actual production** and identify reasons for shortfalls.
* Monitor machine downtime, changeovers and production bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Coordinate with **QC, Stores, Maintenance, Packing and Dispatch** teams for smooth production.
* Ensure availability of raw materials and packaging materials as per the production plan.
* Maintain process consistency for products such as **cookies, biscuits, rusk, cereals and related products**.
* Troubleshoot issues relating to **dough consistency, mixing, baking, colour, texture, moisture, crispness, breakage and product variation**.
* Support **new\-product trials and scale\-up from trial batches to commercial production**.
* Maintain proper batch records, production records, process parameters and shift handovers.
* Ensure compliance with factory hygiene, food\-safety, sanitation and production SOPs.
* Coordinate basic preventive maintenance and escalate machine issues on time.
* Prepare and maintain a simple **daily/weekly production MIS** covering:
* Production plan vs actual
* Output
* Wastage/yield
* Downtime
* Manpower
* Rework
* Key production issues
* Train and develop supervisors/operators so production does not depend on one individual.
* Be capable of independently managing routine production operations in the absence of the senior production head.

Candidate Profile

* **8–10 years** of relevant experience in food manufacturing.
* Strong preference for experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, rusk, cereals, snacks or similar dry\-food products**.
* Hands\-on knowledge of **mixing, forming, baking, cooling and packing processes**.
* Understanding of food\-production variables such as **temperature, time, moisture, dough consistency, formulation variation and process control**.
* Experience managing production workers and shop\-floor manpower.
* Comfortable working in a hands\-on manufacturing environment.
* Ability to analyse production problems rather than merely escalate them.
* Working knowledge of food hygiene, GMP and basic food\-safety systems.
* Ability to maintain production records and MIS.
* Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

B.Tech / B.Sc / Diploma in:  
**Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy/Food Processing,** or relevant manufcturing qualification.

Strong practical food\-production experience can compensate for formal qualification.

What We Will Evaluate in the Interview

Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

* Production volume and number of workers previously handled.
* Examples of reducing wastage or improving yield.
* How they handle production shortfalls and machine downtime.
* How they plan manpower across multiple SKUs.
* Troubleshooting of biscuit/cookie/bakery production problems.
* Production MIS and KPIs they have personally managed.
* Examples of new\-product commercial scale\-up.
* How they would independently run production if their reporting manager were absent.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Faridabad, Haryana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in manufacturing of bakery items like cookies, rusk?
* Do you have experience in formulating new products?
* Your current CTC (will be verified)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

title: Plant Head
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Plant Head –
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Director – Manufacturing
 



**Function:** 
 Plant Operations
 



**Education:** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, or Production Engineering; MBA (preferred)
 



**Experience:** 
 Minimum 18 to 20 years in FMCG manufacturing, with 10\+ years in plant leadership roles. Must have handled operations for cosmetics and personal hygiene products such as creams, lotions, body washes and other formulations.
 



**Role Overview:** 




 The Plant Head will lead the full spectrum of manufacturing operations for cosmetics and personal hygiene products such as creams, lotions, body washes and other formulations. The role entails ownership of production, quality, regulatory compliance, engineering, EHS, and workforce management, aligned with both Egyptian local regulations and international cosmetic GMP standards (e.g., ISO 22716, FDA, EU Cosmetics Regulation)
 



**Core Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Manufacturing Operations** 



* Drive daily production to meet planned volumes, efficiency, and quality KPIs.
* Ensure adherence to GMP, ISO 22716 (cosmetic GMP), and other hygiene\-specific protocols.
* Lead continuous improvement (Kaizen, 5S, TPM, Six Sigma) across departments.



**2\. Quality, Hygiene \& Regulatory** 



* Ensure zero\-compromise hygiene standards in line with MOHP (Ministry of Health and Population), CAPMAS, and relevant EU/international regulations.
* Collaborate with Quality and Regulatory teams for product certifications and inspections.
* Manage customer and regulatory audits with full traceability and documentation readiness.



**3\. Engineering \& Maintenance** 



* Oversee preventive and predictive maintenance programs for high\-speed filling, labeling, and packing lines.
* Ensure uninterrupted utility services (compressed air, chilled water, HVAC, clean rooms).
* Lead initiatives for automation, energy savings, and digital transformation.



**4\. Supply Chain Coordination** 



* Collaborate with Procurement, Planning, and Logistics for seamless RM/PM availability and dispatch planning.
* Monitor warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, and FIFO management.
* Ensure optimal coordination for exports/imports (customs, port handling).



**5\. EHS \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Ensure plant safety policies are aligned with Egyptian Labor Law and OSHA\-Egypt guidelines.
* Conduct periodic safety drills, risk assessments, and training programs.
* Ensure waste disposal and effluent treatment meet EEAA (Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency) norms.



**6\. People Management** 



* Lead and develop a diverse workforce including Egyptian workers, shift supervisors, and expats.
* Implement structured skill development, performance tracking, and succession planning.
* Foster an accountable, collaborative, and compliant work culture.



**7\. Cost \& KPI Management** 



* Own plant\-level P\&L including energy, manpower, maintenance, and wastage cost control.
* Monitor KPIs: OEE, Yield, Downtime, Scrap %, OTIF, Safety Incidents, Absenteeism.
* Drive continuous cost improvement projects without compromising product standards.



**8\. Project Execution** 



* Support new product introduction (NPI) and plant expansion projects.
* Ensure equipment installation and validation is completed per regulatory and operational timelines.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
**The Group**
 Generac is a total energy solutions company that empowers people to use energy on their own terms. Founded in 1959, Generac is a leading global designer, manufacturer, and provider of a wide range of energy technology solutions. The Company provides power generation equipment (i.e. diesel and gas generator), energy storage systems, energy management devices and solutions, and other power products serving the residential, light commercial, data \& telecom, and industrial markets.
   

  

 Generac is a global company with approximately USD 4\.4 billion in annual revenues and direct subsidiaries in more than 18 countries worldwide. The Company continues to expand its energy technology offerings in pursuit of its mission to Power a Smarter World and to lead the evolution toward more resilient, efficient, and sustainable energy solutions.
   

  

 In India, Generac entered the market in 2019 through the acquisition of Captiva Energy Solutions, a bespoke generator manufacturer. Since then, significant investments have been made to scale operations and fully integrate the business into Generac’s global platform. The local headquarters and manufacturing facility are based in Kolkata, supported by regional and remote offices across India. Generac has ambitious growth plans for India, positioning the country as a strategic market within its global footprint.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 This is a high\-impact operational leadership role reporting to the Chief Executive Officer of Generac Captiva Pvt. Ltd. The selected candidate will have end\-to\-end responsibility for manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, quality, project execution, service operations, and Environment, Health and Safety, ensuring that operational capabilities support the Company’s commercial strategy and growth objectives in India.
   

  

 The role requires strong manufacturing leadership, disciplined execution, and the ability to build scalable processes and teams aligned with Generac’s global standards. A key objective will be to elevate the Kolkata manufacturing operation to full global quality, safety, delivery, and productivity standards, while developing the capability to support exports to other Generac subsidiaries worldwide.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the end\-to\-end operations of the Indian subsidiary, including manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, quality, project execution, service operations, and Environment, Health and Safety.
* Translate the Company’s commercial strategy and demand plan into an integrated operational plan covering capacity, production, materials, resources, inventory, projects, and service delivery.
* Drive manufacturing performance through clear operating routines and key performance indicators focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction.
* Upgrade the Kolkata manufacturing facility, processes, and quality systems to meet Generac’s global standards and enable the site to support export requirements and intercompany demand.
* Lead Sales and Operations Planning in coordination with the CEO, Sales, Finance, Product Management, and other relevant functions, ensuring alignment between market demand, production capacity, working capital, and delivery commitments.
* Strengthen supply chain resilience and supplier performance, including sourcing strategy, supplier qualification and development, material availability, inventory optimization, logistics, and cost competitiveness.
* Ensure robust project execution from order handover through engineering, procurement, production, installation, commissioning, and final customer acceptance, with disciplined management of scope, timing, cost, quality, and risk.
* Build an effective service operating model that supports installation, commissioning, warranty, preventive maintenance, spare parts availability, and responsive field support.
* Partner with global and local Engineering and R\&D teams to industrialize products, improve manufacturability, standardize solutions, manage technical changes, and align the product portfolio with operational capabilities.
* Establish and continuously improve quality management systems, root\-cause problem solving, product and process controls, non\-conformity management, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across the organization, using structured problem solving, lean principles, process standardization, digital tools, and data\-based performance management.
* Own the operations budget and operating cost base in partnership with Finance, including productivity plans, capital expenditure priorities, make\-or\-buy evaluations, cost reduction, and working capital improvement.
* Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, environmental, health, safety, product, and operational requirements, as well as Generac policies and internal control standards.
* Identify and manage operational risks, business continuity priorities, capacity constraints, supplier dependencies, and execution issues, providing timely visibility and mitigation plans to the CEO and relevant stakeholders.
* Build, lead, and develop high\-performing operational teams, strengthening accountability, succession, technical capability, cross\-functional collaboration, and a culture of safety, quality, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with the CEO and Generac global leadership, providing transparent reporting on operational performance, priorities, risks, investments, and transformation initiatives.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Proven senior operational leadership experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment, with responsibility for complex, cross\-functional operations.
* Experience in technology\-driven capital equipment businesses, such as diesel or gas generators, HVAC, commercial and industrial pumps, or comparable engineered products; knowledge of the power generation industry is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain, sourcing, quality systems, project execution, service operations, and Environment, Health and Safety.
* Demonstrated success in improving safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer service through structured operational excellence initiatives.
* Experience in scaling or transforming manufacturing operations and aligning local processes with global standards; exposure to export\-oriented operations is a plus.
* Solid financial and commercial acumen, with experience managing operations budgets, capital expenditure, product cost, working capital, and productivity programs.
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, develop management teams, and create strong cross\-functional accountability.
* Strategic vision combined with a hands\-on, execution\-focused leadership style and strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, Operations, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and international environment.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end mid\-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**
* Lead day\-to\-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.


**Mid Mile Network Operations**
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.


**Network Coordination \& Exception Management**
* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.


**Workforce \& Shift Leadership**
* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.


**Fleet, Capacity \& Resource Management**
* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.


**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.


**Safety, Security \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.


**Stakeholder Management \& Operational Communication**
* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.


**People Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on\-the\-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

  

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.


**Experience** 
 :
   

  

  

* Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N): 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid\-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 \- 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high\-volume, time\-sensitive logistics environments.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**
* Hub \& Mid Mile Operations Management
* Air \& Surface Network Operations
* Shipment Processing \& Transit Management
* Fleet Coordination \& Capacity Utilisation
* Network Planning \& Schedule Adherence
* Service Quality \& Operational Excellence
* Operational MIS \& Performance Analytics
* Safety, Security \& Regulatory Compliance
* Process Improvement \& Productivity Enhancement
* Microsoft Office \& Logistics Management Systems


**Key Competencies:**
* Operational Leadership
* Decision Making Under Pressure
* Planning \& Organising
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills
* Team Leadership \& People Development
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Customer Focus
* Accountability \& Ownership
* Adaptability \& Resilience
* Continuous Improvement Mindset


**Key Performance Indicators:**
**KRAs**
**KPIs**
 Network Performance
   

  

 On\-time departure \& arrival adherence, Network connectivity, Schedule adherence
   

  

 Service Quality
   

  

 SLAH %, Misroutes, Misconnections, Shipment processing accuracy, Scan compliance
   

  

 Hub Productivity
   

  

 Hub throughput, Vehicle turnaround time, Dock utilisation, Productivity per FTE
   

  

 Fleet \& Capacity Utilisation
   

  

 Fleet utilisation, Vehicle availability, Capacity utilisation, Dispatch efficiency
   

  

 Operational Excellence
   

  

 Exception closure within TAT, Operational audit compliance, SOP adherence
   

  

 Safety \& Compliance
   

  

 Safety compliance, Security compliance, Regulatory adherence, Audit scores
   

  

 People Management
   

  

 Team productivity, Employee engagement, Training completion, Attrition management
   

  

 Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Process improvement initiatives, Cost optimisation, Productivity enhancement, Operational efficiency gains
   

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
   

  

 Here’s what makes us stand out:
   

  

  

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


 This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work.
 **Come grow with us.**

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end mid\-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.


Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Hub Operations Management**

* Lead day\-to\-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

**Mid Mile Network Operations**

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.

**Network Coordination \& Exception Management**

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

**Workforce \& Shift Leadership**

* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

**Fleet, Capacity \& Resource Management**

* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

**Stakeholder Management \& Operational Communication**

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

**People Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on\-the\-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* **Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N):** 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid\-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* **Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M):** 4 \- 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.

* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high\-volume, time\-sensitive logistics environments.

title: Production Manager
description:
Key Job Roles

* **Production Planning**
* Prepare daily/weekly production schedules.
* Plan machine allocation based on job requirements.
* Ensure jobs are completed within the committed delivery time.
* Coordinate priorities for urgent jobs.
* **Pre\-Press Coordination**
* Coordinate with the pre\-press team for CTP/plate preparation.
* Verify paper size, GSM, ink requirements, color specifications, and imposition.
* Ensure artwork and plates are approved before printing.
* **Offset Printing Operations**
* Supervise offset printing machines and operators.
* Monitor machine productivity, print quality, registration, color balance, and wastage.
* Handle issues related to paper feeding, ink\-water balance, blanket, rollers, and registration.
* Ensure machines are utilized efficiently.
* **Post\-Press Coordination**
* Coordinate cutting, folding, lamination, binding, UV coating, stitching, gluing, and other finishing processes.
* Ensure finished products meet customer specifications.
* Coordinate with external vendors when required.
* **Quality Control**
* Maintain consistent color and print quality throughout production.
* Check proofs/approved samples and first\-off sheets.
* Reduce defects, reprints, and customer complaints.
* Implement quality\-control procedures.
* **Manpower Management**
* Allocate operators and helpers according to workload.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, and discipline.
* Train employees in machine operation, quality, and safety.
* Manage shift requirements and overtime.
* **Material Management**
* Plan requirements for paper, ink, plates, chemicals, blankets, and other consumables.
* Coordinate with stores and purchase departments.
* Minimize paper and ink wastage.
* Monitor material usage against job estimates.
* **Maintenance Coordination**
* Coordinate preventive maintenance of printing machines.
* Report breakdowns and arrange repairs with maintenance teams/service engineers.
* Maintain machine performance and minimize downtime.
* **Cost \& Productivity Control**
* Monitor production costs and machine\-hour utilization.
* Control wastage and rework.
* Track production efficiency and downtime.
* Improve overall **OEE/productivity** where applicable.
* **Documentation \& Reporting**
* Maintain production records and job cards.
* Prepare daily production reports.
* Track job status, wastage, downtime, and output.
* Report production performance to senior management.
* **Safety \& Compliance**
* Ensure workers follow printing\-press safety procedures.
* Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S practices.
* Ensure safe handling and storage of inks, chemicals, and other materials.

Typical KPIs

A Production Manager may be evaluated on:

* On\-time delivery %
* Machine utilization
* Production output
* Paper/ink/plate wastage %
* Rejection and rework %
* Machine downtime
* Production cost per job
* Productivity per operator
* Customer complaints
* Overall print quality

Required Skills

**Technical:** Offset printing process, sheet\-fed/web offset, color management, CTP/pre\-press, paper and ink knowledge, finishing processes, machine troubleshooting.

**Management:** Production planning, manpower handling, vendor coordination, cost control, problem solving, reporting, and team leadership.

**Typical experience:** For a Production Manager position, employers commonly look for **5–10\+ years of printing\-industry experience**

title: IT Operations - Manager
description:
Were proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work , a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. 
 
 Job Description - IT Operations / IT Manager 
 Location: Bangalore| Experience: 10+ years |Team: 5-8 IT professionals | User base: ~500-person IT organization 
 About the Role We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5-8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day-to-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery. 
 1. IT Operations, Service Management & Service Delivery Lead day-to-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end-user technology. Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform. Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction. Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post-incident reviews. Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities. Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues. Maintain a strong customer-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users. 2. Team Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5-8 IT support and infrastructure professionals. Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues. Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team. Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous-improvement-oriented culture. Coordinate cross-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives. 3. IT Infrastructure, Network & End-User Computing Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end-user devices. Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services. Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services. Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal. Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access-card coordination with HR. Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand. Maintain disk-capacity and infrastructure-health reports and proactively address capacity risks. 4. Cloud Management & Cost Optimization Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable. Support cloud services and customer-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources. Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps-style cost optimization. Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management. Balance on-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership. 5. Software, License, Patch & Configuration Management Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization. Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central. Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers. Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance. Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones. 6. DevOps, Git & CI/CD Operations Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices. Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable. Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties. Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams. Lead infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable. Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. 7. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls. Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management. Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities. Manage endpoint protection and antivirus/EDR platforms such as Cortex and ensure security agents remain healthy and current. Oversee identity and access management, privileged access, access reviews, endpoint security, network security, and incident response. Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and support ISO 27001 certification and audit requirements. Participate in quarterly audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and management reviews. Coordinate cybersecurity incidents, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned. 8. Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy & Governance Define and govern enterprise IT architecture standards, technology reference models, and infrastructure principles. Establish vendor evaluation frameworks and technology selection criteria. Define cloud adoption policies, technology lifecycle standards, and application rationalization roadmaps aligned with business strategy. Partner with C-suite and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and investment priorities. Present IT performance metrics, risk posture, cybersecurity status, governance outcomes, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, AIOps, and cloud platforms, and assess their operational and business value. 9. AI, AIOps & Automation Lead adoption of AIOps capabilities such as ML-based event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and automated first-line remediation. Drive AI-powered ITSM capabilities including intelligent ticket classification, AI-driven routing, NLP-based resolution recommendations, and predictive SLA-breach alerts. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, support processes, monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities. Architect and manage infrastructure for AI workloads, including on-premises GPU platforms and cost-optimized cloud AI services where appropriate. Measure operational improvements from AI and automation initiatives, including reduced downtime, faster MTTR, and lower operating cost. 10. Proactive Maintenance, Upgrades & Business Continuity Plan and execute quarterly firmware upgrades for wireless access points and network equipment. Implement and maintain automated OS patching and upgrade cycles for end-user systems and servers. Perform planned server OS upgrades and maintain application/platform upgrade schedules. Perform quarterly GitLab version upgrades with appropriate validation, backup, rollback, and change-management controls. Maintain backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience plans for critical services. Use monitoring and capacity data to identify and resolve issues before they impact users or customers. 11. Monitoring, Reporting & Operational Governance Develop and maintain monthly IT dashboards covering service uptime, Internet uptime, network bandwidth, patch compliance, license renewals, ticket performance, disk usage, cloud spend, and security posture. Produce monthly SLA and KPI reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders. Maintain operational dashboards and trend analysis to identify recurring incidents, capacity risks, cost anomalies, and improvement opportunities. Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset records, service ownership information, escalation matrices, and operational runbooks. Maintain and share access-card server details with HR in accordance with access governance procedures. 12. Procurement, Vendor & Contract Management Own procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, accessories, network equipment, and technology services. Manage vendor, MSP, telecom, cloud, and technology-partner relationships. Define and monitor vendor SLAs, KPIs, contracts, renewals, service quality, and operational performance. Lead vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, renewals, and corrective actions in collaboration with procurement and leadership. Ensure third-party services meet requirements for availability, security, compliance, performance, and cost. 13. IT Budget & Financial Management Own IT CapEx and OpEx planning, forecasting, budget tracking, and financial reporting. Manage cloud spend forecasting and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Optimize software licensing, infrastructure, telecom, support, and vendor costs without compromising service quality or security. Present technology investment proposals and cost-benefit analysis to leadership. 14. Client & Stakeholder Interaction Participate in client calls and technical discussions as required. Provide service status, operational updates, logs, evidence, and technical information to clients in coordination with relevant teams. Translate technical issues into clear business impact, resolution status, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders. Build strong relationships with business leaders, customers, vendors, and internal technology teams. Preferred Qualifications & Certifications ITIL 4 certification. ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor; CISSP or CISM is advantageous. AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications. CompTIA or other infrastructure/security certifications. TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification. PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent project-management certification. Terraform, Kubernetes, or DevOps-related certifications. Key Competencies IT Operations Leadership Infrastructure & Network Management Cloud & FinOps IT Service Management & ITIL Cybersecurity & Compliance DevOps & Automation AI/AIOps & Intelligent IT Operations Enterprise Architecture & Technology Strategy Vendor & Contract Management Budget & Cost Management Problem-Solving & Incident Management Customer Service & Empathy Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management Proactive Approach & Continuous Improvement Team Leadership & People Development Key Performance Indicators IT infrastructure and service availability / uptime. SLA compliance, ticket resolution time, backlog, and user satisfaction. Major incident frequency, MTTR, recurrence, and root-cause closure. Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance. Cloud spend against budget and measurable cost optimization. Software/license compliance and renewal management. Vendor/MSP performance against contractual SLAs. Audit findings, security compliance, and ISO 27001/ISMS performance. Change success rate and change-related incidents. Automation/AIOps adoption and measurable reduction in downtime and operational effort. Successful delivery of infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle activities, and technology roadmaps. Role Impact The IT Manager / IT Operations Lead is accountable for building a stable, secure, scalable, cost-effective, and business-aligned IT environment. The role combines strong operational discipline with strategic technology leadership, proactive service improvement, automation, cybersecurity governance, cloud optimization, and people leadership. The successful candidate will help transform IT into a highly reliable, measurable, customer-focused, and continuously improving technology function.
