title: General Manager - Operations
description:
Work Days: 6 days a week (Monday Off)
Preferred Industry: Hospitality

The Opportunity

We are seeking an accomplished and charismatic General Manager to lead our new luxury racquet club. You will be the face of our club, ensuring every aspect of the member experience reflects our commitment to excellence and luxury. This pivotal role demands a leader with a refined understanding of premium service, strong business acumen, and an exceptional ability to engage with an elite clientele.

What You'll Be Doing:

1. Club Operations & Leadership: Oversee all day-to-day operations (court management, retail, F&B, maintenance, member services), ensuring seamless execution and efficient resource management.

2. Luxury Member Experience: Develop and implement service standards focused on personalized attention, exclusivity, and supreme comfort.

3. Brand Representation: Confidently represent the PadelPark brand. Act as the primary point of contact, building strong relationships and fostering a loyal community.
Team Leadership & Development: Recruit, train, mentor, and motivate a high-performing team dedicated to exceptional service. Foster a positive and professional work environment.

4. Financial Performance: Manage the clubs budget, optimize revenue streams, control costs, and achieve profitability targets through strategic analysis and implementation.

5. Facility Management: Ensure the clubs facilities, courts, and equipment are maintained to the highest standards of luxury, cleanliness, and safety.

6. Compliance & Market Insight: Ensure strict adherence to all health, safety, and regulatory guidelines. Stay abreast of luxury lifestyle trends and competitive landscapes to enhance club offerings.

What We Are Looking For:

- Experience: 5+ years of progressive management experience, with significant time in a luxury hospitality setting (e.g., 5-star hotels, high-end resorts, premium clubs, luxury retail). 
- Sports facility experience is a plus.
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Exceptional Presence: Impeccable presentation, professional demeanor, and outstanding communication skills (verbal and written). Ability to articulate confidently and engagingly.
- Service Excellence: A deep commitment to delivering a personalized, high-touch luxury service experience.
- Leadership & Business Acumen: Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a team, coupled with strong financial literacy and strategic thinking.
- Passion for Sports: A genuine enthusiasm for sports and understanding of club dynamics is highly desirable.

Bonus Points:

- Existing network within Mumbai's luxury or HNI circles.
- Knowledge of racquet sports (Padel, Tennis, Squash).

title: Manager Workforce Management - Dialer
description:
Position Summary The Operations Dialer Manager is responsible for the planning, execution, monitoring, and continuous optimization of outbound and inbound dialing strategies supporting first-party credit card collections. This role serves as a key liaison between Collections Operations, Workforce Management, Analytics/MIS, Compliance, Technology, clients, and third-party vendors, ensuring that account inventory, staffing, contact strategies, dialer capabilities, and business objectives are aligned to maximize collections performance while maintaining operational and regulatory compliance. The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to act as a subject matter expert in dialer strategy and collections operations, capable of representing the organization in discussions with clients, technology providers, telecommunications vendors, and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate has strong experience in first-party credit card collections, understands delinquency-stage strategies and customer segmentation, and has hands-on knowledge of the LiveVox contact center and dialer platform. --- Key Responsibilities Dialer Strategy & Management Develop and execute daily, weekly, and monthly dialing strategies for first-party credit card collection portfolios. Configure and manage LiveVox campaigns, services, skill groups, dialing modes, account segmentation, and contact strategies. Determine appropriate dialing treatments based on delinquency stage, account risk, customer behavior, historical contactability, payment likelihood, and operational priorities. Optimize predictive, automated, manual, and agent-initiated dialing strategies based on portfolio requirements. Manage account penetration and attempt strategies to balance contact rates, collections performance, customer experience, and regulatory requirements. Evaluate campaign performance throughout the day and make real-time adjustments based on staffing, account inventory, penetration, contact rates, and collection results. Coordinate campaign reruns, prioritization strategies, and reassignment of account inventory when necessary. Identify opportunities to improve contact efficiency while reducing unnecessary or low-value dialing activity. --- Collections Operations Support collection strategies across various stages of delinquency, including early-stage, mid-stage, and late-stage credit card collections. Demonstrate working knowledge of key collections concepts, including: o Days Past Due and delinquency buckets o First Payment Default o Promise to Pay o Right Party Contact o Payment conversion o Account penetration o Customer contactability o Risk segmentation o Roll rates and forward flow Partner with Operations leadership to translate portfolio and client objectives into actionable dialer strategies. Identify opportunities to increase successful customer contacts and payment conversions without unnecessarily increasing dialing volume. Evaluate account inventory, staffing, agent utilization, and strategy performance to determine whether performance gaps are driven by manpower, account quality, contactability, dialer strategy, or operational execution. Provide recommendations to Operations leaders regarding staffing allocation, campaign priorities, account treatment, and contact strategy. --- Client, Vendor & Stakeholder Management Serve as a primary point of contact and dialer subject matter expert during discussions with clients, Operations leaders, technology teams, and third-party vendors. Participate in client meetings, business reviews, strategy sessions, and performance discussions related to collections and dialer performance. Present dialer performance, trends, strategy results, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Translate complex dialer and operational data into clear business insights appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences. Work directly with clients to understand portfolio objectives, performance expectations, strategy requirements, and operational priorities. Partner with Operations stakeholders to ensure dialer strategies support frontline execution and overall collections objectives. Coordinate with vendors supporting: o Dialer and contact center technology o Telecommunications services o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Phone intelligence and contactability o Data and analytics solutions Manage vendor-related issues, enhancement requests, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation activities. Evaluate proposed vendor solutions and new technologies based on operational value, cost, expected performance improvement, and implementation requirements. Coordinate testing and validation of new vendor features or dialer capabilities prior to production deployment. Escalate vendor performance, system, or service issues when necessary and track issues through resolution. Maintain productive relationships with clients and vendors while balancing operational requirements, technical limitations, compliance considerations, and business objectives. Support client inquiries and investigations involving dialer behavior, contact strategies, campaign configurations, or performance results. --- Performance Management & Analytics Monitor and analyze dialer and collections KPIs, including: o Attempts o Live Voice / Connect Rate o Right Party Contact Rate o RPC per Attempt o Promise to Pay Rate o Payment / Collection Rate o Contact-to-Payment Conversion o Accounts Worked o Penetration Rate o Average Handle Time o Talk Time o Wrap Time o Agent Occupancy o Idle / Ready Time o Abandonment Rate o Answering Machine Detection performance Perform trend, segmentation, and comparative analysis to identify opportunities for campaign optimization. Evaluate performance by delinquency segment, risk level, account population, time of day, agent group, site, and dialing strategy. Develop or support forecasting models for dialing volume, staffing requirements, contact rates, and expected collection outcomes. Conduct root-cause analysis when operational or client performance targets are missed. Develop clear recommendations and action plans based on analytical findings. Prepare performance summaries, dashboards, and executive-level presentations for internal leadership and clients. --- LiveVox Administration & Optimization Maintain strong working knowledge of LiveVox functionality, including: o Campaign and service configuration o Dialing strategies o Skill groups o Contact lists o Agent routing o Predictive dialing o Answering Machine Detection o Call disposition and result codes o Caller ID and branded calling solutions o Campaign pacing o Contact attempt controls o Reporting and Call Detail Records Troubleshoot campaign and dialing issues in coordination with Technology teams, LiveVox support, and other external vendors. Validate dialer configuration changes before implementation. Monitor system behavior to identify potential inefficiencies, routing issues, pacing concerns, or unusual contact patterns. Coordinate with LiveVox and other technology partners on platform enhancements, defects, upgrades, and new functionality. Support User Acceptance Testing and production validation for changes affecting dialer operations. --- Compliance & Risk Management Ensure dialing strategies comply with applicable company policies and regulatory requirements governing consumer communications and collections. Partner with Compliance, Legal, clients, and technology teams when implementing changes that may affect dialing frequency, calling windows, customer consent, contact treatment, or caller identification. Maintain appropriate controls around account attempts, contact frequency, time zones, phone number treatments, and calling hours. Monitor dialing activity for potential compliance risks and escalate concerns when necessary. Support audits and investigations involving dialer activity, customer contact attempts, and campaign configurations. Ensure changes requested by Operations, clients, or vendors are evaluated for potential compliance and customer-experience impact prior to implementation. --- Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as the primary dialer strategy partner for Operations leadership. Collaborate closely with: o Collections Operations o Client Leadership o Workforce Management o Business Analytics / MIS o Quality Assurance o Compliance o Information Technology o Telecommunications teams o LiveVox and other technology vendors Coordinate staffing and dialer capacity to ensure available agents are effectively utilized. Communicate strategy changes, campaign priorities, and performance expectations to Operations teams. Facilitate discussions between technical and operational stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions are practical and aligned with business objectives. Participate in performance reviews, client business reviews, strategy meetings, project discussions, and executive presentations. Influence stakeholders across multiple departments even when direct reporting relationships do not exist. --- Continuous Improvement Conduct controlled tests of new dialing strategies, account segmentation approaches, contact frequencies, campaign schedules, and dialing technologies. Measure pre- and post-implementation results to determine strategy effectiveness. Develop business cases for new dialer capabilities, vendor solutions, or process improvements. Identify opportunities for automation and improved reporting. Develop repeatable processes, dashboards, and decision frameworks for dialer management. Partner with clients and vendors to identify emerging opportunities to improve customer contactability and collection performance. Stay informed about emerging technologies affecting collections, including: o AI call screening o Branded Caller ID o Caller authentication o Predictive analytics o Customer contact optimization o Alternative communication channels o Phone intelligence and contactability solutions --- Required Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Analytics, or related field preferred. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in credit card collections, consumer finance, or contact center operations. Experience supporting or managing first-party credit card collections strongly preferred. Hands-on experience with LiveVox or a comparable predictive dialer/contact center platform. Experience interacting directly with clients, external vendors, and Operations stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to lead strategy and performance discussions with both internal and external business partners. Strong understanding of credit card delinquency and collections processes. Experience developing or managing outbound dialing strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel. Experience interpreting large operational datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and business requirements to technical teams. --- Preferred Qualifications Experience managing multiple collection segments or delinquency buckets. Experience with SQL and Snowflake or similar data warehouse platforms. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools. Knowledge of Workforce Management concepts including staffing, occupancy, shrinkage, and interval-level capacity planning. Experience with automated reporting and campaign performance dashboards. Experience working with multiple contact center locations or outsourced operations. Experience participating in client-facing business reviews and operational strategy meetings. Experience managing technology or telecommunications vendor relationships. Knowledge of branded caller identification, STIR/SHAKEN, call authentication, and telecommunications concepts. Familiarity with predictive analytics, customer segmentation, and payment likelihood models. Experience conducting vendor evaluations, pilots, testing, and implementation projects. --- Core Competencies Strategic Thinking Translates collections and client objectives into practical account and dialing strategies. Client & Stakeholder Management Builds credibility with clients, Operations leaders, technical teams, and vendors while effectively balancing competing priorities. Vendor Management Works effectively with external technology and service providers to resolve issues, evaluate solutions, and implement improvements. Analytical Decision-Making Uses data to identify performance gaps, opportunities, and appropriate corrective actions. Operational Leadership Understands the relationship between staffing, agent behavior, account inventory, technology, and collection performance. Technical Dialer Knowledge Comfortable working directly with LiveVox configurations, campaign performance, troubleshooting, and call-level data. Collections Expertise Understands the customer lifecycle, delinquency progression, contact strategies, and payment behavior within first-party credit card collections. Compliance Awareness Maintains strong controls around customer communication practices and dialing activity. Communication & Influence Able to clearly explain technical and analytical findings to frontline Operations, clients, vendors, and executive audiences. --- Key Performance Indicators Success in this role may be measured through: Improvement in Right Party Contact Rate Payment / Collection conversion Promise to Pay performance Account penetration Contact efficiency per dialing attempt Agent occupancy and utilization Dialer capacity utilization Reduction of unnecessary or unproductive attempts Achievement of portfolio and client collection targets Compliance with dialing and customer-contact requirements Effectiveness of strategy tests and continuous improvement initiatives Timely resolution of dialer and vendor-related issues Successful implementation of client and vendor initiatives Quality and effectiveness of stakeholder communication and recommendations --- Position Objective The Operations Dialer Manager is expected to ensure that the right accounts are contacted, through the right strategy, at the right time, with the appropriate level of effort and available staffing, while effectively representing the organization s dialer strategy with internal Operations stakeholders, clients, and technology partners. The role continuously balances five priorities: Collections Performance | Contact Efficiency | Agent Utilization | Compliance | Client & Stakeholder Alignment

Responsible for leading various Cash application, Cash operations and Cash accounting / Reconciliation activities within the LSEG Finance Services Operations function. Efficient daily cash management and cash positioning, working closely with Finance Services Operations and other key collaborators.

Ensure compliance with controls and processes

Improve auto matching capabilities for robust cash application for real time cash reporting. Implement AI Cash tool with Oracle Fusion to increase auto matching rates.


Lead talent in an open environment! Promote diversity through active team engagement. Develop team to improve on timelier and effective critical issues, to be initiative\-taking, problem solvers.

Prepare GL journal files for Fin Rep to review, load and approve/post.


Leading bank migrations project \& new initiatives globally working with Treasury \& Other key partners


Follow up on unresolved postings from AP, Treasury, GA \& Credit Control

Support the finance teams where volumes are high/resolution complex to ensure group important metric targets and management reporting goals are met.


Ad hoc reporting and requests from Group and/or local finance as require


**Essential Skills:**

Good understanding of controls related to activities performed.


Technical skills, including proficiency in PowerPoint \& Power BI tool.


Excellent communication (written and verbal), analytical, critical thinking, and social skills.


Good teammate and collaborative within the team and with other collaborators within the business.


Exceptional attention to detail, coupled with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing activities in a demanding environment,
Oracle, SAP, Black line, AI \- tools knowledge desirable.

10 to 12 years work experience in – AR / AP / R2R

title: Sr. Customer Operations Manager
description:
**Introduction To Demandbase**
 Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account\-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.
   

  

 As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world\-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Sr. Customer Operations Manager to serve as the operational and analytical backbone of our Customer Experience organization. This role owns the systems, processes, and insights that power our Customer Success (CS), Professional Services (PS), and Growth/Account Development (GAD) teams — from platform administration to revenue\-critical forecasting models. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on systems expertise with strong analytical rigor and the business acumen to translate raw data into decisions that shape revenue strategy.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Serve as primary administrator for ChurnZero, including platform configuration, health scoring, automation workflows, and digital touch program execution
* Administer Rocketlane for implementation and onboarding project tracking, ensuring data integrity and adoption across PS teams
* Strategize and support the Growth Account Teams as it pertains to Reporting, Account Plans and Management of their book of business
* Manage system enhancement requests with your RevOps partners who own and maintains other GTM systems (SFDC, Gong, Worktao,etc)
* Establish and maintain customer digital touch motion (automation of plays, optimizations, updates, etc)
* Develop new At Risk signals and automations for Account teams
* Be a data steward in our customer data hygiene in CRM (Salesforce) \& ChurnZero
* Optimize territory and account assignment logic across CS, PS, and GAD teams
* Drive key insights in churn analysis to identify risk patterns and inform proactive retention strategies
* Model commission structures and expansion forecasts spanning the full customer portfolio
* Develop performance KPIs and quarterly forecasting models for Growth and Renewals functions
* Build and maintain financial reporting, account management dashboards, and proactive insights used across CX and GAD leadership
* Model customer whitespace analysis to surface expansion opportunities, translating raw account data into actionable growth signals for GADs
* Identify, design, and implement AI\-driven automations to improve operational efficiency across the customer lifecycle
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to scale automation initiatives beyond manual, repetitive workflows
* Model Professional Service Capacity \& metrics around project utilization and areas of optimization


**What We're Looking For**
* 5\-7 years of experience in RevOps, CS Ops, Sales Ops, or a related operations function, ideally within B2B SaaS
* Direct technical administrative experience with ChurnZero, Rocketlane, or Gong (or comparable platforms in each category)
* Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of SQL and/or BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI)
* Demonstrated experience building forecasting models, or portfolio\-level analytics
* Proven ability to partner cross\-functionally with CS, PS, and Sales/GAD teams
* Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent CRM
* Familiarity with AI/automation tooling for operational workflows
* Background supporting post\-sale revenue motions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building process where none exists
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross\-functional communication skills
* Self\-directed with strong project management capabilities across multiple concurrent workstreams


**Benefits**
 Our benefits include Group Medical, Personal Accident, and Term Life Insurance for comprehensive protection. Preventive healthcare covers dental, vision, and OPD needs, complemented by strong mental health support. We also provide a fitness benefit, car lease policy, and gratuity for long\-term financial well\-being.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase**

title: Manager Credit Operations
description:
**About Snapmint** 




  





 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35 million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we’re reimagining how credit works—with a product\-first approach that puts the consumer experience at the center. Our EMI and Pay Later solutions are designed from the ground up to be intuitive, accessible, and frictionless—enabling millions of Indians to purchase what they need, when they need it, whether it’s fashion, electronics, or daily essentials.
 



  





 From seamless onboarding to instant approvals and zero\-cost EMIs, all our products are engineered to empower users while maintaining transparency and trust. We believe that enduring financial services are built not just on fair terms, but also on products that solve real problems with simplicity and scale.
 



 Founded in 2017, Snapmint is now India’s leading online zero\-cost EMI provider. With over 10 million consumers served across 2,500 cities—and doubling year on year—our growth is a direct outcome of building a world\-class online product that people love and rely on.
 



  





 More about us \-
 
 read here
 




  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Credit Operations professional to lead our Manual Credit Authorization function while driving operational excellence across the credit lifecycle. The role requires balancing portfolio quality, customer experience, and business growth by optimizing underwriting processes, reducing refunds and cancellations, maintaining credit performance, and strengthening grievance management.
 



 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in a fast\-paced fintech or NBFC environment and a proven track record of managing teams, improving operational metrics, and collaborating across functions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Credit Operations \& Manual Underwriting** 



* Lead the Manual Credit Authorization team responsible for underwriting exception cases and policy deviations.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
* Monitor approval, decline, and turnaround time metrics to maintain operational efficiency.
* Identify emerging credit trends and recommend policy refinements.
* An eye on fraudulent activities and taking immediate action on curing such incidents.



  





**Process Optimization \& Operational Excellence** 



* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across underwriting and credit operations processes.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement automation opportunities to improve productivity and scalability.
* Reduce operational leakage, manual interventions, and turnaround times.
* Establish and monitor operational KPIs and service\-level agreements.



  





**Portfolio Quality \& Refund Management** 



* Drive initiatives to reduce loan cancellations, refunds.
* Balance business growth objectives with portfolio quality and risk management.
* Partner with Risk, Product, and Business teams to improve customer onboarding and approval journeys.
* Ensure reduction in operational losses while maintaining target default and delinquency levels.



  





**Customer Grievance \& Escalation Management** 



* Own credit\-related customer grievances and escalations.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis of complaints and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure timely resolution of regulatory and customer escalations.
* Build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track complaint trends and recurring issues.



  





**System Monitoring \& Product Collaboration** 



* Identify system defects, process gaps, and operational issues impacting credit decisions or customer experience.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to prioritize fixes and enhancements.
* Provide business requirements and operational feedback for new product launches and process changes.
* Drive UAT and operational readiness for system releases impacting credit operations.



  





**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop a team of credit analysts and operations executives.
* Establish performance management frameworks and coaching mechanisms.
* Foster a culture of accountability, customer\-centricity, and continuous improvement.
* Build organizational capability to support rapid business growth.



  





**Key Metrics** 



* Manual underwriting productivity and TAT
* Approval and conversion rates
* Refund / cancellation rate
* Portfolio delinquency and default metrics
* Customer grievance resolution TAT
* Operational accuracy and quality scores
* Team productivity and SLA adherence



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* **5–10\+ years of experience in Credit Operations, Underwriting, Risk Operations, or Lending Operations.**
* Prior experience in fintech, digital lending, BNPL, consumer finance, or NBFC environments.
* Strong understanding of KYC, CKYC, credit bureau data, fraud controls, and lending operations.
* Proven experience managing operational teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to derive insights from operational data.
* Comfortable working in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities.



  





**Preferred Skills**

 Global Clinical Supply Chain
   

  

**Business Unit**
 Global External Manufacturing and Supply Chain \- Biologics
   

  

**Job Grade**
**Location :**

 At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you
 **“Create your own sunshine”**

**Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**
 As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self\-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead operational supply set\-up and follow\-up for one or more clinical studies, from protocol input through to study close\-out and reconciliation, ensuring investigational product supply is not on the critical path.
* Serve as the primary supply chain interface with the clinical study team (Global Study Manager/Lead, Local Delivery Lead, Quality…), following STOM principles and supporting asset\-level supply strategy in partnership with the Clinical Manufacturing and Supply Chain (CMSC) Workstream Lead.
* Review and challenge clinical protocols with respect to IP supply, ensuring supply feasibility, identifying constraints, and agreeing supply options and risks with study teams before study initiation.
* Develop, implement and maintain IP demand and supply plans for each assigned study, modelling demand from patient enrolment forecasts, treatment regimens, duration and protocol design, and keeping plans up to date as studies progress.
* Define and manage depot and pack site inventory policies and collaborate with worldwide depots to meet in\-country requirements, including management of IP expiry, extensions, replenishment and destruction strategies.
* Ensure label content and data are defined in the appropriate systems; liaise with labelling and packaging experts on pack design and components; and ensure appropriate IRT contracts and study set\-up are in place, including packing and distribution strategies and IVRS/IWRS specifications as applicable.
* Execute supply plans to deliver on published study milestones with consistent, on\-time, compliant delivery to patients, while minimising waste and ensuring timely communication and escalation of supply issues.
* Lead complex problem solving across technical, quality, regulatory and operational dimensions without compromising quality, cost or delivery, maintaining appropriate documentation in accordance with GxP and the Trial Master File (TMF).
* Monitor study KPIs, identify trends and implement corrective and preventive actions, contributing to continuous improvement of supply chain processes and ways of working.
* Oversee externalised supply chain activities by creating study\-specific technical agreements, providing inputs to vendor proposals and proactively identifying and resolving obstacles with external partners.


**Travel Estimate**
 Minimal travel
   

  

**Job Requirements**
**Educational Qualification**
 University degree in life sciences, pharmacy, logistics, engineering or related field.
   

  

**Experience**
 Minimum 3 years’ experience in clinical supply management, clinical operations or logistics for clinical trials.

title: Team Lead, Post Fixture
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Post Fixture Team Lead will oversee the full lifecycle of vessel operations following the conclusion of a fixture. This role requires a strategic leader to manage a team, optimize voyage P\&L, and ensure strict compliance with Charter Party (C/P) terms. You will be the primary point of contact for complex disputes and the lead expert for the company's IMOS commercial management system.
   

  

 This role entails overseeing all Post fixture duties right from the time when a vessel is fixed on a voyage or time charter basis till the completion of the voyage and settling of all accounts with charterers or Owners. Liaising closely with Operations, Commercial \& Finance departments for successful execution of this role.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Execution \& IMOS Management**
* Oversee the entry and maintenance of all fixture data into IMOS, ensuring 100% accuracy for financial reporting and voyage tracking.
* Monitor vessel schedules, and off\-hire events within the system.
* Liaise with IT/Operations/Commercial/ Finance teams to implement IMOS workflow improvements.


**Post\-Fixture Management**
* Manage end\-to\-end post\-fixture activities for time charter and voyage charter contracts.
* Manage the issuance of hire/freight invoices and oversee the diligent collection of Accounts Receivable (AR).
* Sending out notices of delivery / redelivery as per CP.
* Sending notices of arrival to voyage charterers as per booking / fixture note requirement.
* To supervise and perform complex Laytime/Demurrage calculations and lead negotiations for final settlements.
* Ensure compliance with charter party terms and identify any contractual risks.
* Review Vendor invoices, Proforma Disbursement Accounts (PDA) and Final Disbursement Accounts (FDA) to maximize voyage earnings.
* Liaise with brokers, charterers/ owners, agents and vendors to make arrangements for timely charter hires/ SOAs, PDA / FDA/ vendor invoice arrangements as per company’s requirements
* Track and report voyage results and deviations to management.
* Optimize resource utilization and propose strategies to enhance operational efficiency


**Documentation \& Compliance**
* Create and /or update vendor details (Owner/Charterer/Agent/Supplier) in MDG for approval and timely payments. Conduct proper sanction check for vendor in line with Risk Management's requirements.
* Preparing voyage Charter Parties based on the main term recap and proforma CP
* Maintain accurate records of voyage documentation and file vessel\-wise promptly in Sharepoint folders.
* LOI logs creation and filing.


**Key Requirements**
* Experience: Min. 8 to 10 years of direct experience in a post\-fixture role within the shipping industry, with at least 3 years supervising 2\-3 team members.
* Technical Proficiency: Advanced, hands\-on experience with IMOS (Veson Nautical) is mandatory. Familiarity with other shipping platforms (e.g., Shipnet, Diabos) is an advantage.
* Contractual Knowledge: Good understanding of maritime law, C/P clauses, and international shipping regulations.
* Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills to manage diverse stakeholders including Owners, Charterers, and Brokers.
* Education: Diploma/Degree in Maritime Studies or related field

title: Crew Management Partner
description:
**Location Country** 
 India
   

  

**Work Location** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Who are V?** 
 As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals \- people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Overall Purpose of The Job**
* The role ensures compliance with customer agreements, budget ownership, workforce planning, engagement, crew retention, and service delivery. This position acts as the primary interface between Seafarer, Fleet Management, Crewing Operations, and external stakeholders, ensuring execution of crew\-related activities.


**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**Crew Management \& Service Delivery**
* Ensures all duties and responsibilities are carried out in accordance with VMS, national and international statutory requirements.

* Functions as the escalation point for all crew\-related matters, collaborating with Fleet Managers and Crewing Operations to resolve issues.
* Ensures that Crew Management delivers on KPIs agreed upon between client, Fleet Cells, and Crew Management, including budget ownership for crew operations.
* Ensures the diligent usage of ShipSure as the system of record for all crewing activities and drives it with other teams for their crew and vessels.


**Crew Planning \& Workforce Management**

* Maintains an effective crew rotation plan for assigned vessels, ensuring consistency with global planning principles and as guided by Global Pool Managers.
* Identifies candidates for vacancies using fleet crew pools and recruitment when needed. Escalates critical vacancies to RCMP and Global Pool Manager when necessary.
* Works proactively and as guided by the Global Pool Manager to maintain and balance crew pool strength, including managing crew surpluses and reallocations.
* Supports fleet takeovers by identifying suitable seafarers for vessel transition.
* Works closely with the Global Pool Manager and supports building career progression plans for seafarers and ensures performance monitoring through appraisals.

**Budget Management \& Operational Efficiency**
* Owns and manages the Vessel budget, including annual renewals, negotiation with customers and reporting.
* Owns and manage budget preparation by providing insights on wages, benefits, and crewing costs in collaboration with the P\&L team.
* Schedules and reports on service performance and budget reviews, recommending actions to support continuous improvement.


**Compliance, Industrial Relations \& HSSEQ Support**
* Ensures compliance with maritime regulations, flag state requirements, and industrial relations for assigned fleets.
* Manages urgent crew changes and vacancies through the effective utilization of the V.Ships seafarer pool.
* Assists HSSEQ in accident investigations related to crewing and supports the implementation of corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive data quality and comply with Quality Assurance process (Audit)


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Process Improvement**
* Participate in the new business proposal preparation and review as well as new business onboarding process.
* Collaborates proactively with internal and external stakeholders, including seafarers to ensure outstanding service delivery.
* Be familiar with and promote V.Group and Marine HR services and initiatives.
* Provides feedback on ShipSure enhancements and other crewing process improvements.
* Works digitally with V.Crew Connect, ShipSure BI, and other digital tools to streamline operations.
* Delivers client reports, ensuring transparency and data\-driven insights into seafarer management and operational performance.


**What can I expect in return?** 
 V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector \- a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
   

  

**Essential**
* Maritime or shipping industry experience

* Proven customer service mindset and ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational, and problem\-solving skills.

* Ability to manage budgets, reports, and performance KPIs effectively.

* Good technology and data analysis proficiency.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in ShipSure and planning tools functionality.
* Multinational work experience


**Applications Close Date**

title: Vessel Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 The Vessel Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable and economical operation of assigned vessels. The position applies knowledge of engineering, HR\-management, shipping\-industry regulations, commercial and legal considerations, and guides sea\-staff onboard assigned vessels. The Vessel Manager also takes initiative to continuously improve the performance of assigned ships and strengthens the teamwork between ship and office.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* To be familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS).  In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members either of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Guides, advises, and monitor vessel operations; also assists crew performing vessel maintenance
* Researches technical information related to equipment breakdowns, malfunctions, improvements, upgrades or modifications for the reliable long\-term performance of the vessels
* Prepares for scheduled dry dockings, surveys and repairs on assigned ships, and arranges and manages supply of spares, stores, and services to vessels before scheduled maintenance and breakdown repairs
* Manages vessels in full compliance with local and international rules and regulations; and with Seaspan’s Safety Management System (SMS)
* Analyses ships’ performance and relays this information to the onboard master and chief engineer; ensures compliance with current charter\-party terms of employment and other commercial concerns
* Ensures compliance with all necessary operational certification and survey requirements applicable to assigned vessels
* Visits vessels port; may sail with Seaspan ships to reasonably ascertain that they are operated in a safe, reliable and economical way
* Monitors function and performance during ship visits and initiates effective problem solving of on\-board issues, including technical, quality\-assurance, health and safety, commercial or personnel issues
* Takes ownership of on\-board issues and follows them through to resolution
* Prepares budgets in the required detail for the yearly operation of assigned ships, scheduled dry dockings, surveys, repairs and ad\-hoc modifications and repairs within required timelines
* Monitors expenses of assigned vessels and submits monthly variance reporting and tracks against budget
* Ensures that all reporting employees adhere to company policies and procedures
* Communicates expectations to direct reports; manages performance and provides leadership and support to team members
* Demonstrates commitment to Seaspan’s Maritime Resource Management values
* Performs other duties as required


**Requirements:**
* Must have at least one year of experience as a technical superintendent in a company managing handy\-max sized (or larger) vessels engaged in international trading and must have a minimum of one full year in rank as a chief engineer or have completed three contracts as a chief engineer with Seaspan
* English language skills, both verbal and written, must be effective and suitable for a multi\-cultural working environment
* Strong technical knowledge
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
* Class 1 marine engineer certificate
* Degree in marine engineering or equivalent


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Experience working with container ships
* Education in mechanical engineering or naval architecture
* Previous experience with new\-builds and dry\-dockings preferred


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**
* Regular international travel is required and may be on short notice
* Must have mobility to conduct vessel inspections
* Will be required to carry a mobile device and check regularly outside of office hours
* Must maintain a home internet connection for work outside of office hours


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

title: Business Manager (Growth Track) – Atleisure by Roology
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Andheri West)
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Reports to:** 
 Founder
 **Team:** 
 1 intern will report to this role
 **Start date:** 
 October 1, 2026
 **Compensation:** 
 ₹25,000/month for the first 3 months, reviewed alongside the promotion decision below
 


 About Atleisure
 
 Atleisure by Roology is the newest label from Roology, a Mumbai\-based D2C womenswear brand. Atleisure is built around ease, not hustle — elevated comfort wear for women who are done performing productivity 24/7\. We're early\-stage, fast\-moving, and building the brand and the business at the same time — which means this role won't look like a "job description" for very long. It'll evolve as fast as you do.
 


 About the role
 
 We're hiring a generalist who wants to grow into a true Business Manager role — someone who can sit across operations, marketing, and finance in these early months, acting as the connective tissue between the founder, our vendors, our PR/social team, and everyone else keeping Atleisure running day to day. You'll also have an intern working under you from day one — so alongside learning the business, you'll be getting your first experience directing someone else's work.
 



 This is deliberately a
 **growth\-track role** 
 : you'll start hands\-on across all three functions, learning the business from the inside out. Based on performance, you'll be formally reviewed for promotion to
 **Business Manager within 3 months** 
 — with a compensation review at the same time — taking on greater ownership and ambiguity as you prove you can run with it.
 



 If you're early in your career and the idea of learning ops, marketing, and finance simultaneously at a founder's side — rather than being boxed into one narrow function — genuinely excites you, this is built for you.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Operations** 



* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations — vendor follow\-ups, order fulfillment tracking, inventory coordination
* Handle customer queries and support — order status, pre\- and post\-sales questions, and escalations
* Direct and check in on the intern's work, making sure their output actually moves things forward
* Act as the point of contact between the founder and external teams (PR, vendors, freelancers), making sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Document processes as you learn them, so the business runs on systems, not on memory



**Marketing** 



* Own the weekly content/posting calendar in coordination with our social/PR team, keeping Instagram active and on\-schedule
* Track campaign and content performance, flag what's working and what isn't
* Support influencer and PR outreach coordination



**Finance** 



* Track expenses, vendor payments, and basic budget\-vs\-actuals
* Support the founder in monthly financial reviews and reporting
* Flag discrepancies or gaps early, rather than after they've become a problem



**Mediator, across all of it** 



* Translate the founder's priorities into action across teams, and surface what each team needs back up to the founder
* Keep multiple moving parts (marketing, ops, finance, external vendors) talking to each other instead of operating in silos


 What we're looking for
 
**Skills** 



* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the go\-between for multiple people and functions, and customer\-facing at times
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking and reporting
* Organized, detail\-oriented, able to juggle several open threads without dropping any
* Basic familiarity with Instagram/social platforms and e\-commerce (Shopify) is a plus, not a requirement



**Attitude** 



* Genuinely seeks to learn — asks questions, follows up, doesn't wait to be told twice
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a startup pace where the job description shifts as the business does
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions on everything, and comfortable owning an intern's output as well as your own
* Resilient — early\-stage brands have setbacks and false starts, and we need someone who treats that as normal, not alarming



**Knowledge / background** 



* No prior experience in a specific function (ops, marketing, or finance) is required — full training will be provided
* Any prior exposure to D2C/e\-commerce, retail, or a startup environment is a bonus, not a must
* Freshers and early\-career candidates (0–2 years) are welcome to apply


 Why join
 * Direct mentorship from the founder, with real exposure to how a D2C brand is actually built and run
* Early people\-management experience — you'll have an intern supporting you from day one
* A defined growth path — a formal shot at the Business Manager title (and a compensation review) within your first 3 months, not a vague "maybe someday"
* The chance to shape a young brand's systems from the ground up, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook
* Part of the Roology family — access to the learning, processes, and network of an already\-running sister brand


 How to apply
 
 Email us at arushi@atleisureculture.com

 The

* Ensure delivery quality across assigned workstreams, including scope management, stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and executive reporting.

* Work with cross\-functional teams to define data, integration, and governance considerations required for AI\-enabled service transformation.
* Identify opportunities to build accelerators, prototypes, and reusable methods for AI\-enabled service discovery, solution design, and benefits tracking.


**Leadership \& People Development**
* Manage small to mid\-sized project teams or workstreams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables, structured problem solving, and timely execution.
* Coach consultants and analysts on service transformation methods, requirements structuring, stakeholder engagement, and AI\-led operating model design.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**

BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 BDO India is seeking a detail\-oriented and process\-driven Assistant Manager – CRM Data Management \& Operations to oversee the integrity, quality, and governance of customer and business development data within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365\).
 



  





 The role will be responsible for driving CRM data quality initiatives, managing stakeholder data requests, ensuring compliance with Master Data Management (MDM) standards, supporting user onboarding and access management, and partnering with internal teams to continuously improve CRM processes and data governance practices.
 



  





 This position requires strong analytical capabilities, hands\-on CRM administration experience, stakeholder management skills, and a proactive approach to driving operational excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**CRM Data Governance \& Quality Management** 



* Ensure the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of CRM data across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Quotes, and Orders.
* Conduct regular audits of CRM records against defined MDM standards and implement corrective actions to address data quality gaps.
* Lead data cleansing, de\-duplication, validation, and enrichment initiatives to improve overall CRM data health.
* Maintain and monitor CRM data quality scorecards, identifying trends, risks, and areas requiring remediation.
* Track compliance with CRM data entry standards across business units and prepare periodic management reports.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen governance controls.
* Maintain documentation including data dictionaries, governance guidelines, audit logs, and process documentation.



  





**CRM Operations \& Data Request Management** 



* Manage the firm's CRM Data Request Management process, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of stakeholder requests.
* Review and approve account creation requests in line with established governance protocols.
* Facilitate backend creation and maintenance of Accounts, Contacts, and Leads within D365\.
* Ensure adherence to defined service levels for all requests:
* Standard Requests – Within 3 business days
* Priority Requests – Within 1 business day
* Monitor request queues, maintain tracking logs, and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Analyze request patterns and identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and enhance self\-service capabilities.
* Develop and maintain reusable reports, dashboards, and data assets to support business development and leadership requirements.



  





**Stakeholder \& User Management** 



* Act as a key point of contact for CRM\-related data queries and support requests from Partners, Directors, and business teams.
* Support onboarding and offboarding of CRM users, ensuring appropriate role\-based access and security controls.
* Collaborate with the Digital Office and relevant teams on data migration activities, system enhancements, configuration updates, and process improvements.
* Conduct user awareness sessions and promote adherence to CRM data governance standards and best practices.



  





**Reporting \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports on data quality metrics, request turnaround times, compliance levels, and governance KPIs.
* Support the CRM Governance Lead in implementing data quality initiatives and governance frameworks.
* Identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness and user experience.
* Participate in CRM enhancement projects and contribute to the evolution of data governance capabilities within the firm.



  





**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in CRM Operations, Data Management, Data Governance, or CRM Administration.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (preferred) or similar CRM platforms.
* Strong understanding of CRM data management, data quality, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI.
* Experience in data cleansing, de\-duplication, reporting, and maintaining data integrity across large datasets.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and committed to data accuracy and governance.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within defined SLAs.
* Excellent communication skills and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

title: Senior Manager MEP- (PPM Consultant)
description:

**Role description:**
 The Senior Manager – MEP will lead MEP design, coordination, and project management activities for major international construction projects. This role is part of the Design Assurance \& Value Engineering (DA\&VE) team within the Client’s Centre of Excellence (COE) Team and is responsible for ensuring designs align with client briefs, project goals, and industry standards, while driving innovation and sustainability across all MEP services. The position demands technical oversight, strong stakeholder engagement, and effective contribution to project delivery within a global, multidisciplinary environment. This role will be providing services on a variety of large programs being undertaken globally. Accordingly, this role must be prepared to work hours appropriate to a global delivery model.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Design Coordination \& Discipline Integration: Review and validate MEP designs, drawings, and calculations to ensure alignment with the client brief while coordinating with architectural and structural disciplines to resolve clashes and ensure seamless system integration.
* Techno\-Commercial Analysis: Conduct comprehensive techno\-commercial evaluations of MEP schemes and innovative technologies, ensuring that all adopted strategies are cost\-effective, high\-performing, and aligned with the project's commercial design intent.
* Strategic Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the primary technical link between client teams, consultants, and senior management, translating complex technical MEP concepts into transparent project updates and actionable insights.
* Value Engineering \& Sustainability Innovation: Drive value engineering initiatives to identify cost\-saving opportunities and integrate sustainable design principles, energy\-efficient measures, and smart building technologies across all MEP systems.
* Technical Oversight \& Quality Assurance: Oversee the integrity of technical specifications within tender documentation and ensure all designs comply with international building codes, safety regulations, and professional ethical standards.
* Commissioning Strategy \& Handover: Lead the commissioning, testing, and verification process of MEP systems to ensure peak performance and manage the successful handover of documentation and system designs to the Capital Management team.
* Project Governance \& Risk Mitigation: Manage the flow of technical information between external contractors and internal teams, while contributing to the project risk register to identify and mitigate potential MEP\-related operational challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* A Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering is the minimum educational requirement.
* A minimum of 10 to 12 years of experience in MEP design, coordination, project management and Commissioning management.
* Experience working on the client side, or within a consultancy role, managing the client's interests and acting as their representative, is highly valued.
* Demonstrating a strong understanding of MEP systems (High side \& low side), including HVAC, Electrical, Firefighting, IBMS and plumbing systems, along with a deep familiarity with relevant international building codes, standards, and regulations, is essential.
* A good grasp of the construction process, including site issues, coordination with contractors, and installation oversight, is crucial.

title: Head of Information Technology
description:
**About Us:** 
 Heather Grey is a global uniforms supplier to top brands in Food Service, Hospitality, and Aviation – McDonald’s, KFC and Hilton Hotels being just some examples.
 



 We’ve been in the business for over 20 years and have consistently grown from a team of 2 people to over 150 today. We’re well known amongst the clients we serve and come with some brand recognition.
 



 Our office at Peninsula Corporate Park in Lower Parel is our beating heart – with high energy, intelligent, and motivated colleagues, and a dynamic work environment with tight collaboration across domains. You have to see it to feel it!
 



  
 



**Skills and Role:** 
 You will own technology at Heather Grey – both keeping the things we already run working, and building the things we don’t have yet. We don’t have specific requirements for your background – we just need you to be hands\-on, curious about how the business actually works, and comfortable being the person everyone comes to when something breaks.
 



 Some things you will be doing at work are –
 



 1\.   Own our systems end to end – ERP, orders, production and inventory data – and make sure they tell us the truth
 



 2\.   Build or buy what we’re missing, and automate the work our teams currently do by hand
 



 3\.   Connect us to our customers’ systems – portals, EDI, forecasts – so orders flow without someone re\-typing them
 



 4\.   Keep the basics solid – devices, networks, access, backups and security across our offices and partner sites
 



 5\.   Manage our vendors and budgets, and be honest about what’s worth paying for
 



 6\.   Sit with the leadership team on where technology should take us next
 



  
 



**Education and Experience:** 
 We don’t care so much about degrees or years of experience, so don’t let the list below deter you from applying, but generally, these might be helpful indicators that you’re the right person for the job \-
 



 1\. Engineering, computer science or equivalent
 



 2\. 5\+ years of work experience, some of it owning systems rather than just supporting them
 



 3\. Have worked with an ERP or similar business system, ideally in manufacturing, retail or supply chain
 



 4\. Can still get your hands dirty – a script, a query, a spreadsheet that does the job

**Franchise Area Manager**

 Franchise Operations

 Senior Operations Manager / Head – Franchise Operations

title: Credit Risk Operations Team Lead
description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The credit risk operations team plays a critical role in ensuring a healthy financial ecosystem for businesses around the world. This team will directly impact the company's bottom line and growth capabilities by supporting new and emerging businesses. The Credit Operations team is responsible for conducting credit risk assessments, underwriting small and mid\-size users, and proposing mitigation strategies that enable Stripe to take smart risks for our users.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 In this role, you will manage and develop a group of Credit Risk Operations Associates that are focused on commercial credit underwriting and risk mitigation. The Credit Risk Operations Team Lead will cultivate the engagement of their team members while guiding them to be the best they can be, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and advocacy within the organization. This means helping to set team goals, and using metrics to efficiently measure and guide team performance in pursuit of those goals. To be a fit, you will have a strong operations mindset, possess a deep understanding of commercial credit risk, be able to move quickly, and be passionate about delivering an incredible user experience.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage, coach, and develop a new team of in\-office Credit Risk Operations Associates
* Execute on commercial credit underwriting frameworks that allow your team to evaluate business models and financial statements of successful venture\-backed startups to established entities
* Guide your team to identify commercial credit risk and propose risk mitigation strategies
* Drive strong operational delivery and process improvement helping to maintain credit risk tolerance and balance credit loss and customer experience
* Build a great culture and ensure team members are happy, effective, and growing in their career
* Set clear goals and direction, and provide regular feedback on team members’ performance
* Be data\-driven in your analysis of performance, and in your decision making
* Transmit and foster our values, serving as a beacon of Stripe’s user\-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment
* Manage operational performance to deliver KPIs
* Manage capacity and scheduling to ensure adequate coverage
* Help resolve roadblocks and issues as they arise
* Act as a point of escalation for complex credit underwriting reviews


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* A minimum of 6\+ years of experience with commercial credit underwriting, financial statement analysis, risk modeling and cash flow forecasting
* The ability to transform business and financial data into a cohesive narrative that outlines potential credit risks and presents dynamic mitigation strategies
* At least 2\+ years of direct people management experience
* Leadership skills, strong analytical abilities, and excellent communication skills are essential
* An ability to partner effectively with internal globally distributed stakeholders

* Identify defects and ensure rectification within defined timelines.
* Conduct pre\-handover quality inspections.
* Maintain a strong focus on finishing quality and attention to detail.
* Client Coordination
* Act as the primary execution point of contact for the client wherever required.
* Provide clients with regular updates on project progress.
* Coordinate site visits and execution\-related discussions.
* Understand and address client concerns professionally.

title: Senior Manager, Global Production Planning
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
**ABOUT FLUENCE**
 Fluence, a Siemens and AES company, is the global market leader in energy storage technology solutions and services. Fluence is creating a more sustainable future by combining the agility of a technology company with the expertise and vision of two respected industry leaders.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sr. Manager, Global Production Planning leads Fluence’s global production planning function across the contract manufacturing network. This role translates business priorities and customer demand into executable production plans by balancing material availability, manufacturing capacity, contractual commitments, operational constraints, and risk.
   

  

 Operating at the M5 people\-leader level, the role manages multiple related planning teams or workstreams, establishes departmental priorities, allocates resources, and implements strategic planning policies. The Sr. Manager also owns global Clear\-to\-Build (CTB) governance and executive reporting, ensuring leaders have accurate visibility to manufacturing readiness, constraints, recovery plans, and decisions required to protect business outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Production Planning and Strategy**
* Lead the global production planning function across manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers, establishing priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations aligned with business objectives.
* Develop and govern an integrated production plan that balances customer demand, contractual delivery requirements, material availability, factory capacity, labor, logistics, and other operational constraints.
* Implement strategic planning policies, methods, and evaluation criteria; assure adherence to approved schedules, work plans, budgets, and performance requirements.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and longer\-range planning reviews, converting complex data and organizational objectives into clear decisions, trade\-offs, and actions.
* Identify systemic production risks and direct scenario analysis, mitigation, escalation, and recovery planning to protect customer and business commitments.


**Clear\-to\-Build Management and Executive Reporting**
* Own the global CTB process, governance, definitions, reporting cadence, and accountability model across the manufacturing network.
* Consolidate factory readiness, material availability, capacity, and schedule information into an accurate global CTB view with clear assumptions and data ownership.
* Provide concise executive reporting on production outlook, material and capacity constraints, schedule exposure, recovery options, and decisions required.
* Drive improvements in CTB data quality, planning\-system integration, reporting automation, and forecast accuracy.
* Ensure critical issues are escalated with quantified business impact, accountable owners, decision dates, and executable recovery plans.


**People Leadership and Resource Management**
* Lead, hire, develop, and retain a high\-performing global planning team; set clear goals, define roles, manage performance, and build succession and capability plans.
* Manage multiple related planning teams or workstreams, set departmental priorities, and allocate resources to the highest\-value business needs.
* Coach managers and planning professionals in decision quality, stakeholder influence, structured problem solving, and executive communication.
* Establish measurable team objectives and operating metrics, and hold the organization accountable for delivery, quality, and continuous improvement.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership and Planning Excellence**
* Persuade managers and senior leaders to take action on complex, sensitive planning matters and negotiate effectively with external manufacturing partners, vendors, and suppliers.
* Build strong formal networks across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Program Management, Commercial, Finance, Quality, Engineering, and contract manufacturing partners.
* Standardize global planning processes, governance, controls, and operating procedures while enabling appropriate regional and site\-level execution.
* Lead cross\-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen planning maturity, decision speed, resilience, and scalability across the manufacturing network.
* Support strategic capacity, footprint, supplier, and operational\-readiness initiatives required for business growth.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Typically 12\+ years of progressive experience in production planning, supply planning, manufacturing operations, or integrated business planning, including significant global or multi\-site responsibility.
* Demonstrated people\-leadership experience, including responsibility for hiring, goal setting, performance management, development planning, and resource allocation across related teams or workstreams.
* Proven experience leading production planning within a contract manufacturing and supplier network environment.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex operational situations using in\-depth knowledge of organizational objectives and translate findings into strategic policies, priorities, and executable plans.
* Executive\-level communication and influence skills, including the ability to persuade leaders, navigate sensitive trade\-offs, and negotiate with external partners.
* Experience establishing planning governance, performance metrics, schedules, work plans, and budget accountability.
* Strong capability in scenario planning, risk management, recovery planning, data quality, and planning\-process automation.
* ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification preferred.


**LEADERSHIP IMPACT**
 Success in this role is measured by the reliability and transparency of the global production plan, the quality and timeliness of CTB decisions, the organization’s ability to anticipate and recover from constraints, and the strength of the planning team. Decisions made in this position can materially affect production schedules, unit operations, customer commitments, and broader business activities.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
   

  

**Unleash Voices**
 We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
   

  

**Customer Fluent**
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
   

  

**Infinite Impact**
 We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
   

  

**All In**
 We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.
