title: Strategic Projects Lead
description:
**About Handshake**
 Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
   

  

 In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
   

  

**Why Join Handshake Now**
* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue


**About Handshake AI**
 Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3\-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
   

  

 We are building our India team to help accelerate the development of frontier models. This team is a critical, strategic investment for us \- we have grown the team 3x in the past six months to help fuel our next phase of growth. India\-based teammates will work hand\-in\-hand with US\-based teams to scope, execute, and deliver critical human data projects to Frontier Labs and other customers.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Strategic Projects Lead (SPL), you will own the execution of large\-scale human data programs that directly power frontier AI model training and evaluation. Working hands\-on with leading AI labs and technology companies, you will make real\-time decisions that affect revenue, margins, delivery quality, and long\-term customer relationships.
   

  

**Role**
 This is a high\-ownership, outcomes\-driven role for operators who thrive in ambiguity, move fast with incomplete information, and are accountable for results at scale. What you'll do:
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end execution of multi\-week to multi\-month AI data programs to deliver double\-digit millions in ARR\-equivalent impact
* Lead and coordinate hundreds to thousands of expert Fellows to meet aggressive delivery timelines while maintaining quality and cost targets
* Design and adapt staffing models, incentives, and workflows to improve throughput, margins, and delivery reliability under changing requirements
* Partner directly with frontier AI labs and senior stakeholders to shape scope, resolve issues, and expand programs through execution


**You Have**
* 6\+ years of experience in technical or analytical roles such as software engineering, data, analytics, or technical product.
* A technical degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or similar and/or hands\-on experience with coding (Python, SQL, or similar).
* Strong analytical and first\-principles problem\-solving skills applied to scaling operations
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, including with senior customers
* High ownership mindset with pride in end\-to\-end accountability
* Curiosity and ability to quickly learn technical AI concepts and industry trends


**Bonus Points**
* Experience managing large, distributed workforces or marketplaces
* Exposure to AI data, model evaluation, or technical services delivery
* Background in productOps, investment banking, private equity, or management consulting


**You’ll Thrive Here If You**
* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.


**Perks**
* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1\.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 \- 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

title: Manager / Director – Staffing Delivery (IT Services)
description:
**Why VARITE** 




  





 Every day, VARITE connects the world's leading enterprises with the talent that powers their technology initiatives. We are a global staffing and IT consulting partner delivering contract and permanent staffing to Fortune 1000 companies across the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Ireland, and India.
 



  





 Our 1,500\+ member global team supports leading technology, financial services, automotive, defense, energy, life sciences, semiconductor, and engineering companies.
 



  





 Our performance speaks for itself: winner of the Magnit Global Supplier Excellence Award, Cisco Business Growth Award, Pinnacle Premier Supplier Award, and People Scout Select Supplier Award.
 



  





 Winning is in our DNA. VARITE is ranked among the Top 3 suppliers by most of our clients, and we intend to keep it that way.
 



  





 We are looking for hard hitters who share that DNA: leaders who set the pace for the industry, develop great people as mentors, and deliver results month after month. If you have built delivery engines, not just teams, this is your seat at the table.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a Manager or Director – Staffing Delivery (level based on experience) to own high\-volume delivery for our large IT Services clients. You will run the business end to end: client relationships, recruitment teams, ATS governance, AI\-enabled productivity, delivery metrics, and P\&L.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 • Own and consistently deliver 50\+ placements per month across your client portfolio.
 



 • Own the P\&L for your delivery portfolio: revenue, gross margin, headcount productivity, and cost of delivery.
 



 • Drive recruiter productivity: set and manage clear per\-recruiter targets for submittals, interviews, and placements.
 



 • Drive core staffing metrics: submittal\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-offer, offer\-to\-join ratios, time\-to\-submit, and fill rate.
 



 • Use AI tools across sourcing, screening, matching, and reporting to increase speed and quality of delivery, and lead team\-wide AI adoption.
 



 • Establish and enforce ATS governance on JobDiva / Ceipal: data hygiene, pipeline discipline, activity tracking, and reporting accuracy.
 



 • Build and deepen relationships with delivery heads, TA leaders, and procurement stakeholders at large IT Services companies to grow wallet share.
 



 • Maintain top\-tier supplier rankings through scorecard\- and SLA\-driven performance management.
 



 • Present business reviews, delivery dashboards, and growth plans to clients and VARITE leadership with clarity and confidence.
 



 • Lead, coach, and scale high\-performing recruitment teams with a culture of accountability.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




 • Proven track record of delivering 50\+ placements per month in IT staffing for IT Services / ISV clients.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to raise recruiter productivity through targets, coaching, and process discipline.
 



 • A proven mentor who builds leaders, not just recruiters, and is recognized in the industry for delivery excellence.
 



 • Highly AI\-savvy: hands\-on use of AI tools for sourcing, screening, and workflow automation, with a clear view of how AI changes recruiting operations.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience and governance of ATS platforms, specifically JobDiva and/or Ceipal.
 



 • Deep, active connections with large IT Services companies at decision\-maker level.
 



 • Demonstrated P\&L ownership with measurable revenue and margin outcomes.
 



 • Metrics\-first mindset: you manage the business through data, not instinct.
 



 • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; comfortable leading QBRs and leadership reviews.
 



 • Experience with scorecards, VMS platforms, and contingent workforce models.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA preferred.
 



 • Manager: 8–12 years in IT staffing delivery, including team leadership.
 



 • Director: 12\+ years in IT staffing delivery, including P\&L ownership and leading multi\-level teams.
 



  





**Location:** 
  Bengaluru or Gurgaon, India
 



  





**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office (5 days). This is not a hybrid or remote role.
 



  





**Ready to lead delivery at scale? Apply now.**

title: Logistics Sourcing Intelligence Manager
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
**HPE Operations** 
 is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 The Logistics Sourcing Intelligence Manager is a leadership role within the Global Logistics \& Spares Supply Chain Sourcing (GLSS) organization, responsible for managing logistics sourcing intelligence deliverables across various transportation modes, including air, ocean, surface, warehousing, brokerage, and related logistics services.
   

  

 This role enables fact\-based sourcing decisions, sustainable savings, cost avoidance, and commercial governance by building consistent analytics practices across RFIs, RFQs, solutioning support, rate benchmarking, spend analytics, and savings / avoidance reporting.
   

  

 The manager is expected to bring broad logistics commercial understanding and strong procurement process knowledge, including Source\-to\-Contract (S2C), RFQ governance, supplier evaluation, negotiation analytics, sourcing tools such as Coupa Sourcing Optimizer, and executive\-ready reporting.
   

  

 The position strengthens GLSS capability by developing talent, standardizing sourcing intelligence methods, driving digital and AI\-enabled analytics adoption, and ensuring that insights translate into practical sourcing actions and measurable business value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leadership \& Development
* Lead, coach, and develop logistics sourcing intelligence managers supporting multiple transportation modes and regions.
* Set clear priorities, operating rhythms, quality expectations, and development plans for the team.
* Build a high\-performing analytics culture focused on ownership, stakeholder impact, business acumen, and continuous improvement.
* Provide guidance on complex sourcing analytics, commercial interpretation, and executive\-ready storytelling without needing to be the deepest mode expert in every area.
* Logistics Commercial Intelligence Across Modes
* Own the common logistics commercial intelligence framework across air, ocean, surface, warehousing, brokerage, and related service categories.
* Guide teams in interpreting freight rate structures, accessorials, fuel mechanisms, lane / network impacts, capacity dynamics, service trade\-offs, and supplier commercial proposals.
* Ensure consistent benchmarking, rate normalization, scenario modeling, and total cost comparison methods across sourcing events.
* Translate logistics market signals and commercial trends into practical recommendations for sourcing strategy, cost mitigation, and supply chain resilience.
* Source\-to\-Contract, RFQ \& Solutioning Support
* Provide leadership oversight across the S2C process, including RFI, RFQ, supplier response management, scenario analysis, evaluation support, recommendation development, and award readiness.
* Partner with sourcing managers and solutioning teams to shape sourcing event design, bid templates, evaluation criteria, baseline assumptions, and negotiation targets.
* Drive standardized RFQ governance, including data readiness, bid validation, supplier comparability, savings logic, auditability, and decision documentation.
* Support solutioning work by helping teams connect logistics requirements, service design, supplier capabilities, cost models, and operational constraints.
* Procurement Tools, Coupa Enablement \& Digital Process Adoption
* Provide functional leadership on procurement and sourcing tools, including Coupa or similar S2P / S2C platforms, to improve sourcing event execution and governance.
* Define business requirements for digital RFQs, sourcing dashboards, analytics workflows, and future\-state process improvements.
* Partner with digital, IT, sourcing operations, and business users to improve tool adoption, process compliance, and data quality.
* Promote AI\-enabled analytics, automation, and reusable reporting models to improve productivity and decision quality across GLSS.
* Spend Analytics, Savings \& Avoidance Governance
* Lead logistics spend analytics across modes to identify cost trends, demand shifts, rate risks, supplier concentration, and sourcing opportunities.
* Ensure consistent savings and cost avoidance methodologies, including baseline management, negotiated vs. realized savings tracking, benefit validation, and leakage identification.
* Build executive\-ready reporting on sourcing performance, spend movement, commercial outcomes, and value delivery.
* Use analytics to support budgeting, business planning, supplier reviews, and leadership decision\-making.
* Stakeholder, Supplier \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Act as a interface between sourcing, finance, contracts, operations, partner management, digital teams, and regional stakeholders.
* Influence sourcing and operations leaders through clear insights, structured recommendations, and strong commercial reasoning.
* Support supplier\-facing discussions by preparing fact\-based views on pricing, service performance, competitive benchmarks, and negotiation levers.
* Create alignment across global stakeholders while balancing standardization with regional business needs..


**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***
* 12\-16\+ years of experience in logistics sourcing, transportation procurement, sourcing intelligence, procurement analytics, supply chain analytics, or logistics commercial roles.
* Demonstrated experience leading people, including coaching, setting priorities, reviewing output quality, and developing talent.
* Broad logistics commercial knowledge across multiple modes; depth in one mode is helpful but not mandatory if the candidate can connect commercial principles across categories.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Contract processes, RFI / RFQ execution, supplier evaluation, negotiation support, and sourcing governance.
* Experience supporting sourcing events through spend analysis, rate benchmarking, scenario modeling, savings calculations, and leadership recommendations.
* Comfort working with global stakeholders in fast\-paced, matrixed environments.


**Knowledge And Skills**
**Analytical, Digital \& Tooling Skills**
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for analytics, modeling, synthesis, and executive communication.
* Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms; SQL or data querying capability preferred.
* Working knowledge of procurement and sourcing platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Ivalua, or similar S2P / S2C tools.
* Ability to define analytics requirements, improve data quality, standardize dashboards, and support digital RFQ / sourcing processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled analytics, automation use cases, and digital transformation concepts is a plus.


**Professional Attributes**
* People\-first leader with strong coaching, prioritization, and team development skills.
* Commercially sharp, analytically structured, and comfortable making trade\-offs with imperfect data.
* Strong communicator who can simplify complex logistics and sourcing topics for senior stakeholders.
* Governance\-oriented mindset with focus on accuracy, consistency, transparency, and auditability.
* Curious, proactive learner with passion for sourcing intelligence, digital enablement, and AI\-led productivity improvement.


**Accessibility**
 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

**What We Can Offer You**
**Health \& Wellbeing**
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

**Personal \& Professional Development**
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
   

  

**Unconditional Inclusion**
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

title: Head of Foundry Operations, India
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid\-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.
 



  





 As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting\-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead our India foundry operations with full accountability for production excellence opereational trainformation, and strategic growth. You'll drive the facility's evolution from tradition bronze casting to advanced stainless steel manufacturing, implementing automation and lean practices that position us for future. As a key member of our global opreations leadership team, you'll ensure our India foundry delivers world\-class quality, maintains optimal inventory levels, and serves our global customer base with excellence while fostering a positive, engaged workforce culture
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Operations Leadership \& Performance** 



* Lead all foundry manufacturing activities including bronze impeller production using both machine core and hand core processes, ensuring consistent quality, on\-time delivery, and cost efficiency.
* Provide strategic direction and operational oversight for the transition from bronze to stainless steel casting capabilities by conducting feasibility studies, process development, and qualification activities.
* Drive achievement of key performance metrics including safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets across all production areas \[Automation \& Operational Excellence] including sustainability initiatives that reduce waste, energy consumption, and environmental impact \[Financial Management \& Strategic Planning].
* Support and lead the automation transformation roadmap for the foundry, identifying and implementing technologies that improve efficiency, quality, and capacity.
* Work with engineering teams to design, specify, and commission automated systems for core making, casting, finishing, and material handling processes including to ensure new material capabilities meet customer requirements and quality standards.
* Coordinate changes to production workflows and layouts to maximize the benefits of automation investments.
* Lead/sponsor continuous improvement initiatives using lean manufacturing principles and problem\-solving methodologies \[Operations, Supply Chain \& Inventory Management].
* Support optimization of secondary supplier relationships for raw materials, consumables, tooling, and outsourced services to ensure quality, reliability, and cost
* Work with supply chain teams to create and monitor inventory management plans that maintain 95% safety stock availability in the HUB at all times.
* Coordinate changes to procurement strategies and supplier partnerships that reduce lead times and improve material flow.
* Participate in supplier development programs and quality improvement initiatives with key vendors.



  





**People Development \& Employee Relations :** 



* Support the development of a highly skilled, engaged, and motivated workforce through effective talent management, training programs, and career development
* Work with HR teams to create and monitor employee engagement strategies that build trust, transparency, and open communication across all levels.
* Coordinate changes to compensation, benefits, and recognition programs that are competitive and equitable.
* Participate in the cultivation of a positive workplace culture that emphasizes safety, respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, reducing the risk of unionization through proactive employee relations \[Material Transition Strategy].
* Support the maintenance of world\-class safety performance with a goal of zero incidents through robust safety management systems and continuous risk
* Work with quality teams to create and monitor quality assurance processes that ensure 100% conformance to customer specifications and industry
* Coordinate changes to ensure full compliance with all environmental, health, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Support the development and management of annual operating budgets, capital investment plans, and financial forecasts for the foundry.
* Work with finance teams to create and monitor cost reduction initiatives and productivity improvement programs that enhance profitability.
* Coordinate changes to manufacturing strategies aligned with corporate objectives and market demands.
* Participate in business reviews with senior leadership, providing insights and recommendations on operational performance and strategic opportunities



  





**What We're Looking for** 




**To thrive in this role, you should bring:** 




**Education and Experience** 



* Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.
* 15\-18 years of progressive experience in foundry or casting operations, with at least 5\-7 years in senior leadership roles managing engineering, manufacturing, and distribution operations in an industrial environment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of ferrous and non\-ferrous casting processes, metallurgy principles, foundry equipment, and industry best
* Proven track record of leading operational transformations, including automation implementation and material/process transitions.
* Experience managing multi\-cultural teams and driving change in complex organizational environments.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws, industrial regulations, policies, and
* Experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies strongly preferred.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Deep understanding of foundry operations including pattern making, core making, melting, pouring, heat treatment, finishing, and quality control processes for bronze and stainless steel castings.
* Proficiency in manufacturing technologies, automation systems, and Industry 4\.0 concepts applicable to foundry environments.
* Strong knowledge of supply chain management, procurement strategies, inventory optimization, and supplier quality management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with ERP/MRP system
* A self\-starter attitude with the ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment.
* Creative problem\-solving skills and the ability to manage conflicts and navigate challenges within various organizational structures.
* Project management capabilities with experience leading capital projects and operational improvement initiatives.



  





**Soft Skills** 



* The capability to simplify complex problems, conduct root cause analysis, and provide clear, well\-thought\-out recommendations that drive business result.
* Team\-oriented leadership skills with a demonstrated ability to build, develop, and inspire high\-performing teams across multiple function.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with employees at all levels, senior executives, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Cultural sensitivity and emotional intelligence to lead diverse teams and foster an inclusive workplace environment.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance operational excellence, customer satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial performance.
* Change management expertise with a track record of successfully leading organizations through significant transformations.
* Strategic thinking combined with hands\-on execution capability to drive both long\-term vision and short\-term results.



  





**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?** 




 By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid\-flow technology. This role offers a rare opportunity – to build something from the ground up. You will establish Armstrong’s Industrial RSEC function, shape how the company engages with some of the world’s most demanding industrial customers and grow into the leader of a function that will define Armstrong’s industrial commercial capability for years to come. Together, we’ll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: City Head
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Sunshine by Lissun is one of India’s fastest\-growing networks of child development centers, focused on empowering children with autism, ADHD, speech and language delays, and other developmental needs. As part of the larger Lissun ecosystem, Sunshine brings together a multidisciplinary team of speech therapists, occupational therapists, special educators, psychologists, and counselors who work collaboratively to provide holistic care.  About the Role
 
 We're looking for a City Lead to own Sunshine's business in Bengaluru end to end. You'll run day\-to\-day center operations, grow the business, lead the local team, and make sure every family who walks through our doors has a great experience.
 



 This role suits someone who thinks like an owner. You should be comfortable moving between a P\&L review, a difficult parent conversation, and a hiring interview in the same afternoon.

* Own the city's revenue, profitability, and growth targets.

**Family experience** 



* Make sure families feel supported from their first enquiry through ongoing therapy.

 What We're Looking For
 
  




* Strong grasp of unit economics: you're comfortable with P\&Ls, targets, and data.

* Excellent communication in English, plus Kannada or Hindi.
* Genuine empathy for children and families.



  





**Nice\-to\-haves** 



* Background in pediatric healthcare, therapy services, or special education.
* Experience launching or scaling a new location.
* An existing network among pediatricians, schools, or hospitals in Bengaluru.

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh**

title: Director of AI Labs Business
description:
**🚀 About Joveo** 




 Joveo builds AI\-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work.
 



 We are hiring a director to shape this capability and build the organisation that delivers it.
 



  





**🌟 About the role** 




 Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on.
 



 You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop.
 



 For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost.
 



  





**🧠 What you’ll do** 



* Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service.
* Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand.
* Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible.
* Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs.
* Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions.
* Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability.



  





**🎯 What we’re looking for** 



* You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field.
* You have hired or developed managers and held responsibility for complex customer outcomes. You can build a team that makes good decisions without every issue reaching you.
* You are credible in both a technical review and a commercial discussion. You can challenge an evaluation design, identify weak acceptance criteria and work through the implications for delivery and cost.
* You have made consequential operating decisions: narrowing an offering, resetting a customer commitment, changing a quality system or rebuilding a team. You can explain your reasoning and the results.
* Experience launching a service, turning pilots into repeat programs or operating expert contributor networks is especially relevant.



 We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold.
 



  





**✨ Why join Joveo** 




 You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience.
 



 This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Product Delivery Manager \- Custody / Asset Servicing.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Product Delivery Manager to support the delivery of initiatives related to our Custody Product within the Securities Services business. The successful candidate will assist in gathering requirements, analysing processes, and coordinating project activities to ensure the effective execution of product enhancements, regulatory changes, and client\-driven projects.
* Project Support: Assist in the coordination and execution of custody product initiatives, tracking progress and supporting the achievement of project milestones.
* Requirements Gathering: Work with stakeholders to collect, document, and validate business and functional requirements for custody product enhancements and regulatory changes.
* Process Analysis: Analyse existing processes and workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the development of efficient solutions.
* Documentation: Prepare and maintain project documentation, including requirements, process maps, test cases, and user guides.
* Testing Support: Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT), including test planning, execution, and issue tracking to ensure solutions meet business needs.
* Stakeholder Communication: Support effective communication between business, technology, operations, and other teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Regulatory Compliance: Help ensure initiatives comply with relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the enhancement of delivery processes and best practices within the team.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, Finance, Technology, Data/Analytics, or a related field.
* 8\+ years’ experience in product management / product delivery, business analysis, or change delivery within financial services, ideally within Securities Services / Custody and Asset Servicing. Demonstrable domain knowledge across Asset Servicing, including Corporate Actions and Income Processing (end\-to\-end lifecycle, key controls, and client impacts).
* Strong understanding of data concepts and operating models, with experience delivering or partnering on Data Platform capabilities and data\-led product outcomes. Proven experience working with Client Reference Data and Asset Reference Data (data quality, governance, lineage, controls, and downstream consumer impacts).
* Hands\-on or delivery experience with Xceptor (or comparable workflow/data automation tooling) to improve STP (Straight Through Processing), reduce risk, and enhance operational efficiency. Strong understanding of custody operations, securities processing, and the applicable regulatory environment; ability to translate regulatory and risk requirements into product features and controls. Xceptor: experience designing/implementing workflows, exception management, and controls automation to improve STP (Straight Through Processing) and operational resilience. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable working with complex datasets and process flows to identify root causes and drive fixes.
* Track record of working effectively in cross\-functional teams (Operations, Technology, Data, Risk/Compliance, Client Coverage) and driving outcomes through influence. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex operational and data topics clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Asset Servicing expertise: strong functional knowledge of custody/asset servicing processes, controls, and client outcomes. Corporate Actions: event lifecycle understanding (announcement through entitlement), processing variants, exception handling, and client reporting considerations. Income Processing: coupon/dividend lifecycle, tax considerations (where relevant), breaks management, and reconciliation touchpoints.
* Data Platform delivery: ability to define requirements, prioritise platform capabilities, and align product outcomes to data architecture and operating model constraints. Reference Data management: practical experience with Client Reference Data and Asset Reference Data including data quality metrics, remediation approaches, governance, and stewardship models.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills; ability to partner across Technology, Operations, Data, and Risk to deliver at pace. Delivery discipline: ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and dependencies, with a focus on measurable outcomes. Clear, structured communicator with strong documentation skills (business requirements, operating model changes, controls, and executive updates). Proactive, continuous\-improvement mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 Regional Surface Head role is accountable for the end\-to\-end governance, performance, and optimization of the Surface Network, SFC Hub Operations, Surface Fleet, and First Mile (PUD) Operations across multiple states.
   

  

 Owns regional Surface Hub performance, transportation efficiency, fleet utilization, First Mile integration, network flow, service quality, productivity, and cost optimization to ensure seamless movement of shipments from pickup through middle\-mile transportation.
   

  

 Leads Regional Surface Fleet \& Network Managers, Regional Senior Manager – PUD Operations, and Regional SFC Hub Managers, driving operational consistency, standardized execution, infrastructure readiness, and continuous improvement across all Surface operations within the region.
   

  

 Acts as the regional owner for Surface Operations by integrating Hub Operations, Fleet \& Network Management, and PUD Operations to deliver superior service quality, operational excellence, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 This role operates as a regional capability and governance function, working closely with Air Network, CPU Operations, Last Mile Operations, Engineering, Finance, Commercial, and Network Planning teams to ensure a reliable, scalable, and cost\-effective logistics network.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To build and operate a high\-performing Surface Operations network by integrating SFC Hub Operations, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile (PUD) Operations, while driving operational excellence, service quality, transportation efficiency, hub productivity, customer experience, and cost optimization across the region.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Strategic Leadership**
* Define and execute the regional Surface Operations strategy aligned with service SLAs, business growth, and cost objectives.
* Translate national Surface Operations strategies into region\-specific execution plans.
* Drive continuous improvement across Surface Hub Operations, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile Operations.


**Leadership**
* Lead and manage Regional Surface Fleet \& Network Managers, Regional SFC Hub Managers, and Regional Senior Manager – PUD Operations across the region, ensuring alignment to service, productivity, cost, and operational excellence objectives.
* Provide strategic direction and governance across Surface Hub Operations, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile (PUD) Operations, ensuring seamless integration and standardized execution throughout the regional Surface Network.
* Drive operational excellence by improving hub throughput, transportation efficiency, fleet utilization, pickup productivity, infrastructure readiness, and end\-to\-end network performance.
* Build leadership capability, succession pipeline, and operational bench strength while fostering a high\-performance culture across all Surface Operations functions.
* Drive collaboration between Surface Operations, CPU, Air Network, Last Mile, Commercial, Engineering, Finance, HR, and other cross\-functional teams to achieve regional service and business objectives.
* Ensure consistent implementation of national operational strategies, governance frameworks, and best practices across all regional Surface Operations.


**Operational Excellence**
* Own and govern operational performance across Surface Hubs, Surface Fleet \& Network, and First Mile Operations.
* Drive network optimization through improved routing, fleet utilization, hub productivity, and transportation planning.
* Ensure seamless integration between First Mile, Middle Mile, and downstream operations to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
* Establish standardized operating practices across all Surface Operations while ensuring compliance with SOPs, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor regional operational performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to improve network productivity and service performance.


**Cost Optimization \& Efficiency**
* Drive transportation and operational cost optimization through improved fleet utilization, route optimization, manpower productivity, and infrastructure utilization.
* Monitor cost per shipment and identify opportunities to improve regional operating efficiency.
* Balance cost optimization initiatives with customer service commitments and operational reliability.


**Process Re\-engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, service quality, and transportation efficiency.
* Drive standardization of operational processes across Surface Hubs, Fleet Operations, and PUD Operations.
* Implement scalable operating models to support business growth and peak season readiness.


**Stakeholder \& Governance**
* Collaborate with Air Network, CPU Operations, Last Mile Operations, Finance, Engineering, Commercial, HR, Procurement, and Network Planning teams to ensure end\-to\-end operational alignment.
* Ensure alignment between regional execution and national operational strategy.
* Act as the regional SME for Surface Operations in internal governance forums and strategic discussions.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Education: Bachelor's degree (Engineering / Operations / Supply Chain preferred); MBA/PG desirable.
* Experience: 12–15 years of experience in logistics operations with strong exposure to Surface Transportation, Hub Operations, Fleet Management, First Mile Operations, and Multi\-location Operations.
* Proven experience in managing large cross\-functional teams across multiple locations.
* Exposure to network optimization, transportation planning, and cost management preferred.
* Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, 3PL, Transportation, eCommerce Logistics, Supply Chain.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**
* Surface Operations Management
* Hub Operations \& Throughput Management
* Surface Fleet \& Network Optimization
* First Mile (PUD) Operations
* Analytical Capability
* Transportation Planning \& Capacity Management
* Cost Optimization \& Productivity Improvement
* Process Re\-engineering \& Continuous Improvement


**Key Competencies:**
* Strategic Leadership
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Data\-driven Decision Making
* Stakeholder Management
* Operational Excellence
* Customer Focus
* Change Management
* Problem Solving \& Execution Excellence
* Data analysis and data lead governance


**Key Performance Indicators:**
**Key Result Areas**

 Surface Operations Performance
   

  

 Surface SLA, Transit Reliability
   

  

 Hub Performance
   

  

 Throughput, Hub TAT, Productivity

 Fleet Utilization, Load Factor, Route Optimization

 Pickup SLA, Revenue Assurance, Pickup Productivity

 Cost per Shipment, Transportation Cost Reduction

 Network Stability

 Employee Engagement, Attrition, Training Completion
   

  

 Safety \& Compliance
   

  

 EHS Compliance, Audit Compliance Score
   

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
   

  

 Here’s what makes us stand out:

description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM, we are committed to delivering exceptional client and employee experiences through operational excellence, data\-driven decision\-making, and continuous innovation. Workforce Management plays a critical role in ensuring optimal resource utilization, service delivery performance, and operational efficiency across global support functions.
   

  

 As an Assistant Manager – Workforce Management, you will be responsible for driving workforce planning strategies, forecasting demand, optimizing staffing requirements, and ensuring service level commitments are achieved. You will work closely with operations leadership, business stakeholders, and support teams to provide actionable insights and enable effective decision\-making through workforce analytics.
   

  

 This role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in Workforce Management, Operations Strategy, Capacity Planning, and Service Delivery Excellence within a fast\-paced global environment.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead workforce management activities including forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time workforce optimization.
* Develop short\-term and long\-term staffing models based on business demand forecasts, historical trends, and operational requirements.
* Monitor workforce metrics and ensure achievement of service levels, productivity targets, occupancy goals, and operational KPIs.
* Analyze call, chat, email, and transaction volume trends to identify staffing requirements and operational risks.
* Partner with Operations, HR, Recruitment, Training, and Business teams to align workforce plans with organizational objectives.
* Manage intraday staffing adjustments and recommend actions to address service level fluctuations.
* Identify capacity gaps and recommend workforce solutions to mitigate operational risks.
* Develop and maintain workforce management dashboards, scorecards, forecasting models, and management reports.
* Perform trend analysis and provide actionable recommendations to improve service delivery and resource utilization.
* Lead workforce planning reviews and provide strategic insights to senior stakeholders.
* Drive process improvements, automation opportunities, and best practices within workforce management operations.
* Ensure workforce management practices comply with established governance, operational standards, and reporting requirements.
* Support business continuity planning and workforce contingency management activities.
* Manage stakeholder communication regarding capacity planning, staffing challenges, and operational performance.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Experience**
**Required technical and professional expertise**
* Graduate or Postgraduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in Workforce Management, Capacity Planning, Operations Analytics, Resource Management, or Contact Center Planning.
* Strong experience in forecasting, scheduling, capacity planning, and workforce optimization.
* Experience managing workforce planning activities in a high\-volume operational environment.
* Strong understanding of contact center metrics including Service Level, AHT, Shrinkage, Occupancy, Productivity, and Forecast Accuracy.
* Experience building staffing models and resource plans using historical and predictive data.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and influence workforce planning decisions.
* Experience supporting global operations across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong experience in operational reporting, KPI governance, and performance analysis.


**Skills Required**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to interpret large datasets and convert insights into business recommendations.
* Strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and advanced formulas.
* Experience with workforce management tools such as NICE IEX, Verint, Aspect, Genesys, Calabrio, or similar platforms.
* Strong presentation and reporting skills using PowerPoint and visualization tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong organizational, planning, and project coordination skills.
* Ability to influence decision\-making through data\-driven recommendations.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Experience supporting global financial services, investment banking, or shared services organizations.
* Exposure to business intelligence and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, or SQL.
* Knowledge of workforce optimization methodologies and predictive analytics.
* Experience leading process improvement or automation initiatives.
* Certification in Workforce Management, Six Sigma, Lean, or Operations Excellence is an advantage.

 We are looking for an Engineering/Technical Program Manager who will own the engineering delivery system and the people performance diagnostic layer across CynLr’s multi\-disciplinary engineering organization. This is not a project management role that runs Agile ceremonies. This is a role for someone who can design engineering processes from first principles, build objective performance assessment frameworks, diagnose systemic bottlenecks across hardware\-software\-research workflows, and drive alignment across teams with genuine interpersonal skill.
 



  





 You will design \& execute the processes, frameworks, and diagnostics that allow CynLr’s engineering teams to deliver with clarity, speed, and accountability across every stream.
 



  





**Your Primary Contributions** 




  





*1\. Engineering Process Design \& Delivery* 



* Design and own the end\-to\-end product delivery process from concept through design, development, testing, and release across hardware, firmware, software, and research streams.
* Map inter\-stream dependencies, tool workflows, and external/internal bottlenecks and resolve them before they become blockers.
* Set up milestones with built\-in assessment checkpoints for product development, projects, and design work.
* Design and manage the tool workflow for product delivery (Asana and engineering management tools), driving adoption and discipline across teams.
* Build a distinct R\&D management workflow for research and exploratory projects separate from routine software development processes.



  





*2\. Engineering Review Process* 



* Design the engineering review process for Design, Development, and Research across all engineering streams.
* Define review metrics, assess process effectiveness, and refine iteratively.
* Organize and conduct review sessions where engineering leads assess the work. You will design, structure, and run the process.



  





*3\. Performance Diagnostics \& Assessment* 



* Design an analytics\-driven continuous assessment process by weaving diagnostic probes into engineering workflows making performance reviews objective rather than subjective.
* Structure performance assessment across three dimensions: Individual, Team, and Process ensuring root causes are diagnosable across all three.
* Diagnose performance issues to their root: Process gap? Tooling gap? Motivation? Skill gap? Design specific remedies for each.
* Formulate monthly performance reports and conduct quarterly assessment programs in collaboration with HR.



  





*4\. Resource \& Project Planning* 



* Maintain resource maps, skill maps, and performance grades and use them actively for project planning and allocation decisions.
* Organize individual engineers’ calendars with categorized task blocks and drive adherence.
* Manage project timelines, dependencies, and delivery commitments across streams.



  





 5\.
 *Team Alignment \& People Skills* 



* Drive alignment across engineering teams not through authority, but through clarity, negotiation, and building shared understanding.
* Handle individual negotiations, identify morale bottlenecks, and resolve conflicts across teams.
* Build team cohesion and soft\-skill development as a deliberate practice, not a cultural afterthought.



  





**What Will You Do?** 




 You will augment Founder's Vision and make CynLr’s engineering organization legible to itself, to leadership, and to the people inside it.
 



 You will:
 


* Translate ambiguity into structure without losing the nuance that makes deep\-tech hard.
* Surface bottlenecks before they surface themselves as missed deadlines.
* Build systems that make good engineering behavior the path of least resistance.
* Diagnose performance problems at their root and not just at their symptom.
* Hold the delivery system together across hardware, firmware, software, and research without becoming a bottleneck yourself.



 You are not expected to be a domain expert in every engineering stream. You are expected to understand how they interlock and to design \& execute accordingly.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not an Agile/Scrum Master role. We do not use template frameworks. You will design processes from first principles based on what the engineering organization actually needs.
* Not a passive PMO. You will not track Gantt charts from the sidelines. You will actively diagnose, intervene, and drive systemic improvements.
* Not a pure HR role. While you will collaborate with HR on performance programs, your primary orientation is engineering operations and process design.



  





**What Will You Need to Do This Role Well** 



* At least 3–5 years of owning engineering processes end\-to\-end — not just participating in them.
* Strong understanding of multiple engineering streams (hardware, firmware, software, research) and their interlinkings dependency patterns, bottleneck dynamics, and cross\-stream risk.
* Demonstrated experience designing delivery processes, milestone frameworks, and assessment systems from scratch
* Hands\-on experience with engineering program management tools (Asana strongly preferred).
* Analytical mindset with the ability to design diagnostic probes and data\-driven assessment frameworks.
* Strong interpersonal skills: conflict resolution, individual negotiation, team alignment.



  





**Experience That Will Accelerate You** 



* Engineering degree with a technical career foundation before moving into program or process roles.
* Experience in deep\-tech, robotics, embedded systems, automotive, aerospace/defense, industrial automation, medical devices, or semiconductor equipment
* Experience in organizations with 30–150 engineers where process had to be built, not just followed.
* Comfort operating in a founder\-driven environment with high ownership expectations and minimal bureaucratic scaffolding.
* Background in a product company that ships integrated hardware\-software products.



  





**How Will You Do It?** 




 This role resists templating by design. When we build a new industry from Scratch, we can't do by borrowing tools from other professions/industries.
 



  





 You will operate by:
 



 • Studying the engineering organization as a system before intervening in it.
 



 • Asking sharp clarifying questions before designing solutions.
 



 • Building your own frameworks for tracking, diagnostics, and follow\-through.
 



 • Knowing when to enforce structure and when structure itself is the bottleneck.
 



 • Learning from feedback quickly and evolving your approach as the organization grows.
 



*Success here comes from systems thinking, engineering understanding, and the discipline to build things that outlast your direct involvement.* 




  





**Team Structure** 




 The Technical Program Manager operates within the Founder’s Office, embedded directly into the engineering organization.
 



 While the TPM works closely with the founder(s), the role interfaces continuously with:
 



 • Engineering leads
 



 • HR and Talent, for performance programs and people\-related interventions
 



 • Finance and Operations, for resource planning and project budgeting
 



 • External vendors and tooling partners, where applicable
 



 The TPM owns process design and delivery hygiene across all engineering streams — acting as the connective layer that keeps multi\-disciplinary teams aligned without creating dependency on a single coordination point.
 



  





**About CynLr** 




 Just like a baby’s brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see \& pick any object under any ambience, without any training. (a demo video link).
 



  





 From fitting a screw to removing object out of its the plastic wrapper to automating the assembly of a car/gadget \- every such object handling task that involves "adapting on the fly" is not prior trainable \& thereby remains non\-automatable across the industries. CynLr builds a stack of Micro RL blocks called Sensing \& Action Primitives, using which a High Level Task can be composed.
 



  





 CynLr's OI enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into
 *modular LEGO\-like* 
 Universal\-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change.
 



  





 CynLr’ s Vision and ML stacks are
 *deeply inspired by neuroscience,* 
 modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision\-making, and action.
 



  





 We are a deep\-tech robotics company at the intersection of computer vision, real\-time control systems, and precision hardware, headquartered in Bengaluru with a Swiss entity. Our engineering spans optics, embedded systems, firmware, real\-time software, mechanical design, and applied research.

description:
**About CIBC:** 




 CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose \- to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award\-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.
 



  





**About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):** 




 The Manager, Central Reconciliations provides strategic and operational leadership for a critical function supporting the integrity, control, and scalability of reconciliation activities across the enterprise. The role leads the continued evolution of the Central Reconciliations team in CIBC India, ensuring operational readiness to support business growth, regulatory expectations, and modernization priorities. This position oversees automated and manual reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and suspense account management while driving standardization, control enhancement, process optimization, and service excellence. The role also acts as a subject matter expert for reconciliation operations and the TLM application.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):** 




**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:** 



* Lead the day\-to\-day operations and ongoing evolution of the Central Reconciliations function, including automated and manual reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and suspense account oversight.
* Establish and maintain a scalable operating model aligned to business growth and enterprise priorities, while delivering against service levels, operational metrics, productivity targets, and control standards.
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve operational efficiency through modernization, standardization, and process enhancement initiatives.
* Support the migration of critical and time\-sensitive activities into the Central Reconciliations model with minimal disruption, partnering with Technology and Change teams to enhance tooling, exception management, reporting, and data feeds.
* Maintain a strong control environment by proactively identifying, escalating, and mitigating operational risks, and partnering with Audit, Compliance, Risk, and Regulatory stakeholders to support reviews, remediation, and sustained compliance.
* Build strong partnerships across Capital Markets, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and other business stakeholders to support service delivery and business priorities.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team while managing capacity planning, resource allocation, succession planning, budget management, staffing strategy, and investment priorities aligned to the function’s roadmap.
* Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with Capital Markets, Retail, Wealth Management, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and other Operations teams across CIBC
* Partners with business stakeholders, control functions, and technology teams to resolve operational issues, support service delivery, and implement process improvements
* Liaises with internal and external stakeholders, as applicable, to address exceptions, support reconciliation activities, and meet business, audit, and regulatory requirements


- 


**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* As a manager of people, this job must ensure all employees within the business unit comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls



  





**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:** 




**JOB DIMENSIONS:** 




**Experience:** 
 7\+ years of experience
 


* As a manager of people, this job has the authority to assign tasks to employees within their span of control, select individuals for hire, assess individual performance, make employee compensation decisions, and take disciplinary measures up to and including termination
* Leads a critical reconciliation function supporting multiple business lines, with accountability for service delivery, regulatory reporting, suspense account oversight, and control effectiveness
* Manages team capacity, operational performance, and stakeholder engagement across Operations, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Audit in a regulated environment.



  





**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):** 




**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field
* 7\+ years of relevant experience in Capital Markets operations, reconciliations, or settlements, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role
* Demonstrated experience leading reconciliation operations in a regulated environment
* Proven experience leading operational change, business transformation, or process migration initiatives
* Deep knowledge of reconciliation processes, including automated and manual reconciliations, exception management, suspense account oversight, and operational control frameworks
* Strong understanding of Capital Markets operations and related financial products; experience with Securities Lending, Equity Trading, OTC Derivatives, and Collateral Management is an asset
* Hands\-on knowledge of reconciliation platforms such as TLM and familiarity with systems including DTC, CDS, Broadridge (ADP), Fund SERV, GOW, and similar operational tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess data, identify trends, determine root causes, and drive effective decisions
* Ability to translate business needs into operational and technology requirements to support strategic and process improvements
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, planning, prioritization, and decision\-making skills
* Strong risk awareness and commitment to compliance, governance, and control discipline



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get to Know our Team:**
 Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in\-person, real\-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each and every customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer’s experience.  Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R\&D, Data \& Digital functions . Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, globally.

* Lead and manage the Global MAP Coordinators (GMCs) team to deliver end\-to\-end MAP operations from product receipt through to product shipment for both structured programs and single patient requests across General Medicine and Specialty Care GBUs.
* Oversee MAP Operational Excellence
