title: Senior Production Executive / Assistant Production Manager
description:
Assistant Production Manager / Production Manager – Food Manufacturing

**Industry:** Packaged Foods / FMCG Manufacturing

We are looking for a hands\-on production professional with relevant experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, cereals, snacks or similar food manufacturing**.

This role is not just for production supervision. The person should be capable of gradually taking ownership of **production planning, manpower, output, wastage, process control and daily factory execution**.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and execute **daily and weekly production plans** based on orders, inventory and dispatch requirements.
* Manage shop\-floor production across **mixing, dough preparation, forming, baking, cooling and packing** operations.
* Ensure achievement of **planned output, productivity and dispatch commitments**.
* Allocate manpower effectively across production lines and shifts.
* Monitor and control **yield, wastage, rework, breakage and process losses**.
* Track **plan vs actual production** and identify reasons for shortfalls.
* Monitor machine downtime, changeovers and production bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Coordinate with **QC, Stores, Maintenance, Packing and Dispatch** teams for smooth production.
* Ensure availability of raw materials and packaging materials as per the production plan.
* Maintain process consistency for products such as **cookies, biscuits, rusk, cereals and related products**.
* Troubleshoot issues relating to **dough consistency, mixing, baking, colour, texture, moisture, crispness, breakage and product variation**.
* Support **new\-product trials and scale\-up from trial batches to commercial production**.
* Maintain proper batch records, production records, process parameters and shift handovers.
* Ensure compliance with factory hygiene, food\-safety, sanitation and production SOPs.
* Coordinate basic preventive maintenance and escalate machine issues on time.
* Prepare and maintain a simple **daily/weekly production MIS** covering:
* Production plan vs actual
* Output
* Wastage/yield
* Downtime
* Manpower
* Rework
* Key production issues
* Train and develop supervisors/operators so production does not depend on one individual.
* Be capable of independently managing routine production operations in the absence of the senior production head.

Candidate Profile

* **8–10 years** of relevant experience in food manufacturing.
* Strong preference for experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, rusk, cereals, snacks or similar dry\-food products**.
* Hands\-on knowledge of **mixing, forming, baking, cooling and packing processes**.
* Understanding of food\-production variables such as **temperature, time, moisture, dough consistency, formulation variation and process control**.
* Experience managing production workers and shop\-floor manpower.
* Comfortable working in a hands\-on manufacturing environment.
* Ability to analyse production problems rather than merely escalate them.
* Working knowledge of food hygiene, GMP and basic food\-safety systems.
* Ability to maintain production records and MIS.
* Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

B.Tech / B.Sc / Diploma in:  
**Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy/Food Processing,** or relevant manufcturing qualification.

Strong practical food\-production experience can compensate for formal qualification.

What We Will Evaluate in the Interview

Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

* Production volume and number of workers previously handled.
* Examples of reducing wastage or improving yield.
* How they handle production shortfalls and machine downtime.
* How they plan manpower across multiple SKUs.
* Troubleshooting of biscuit/cookie/bakery production problems.
* Production MIS and KPIs they have personally managed.
* Examples of new\-product commercial scale\-up.
* How they would independently run production if their reporting manager were absent.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Faridabad, Haryana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in manufacturing of bakery items like cookies, rusk?
* Do you have experience in formulating new products?
* Your current CTC (will be verified)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Food industry: 5 years (Required)

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Objective / Purpose:**


Support the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement in applying operational excellence and human\-centered design to evaluate, redesign, and continuously improve the processes underpinning GPT (Global Program Team) ways of working and the broader R\&D Operational Excellence function. This role combines process design expertise with technical acumen to translate business needs into scalable, technology\-enabled solutions — automations, dashboards, and digital products — that improve insight generation, data usability, and operational efficiency. Working closely with Data, Digital \& Technology (DD\&T) and business stakeholders, the role stewards a practical, Lean\-based optimization framework and moves teams beyond static documentation toward integrated, user\-centric, digitally enabled solutions that balance enterprise standards with business flexibility.

**Accountabilities:**

**1\) Process Design \& Improvement**

* Evaluate current processes and ways of working for GPTs and R\&D Operational Excellence functions, and partner with the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement and function owners to redesign prioritized processes against strategic needs.
* Identify possible opportunities where AI, automation, or digital tooling can reduce manual effort, accelerate cycle time, or improve quality — recommending what to automate versus keep human\-in\-the\-loop, and the expected value.
* Incorporate automation, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to support self\-service and system\-generated insights that improve decision\-making and operational effectiveness.
* Reimagine static outputs (e.g., fixed dashboards) as flexible solutions that support both standardized reporting and user\-driven data exploration.

**2\) Technology \& Data Enablement**

* Collaborate with business owners, DD\&T, and data teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions for redesigned processes.
* Embed and optimize data within process implementations for structured, reusable inputs, ensuring alignment with enterprise data standards and governance.
* Identify and evaluate data sources critical to process improvement initiatives, assessing availability, accessibility, and usability.
* Hands\-on development and delivery of technical prototypes and demos to validate process improvements, demonstrate new capabilities, and drive adoption.
* Partner with DD\&T and data quality SMEs to uncover barriers to data access and establish frameworks that balance end\-user flexibility with a single source of truth.
* Maintain accessible, well\-governed process documentation — interconnected with related resources and structured for long\-term version control — so functional leads can apply Process Optimization \& Enablement methods independently.

**3\) Continuous Improvement \& Adoption**

* Lead follow\-up on prototypes to capture lessons learned and refine solutions before broader rollout, keeping a clear line of sight from design intent to adoption and outcomes.
* Support and ensure post\-implementation assessments are completed to capture value, ROI, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Represent process design work in working groups and governance forums on behalf of the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement.

**4\) Cross\-Functional Enablement \& Relationships**

* Provide process design support and technical reference guides across R\&D Operational Excellence functions, in alignment with the framework set by the Head of Process Optimization \& Enablement.
* Partner with the Operations \& Digital Enablement Lead to train peers and line function teams, building an internal process design capability that isn't dependent on any one individual.
* Define simple leading and lagging indicators (e.g., cycle time, rework, adoption, quality) that support periodic process health reviews, and recommend the next round of improvements.
* Build effective working relationships with GPT Enablement, CAPTIVATE process leads, R\&D line function leaders, transformation program leads, and DD\&T partners to ensure designs reflect real operating constraints and surface upstream/downstream dependencies.

**Education \& Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred, with 4\-6\+ years of experience in process design, business operations, data/analytics, or digital transformation.
* Strong, hands\-on command of operational excellence and process improvement methodologies (e.g., value\-stream mapping, metric development, root\-cause analysis, RACI design, and Kaizen\-style improvement events).

 Masters in Finance and Management Minimum of 8\-12 years’ experience in Security Valuations or Pricing for Hedge Fund , Reference Data Setup or Capital Market Experience Preference will be given to candidates with exposure to Pricing or Valuations
   

  

**Skills \& Other Requirements**
 Should have managed a team of 10\-15 members First or second level management expertise required Candidate should demonstrate problem solving skills, conducting specialized research and analysis of complex securities pricing issues Must have considerable domain knowledge preferably in areas of Pricing or Valuations with good product knowledge across Equity, Fixed Income, and Derivatives. title: Manager – Financial Operations
description:
Management Level
   

  

 F
   

  

 EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer\-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Manager – Financial Operations**
 The Manager, Financial Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of all finance activities processed through the organisation's Workday/ERP platform. The role acts as the global process owner for Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and direct oversight of UK Payroll processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing, timely financial reporting, strong controls, and optimal use of Workday/ERP capabilities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a strong people leader with the ability to develop high\-performing teams, build organisational capability, and drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
   

  

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Process Ownership**
* Lead the delivery of finance operations across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and Payroll processes.
* Own operational performance, ensuring delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Ensure standardised, efficient, and well\-controlled end\-to\-end finance processes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues and process exceptions.


**People Management**
* Lead, develop, and motivate a high\-performing Finance Operations team.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and career development opportunities to enhance capability and engagement.
* Drive talent management, succession planning, and skills development to ensure long\-term organisational resilience.


**Accounts Payable Operations**
* Oversee invoice processing, payment execution, employee expenses, and supplier account management.
* Ensure timely supplier payments and effective resolution of payment\-related issues.
* Maintain strong AP controls, compliance, and governance standards.
* Act as the functional owner for Workday Accounts Payable processes and enhancements.


**Record\-to\-Report Operations**
* Ensure timely and accurate journal processing and financial accounting activities.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalisation, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
* Manage balance sheet reconciliations, bank reconciliations, and prepayment accounting.
* Support statutory, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvements across RTR processes to improve efficiency, control, and reporting quality.


**Procurement Operations**
* Manage Purchase Order (PO) support processes.
* Oversee supplier onboarding activities and vendor master governance.
* Support procurement compliance and policy adherence.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive efficient purchasing processes.
* Support supplier negotiations and process optimisation initiatives.


**Payroll Operations (UK)**
* Oversee UK payroll processing, validation, reconciliations, and payroll accounting activities.
* Ensure payroll operations are delivered accurately, compliantly, and on time.
* Review payroll journals, controls, and exception management processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of payroll queries and exceptions.
* Partner with HR and external providers to maintain a high\-quality payroll service.


**Workday/ERP Governance \& Optimisation**
* Act as the Finance SME for Workday/ERP processes and functionality.
* Drive maximum utilisation of system capabilities through automation and process standardisation.
* Partner with Technology and Business teams on system enhancements and process changes.


**Performance Management \& Reporting**
* Develop and maintain KPI dashboards and operational reporting.
* Monitor productivity, service levels, quality, and control metrics.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide regular management information to Finance leadership.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Simplify workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support Finance transformation and change initiatives.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
* Strong experience across Finance Operations, Shared Services, or Financial Accounting environments.
* End\-to\-end knowledge of Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Fixed Assets, and UK Payroll processes.
* Experience of operating and optimising ERP platforms, preferably Workday.
* Strong understanding of Month\-End and year\-end financial close processes.
* Experience delivering operational excellence, automation, and process transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple functions and levels.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to lead change and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**
* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA) or equivalent


**SKILLS:**
* Fluent English: written and spoken.
* Proven Leadership abilities and team working
* Excellent organizational, communication and planning skills
* Professional, credible individual with an ability to influence peers, superiors and subordinates
* Adaptable with an ability to change direction and priorities if required
* Achievement orientation: Driven by goals and deadlines
* Ability to work well with people across the organisation.
* Ability to understand the detail behind processes.


 We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. Please note any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory pre\-employment screening checks.

title: Asset Manager

In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.
   

  

 You will focus on supporting and overseeing credit documentation and managing the execution of lending transactions while ensuring compliance with legal and operational requirements. * Analyse legal drafts and ensure alignment with business, regulatory, and operational requirements.

 To support Wholesale Lending with day\-to\-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.

* Lead the delivery of MetricStream implementation at Glencore, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including IT, business stakeholders, and external vendors, to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, including resource allocation and timelines.
* Monitor project progress to plan, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely delivery.
* Facilitate regular project meetings to communicate status, address challenges and escalations as necessary.
* Ensure adherence to best practices and standards in project management and GRC implementations.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance environment.


**Technical Experience:**
* Degree (e.g., BA, BSc) or professional certifications in computer science, Information technology, or a related field.
* 10\+ years’ experience delivering and managing MetricStream implementations in global organizations.
* Proven experience as a delivery lead, preferably with MetricStream or similar GRC platforms.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) and tools (e.g., JIRA, MS Project).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on delivering results.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written \& ability to collaborate across departments and cultures
* Knowledge of MetricStream features and technology (BAPI journeys, PL\-SQL, JAVA and MetricStream reporting tools, Power BI etc.)
* Knowledge of data governance and the integration of Risk, Audit, and HSEC processes.


**Key strengths include:**
* A solutions\-focused individual who can work with teams through complex challenges while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification is a plus.
* Familiarity with compliance, risk management, and audit processes.
* Awareness of natural resources sector compliance challenges and emerging GRC \& ERM trends, is a plus.


**Benefits**
* We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.
* We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.
* We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.


**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
   

  

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024\-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.
   

  

 Note\*: All applications will be subject to potential background checks. You will be informed if this will be the case. Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.

title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa\+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient \- increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
   

  

 We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India\-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high\-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI\-first engineering organization operates \- where large language models, agents, and AI\-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day\-to\-day engineering.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi\-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
* As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
* Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India\-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on\-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
* Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM\-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI\-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
* Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 8\+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
* Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
* Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
* Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in computer science or related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user\-facing technologies.
* Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
* Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production\-ready solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* AI Leadership Competencies \-We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
* AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine\-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
* AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost\-per\-interaction, trust).
* Driving AI\-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI\-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
* Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
* Talent and culture for an AI\-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI\-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.

title: Deputy Manager- Execution
description:
**Job Description**
**Your Responsibilities:**
 We are looking for a dynamic Trade Execution \& Port Operations professional to manage end\-to\-end execution of edible oil imports and domestic trade operations. The role will be responsible for execution of import and local purchase contracts, vessel operations, customs coordination, terminal operations, inventory management, customer deliveries, documentation, cost control, and stakeholder management across multiple ports including JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and Haldia.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in handling imported edible oils such as Crude Palm Oil (CPO), Degummed Soybean Oil (DSO), Sunflower Oil, RBD and other bulk liquid commodities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Trade Execution
   

  

* Manage complete execution of purchase and sales contracts from contract confirmation until final settlement.
* Ensure timely execution of import shipments with minimal operational and financial risk.
* Coordinate contract nominations, shipment schedules, delivery plans, and execution timelines.
* Monitor contractual obligations and ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms.
* Maintain accurate trade position and execution status.


 Port \& Terminal Operations
   

  

* Independently manage day\-to\-day operations at JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and other assigned ports.
* Coordinate vessel discharge operations with shipping agents, tank terminals, surveyors, customs brokers, and transporters.
* Monitor vessel berthing, discharge progress, storage utilization, and cargo evacuation.
* Ensure timely completion of discharge operations while minimizing demurrage, detention, and operational delays.
* Coordinate local purchase unloading and customer loading operations.


 Customs \& Documentation
   

  

* Track Bill of Entry (BOE) filing and customs clearance.
* Coordinate with Customs House Agents (CHA), shipping lines, and regulatory authorities.
* Monitor duty payments and customs\-related compliance.
* Ensure timely availability of import documents for cargo clearance.


 Customer \& Supplier Coordination
   

  

* Act as the primary execution contact for buyers, suppliers, shipping companies, tank terminals, surveyors, inspectors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate delivery orders, cargo lifting schedules, sampling, inspections, and documentation.
* Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Perform margin calculations, revised pricing, duty variance calculations, and commercial settlements.
* Process Debit Notes (DN), Credit Notes (CN), and trade settlements.
* Verify invoices before processing


 Inventory \& Quality Management
   

  

* Monitor stock positions across terminals.
* Coordinate quality inspections, sampling, and survey reports.
* Ensure accurate inventory reconciliation.
* Coordinate quality and weight settlements with suppliers and buyers while minimizing commercial exposure.
* Monitor execution costs and identify opportunities for operational savings.
* Review port, terminal, survey, transport, and warehouse costs.
* Support vendor invoice verification and non\-raw material vendor payments.


 Reporting \& MIS, Process Improvement \& Compliance
   

  

* Maintain execution records and operational documentation.
* Prepare Daily Discharge Reports (DDR), vessel status reports, stock reports, and execution MIS.
* Update SharePoint and ERP systems with execution data.
* Prepare month\-end operational reports and support financial closing activities.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, trade compliance, food safety, and statutory requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining complete documentation.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Trading, Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Logistics, Customs, and Legal teams.
* Build effective relationships with customers, suppliers, terminals, surveyors, transporters, shipping agents, and government authorities.
* Maintain accurate execution records.
* Support ERP implementation and digital initiatives.
* Perform additional execution\-related responsibilities assigned by management.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Timely execution of purchase and sales contracts.
* Zero operational disruptions due to execution lapses.
* Minimized demurrage, detention, and avoidable logistics costs.
* Accurate BOE tracking and customs clearance.
* Timely customer deliveries and cargo lifting.
* Inventory accuracy and stock reconciliation.
* Timely completion of commercial settlements (DN/CN).
* Accuracy of MIS and operational reporting.
* Strong compliance with SOPs and audit requirements.
* Continuous improvement through cost\-saving and process optimization initiatives.


**Your Profile**
 Preferred Experience
   

  

* 5–10 years of experience in Trade Execution, Import Operations, Port Operations, or Supply Chain.
* Experience in edible oil imports is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience managing bulk liquid cargo operations.
* Experience handling multiple ports simultaneously.


**Preferred Commodity Experience**
* Crude Palm Oil (CPO) /Crude Deggumed Soybean Oil /Refined Oils /Crude Sunflower Oil /Other edible oil commodities

description:
As Design Lead (Civil / Structural), the person shall be capable of reviewing \& executing Engineering Activities of Civil/Structural Engineering of Solar PV Power Plants. She / He shall lead a team of Design Engineers and Draughts Persons to manage the Engineering activities within budget, deliver on time and maintaining a high quality of Engineering.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Timely Delivery of Engineering Drawings \& Documents
* Ensure deliveries are aligned to Project Schedule
* Review drawings by Design Engineers \& Draughts Persons. Checking of design \& sizing calculations of engineering electrical equipment and obtaining approvals from the client
* Review of Vendor deliverables pertaining to Engineering
* Capable of Multitasking and deliver multiple things on time
* Estimate and Plan man\-hour requirements
* Review BOQ and submit to contracts team and providing technical clarifications
* Coordinate with multiple disciplines for ensuring inter\-departmental checks
* Provide support \& clarifications to the Site Execution team
* Check pre\-award evaluation of vendors (w.r.t. technical specifications requirement of the client) and forward the validation document to Supply Chain Management
* Inspect equipment from the finalized vendor after submission of validation document of the vendor
* Clarify issues w.r.t. the design \& requirements of the client to the Site Execution Team
* Collect inputs for project details (Soil report, boundary coordinates, Topo Survey etc.) from client \& Section Hea
* Coordinating with Operations team and informing Design specifications for obtaining approval
* Provide support to Electrical DC, AC \& Instrumentation for reviewing Vendor drawings
* Submit requirement of man\-hours for undertaking \& reviewing of design \& drawings of the project
* Design deliverables like Module mounting structure design, GA Drawing, Control room, Inverter room civil \& Structural drawings \& document, Solar Plant Civil infrastructure drawings and design.


**Software Skills Required**
* Awareness of Staad pro, AUTOCAD, RIVIT, Google Earth, Civil 3D, Global Mapper, Solid Works


**Technical Expertise**
* Design Lead shall have technical expertise in Engineering activities for civil \& structural covering control room buildings, transformer foundations, outdoor equipment foundations, inverter rooms, grading, roads and drainage, outdoor steel structures and miscellaneous works related to the Solar Power Plant. Design Lead shall be able to review Vendor engineering documents with respect to Civil \& Structural design. The Design Lead (Civil / Structural) is required to understand and interpret the contractual technical requirements and facilitate the Project Teams as and when required.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* B.E. / B. Tech in Civil / Structural Engineering
* 10\-12 years (Must have experience in design aspects of Solar PV Power Plants / Power Distribution Projects)

 Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are hiring a
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations – Supply Chain Management Manager** 
 to join our Customer Success team. This role is crucial in ensuring the stability and effectiveness of our D365 F\&O system in the supply chain domain. You will collaborate with clients, functional teams, technical teams and developers to provide expert support, drive solutions and improve process outcomes. * Prepare/maintain support documentation, configuration guides and process documentation.
* Support implementation of enhancements through the full software development life cycle, hotfixes and service updates.
* Support period\-end/year\-end business activities.
* Guide clients on best practices for configuration/processes and internal controls within D365 F\&O.
* Continuous self\-learning of new features/functionality/technologies as well as guiding younger team members on their cases/career.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with D365 F\&O
* Strong functional knowledge of D365 F\&O SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Product Information Management, Warehouse Management).
* Microsoft certifications for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (preferred).
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail and collaborative teamwork abilities.
* Clear, confident English communication – comfortable engaging directly with U.S. counterparts during the alternate shift.
* Ability to manage multiple client expectations and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience supporting integrations between D365 SCM and 3PL, shipping carriers, or EDI platforms.
* Familiarity with manufacturing and distribution best practices.
* Experience with multi\-entity or global deployments.

* Experience managing business transformation and debottlenecking projects.

title: Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) - Internal Medicine
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 PPD’s (a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific) mission is to improve health. It starts as an idea to find a cure. It becomes a life saved. All in\-between, it’s you! We know that meaningful results not only require the right approach, but also the right people. We invite you to re\-imagine health promoting protocols with us, working alongside our talented, bright and energetic teams.
   

  

 Our therapeutic team directs, coordinates and manages the technical and operational aspects of projects, securing the successful completion of clinical trials. The team is therapeutically aligned to respond better to our customer needs.
   

  

**The therapeutic scope includes Cardiovascular \& Internal Medicine** 
**\-** 
 Dermatology, GI, (UC/CD), Cardiovascular, Liver, Nephrology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Diabetes, Obesity, Dyslipidemia, Women's Health.
   

  

 As a Senior Clinical Team Manager (Sr. CTM), you combine deep knowledge, therapeutic expertise, and robust tools to help our clients deliver life\-changing therapies to market. You take ownership of all start\-up and clinical deliverables, anticipate problems, find solutions and deliver results; coordinating the activities of start\-up and clinical team members which are allocated to a project on a Regional or Country basis.
   

  

 You will work in partnership with the Project Manager to ensure the necessary training, tracking and quality systems are in place for the clinical management team and be primarily responsible for the start\-up and clinical deliverables of the Project within agreed timelines and budget. Clinical Team Managers provide contact and support to the project sponsor for all clinical aspects.
   

  

 At PPD we hire the best, develop ourselves and each other, and recognize the power of being one team. We offer continued career advancement opportunities, award winning training and benefits focused on the health and wellbeing of our employees.
   

  

 Summarized Purpose:
   

  

 Accountable for achieving the final start\-up and clinical deliverables (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. Interprets data on complex issues and makes good business decisions with support from line management. Works to ensure that all start\-up and clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations. Maintains profitability by ensuring start\-up and clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the country start\-up and clinical team. Typically works independently on projects of moderate to high complexity and may assume regional lead or Clinical Study Manager responsibilities.
   

  

 Essential Functions:
   

  

* Manages all clinical and start\-up activities, operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of moderate to high complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Lead CTM responsibilities on regional level, Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities or take on additional responsibilities; e.g. process improvements, manage complex programs, have wider management or project coordination responsibilities.
* Acts as the primary point of contact for study start\-up activities and site activation across the assigned region and/or globally, driving timelines and ensuring operational excellence.
* Develops start\-up and clinical tools (e.g. Essential Document Checklist, Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the study requirements and Data Quality Plan. Contributes to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensures timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborates with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand\-off meetings.
* Collaborates with the start\-up country team, regulatory, clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicates with the team and leads team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department.
* Ensures achievement of the start\-up and clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring start\-up and clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitors clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. May routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials.
* Communicates with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study\-related issues.
* Coordinates all start\-up activities and ensures that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Ensures timely regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Reviews and follows up on all questions raised by ethics committees. Responsibilities may vary based on project timelines.
* Provides input into preparation of forecast estimates for start\-up and clinical activities. Responsible for start\-up and clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements.


 Education and Experience:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
* Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5\+ years).
* In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.


 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
   

  

* Strong experience managing end\-to\-end clinical trial start\-up (SSU) activities
* Experience leading cross\-functional collaboration with CAS, RAL, ICF PM, GCS, Contract Management, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless study execution.
* Strong leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teams
* Strong planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload and workload of team members
* Strong interpersonal and problem\-solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organization
* Solid understanding of change management principles
* Comprehensive understanding of the practices, processes, and requirements of start\-up and clinical monitoring
* Strong judgment, decision making, escalation, and risk management skills
* Effective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiency
* Capable of evaluating own and team members workload against project budget and adjust resources accordingly
* Strong financial acumen and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management
* Strong attention to detail
* In\-depth understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc.
* Strong computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.
* Capable of independently managing clinical only studies


 Working Environment:
   

  

* PPD, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:
* Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.
* Able to work upright and stationary for typical working hours.
* Able to work in non\-traditional work environments.
* Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.
* Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.
* May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.
* This role requires independent travel up to 20%, inclusive of traveling in automobiles, airplanes, and trains.


 Our 4i Values:
   

  

* Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – Involvement
* If you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you!

title: Area Business Manager
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
   

  

 Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
   

  

 Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial and team activities across a defined area in India to deliver measurable business results. You will build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital teams and internal partners to ensure high\-quality engagement. We value clarity, teamwork and practical problem solving. This role offers visible impact, career growth and the chance to help GSK unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: \- Develop and deliver an area business plan that meets local objectives and patient needs. \- Build and maintain trusted relationships with clinicians, hospital teams and healthcare decision makers. \- Lead, coach and support field teams to achieve targets and grow professionally. \- Coordinate with medical, market access and marketing colleagues to align local activities. \- Use market and customer insights to refine plans and improve local decisions. \- Monitor area performance, manage budgets and ensure accurate, timely reporting. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals \- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, business or related field. \- Minimum 3 years’ experience in pharmaceutical field roles, territory management or sales. \- Experience managing teams or leading field activities. \- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. \- Comfortable using CRM systems, Microsoft Office and digital tools. \- Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel across the assigned area. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus \- Experience working with hospitals, specialty or tertiary care providers. \- Background in specialty or complex therapeutic areas. \- Experience collaborating with medical affairs, access or procurement teams. \- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into practical actions. \- Prior coaching, mentoring or line management experience. \- Familiarity with virtual customer engagement and omnichannel approaches. Working arrangement This role is on\-site with regular travel across the assigned area. Hybrid working options may be discussed based on business needs and local policy. What we value in you We value clear communicators who listen and learn. We look for people who work well with others and put patients first. You should be curious, adaptable and comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. How to apply If this role motivates you and you want to grow while making a real difference to patients, please submit your CV and a short note explaining your interest. We look forward to hearing how you can contribute to our work to get ahead of disease together.
   

  

**Skills**
 Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
   

  

**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
 GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
   

  

**Inclusion at GSK:**
 As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
   

  

 Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
   

  

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
 GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
   

  

 It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
   

  

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
 If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Head of Business Applications for Grid Technologies Digital Services
description:
Head of GT DS BAP (Business Applications)
   

  

 Job Family: Information Technology
   

  

 Department: SE GT DS BAP
   

  

 Job Grade: Global \- Senior Management
   

  

**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As the Head of Business Applications, you are the leader of the development and delivery engine for GT Digital Services. You are accountable for the entire business application portfolio that runs our global Grid Technologies business from the PLM systems and platforms that design our Manufacturing and Production to the Engineering and Project and Service Platforms. Linked to our factories, and the CRM that manages our customer relationships, and the PM ecosystem that enables complex project execution. Certain platforms and applications are delivered by your own organization; others are delivered by global Digital Core Value Centers for the GT Business or by external parties.
   

  

 Ensuring that projects and services are delivered flawlessly is your ambition. Your day will be spent leading a large, diverse organization of technology experts and managers, overseeing the execution of major digital programs, ensuring the operational stability of our critical systems, managing external service providers and partnering closely with our Business Partnering teams to manage and deliver on a complex portfolio of business demands.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Leading, inspiring, and developing a large, multi\-layered, and growing organization of internal and external application managers, developers, service owners, and data experts, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement
* Establishing a strong, collaborative partnership with Grid Technologies Process Owners in the business and Business Integration Architects in our GT DS Governance \& Digital Architecture team to ensure our application platforms are perfectly aligned with our end\-to\-end business processes and enterprise architecture
* Being accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of all application projects and programs, ensuring they are executed on time, within budget, and to a high standard of quality
* Championing and driving the modernization of our application landscape and engineering practices, leading the transition towards an Agile operating model and challenging the status quo to achieve productivity increase while supporting our growth.
* Managing the entire application portfolio lifecycle for Grid Technologies, making strategic decisions on technology selection, investment, and the rationalization of legacy systems
* Ensuring the operational stability, performance, and security of all business\-critical applications, in line with agreed\-upon service levels


**What You Bring**
* Longstanding experience in a senior leadership role, managing large\-scale application development and operations teams (50\-100\+ FTEs) within a global, industrial or manufacturing company
* Proven experience in managing strategic vendors and technology suppliers, including contract negotiation, performance management, and leveraging effective sourcing strategies for the benefit of the business
* You are a technology leader who speaks the language of the business. You have a proven ability to connect technology investments to tangible business outcomes and to manage a large and complex budget effectively
* Strong change management capability and proven transformation experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading organizations through complex technology and business transformations, driving cultural change, and ensuring sustainable adoption across globally distributed teams
* Expert\-level knowledge of the core enterprise application platforms that underpin the industrial value chain, including PLM, ERP, MES, CRM/FSM, PM, as well as demonstrated experience in implementing and scaling modern software engineering practices, including Agile methodologies (SAFe, Scrum), CI/CD, and DevOps. At best you have a background in applications programing or solutions development, and you are very familiar with the world of IT applications.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), data architecture, and AI/ML principles, as well as deep expertise in IT Service Management (ITSM/ITIL), application portfolio management, and large\-scale program management
* Demonstrated experience in leading large, globally distributed, and multi\-layered technology organizations with a proven ability to lead and develop other managers, as well as exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical strategies and roadmaps to senior business executives and, in parallel, to guide and motivate deep technical specialists


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100\.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
 In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer\-financed company pension scheme.
   

  

 We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder.
   

  

 We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity.
   

  

 The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us.
   

  

 We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self\-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose.
   

  

 In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part\-time work or even a sabbatical.
   

  

 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

title: Manager ,Restructuring
description:
**Associate Vice President, Restructuring**
 Our Restructuring practices’ aim is to provide effective solutions to its clients. Our clients include major high street banks, asset\-based lenders, private equity houses, accountants, solicitors, financial sponsors, lenders, creditors, corporates and individuals. We are tasked with offering transaction and advisory services along with expert guidance to both domestic and foreign organizations in distressed situations across virtually every industry and every situation.
   

  

 We are seeking an Associate Vice President to work with clients to advise them on how they can simplify their group structures. This role will be based in India and will collaborate closely with global teams in UK and Europe region.
   

  

 You will be involved throughout all stages of the simplification lifecycle, working as part of a team to advise clients on how to dispose of and reorganise corporate entities, realise assets, resolve outstanding issues such as the settlement of creditor claims and assist in the distribution of the surplus assets to shareholders.
   

  

 You will broaden your knowledge as part of a fast\-growing global team that has strong relationships and networks across different industry groups and jurisdictions.
   

  

 You will develop an impressive range of advisory and technical implementation skills, gaining exposure to company legislation and accounting principles. This will foster a solid legal and financial understanding of different clients and businesses that will offer you both growth and career progression opportunities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Pre\-elimination diligence to identify risk areas (both on and off balance sheet) requiring resolution ahead of liquidation. For example, preparation of balance sheet rationalisation steps, underpinned by a solid understanding of accounting principles and an awareness of corporate law and tax implications.
* Administer a portfolio of MVLs and CVLs from cradle\-to\-grave, ensuring statutory compliance and case progression in line with agreed timetables and budgets.
* Oversee and review work prepared by junior colleagues including: KYC, fee quotes, engagement letters, liquidation appointment documentation, case reviews, annual progress reports, distribution documentation and final reports.
* Assume responsibility for client relations and liaise with clients, clients’ employees, agents and solicitors as necessary
* Provide ad hoc support including input into proposals, statutory compliance, tracking pipeline opportunities and billing management etc.
* Provide guidance, motivation, mentoring and assistance to the team, assisting them with their training and progression in Kroll and undertake appraisals and other actions as required
* Adhere to Kroll systems, policy requirements and relevant Health \& Safety policy


**Requirements**
* Strong academic qualifications and accounting experience. An ideal candidate will possess finance relation educational qualifications such as Chartered Accountant, Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting or Finance MBA
* At least five years’ experience preparing entities for closure and managing a portfolio of MVLs and CVLs.
* A sound understanding of relevant insolvency legislation and of statutory and regulatory requirements in respect of the liquidation processes across Scotland, England and Wales, with proven experience.
* Good interpersonal, written and oral communication skills and experience collaborating with key stakeholders (i.e. clients, professional advisors, tax authorities).
* A self\-starting team player with a can\-do attitude and a problem\-solving mind.
* Good attention to detail, organisational and administrative capabilities with the ability to prioritise effectively.
* Ability to work well under pressure, deal with ambiguity and meet deadlines.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, specifically Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience in using IPS.


 In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com.
   

  

*Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit.*

title: Lead Analyst – Supply Chain (SAP MM)
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Digital and Technology team of General Mills is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual to contribute to the Logistics and Customer Fulfillment team in capacity of a Lead Analyst focusing on driving, delivering, and supporting the key portfolio shaping initiatives in Inventory space across our Supply Chain organization. This position offers the opportunity to experience a full range of project life cycle including discovery, design, development, testing, delivery, and support of the solutions in SAP Supply Chain areas of Operations. Expectation is to scale global solutions, drive innovations that enhance user experience, deliver value to business, mentor the broader Logistics and Customer Fulfillment team and support process and technology across Supply Chain.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide technical leadership for SAP MM and related inventory management solutions
* Lead the design of scalable, secure, and resilient supply chain inventory solutions
* Translate business requirements into integrated solution designs that support supply chain operations
* Lead end\-to\-end solution delivery across design, build, testing, deployment, and stabilization
* Identify and implement innovative, AI\-enabled improvements to enhance system efficiency and sustainability
* Ensure solutions comply with security, integration, data, and operational standards
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to supply chain stakeholders and business partners
* Mentor analysts, developers, and capability teams to strengthen technical delivery and solution quality
* Identify opportunities to simplify, optimize, and enhance inventory processes and supporting technology solutions
* Drive operational excellence across production support, escalations, ServiceNow performance, and key service metrics
* Build strong partnerships across business teams, technical teams, and external partners to deliver value


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university
* 14\+ years of experience across SAP ECC and S/4HANA, including 7\+ years of project implementation and delivery experience
* Strong experience leading end\-to\-end SAP implementations in Inventory domain of supply chain environments
* Deep expertise in SAP Supply Chain, with strong focus on Materials Management, Inventory Management, Quality Management, and Batch Management
* Strong understanding of SAP and non\-SAP integrations to help support solutions
* Good understanding of the master and transactional data required for SAP S/4 and planning tools
* Strong business process experience in inventory, logistics, and supply chain operations
* Proven ability to translate supply chain business challenges into effective technical solutions
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across organizational levels
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver in fast\-paced environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a structured approach


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Basic understanding of Production Planning, Warehouse Management
* Experience in ABAP development
* Experience with agile methods and ways of working
* Good understanding of integration technologies such as EDI, MuleSoft, APIs, and third\-party systems


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally.  The Position
   

  

 Technology Consultant Learning Operations Expert
   

  

**Introduction** 
 As a Technology Consultant at the SE6 level within RDT Performance \& Insights, you will take on a matrix leadership role to deliver on a diversity of high\-impact products and multi\-faceted projects. You will lead both internal and external teams or squads in a matrix organization, developing advanced approaches like Agile backlog management, and driving the timeline and strategy across product teams. **Who you are:**

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
   

  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL\-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision\-making through data\-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support \& engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go\-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data\-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.


**Industry Insight:** 
 Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
   

  

**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on\-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision\-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior\-level decision\-makers and c\-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**

 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.
