The Warehouse Manager will be responsible for **overall warehouse operations, inventory, production coordination and timely fulfilment of customer POs**. The role will also involve managing **Amazon and Flipkart shipments**, ensuring that orders are prepared and dispatched accurately as per PO requirements and marketplace timelines.

Core Responsibilities

**1\. Warehouse Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day warehouse operations and ensure smooth movement of stock.
* Maintain proper storage and SKU\-wise organization of raw materials, components and finished goods.
* Monitor inward, outward, transfers, damages and stock discrepancies.
* Ensure physical stock matches system/ERP inventory.
* Maintain proper warehouse discipline, housekeeping and processes.
* Supervise warehouse staff and allocate daily responsibilities.

**2\. Production \& Order Fulfilment**

* Plan and coordinate production/assembly based on upcoming POs and order requirements.
* Ensure sufficient finished goods are available for timely PO fulfilment.
* Follow up with production and assembly teams for pending requirements.
* Identify shortages or production delays and take timely action.
* Prepare a daily production and fulfilment plan based on dispatch priorities.

**3\. PO Management \& Dispatch**

* Review customer POs and plan fulfilment according to required dispatch dates.
* Ensure correct **SKU, quantity, packaging and labeling** against each PO.
* Coordinate picking, packing and final dispatch.
* Track PO\-wise Ready / Pending / Dispatched status.
* Ensure shipments are dispatched within the required timeline.
* Maintain dispatch records and documentation.

**4\. Amazon \& Flipkart Operations**

* Handle shipment creation and dispatch processes on **Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub**.
* Manage FBA/FBF shipment requirements as applicable.
* Create shipments according to PO/order requirements.
* Ensure correct SKU, quantity, carton details and shipment documentation.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams for timely handover.
* Monitor shipment status and resolve dispatch\-related issues.

**5\. Inventory Control**

* Maintain accurate inventory of raw materials, components and finished goods.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconciliation.
* Monitor fast\-moving, slow\-moving and low\-stock items.
* Identify inventory shortages and discrepancies and report them to management.
* Ensure timely stock updates in ERP/Excel.

Team Management

* Supervise warehouse, packing and dispatch staff.
* Set daily priorities and monitor work completion.
* Ensure staff follow warehouse and dispatch processes.
* Train team members on SKU handling, packing and dispatch procedures.

Key Deliverables

* On\-time PO fulfilment and dispatch
* Accurate Amazon \& Flipkart shipments
* Accurate inventory records
* Production aligned with order requirements
* Minimum stock discrepancies
* Daily warehouse and dispatch reporting
* Proper warehouse organization and team productivity

* Warehouse Management

* Production \& Assembly Coordination
* PO Fulfilment
* Dispatch \& Logistics Management
* Amazon Seller Central
* Flipkart Seller Hub
* FBA / FBF Shipment Management
* Excel \& Inventory Reporting
* Team Management
* Planning, Coordination \& Follow\-up
* Strong attention to detail

Candidate Profile

title: SITE SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGER
description:
Job Title\- Supply Chain Manager
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Manager – Supply Chain Management is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing end\-to\-end supply chain operations, including procurement, inventory management, logistics, warehousing,
 **Stores** 
 , and
 **Spare Parts Division (SPD)** 
 . The role ensures uninterrupted material availability, cost efficiency, accurate inventory control, and timely support to production, maintenance, and after\-sales/service functions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supply Chain Planning \& Control
* Develop and implement supply chain strategies aligned with business goals.
* Plan demand forecasting, material planning, and replenishment cycles.
* Ensure optimal inventory levels while minimizing carrying and obsolescence costs.
* Coordinate with production, maintenance, sales, and service teams.
* Stores Management
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of stores/warehouses.
* Ensure proper receipt, storage, preservation, and issuance of materials.
* Implement FIFO/FEFO practices and ensure accurate stock records.
* Maintain inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts and audits.
* Ensure compliance with safety, housekeeping, and regulatory standards.
* Spare Parts Division (SPD) Management
* Manage end\-to\-end operations of the Spare Parts Division.
* Ensure availability of critical and fast\-moving spare parts to support maintenance and service requirements.
* Classify and control spare parts (critical, insurance, non\-moving, obsolete).
* Optimize spare parts inventory levels to reduce downtime and excess stock.
* Coordinate with maintenance, service, and engineering teams for forecasting and planning.
* Logistics \& Distribution
* Manage inbound and outbound logistics operations.
* Optimize transportation costs and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with logistics partners and ensure timely dispatch and receipt of materials and spares.
* Systems, Processes \& Compliance
* Ensure effective use of ERP/MRP systems for inventory and supply chain management.
* Develop and improve SOPs for stores, procurement, and SPD operations.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and statutory regulations.
* Team Leadership \& Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop supply chain, stores, and SPD teams.
* Allocate tasks, set performance goals, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
* Prepare MIS reports on inventory, procurement, logistics, and spare parts performance.
* Analyze KPIs such as inventory turnover, service level, stock accuracy, and cost savings.
* Identify improvement opportunities and implement best practices.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of supply chain, inventory, stores, and spare parts management
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Vendor negotiation and cost management
* ERP/MRP system proficiency
* Leadership and team management skills
* Strong communication and coordination abilities


**Qualifications**
* BE \+ MBA in Supply Chain Management, Logistics.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in supply chain management from Auto Ancillary Companies MNC are preferred.
* Proven experience managing Stores and Spare Parts Division in a manufacturing, industrial, or service environment.
* Experience Must able to handle multiple locations

* Establish and monitor service standards and SLAs for all facility service providers.
* Conduct regular facility inspections and take corrective actions where required.
* Employee Transportation – Pune \& Hyderabad
* Own and coordinate employee transportation operations for the Pune office, including day\-to\-day transport requirements for employees working in different shifts.
* Provide coordination and operational oversight for employee transportation for Hyderabad night\-shift employees.
* Ensure safe, reliable and timely transportation for employees, particularly during night shifts.
* Coordinate with transportation vendors, transport desk/teams, security and internal stakeholders.
* Manage cab routes, rosters, vehicle allocation, trip schedules and shift requirements.
* Monitor transportation vendor performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.

* Ensure appropriate escalation and contingency arrangements are available for late\-night or emergency situations.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure that transportation arrangements remain aligned with employee shift patterns and business requirements.
* Night\-Shift Facilities Coordination
* Coordinate and oversee facilities requirements for night\-shift operations in both Pune and Hyderabad.
* Ensure appropriate availability of security, housekeeping, transportation, pantry and other essential facility services during night shifts.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms for facility or employee transportation issues occurring outside normal business hours.
* Coordinate remotely with Hyderabad teams/vendors and travel to Hyderabad when required for operational reviews, audits, projects or escalations.
* Ensure adequate support and contingency arrangements for critical night\-shift requirements.
* Vendor \& Contract Management

* Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews.

title: Global Supply Chain Manager
description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
   

  

 Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
   

  

****Our Mission****
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
   

  

 Follow us on
   

  

 LinkedIn \| Youtube \| Instagram
   

  

**About The Role**
****Job Title****
 : Global Supply Chain Manager
   

  

****Experience****
 : 8\+ years
   

  

****Location****
 : Pune
   

  

 We are looking for a Global Supply Chain Manager to own the end to end supply chain for Sibros hardware. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role. You will own supplier relationships and agreements, demand planning against long component lead times, global trade and customs compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India, carrier and third party logistics partnerships, and the inventory system of record. You will set the policies that govern how we forecast, buy, hold, move, and return hardware, and you will be accountable for the cost, timing, and compliance of every unit that moves.
   

  

 The role sits at the point where customer commitments meet supplier capacity. Component lead times run six to twelve months, we order against forecasts ahead of customer purchase orders, and we are building our own telematics control unit alongside our existing supplier portfolio. You will own the risk that sits inside that gap. You will work directly with Finance on inventory exposure, with Sales and Technical Program Management on customer commitments, with Legal on supplier and export compliance, and with Engineering on new product introduction.
   

  

 This role is built for someone who raises problems early, escalates without being asked, and closes them without being chased.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Supplier Management and Procurement\- Own supplier relationships end to end, from qualification and onboarding through agreement execution and ongoing commercial management. Ensure every supplier is onboarded under a signed agreement before we transact. Issue approved purchase orders to suppliers within 24 hours and drive supplier follow through to committed dates.
* Demand Planning and Inventory Strategy\- Build and maintain the rolling demand forecast that long component lead times require. Set and maintain regional buffer stock levels and reorder points. Own the inventory position against both committed and forecast customer demand, and surface working capital exposure to Finance before it is committed rather than after.
* Global Trade and Customs Compliance\- Own import and export compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India. Maintain entity registrations, EORI and VAT numbers, product classifications, Incoterms, and customs broker relationships. Ensure every shipment departs with complete and correct documentation so that clearance is routine rather than an escalation.
* Logistics, Carrier, and 3PL Management\- Own carrier and third party logistics relationships, contracts, and rates. Manage freight and landed cost per unit as a reported metric with a target. Own shipment escalation end to end, including direct escalation into carriers, so that Engineering and Technical Program Management are never asked to execute logistics work.
* Returns, Warranty, and Device Lifecycle\- Own the returns and warranty process from customer intake through supplier claim and closure. Maintain unit level traceability across serial number, IMEI, and SIM for every device from receipt through decommissioning.
* Systems, Reporting, and Process Ownership\- Own the inventory system of record and its accuracy. Maintain the operating procedures and runbooks that govern the hardware process. Publish the weekly open order report, the monthly inventory reconciliation, and the quarterly demand forecast, and hold the numbers to an audit ready standard.
* New Product Introduction Support\- Support the launch of Sibros designed hardware by owning supplier selection, component sourcing strategy, contract manufacturer evaluation, and the supply chain readiness plan from prototype through production.


**What You Should Know**
* Education: Bachelor's / Master's degree in any discipline.
* Professional Experience: 8\+ years in supply chain, procurement, or global logistics, including at least 3 years owning a function rather than executing within one.
* Demand Planning: Demonstrated ownership of a demand forecast against component or finished goods lead times of six months or longer, including buffer stock policy and reorder point setting.
* Trade Compliance: Hands on ownership of import and export documentation and customs clearance in at least two of the United States, the European Union, and India, including direct management of customs brokers.
* Commercial Management: Experience negotiating and managing supplier, carrier, and third party logistics contracts, and managing freight and landed cost as a controlled expense.
* Systems: Ownership of an ERP or inventory management system as the system of record, with advanced Excel and Google Sheets capability for reconciliation and reporting.
* Ownership and Escalation: A proven record of raising risks early, escalating without prompting, and closing issues without follow up. This is the most important requirement of the role.
* Communication: Clear and timely communication across the United States, European Union, and India time zones with internal teams, suppliers, carriers, and customers.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field. APICS CPIM, APICS CSCP, or CIPS certification.
* Industry Context: Experience in hardware enabled, IoT, automotive, or embedded systems environments, including exposure to automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949\.
* New Product Introduction: Experience taking a new hardware product from prototype to volume production, including electronics manufacturing services and contract manufacturer selection.
* Regional Expertise: Established customs broker and freight forwarder relationships in India, and working familiarity with the India to European Union and India to United States shipping lanes.
* ERP Proficiency: Experience with NetSuite, Odoo, Zoho, QuickBooks, or other ERP and inventory tools, and with Jira as an operational workflow system.
* Lifecycle Management: Exposure to returns, reverse logistics, refurbishment, and end of life device disposition.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives.
* Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement.
* Learning \& Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs.
* Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off, you decide when you need a break.
* Team Culture: Regular team events, off\-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.


 Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Sibros is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, age, sex, ancestry, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, present or past history of mental disability, genetic information or any other classification protected by state or federal law.

title: Freight Operations Supervisor
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Title\- Assistant Manager – Ocean Operations
 



 Location: Pune, Magarpatta
 



  





 Position Overview: The Assistant Manager – Ocean Operations will be responsible for managing and overseeing end\-to\-end ocean freight operations, covering both FCL and LCL shipments. The role will involve shipment planning and execution, booking and scheduling, coordination with shipping lines and freight forwarders, documentation, shipment tracking, exception management, and timely delivery follow\-up. The role will also be responsible for ensuring operational accuracy, compliance with applicable shipping and trade requirements, effective stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement of ocean freight processes. The position will provide operational guidance and support to team members while ensuring smooth and efficient handling of increasing shipment volumes.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* End\-to\-End Ocean Freight Operations:
* Manage the complete lifecycle of FCL and LCL ocean shipments, from shipment planning and booking through documentation, vessel movement, tracking, and final delivery.
* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, warehouses, and other logistics partners for smooth shipment execution.
* Handle shipment bookings, vessel schedules, cut\-off timelines, cargo readiness, container planning, and documentation requirements.
* Monitor shipment milestones and proactively follow up on delays, rollovers, schedule changes, container\-related issues, and other operational exceptions.
* Ensure timely coordination for cargo pickup, stuffing, container movement, port processes, vessel departure, transshipment, arrival, and delivery.
* Ensure shipments are executed within agreed timelines and operational requirements.
* Handle day\-to\-day operational queries and resolve shipment\-related issues through effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.



**FCL \& LCL Shipment Management:** 



* Manage FCL export and import shipments, including container booking, equipment availability, shipping line coordination, cut\-off management, and shipment tracking.
* Manage LCL shipments, including coordination with freight forwarders/consolidators, cargo readiness, consolidation schedules, documentation, and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate with relevant parties to ensure timely cargo movement and avoid unnecessary delays, demurrage, detention, storage, and other additional costs.
* Monitor container and cargo movement and ensure timely escalation of operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with warehouses, suppliers, freight forwarders, and transporters to ensure cargo is available and moved as per the planned sailing schedule.



**Documentation \& Trade Compliance:** 



* Ensure accurate and timely preparation, verification, and submission of ocean shipping documentation.
* Handle and review documents such as Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Shipping Instructions, and other applicable shipping and trade documents.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve documentation discrepancies.
* Ensure shipping documentation is complete and accurate within defined timelines.
* Handle preferential and non\-preferential Certificates of Origin and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for issuance and submission.
* Ensure compliance with applicable international trade, customs, shipping, and documentation requirements.
* Maintain proper operational records and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.



  





**Shipping Line \& Freight Forwarder Coordination:** 



* Coordinate with shipping lines and freight forwarders for bookings, schedules, rates, equipment availability, documentation, and shipment execution.
* Follow up on vessel schedules, rollovers, delays, transshipments, port congestion, and other operational issues.
* Monitor service levels and operational performance of logistics service providers.
* Escalate recurring service issues and coordinate corrective actions with service providers.
* Support negotiations and discussions related to operational requirements, service quality, and freight\-related issues.



  





**Stakeholder Management:** 



* Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders regarding ocean freight shipments and operational matters.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Planning, Finance, Warehouse, Supply Chain, Customs, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Provide timely shipment status updates and highlight potential delays or risks.
* Ensure alignment between shipment requirements, cargo readiness, documentation, and delivery timelines.
* Handle operational escalations and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.



  





**Team Coordination \& Support:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day operational guidance and support to team members handling ocean freight activities.
* Support the team in managing FCL and LCL shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Review operational activities for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with defined processes.
* Train and guide junior team members on ocean freight processes, documentation, systems, and operational procedures.
* Support the team in resolving complex shipment\-related issues and exceptions.
* Ensure appropriate allocation and prioritization of operational activities within the team.



  





**Cost Control \& Process Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to improve ocean freight processes, shipment planning, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Monitor and minimize avoidable costs such as demurrage, detention, storage, documentation charges, and other operational expenses.
* Support freight and logistics cost optimization through effective shipment planning and coordination.
* Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of SOPs, process controls, and operational best practices.
* Monitor key operational performance indicators and support continuous improvement initiatives.



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Commerce, or a
 



 related field.
 



  





**Experience** 




 • 7–9 years of relevant experience in Ocean Freight Operations.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience in managing both FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Experience in end\-to\-end ocean freight operations, shipment coordination, documentation, and
 



 carrier/freight forwarder management.
 



 • Prior experience in handling or coordinating a team will be preferred.

title: P & M General Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 MD Infra India Pvt. Ltd. (MDI) is an infrastructure development and construction company headquartered in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, with projects across Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Goa. The organization focuses on complex and critical infrastructure projects, including roads, highways, bridges, dams, and water infrastructure. MDI combines engineering expertise, experienced project teams, technology, and strong operational discipline to deliver projects safely and efficiently. The company emphasizes responsible construction that promotes connectivity, opportunities, and long\-term value for clients, communities, and the nation. Guided by the objective to build better, responsibly, and for the future, MDI continues to invest in people, systems, and sustainable practices.
   

**Role Description** 
 The P \& M (Plant \& Machinery) General Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune Division. This role oversees the planning, deployment, operation, and maintenance of construction equipment and machinery for highway, bridge, and infrastructure projects. The General Manager will manage asset utilization, preventive and corrective maintenance schedules, spare parts planning, and vendor coordination to ensure minimal downtime and optimal productivity. Daily responsibilities include supervising P \& M teams, monitoring equipment performance and costs, implementing safety and compliance standards, and preparing reports and forecasts for senior leadership. The role also involves collaborating with project managers, procurement, and finance to align equipment resources with project timelines and budgets, and driving continuous improvement in P \& M processes and systems.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong experience in plant and machinery management within infrastructure, roads, highways, or heavy construction projects.
* Proficiency in equipment planning, preventive and predictive maintenance, and asset lifecycle management.
* Ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams, with skills in people management, delegation, and performance monitoring.
* Competence in budgeting, cost control, and analytical reporting related to equipment utilization and operating expenses.
* Knowledge of safety regulations, statutory compliances, and best practices for operating heavy construction equipment.
* Experience in vendor management, negotiation, and coordination for equipment procurement, rentals, and spare parts.
* Familiarity with maintenance management systems, ERP tools, or digital platforms for tracking equipment and workflows.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification in management is an added advantage.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across project and corporate teams.
* Proven ability to work on\-site in dynamic project environments and travel to project locations as required.

title: Transformation Programme Manager, Procurement
description:
**Entity**
 Finance

**Overview**
**Job Description:**
 We are a global energy business involved in every aspect of the energy system. We are working towards delivering light, heat and mobility to millions of people, every day. Our people want to play their part in solving the big, sophisticated challenges facing our world today and, guided by our bp values, are working to help meet the world’s need for more energy while lowering carbon emissions. In our offices at Pune, we work in customer service, finance, accounting, procurement,
   

  

 Would you like to discover how our diverse, hardworking people are leading the way in making energy cleaner and better – and how you can play your part in our outstanding team?
   

  

 Join our team, and develop your career in an encouraging, forward\-thinking environment!
   

  

**Role: Transformation Programme Manager, Procurement**
 Procurement at bp is going through its biggest digital and process transformation in a generation. The vision and purpose of this transformation is to make procurement at bp a ‘best\-in\-class’ function, achieving ‘top quartile’ status across efficiency and effectiveness.
   

  

 Reporting into the Procurement Transformation PMO, you will take ownership of one or more projects within a portfolio of 15\+ initiatives that span all of bp's operating businesses, as part of a 5\+ year transformation roadmap that started in 2024\.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* You will be hands\-on in the day\-to\-day management and delivery of your projects — driving plans, supervising progress, handling risks and keeping stakeholders aligned — while applying the programme and project management standards set by the PMO.
* You will handle the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned projects within the Procurement Transformation programme, ensuring they are delivered to plan, budget and agreed outcomes.
* You will apply programme and project management best practice, working within the standard ways of working and delivery framework set by the PMO.
* You will work closely with our technology teams on project deliverables, coordinating dependencies and helping hold delivery to account on agreed outcomes.
* You will coordinate and empower project squads, delivery partners and third\-party contractors — leading through influence rather than direct line management — while fostering an inclusive working culture.
* You will liaise with vendors and colleagues across different time zones, requiring careful coordination between teams.
* You will keep abreast of developments in rapidly changing industry best practices, as well as bp's internal policies and procedures, to ensure compliance and support continuous improvement.
* You will ensure your projects are delivered to the scope signed off by the relevant Project Management \& Governance groups.
* You will build, integrate and maintain accurate project schedules — sequencing activities and tracking plans and reporting to support on\-time delivery of the wider portfolio.
* You will identify and highlight risks and issues, working with the PMO and relevant teams to manage and mitigate them, and contributing to a strong risk culture within the teams.
* You will capture lessons learned and support their embedding into similar projects and initiatives.
* You will prepare clear, accurate progress reporting, important metrics and benefits supervising for your projects to support PMO and governance reviews.


**Essential Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Management, Project Management, Procurement, Business, Finance, Accounting or a related field. A Master's degree will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in project management and process improvement within large, complex programmes. Procurement\-related project management will be an added advantage.
* A recognised project management qualification (e.g. Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2, APMG or similar).
* A track record of managing projects to ensure they are well defined and completed within scope, schedule and budget.
* Experience of coordinating and motivating delivery teams, squads and third\-party contractors in a matrixed environment, without formal line authority.
* A good understanding of the Source to Pay function — how it runs, delivers value, and its challenges and opportunities.
* Experience of working cross\-culturally and in an international environment.
* Strong communication, presentation and articulation skills — able to present confidently to senior stakeholders.


**Join our Team and advance your career as a Transformation Programme Manager, Procurement!**

title: South Indian Head chef
description:
**About us** 




 Gatti Chutney is a premium South Indian QSR specialising in Bangalore\-style dosas, with three outlets in Pune (Koregaon Park, Baner, Kharadi). Every batter, chutney and base is made in our Central Kitchen and sent to the outlets daily, so the CK is the heart of the brand. We're open 365 days a year.
 



**The role** 




 You'll own the Central Kitchen end to end: what gets made, how it tastes, what it costs, and how it reaches the outlets. You'll also lead menu R\&D and launch one new dish every month.
 



**Key responsibilities** 




*Production \& consistency* 



* Run daily production of dosa and idli batters, chutneys, sambar, palya and other prep strictly as per company SOPs and standard recipes
* Plan production against outlet indents and ensure on\-time, complete dispatch
* Control batter fermentation and chutney consistency across batches and seasons
* Maintain standard recipes with defined yields and portion specs



*Quality \& food safety* 



* Check incoming raw material for quality, weight and expiry; reject non\-conforming stock
* QC every batch before dispatch (taste, texture, temperature, labelling with batch/prep date/use\-by)
* Enforce FIFO/FEFO, shelf\-life rules and cold chain from CK to outlet
* Keep the CK FSSAI\-compliant and audit\-ready: hygiene, pest control, water testing, periodic lab testing
* Investigate outlet quality complaints and fix the root cause



*Food cost \& wastage* 



* Keep food cost within company target; track yields and variances
* Record, analyse and reduce CK wastage
* Conduct stock counts and reconcile consumption against production
* Work with purchase on raw material specs, vendor quality and pricing



*R\&D \& menu* 



* Launch one new dish every month: develop, cost, trial, write the SOP and train outlet teams
* Create seasonal and festive specials
* Improve existing recipes for taste, cost and shelf life



*Team* 



* Lead the CK team: rostering for 365\-day operations, training, hygiene discipline, performance
* Train outlet kitchen teams on new dishes and SOP updates; do regular outlet taste audits
* Develop a second\-in\-command



*Equipment \& reporting* 



* Ensure upkeep of grinders, kettles and cold storage with a preventive maintenance schedule
* Share daily production, dispatch and wastage reports; monthly food cost and R\&D update to founders



**What we're looking for** 



* 5\+ years in South Indian kitchen
* Hands\-on mastery For South Indian dishes
* Strong in recipe costing, yield control and inventory management
* FSSAI FoSTaC (Food Safety Supervisor) certified, or willing to get certified
* Comfortable with Excel and POS/inventory software (we use Petpooja)
* A floor leader, not a desk chef



**How you'll be measured** 




 Food cost %, CK wastage %, on\-time dispatch and fill rate, outlet quality complaints, audit scores, one new dish launched every month.
 



**What we offer** 



* ₹65k–90k/month based on experience
* Annual bonus
* 30 paid leaves a year, plus weekly off
* Accommodation
* 3 meals a day
* PF and gratuity as per law
* The chance to build the kitchen behind a growing premium brand

 Booking

**Network Experience**

 The candidate will work with Network Operations to improve the physical customer experience at every charging station:
 



  





 Signage
 



 Parking
 



 Charger accessibility
 



 Lighting
 



 Cleanliness
 



 Safety
 



 Cable management
 



 User instructions
 



 Branding
 



 Site information
 



 Customer amenities

**Data \& Analytics**

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

**MUST\-HAVE EXPERIENCE**

title: Infrastructure Engineer - Network operations
description:

* Automation and scripting: Practical experience using Python and/or Ansible (and related tooling) to automate operational tasks, reduce toil, validate configurations, and improve reliability at scale.


**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**
* Reliability engineering and observability: Experience improving monitoring, alert quality, operational KPIs, and proactive issue prevention.
* Advanced automation and IaC: Exposure to CI/CD patterns for network change, configuration management, testing/validation, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform) where applicable.
* Hybrid and cloud networking: Working knowledge of cloud connectivity and hybrid patterns (AWS/Azure), including operational troubleshooting across on\-prem and cloud.
* Vendor and service integration: Experience working with vendor\-delivered services under defined operational controls, knowledge transfer, and measurable outcomes.
* Operational excellence: Recognised escalation SME who drives sustained operational improvement through data, controls, and disciplined execution.


 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: F&A Manager | CA
description:
**Manager – Accounts \& Finance**




**Job Location: Pune (Camp)** 




**Industry: Real Estate / Construction / Promoter \& Developer** 




**Reporting to: Head – Finance / CFO** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and technology\-savvy Manager – Accounts \& Finance to lead the Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP\&A and Tax Compliance functions for a leading promoter, developer and construction group in Pune.
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, smooth monthly closing, effective tax compliance, robust MIS and FP\&A support, and efficient utilisation of the organisation’s ERP system. The position will also lead and mentor the accounting team and drive process discipline, automation and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 




 Lead day\-to\-day accounting operations across the group and ensure accuracy, completeness and timely recording of financial transactions.
 



 Drive the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close process.
 



 Review general ledger, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, revenue, costs, receivables, payables and other accounting schedules.
 



 Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for construction projects, development activities, land transactions, project costs and related\-party transactions.
 



 Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
 



  





**MIS, FP\&A \& Business Support** 




 Lead preparation of monthly MIS, project\-wise profitability reports, budgets, forecasts, cash\-flow projections and variance analysis.
 



 Provide meaningful financial insights to management on project performance, costs, margins, working capital and cash flows.
 



 Develop and improve management dashboards and analytical reports to support business decision\-making.
 



 Work closely with project, commercial, procurement and business teams to ensure timely and accurate financial information.
 



  





**Tax \& Statutory Compliance** 




 Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
 



 Ensure timely filing of returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax/statutory queries.
 



 Coordinate with external tax advisors, auditors and consultants wherever required.
 



 Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.
 



  





**ERP \& Process Management** 




 Take ownership of the ERP system from a finance and accounting perspective and ensure smooth and effective utilisation by the accounting and business teams.
 



 Work with ERP teams/consultants to configure processes, improve controls and develop MIS reports.
 



 Should have the ability to understand business requirements and design/define ERP\-based MIS and reporting solutions.
 



 Experience with ERP platforms such as Highrise, SAP or equivalent will be an advantage.
 



 Drive standardisation, automation, internal controls and continuous improvement of finance processes.
 



  





**Audit \& Compliance** 




 Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
 



 Maintain appropriate documentation and supporting schedules for audit and management review.
 



 Strengthen financial controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Lead, guide and motivate the accounting team to deliver accurate, timely and reliable financial information.
 



 Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and develop team capabilities.
 



 Establish a process\-oriented and accountability\-driven culture within the finance function.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies**




 In\-depth knowledge of accounting, financial reporting and month\-end/year\-end close processes.
 



 Strong understanding of the real estate, construction, promoter and developer business, including project accounting and project\-wise financial analysis.
 



 Strong knowledge of FP\&A, MIS, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
 



 Good understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances relevant to the business.
 



 Strong ERP knowledge with the ability to use technology for process improvement and MIS development.
 



 Experience with Highrise, SAP or similar ERP systems will be preferred.
 



 Technology\-savvy and comfortable working with ERP, reporting tools, Excel and data\-driven financial analysis.
 



 Strong process orientation, attention to detail and analytical ability.
 



 Excellent people\-management, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a fast\-paced business environment.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience**




 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5 years of post qualification experience or completion of CA article ship with 10 years of experience in leading the accounting/finance function.
 



 Candidates with substantial experience in a real estate, construction, promoter or developer organization will be strongly preferred.
 



 Proven experience in managing accounting teams and delivering monthly MIS, financial close, statutory compliance and management reporting.
 



  





**Key Success Measures**




 Timely and accurate monthly financial close.
 



 Quality and timeliness of MIS and management reporting.
 



 Effective project\-wise financial and cost reporting.
 



 Timely statutory and tax compliance.
 



 Smooth and effective ERP operations.
 



 Strong financial controls and audit readiness.
 



 Improved finance processes, automation and reporting.
 



 Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.

description:
**Production Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



**Department:** 
 Production / Manufacturing
 



**Position:** 
 Production Manager
 



**Experience 5 to 10 Years** 




 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Production Manager to manage and control the complete manufacturing activities of
 **pharma\-grade purified water generation systems and process equipment.** 




  





**1\. Production Planning \& Execution** 




  





 \* Prepare daily, weekly and project\-wise production plans based on project requirements and delivery schedules.
 



 \* Coordinate manufacturing activities for \*RO, UF, EDI, UV, Ozone, PW generation and distribution systems, skids, tanks and piping assemblies\*.
 



 \* Ensure production activities are completed within defined timelines.
 



  





  





**2\. Fabrication \& Assembly** 




  





 \* Supervise \*SS fabrication, TIG welding, piping, skid fabrication, tank fabrication, machining, assembly and installation activities\*.
 



 \* Ensure fabrication is carried out as per approved GA drawings, P\&IDs, fabrication drawings and specifications.
 



 \* Monitor fit\-up, welding, orbital/TIG welding, polishing, passivation and other fabrication activities where applicable.
 



 \* Ensure proper assembly of pumps, valves, instruments, piping, filters, membranes, electrical/control panels and associated equipment.
 



 \* Review manufacturing difficulties and provide practical solutions in coordination with Engineering.
 



  





**3\. Manpower Management** 




  





 \* Manage production supervisors, technicians, fabricators, welders, fitters, helpers and other shop\-floor personnel.
 



 \* Allocate manpower according to project priorities and production requirements.
 



 \* Train and develop production personnel to improve workmanship and efficiency.
 



 \* Maintain discipline and safe working practices on the shop floor.
 



  





**4\. Quality \& Documentation** 




  





 \* Ensure manufacturing complies with approved drawings, specifications and quality requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate with the Quality team for inspections and testing.
 



 \* Ensure proper \*WPS/PQR, welding records, inspection reports, hydro/pneumatic testing, dimensional inspection, material traceability and other applicable documentation\*.
 



  





  





**5\. Material \& Inventory Coordination** 




  





 \* Coordinate with Stores and Procurement for timely availability of production materials.
 



 \* Verify material requirements against BOMs and drawings.
 



 \* Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.
 



  





**6\. Project Coordination** 




  





 \* Work closely with the \*Project Manager / Project Engineer\* to understand project priorities and delivery commitments.
 



 \* Provide regular production status updates.
 



 \* Identify critical activities affecting project completion and take corrective action.
 



 \* Coordinate factory inspection, FAT, punch\-point closure, packing and dispatch readiness.
 



  





  





**7\. Productivity \& Cost Control** 




  





 \* Improve production efficiency and manpower utilization.
 



 \* Reduce fabrication time, material wastage and rework.
 



 \* Develop standard manufacturing practices and SOPs.
 



 \* Monitor production cost against project requirements.
 



 \* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
 



  





**8\. Safety \& Shop\-Floor Management** 




  





 \* Ensure compliance with company safety procedures.
 



 \* Maintain proper housekeeping and \*5S\* on the shop floor.
 



 \* Ensure safe handling of welding equipment, machinery, lifting equipment and tools.
 



 \* Report and address unsafe conditions immediately.
 



  





**Required Technical Knowledge** 




  





 The candidate should have working knowledge of:
 



  





 \* SS 304 / SS 316 / SS 316L fabrication
 



 \* TIG welding and sanitary/industrial piping
 



 \* Skid fabrication and equipment assembly
 



 \* Pressure vessels and process tanks
 



 \* RO / UF / EDI / UV / Ozone systems
 



 \* Pumps, valves, filters and instrumentation
 



 \* P\&IDs, GA drawings, fabrication drawings and BOMs
 



 \* Welding, grinding, polishing and passivation
 



 \* Hydrostatic / pressure testing
 



 \* Material traceability and inspection procedures
 



 \* Pharma / GMP\-oriented manufacturing practices
 



 \* Production planning and project scheduling
 



 \* ERP / Excel\-based production tracking
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




  





 The Production Manager will be evaluated on:
 



  





 \* On\-time completion of production activities
 



 \* Project delivery adherence
 



 \* Production productivity
 



 \* Manpower utilization
 



 \* Rework and rejection percentage
 



 \* Material wastage
 



 \* Production cost control

 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end mid\-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**
* Lead day\-to\-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.


**Mid Mile Network Operations**
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.


**Network Coordination \& Exception Management**
* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.


**Workforce \& Shift Leadership**
* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.


**Fleet, Capacity \& Resource Management**
* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.


**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.


**Safety, Security \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.


**Stakeholder Management \& Operational Communication**
* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.


**People Leadership \& Capability Development**
* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on\-the\-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

  

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.


**Experience** 
 :
   

  

  

* Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N): 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid\-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 \- 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high\-volume, time\-sensitive logistics environments.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**
* Hub \& Mid Mile Operations Management
* Air \& Surface Network Operations
* Shipment Processing \& Transit Management
* Fleet Coordination \& Capacity Utilisation
* Network Planning \& Schedule Adherence
* Service Quality \& Operational Excellence
* Operational MIS \& Performance Analytics
* Safety, Security \& Regulatory Compliance
* Process Improvement \& Productivity Enhancement
* Microsoft Office \& Logistics Management Systems

* Operational Leadership
* Decision Making Under Pressure
* Planning \& Organising
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills
* Team Leadership \& People Development
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Customer Focus
* Accountability \& Ownership
* Adaptability \& Resilience
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**KPIs**
 Network Performance
   

  

 On\-time departure \& arrival adherence, Network connectivity, Schedule adherence
   

  

 Service Quality
   

  

 SLAH %, Misroutes, Misconnections, Shipment processing accuracy, Scan compliance
   

  

 Hub Productivity
   

  

 Hub throughput, Vehicle turnaround time, Dock utilisation, Productivity per FTE
   

  

 Fleet \& Capacity Utilisation
   

  

 Fleet utilisation, Vehicle availability, Capacity utilisation, Dispatch efficiency
   

  

 Operational Excellence
   

  

 Exception closure within TAT, Operational audit compliance, SOP adherence
   

  

 Safety \& Compliance
   

  

 Safety compliance, Security compliance, Regulatory adherence, Audit scores
   

  

 People Management
   

  

 Team productivity, Employee engagement, Training completion, Attrition management
   

  

 Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Process improvement initiatives, Cost optimisation, Productivity enhancement, Operational efficiency gains
   

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
   

  

 Here’s what makes us stand out:
   

  

  

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.

title: Production Manager
description:
**About Company:** 




 Vimson Derma is a contract manufacturer of cosmetic and medicated products based in Ahmedabad. With over 45 years of experience in cosmetics and dermatology, Vimson Derma is a trusted name in the industry. The company is GMP, GLP, and ISO 9001:2015 certified, ensuring the highest quality standards. Vimson Derma manufactures a wide range of products including dusting powders, talcum powders, shampoo, conditioner, cream, gel, lotions, oil, soaps, sunscreen, serums and more. With a strong client base, Vimson Derma works with over 200 companies across India.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 To lead and oversee the complete production operations of both the Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic manufacturing plants by ensuring products are manufactured safely, efficiently, and in compliance with quality and regulatory standards. The Production Head will be responsible for production planning, manpower management, process optimization, capacity utilization, and achieving production targets through effective leadership of Production Supervisors and cross\-functional coordination.  
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




 1\. Production Operations Management  
 



 Lead and oversee daily production activities for both Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic manufacturing plants.  
 



 Ensure production schedules are executed efficiently while meeting quality, cost, and delivery objectives.  
 



 Allocate resources, manpower, and equipment to maximize productivity and plant utilization.  
 



 Monitor production output, efficiency, and adherence to production plans.  
 



  





 2\. Leadership \& Team Management 
 



 Lead, mentor, and develop Production Supervisors and production teams across both plants.  
 



 Define production targets and monitor team performance through regular reviews.  
 



 Build a culture of accountability, discipline, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.  
 



 Ensure adequate manpower planning and succession planning for production functions.  
 



  





 3\. Production Planning \& Coordination 
 



 Coordinate with PPC, Stores, Purchase, QA, QC, Warehouse, Maintenance, and Dispatch to ensure uninterrupted production.  
 



 Review daily production plans and prioritize manufacturing based on business requirements.
 



 Ensure timely availability of raw materials, packing materials, machinery, and manpower.  
 



  





 4\. Process Improvement \& Productivity 
 



 Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce manufacturing cycle time, and optimize resource utilization.  
 



 Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
 



 Monitor production KPIs and drive corrective actions for performance improvement.  
 



  





 5\. Quality \& Compliance 
 



 Ensure all manufacturing activities comply with GMP, SOPs, Batch Manufacturing 
 



 Records (BMR), and applicable regulatory requirements.  
 



 Support QA and QC in investigations related to deviations, non\-conformances, and CAPA implementation.  
 



 Ensure production documentation is complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.  
 



 Prepare both plants for customer audits and future WHO\-GMP certification.  
 



  





 6\. Operational Excellence 
 



 Monitor Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), production efficiency, and manufacturing losses.  
 



 Reduce production downtime through effective coordination with Engineering and Maintenance teams.  
 



 Minimize product rejections, rework, wastage, and process deviations.  
 



 Drive continuous improvement projects to enhance manufacturing performance.  
 



  





 7\. Safety \& Compliance 
 



 Ensure adherence to EHS, GMP, and workplace safety practices across both plants.  
 



 Promote safe handling of materials, equipment, and manufacturing processes.  
 



 Ensure production personnel comply with hygiene and safety requirements.  
 



 8\. Reporting \& Performance Monitoring 
 



 Review daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.  
 



 Monitor production KPIs, capacity utilization, manpower efficiency, and manufacturing costs.  
 



 Present operational performance and improvement initiatives to senior management. 
 



  





**Required qualification and skills:** 




 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Industrial 
 



 Engineering, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.  
 



 10–15 years of production experience in Pharmaceuticals, Cosmetics, FMCG, or regulated manufacturing industries.  
 



 Minimum 5 years of experience in a production leadership role managing multiple production lines or manufacturing units.  
 



 Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical and cosmetic manufacturing processes.  
 



 Experience with GMP, WHO\-GMP, ISO standards, documentation, and regulatory compliance.  
 



 Knowledge of production planning, capacity management, batch manufacturing, and process optimization.  
 



 Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
 



 Strong leadership, people management, communication, and decision\-making skills.  
 



 Proficiency in ERP systems, MS Office, and manufacturing reporting tools. 
 



  





**Working Days** 
 : 6 days 
 



  





**Manufacturing Location:** 
 816/3 Kothari Industrial Estate, Opp Khodal Lodge, Santej, Kalol, Gujarat 382721\.

title: Supply Chain Executive
description:
**Supply Chain Executive – Stores \& Logistics**
**Department:** 
 Supply Chain / Stores \& Logistics
   

  

**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad

 Head – Supply Chain / SCM
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
   

  

**Industry Preference:** 
 Solar / Renewable Energy / Manufacturing
   

  

**Education:** 
 Graduate / Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. / MBA/PG Diploma in Supply Chain or Logistics preferred
   

  

**About The Role**
 Responsible for the
 **end\-to\-end management of plant stores, warehouse, inventory, material movement and logistics operations** 
 . The role will ensure timely material receipt, storage, issue, internal movement and dispatch while maintaining high inventory accuracy, proper documentation, ERP discipline and cost\-effective logistics operations.
   

  

 The key objective is to ensure the
 **right material, in the right quantity, at the right location, with the right documentation and at the right time** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Stores \& Warehouse Management: Manage day\-to\-day plant stores and warehouse operations, including receiving, unloading, inspection coordination, put\-away, bin management, storage, space utilization, 5S and safety.
* Inward Material Management: Coordinate material receipts with Procurement, QA/QC, Security and Accounts; verify documentation and ensure timely GRN/MRN completion while tracking shortages, damages and discrepancies.
* Material Issue \& Production Support: Ensure timely and accurate material issue to Production, Maintenance, EPC and other departments against approved requisitions, while monitoring line\-side inventory and material returns.
* Inventory Control: Maintain ≥99% inventory accuracy between physical and ERP stock through cycle counts, stock verification, variance analysis, batch/lot/serial traceability and control of slow/non\-moving inventory.
* Logistics \& Transportation: Manage inbound and outbound logistics, vehicle planning and placement, loading, dispatch, delivery tracking, PODs, transporter coordination, freight costs and vehicle utilization.
* ERP / Odoo Management: Ensure accurate and timely ERP/Odoo transactions for GRN, material issue, transfers, returns and dispatches, along with regular stock reconciliation and inventory reporting.
* Documentation \& Compliance: Maintain stores and logistics records, ensure proper documentation for inter\-plant transfers, customer dispatches, imported/bonded materials and support internal, financial, customer and statutory audits.
* Team Management: Lead and supervise storekeepers, warehouse staff, loaders and logistics coordinators; allocate daily activities, monitor productivity, train employees on SOPs, ERP and safety, and drive accountability through KPIs.


**Key Requirements**
* Strong knowledge of Stores \& Warehouse Management
* Inventory planning and control
* Logistics and transportation management
* Hands\-on experience with ERP/Odoo
* Strong MS Excel skills including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and dashboards
* Vendor and transporter coordination
* Team leadership and manpower management
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Strong documentation and audit discipline
* Good communication and cross\-functional coordination
* Ability to work in a manufacturing/plant environment


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Inventory accuracy: ≥99%
* GRN completion within defined TAT
* Material issue TAT
* Dispatch adherence / OTIF
* Warehouse space utilization
* Stock variance
* Damage/breakage percentage
* Freight cost per MT / MW / shipment
* Vehicle placement adherence
* Slow/non\-moving inventory reduction
* POD submission TAT
* Audit observations
* 5S and safety compliance

description:

With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The TCD Site Executive (OPEX) is responsible for overseeing the procurement and inventory management of OPEX items required for operational activities across all mining sites. The role ensures the timely and cost\-effective acquisition of goods and services, maintaining optimal inventory levels to support continuous site operations.
   

  

****JOB RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Category In\-charge (CAPEX) \- NR**
****Strategic Procurement And Supplier Management:****
 Coordinate procurement activities across sites, ensuring strategic planning and alignment with operational needs.
   

  

 Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to procure quality OPEX items, ensuring cost\-effectiveness and adherence to quality standards.
   

  

 Manage supplier relationships to negotiate favorable terms and ensure continuous improvement in vendor performance.
   

  

 Lead process improvement initiatives in purchasing, contract management, supplier selection, and sourcing to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
   

  

**Inventory Management:**
 Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure availability of OPEX items, minimizing excess stock and obsolescence.
   

  

 Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to maintain accurate records.
   

  

 Determine optimal reorder points and quantities to prevent stockouts and ensure uninterrupted site operations.
   

  

 Generate and analyze inventory reports to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform procurement decisions.
   

  

 Review inventory levels periodically and take necessary actions to maintain optimal stock at all sites.
   

  

**Financial And Budget Management:**
 Conduct cost analysis of procurement activities to identify savings opportunities and drive cost reduction initiatives.
   

  

 Ensure procurement activities are within budgetary constraints and provide regular updates to management on budget status.
   

  

 Manage buying processes efficiently, including RFPs, proposal evaluations, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract awards.
   

  

 Prepare and issue purchase orders for required OPEX items, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.
   

  

**Operational Coordination And Reporting:**
 Coordinate with site managers and operational teams to understand OPEX requirements and ensure timely delivery of needed items.
   

  

 Address and resolve procurement or inventory issues to ensure smooth operational activities.
   

  

 Manage urgent procurement requests to support unplanned operational needs and minimize downtime.
   

  

 Attend to internal/external audit queries, provide data, and take corrective actions for observations received.
   

  

 Review commercial/stores SOPs annually, make necessary changes, and update the revision.
   

  

 Review Pending PRs status with team members and take necessary corrective actions, providing performance feedback.
   

  

 Attend review meetings conducted by TCD Leads/site head/corporate and prepare necessary data and presentations on OPEX\-related procurements and inventory.
   

  

 Release all e\-NFA documents after checking the support documents and follow up for timely approval.
   

  

 Check and release New Vendor code, VC unblock, and GRN error in MDG portal.
   

  

 Review reports on inventory stock at all sites and follow up with contractors for monthly consumption reports.
   

  

**Compliance And Quality Assurance:**
 Ensure compliance with quality, legal, financial, and safety terms in OPEX purchase and service contracts.
   

  

 Monitor material/service providers’ performance and take necessary action to bridge gaps and ensure timely renewal of contracts.
   

  

 Manage all commercial processes and data as per IMS standards, update data, attend audits, and address observations.
   

  

**Technology Integration:**
 Deploy digital tools for real\-time monitoring and optimization of operational expenditures on site, enhancing cost efficiency and project outcomes.
   

  

 Implement advanced digital solutions for managing site operations and resource allocation, ensuring effective and efficient use of operational resources.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Sites Projects team
   

  

 Marketing department
   

  

 Finance \& Accounts team
   

  

 Quality Assurance Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Vendors
   

  

 Suppliers
   

  

 External agencies
   

  

 Auditors
   

  

****RESPONSIBILITIES****
 Strategic Sourcing:
   

  

* Plan and forecast Capex procurement needs based on the projects in pipeline and organization's strategic objectives.
* Formulate contractual terms and conditions for major EPC contracts to secure favorable terms.
* Negotiate with vendors for long\-term contract terms to ensure beneficial agreements.
* Select the bidding process, prepare vendor selection approaches, and vendor evaluation criteria to streamline the procurement process.
* Review RFI and RFP documents, identify potential bidders, and organize pre\-bid meetings to facilitate a competitive bidding process.
* Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations and fact\-based negotiations/e\-auctions to select the best vendors.
* Review Notes for Approval (NFA) for selected bidders and obtain required approvals to ensure compliance with company policies.
* Leverage extensive experience in mining and material handling procurement, including handling mining and EPC contractors, explosives, CHPP, and project monitoring to develop and implement procurement strategies.


**Core Procurement Activities:**
* Understand the Techno\-Commercial strategy and plan for the Business Unit (BU) to implement strategic initiatives for all categories (Group\-wide/BU specific) as per plan.
* Oversee the review of approved PRs from user departments to ensure correctness and completeness of PRs.
* Coordinate with leads in identifying the type and method of procurement based on material/service type, urgency, stock availability, rate contracts, value, and delivery timeline to optimize procurement efficiency.


**Contract Management:**
* Oversee the preparation of contract documents as per protocols and standard templates to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Set up approved contract records within the ERP system to maintain accurate and accessible records.
* Maintain contract documents for future reference and compliance to ensure traceability and accountability.
* Collate Advance Bank Guarantee/Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (ABG/CPBG)/Customs related documents from vendors to secure financial assurances.
* Prepare, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved NFAs to secure long\-term pricing agreements.
* Prepare master outline agreements in ERP systems based on rate contracts to streamline procurement processes.
* Prepare PO/SO for procurement under valid rate contracts to facilitate timely procurement.


**Supplier Management:**
* Oversee the identification of vendor evaluation criteria in consultation with quality, engineering, and project management departments to ensure rigorous vendor selection.
* Ensure completeness of forms submitted by vendors and update the approved vendor list to maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date vendor database.
* Coordinate with new vendors for evaluation documents and with quality/engineering/user teams for assessments if required to ensure comprehensive vendor evaluations.
* Prepare vendor segmentation matrices and performance evaluation criteria to categorize and assess vendor performance effectively.
* Oversee the evaluation process for CapEx and services vendors, ensuring thorough review of vendor scorecards.
* Plan improvement actions for vendors with unsatisfactory performance to enhance vendor performance.
* Manage all cluster CAPEX commercial activities and site TC functions as per Delegation of Authority (DoA) to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.


**Data Management And Risk Management:**
* Collate and analyze data related to large scale procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) to derive actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and value through data analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Identify procurement risks for assigned categories using master lists, supply market analysis, long\-term procurement plans, annual procurement plans, and project risk registers to mitigate risks.
