title: Senior Manager/AVP – US Bookkeeping
description:
**The Opportunity** 





 Qualicentric runs an established US bookkeeping and accounting delivery practice — a team of roughly ten accountants handling bookkeeping, month\-end close, and reporting for US small and mid\-market clients. The practice works, and now we want to level it up: tighten the operating engine, raise the quality bar, and build the structure to scale it several times over.
 





 We are also moving the wider firm toward an outcome\-based, fixed\-fee model powered by automation and AI — a shift away from the headcount\-based offshore norm. This role sits at the centre of both: stabilise and strengthen what exists today, then build the bigger, smarter practice of tomorrow.
 




  





**Who We're Looking For** 





 Someone who has personally run a comparable US bookkeeping / accounting delivery practice in a KPO or outsourcing environment — not just managed a team, but owned the quality, economics, and growth of a book of US clients. You bring deep, hands\-on US accounting expertise, the operational instinct to run a tight delivery engine, and the leadership to build one that scales.
 





 Four things matter most in this role: strong communication and client presence, sharp accounting fundamentals, an uncompromising quality bar, and the flexibility to adapt across clients, priorities, and US time zones. If those are your strengths, this is a role you will thrive in.
 




  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Delivery \& Quality** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery for the US bookkeeping \& accounting book — quality, accuracy, timeliness, and SLA adherence across bookkeeping, month\-end close, and reporting.
* Run delivery governance: capacity planning, resource allocation, utilization, WIP, and quality reviews, with clear performance metrics.
* Surface and resolve delivery risks, dependencies, and scope issues early — maintaining a zero\-surprise culture with clients and internally.
* Own the practice's operational economics — utilization, realization, and profitability, not just output.



  





**Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team — accountants, seniors, and managers — setting clear expectations and holding accountability for outcomes.
* Build leadership depth and succession by growing managers into owners, and close capability gaps through targeted coaching and training.
* Design the team structure and hiring plan to scale the practice as the client base grows.



  





**Client Partnership** 



* Work closely with clients day to day — interacting regularly, building trust, and taking complete, end\-to\-end ownership of every deliverable.
* Support clients on the FP\&A and strategy side — budgeting, forecasting, and the analysis that shapes their business decisions — not just the books.
* Partner with clients as a trusted advisor, presenting month\-end results, cash flow, and operational insight in clear, confident communication.
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex delivery and accounting matters, with proactive updates on risks, delays, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Business Development on onboarding, solutioning, account expansion, and cross\-sell.



  





**Process, Technology \& AI** 



* Standardise SOPs, quality controls, and delivery processes across accounts so quality is repeatable, not personality\-dependent.
* Champion automation, AI\-enabled workflows, and data\-driven dashboards to lift efficiency, quality, and client experience.
* Help drive the firm's transition to an outcome\-based delivery model.



  





**Qualifications** 

  
 



* 10\+ years in Finance \& Accounting, with 4–5\+ years leading teams — ideally in outsourcing, KPO, or a CA/CPA environment.
* Proven track record running a US F\&A delivery practice: leading delivery teams, driving operational excellence, and building scalable functions in a client\-facing setting.
* Strong US GAAP knowledge across month\-end close, bookkeeping, financial reporting, AP/AR, and FP\&A.
* Excellent written and verbal business English, with the communication skills and presence to hold senior client relationships directly.
* An uncompromising eye for quality and accuracy, paired with the flexibility to adapt across clients, shifting priorities, and US time zones.
* Comfort supporting clients beyond the books — on FP\&A, budgeting, forecasting, and the strategy conversations that come with them.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent preferred.
* Hands\-on with QuickBooks, Xero, Bill.com, Ramp, or similar; exposure to AI/automation in accounting is a strong plus.



  





**What We Offer** 

  
 





 This is structured as an operator's role with an owner's upside. We want the person who runs this practice to think — and be rewarded — like a builder, not a caretaker.
 



* A competitive fixed salary, benchmarked to senior F\&A outsourcing roles.
* Performance\-linked upside tied to the practice's profitability — you share directly in the margin you help grow.
* A share of the new business you bring in, rewarding origination on top of delivery.
* A defined path to partner — this role is built to grow into an ownership stake in the practice as you deliver against clear milestones.
* Real ownership from day one — the mandate to build and scale, with direct visibility to the founders.
* Direct exposure to US clients, complex F\&A engagements, and a front\-row seat in the AI\-driven transformation of the industry.

title: GM/AVP- Employee Relations and Retention
description:
Role Summary
 
 ICCS is looking for a General Manager / AVP – Employee Relations \& Retention to own attrition as a business number across ICCS's approximately 5,000\-employee, 10\+ site PAN India footprint, and to run the compliance\-first ER case function that supports it. In a domestic BPO, attrition is the single largest controllable cost driver — this role exists to move that number, not merely to administer grievance and disciplinary process around it. It is for a seasoned ER / attrition leader who has run a high\-volume ER function inside a BPO / ITES / contact\-centre environment — grievance handling, disciplinary process and domestic enquiries, POSH compliance — and has personally owned and moved an attrition number at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Attrition Ownership \& Retention Strategy** 




 •    Own the PAN India attrition target; publish and defend attrition performance to the CEO's office monthly.
 



 •    Design and run retention programmes targeted at the 0–90 day window, where most frontline attrition occurs.
 



 •    Build exit analytics — reason codes, tenure cohorts, site and process\-level patterns — and convert them into operational interventions, not just engagement activity.
 



 •    Partner with Operations leadership so retention actions land with team leaders, not only with HR.
 



**2\. PAN India ER Strategy \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER framework end\-to\-end for all ICCS centres (Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and any new sites), ensuring consistent grievance redressal, disciplinary process and investigation protocols.
 



 •    Own ER case TAT and SLA commitments against every open case, and personally intervene on high\-risk or aging matters.
 



 •    Build and standardise ER policies, SOPs and escalation matrices consistently across all sites and processes.
 



**3\. Grievance Handling \& Investigations** 




 •    Lead or oversee investigations into employee complaints — misconduct, harassment, policy violations — ensuring principles of natural justice are followed throughout.
 



 •    Conduct or supervise disciplinary hearings and domestic enquiries, working closely with site HR and Operations.
 



 •    Ensure fair, prompt and confidential handling of every case, with documentation that stands up to audit and legal scrutiny.
 



**4\. Statutory Compliance \& POSH** 




 •    Own POSH compliance PAN India — constitution and functioning of Internal Committees (IC) at every location, awareness sessions, and timely closure of complaints within statutory timelines.
 



 •    Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, and other state\-specific regulations across all centres.
 



 •    Liaise with legal counsel on ER matters that carry litigation or regulatory risk.
 



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Listening** 




 •    Run skip\-level connects, engagement surveys and floor\-level listening mechanisms, particularly at frontline/production level.
 



 •    Analyse exit interview and case data to identify ER\-linked attrition drivers and recommend systemic fixes to Operations and HR leadership.
 



**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Management** 




 •    Manage works/grievance committees as required under Standing Orders, and act as the primary liaison between employees, Operations leadership and HR on sensitive matters.
 



 •    Partner closely with Operations, Legal and Compliance teams on high\-risk or reputationally sensitive cases.
 



 •    Build, mentor and manage a PAN India ER team of 8–10 across locations — setting case\-quality, TAT and attrition\-outcome standards.
 



**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER and attrition dashboard and report monthly on attrition performance, case volumes, TAT, closure rates and POSH compliance status to the CEO's office and Head – HR.
 



 •    Maintain complete case documentation and ensure audit\-readiness across all centres at all times.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Employee Relations / Industrial Relations, with direct ownership of an attrition number — not case management alone.
 



 •    Has owned an attrition number across a workforce of 3,000 or more in a BPO or similar high\-churn environment, with a measurable, personally\-driven reduction backed by before\-and\-after figures.
 



 •    Mandatory: current or recent experience within the BPO / ITES / Contact Centre / Shared Services industry, with direct ER exposure in a high\-volume, frontline environment.
 



 •    Managed a PAN India, multi\-location ER team of 8 or more (minimum 3–4 locations), ideally including Noida/Delhi\-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience conducting domestic enquiries and POSH investigations, from complaint intake through to closure.
 



 •    Working knowledge of applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Contract Labour Act and related state regulations, including contract labour compliance.
 



 •    Experience partnering with Legal and Operations leadership on high\-risk or litigation\-prone cases.
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Experience in a unionised or union\-attempt environment.
 



 •    Exposure to predictive attrition analytics.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Generalist HRBPs who have supported attrition initiatives without owning the number.
 



 •    Corporate or white\-collar ER backgrounds with no frontline, high\-churn exposure.
 



 •    Candidates who describe retention purely as engagement activity — events, celebrations, rewards — with no analytical basis.
 



**Education** 




 •    Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Ownership of an attrition number as a business metric, backed by data.
 



 •    Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance.
 



 •    Excellent investigation, case\-management and documentation skills.
 



 •    Stakeholder management across Operations, Legal and employees at all levels.
 



 •    High emotional intelligence, discretion and conflict\-resolution ability.
 



 •    Team building and people leadership across a distributed, PAN India team.
 



 •    Data orientation — comfortable building and defending an attrition / case\-management dashboard/MIS.
 



 •    Ability to operate calmly and objectively in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, sensitive\-case environment.

title: Manager Regulatory Affairs
description:
**Jubilant Bhartia Group**




 Jubilant Bhartia Group is a global conglomerate founded by Mr. Shyam S Bhartia and Mr. Hari S Bhartia with strong presence in diverse sectors like Pharmaceuticals, Contract Research and Development Services, Proprietary Novel Drugs, Life Science Ingredients, Agri Products, Performance Polymers, Food Service (QSR), Food, Auto, Consulting in Aerospace and Oilfield Services. Jubilant Bhartia Group has four flagships Companies\- Jubilant Pharmova Limited, Jubilant Ingrevia Limited, Jubilant FoodWorks Limited and Jubilant Industries Limited. Currently the group has a global workforce of around 56,000 employees.
 



  





**Jubilant Pharmova Limited**




 Jubilant Pharmova Limited (formerly Jubilant Life Sciences Limited) is a company with global presence that is involved in Radiopharma, Allergy Immunotherapy, CDMO Sterile Injectables, Contract Research Development and Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO),
 **Generics** 
 and Proprietary Novel Drugs businesses. In the Radiopharma business, the Company is involved in manufacturing and supply of Radiopharmaceuticals with a network of 46 radio\-pharmacies in the US. The Company’s Allergy Immunotherapy business is involved in the manufacturing and supply of allergic extracts and venom products in the US and in some other markets such as Canada, Europe and Australia. Jubilant through its CDMO Sterile Injectables business offers manufacturing services including sterile fill and finish injectables (both liquid and lyophilization), full\-service ophthalmic offer (liquids, ointments \& creams) and ampoules. The CRDMO business of the Company includes the Drug Discovery Services business that provides contract research and development services through two world\-class research centres in Bangalore and Noida in India and the CDMO\-API business that is involved in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients. Jubilant Therapeutics is involved in Proprietary Novel Drugs business and is an innovative biopharmaceutical company developing breakthrough therapies in the area of oncology and autoimmune disorders. The company operates six manufacturing facilities that cater to all the regulated market including USA, Europe and other geographies.
 



 Find out more about us at: Company Profile (jubilantpharmova.com)
 



  





**Position Details
 
 :** 



* **Organization:** 
 Jubilant Generics Limited
* **Designation:** 
**Manager \- Regulatory Affairs (UK / EU)**
* **Location:** 
 Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
* **Job Summary:** 
 To lead the regulatory strategy for new submissions, submission planning and lifecycle management of drug product dossiers for Europe, UK, Australia and Canada markets. This role combines hands\-on regulatory expertise with people leadership, owning both the quality of regulatory output and the performance and development of the team delivering it.
* **Challenges:** 
 Thorough knowledge of CMC requirements, labelling requirements, regulatory impact of post approval changes and regulatory life cycle management.



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 :** 




**Europe / UK:** 



* Own and drive drug dossier authoring, review, and submission strategy for EU (DCP/MRP/NP), UK, Australia, and Canada markets.
* Direct product life cycle management (LCM) activities across the assigned portfolio.
* Oversee assessment of post\-approval changes and ensure timely, compliant execution.
* Own eCTD publishing standards and compliance across all submissions.
* Maintain and ensure team\-wide expert\-level knowledge of CMC and Module 1 requirements.



  





**Preparation \& Submission:** 



* Review and approve dossier applications, variations, renewals, and RFI responses authored by the team prior to submission to EU, UK, Australia, and Canada Health Authorities.
* Oversee authoring quality for Module 1 and quality modules across the team.
* Direct assessment of post\-approval changes and lifecycle maintenance; ensure regulatory filing timelines are met.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams (R\&D, QA, ADL) to secure required regulatory data and align filing plans.
* Review and approve artwork/labelling finalization against current QRD guidelines.
* Own the regulatory intelligence function — ensure the team tracks and applies current technical guidelines, regulatory requirements, and emerging trends.



  





**Coordination:** 



* Act as primary interface with R\&D and other business functions to ensure project\-specific regulatory strategy is defined, agreed, and delivered on time.
* Manage relationships with API vendors, resolving technical queries related to regulatory requirements.
* Review technical documents (process validation, AMV, stability, composition, etc.) from Site QA, R\&D, and ADL against DMF/dossier requirements, and escalate gaps.
* Represent Regulatory Affairs in leadership and project review meetings; report status, risks, and mitigation plans to senior management.



  





**Reporting \& Maintenance:** 



* Maintain regulatory files/database



  





**Person Profile
 
 :** 



* **Qualification:** 
 Master / Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy
* **Desired Certifications:** 
 PGDRA
* **Experience:** 
 10\-12 years of regulatory experience with large/midsized pharma companies.
* **Desired function skills:** 
 Well versed with latest regulatory guidelines.
* **Desired behavioral skills:** 
 Team handling exposure, commitment \& ownership, strong communication, problem solving skills and ability to work with the agency timelines.



  





***Jubilant is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, colour, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, political affiliation, race, ethnicity, religion or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.***

title: Restaurant Onboarding Manager
description:
Experience Required: 3–6 Years
 



 CTC: 3\-3\.5 LPA
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About Gintaa** 




 At Gintaa, were redefining how Indians order food. With our focus on affordability, exclusive restaurant partnerships, and hyperlocal logistics, we aim to scale across India’s Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities. We’re backed by a mission\-driven team and expanding rapidly – now’s the time to join the core tech leadership and build something impactful from the ground up.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced and execution\-driven
 **Restaurant Onboarding Manager** 
 to lead Gintaa’s restaurant acquisition and onboarding operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for identifying and acquiring high\-potential restaurant partners, managing commercial discussions, ensuring documentation and onboarding completion, coordinating menu and catalogue setup, driving restaurant activation, and ensuring that newly onboarded restaurants become successfully operational on the Gintaa platform.
 



 The ideal candidate must have
 **5–7 years of hands\-on experience specifically in restaurant onboarding, restaurant acquisition, merchant acquisition, food\-tech partnerships, or restaurant account management within the online food delivery ecosystem.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Restaurant Acquisition \& Market Expansion
 


* Own restaurant acquisition and onboarding targets across assigned territories, zones, and markets.
* Identify high\-potential restaurants, QSRs, cloud kitchens, local food brands, restaurant chains, and strategic merchant partners.
* Develop market\-level acquisition strategies based on cuisine gaps, customer demand, locality coverage, pricing, and restaurant popularity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective restaurant partners.
* Conduct regular market mapping and identify restaurants currently missing from Gintaa's portfolio.
* Drive both field\-based and strategic restaurant acquisition initiatives.
* Support Gintaa's expansion into new locations by rapidly developing the restaurant supply base.



  





 2\. Restaurant Onboarding
 


* Manage the complete restaurant onboarding lifecycle from initial contact to successful activation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of required restaurant information and documentation.
* Ensure restaurant profiles, menus, pricing, operating hours, images, bank details, tax information, and other required information are accurately captured.
* Coordinate internally for account creation and platform configuration.
* Ensure onboarding activities are completed within defined turnaround times.
* Maintain high onboarding quality and minimize errors that could affect restaurant operations or customer experience.



  





 3\. Commercial Negotiation \& Partner Conversion
 


* Conduct commercial discussions with restaurant owners, decision\-makers, and management teams.
* Clearly communicate Gintaa's value proposition and partnership model.
* Negotiate commercials and partnership terms within approved company guidelines.
* Handle objections and competitive comparisons effectively.
* Drive conversion of qualified restaurant leads into active partners.
* Maintain transparency in all commercial commitments made to restaurant partners.



  





 4\. Restaurant Activation \& Go\-Live
 


* Own the journey from
 **Lead → Meeting → Agreement → Documentation → Menu Setup → Onboarding → Go\-Live → First Order** 
 .
* Ensure newly onboarded restaurants become operational within the defined activation timeline.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners to resolve issues delaying activation.
* Track restaurants that have completed onboarding but have not gone live or received orders.
* Drive activation and first\-order completion for newly onboarded partners.
* Ensure restaurant partners understand the operational workflow before going live.



  





 5\. Menu \& Catalogue Readiness
 


* Ensure restaurant menus are accurately represented on the Gintaa platform.
* Coordinate menu collection, item categorization, pricing, descriptions, images, availability, add\-ons, and customization requirements.
* Ensure restaurant information including address, operating hours, cuisines, and contact details is accurate.
* Work closely with catalogue/content teams to minimize menu\-related errors.
* Coordinate with restaurant partners for timely menu updates whenever required.



  





 6\. Partner Training \& Operational Readiness
 


* Educate newly onboarded restaurant partners on order acceptance and management processes.
* Explain platform workflows, restaurant responsibilities, delivery coordination, cancellations, customer issues, and escalation procedures.
* Ensure restaurant staff understand how to efficiently manage online orders.
* Provide initial operational support during the restaurant's launch phase.
* Reduce early\-stage operational issues through effective onboarding and training.



  





 7\. Restaurant Partner Relationship Management
 


* Build strong working relationships with restaurant owners and key decision\-makers.
* Act as an escalation point during the initial onboarding and activation period.
* Understand restaurant partner concerns and coordinate internally for resolution.
* Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction throughout the onboarding journey.
* Ensure smooth handover of successfully activated restaurants to the relevant account management or restaurant operations team.



  





 8\. Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead and mentor Restaurant Acquisition Managers, Onboarding Executives, Business Development Executives, and field teams.
* Allocate territories and acquisition targets based on market potential.
* Conduct daily and weekly pipeline reviews with the team.
* Track individual and team\-level performance against defined targets.
* Coach team members on pitching, negotiation, objection handling, and restaurant conversion.
* Build a high\-performance culture focused on acquisition quality, speed, ownership, and execution.



  





 9\. Market Intelligence \& Competition Tracking
 


* Maintain strong awareness of the local restaurant and food delivery ecosystem.
* Track competitor restaurant partnerships, market penetration, restaurant offers, and acquisition activities.
* Gather structured feedback from restaurant partners regarding market trends and competitor propositions.
* Identify cuisine, pricing, locality, and restaurant\-selection gaps in Gintaa's marketplace.
* Share actionable market intelligence with business leadership.



  





 10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Restaurant Operations
* Catalogue/Menu Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Finance
* Legal/Compliance
* Customer Support
* Delivery Operations
* Product \& Technology
* Marketing



  





 Ensure smooth movement of restaurant partners across the entire acquisition, onboarding, activation, and operational handover journey.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance for this role will primarily be measured through:
 


* Number of Restaurants Acquired
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Onboarding Conversion %
* Restaurants Onboarded per Month
* Restaurant Activation / Go\-Live Rate
* Average Onboarding TAT
* Documentation Completion Rate
* Menu/Listing Accuracy
* Agreement\-to\-Go\-Live TAT
* Onboarding\-to\-First\-Order Conversion
* Restaurant Partner Drop\-Off Rate
* Acquisition Cost per Restaurant
* Restaurant Coverage by Zone
* Target vs. Achievement
* Team Productivity
* Restaurant Partner Satisfaction



  





 Required Experience \& Qualifications
 


* **5–7 years of relevant professional experience.**
* **Prior experience in the same domain – restaurant acquisition, restaurant onboarding, food\-tech merchant acquisition, or restaurant partnerships – is MANDATORY.**
* **Candidates without relevant restaurant/food\-delivery onboarding or acquisition experience will not be considered for this position.**
* **Proven experience working directly with restaurant owners, restaurant chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, or food\-service businesses.**
* **Strong experience in restaurant acquisition, onboarding, activation, and commercial negotiations.**
* **Experience managing field sales/acquisition teams and territory\-level targets.**
* **Strong understanding of online food delivery marketplace operations.**
* **Graduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality, or a related discipline.**
* **MBA/PGDM will be an advantage.**
* **Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, CRM systems, MIS reporting, and performance dashboards.**
* **Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.**
* **Willingness to travel extensively within assigned markets and interact directly with restaurant partners.**

* Own manufacturing process and line design, including process flow, workstation design, takt time, UPH, staffing, and material flow.

* Lead product and production\-line transfers between sites, ensuring capacity, process, equipment, quality, cost, and ramp\-up readiness.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, NPI, Facilities, IT, Finance, and Commercial teams to achieve manufacturing and business targets.
* Drive material\-flow and internal logistics optimization, including supermarkets, Kanban, point\-of\-use delivery, WIP reduction, AGV/AMR, and warehouse\-to\-line flow.
* Build and develop a high\-performing Industrial Engineering organization through competency development, mentoring, succession planning, standard methodologies, and best\-practice sharing.
* Provide executive\-level manufacturing leadership, identifying operational risks and opportunities while driving improvements in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Productivity, and Customer Satisfaction.

* Prepares internal operational reports, budget proposals, policy recommendations, memoranda, and executive communications for Department leadership and external stakeholders.
* Executive Liaison and External Relations
* Represents the Department on school safety, security, and emergency management initiatives across complex area offices, districts, and state agencies to ensure alignment and coordinated implementation of statewide initiatives.
* Accompanies or represents the OCOS Assistant Superintendent in meetings with the Superintendent, Board of Education, legislative hearings, and civic or community groups as assigned.
* Prepares legislative testimony, executive briefings, and formal responses to inquiries from elected officials, governmental agencies, and the public.
* Builds and maintains collaborative partnerships with federal, state, county, and community agencies to advance Department priorities and strengthen statewide safety and emergency preparedness efforts.
* Personnel and Operations Management
* Provides leadership, supervision, and direction to staff within the Branch; establishes performance expectations, evaluates performance, identifies professional development opportunities, and supports required training.
* Directs workforce planning, recruitment, selection, employee development, succession planning, and personnel actions in accordance with Department policies and collective bargaining agreements.
* Conducts staff meetings and provides guidance regarding the interpretation and implementation of laws, regulations, policies, procedures, and program requirements to promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Emergency Management and Security Coordination
* Serves as the Department's emergency management coordinator and primary liaison with state and county emergency management agencies; coordinates Department preparedness, response, recovery, and continuity of operations for emergencies and disasters affecting schools and Department facilities.
* Oversees the development, implementation, maintenance, and periodic review of the Department’s Emergency Operations Plan, Continuity of Operations Plan, and related emergency management plans.
* Provides timely situational awareness and emergency notifications to Department leadership regarding natural hazards, public safety incidents, and emergencies; coordinates statewide shelter operations and Department\-wide emergency response activities when required.
* Provides statewide leadership for school safety and security initiatives by overseeing safety and security vulnerability assessments, risk analyses, security technology, security personnel training, and the development of standards for physical security, access control, and visitor management.
* Establishes and maintains collaborative partnerships with law enforcement, fire services, emergency management agencies, and other public safety organizations to strengthen school safety, security, emergency preparedness, and coordinated response efforts.
* Evaluates safety and security incidents, identifies emerging threats and trends, and implements risk mitigation strategies.
* Policy, Compliance and Technical Assistance
* Directs the development, interpretation, implementation, and communication of Department policies, procedures, standards, and guidance related to safety, security, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance.
* Ensures schools and Department offices receive timely technical assistance, training, and consultation to support consistent implementation of statewide programs and compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Department requirements.
* Monitors changes in legislation, regulations, and professional best practices and recommends policy or program modifications to improve effectiveness and organizational readiness.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

 : Principles and practices of school safety and security; emergency management, operations planning, and continuity of operations; safety management principles and occupational safety requirements; threat assessment and violence prevention; federal and state laws affecting school safety and emergency management; public relations; current literature, trends, methods, and developments in the areas of assignment.
   

  

**Ability to** 
 : Plan, direct, coordinate, and evaluate central staff services; deal effectively with federal, state, county, and departmental officials and others to accomplish program goals and objectives; communicate effectively with others both orally and in writing; operate a computer and other business machines.

title: Senior Manager - Compute Infrastructure and Cloud Ops
description:
Job Summary 
 The Senior Manager, Compute Infrastructure and Cloud Operations, is a strategic leadership role responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost-effective delivery of enterprise compute services across on-premises and cloud environments. The position will lead Windows Server administration, Linux server administration, NetApp storage, VMware virtualization, and cloud operations across AWS and Microsoft Azure. The role requires strong infrastructure delivery experience, forward-looking strategic thinking, mature people leadership, and the ability to operate across multiple business domains while balancing operational stability, modernization, security, risk, and ficial accountability. Responsibilities 
 Provide overall leadership and accountability for enterprise compute infrastructure and cloud operations across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments. Define and execute the compute infrastructure strategy, operating model, technology roadmap, lifecycle plan, and modernization priorities in alignment with business and enterprise technology objectives. Lead service delivery for Microsoft Windows Server platforms, including administration, patching, hardening, capacity management, performance optimization, high availability, and lifecycle management. Lead service delivery for enterprise Linux platforms, including administration, patching, security hardening, performance optimization, configuration management, and platform standardization. Oversee NetApp storage services, including capacity planning, performance, availability, data protection, replication, backup integration, lifecycle management, and storage optimization. Oversee VMware virtualization services, including platform availability, cluster and capacity management, upgrades, security, performance, resilience, and technology lifecycle planning. Provide operational leadership for AWS and Microsoft Azure services, covering goverce, reliability, security, cost optimization, monitoring, incident response, backup, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. Drive hybrid-cloud adoption by identifying appropriate workload placement, migration opportunities, platform standards, automation requirements, and operating controls. Ensure infrastructure services meet agreed availability, performance, security, recovery, compliance, and service-level expectations. Own major incident readiness and response for the compute tower, including technical escalation, stakeholder communication, problem management, root-cause analysis, and prevention of recurring issues. Establish proactive monitoring, observability, event management, capacity forecasting, and operational health reporting across compute, storage, virtualization, and cloud platforms. Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, accelerate provisioning, strengthen compliance, and increase operational efficiency. Develop and maintain standards, policies, procedures, service documentation, architecture guardrails, runbooks, and configuration baselines for the compute portfolio. Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, network, database, application, service management, engineering, and business teams to deliver secure and resilient infrastructure solutions. Lead platform upgrades, technical debt reduction, end-of-life remediation, vulnerability treatment, patch compliance, and infrastructure refresh programs. Manage ficial planning for the compute portfolio, including budgets, forecasts, licensing, consumption, hardware and cloud costs, unit-cost transparency, and optimization opportunities. Manage strategic suppliers, technology partners, managed service providers, contracts, service reviews, licensing positions, and vendor performance. Build, lead, coach, and retain a high-performing multi-skilled infrastructure team, with clear accountability, succession planning, career development, cross-training, and continuous capability improvement. Establish measurable operational KPIs and goverce routines covering service reliability, incidents, changes, capacity, vulnerabilities, patching, automation, cost, customer experience, and delivery outcomes. Communicate strategy, risks, service performance, investment needs, and transformation progress effectively to senior technology and business stakeholders. Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, disciplined execution, innovation, and continuous improvement across geographically distributed teams. 

 Experience Required 
 At least 18 years of progressive experience in infrastructure delivery and operations, with significant leadership responsibility in large, complex enterprise environments. Demonstrated experience leading compute infrastructure services across multiple business domains and geographically distributed teams. Strong hands-on foundation and leadership experience in on-premises Microsoft Windows Server administration and enterprise Linux server administration. Strong experience managing NetApp storage platforms and VMware virtualization environments at enterprise scale. Proven experience leading cloud operations in AWS and Microsoft Azure, including governance, reliability, security, cost management, and operational support. Experience developing infrastructure strategy, multi-year roadmaps, operating models, transformation plans, business cases, and investment priorities. Proven people-management capability, including organization design, workforce planning, performance enablement, coaching, succession planning, and skills development. Experience managing major incidents, service continuity, disaster recovery, operational risk, audit requirements, security remediation, and regulatory or compliance obligations. Experience driving automation, standardization, observability, self-service, and continuous improvement across infrastructure operations. Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, contracts, licenses, cloud consumption, and operational cost optimization. Strong understanding of IT service management practices, including incident, problem, change, configuration, capacity, availability, and service-level management. Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, decision-making, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership skills. Ability to translate business priorities into practical infrastructure strategies and measurable operational outcomes. Bachelors degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant professional certifications in IT service management, VMware, NetApp, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Windows, Linux, or enterprise architecture are advantageous.

description:

Once up and running the role will become responsible for all aspects of support for end users and their technology, whether in the office or working remotely, as well as select North American after-hours users. Excellent working knowledge of end user technology including PCs, peripherals, printers, mobile devices, etc. Strong knowledge with multi-factor authentication, email content filtering, and endpoint security controls. title: Manager - SCM Operations (E Commerce)
description:
ROLE PURPOSE Own end-to-end logistics operations for the organisation's Quick Commerce business, courier partnerships, and marketplace fulfilment. Ensure timely, accurate and cost-efficient movement of goods from warehouse to platform to customer, while managing courier and 3PL relationships, resolving delivery escalations, and driving continuous improvement in fulfilment turnaround, cost and service levels. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own end-to-end logistics operations for the Quick Commerce business dark store / warehouse dispatch, inbound replenishment, and last-mile delivery timelines across QC platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart and similar). Manage relationships with courier and 3PL partners onboarding, rate negotiation, SLA agreements, and performance reviews to ensure reliable and cost-effective delivery. Coordinate marketplace logistics including FBA/FC shipments, inbound stock transfers, and platform-specific fulfilment requirements (Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplaces). Track and improve key logistics metrics on-time dispatch, on-time delivery, order fulfilment turnaround, and delivery cost per order across all channels. Monitor and resolve escalations related to delayed shipments, lost/damaged consignments, failed deliveries and courier claims. Coordinate closely with Sales, Marketplace Operations and Warehouse teams to align stock availability with dispatch and delivery schedules. Manage reverse logistics returns processing, RTO (Return to Origin) tracking, and coordination with couriers for pickup and reconciliation. Own courier and logistics cost tracking, freight reconciliation, and monthly cost-vs-budget reporting. Ensure compliance with marketplace and courier documentation requirements e-way bills, invoices, and shipment labelling standards. Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to reduce delivery TAT (turnaround time) and logistics costs. Lead and manage the logistics coordination team, ensuring smooth day-to-day execution and accountability. Prepare and present regular MIS reports on logistics performance, courier scorecards, and delivery SLAs to leadership. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS On-time dispatch % and on-time delivery % across Quick Commerce, courier and marketplace channels Delivery cost per order and overall logistics cost as a % of sales RTO / return rate and reverse logistics turnaround Courier SLA adherence and claim resolution TAT Order fulfilment accuracy and stock-out incidents due to logistics delays 
 EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS Graduate / Post-graduate degree; MBA / PGDM (Supply Chain / Operations) preferred. 
 WORK EXPERIENCE 58 years of experience in logistics, supply chain or fulfilment operations, with hands-on exposure to Quick Commerce, courier management and marketplace logistics. Prior experience coordinating with courier / 3PL partners and marketplace fulfilment systems (Amazon FBA, Flipkart FA and similar). Experience managing a logistics or operations team preferred. Experience in an e-commerce / distribution / FMCG company will be an added advantage. 
 SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Strong understanding of Quick Commerce, courier and marketplace logistics workflows. Vendor management and negotiation skills with courier and 3PL partners. Strong MS Excel skills data tracking, MIS reporting and cost analysis. Problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage delivery escalations under pressure. Good communication and cross-functional coordination skills.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 An experienced operations professional responsible for owning end-to-end field operations for digital learning projects across multiple states and districts. Leads a team of operations associates and field coordinators, manages the vendor and logistics ecosystem, and holds accountability for project timelines, quality standards, and budgets. Drives planning, process design, and reporting, while engaging school authorities, government officials, and partner agencies to ensure smooth and efficient project delivery. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own end-to-end planning and execution of field operations for digital learning labs in government and private schools across India. Build and track rollout plans covering timelines, milestones, dependencies, resource allocation, and risk mitigation, and hold accountability for on-time delivery. Lead, coach, and manage a team of Operations Associates and field coordinators, allocating territories, setting goals, and reviewing performance. Identify, onboard, and manage vendors for hardware, infrastructure, accessories, printing, paper, and packaging, including rate negotiation and SLA-based performance management. Oversee logistics and inventory planning, including dispatch scheduling, warehousing, and state-wise, district-wise, and block-wise alignment and reconciliation. Manage the operations budget for assigned projects, control costs, and validate vendor invoices and reconciliations in coordination with Finance. Oversee on-ground coordination with school authorities and internal teams, ensuring smooth installation, configuration, and readiness of digital labs. Ensure site assessments and pre-deployment checks for all lab components (electrical setup, furniture, networking, printing) meet required standards, and conduct periodic quality audits. Design, standardize, and continuously improve documentation, checklists, and operational SOPs for lab readiness and field processes, and drive adoption across geographies. Prepare and present lab readiness and project performance reports to leadership, highlighting installation status, gaps, risks, and action recommendations. Act as the primary operations point of contact for external agencies, partner organizations, and district and state officials for large-scale implementation across multiple districts and states. Own the ticketing and escalation process for hardware, connectivity, and operational issues, monitoring resolution turnaround times and driving root-cause fixes. Ensure compliance with project timelines, operational standards, and client and government reporting requirements. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor s or equivalent degree from a recognized institution. A postgraduate qualification in Operations, Supply Chain, or Management is an added advantage. 3-4 years of relevant experience in operations, logistics, and project management, with demonstrated ownership of multi-location or multi-project delivery. 
 
 Must-have skills 
 Prior experience managing a small team or leading field coordinators is strongly preferred. Proven vendor management experience, including negotiation, SLA tracking, and performance reviews. Strong planning, prioritization, and project management skills, with experience in budget and cost tracking. Strong communication skills in both Hindi and English, with the ability to engage government officials and senior external stakeholders. Ability to connect and coordinate effectively with diverse Internal External teams. Capable of working under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, multi-Project environment while meeting timelines independently. Flexible, proactive, and responsive to dynamic organizational needs. Willingness to travel across project locations as required. Prior experience in a start-up or fast-moving operational environment is preferred. Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; familiarity with project management or ticketing tools is a plus.

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high\-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
   

  

 Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer\-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
   

  

 The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day\-to\-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day\-to\-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high\-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer\-focused team culture.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned business stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and reliable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing regular updates on service requests, priorities, and operational performance.
* Resolve operational issues and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
* Support service reviews by providing updates on performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process standardization, simplification, and automation.
* Lead implementation of process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, knowledge articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Monitor operational metrics and identify trends to support informed decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the team.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams across Client Service Operations to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Work closely with leadership to support operational planning, resource management, and service expansion initiatives.
* Share best practices across Business Support Services to promote consistency and standardization.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Service Delivery: SLA achievement, Turnaround time, Queue management, Delivery throughput
* Quality: Quality scores, Rework rates, Process compliance, Audit readiness
* Operational Performance: Productivity, Capacity utilization, Workload balancing, Operational efficiency
* Stakeholder Experience: Stakeholder satisfaction, Escalation resolution, Responsiveness, Service adoption
* People: Team engagement, Performance management, Training completion, Capability development
* Continuous Improvement: Process improvements implemented, Standardization initiatives, Automation opportunities identified, Knowledge management contributions


**Essential Traits**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Management, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Client Service Operations, Shared Services, Business Operations, Business Support Services, or Professional Services.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or coordinating operational teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery within a shared services or operational support environment.
* Strong operational leadership and service delivery management.
* Experience managing teams within a shared services or business operations environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience with workflow management, reporting, and operational governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Monday.com, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or similar workflow tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**About Kroll**
 Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century\-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting\-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
   

  

 In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com
   

  

*Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit*

title: Regional Operations Director
description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****About The Role****
 We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as an APAC Operations Director. This is a full\-time position based in India. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best in class service for Amazon in every country across its diverse businesses.
   

  

**Responsiblities**
 The APAC Operations Director will focus on six areas, working continuously with OpenDoor leaders to ensure success across each aspect for OpenDoor in APAC.
   

  

**Financial Operations**
* Own the APAC financial operations strategy, driving improvements in financial health, controls, accuracy, and process compliance across all markets.
* Establish governance frameworks and performance standards across billing, revenue recognition, PO management, commission reconciliation, and financial reporting processes.
* Partner with Global Commercial and FinOps teams to ensure consistent adoption of global standards, controls, and SOX requirements across APAC.
* Lead resolution of significant financial operational risks, trends, and recurring process failures.


**Process \& Continuous Improvement**
* Own the regional operational improvement roadmap, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate, and scale operational processes.
* Ensure operational processes remain fit for purpose and aligned to evolving business and client requirements.
* Sponsor cross\-functional initiatives that improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and strengthen governance.
* Act as the regional escalation point for complex operational challenges requiring structural or process change.


**Operational Excellence**
* Establish and monitor operational performance measures across APAC, including financial compliance, workflow adoption, PBR performance, and operational service quality.
* Lead regional operational reviews, ensuring actions, risks, and opportunities are actively managed and resolved.
* Drive accountability for adherence to agreed operational standards, policies, and ways of working.
* Provide operational performance reporting and insights to regional and global leadership teams.


**Project Management**
* Lead APAC participation in global transformation programmes, operational initiatives, and platform deployments.
* Prioritise and oversee regional operational projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate cross\-market delivery of operational change programmes and process improvements.
* Ensure project outcomes are effectively embedded into business\-as\-usual operations.


**Operating Model Effectiveness**
* Partner with market and regional leaders to identify capability gaps, onboarding requirements, and opportunities to improve operational maturity.
* Support implementation of consistent onboarding, role clarity, and operational standards across markets.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure Operations remains aligned to business needs while maintaining global consistency.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and develop the APAC Operations team, setting clear priorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Coach and support team members to build capability, drive accountability, and encourage continuous improvement.
* Allocate resources and workload to ensure effective delivery against regional and global priorities.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture focused on operational excellence and stakeholder partnership.


****Qualifications****
* Strong experience in media, business operations, financial operations, or operational leadership roles.
* Good understanding of media agency functions, delivery models, and financial processes.
* Proven track record of driving operational improvement, transformation, and organisational change.
* Experience implementing governance frameworks, controls, and performance management processes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior leaders.
* Excellent project and programme management capabilities.
* Outstanding communication, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

 Opportunities to make an impact in fintech

**Job Description**

 The Credit \& Control Team Lead at NIQ is responsible for overseeing the credit management and control processes within the finance department. This leadership role entails managing a team focused on maintaining sound credit policies, performing credit assessments, managing receivables, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, a solid background in credit management, and the ability to foster a team environment that prioritizes accuracy and efficiency.

* **Credit Policy Management:** 
 Develop, implement, and maintain credit policies and procedures that minimize risk and promote revenue growth
* **Team Leadership:** 
 Lead and mentor a team of credit analysts and control team members, managing workloads, setting goals, and conducting performance reviews
* **Credit Risk Assessment:** 
 Oversee the assessment of credit risk, approve credit limits, and monitor credit exposures to ensure compliance with internal guidelines
* **Accounts Receivable Management:** 
 Ensure efficient management of accounts receivable and timely collection of monies owed. Implement strategies to reduce days sales outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and enhance customer satisfaction
* **Reporting and Compliance:** 
 Generate regular reports on credit control activities and performance metrics. Ensure compliance with financial policies and regulatory requirements
* **Process Improvement:** 
 Continuously identify and implement improvements in credit processes and technologies to increase efficiency and effectiveness



  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field. Professional certification in credit management (e.g., CICM) is a must

 Strong knowledge of credit\-related laws and regulations, as well as proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 High level of analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess credit risk and make informed decisions
* **Leadership Abilities:** 
 Proven leadership skills with experience in managing teams. Ability to coach, mentor, and inspire team members to achieve business goals
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization and external stakeholders

 Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously

 Manager – Business Development / Territory Manager Function
   

  

 Commercial Reports To
   

  

 Branch Manager / Senior Branch Manager Location
   

  

 Region Travel Required
   

  

 25% ☐ 50% ? 75% ☐
   

  

 About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. Position Overview:
   

  

 The Manager – Business Development / Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth through effective sales process management across all product categories, including DP, International, Retail, Cargo, and E\-Retail. This role involves overseeing the sales team, implementing strategic sales and marketing plans, and enhancing revenue through channel partners. Additionally, the Manager – Business Development monitors performance metrics and fosters strong relationships with key clients to ensure operational excellence and profitability. Job Purpose:
   

  

 To drive the revenue growth by managing the sales process for all product categories within the branch. This role focuses on implementing strategic sales initiatives, optimizing channel partner performance, and ensuring operational excellence. Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 Sales Strategy \& Planning
   

  

  

* Develop and implement short\-term and long\-term sales strategies aligned with organizational revenue and profitability goals.
* Forecast sales trends, set performance targets, and devise action plans to achieve growth objectives across all product categories.
* Collaborate with the Regional Sales Head – Product to identify opportunities for new offerings or product modifications to drive revenue.


 Sales Operations \& Performance Management
   

  

  

* Monitor branch sales performance against targets, analyse deviations, and implement corrective measures to ensure consistent growth.
* Oversee the sales process to ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices.
* Drive revenue growth through effective channel partner management, including performance tracking and support initiatives.


 Client Relationship Management
   

  

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, decision\-makers, and business partners to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
* Negotiate rates, service terms, and offers in consultation with the Branch Head, ensuring adherence to pricing and profitability guidelines.


 Financial Management
   

  

  

* Ensure timely collections and manage account receivables to meet financial targets and maintain healthy cash flow.
* Support the Branch Head in achieving overall profitability through effective cost control and revenue optimization.


 Team Leadership \& Capability Building
   

  

  

* Provide direction, coaching, and support to the sales team to drive performance and productivity.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels and foster a high\-performance, target\-oriented culture.
* Support capability\-building initiatives, including sales training, skill enhancement, and performance evaluation programs.


 Qualifications \& Experience:
   

  

 Education:
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field; a Master’s degree (MBA) is preferred.
* Relevant certifications in sales management or marketing are advantageous.


 Experience:
   

  

  

* 3\-5 years of experience in sales, marketing, or business development roles.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and managing branch operations within the logistics or express delivery industry.
* Strong experience in developing and executing strategic sales plans, monitoring performance metrics, and achieving financial targets.


 Skills \& Capabilities:
   

  

 Technical Skills:
   

  

  

* Proficiency in sales management techniques and strategies.
* Strong understanding of market analysis and competitive landscape.
* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools to monitor sales performance.
* Knowledge of logistics and express delivery industry practices.
* Ability to develop and implement effective marketing plans.


 Key Competencies:
   

  

  

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a high\-performing sales team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building customer relationships.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities to drive sales performance.
* Adaptability and resilience in responding to changing market conditions.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high\-quality service and solutions.


 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

 KRAs
   

  

 KPIs
   

  

 Revenue Growth
   

  

  

* % achievement of branch revenue targets
* % increase in overall sales volume year\-over\-year
* Revenue generated from new customer acquisitions


 Customer Engagement
   

  

  

* Customer satisfaction score (NPS or similar metrics)
* % of customer complaints resolved within defined turnaround times


 Operational Efficiency
   

  

  

* % adherence to operational cost targets (OCPK and OCPM)
* % of on\-time deliveries


 Team Development
   

  

  

* Employee engagement scores within the sales team
* % of team members participating in training and development programs


 Market Expansion
   

  

  

* Number of new clients acquired in targeted segments
* % increase in market share for assigned product categories


 Compliance and Reporting
   

  

  

* Timeliness of sales reporting to senior management
* % adherence to compliance standards and internal policies


 Performance Management
   

  

  

* Adherence to performance management system timelines for sales staff
* % of sales team meeting or exceeding individual performance targets


 Why join DHL Blue Dart?
   

  

 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
   

  

 Here’s what makes us stand out:
   

  

 Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
   

  

 Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
   

  

 Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
   

  

 Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
   

  

 A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
   

  

 Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
   

  

 The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.
   

  

 This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.
   

  

 Disclaimer: At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).
   

  

 Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.

title: Cluster Head - Prime
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Requirements**
**About The Role**
 The
 **Cluster Head** 
 is responsible for overseeing the performance and operations of multiple branches within a designated cluster. This role focuses on driving growth in CASA (Current Account Savings Account), Term Deposits, Wealth Products, Retail Assets, Working Capital and other retail banking products, ensuring superior customer service, and maintaining operational excellence. The Cluster Head guides Branch Managers in identifying market opportunities, developing business plans, and achieving financial objectives aligned with the broader goals of the Retail Banking unit.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Oversee branch operations including distribution, customer service, administration, and sales.
* Guide Branch Managers in assessing local market conditions and identifying current and prospective sales opportunities.
* Develop forecasts, financial objectives, and business plans aligned with cluster goals.
* Manage budgets and allocate funds appropriately across branches.
* Identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions to address challenges and leverage growth opportunities.
* Share best practices, competitive intelligence, and business insights across branches and with headquarters.
* Address customer and employee satisfaction issues promptly and effectively.
* Ensure compliance with ethical standards, regulations, and applicable laws.
* Strengthen the bank’s presence and reputation within the catchment area.
* Achieve overall product targets for the cluster including CASA, Investments, Insurance, Trade Services, Term Deposits, Business Banking, and asset products like Home Loans and Loan Against Property.
* Cultivate relationships with individual and corporate customers.
* Drive customer\-centric operations and ensure service quality standards are met.
* Facilitate a customer\-focused branch channel and exceed Net Promoter Score (NPS) targets.
* Monitor branch network expansion in line with the defined business plan.
* Manage attrition by building a rapport with all staff.
* Ensure hiring is aligned to business needs.


 Secondary Responsibilities
   

  

* Evaluate growth strategies based on competitor analysis and feedback from customers and channels.
* Recommend process enhancements to improve service efficiency and quality across the branch network.
* Support marketing initiatives and conceptualize promotional strategies to drive business growth.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Postgraduate in Finance (MBA preferred).


**Experience**
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in branch banking, with proven leadership in managing multiple branches or clusters.


 Skills and Attributes
   

  

* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Strategic thinking with the ability to develop and execute business plans.
* High level of integrity, discipline, and customer orientation.
* Ability to drive performance and manage productivity across teams.
* Deep understanding of retail banking products and market dynamics.
* Fluent in English with strong business communication skills
