title: Area Manager-East
description:
**General Scope**
 Manages an assigned account, or group of accounts, with the primary responsibility to create value for the assigned customers through the technical service they provide; and identifying new product opportunities and selling to existing customers. A Sales Service Professional’s sole focus is to maintain revenue, price capture and to improve gross profit. A Sales Service Professional may work on attaining new business where appropriate, but that is not their primary assignment or job responsibility.
   

  

**Knowledge**
 Requires extensive knowledge in specialized functions. A wide and comprehensive acquaintance with, and understanding of, both general and specific aspects and the technical phases of the job and their practical application to complex problems and situations ordinarily encountered.
   

  

**Job Complexity**
 Usually works without established procedures, performing a wide variety of nonstandard complex tasks using advanced techniques and requiring extensive knowledge of discipline. Analyzes requirements for special projects and recommends methods and processes to accomplish. Supports the design/development of new or modified equipment or methods/systems for improved performance through analysis and check\-out. Evaluates and resolves calibrating and troubleshooting problems. Leads and mentors others and lower level employees, may assign work and schedule work flow.
   

  

**Impact**
 Impact of work significant to assigned area. Erroneous work product would normally result in failure to achieve schedule, and potentially affect mission success.

title: Associate Manager I - Reg CMC Strategy (LEC Team)
description:
**Job Summary**
 Functions as a Strategist for Brands\-LEC team, working with Global Regulatory Strategist (GRS\-CMC) and Cross Functional Teams to prepare and submit the variations for entity name change across global markets including US, EU \& ROW as per defined timelines.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Manages day\-to\-day regulatory activities associated with assigned LEC variations within agreed upon timelines.
* Evaluate change controls for completeness, accuracy and required supporting documents. Initiate change controls when needed.
* Performs Market Impact Assessment (MIA) for the specific entity name change.
* Runs the Reg Atlas to determine the filing action and impacted sections specific for entity name change and to obtain confirmation from the Regional Regulatory Lead.
* Search Regulatory databases for Common Technical Document components or request them from appropriate market contacts, when not available.
* Familiarity with global guidelines for filing Legal Entity Changes (LEC) and run corresponding reports in the regulatory requirements database.
* Should be familiar with submission grouping practices.
* Interpret and apply global/regional CMC regulatory policies.
* Request documents from the sites/markets/center functions as needed.
* Request Ancillary documents from Ancillary documents team.
* Communicate with markets if clarification/prioritization is needed.
* Follow up with all responsible disciplines to be able to meet timelines.
* Authoring of the impacted CMC sections i.e. Module 3 under the guidance from the product strategists as appropriate and within agreed timelines.
* Responsible for obtaining approval in Reg\-459 form from GRS CMCs on the completion of authoring the sections.
* Utilizes Pfizer’s CMC systems, i.e. GDMS, PDM, SPA, PEARL, RegAtlas, Rosetta etc., as appropriate.
* Must be extremely organized as LEC projects can run across multiple products/markets.
* Ensures compliance to Pfizer internal procedures and training SOPs.
* Ownership of process improvements, metrics and delivery risks
* Team player and work under matrix environment
* Works under the supervision of line manager
* Escalation management and cross\-functional issue resolution.
* Accountability for defined team milestones, rather than only assigned individual activities.
* Technical coaching or knowledge sharing within the work team.

title: Calibration Laboratory Head
description:
Job Title: Calibration Laboratory Head
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Company: Oizom Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
 



  





**About Oizom:** 




 Oizom is a leading environmental monitoring solutions company, building innovative sensor\-based platforms to measure, analyze, and visualize environmental data. Our solutions help governments, industries, and researchers make data\-driven decisions for cleaner and healthier environments.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are hiring a Calibration Laboratory Head to lead the technical direction and quality oversight of our calibration laboratory for gas, dust, and meteorological instruments. This role involves defining calibration processes, developing SOPs, planning setups for new parameters and capabilities, and driving measurement accuracy improvement through structured testing.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs):** 




 ● Develop and maintain calibration SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation across gas, dust, and meteorological parameters
 



 ● Plan and define calibration setups for new parameters, instrument types, or measurement ranges — providing technical specifications, workflow design, and environmental requirements
 



 ● Design and supervise testing experiments to identify and reduce sources of measurement error — linearity, drift, cross\-sensitivity, and environmental influence studies
 



 ● Set calibration quality standards, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement
 



 ● Prepare and maintain measurement uncertainty budgets and ensure traceability to national/international standards
 



 ● Build and maintain quality documentation and processes aligned to ISO/IEC 17025 standards
 



 ● Provide technical direction, training, and mentorship to the team.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instrumentation, Environmental Engineering, Applied Physics, Atmospheric Science, Metrology, or a related field
 



 ● Minimum 4 years of hands\-on experience in a calibration or testing laboratory environment, with a total professional experience of 6\+ years preferred.
 



 ● Strong understanding of measurement uncertainty estimation and GUM methodology
 



 ● Experience with gas analyzers, dust/particulate monitors, or meteorological sensors
 



 ● Demonstrated ability to write SOPs, design calibration workflows, and build technical documentation ● Proven ability to lead and coordinate with technical teams
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 ● Experience with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation processes
 



 ● ISO/IEC 17025 Internal Auditor or Lead Assessor certification
 



 ● Experience in designing testing experiments, method validation, or accuracy improvement initiatives ● Familiarity with air quality regulatory standards and calibration protocols
 



 ● Proficiency with data analysis tools and statistical methods

Sansera Engineering is an engineering\-led integrated manufacturer of forged complex and high\-precision components for the automotive, non\-Automotive and Aerospace sectors. With a rich legacy spanning over three decades, Sansera Engineering is committed to delivering quality products to its global clientele. As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, we are seeking talented and dedicated individuals to join our team.
   

  

* Production Planning \& Execution
* Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
* Monitor production schedules and coordinate with PPC, SCM, Quality, and Maintenance teams.
* Optimize machine utilization, manpower allocation, and line balancing.
* Ensure smooth production flow and minimize bottlenecks.
* Drive adherence to customer delivery commitments.
* Operational Excellence
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, TPM, and Six Sigma initiatives.
* Improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor and reduce cycle time, changeover time, and process losses.
* Establish and track key production KPIs.
* Lead productivity and cost reduction projects.
* Quality Management
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Work closely with Quality Assurance teams to achieve zero\-defect manufacturing.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for production\-related issues.
* Monitor first\-pass yield, rejection, rework, and scrap reduction programs.
* Safety \& Compliance
* Ensure adherence to EHS standards and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture through regular audits and training.
* Conduct risk assessments and implement preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with environmental and workplace regulations.
* Team Leadership \& Development
* Lead and manage production supervisors, engineers, and operators.
* Conduct skill development and cross\-functional training programs.
* Drive employee engagement and performance management.
* Foster a culture of accountability, discipline, and teamwork.
* Cost Management
* Monitor manufacturing costs and operational expenses.
* Drive initiatives for waste reduction and productivity improvement.
* Optimize consumption of raw materials, consumables, and utilities.
* Support budgeting and cost control activities.
* Maintenance Coordination
* Coordinate with Maintenance teams to ensure machine availability.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Minimize production downtime through proactive actions.
* Customer \& Audit Support
* Participate in customer visits and audits.
* Support internal, external, and certification audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings and customer concerns.

title: Client Data
description:
**Job Description**
 This role plays a key part in collaborating with various internal teams to ensure all client KYC records adhere to regulatory standards; ensuring the high\-quality and timely completion of all client\-level due diligence. Responsible for reviewing the data collection and verification processes to ensure all KYC records are accurate and complete before the final review by the client\-facing team.
   

  

 As a Client Data Manager II within the Operations team, you will be responsible for reviewing and improving data collection and verification processes, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of KYC records before they are reviewed by the client\-facing team. Your advanced organizational skills will be crucial in managing multiple tasks and activities, while your proficiency in digital and tech literacy will help you leverage software applications and digital platforms to enhance processes and client experience.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Perform day to day management of a team, including coaching and providing ongoing performance feedback.
* Track performance of individual team members over time to evaluate performance, learning and capability.
* Effectively address any service issues that might be escalated by either internal or external customers.
* Take action independently and move forward without clear instruction or close supervision.
* Make decisions that are effective and well\-grounded based on data, insight, and experience.
* Create an effective and efficient team through continuous communication, timely feedback, and appropriate supervisory practices.
* Organize workflow and distribute work appropriately.
* Support all aspects of client onboarding to include the fulfillment of AML and KYC requirement.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Demonstrated ability to develop, manage, coach, and motivate teams.
* Must be flexible and adaptable to manage interim projects and processes based on the business requirements.
* Knowledge of banking products.
* Proven leader of process and organizational change.
* Demonstrated ability to identify, analyze, plan, prioritize, and solve problems, by providing viable solutions and executing.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to cope with change; comfort with ambiguity.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Previous experience in AML, Compliance, Fraud, KYC, or Operational Risk an advantage.
* Competent in mainframe and PC based systems, with a strong proficiency in MS Office.
* Previous people manager experience of high performing team.


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. **About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: FAAS Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS\- Assurance FAAS – Manager – Trade Operations Specialist**
 In a world that is changing faster than ever, our purpose acts as our ‘North Star’ guiding our more than 300,000 people – providing the context and meaning for the work we do every day. In doing so, we play a critical role in
 **building a better working world** 
 for our people, clients and communities. Thanks to our innovative services in auditing, tax consulting as well as transaction and management consulting, we proudly drive our clients into the future. As the only one of the Big 4 with a specialist cross\-border practice dedicated to the Financial Services Sector, we offer our clients seamless, consistent and high\-quality services around the globe. With our Assurance Services, we strengthen public confidence in global capital markets and promote sustainable growth. If you are looking to develop your individual skills whilst working in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams, come join us!
   

  

**We provide advisory services encompassing:**
* Accounting, reporting and controlling process assessment and design including information systems implementation
* Finance process optimization and automation incl. Robotics Process Automation
* Accounting and regulatory support on accounting change in IFRS (IFRS conversion and implementation, new standards implementation)
* Financial consolidation
* Transactions accounting
* Audit readiness and audit remediation services
* Finance function strategic transformation
* Data analytics and visualization
* Investment Accounting, hedge accounting and derivative accounting
* Short term assignments to finance functions – accounting specialist, compliance specialist, consolidation specialist, controller etc.


**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**
**Collateral Management Operations**
* Lead end\-to\-end collateral management processes for OTC derivative portfolios across various asset classes.
* Provide oversight over exposure calculations and validate margin requirements in accordance with client methodologies and collateral agreements.
* Review and challenge collateral balances, margin movements and settlement information to lead ongoing collateral management activities.
* Oversee collateral eligibility, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts and other key agreement terms.
* Lead collateral call administration activities through preparation, validation and tracking of collateral requirements.
* Drive operational excellence, process standardization and automation initiatives.


**Reconciliations and Exception Management**
* Oversee reconciliations and exception management processes across counterparties and internal records.
* Manage escalation and resolution of collateral breaks, valuation differences, operational/ aged exceptions and collateral\-related discrepancies.
* Monitor KPI/ KRI reporting, trackers, issue logs and exception reporting.


**CSA and Documentation Support**
* Review and interpret Credit Support Annex (CSA) provisions and provide guidance to document key collateral terms within operational processes.
* Lead collateral onboarding activities and operational readiness assessments.
* Maintain governance collateral reference data, procedures, SOPs and controls.


**Reporting, Controls and Governance**
* Manage collateral management reports, dashboards and management information packs.
* Monitoring of key risk indicators, operational metrics and service\-level agreements.
* Establish and maintain relationships with client management and global stakeholders.
* Supervise engagement execution, planning, budgeting and resource management.


**Our Requirements:**
* 6\-10 years of experience in Collateral Management, Treasury Operations, Derivatives Operations, Capital Markets Operations or Risk Operations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, complemented with a further relevant professional education (e.g. Chartered Accountant, CPA, CFA or ACCA)
* Experience supporting FX, derivatives, fixed income or money market products.
* Advanced Excel/Power BI skills/ data analytics \- familiarity with data visualization and reconciliations.
* Strong knowledge of collateral management and OTC derivative operations.
* Good understanding of IFRS/US GAAP and International auditing standards.
* Knowledge of IFRS/ US GAAP for financial instruments
* Knowledge of ISDA and CSA documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and technical writing skills.
* Ability and comfort level in overseeing client inquires and emerging issues, including regulations, industry practices and new technologies.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Manager, Platform Security & Consulting Operations
description:

These platforms underpin Cyderes' managed services, including SIEM, EDR, FW, and supporting cloud and on\-premises infrastructure. title: Payroll Operations Manager
description:
**Role Summary**
 The Payroll Manager is responsible for leading the delivery of high\-quality payroll services across multiple countries within a Managed Services environment. The role ensures payroll is processed accurately, on time, and in compliance with local legislation and company policies while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The Payroll Manager leads a team of 4–6 Payroll Specialists, providing coaching, performance management, workload planning, and technical guidance. The role also acts as the primary escalation point for payroll issues and collaborates closely with HR, Finance, vendors, and stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Payroll Operations**
* Lead the end\-to\-end payroll delivery for assigned countries
* Ensure payroll is processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with local legislation, tax, and social security requirements.
* Monitor payroll quality, service levels, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Review payroll results and resolve complex payroll issues and escalations.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and data privacy regulations.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4–6 Payroll Specialists.
* Set performance expectations and conduct regular performance reviews and development discussions.
* Allocate workload and manage team capacity to ensure service continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, customer\-focused, and high\-performing team culture.
* Support onboarding and training of new team members.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Act as the main escalation point for payroll\-related matters.
* Partner with HR, Finance, Time \& Attendance, Benefits, and external payroll provider to resolve issues.
* Communicate payroll updates, risks, and improvement initiatives to leadership.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, controls, and efficiency.
* Lead or participate in payroll transformation and system implementation projects.
* Support standardization and automation initiatives across the Managed Services organization.
* Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring issues.


**Governance \& Compliance**
* Ensure adherence to payroll policies, procedures, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of payroll legislation and regulatory changes.
* Ensure compliance with SOX and other internal control requirements, where applicable.

title: Machine Shop Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bansal Forge Precision Pvt. Ltd., established in 2004, is a global manufacturer of high\-quality forged and machined components serving automotive, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. The company combines advanced forging and machining technologies with stringent global standards to deliver durable, reliable, and custom\-crafted solutions. Bansal Forge is trusted by leading OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and multinational partners, backed by certified quality systems and zero\-defect commitments. The organization promotes a people\-centric culture that values respect, integrity, and continuous improvement, while aligning its operations with sustainability and environmental responsibility. Its vision is to be a world\-class forging plant that empowers industries through innovation, strong partnerships, and customer\-focused solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Machine Shop Manager is responsible for overseeing daily machining operations, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and safety protocols are consistently met. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru includes managing machine shop staff, coordinating workflow, optimizing machine utilization, and maintaining equipment and tooling. The role involves planning and monitoring production schedules, resolving technical and operational issues, and collaborating with engineering, quality, and maintenance teams to improve processes and reduce downtime. The Machine Shop Manager will track performance metrics, implement continuous improvement initiatives, and support audits and compliance requirements. The individual will also contribute to training, coaching, and developing team members to maintain a skilled and efficient workforce.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in Production Planning and Production Management to coordinate machining operations and meet delivery timelines.
* Hands\-on expertise in Machining processes, machine tools, and shop\-floor practices to ensure efficient and safe operations.
* Experience in Quality Management and Inspection to maintain standards, conduct checks, and support zero\-defect output.
* Knowledge of CNC and conventional machining, tooling selection, and process optimization.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and tolerances.
* Proven experience in team leadership, shift management, and performance monitoring in a machine shop or manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field; relevant experience in forging or precision machining is an advantage.
* Effective communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills, with a commitment to safety and compliance.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
**Let's start with who we are** 




 Interviews can be hard. And when it comes to the top tech companies like Google, Facebook, Netflix, etc., they can be downright brutal. Most candidates don't make it simply because they don't prepare well enough. Interview Kickstart helps candidates nail the toughest tech interviews. At IK, current and former hiring managers at these top companies take candidates through an intense prep course to prepare them to crack the toughest Technical interviews. You could think of us as the everything store for career transitions and interview skill development.
 



**How do we do that, you ask?** 




 We have a structured way of helping folks crack interviews\-
 


* Career accelerator course
* End\-to\-end courses \+ platform
* More than 750\+ instructors from Google, FB, Amazon, Netflix, Dropbox, and other top Silicon Valley companies.
* And, to date, we have trained over 27000\+ engineers!



 Sounds interesting? Then here is some more information about the role:
 



**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for a Manager – Sales Operations to support our revenue organization through data\-driven insights, sales performance analysis, reporting, and operational excellence. This role will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Business teams to improve sales productivity, forecasting accuracy, funnel visibility, and decision\-making.
 



 The ideal candidate has experience working in high\-growth EdTech, SaaS, or inside\-sales driven organizations and possesses strong analytical capabilities, CRM expertise, and a passion for translating data into actionable business insights.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reports to track sales performance and business KPIs.
* Analyze sales funnel metrics, conversion rates, productivity trends, and revenue performance to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support sales forecasting, target tracking, business reviews, and leadership reporting.
* Own CRM data quality, reporting accuracy, and sales process governance.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on sales performance gaps, lead management issues, and operational bottlenecks.
* Support webinar, event, and sales enablement operations, including performance tracking, attendance analysis, and operational reporting where required.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Business teams to drive data\-backed decision\-making and process improvements.
* Create and automate recurring reports to improve visibility and operational efficiency.



**What Would Excite Us?** 



* 4–8 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Analytics, Business Analytics, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations.
* Prior experience in EdTech, SaaS, B2C Sales, or high\-volume inside sales environments.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, and data analysis.
* Hands\-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar reporting tools.
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, LeadSquared, or equivalent systems.
* Strong understanding of sales funnels, forecasting, KPI tracking, conversion analysis, and business performance metrics.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis and presenting recommendations to business stakeholders.



**What Would Excite You?** 



* Work directly with sales leadership and influence key revenue\-driving decisions.
* Build analytics frameworks and reporting systems that impact business growth.
* Gain exposure to strategy, forecasting, and performance management across a global EdTech business.
* Collaborate with high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced and data\-driven environment.

title: Senior Manager Operations
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* In partnership with the Snr Operations Manager, provide strong people leadership for 5 or more Assistant Managers and employees to deliver an exceptional customer experience in an inclusive environment, leading our Health \& Dental claims operation team in Bangalore
* Ensure strong employee engagement results, performance management, coaching and development of all employees within Benefits Payment Office
* Ensure all operational objectives are achieved including time service, quality, and productivity for claim adjudication
* Drive a continuous improvement culture to implement solutions that create value
* Embed a mindset that empowers employees to make informed and timely decisions that focus on the customer
* Collaborate with other site leaders on forecasting \& capacity planning and ensuring appropriate resources are in place to efficiently and effectively deal with claims volume and service objectives to ensure consistent national delivery of service
* Ensure strong training delivery to enhance employee skills and capabilities to deliver against business objectives
* Manage and maintain site operating budget – ensuring prudent financial management of related expenses.
* Ensure adherence to compliance protocols \& ‘satisfactory’ audits are achieved


**What You Will Bring**
* University degree or the equivalent education or experience in a field related to operations management, business administration, etc.
* 12\+ years leadership experience in an operations business within financial services – providing leadership for day\-to\-day operations with a strong customer centric focus
* Group Health \& Dental claims experience would be considered an asset
* Be a culture leader who is focused on building high performing teams, collaboration, empowering employees and creating a psychologically safe work environment
* Passion for coaching \& mentoring team members to reach performance expectations and support them in developing their potential
* Strong change leadership skills coupled with the ability to inspire and motivate individuals and teams
* Foster an environment that encourages new approaches, challenges the status quo, and inspires creativity
* Creative thinker with proven analytical and problem\-solving skills to identify meaningful solutions
* Good judgment and decisions making skills – along with ability to assess risk and make informed decisions
* Proven ability to develop strong relationships with both internal and external partners / clients
* 8\-10\+ Years managing managers

* Demonstrated ownership of SLA, productivity, quality, Customer, and financial metrics

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services (Network Security)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Senior Manager, Technical Services leads multiple delivery pods within the Global Delivery Center Technical Services organization (NetSec) and, where applicable, manages first\-line managers. The role sits between hands\-on delivery leadership and the Director\-level strategic mandate: you will translate the broader Technical Services strategy into concrete operating plans, scale delivery capacity across pods, own executive\-level customer escalations end\-to\-end, and develop the next generation of managers on the team. This position requires seasoned people\-of\-people leadership, strong operational discipline, and a proven ability to build repeatable delivery motions in a high\-growth environment.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

 Delivery Program Leadership
   

  

 Cross\-Pod Execution: Own delivery outcomes across multiple pods / functional areas health of engagements, utilization, margin, and customer satisfaction with a weekly operating rhythm and a clear escalation ladder.
   

  

 Playbooks \& Standards: Codify how the Global Delivery Center Technical Services team delivers engagement kickoff templates, quality gates, technical review checklists, handoff protocols and drive consistent adoption across managers and leads.
   

  

 Capacity Planning: Own the multi\-quarter capacity model for your area; partner with Recruiting on the hiring plan and with Sales on the demand forecast.
   

  

 People \& Manager Development
   

  

 Manage Managers: Develop your first\-line managers running structured 1:1s, coaching them through hiring, performance conversations, and escalations rather than doing the work for them.
   

  

 Talent Bench: Own the succession plan and readiness ratings for your area; identify and grow next\- manager candidates from within the IC ranks.
   

  

 Culture Owner: Set the tone for how your teams work together high\-trust, high\-standards, low\- drama and hold the line on it when pressure spikes.
   

  

 Hiring at Scale: Own the end\-to\-end hiring plan for your area role definition, interview loops, calibration, offer strategy and drive the pass\-through rate.
   

  

 Customer \& Sales Partnership
   

  

 Executive Customer Relationships: Be the Technical Services face for strategic accounts in your region QBRs, steering committees, and post\-mortems.
   

  

 Sales \& GTM Alignment: Partner with Sales Leadership and Solutions
   

  

 Consulting on pipeline shape, deal shaping, and services\-attach; help scope large / complex engagements.
   

  

 Partner Enablement: Where relevant, work with the Partner Ecosystem team to grow delivery capacityand quality through channel partners. Escalation
   

  

 Ownership
   

  

 Own the Recovery: Lead customer escalations end\-to\-end for your area — structure the recovery plan, sequence the technical and commercial workstreams, and drive to a written closure.
   

  

 Executive Communication: Represent status crisply upward (Director / VP) and outward (customer executive sponsors) during high\-pressure situations.
   

  

 Operational Rigor
   

  

 Metrics \& Reporting: Own the weekly / monthly business review for your area utilization, delivery health, CSAT, attrition, hiring velocity and act on the signals.
   

  

 QBR Participation: Contribute directly to Regional QBRs with a defensible read on plan\-to\-actuals and a forward view.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Educational Background: Undergraduate degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; MBA or Masters degree preferred.
   

  

 Proven Leadership: 5\+ years managing service delivery teams of 10\+ professionals in a high\-growth technology environment, including 1\+ year of experience managing other managers or team leads.
   

  

 Security Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of Network Security concepts and product delivery — Palo Alto Networks NGFW / Panorama / Prisma Access / SASE strongly preferred; broader familiarity with the adjacent NetSec ecosystem (Cloud, SD\-WAN, ZTNA) valued.
   

  

 Delivery Program Ownership: Track record of running multi\-pod / multi\-account delivery portfolios —building playbooks, standardizing quality bars, and scaling capacity without proportional headcount growth.
   

  

 Manager Development: Concrete examples of first\-line managers you have hired, coached, and grown ,including cases where you handled underperformance decisively.
   

  

 Escalation Command: Demonstrated ability to serve as the calm, decisive owner of high\-visibility customer escalations with a written record of resolutions rather than heroics.
   

  

 Executive Communication: Fluent presenting to internal executives (RVP / VP) and external customer /partner executives; able to translate technical complexity into business outcome.
   

  

 Multitasking Mastery: Proven ability to oversee many concurrent engagements and prioritize a complex workload proactively without dropping commitments.
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Supervisor I
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data\-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.
   

  

 Labcorp is seeking a
 **Supervisor I** 
 to join our team at Yeshwantpur, Bangalore, Karnataka.
   

  

**Work Schedule**
 2nd Shift \- 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**People Responsibilities:**
* Provides regular feedback and coaching for all direct reports.
* Implements the PMD\-process: objective setting, assessments, corresponding appraisal interviews, proposal of salary adjustments and promotions. Ensures the compliance of objectives with corporate goals and provides support if expectations are not met.
* Learns to create the individual development plan of staff in co\-operation with the line manager and monitors the staff development.
* Responsible for the realisation of the probation period process: designation of mentors, monitoring the training phase, regular assessment and appraisal interviews including appropriate documentation.
* Learns how to and participates in the recruitment process for prospective new team members.
* Learns to assist in managerial duties in support of upper management as needed
* Implements diversity goals and initiatives.


**Essential Job Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Schedules and coordinates proactively and in conjunction with other groups or departments the daily activities of the group and liaises with other groups, sections and departments. Organizes necessary resources for conducting all relevant study or non\-study related tasks and participates in the study performance.
* Assures appropriate communication within the group, particularly for dissemination of information (i.e. Study progress, Facility procedures, Quality, Health and Safety, Business Updates and any other departmental or company communications)
* Understands and interprets study plans and identifies problems resulting from the study plan or during study conduct and takes appropriate action.
* Ensures maximum utilization of staff within Global Operations teams \& maintaining various metrics related to team operations.
* Optimizes existing and develops new techniques, methods for study conduct or non\-study specific areas and supports their application.
* Plans, organizes and participates in meetings (i.e. study start\-up meetings, coordination meetings, team meetings, and 1:1 meetings)
* Performs quality controls, assures corrections of errors (incl. documentation) identifies potential problems and optimizes the quality control system.
* Responsible for constructive responses to reports and questions from Study Direction, QAU, EH\&S, clients or regulatory agencies in a timely manner. Performs corrective actions when needed.
* Provides for safety and welfare of staff and supports/enforces Environmental Health and Safety Policies
* May be asked to participate in global working groups.
* Reports all animal welfare concerns and becomes involved in the resolution and appropriate corrective action, when necessary.
* Provides support, training and guidance for less experienced staff.
* Learn our cost structure and how to proactively impact it.
* Participates in meetings, inspections or client visits.
* Works under occasional supervision.
* Performs other related duties as needed


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Master's Degree in Life Sciences.
* 5 or more years of experience in Preclinical and/or Clinical research environments, with demonstrated expertise in GLP and GCP\-regulated operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Biotechnology.
* 1or more years of experience exhibiting leadership behaviors such as guiding peers, driving cross\-functional initiatives, and supporting team development, with readiness to assume formal people management responsibilities.


**Additional Job Standards**
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to effectively manage priorities and operational activities.
* Effective leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills to lead teams and work collaboratively across functions.
* Proficient in using software applications and operational systems to support daily operations, reporting, and resource planning
* Strong Knowledge of departmental tasks of Animal House Operations, including laboratory animal care and husbandry, animal welfare, dosing procedures, sample collection, dispensary functions, facility operations, and coordination with pathology, histology, necropsy, and analytical support teams.
* Advanced knowledge of Animal Welfare Act, GLP principles, and applicable regulatory agency guidelines, with responsibility for maintaining compliance, supporting study conduct, and ensuring high standards of animal care and operational quality.

title: Manager, Account management, RBS - AVS Account Management
description:
**Description**
 About Amazon.com
   

  

 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
   

  

**About Our Business**
 Our team will be responsible for managing operational business metrics and related tasks for ZA AVS vendors. Our goal is to achieve this through a dedicated team of vendor managers, who will serve as the primary owners of the business metrics for their assigned vendors. You will be accountable for their output and for effectively managing the team.
   

  

 Our primary customers are the vendors who subscribe to the AVS service with the aim of receiving customized support to drive their growth on the Amazon platform. In order to meet and exceed their expectations, we are committed to delivering high\-quality services by improving key business metrics that accelerate their success on Amazon.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Manager Account Management
   

  

 Manager Account Management leads ZA MP across product families for the program through a team of 8 Account Manager. You will collaborate internally with leaders from Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for certain aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Ideal incumbent in this role would always be on a lookout for opportunity to add value to Amazon retail business through serving Amazon vendors. You will be required to analyze data, interact with cross functional teams, recommend and pilot improvements that will help us serve our customers better, inline with our goal to be the Earth’s Most Customer Centric Company.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* You need to monitor and manage the achievement of business metrics for each team member and be accountable for the final results.
* You need to provide weekly reports to relevant internal teams.
* You need to periodically present reports to our vendors along with your team members.
* You need to coordinate internal and external resources to ensure the team can smoothly achieve its goals.
* You need to effectively manage the team’s daily operations, performance management, and personnel management.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of mentoring, leading and coaching experience

title: Lead Support Analyst I
description:
**Overview**
 The HR Systems \& ServiceNow Operations Lead is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, support, workforce management, and continuous improvement of the organization's'HR technology ecosystem, including Workday, ServiceNow HR workflows, and associated HR applications and integrations. The role ensures stable, secure, compliant, and efficient service delivery while leading a global operations team and partnering closely with HR, IT, vendors, and business stakeholders. The role also supports the organization's strategy to align HR and ServiceNow service delivery under a unified operational model.

title: Manager, Technical Services (Network Security)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Job Description
   

  

 The Technical Services Manager is a first\-line people leader responsible for the day\-to\-day execution and
   

  

 delivery quality of a Technical Services pod for the Global Delivery Center (NetSec). The role requires strong technical grounding, hands\-on engagement with active engagements, and the ability to develop early\-career engineers while consistently meeting customer commitments. You will own the health of your teams projects, act as the first escalation point for delivery issues, and partner closely with a SeniorManager or Director on staffing, capacity, and career\-path planning.
   

  

 Delivery Execution
   

  

 Own Engagement Quality: Ensure Professional Services and Resident Engineer engagements owned by your pod are delivered on\-scope, on\-schedule, and to defined quality bars — with weekly visibility into risks and blockers.
   

  

 Technical Oversight: Stay hands\-on enough to review designs, validate architectures, and unblock engineers on Network Security (PAN\-OS, Panorama, Prisma Access, SASE) product implementations.
   

  

 Capacity \& Assignment: Match consultants to engagements based on skill, growth goals, and utilization; flag capacity gaps to leadership early.
   

  

 People Management
   

  

 1:1 Coaching: Run consistent weekly 1:1s with each direct report, actively coach on technical depth, communication, and customer skills, and drive individual development plans.
   

  

 Hiring \& Onboarding: Own hiring for open roles on your pod — screening, interviewing, offer partnership with recruiting — and drive structured onboarding for new hires and CWs.
   

  

 Performance Management: Deliver clear, timely feedback; own performance reviews, promotion nominations, and performance improvement plans for your direct reports.
   

  

 Customer \& Stakeholder
   

  

 Customer Relationship: Be a visible point of contact for the customers your pod serves; join key checkpoint calls and steer engagements when they drift.
   

  

 Sales Partnership: Work with Sales and Solutions Consulting on scoping, staffing, and effort estimation for new opportunities in your area.
   

  

 Escalation Response
   

  

 First Responder: Act as the first escalation point for delivery issues on your team's engagements — triage, own the recovery plan, and communicate clearly to both customer and internal stakeholders.
   

  

 Escalate Up: Know when to pull in the Senior Manager / Director early, with a clean summary of the situation and a proposed path.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Your Experience
   

  

 Educational Background: Undergraduate degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
   

  

 Leadership Foundation: 2\+ years managing a team of 5–8 service delivery engineers, OR 8\+ years of technical services / professional services experience with demonstrated team\-lead responsibilities (mentoring, work assignment, quality ownership).
   

  

 Security Domain Expertise: Hands\-on delivery experience with Network Security products — Palo Alto Networks NGFW / Panorama / Prisma Access / SASE preferred; equivalent experience with other enterprise firewall or SASE vendors considered.
   

  

 Delivery Rigor: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent customer engagements without slippage, using a defined delivery methodology (statement\-of\-work, milestones, acceptance criteria).
   

  

 Coaching Skills: Track record of growing individual engineers — measurable examples of team members promoted, upskilled, or successfully onboarded onto complex customer work.
   

  

 Communication: Strong written and verbal communication in English; comfortable running customer\- facing status calls and translating technical detail into next steps a non\-technical stakeholder can action.
   

  

 The Team
   

  

 Our technical services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post\-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesnt stop once they sign – it evolves.
   

  

 As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You will be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and will fix integrations and critical issues as they are raised
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Technical Support Lead
description:
**About Cyble**
 Cyble is revolutionizing the landscape of cybersecurity intelligence. Founded in 2019, Cyble began as a visionary college project and has quickly transformed into a leading force in proactive cyber threat detection and mitigation, that is now globally significant, with people in 20 countries \- Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, and with offices in Australia, Malaysia, Singapore, Dubai, Saudi Arabia and India
   

  

 Our mission is clear: to provide visibility, intelligence and cybersecurity protection using cutting\-edge advanced technology, giving enterprises a powerful advantage. We democratize real\-time intelligence about cyber threats and vulnerabilities, enabling organizations to take proactive measures and maintain robust cybersecurity. We strive to make the digital world a safer place for everyone.
   

  

 At Cyble, artificial intelligence (AI) and innovation are central to all operations, with a commitment to continuous improvement and excellence in both products and business practices. Cyble values inclusivity, offering team members autonomy and flexibility to balance their professional and personal lives. Cyble fosters a culture where employees voices are heard, contributions are recognized, and everyone is encouraged to be part of something extraordinary. To learn more about Cyble, visit
 **www.cyble.com** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Technical Support Lead – Cybersecurity Products** 
 to join our team, to own and scale technical product support for our cybersecurity products and enterprise customers globally.
   

  

 This role will own the support operation end\-to\-end — including team management, global support coverage, shift and on\-call planning, support SLAs, escalations, customer communication, and continuous improvement of support processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has 8\+ years of experience in technical/product support for cybersecurity products, with experience leading support teams and operating in an environment with defined customer SLAs.
   

  

**What You’ll Do At Cyble**
**Product \& Customer Support**
* Lead day\-to\-day technical support for Cyble's cybersecurity products and enterprise customers.
* Own the support lifecycle from ticket intake and triage through resolution and customer communication.
* Establish and enforce appropriate priority/severity classification and escalation processes.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex or high\-impact customer issues.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and professional communication with customers throughout the resolution lifecycle.
* Work with customers to understand product issues, reproduce problems, gather relevant technical information, and drive issues to closure.


**SLA \& Support Operations**
* Own and track support SLAs, response times, resolution times, backlog, escalations, and SLA breaches.
* Define and improve support processes, workflows, escalation matrices, and operating procedures.
* Establish mechanisms for effective ticket prioritization and resource allocation based on severity and customer impact.
* Own global support coverage, including shift planning, staffing, and shift rosters across geographies and time zones.
* Manage on\-call rotations and after\-hours support for critical customer issues.
* Ensure appropriate coverage for P1/P2 incidents, weekends, holidays, and other periods of elevated support demand.
* Establish effective handoff processes across shifts and geographies, ensuring continuity of ownership for open and high\-priority issues.
* Monitor support performance and provide regular reporting on key support metrics.
* Identify bottlenecks and recurring causes of SLA breaches and drive corrective actions.
* Build and maintain a structured knowledge base, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and support documentation.


**Technical Escalation \& Problem Management**
* Lead investigation of complex issues involving APIs, integrations, product functionality, data, deployments, and customer environments.
* Work with Engineering and QA to reproduce and diagnose product defects.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA) for major or recurring customer issues and ensure appropriate corrective actions.
* Distinguish between product defects, configuration issues, integration issues, and customer\-environment issues.
* Ensure escalated issues have sufficient technical information for Engineering to investigate efficiently.
* Track engineering fixes through to validation and customer closure.
* Identify recurring technical issues and drive improvements to reduce repeat incidents and support volume.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed technical support team.
* Define team structure, responsibilities, coverage models, and escalation paths.
* Plan staffing, shift rosters, on\-call rotations, leave coverage, and holiday/weekend coverage.
* Manage workload allocation across the support team based on ticket volume, severity, customer impact, and SLA commitments.
* Establish regular operational reviews covering SLA performance, backlog, escalations, customer issues, and team capacity.
* Review ticket quality, troubleshooting effectiveness, customer communication, and adherence to support processes.
* Coach team members on technical troubleshooting, cybersecurity products, incident handling, and customer communication.
* Build a culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, and customer focus.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with Engineering and QA to troubleshoot and resolve customer\-impacting product issues.
* Collaborate with Customer Success and Account teams on high\-priority customers and escalations.
* Provide structured customer feedback and support insights to Engineering and other relevant internal teams.
* Coordinate with third\-party vendors and technology partners when required.
* Drive continuous improvement based on ticket trends, customer feedback, and support metrics.


**What You’ll Need**
* 8\+ years of experience in technical/product support for cybersecurity products, with 2\+ years of experience leading or managing technical/product support teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise support SLAs, severity levels, response and resolution targets, escalations, and SLA breaches.
* Experience managing global support operations, including shift rosters, coverage planning, cross\-geography handoffs, and on\-call rotations.
* Experience handling P1/P2 customer escalations and driving issues through to resolution.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills across web applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and cloud environments.
* Experience working closely with Engineering and QA teams to troubleshoot and resolve product defects.
* Strong understanding of RCA, problem management, incident management, and escalation processes.
* Experience with ticketing/support platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or similar tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in communicating technical issues to enterprise customers.
* Strong customer orientation with the ability to manage difficult or high\-pressure customer situations.
* Ability to prioritize multiple customer issues based on business impact, severity, and contractual SLAs.
* Strong ownership, analytical ability, and attention to detail.


**Bonus Points If You Have**
* Familiarity with APIs, REST, authentication, networking, cloud environments, and common enterprise integrations.
* Experience establishing or scaling a support function in a growing organization.
* Experience defining support KPIs and dashboards such as SLA compliance, first response time, resolution time, backlog, reopen rate, escalation rate, and CSAT.
* Scripting/debugging experience with Python, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience creating customer\-facing technical documentation and knowledge bases.


**Key Success Measures**
* SLA adherence and reduction in SLA breaches
* Reduction in open and aging support tickets
* Faster and more effective resolution of high\-severity issues
* Quality and timeliness of customer communication
* Reduction in recurring issues and escalations
* Improved support processes, documentation, and knowledge base
* Customer satisfaction and confidence in Cyble's support organization
* Effective global coverage and on\-call operations
* Growth and effectiveness of the technical support team


**Cyble Offers**
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunities for learning and career growth.

 Full\-time

**Cluster Manager – Retail Sales** 
 to oversee the performance of field sales executives and retail stores, channel partners and drive sales growth, lead field sales teams, and ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations across the assigned cluster.

This role involves managing and motivating store \& field teams, monitoring performance, planning staff rosters, conducting regular training, coordinating with EHS (Expert Home Service) and internal teams, and ensuring a consistent customer experience across stores. **●      Take ownership of sales performance across the assigned territories and stores to ensure achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.** 




**●      Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales and identify gaps and opportunities to improve performance.** 




**●      Work closely with the Founders to implement sales strategies, business priorities, and initiatives across the retail stores.** 




**●      Lead, motivate, and manage store teams to improve productivity, sales conversion, customer experience, and overall performance.** 




**●      Prepare and manage staff rosters, shifts, weekly offs, and manpower allocation based on store requirements.** 




**●      Conduct regular store visits to review sales, staff performance, customer experience, visual merchandising, stock availability, and store operations.** 




**●      Set clear sales priorities for store teams and follow up regularly to ensure targets are being worked towards and achieved.** 




**●      Track individual and store\-level performance and provide regular feedback, coaching, and support to team members.** 




**●      Identify training requirements and conduct regular training on products, selling techniques, customer handling, upselling, cross\-selling, and company processes.** 




**●      Work closely with the EHS team to ensure effective coordination and follow\-up on leads and customer requirements.**

**●      Address store\-level challenges and take timely corrective actions to improve sales and team performance.** 




**●      Monitor customer feedback and ensure issues are resolved effectively to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.** 




**●       Prepare and share regular sales and performance updates with the Founders and Senior Management.** 




**●       Identify new opportunities to increase store sales, customer engagement, repeat business, and overall retail growth.** 




**Requirements:** 




**●      6\+ years of experience in retail / field sales, preferably in home furnishing, home decor, lifestyle, or related industries.** 




**●      Proven managerial experience in managing multiple retail stores or a cluster of stores.** 




**●      Strong track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.** 




**●      Strong leadership, team management, and people development skills.** 




**●      Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer relationship management skills.**

title: Accountable Manager - MRO
description:
**Role Overview** 




 The Accountable Manager (AM) is the DGCA\-designated senior management position responsible for bearing ultimate accountability for all continuing airworthiness (CA) activities and maintenance operations within Aviaman Aerotek's MRO organization. The AM serves as the principal regulatory interface with the DGCA, ensuring all maintenance, repairs, modifications, and overhauls performed on the company's helicopter and business jet fleets comply fully with:
 



 ● DGCA Continuing Airworthiness (CA) regulations and Airworthiness Directives (AD)
 



 ● Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) maintenance programs and technical documentation
 



 ● Company Maintenance Manuals, Quality Assurance protocols, and Continuing Airworthiness Management (CAMO) procedures
 



 ● Indian civil aviation safety standards and corporate governance requirements
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Continuing Airworthiness \& Regulatory Compliance** 




 ● Establish and maintain the company's Maintenance Planning Document (MPD) and Continuing Airworthiness Management (CAMO) program compliant with DGCA requirements
 



 ● Track, analyze, and implement all DGCA\-issued Airworthiness Directives (ADs) and OEM Service Bulletins (SBs) across the rotary and fixed\-wing fleet
 



 ● Conduct airworthiness reviews and maintain technical records (flight hours, cycles, maintenance history) for all aircraft to support certification audits and regulatory inspections
 



  





**MRO Program Management \& Fleet Oversight** 




 ● Oversee planning, scheduling, and execution of scheduled maintenance (Phase checks, C\-checks, D\-checks for fixed\-wing; equivalent for rotary) to optimize aircraft availability for commercial operations
 



 ● Review and approve maintenance work scopes, technical documentation, and engineering change orders for airworthiness compliance
 



 ● Manage reliability analysis and trend monitoring; recommend preventive actions to reduce unscheduled maintenance and improve on\-time performance
 



 ● Coordinate technical troubleshooting across flight operations, engineering, and quality assurance teams
 



 Quality Assurance \& Technical Oversight
 



 ● Approve all maintenance personnel certifications, training records, and technical licenses to ensure compliance with DGCA licensing requirements
 



 ● Establish and enforce safety standards, quality control procedures, and airworthiness directives across the MRO organization
 



 ● Oversee internal audits and support external DGCA inspections and surveillance activities
 



 ● Lead root cause analysis on maintenance defects and non\-compliance findings; develop corrective action plans
 



  





**Regulatory Interface \& Compliance Documentation** 




 ● Serve as primary regulatory liaison with DGCA for all airworthiness certification, maintenance approvals, and regulatory correspondence
 



 ● Maintain and update the company CAR 145 (or equivalent DGCA maintenance organization) Manual and supporting documentation
 



 ● Prepare and submit regulatory filings, certification requests, and airworthiness records for DGCA review and approval
 



 ● Ensure all aircraft airworthiness certificates, licenses, and technical records are complete, current, and accessible for audit
 



  





**Leadership \& Organizational Development** 




 ● Direct and mentor the maintenance management team, including MRO supervisors, CAMO coordinators, and flight line engineers
 



 ● Contribute to budget planning and resource allocation for maintenance operations, spares inventory, and tooling
 



 ● Champion continuous improvement initiatives, safety culture, and industry best practices in MRO operations
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





**Licenses \& Certifications** 




 ● Current DGCA Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (AME) License – B1\.3 (Helicopter) and/or B2 (Fixed\-wing) or higher category or valid DGCA/EASA Pilots license.
 



 ● Alternatively, proven equivalent international license (EASA B1/B2, FAA A\&P) with DGCA type\-rating or recognition
 



  





**Experience** 




 ● Minimum 12\+ years of aviation maintenance experience, with at least 5\+ years in a senior management role (Chief Engineer, Director of Maintenance, Accountable Manager, or equivalent)
 



 ● Demonstrated experience with DGCA regulatory framework, Continuing Airworthiness management, and compliance audits
 



 ● Prior exposure to both rotary\-wing (helicopters) and fixed\-wing aircraft maintenance is highly advantageous
 



 ● Proven track record in corporate, charter, or offshore aviation operations; MRO or maintenance organization background preferred
 



 ● Experience managing multi\-aircraft fleets and complex maintenance planning programs (e.g., Airbus, Bombardier platforms)
 



  





**Technical \& Professional Competencies** 




 ● Deep knowledge of helicopter systems (Airbus H160/H175 preferred) and business jet systems (Bombardier, Cessna)
 



 ● Expert\-level proficiency in aircraft maintenance planning, reliability analysis, and technical record management
 



 ● Strong command of CAMO software tools, maintenance tracking systems, and digital airworthiness documentation platforms
 



 ● Advanced proficiency in MS Office, data analysis, and regulatory reporting systems
 



 ● Ability to interpret OEM technical manuals, engineering drawings, and regulatory guidance in English
 



 Desired Qualifications
 



 ● Prior experience as Accountable Manager under DGCA or equivalent regulatory regime
 



 ● Experience with Continuing Airworthiness Management Organizations (CAMO) or CAR 145 maintenance organization approvals
 



 ● Advanced certification in aviation quality management, safety management systems, or lean/six sigma methodologies
 



  





**Skills \& Core Competencies** 




 ● Leadership \& Strategic Oversight – Ability to direct cross\-functional teams, manage competing operational priorities, and align MRO activities with commercial objectives
 



 ● Regulatory Acumen – In\-depth knowledge of DGCA regulations, international aviation standards, and the ability to navigate complex compliance landscapes
 



 ● Technical Excellence – Advanced troubleshooting, systems analysis, and engineering decision\-making under safety\-critical conditions
 



 ● Communication \& Relationship Management – Strong verbal and written communication skills for DGCA correspondence, internal reporting, and customer liaison
 



 ● Critical Thinking \& Problem Solving – Root cause analysis, engineering judgment, and data\-driven decision\-making in safety\-sensitive environments
 



 ● Integrity \& Accountability – Unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and regulatory compliance; ability to make tough calls in the interest of airworthiness
 



 ● Personnel Development – Coaching, mentoring, and training capabilities to build a high\-performing,
 



  





**Our Commitment to Safety \& Excellence
 
 ﻿**




 At Aviaman Aerotek, safety is non\-negotiable. The Accountable Manager is entrusted with the highest responsibility: ensuring that every flight, every maintenance action, and every engineering decision meets or exceeds DGCA standards and OEM specifications. This role carries real accountability—and real authority to make decisions in the interest of airworthiness. We seek a leader who shares this uncompromising commitment to safety, quality, and integrity.
