 **What We are Looking For:*** 6 to 10 years of facility management experience. Prior experience managing facilities in KIADB, industrial parks, or hardware/R\&D environments in Bengaluru is highly preferred.

title: Director, Call Center Operations Control
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director, Contact Center Governance, Controls \& Performance Management is a strategic leadership role responsible for establishing and leading the governance, performance management, financial control, operational risk, compliance, and quality oversight framework for Contact Center Operations. This leader serves as the first line of defense and is accountable for ensuring operational processes, customer servicing activities, technology platforms, and business controls operate effectively while supporting enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, financial performance expectations, and customer experience goals.


The Director partners closely with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Quality, and Change Management teams to drive operational excellence, strengthen controls, improve performance visibility, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for executive performance reporting, Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), Balanced Scorecard governance, operational readiness reviews, financial analysis, technology change governance, testing of new system rollouts, and deployment of AI\-enabled controls and quality assurance capabilities.


Reporting directly to the SVP, Contact Center Operations, this position plays a critical role in protecting enterprise value, enabling scalable growth, reducing operational risk, improving financial discipline, and driving a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data\-driven decision making.


**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Governance, Risk \& Controls Leadership**

* Lead the overall governance and first\-line control framework for Contact Center Operations, including policies, procedures, control standards, process documentation, and governance routines aligned with enterprise requirements.
* Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate operational, regulatory, compliance, financial, and reputational risks across Contact Center Operations.
* Oversee RCSA activities, issue management, remediation plans, corrective actions, audit responses, and regulatory examination support.
* Serve as the primary liaison for Internal Audit, Compliance, Risk Management, external auditors, and regulatory examination teams.

**Performance Management \& Executive Reporting**

* Own the Contact Center Operations performance management framework, including KPI governance across customer experience, quality, productivity, compliance, operational effectiveness, financial performance, and risk management.
* Lead monthly Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), executive operating reviews, and Balanced Scorecard governance forums.
* Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting packages that provide actionable operational and financial insights.
* Drive accountability for performance improvement initiatives through structured action planning, follow\-up governance, and data\-driven recommendations.

**Financial Analysis, Accounting \& Business Performance**

* Apply accounting, financial analysis, and business performance expertise to evaluate operating results, expense trends, control effectiveness, and operational decision impacts.
* Partner with Finance and Operations leadership to analyze cost\-to\-serve, productivity, staffing efficiency, operational investments, and business performance trends.
* Develop business cases supporting automation, process improvement, technology investments, and strategic initiatives.
* Support annual planning, forecasting, budgeting, expense governance, and financial performance routines as required.

**AI, Automation \& Intelligent Controls**

* Lead the strategy and roadmap for AI\-enabled controls, automated quality assurance, and intelligent operational monitoring across Contact Center Operations.
* Leverage AI, machine learning, speech analytics, interaction analytics, automation, and advanced analytics to strengthen oversight, improve quality coverage, and detect risks earlier.
* Develop predictive monitoring, exception management, and automated control capabilities that proactively identify compliance risks, process failures, customer friction, and operational defects.
* Ensure AI\-enabled solutions operate within established governance, regulatory, compliance, risk management, and model oversight standards.

**Technology Governance \& Change Management**

* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to ensure controls, compliance requirements, and operational readiness expectations are embedded into new systems and process changes.
* Lead operational readiness reviews for technology implementations, automation initiatives, and strategic system rollouts.
* Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, control testing, implementation governance, and post\-implementation performance monitoring.
* Ensure operational risks associated with system implementations are identified, assessed, mitigated, and monitored after deployment.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:**

**Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline required.
* CA isa must.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls, financial reporting, and business performance management required.

**Experience**

* Minimum 15\-18 years of progressive experience in Operational Risk, Internal Controls, Compliance, Audit, Accounting, Finance, or Financial Services Operations.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, enterprise risk management activities, and remediation governance.
* Experience managing operational controls within a highly regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrated experience in accounting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance management.
* Experience leading executive scorecards, KPI governance, Management Business Reviews (MBRs), and performance management programs.
* Minimum 5 years of direct leadership experience managing professional teams.
* Mortgage servicing, banking, consumer lending, or financial services experience preferred.
* Experience implementing AI, automation, speech analytics, predictive analytics, or intelligent quality management solutions preferred.
* Experience leading large\-scale operational transformation or technology modernization initiatives preferred.

**Technical \& Analytical Skills**

* Knowledge of MS\-Office \& SharePoint with advanced Excel skills required.
* Strong analytical skills, including ability to develop reports, analyze and interpret data.
* Working knowledge of continuous improvement and Lean principles, with the ability to streamline processes and adapt controls as technology and ways of working evolve.


**Core Attributes**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills required.
* Ability to work effectively with global cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and adapt to constantly changing business environment.
* Customer\-oriented individual.
* Creative problem solver with a proactive approach to mitigating operational risk.

**COMPETENCIES**

Competency Description
  

Strategic Governance \& Risk Leadership Creates sustainable governance frameworks that protect the organization while enabling operational agility, growth, and disciplined execution.
  

Financial Acumen \& Business Analysis Applies accounting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance expertise to operational decision making.
  

Performance Management Uses KPIs, scorecards, MBRs, executive reviews, and action planning routines to drive accountability and measurable business outcomes.
  

AI \& Intelligent Automation Leverages AI, automation, analytics, and automated QA to improve control effectiveness, quality oversight, operational performance, and customer outcomes.
  

Change \& Technology Leadership Governs technology transformation, system rollouts, testing, readiness, and post\-implementation monitoring while maintaining a strong control environment.
  

Executive Communication \& Influence Delivers clear, data\-driven insights and recommendations that influence senior leadership decisions and cross\-functional execution.
  

Leadership \& Talent Development Builds high\-performing teams through coaching, clear expectations, development plans, accountability, and continuous learning.

* 3pm to 12 midnight
* Minimal travel requirements

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Senior Manager
   

  

 As a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for overall technical delivery as part of large\-scale software solutions at enterprise level. You will lead functional and technical teams on the project located across shores guiding and mentoring junior team members and collaborating to understand the functional requirements. You will respond to new sales or proposals and support end\-to\-end delivery of the project along with estimations and planning.
   

  

 You will be responsible for managing the design, development, and deployment of large\-scale system implementations at an enterprise level. You will be responsible for independently managing the team and guiding team members at different levels through their career path, work through technical leads across shores to manage implementation of the functional requirements and implement them on platforms like Guidewire and Majesco. You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of the project from estimations, planning, and execution. You would also be responsible for managing the status and end to end delivery of the final product.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Deloitte's Health Care Provider practice helps hospital and health system clients design, implement, optimize, and stabilize Epic and other electronic medical record (EMR) platforms as part of broader digital and clinical transformation programs. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead our offshore Epic delivery teams, acting as the connective layer between onshore client\-facing leadership and our India\-based build, testing, and support teams.
   

  

 This is a delivery leadership role — you will own workstream execution, team management, and quality for one or more Epic modules/applications across engagements, while helping mature our offshore Epic capability.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead offshore delivery for Epic EMR workstreams (e.g., Ambulatory, Inpatient/ClinDoc, Cadence, Prelude/ADT, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Grand Central, Radiant, HIM, or Payer platforms) across implementation, optimization, upgrade, and application managed services (AMS) engagements.
* Manage a team of Epic analysts, builders, and testers (typically 60–80\+ FTEs), including staffing, performance management, mentoring, and career development.
* Own workstream execution — build plans, Incidents/SRs, small and large enhancements— ensuring on\-time, on\-quality delivery against client\-agreed scope and adhering to client’s processes.
* Partner with client and onshore engagement leadership to translate client requirements, workflows, and design decisions into actionable offshore work packages.
* Drive governance and reporting — status updates, RAID logs, capacity/utilization tracking, and escalation management across time zones.
* Ensure Epic build quality and compliance with client governance, Epic's own standards (e.g., Epic's Storyboard/Chronicles environment practices), and Deloitte delivery methodology.
* Support pre\-sales and proposal efforts , including offshore staffing plans, effort estimation, and delivery approach for new pursuits.
* Contribute to offshore practice development — recruiting, training curricula, reusable accelerators, and knowledge management.
* Manage stakeholder relationships across US/onshore client teams, and internal Deloitte leadership.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of total IT/consulting experience, with 6\+ years dedicated to Epic EMR implementation, optimization, or support.
* Proven experience managing offshore or globally distributed teams on Epic engagements, including cross\-time\-zone delivery models.
* Hands\-on depth in at least one major Epic application area (Ambulatory, Inpatient, ClinDoc, Cadence/Prelude, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Radiant, HIM, or Tapestry/Payer), with working knowledge of adjacent modules.
* Active or recent Epic certification(s) in a relevant module (certification lapses acceptable if recency and/or depth are demonstrated).
* Experience across the full ITSM delivery activities: Incidents, SRs, changes, tasks and projects/enhancements with associated build, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover planning, go\-live support, and post\-live stabilization activities
* Strong people leadership — staffing, performance reviews, coaching, and building bench strength in an offshore delivery center.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to onshore client and Deloitte leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Health Informatics, Life Sciences, or related); Master's preferred.
* Flexibility to work overlapping hours with US client teams as needed.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience at a Big 4 or major healthcare IT consulting firm.
* Multiple Epic certifications or other EMR experience
* Exposure to Epic upgrades (e.g., version migrations), or multi\-hospital rollouts.
* Familiarity with adjacent healthcare IT domains: HL7/FHIR interoperability, revenue cycle, clinical informatics, or population health.
* Experience with Agile/hybrid delivery methodologies and tools (JIRA, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps).
* Prior role in building or scaling an offshore/GDC healthcare IT practice.

title: Chief Administrative Officer
description:
🚨 WE ARE HIRING \| CHIEF ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER (CAO)
 



  





**Meenakshi Sundararajan Group of Institutions (MSGI)** 




 📍 Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



  





 Meenakshi Sundararajan Group of Institutions (MSGI) is looking for an experienced and dynamic \*Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)\* to lead the overall administrative and operational functions of our Kodambakkam campus.
 



  





 The CAO will play a key leadership role in ensuring
 **efficient campus operations, infrastructure management, safety, security, facilities, procurement, vendor management and administrative governance.** 




  





 🔹 POSITION
 



  





 \*Designation:\* Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)
 



 \*Location:\* Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



 \*Department:\* Administration
 



 \*Reporting To:\* Secretary / Management
 



 \*Employment Type:\* Full\-time
 



 \*Experience:\* 15\+ years in senior administration / institutional operations / facilities management
 



  





  🎯 ROLE PURPOSE
 



  





 The CAO will be responsible for the overall administrative and operational excellence of the MSGI campus.
 



  





 The role requires a hands\-on leader who can translate Management decisions into effective execution, establish strong systems and SOPs, lead administrative teams, ensure campus readiness and maintain high standards of
 **safety, discipline, service quality and operational efficiency** 
 .
 



  





  🔹 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





  1\. Institutional Administration
 



  





 \* Lead the overall administrative operations of the campus.
 



 \* Develop and implement administrative policies, SOPs, systems and processes.
 



 \* Ensure timely execution of Management decisions and institutional requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate effectively with the Principal, COO, HODs and functional heads.
 



 \* Monitor administrative performance and resolve operational challenges.
 



  





  2\. Infrastructure \& Facilities
 



  





 \* Oversee campus infrastructure, buildings, classrooms, laboratories and common facilities.
 



 \* Manage civil, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, DG, lift, water and other facility\-related services.
 



 \* Establish preventive maintenance systems and ensure timely breakdown resolution.
 



 \* Monitor renovation, refurbishment and infrastructure projects.
 



  





  3\. Safety \& Security
 



  





 \* Lead campus safety, security and emergency preparedness initiatives.
 



 \* Supervise security operations, access control, CCTV and visitor management.
 



 \* Monitor fire, electrical, building and workplace safety.
 



 \* Conduct regular campus inspections and ensure closure of safety observations.
 



 \* Develop and periodically review emergency response procedures.
 



  





  4\. Housekeeping \& Campus Services
 



  





 \* Oversee housekeeping, cleanliness, hygiene and campus presentation.
 



 \* Monitor manpower deployment, attendance, discipline and service standards.
 



 \* Establish inspection checklists and service\-level standards.
 



 \* Ensure timely resolution of cleanliness and facility\-related complaints.
 



  





  5\. Procurement \& Vendor Management
 



  





 \* Oversee administrative procurement and vendor coordination.
 



 \* Review quotations, comparative statements, purchase requirements and service contracts.
 



 \* Develop and manage an approved vendor network.
 



 \* Monitor vendor performance, AMC contracts, service quality and timelines.
 



 \* Support cost\-effective and transparent procurement.
 



  





  6\. Budget \& Cost Control
 



  





 \* Prepare and monitor the annual administrative budget.
 



 \* Track infrastructure, maintenance, security, housekeeping and procurement expenditure.
 



 \* Identify opportunities for cost optimization.
 



 \* Ensure effective utilization of institutional resources.
 



  





  7\. Asset \& Inventory Management
 



  





 \* Maintain effective systems for asset and inventory management.
 



 \* Ensure periodic physical verification and proper documentation.
 



 \* Monitor utilization, movement, maintenance and replacement of institutional assets.
 



  





  8\. Team Leadership
 



  





 \* Lead administrative, maintenance, security, housekeeping and support teams.
 



 \* Establish clear responsibilities, accountability and performance standards.
 



 \* Conduct periodic performance reviews and support team development.
 



 \* Coordinate with HR on manpower, discipline, attendance and employee\-related matters.
 



  





 9\. MIS \& Management Reporting
 



  





 \* Prepare and present periodic Administrative MIS to Management.
 



 \* Track maintenance, safety, procurement, vendors, manpower, expenditure and pending activities.
 



 \* Maintain action trackers for Management instructions.
 



 \* Escalate critical issues and delays with appropriate recommendations.
 



  





 10\. Institutional Events \& Special Projects
 



  





 \* Provide administrative and logistical support for admissions, examinations, events, conferences, inspections and institutional programmes.
 



 \* Coordinate campus readiness, security, facilities, housekeeping and logistics.
 



 \* Undertake special projects and responsibilities assigned by Management.
 



  





 🎓 QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \*Essential:\*
 



  





 \* Graduate / Postgraduate degree in Administration, Management, Engineering, Law or a related discipline.
 



 \* \*15\+ years of relevant experience\*, with significant experience in a senior administrative / operations leadership role.
 



 \* Strong experience in infrastructure, facilities, maintenance, safety, security, procurement and vendor management.
 



 \* Experience managing multiple administrative and support\-service teams.
 



  





 \*Preferred:\*
 



  





 \* Experience in an educational institution, university, hospital, corporate campus or large organization.
 



 \* MBA / PG qualification in Management or a related field.
 



 \* Strong exposure to budgeting, MIS, SOP development and process improvement.
 



 \* Experience with ERP / digital administrative systems.
 



  





  KEY SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES
 



  





 \* Strategic \& Operational Administration
 



 \* Campus \& Facilities Management
 



 \* Infrastructure \& Maintenance
 



 \* Safety \& Risk Management
 



 \* Security Management
 



 \* Procurement \& Vendor Management
 



 \* Budget \& Cost Control
 



 \* Team Leadership
 



 \* Crisis \& Emergency Management
 



 \* Stakeholder Management
 



 \* Negotiation \& Decision Making
 



 \* MIS \& Reporting
 



 \* SOP \& Process Development
 



 \* Problem Solving
 



 \* Strong Execution \& Follow\-through
 



  





  📊 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
 



  





 The CAO will be evaluated on:
 



  





 \* Operational efficiency of the campus
 



 \* Infrastructure and maintenance performance
 



 \* Safety and security standards
 



 \* Housekeeping and campus service quality
 



 \* Procurement efficiency and vendor performance
 



 \* Budget adherence and cost optimization
 



 \* Administrative team productivity
 



 \* Asset and inventory control
 



 \* Timeliness and accuracy of MIS
 



 \* Execution of Management instructions
 



 \* Timely closure of administrative issues
 



  





 👤 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



  





 We are looking for a \*mature, proactive and hands\-on administrative leader\* who can independently manage a large institutional environment, anticipate operational requirements, solve problems quickly and build systems that improve efficiency.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, communication, negotiation, decision\-making and execution skills, along with the ability to work closely with senior Management and academic leadership.
 



  





 📩 INTERESTED CANDIDATES
 



  





 Candidates with relevant experience and a strong background in institutional administration / campus operations / facilities management are invited to apply.
 



  





 Location: Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



 Position: Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)
 



  




* Join MSGI and contribute to building a professionally managed, safe, efficient and future\-ready institutional campus.

**Job Description Summary:**

This role is responsible for strategizing, implementing, and governing the effectiveness of new hire, lateral, and leadership training across Provider verticals, ensuring that business needs, client SLAs, compliance standards, and employee development goals are met. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong people management skills and domain expertise in US healthcare revenue cycle processes.

**Training Strategy \& Frameworks:** 



* Own the RCM training charter across geographies (onboarding ( New hires \& Laterals), role\-based, refresher, upskilling).

* Design and standardize SOP\-driven, competency\-based training modules across client accounts.

* Implement digital learning (LMS, simulations, eLearning) and measure training ROI.
* Create and maintain dashboards for training effectiveness, speed\-to\-proficiency, and knowledge retention.
* Ensure audit\-readiness of training documentation and process certifications.
* Support transitions, client ramp\-ups, and strategic capability\-building projects.
* Develop \& execute annual training roadmaps aligned to client SLAs and internal KPIs.
* Institutionalize “Training Need Identification (TNI)” and “Training Need Analysis (TNA)” frameworks across business units.
* Lead process maturity assessments and training diagnostics to define capability building projects.



  





**Team Management** 



* Lead and mentor a team of 2–10 trainers, content developers, and facilitators across Indian geographies.
* Conduct trainer calibration, TTT (Train\-the\-Trainer) programs, and quarterly capability reviews.
* Drive a Trainer Productivity Index (sessions held vs. business impact measured).

* Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, Rise, Camtasia, Vyond ( Any two from the list is Mandatory)

* Collaborate with SMEs and operations to build role\-specific learning paths, simulations, job aids, and explainer videos.



  





**Measurement, ROI \& Governance:** 



* Create a learning effectiveness model using Kirkpatrick’s Evaluation Levels and Phillips ROI Methodology.
* Track and publish data on: Time to Proficiency, First Pass Accuracy (FPA), Quality vs. Pre/Post Training Intervention, Attrition post\-training (30/60/90\-day window)
* Prepare for and participate in client audits, \& internal compliance assessments.



  





**Client and Business Engagement:**

title: Project SCM Manager - HVDC
description:
**The Opportunity**
 HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. The HVDC market for large scale transmission and offshore wind is booming as an enabler for the global energy transitions. All these projects are classified as very critical infrastructures and hence cyber security requirements, and standard compliance is very high. Hitachi Energy is seeking Project Managers – Supply Chain for Chennai location. This is a great opportunity to apply your passion for project management to manage million\-dollar projects!
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role, responsible for SCM (Supply Chain Management) in the Project, reporting to the Regional Supply Chain Manager while supporting the project director. If you like complex projects, business challenges, have a curious mind, and have a problem\-solving attitude, take the opportunity to join a World Technology Leader Company. Experience the great feeling from managing the SCM scope of large projects close to the end customer. We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don´t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse background is waiting for you to join.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* In this role you will be Project Manager within the HVDC SCM project and responsible for the procurement activities in our HVDC projects.
* You will be part of the HVDC Project Core team for the projects you manage.
* In this role, you will coordinate across multiple global regions with engineers, controllers, project planners, logisticians, quality professionals, buyers, and suppliers to ensure that equipment is procured and delivered on time, within budget, and within standard.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all key personnel within the project, global supply chain, the HVDC organization, and the client are aware of any risks and opportunities within project supply chain.
* During the project execution Project SCM need to ensure relentless execution with proactive planning and follow\-up all equipment delivers with our suppliers and internal stakeholders. Project SCM to solve upcoming quality constraints or deficiencies with the supplier equipment deliveries.
* Contribute to vendor list management by providing Supplier Performance data. Ensure that our suppliers comply with the laws, regulations, standards, certificates and directives that Hitachi Energy requires from their suppliers.
* You will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering with preferably 12\+ years relevant work experience and master's in business administration is added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage the supply chain management needs of multi\-million dollar projects.
* Strong organizational and planning skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proactively address business demands in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to prioritize and allocate resources to align with department and company goals.
* Preferred CPSM or PMP certifications, Lean Six Sigma, SAP Experience, Documentation Management Systems, Power BI and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to create strong working relationships.

title: Stores Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sevalaya is a registered charitable trust established in 1988, serving communities across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Telangana. Over 1 million people have benefited from Sevalaya’s work in education, healthcare, rural development, and welfare. The organization is professionally managed and guided by a committed Board of Trustees with diverse professional backgrounds and a shared passion for social development. Sevalaya operates with the philosophy of “Love All Serve All,” offering opportunities for team members to contribute meaningfully to social change. Interested individuals can learn more about Sevalaya’s initiatives through its presence on major social media platforms.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Stores Manager role based in Tiruvallur. The Stores Manager will oversee day\-to\-day store operations, including inventory management, stock receipt and issuance, and maintenance of accurate records and documentation. The role involves coordinating with procurement and program teams to ensure timely availability of materials, monitoring stock levels, and implementing controls to prevent losses and pilferage. The Stores Manager will be responsible for maintaining a clean, organized, and safe store environment, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures. The role also includes supervising store staff, supporting audits, and contributing to process improvements that enhance efficiency and support Sevalaya’s service\-focused mission.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Store Management skills, including inventory control, stock handling, and basic documentation.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills to support internal stakeholders and ensure timely, accurate material support for projects.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for coordinating with procurement, program teams, and auditors.
* Candidates should possess Retail Loss Prevention skills, including implementing checks to minimize shrinkage and ensure asset protection.
* Relevant experience in store or warehouse management, preferably in nonprofit, educational, healthcare, or rural development settings.
* Ability to use basic computer applications (e.g., spreadsheets, inventory software) and maintain clear, organized records.
* Strong attention to detail, integrity, and reliability in handling materials and documentation.
* Minimum of a diploma or bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain, commerce, or a related field is preferred.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.

title: Data Acquisition and Reconciliation Operations, Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

In this role, you will work with State Street teams from around the globe to lead Reconciliation team supporting State street Middle Office and back office services. You will have responsibility to oversee and deliver all day\-to\-day deliverables of the Reconciliation management team in a fast\-paced, flexible and exciting environment. The role will need to initiate and develop good communication and interpersonal relationship with business operations teams and IT and to maintain the high level of service that is currently being provided to all the clients.


**Why this role is important to us**

This is a varied operational and managerial position with a senior level of responsibility within the Reconciliation team. This Reconciliation Officer/Assistant Vice President acts as a Primary contact point for all internal/external clients. The team is responsible performing Cash, Position and Non\-Core reconciliation and support various functional teams to resolve the exception within SLA. The candidate should be a hands on manager who is required to ensure the teams under their responsibility undertake delivery to both internal and external clients, ensure timely response to client initiated queries, and escalation of any unresolve matters to manager for best resolution.


**What you will be responsible for**

* Oversee and provide day to day management of Reconciliation Management team for responsible Reconciliation unit/client
* Drive Reconciliation process excellence though proactive management of the exception lifecycle
* Responsible for service delivery and client sentiment, including direct client contact
* Support a strong risk management and control environment
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations.
* Conduct high\-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work\-processing issues, make suggestions to streamline operations and implement.
* Liaise with colleagues in region or divisions globally where required for client issue resolution
* Perform an review function of Reconciliation process to identifying operational trends, issues and areas for improvement.
* Perform work independently within scope of established guidelines and according to specific procedures.
* Support and proactive manage on Client Change Request items impacting the Enterprise processes and Operating Models
* Communicate effectively on issues / problems to the Client and to SSC management and ensure a proper and timely follow\-up to ensure resolution.
* Provide guidance, support and development opportunities to the members of your team
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to analyze on the spot.

**What we value**

* Extensive asset management experience, including investment operations, reconciliations and fund accounting.
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of the asset management industry, gained through working in a variety of asset management disciplines.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Hands\-on experience with reconciliation tools like TLP/IntelliMatch and proficiency in manual reconciliation processes.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to audiences of different sizes and levels of seniority
* Must be self\-motivated, adaptable and show initiative in different circumstances and under pressure
* Good team working skills.
* Flexibility in working outside of your responsibilities and areas of expertise.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications:**

* Degree in finance, business, technology or equivalent with 15\+ yrs. of relevant industry experience
* Proven experience in client communication and interaction at all levels
* In depth understanding of Middle or Back Office operations, end\-to\-end processes of Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, ETFs, and other investment vehicles. Should be proficient in multiple asset classes including derivatives, bank loans, fixed income, OTC products, etc., and have a deep understanding of their life cycles.
* Understanding of key technology within the support of investment management operations, TLM/TLP and Intellimatch.
* Experience of driving organizational change, with an understanding of change management principles, techniques \& tools.
* Experience in leveraging technology solutions including low\-code tools, SQL, Python or similar is advantageous
* Strong MS Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint skills necessary

**Additional requirements :** Working from office 4 days a week

Join us in shaping the future.

The platform processes over 2\.2 million Purchase Orders per year and targets a 75–85% fully\-automated (touchless) rate. The team handles every document the AI cannot process autonomously.

**\& Performance Management — 70%**
* Directly supervise 15\-20 Document Review Specialists; own rostering across rotational shifts, attendance tracking, and queue capacity planning against daily document volume
* Manage operations SLA – TAT, Quality, along with people metrics
* Own day\-to\-day operations management: shift rosters and week\-offs, leave planning, planned \& unplanned shrinkage, absenteeism control, and real\-time reallocation of staffing to protect SLAs \& operations performance metrics
* Set and communicate daily, weekly, and monthly throughput, AHT, and accuracy targets; monitor individual and team performance against SLA and productivity standards
* Participate in and present at weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (WBR / MBR / QBR) — performance against KPIs, root\-cause analysis of misses, and committed corrective actions
* Own the full performance cycle for direct reports, including goal setting, mid\-year and annual appraisals, with documented performance ratings, development plans, and calibration against peer supervisors
* Conduct weekly 1:1s and team calibration sessions; coach on accuracy, field interpretation, and escalation judgment
* Manage performance improvement plans for specialists not meeting accuracy, AHT, or throughput standards; drive engagement and retention to control attrition
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members; maintain a bench and cross\-skilling plan to cover leave and attrition
* Proactively escalate capacity gaps and SLA risk to GHX US management before they impact queue throughput


**Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement— 20%**
* Identify patterns in AI extraction errors that indicate model weaknesses (e.g., systematic misread of specific templates); surface findings as structured product feedback to GHX Engineering
* Develop and maintain team SOPs, job aids, audit checklists, and the GHX field\-standards reference guide
* Recommend tool and process improvements to reduce per\-document review time (AHT) and improving accuracy
* Contribute to the ADM continuous improvement cycle by translating on\-the\-ground operational insight into prioritized product feedback
* Own team field accuracy at or above 99% for mandatory (Tier 1\) fields; track and report accuracy, throughput, and SLA attainment in a weekly dashboard
* Conduct periodical audits of each team member's work on a defined cadence (daily sampling, weekly per\-specialist audit, and monthly deep\-dive) with documented findings, scores, and feedback logged per specialist
* Conduct structured quality audits — sampled review of completed documents across team members — to detect systematic errors and training gaps
* Run audit\-driven coaching loops: convert audit findings into individual feedback, refresher training, and re\-audit to confirm the correction held
* Maintain and execute the escalation protocol for documents that cannot be resolved by specialists (damaged images, ambiguous formatting, novel document types)
* Own the error log: categorize error types, track frequency and trend, deliver structured feedback to GHX Engineering as actionable product input


**Cross\-Functional Coordination — 10%**
* Serve as the primary GHXI point of contact for GHX US Product and Engineering on Document Queue status, error patterns, and team capacity
* Participate in ADM platform update reviews; translate tool changes into updated team procedures and retraining plans before each release
* Deliver clear, data\-backed written status updates to US stakeholders; communicate GHX US expectations and standards to the Hyderabad team
* Coordinate with GHXI local management on workspace, IT, HR, compliance, rostering, transport, and facilities matters


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS OWNED BY THIS ROLE**
 The Supervisor Is Accountable For The Standard Operational KPI Set Of a Production Contact\-center / Transaction\-processing Environment, Reported In The Weekly Dashboard And Reviewed In WBR, And MBR, Forums
   

  

* Productivity \& throughput: documents processed per specialist per hour, daily/weekly volume completed
* AHT (Average Handling Time) and average review time per document type
* SLA / TAT attainment: % of documents completed within committed turnaround; queue aging and backlog carried over
* Service level and queue wait for real\-time\-facing work; abandonment rate where applicable
* Quality: field\-level accuracy (Tier 1 ≥ 99%), audit score per specialist, critical vs. non\-critical error rate, rework %, first\-pass yield, FCR (First Contact / First Pass Resolution)
* Occupancy and utilization; schedule adherence and conformance
* Shrinkage — planned (leave, training, meetings, breaks) and unplanned (unscheduled absence, late logins, system downtime)
* Absenteeism — planned and unplanned — and attrition (voluntary, involuntary, and early\-life attrition)
* Forecast vs. actual volume accuracy and staffing variance (required vs. rostered vs. actual)
* Escalation rate, reopen rate, and aging of escalated or exception items
* Customer\-impacting measures: CSAT / internal stakeholder satisfaction, NPS where measured, and downstream EDI failure or defect leakage rate
* Cost per transaction and productivity per FTE against the operating plan
* Training and certification: nesting graduation rate, time\-to\-proficiency for new hires, cross\-skilling coverage %


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification in Operations, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* Minimum 6 years of total experience in BPO, KPO, shared services in a document processing operations
* Minimum 2 years in a confirmed Supervisory or Team lead role with accountability for 10 or more staff
* Demonstrated understanding \& ownership of core operational KPIs — SLA, AHT, quality/accuracy, shrinkage, absenteeism, and attrition — in a production environment
* Experience running periodical quality audits and sample\-based audit methodologies, with documented feedback and coaching loops
* Experience in owning the people\-management cycle: rostering, leave and shrinkage planning, mid\-year and annual appraisals, and performance improvement plans
* Experience in preparing for and presenting in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews
* Strong business English — written and verbal — for regular written and video communication with stakeholders
* Comfortable building and presenting weekly operational reports (throughput, AHT, accuracy trend, error categories) in Excel or Google Sheets
* Demonstrated ability to write clear SOPs, job aids, and team process guides from scratch
* Willing and able to work rotational shifts, including US Mountain Time night rotations, on\-site 5 days per week


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to AI\-augmented operations: annotation platforms, RLHF review queues, AI quality assurance, or document intelligence tools
* Experience coordinating with US\-based counterparts across time zones on a regular basis
* Background in procurement or supply chain document processing (Purchase Orders, invoices, order acknowledgements)
* Understanding of how AI confidence scoring works and the relationship between human corrections and model retraining
* Workforce management exposure — forecasting, capacity planning, and roster optimisation experience
* Six Sigma, Lean, or equivalent process improvement certification
* Greenfield experience — prior role that required standing up a new team or operations function with minimal existing infrastructure


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
**Location:** 
 GHX India (GHXI) office, Hyderabad, Telangana — on\-site, 5 days per week;
 ***no remote or hybrid option***
**Shift:** 
 Rotational shifts on a 24x7 roster, including night rotations aligned to US Mountain Time (\~8:30 PM–4:30 AM IST (MDT) / \~9:30 PM–5:30 AM IST (MST)); week\-offs rotate with the roster
   

  

**US Coordination:** 
 Regular video calls with GHX US Engineering, Product, and Director, Automation \& Scalability (functional line)
   

  

**GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare**
 Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
   

  

 GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud\-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

title: NOC Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
 CTS is seeking a hands\-on Network Operations Center (NOC) Manager to build and operate a centralized, global 24x7 NOC based in Hyderabad, India. This role reports to the VP of Operations and is accountable for establishing the people, processes, and performance required to support more than 50 global customer programs delivering transit fare collection and payment card processing services.
   

  

 The NOC Manager will lead a team of approximately 40–60 Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC analysts operating around the clock, with defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional field services teams. The role requires prior experience building or significantly maturing a 24x7 operations center and enforcing disciplined, repeatable operational practices aligned with ITIL 4, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS v4 operational monitoring expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This is a build\-and\-operate leadership role responsible for end\-to\-end NOC effectiveness, including:
   

  

* Build and lead a centralized Hyderabad\-based NOC organization (40–60 staff) with Tier 1 and Tier 2 roles and defined escalation to Tier 3 engineering and regional operations.
* Design and manage 24x7 shift coverage, staffing models, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Establish and operate 24x7 monitoring and event management for networks, systems, cloud services, applications, and OT/edge devices supporting transit payments.
* Implement and enforce ITIL\-aligned Incident Management, including triage, severity assignment, escalation, major incident coordination, communications, and post\-incident review.
* Ensure continuous verification of operational controls including log management, monitoring coverage, backup success, recovery testing, change control discipline, and DR readiness.
* Ensure NOC operations support PCI DSS v4 monitoring requirements and are executed in a manner consistent with ISO 27001 operational control and evidence expectations.
* Lead operational response to emergent incidents, ensuring rapid containment, service restoration, and accurate executive and stakeholder communications.
* Define and maintain runbooks, SOPs, escalation matrices, and shift handover standards.
* Establish KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadences; drive continual improvement through trend analysis and postmortems.
* Coordinate closely with Security Operations (SOC) for escalation of operational anomalies with potential security implications.


**Essential Job Duties**
* Operate a 24x7 NOC covering monitoring, performance and capacity management, incident management, logging, change coordination, backup verification, and DR readiness.
* Ensure rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of outages and degradations affecting customer\-facing payment and transit services.
* Lead major incident bridges and enforce structured communication and restoration validation.
* Ensure logging, monitoring, and telemetry failures are treated as operational risks and remediated with urgency.
* Produce and maintain incident records, reports, and operational evidence suitable for audit and compliance review.


 General Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Operate effectively under limited supervision in a high\-availability, mission\-critical environment.
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and consistency in process execution and documentation.
* Communicate effectively in English, including written incident updates and executive\-level operational summaries.
* Motivate and lead teams across multiple shifts, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
* Escalate issues appropriately while maintaining productive working relationships.
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to motivate activity to meet the needs, and adept at escalating in an effective manner that preserves relations.
* Able to reliably demonstrate ethical behavior and accurate communications even when complex factors are involved.
* Able to operate in a professional manner, even in crisis settings.
* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures


**Essential**
 Skills / Experience / Knowledge
   

  

* Proven experience building and leading a 24x7 NOC or equivalent mission\-critical operations organization.
* Strong command of monitoring \& event management and incident management, including major incident leadership.
* Experience operating hybrid environments including customer\-site data centers and Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated operational ownership of log management, backup verification, change/configuration control, and DR readiness.
* Experience working in regulated environments with strong audit and evidence requirements (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC, etc.).
* Establishes operational objectives, policies, procedures and work plans and delegates assignments to subordinates. Develops, modifies and executes company policies that affect immediate operations and may also have company\-wide effect. Accountable for department budget which may be broad and have far reaching impact on the business segment.
* Works on issues where analysis of situations or data requires conceptual thinking and an in\-depth knowledge of organizational objectives. Problems are not clearly defined and may lack strategic direction. Implements policies and selects methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Drives the strategy and success of larger projects which contribute to multiple areas of the organization.
* Interacts regularly with lower and/or senior management on matters concerning multiple functional areas, department, and/or customers. Requires the ability to persuade others in sensitive complex situations while preserving relationships. Applies knowledge to convince other stakeholders on desired departmental outcomes.

 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About The Role** 




  





 The Director, Delivery Management ensures the on\-time delivery of all published services within our Global Technical Delivery (GTD) organization. Reporting to the Head of Global Technical Delivery, Endpoint Solutions, you will build and lead a scalable organization that flexes with changing needs. Drawing on deep delivery expertise, you will partner closely with the Global Project Management organization to ensure client expectations are met, collaborate with teams across and outside Signant Health, and drive the adoption of delivery best practices throughout the organization. This is an inspirational leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, leads change through influence, and operates autonomously.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function** 




  




* Own on\-time delivery of all technical delivery commitments, applying deep expertise in enterprise solution delivery — including large\-scale, complex resource scheduling, forecasting, and risk mitigation.
* Enforce industry and regulatory best practices and consistency of standards across your pods, with deep expertise in one or more major competencies (Solution, Engineering, Testing, Delivery).
* Lead geographically dispersed teams, with direct management responsibility or indirect oversight of deliverables for two or more concurrent projects at a time.
* Manage exacting client expectations and execute resource\-management solutions that allow teams to scale in response to changing needs.
* Set and drive strategic and tactical direction using industry\-standard delivery and team\-performance metrics, continually adjusting to raise team performance.
* Represent your teams at Delivery Cross\-Portfolio Planning exercises, focusing on release coordination and critical\-path alignment, and act as decision\-maker and escalation point for resolving implementation impediments.
* Partner closely with Global Project Management, Sales, Product, and R\&D to create a closed\-loop feedback cycle of innovation.
* Coach technical teams on capability and implementation best practices, emphasizing agility to improve quality, productivity, and efficiency.
* Implement financially sound resource\-utilization solutions indexed on low\-cost operations and a progressive skills\-management framework.
* Influence direction and decisions without reliance on hierarchy, executing courageously and fostering a culture of agility, growth, and accountability through transparent leadership.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes** 




  





**Essential:** 



* Twelve or more years of combined, progressive experience in enterprise solution delivery, software engineering, and/or solution architecture — preferably including consulting services delivery.
* Eight or more years of progressive, global departmental and personnel management experience within engineering and delivery organizations of 25 or more reports.
* Experience in significant practice\-building and/or organizational\-redesign efforts, preferably including successful agile delivery transformations in high\-pressure environments.

title: Associate Manager / Manager - Collections
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
 Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.
   

  

 Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
   

  

 Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

**Overview**
 As a Collections Manager, you will be instrumental in managing and optimizing the collections process for our organization. This role requires a professional with deep domain knowledge, team leadership capabilities, and a proactive approach toward process optimization and stakeholder alignment. The candidate will play a critical role in driving
 **cash flow improvement, reducing DSO** 
 , and
 **minimizing bad debt** 
 while ensuring a culture of
 **accountability, transparency, and customer\-centricity** 
 within the team. Your primary responsibility will be to lead a group of Team Leads to effectively manage our outstanding accounts receivable. You will collaborate with various stakeholders, including Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams, to ensure that the collections function aligns with the company's financial goals and objectives. You will be called on to demonstrate your leadership skills, contribute to our financial success, and ensure the stability of our accounts receivable.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Pre\-requisites:**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Collections Manager or in a similar leadership role within a large organization, preferably in a multinational environment.
* 12\+ years of total experience with at least 5 years in leading collections teams in a shared services or multinational environment.
* Hands\-on experience in managing large portfolios / teams
* In\-depth understanding of end\-to\-end collections processes, credit risk assessment, dispute management, and customer account reconciliation.
* Familiarity with O2C cycle and its integration with upstream/downstream finance processes (invoicing, cash apps, billing, customer master data).
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and develop actionable insights.
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills to interact with internal stakeholders and key customers.
* Demonstrated success in building and leading high\-performing, customer\-focused teams.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and retain talent, with a focus on performance metrics and engagement.
* Proficiency in using collection tools, software, and financial systems.
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills to deal with customers, sales teams, and senior finance leaders.
* Conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills in a cross\-functional setup.
* Problem\-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations.
* Data\-driven approach to collections strategy and decision\-making.
* Experience in root cause analysis, aging trend analysis, and defining collection effectiveness KPIs.


**Responsibilities/Expectations From The Role**
* Oversee and manage a group of Team Leads, providing leadership, guidance, and support to ensure efficiency and effectiveness in the collections process.
* Drive and execute effective collections strategies to achieve cash collection targets, reduce DSO, and minimize aged receivables.
* Monitor collection activities, track performance metrics, and generate reports for management, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
* Collaborate with Operations, Sales, and Customer Service teams to identify and resolve disputes, billing discrepancies, and payment delays, ensuring timely resolution and maintaining positive customer relationships.
* Lead interactions with key customers, especially on escalated or high\-value accounts, with clear action planning and resolution pathways.
* Generate and present weekly/monthly dashboards on collection performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership.
* Provide insights and forecasts to support working capital and cash flow planning.
* Stay updated on industry best practices, regulations, and changes in credit reporting and collections laws to ensure compliance and make necessary adjustments to the collections process.
* Coach Team Leads to lead their teams in pursuit of continuous improvement, and to develop existing talent.
* Represent team for Business Governance meetings with on\-site. Deep understanding of the business to be able to address issues being raised by On\-site partners. Play the role of POC at GCC
* Ensure key collection strategies are being implemented and adhered to by the team. Should proactively work with leads and AMs and collate feedback on strategies and report to management.
* Identify automation and process improvement opportunities across collections workflows.
* Ensure adherence to audit, compliance, and internal control standards.


**Qualifications**
**Preferred Attributes:**
* Resilient leader with a strong bias for execution
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and matrixed environment
* Agile mindset to adapt strategies to business realities
* Strong customer orientation with commercial acumen
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement initiatives
