title: Lead Construction Manager
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
 The Lead Construction Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all construction activities related to civil, structural, and mechanical disciplines during project execution. The role ensures safe, high\-quality, and efficient delivery of construction works while achieving project objectives related to scope, schedule, cost, quality, and compliance. The position serves as the primary site leader coordinating contractors, engineers, suppliers, and stakeholders throughout construction, commissioning support, and project handover.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Construction Leadership \& Site Management**
* Lead all site construction activities across civil, structural, mechanical, piping, and utility scopes.
* Establish execution strategies, construction methodologies, and resource plans.
* Direct field teams and contractors to ensure efficient execution of work packages.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for site construction performance.


**Civil \& Structural Construction Management**
* Oversee earthworks, excavation, foundations, piling, concrete structures, buildings, roads, drainage systems, and underground utilities.
* Ensure construction activities are executed according to approved designs, specifications, and engineering standards.
* Coordinate interfaces between civil works and mechanical installation activities.


**Mechanical Construction Management**
* Lead installation of process equipment, utilities, piping systems, HVAC, tanks, pumps, and supporting infrastructure.
* Ensure proper sequencing of equipment erection, alignment, testing, and mechanical completion.
* Support commissioning and start\-up readiness activities.
* Resolve field technical issues in collaboration with engineering teams and vendors.


**Contractor \& Stakeholder Management**
* Manage EPC/EPCM contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and suppliers.
* Conduct contractor performance reviews and monitor productivity.
* Lead construction progress meetings and coordinate stakeholder alignment.
* Ensure effective communication between project management, engineering, operations, maintenance, and safety teams.


**Safety, Health \& Environmental Management**
* Promote and enforce a zero\-accident safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, and regulatory standards.
* Lead risk assessments, toolbox talks, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Drive EHS compliance throughout project execution.


**Schedule, Cost \& Risk Management**
* Monitor construction schedules, milestones, and productivity metrics.
* Identify critical path risks and develop recovery plans when required.
* Control construction budgets and manage variations, claims, and change orders.
* Support forecasting and reporting to project leadership.


**Quality Assurance \& Compliance**
* Ensure implementation of QA/QC processes, inspection plans, and testing requirements.
* Review and approve method statements, inspection records, and construction documentation.
* Drive first\-time\-right execution and minimize rework.
* Ensure statutory, regulatory, and company compliance requirements are met.


**Commissioning \& Handover**
* Coordinate mechanical completion and turnover processes.
* Ensure punch\-list closure and construction readiness for commissioning.
* Support operational acceptance, training, and project handover.
* Ensure as\-built documentation and final project records are complete.


**In this role you’ll make an impact by:**
* Delivering complex construction projects safely, on time, and within budget while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.
* Leading multidisciplinary civil and mechanical construction teams to achieve key project milestones and operational readiness.
* Driving construction excellence through proactive planning, contractor management, and risk mitigation.
* Ensuring seamless integration between civil infrastructure, mechanical systems, utilities, equipment installation, and commissioning activities.
* Creating a strong safety culture that prioritizes people, environmental sustainability, and operational integrity.
* Enabling successful project handover through disciplined execution, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration.


**To succeed:**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Professional certification in Project Management, Construction Management, or equivalent preferred.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in industrial construction, manufacturing projects, CAPEX projects, chemical/manufacturing industries.
* Proven experience managing both civil and mechanical construction activities.
* Experience in greenfield and brownfield project execution.
* Strong experience in contractor construction management and commissioning support.


**Key Competencies**
* Construction Execution Leadership
* Civil \& Structural Engineering Knowledge
* Mechanical Installation Management
* Contractor Management
* Project Planning \& Scheduling
* Cost and Risk Management
* EHS Leadership
* Quality Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Conflict Resolution and Decision Making

title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
description:
**Who We Are**



Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

#### **The Role**



Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.



As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization.



Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


#### **What You'll Do**


* Lead and manage a team of Analysts \& Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery.
* Act as a Subject matter expert \& support the team on complex document processing
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
* Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues.
* Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
* Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
* Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play\-books.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency.

#### **Who You Are**


* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2\+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back\-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw\-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem\-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R\&D
* Highly self\-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team\-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

 **Our Values**


* **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.



PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Head of Operations
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring a Head of Operations: total accountability for how every Pasban hotel actually runs.
 



  





 We operate nine boutique and experiential hotels today \- wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, and heritage properties, most of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros \- and expect to reach twenty\-five to thirty properties within the next eighteen months. The corporate office in New Delhi is deliberately lean and senior; the depth sits at unit level, where each property carries its own operating team.
 



  





 This role reports to the Founder and owns the operating result of the group. Unit General Managers and Operations Managers run their hotels; this role directs, supports and holds them to account. It is equally a desk role and a road role \- the operating picture is formed at the properties, not from a report.
 



  





 What you'll own
 



  





 \- Portfolio operations: direct every property through its General Manager or Operations Manager, set the reporting discipline (daily flash, weekly operating call, monthly review), and hold each unit to its occupancy, service, cost and compliance commitments
 



 \- P\&L and profit delivery: monthly unit P\&L reviews with GMs and Finance, gross operating profit against budget, and recovery actions you verify were executed
 



 \- Budgets, cost control and capex: annual operating budgets, manpower cost to revenue, F\&B cost, energy, contracts and repairs; capital expenditure and FF\&E prioritised against the return it produces
 



 \- Brand and operating standards: own the SOPs for every department, run scheduled audits and unannounced checks, and close the gaps so every Pasban hotel feels unmistakably like a Pasban hotel
 



 \- Guest experience and reputation: review score targets by property across Google, TripAdvisor and the OTAs, response and service recovery protocols, and feedback read for patterns rather than incidents
 



 \- Purchasing and supply chain: group procurement policy, annual rate contracts negotiated at portfolio scale, and reliable supply into remote properties
 



 \- Statutory, safety and risk: every licence current \- trade, FSSAI, bar and excise, fire, pollution, tourism and municipal \- plus safety drills, hygiene discipline, insurance and crisis protocol
 



 \- People: staffing grids by property and season, selection panels for General Managers and department heads, training calendars and succession
 



 \- Pre\-openings: the operational critical path from handover to opening, ready on the committed date and to standard from the first guest
 



 \- Owner relations: monthly performance reporting, owner meetings, and honest handling of the difficult conversations
 



  





 Who we're looking for
 



  





 \- 12\-18 years in hotel operations, including tenure as a General Manager carrying full P\&L responsibility
 



 \- Multi\-property, cluster or area experience strongly preferred
 



 \- Boutique, experiential, resort or remote\-location operating experience is more relevant here than large city\-hotel experience alone
 



 \- Degree or diploma in Hotel Management (IHM or comparable), with genuine depth in both rooms and F\&B \- not a specialist in one and a passenger in the other
 



 \- Comfortable with property management, point\-of\-sale, channel and reporting systems
 



 \- Appetite for the road: this role is expected to spend a substantial share of each month at the properties
 



  





 Why this role
 



  





 \- Direct founder access. Decisions are made in days, not through committees
 



 \- The standards, cadence and controls for a thirty\-hotel group are yours to set now
 



 \- Regional structures and a larger operating organisation follow the portfolio
 



 \- Hotels in places most people travel a long way to see, and teams worth building
 



  





 Base location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope is pan\-India, across all operating properties and pre\-opening projects. Travel is extensive.
 



  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the seniority of the role.
 



  





 Selection process: telephonic or video discussion, in\-person meeting with the Founder in New Delhi, property visit, reference checks, offer.
 



  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

****Overview****
**About the Organisation**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Common Cancer, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

****About The Program****
 The Cancer, NCD and Mental Health portfolio aims to strengthen India's response to the growing burden of non\-communicable diseases by supporting governments to design, implement and scale sustainable models of prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.
   

  

 The portfolio currently supports programs across common cancers (breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers), chronic NCDs, mental health, comprehensive primary healthcare, digital health, implementation research, market shaping and health systems strengthening. The program works closely with national and state governments, development partners, academia, professional bodies and the private sector to develop scalable models that contribute towards India's National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD).
   

  

****About The Position****
 The Associate Director provides strategic, technical and operational leadership for Jhpiego India's Cancer, control portfolio. The position is responsible for shaping the overall program strategy, developing new business opportunities, ensuring high\-quality implementation across multiple states, strengthening partnerships with governments and donors, managing large multidisciplinary teams, and driving innovation and evidence generation.

 With over 250 employees, strong growth momentum, and international ambitions, we are now looking for an
 **Application Manager** 
 to strengthen our Perfomance, Transformation and Technology Department.
   

  

**Our Four Core Values**

* Excellence: Always aiming for the highest level of quality and achievement in everything we do
* Proximity: Working as a team for greater day\-to\-day efficiency
* Sustainability: Building long\-term relationships and acting responsibly to protect the environment
* Ambition: Delivering outstanding results, staying ingenious and agile to always anticipate what's ahead


**Why We Need You**
 You will be joining a company in the midst of a significant IT transformation.
   

  

 As part of the
 **Performance, Transformation \& Technology** 
 team, you will play a central role within our business application ecosystem, primarily across the
 **Finance, Procurement, and Project Management** 
 domains.
   

  

 You will contribute to the smooth operation of the applications within your scope and participate in their evolution to improve performance and better meet user needs. Working closely with business teams, integrators, and software vendors, you will be involved in incident management, change tracking, and continuous improvement projects. You will also support users in adopting and making the most of our applications.

**Software Configuration Management for our IFS ERP and related applications:**
* Assist and advise on the use of the application systems under your responsibility
* Ensure the quality and operational performance of the solutions you manage

**Application Service Quality Management**
* Apply and enforce established standards, methods, and tools
* Keep the application landscape up to date (components, data flows, etc.)
* Ensure knowledge continuity and publish business procedures and technical notes in our knowledge base
* Broadly monitor the quality of service across technology solutions, identify gaps, and track continuous improvement initiatives


**Communication And Support**
* Act as the primary point of contact between the IT department and business users within your scope
* Prioritise and resolve Level 1 and 2 support requests on a daily basis for your applications
* Escalate requests to software vendors and/or integrators when necessary, ensuring incidents and issues are followed through to full resolution
* Serve as a key liaison with our technical infrastructure team to maintain operational readiness of solutions (security, access management, scalability, performance, etc.)

**Business Analysis**
 You will contribute to writing functional and technical specifications to evolve the configurations within our application ecosystem. A solid
 **techno\-functional understanding** 
 of our ERP ecosystem is therefore required — including reference data, application interfaces, and data exchange flows.

 You will be joining a team of
 **22 people** 
 spread across France, whose members will be delighted to welcome you and share their varied experiences and expertise.
   

  

**Lakshmi** 
 , your future manager, is the Application Programme Manager, and
 **Herizo** 
 , your future Director, is a member of the
 **Executive Committee** 
 . He holds a high level of professional standards and will actively support and recognise your contributions. Joining Mexens' Performance, Transformation and Technology Department means investing in a
 **long\-term career development plan** 
 within a department set to grow from two to around ten internal team members by 2035\.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
**Bachelor’s degree** 
 in
 **Computer Science or Information Technology. Master's would be a plus.**
**At least 3 years of hands\-on experience** 
 managing the
 **IFS ERP platform** 
 from a technical standpoint, complemented by solid functional knowledge.
   

  

 Ideally, you have worked within a
 **fast\-growing mid\-sized company** 
 or a
 **large international group** 
 of several thousand employees.
   

  

**Key Knowledge And Skills Required** 
 \- Software lifecycle management
 *(agile and/or hybrid)*
* ERP management, with specific expertise in the IFS product
* Exposure to SaaS solutions across the following domains:
* Payments and treasury management
* Tax reporting
* Document digitalisation and processing
* Similar solutions that complement an ERP through application interfaces (APIs)
* Fluent in English (Speaking and Writing): Ability to write support tickets for international stakeholders and leads meetings.
* A genuine ability to understand expressed needs and reformulate them clearly — both in writing and verbally — for diverse audiences, including Procurement and Finance teams

**Conditions**
 A competitive salary and an opportunity to work at a young, entrepreneurial, and a growing company, with plenty of room for your own initiatives and ideas.

**Mexens is waiting for you 😊**
 Apply now by sending us your CV.

title: Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating-cooling system)
description:
**Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating\-cooling system)** 




**Zehnder Group \| Represented in India by T\&A Consulting** 




**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru** 




  





**About Zehnder Group** 




 Zehnder Group is a Swiss headquartered provider of world\-leading solutions for a comfortable, energy\-efficient and healthy indoor climate. The products and services of the Group include heating, cooling, indoor ventilation and air cleaning. The Group develops and manufactures its products at its own factories in Europe, China, and North America.
 



 As part of its international growth strategy, Zehnder is now entering the Indian market and is looking to appoint Country Manager – India.
 



**More about Zehnder Group on www.zehndergroup.com** 




 Zehnder has partnered with
 **T\&A Consulting** 
 to support its India market entry and leadership hiring.
 



  





**About T\&A Consulting** 




 T\&A Consulting is a global advisory firm, with extensive experience of working with government, economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, and the Americas towards their expansion in the international markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Country Manager – India who will be responsible for building Zehnder’s business in India from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional sales role. It is a
 **market\-entry, business development and category\-building role** 
 for a senior commercial professional who can create demand for premium indoor climate solutions in India.
 



 The role requires someone who can position Zehnder as a premium ventilation, fresh\-air and indoor air quality brand in India, build specification\-led demand, develop a strong project pipeline, create the right partner ecosystem, and secure early reference projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial setup where brand awareness, channels, installer capability and market acceptance need to be built from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. India Market Entry \& Business Build\-Up** 



* Establish Zehnder’s presence in India.
* Develop and execute a practical go\-to\-market plan for India.
* Identify priority customer segments, geographies and project types.
* Build Zehnder’s visibility among architects, consultants, developers, contractors and premium project decision\-makers.
* Generate qualified project pipeline and secure early reference projects.
* Provide regular market intelligence, competitor insights and customer feedback to Zehnder’s global leadership team.



  





**2\. Ventilation, Fresh\-Air \& Indoor Climate Business Development** 



* Lead market development for Zehnder’s balanced energy recovery ventilation systems
 **(ERV/ HRV, fresh air)** 
 with focus on the residential market.
* Build demand around the need for healthy indoor air, controlled ventilation, humidity management, energy efficiency and premium indoor comfort.
* Educate the market on the difference between air purification, air\-conditioning and engineered balanced energy recovery ventilation systems.
* Position Zehnder as a premium, technically superior and performance\-led indoor climate solution provider.



  





**3\. Premium / Luxury Project Sales** 



* Identify and develop opportunities in premium and luxury building projects.
* Target relevant segments such as luxury residential developments, branded residences, HNI villas, premium apartments, wellness spaces, high\-end hospitality, international schools, healthcare and select green building projects.
* Build relationships with premium developers, architects, interior designers, consultants, villa owners, project owners and HNI\-focused ecosystem partners.
* Sell on value, performance, comfort, health, acoustics, energy efficiency and lifecycle benefit, not on price alone.



  





**4\. Specification \& Project Sales** 



* Drive specification\-led selling by engaging architects, MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, green building consultants, PMCs, developers and contractors.
* Influence projects at the design and specification stage, before tendering and commercial negotiation.
* Develop technical presentations, concept notes and project\-specific value propositions.
* Support the creation of BOQ inputs, specification language, product comparisons, technical submittals and project proposals.
* Ensure that Zehnder is positioned as a system solution, not merely a product or equipment supplier.



  





**5\. Partner Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate and develop suitable channel partners, system partners, installers, integrators and commissioning partners.
* Build a limited but high\-quality partner network capable of selling, installing and servicing premium ventilation systems.
* Train partners on Zehnder’s product value proposition, installation standards, commissioning discipline and customer experience expectations.
* Ensure that partners have the capability to support premium projects and maintain Zehnder’s brand standards.
* Develop a partner model that protects pricing, service quality, installation quality and long\-term customer satisfaction.



  





**6\. Technical Selling \& Customer Education** 



* Explain Zehnder’s solutions convincingly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate the benefits of balanced ventilation, fresh\-air supply, energy recovery, humidity control, filtration, low\-noise operation and indoor air quality.
* Conduct presentations, seminars, consultant meetings, architect discussions, CPD\-style sessions and industry engagements.
* Build awareness among the market that premium indoor climate is about air quality, comfort, health and performance \- not only cooling.



  





**7\. Brand Representation \& Executive Presence** 



* Act as the face of Zehnder in India.
* Represent the company in senior client meetings, industry forums, trade events, consultant interactions and partner discussions.
* Build credibility with Indian stakeholders while maintaining alignment with Zehnder’s European quality, brand and business standards.
* Communicate clearly with Zehnder’s global leadership team on India market realities, opportunities, challenges and progress.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation, building technology, indoor air quality, air filtration, fresh\-air systems, ERV/HRV, heat recovery, energy recovery, related technical building solutions.
* Experience in premium or specification\-led project sales is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to international companies, European brands, premium technical products or MNC environments will be an advantage.
* Experience in building a new business vertical, product category, region, partner network or market from an early stage will be highly valued.



  





**Product / Sector Exposure** 




 The ideal candidate should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* **Balanced energy recovery ventilation systems (ERV/ HRV, fresh air)**
* **Residential ventilation systems**
* Heat recovery / energy recovery
* Indoor air quality solutions
* Air filtration / clean\-air solutions
* Premium HVAC systems
* Green building / energy\-efficient building solutions



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a commercially strong, self\-driven professional with a builder mindset. The right candidate will be someone who has the maturity of working with international companies, but also the agility, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive required to build a business in a new market.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ▪ Strong business development and pipeline creation capability
 



 ▪ Ability to build markets, channels, and partnerships from the ground up
 



 ▪ Commercially sharp and opportunity\-driven
 



 ▪ Strong network in HVAC / ventilation / building technology ecosystem
 



 ▪ Good understanding of specification\-led and project\-led sales
 



 ▪ Ability to work independently with limited local infrastructure
 



 ▪ High ownership, initiative, and accountability
 



 ▪ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ▪ Comfortable working with international leadership teams
 



 ▪ Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
 



  





**Why This Role Is Exciting** 




 ▪ Opportunity to lead the India market entry for a respected European brand
 



 ▪ First commercial leadership role for Zehnder in India
 



 ▪ High ownership and visibility with global leadership
 



 ▪ Opportunity to shape market strategy, channel structure, and early business growth
 



 ▪ Ideal role for a professional who enjoys building, not just managing.

**About Us:** 




  






 We are B2B Travel Tech startup that is reshaping the way travel agents sell and deliver exceptional travel experiences worldwide. We enable travel agents to book flights, hotels \& holidays conveniently and we provide comprehensive end\-to\-end on\-ground travel services.

 • Ashish Thapliyal – Co\-founder, Technology — Ex\-CTO Cars24 \| CTO FabFurnish \| Gaadi

* **We are a team of believers.** 

 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.

 yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.

 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.

 when travel agents grow, we grow with them.

 Build and strengthen TravClan’s international DMC network so that our travel partners receive competitive rates, reliable service and strong on\-ground support. Own DMC sourcing, contracting, commercial performance and escalations end\-to\-end.
 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities\-** 




  






 • Own the MICE strategy and P\&L, including GMV, revenue, contribution margin, collections and cash\-flow targets.
 





 • Build a strong pipeline across corporates, travel partners, incentive houses, conferences, offsites and large group movements.
 





 • Lead strategic opportunities end\-to\-end—from prospecting and RFP management through solutioning, negotiation, contracting and closure.
 





 • Build and grow key accounts through senior relationships, repeat business, cross\-selling and increased share of wallet.
 





 • Build and lead the MICE sales team; define targets and drive productivity through structured pipeline and conversion reviews.
 





 • Work with Quotes, Contracting, Operations and Finance to develop competitive proposals, protect margins and ensure accurate handovers.
 





 • Maintain reliable forecasts and MIS while using market and competitor insight to identify new growth opportunities.
 




  





**What is on Offer ?** 




  




* Ownership of a strategically important growth vertical.
* Direct founder and senior\-leadership interaction.
* Autonomy to shape the team, sales strategy and go\-to\-market model.
* Competitive compensation of about 18\-35 LPA (80% fixed and 20% variable)



  





**Growth Path:** 




  




* GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
* Head \- 18\-35 LPA
* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  






 • 5\+ years of experience in MICE sales, corporate travel, events or group travel, including meaningful business leadership.
 





 • Proven ownership of substantial revenue and profitability targets.
 





 • Strong record of acquiring and growing large corporate or partner accounts.
 





 • Established relationships across the corporate and MICE ecosystem.
 





 • Experience closing large domestic and international MICE opportunities.
 





 • Strong command of RFPs, contracting, pricing, margins, payment terms and collections.
 





 • Experience building and leading a high\-performance sales team.
 




  





**You will Thrive in This Role If....** 




  






 • You enjoy hunting for new business and owning ambitious targets.
 





 • You build senior relationships while maintaining sales discipline.
 





 • You balance growth with profitability, cash flow and delivery feasibility.
 




  





**This Role May not be the Right Fit if you.** 




  






 • Your experience is primarily in MICE operations rather than sales.
 





 • You depend mainly on inbound leads or inherited accounts.
 





 • You focus on topline without understanding margins or execution risk..

description:
**About Winfra Buildtech Pvt Ltd** 




 Winfra Buildtech Pvt Ltd is a leading manufacturer of high\-quality Zincalume storage tanks, offering customized and durable storage solutions for industrial, commercial, and residential applications. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, the company delivers end\-to\-end storage solutions including manufacturing, installation, and maintenance services.
 



  





  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced and result\-driven
 **Production \& Planning Manager** 
 to oversee production operations, production planning, inventory coordination, manpower utilization, and dispatch scheduling. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring timely production execution, maintaining quality standards, optimizing resources, and improving overall operational efficiency.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, planning expertise, and experience in manufacturing operations.
 



  





  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Production Management** 



* Plan, manage, and monitor daily production activities to achieve production targets.
* Ensure smooth functioning of manufacturing operations with optimum utilization of manpower, machines, and materials.
* Monitor production schedules and ensure timely completion of orders.
* Coordinate with fabrication, assembly, dispatch, and installation teams for seamless operations.
* Ensure adherence to quality and safety standards during production activities.



**Production Planning \& Control** 



* Prepare monthly, weekly, and daily production plans based on sales orders and project requirements.
* Monitor production progress and take corrective actions to avoid delays.
* Coordinate with procurement and stores departments for timely material availability.
* Optimize production processes to improve productivity and reduce wastage.



**Inventory \& Material Management** 



* Monitor raw material consumption and stock levels.
* Coordinate with stores and procurement teams for inventory planning.
* Ensure proper control over material movement and production records.



**Quality \& Process Improvement** 



* Ensure production activities comply with quality standards and company procedures.
* Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce production costs.
* Implement SOPs and production control systems.



**Team Management** 



* Lead and supervise production staff, supervisors, and workers.
* Ensure proper manpower planning and shift management.
* Conduct regular performance monitoring and team coordination meetings.



**Reporting \& Coordination** 



* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production MIS reports.
* Coordinate with management regarding production status, delays, and operational requirements.
* Maintain proper production documentation and reporting systems.



**Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure workplace safety standards and compliance with company policies.
* Monitor machine maintenance schedules and operational safety practices.



  





  





**Qualification Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* 8–15 years of experience in Production \& Planning
* Experience in Manufacturing, Steel Fabrication, Storage Tank, EPC, or Industrial Product industry preferred



  





  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong knowledge of production planning and manufacturing operations
* Experience in fabrication and industrial production processes
* Good leadership and team management skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Proficiency in MS Excel, ERP systems, and production reporting
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Good communication and coordination skills

 Sneakinn Laundry, founded in 2020, specializes in delivering premium cleaning, protection,
 



 and restoration services for sneakers, footwear, handbags, luxury accessories, and
 



 garments. Our skilled technicians and cutting\-edge facility ensure each item receives the

 Position: Retail Store Manager

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

title: Supply Chain & Procurement Head | Drone/UAV
description:
Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head
 



 Company: AVPL International
 



 Location: Gurugram, Haryana
 



 Department: Supply Chain, Procurement \& Administration
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Experience: 10\+ Years
 



 Payroll: AVPL International
 



 Industry Preference: Drone / UAV / Aerospace / Defence / Advanced Manufacturing
 



 About AVPL International
 



 AVPL International is a technology\-driven organization operating in the Drone \& UAV ecosystem, working across drone manufacturing, technology, training, and related applications.
 



 We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head who can lead end\-to\-end supply chain, procurement, vendor management, logistics, inventory, and administration operations.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong experience in the Drone/UAV industry, sound knowledge of drone technology and components, and an established pool/network of reliable vendors and suppliers.
 



 Role Overview
 



 The Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head will be responsible for developing and managing a robust and cost\-effective supply chain for AVPL's drone\-related operations.
 



 The person will be expected to build, maintain, and leverage a strong vendor ecosystem, ensure timely availability of critical components, optimize procurement costs, and ensure smooth administrative and operational functioning.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Supply Chain \& Procurement
 



 • Lead the complete Supply Chain Management and Procurement function.
 



 • Develop and implement strategic sourcing and procurement plans.
 



 • Ensure timely procurement and availability of materials required for drone manufacturing and operations.
 



 • Manage the complete procurement cycle from requirement identification to vendor selection, negotiation, purchase, delivery, and quality coordination.
 



 • Develop alternate sourcing strategies for critical components to minimize supply\-chain risks.
 



 • Identify opportunities for cost reduction, localization, and process improvement.
 



 2\. Vendor Management \& Vendor Network
 



 • Build, develop, and maintain a strong and reliable vendor pool across India and international markets.
 



 • Leverage existing industry relationships to identify and onboard reliable suppliers quickly.
 



 • Develop vendors for drone components, electronics, mechanical parts, batteries, motors, sensors, flight controllers, frames, payloads, communication systems, and other relevant components.
 



 • Evaluate vendors based on quality, cost, capacity, lead time, reliability, and delivery performance.
 



 • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, MOQ, lead times, and commercial agreements.
 



 • Maintain a strong database of approved and alternate vendors for critical materials.
 



 • Continuously identify new suppliers and develop alternate sources to avoid dependency on single vendors.
 



 • Monitor vendor performance and take corrective action where required.
 



 3\. Drone / UAV Industry Knowledge
 



 • Possess a good understanding of the Drone/UAV ecosystem and its supply chain.
 



 • Understand the basic functionality and sourcing requirements of major drone components.
 



 • Have knowledge of components such as:
 



 o Motors \& ESCs
 



 o Flight Controllers
 



 o GPS/GNSS
 



 o Batteries \& BMS
 



 o Propellers
 



 o Frames
 



 o Sensors
 



 o Communication/Telemetry systems
 



 o Cameras \& Payloads
 



 o Electronic and mechanical components
 



 • Work closely with R\&D, Engineering and Production teams to understand BOMs, specifications, component requirements, and sourcing alternatives.
 



 • Stay updated with developments in the drone industry, component suppliers, and emerging technologies.
 



 4\. Inventory \& Logistics Management
 



 • Establish effective inventory\-control systems for critical components and finished products.
 



 • Monitor stock levels, consumption, lead times, and reorder requirements.
 



 • Minimize excess inventory, dead stock, material wastage, and stock\-outs.
 



 • Oversee warehousing, transportation, dispatch, and logistics operations.
 



 • Ensure timely movement of materials between vendors, warehouses, manufacturing units, and project locations.
 



 5\. Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • Lead overall administration and facility\-management activities.
 



 • Manage office, warehouse, manufacturing/facility infrastructure, security, housekeeping, transportation, and other administrative services.
 



 • Manage administrative vendors and service providers.
 



 • Ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of facilities and operational locations.
 



 • Monitor administrative budgets and optimize operational expenses.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal policies, safety standards, and applicable statutory requirements.
 



 6\. Team \& Stakeholder Management
 



 • Lead and develop the Supply Chain, Procurement, Stores, Logistics, and Administration teams.
 



 • Coordinate closely with R\&D, Production, Engineering, Finance, Projects, Sales, and Management.
 



 • Establish clear KPIs and performance metrics for procurement and supply\-chain teams.
 



 • Prepare and present MIS and management reports related to procurement, inventory, vendor performance, and logistics.
 



 Key Skills Required
 



 • Strategic Procurement \& Sourcing
 



 • Supply Chain Management
 



 • Strong Vendor Development
 



 • Established Vendor Network / Vendor Pool
 



 • Vendor Negotiation \& Commercial Management
 



 • Inventory \& Warehouse Management
 



 • Logistics Management
 



 • Material Planning
 



 • Cost Optimization
 



 • Vendor Performance Management
 



 • Team Leadership
 



 • Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • MIS \& Reporting
 



 • Strong stakeholder\-management and negotiation skills
 



 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 The best\-fit candidate will:
 



 • Have 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, or related functions.
 



 • Have strong hands\-on experience in the Drone/UAV industry.
 



 • Have a good understanding of drone technology, components, manufacturing, and the UAV ecosystem.
 



 • Bring an established and extensive vendor pool/network, particularly for drone components and technology products.
 



 • Have strong relationships with suppliers and the ability to quickly source critical components.
 



 • Have experience managing procurement for electronics, mechanical components, batteries, motors, sensors, and other high\-tech products.
 



 • Have experience working with manufacturing, R\&D, engineering, or technology\-driven organizations.
 



 • Demonstrate strong negotiation and cost\-optimization capabilities.
 



 • Have experience managing teams and multiple vendors simultaneously.
 



 • Be highly proactive, commercially aware, and capable of building a scalable supply\-chain ecosystem.
 



 Preferred Industry Background
 



 Priority 1: Drone / UAV / Unmanned Systems
 



 Priority 2: Aerospace / Defence / Robotics
 



 Priority 3: Electronics / EV / Automotive / Advanced Manufacturing / Engineering \& Technology
 



 Education
 



 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



 MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, or related specialization will be an added advantage.
 



 Key Hiring Priority
 


* Drone Industry Experience \+ Drone Component Knowledge \+ Strong Existing Vendor Pool/Network \+ Strategic Procurement Expertise will be the key differentiators for this position.) is preferred.

**Job Description Summary**
 The HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading all site construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Construction Management
   

  

* Support on\-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non\-conformances, and site technical queries.


 Commissioning Management
   

  

* Plan and manage pre\-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.

practising Good Agricultural Practices.

Kaze Living is KSKT's premium gourmet grocery marketplace \- bringing fresh produce, artisan bakery, clean\-

label snacks, functional beverages, wellness essentials, and curated lifestyle products to discerning Delhi NCR

households. Together, KSKT and Kaze Living are building a modern retail ecosystem that combines quality,

transparency, and convenience across online and offline channels. www.ksktagromart.com

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Retail Operations Manager to drive day\-to\-day store operations and omnichannel executionacross our retail network. Based at the Gurgaon HO, this role requires frequent travel to stores and the mother DC to ensure smooth, consistent, and efficient operations on the ground.You will own the operational and P\&L performance of stores, lead store teams, and act as the key coordination link between stores and the central DC.

**Key Responsibilities**

Retail \& Store Operations

* Own end\-to\-end store operations across the network \- opening/closing procedures, stock availability, store hygiene, and operational compliance.
* Drive standardization of SOPs across stores and ensure consistent execution on the ground.
* Conduct regular store visits/audits to identify gaps and drive corrective action.
* Troubleshoot day\-to\-day operational issues and escalate/resolve as needed.

Omnichannel Operations

* Manage omnichannel fulfilment from stores (online orders, click\-and\-collect, quick\-commerce/last\-mile integrations as applicable).
* Ensure store\-level readiness (systems, inventory accuracy, packing/dispatch processes) to support online order fulfilment.
* Work with tech/ops teams to resolve omnichannel order and inventory sync issues.

P\&L \& Business Ownership

* Own the P\&L of assigned stores \- driving revenue, controlling costs (shrinkage, wastage, manpower,utilities), and improving store profitability.
* Track and review store\-level performance metrics (sales, footfall, conversion, basket size, wastage) and drive improvement plans.
* Plan and monitor budgets for store operating expenses.

Team Handling

* Lead, mentor and manage store managers and store teams across the network.
* Drive hiring, training, performance management, and retention of store\-level staff.
* Build a strong, accountable store operations culture with clear ownership at each level.

Coordination with Mother DC

* Act as the primary coordination point between stores and the mother DC for stock replenishment, indenting, and fill\-rate management.
* Work closely with the DC team to resolve supply gaps, damages/returns, and delivery scheduling issues.
* Improve store\-DC processes to reduce stock\-outs and improve inventory turnaround.

What We Are Looking For

* 4\-6 years of experience in retail operations, store operations, or omnichannel retail, ideally in a multi\-store environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning store\-level P\&L and driving profitability.
* Strong team handling and people management experience across front\-line and supervisory staff.
* Comfort with frequent travel between HO, stores, and the DC.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and comfort operating in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment.
* Good working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets for tracking performance and inventory.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills to work across stores, DC, and HO teams.

* Manage cost and productivity. Hold fixed cost and team productivity to plan, so the region grows profitably as it scales.
* Lead the West Bengal model (East \& NE). For East \& NE, drive the 2X West Bengal play through the two Bengal Zonal Heads and make it the template other regions follow.
* Develop the market and the team. Grow the channel, the counters and the next line of leaders across the region.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **15 to 20 years** 
 from
 **Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only** 
 .
* MBA preferred across all regions.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Must have led a team of at least 60, with 3 to 4 direct reports at Zonal Head level.
* Proven regional P\&L ownership, with growth delivered on contribution margin, not tonnage alone.
* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share gain.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, and runs on data and a clear review cadence.
* For East \& NE, a strong track record in the eastern market and the ability to drive the West Bengal 2X model.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience operating under a unified national market framework.
* Experience in managing multiple regions or diverse state markets.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 As per the Industry.
 



  





**Additional Role Context** 




  





*Why this role exists* 



* The Regional VP runs a region of steel sales end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into share.
* All four regions run under one national market framework, so growth is comparable, disciplined and margin\-led rather than a set of local styles.



  





*The national market framework (one scope)* 



* Every region operates on the same three pillars, under one scope.
* Contribution margin. Growth is measured by contribution, not tonnage alone. The region is run to protect and grow margin.
* Fixed\-cost and team productivity. Output per member and return on fixed cost are managed as hard numbers, so the region scales efficiently.
* Counter share. Share of the counter, won district by district, is the true measure of market strength.
* East \& NE leads the model. West Bengal must lead the framework, targeting 2X sales growth and competitive dominance through rigorous district and counter\-level execution, with two dedicated Zonal Heads for North Bengal and South Bengal.



  





*Regional scope* 




  




* Region / Indicative states / Special mandate.
* East \& NE: West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam and the North East, Sikkim – Lead the model: West Bengal 2X, two ZHs for North and South Bengal.



  





*Measurable indices and scale of growth* 




  




* Targets are indicative and to be locked per region with the CSMO..
* Index / What it measures / Target .
* Volume growth – Regional steel tonnage – \+25 to 35% YoY (WB: 2X).
* Contribution margin – Region contribution and margin – Grow margin YoY under one framework.
* Counter share – Share of counter throughput – Top 2 or 3 in priority districts.
* Reach – Active billing counters – Rising quarter on quarter.
* Team productivity – Tonnage and contribution per member – Improve YoY, fixed cost held.
* Collections – DSO and overdue share – Within norm, overdue under 5%.

title: Market Access Manager
description:
**Department** 
 : Rare Disease \& Public Care
   

  

**Location** 
 : Kolkata
   

  

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Daglig leder til Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave
description:
Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave er en hyggelig privat institution med omkring 20 dejlige skovbørn, hvor der er masser af hjertevarme, glæde og fællesskab.
   

  

 Institutionen blev grundlagt i 1970 og har i dag base i Stenløse Egedal Kommune. Hver dag, året rundt kører vi på eventyr i skov og ved strand i vores trofaste bus ”Rumle”. Vi bruger alt vores tid ude, og vores mål er at lære børnene at færdes i naturen, vise dem hvor givende naturen er, med bl.a. læring om respekt for dyr og plantelivet.
   

  

 Nærvær og indlevelse, glæde og latter er det centrale omdrejningspunkt i vores hverdag. Vi sætter en ære i at alle har haft en god dag, når de går hjem.
   

  

 Du vil blive leder for en dynamisk og engageret personalegruppe med hver deres kompetencer, som har et tæt samarbejde – både blandt hinanden, men også med forældregruppen og bestyrelsen. Vores værdier og menneskesyn udspringer af anerkendelse og respekt over for hinanden – store som små, og at møde barnet der hvor det er, og bidrage til selvværd og selvudvikling hos det enkelte barn. Vi bruger alle rammerne i naturen til at skabe læring, sjov og glæde. Vi har særlig fokus på leg, bevægelse, kreativitet og sociale fællesskaber samt børneyoga og mindfulness.
   

  

 Personaleledelse, administration og samarbejde
   

  

 Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave består af en personalegruppe på 4 personer og mellem 20 og 30 skønne skovbørn. Du skal have overblik, være struktureret og god til at samarbejde. Jobbet indebærer en række administrative opgaver, herunder budgetansvar, ugeplanlægning, ventelistehåndtering, opfølgning, personale\- og forældresamtaler, svare henvendelser på mail og telefon mv. Økonomi og administration vil foregå i tæt dialog med bestyrelsen og Landsorganisationen Danske Daginstitutioner – LDD som vi er medlem af.
   

  

 Arbejdet vil være fordelt således, at der i gennemsnit er 2 faste dage om ugen til kontor og de resterende dage er du med i skoven.
   

  

 Profil
   

  

* Du er uddannet pædagog og har gerne erfaring ledelse fra tidligere job.
* Du skal kunne lide at færdes i naturen og har flair for udelivet.
* Du har økonomisk overblik, arbejder struktureret og har it\-forståelser.
* Du skal kunne bevæge dig i krydsfeltet mellem at være på børn og være leder.
* Du besidder empati og kan skabe tryghed og omsorg for det enkelte barn og gruppen som helhed.
* Du kan udvise ansvarlighed overfor børnehavens værdier og koncept.
* Du kan samarbejde med åben dialog, forståelse og tydelig kommunikation.
* Du kan inspirere og er god til sparring og opbygge et positivt samarbejdsklima.


 Vi søger dig, som har lyst til at indgå i et spændende og givende job, hvor du vil få stor indflydelse på, at vores børn får den bedste start på livet ved at gå i en skovbørnehave.
   

  

 Stillingen er på 37 timer og til besættelse snarest muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Frist for ansøgning er 14\. oktober 2026\.
   

  

 Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, kan du ringe til vores formand Cecilie Wium\-Tellefsen på 28 15 95 13\.
   

  

 Din ansøgning sendes til formand@skovboernehave.dk, og du bedes vedhæfte CV, uddannelsespapirer, kursusbeviser, udtalelser, referencer og/eller andre relevante papirer.
   

  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

title: Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics
description:
**About Company**
 Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e\-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers \& All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.
   

  

 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
   

  

 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
   

  

**Website:** 
 https://groupbayport.com/about\-us/
   

  

**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
   

  

**Designation:** 
**Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics**
**Location: Gandhinagar**
**About The Role**
 This role owns end\-to\-end execution of Bayport's outbound and inbound logistics operation — from raw material import through SEZ export compliance, carrier management, international transit, and final delivery with proof of delivery — while also owning full financial control of the freight and 3PL spend that flows through the department. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has run high\-volume international parcel/express operations before and can bring immediate rigor, carrier relationships, and operational and financial discipline to a fast\-scaling, compliance\-intensive environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* International Carrier \& Freight Management: Own the relationship and performance of FedEx, UPS, Emirates and other carrier partners — rate negotiation, annual contracts, service\-level management, escalation handling, and carrier score carding across air, sea, and surface.
* Inbound \& Outbound Logistics: Own inbound raw material import logistics with a focus on cost and lead\-time reduction, alongside full ownership of outbound sea and air shipments across B2B, B2C, and marketplace channels.
* SEZ \& Trade Compliance: Ensure disciplined, audit\-ready execution of shipping bill filing, customs documentation, and SEZ regulatory requirements, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and Importer of Record (IOR) procedures across key markets (US, Canada, UK, Australia, EU, China).
* 3PL Vendor Bill Audit \& Financial Control: Own the checking and audit of all 3PL/carrier vendor bills against contracted rates and actual service delivered and drive timely payment and reconciliation in coordination with Finance and the vendor — this is a named, direct accountability of this role, not a shared or informal responsibility.
* End\-to\-End Operational Ownership: Drive the full flow from production handover through packing, carrier dispatch, in\-transit visibility, destination customs, last\-mile delivery, and signed proof of delivery (POD).
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Logistics Manager and the wider team covering domestic/non SEZ vendor operations, SEZ compliance, night operations, MIS/sea freight/refund \& reship, and Atlanta linked shipping — building capability and accountability at every level.
* Performance \& MIS Reporting: Own a KPI\-driven daily/weekly/monthly MIS reporting cadence — cycle time by stage, on\-time pickup/delivery, freight cost, exception and lost\-shipment tracking, and POD closure — with full visibility to the Head of Supply Chain \& Logistics.
* Cost \& Network Optimization: Continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost per shipment, improve carrier mix, and eliminate avoidable delays or rework across the network.
* Business Expansion \& Vendor Development: Identify and onboard logistics partners in new geographies as Bayport's brands expand into new international markets.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with Production Planning, Material Planning, and Vendor Management to tighten the handover from production to logistics and resolve root\-cause issues jointly rather than in isolation.
* Exception \& Escalation Ownership: Personally own resolution of high\-impact exceptions — customs hold, lost shipments, delivery disputes — ensuring timely closure and clear communication.
* Marketplace Logistics: Build the roadmap and business case for bringing marketplace last mile fulfilment in\-house


**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**
* A fully visible, stage\-wise logistics dashboard covering the complete order lifecycle — inbound through final delivery, not just packing\-to\-carrier\-handover
* A clean, current, reconciled 3PL vendor billing process with no payment disputes or aged discrepancies with Finance
* Measurable improvement in on\-time pickup and on\-time delivery percentages across all three carriers
* A formalized, audit\-ready SEZ and customs compliance process with clear ownership and turnaround times
* A functioning POD/exception closure process with defined liability and resolution timelines
* A stable, accountable, well\-led Logistics team operating on clear KPIs and a regular performance cadence


**Required Experience**
* 10–15 years in international logistics/parcel\-express operations, with substantial experience managing outbound and inbound volume through global carriers
* Prior experience with FedEx, DHL, UPS, or a comparable global express/parcel carrier is strongly preferred — this significantly shortens the learning curve for Bayport's carrier\-heavy, SLA\-driven model
* Demonstrated experience with export/import compliance, customs documentation, duties/tariffs, and ideally SEZ or bonded\-warehouse environments
* Direct experience auditing 3PL/carrier invoices and managing reconciliation with Finance
* Track record of leading and developing operational teams of meaningful size, with a hands\-on, floor present leadership style
* Experience building or owning KPI dashboards and driving performance through data, not just tenure or relationships


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree or equivalent is a plus
* Six Sigma / Lean or equivalent process\-improvement certification is an advantage


**Key Competencies**
* Operational and financial rigor under time\-sensitive, SLA\-driven conditions
* Strong carrier and vendor negotiation skills, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and IOR procedures across key international markets
* Direct, transparent communication style with the ability to hold a team accountable while developing them
* Proficient in logistics software, MS Office Suite, and ERP systems
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-scaling, still\-formalizing process environment — able to build structure, not just follow it
