title: Plant Head
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Plant Head will be responsible for the overall leadership, management, and operational performance of the manufacturing facilities of Vidya Wires Limited and ALCU Industries Limited. The role encompasses end\-to\-end responsibility for production, quality, maintenance, supply chain coordination, cost optimization, safety, compliance, people management, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure achievement of business objectives.
 



 The incumbent shall drive operational excellence by maximizing productivity, ensuring customer satisfaction, maintaining statutory compliance, and fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and innovation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Business Planning** 



* Develop and implement plant strategies aligned with the organization's business objectives.
* Prepare annual operating plans, budgets, capacity plans, and production forecasts.
* Drive business growth through process optimization, productivity enhancement, and cost reduction initiatives.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to achieve operational targets.
* Support expansion projects, new product development, and technology upgradation initiatives.



**2\. Production \& Operations Management** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end manufacturing operations across all units.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Optimize machine utilization, manpower productivity, and resource allocation.
* Minimize downtime, rejection, rework, and process losses.
* Ensure effective implementation of production planning and control systems.
* Coordinate with the sales, procurement, stores, and logistics teams for seamless operations.



**3\. Quality Management** 



* Ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal quality standards, and applicable industry requirements.
* Drive quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects and customer complaints.
* Monitor process capability and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Lead internal and external quality audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems such as International Organization for Standardization standards and customer\-specific requirements.



**4\. Maintenance \& Engineering** 



* Ensure preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of all plant equipment and utilities.
* Improve equipment reliability, availability, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Lead capital expenditure projects, plant modifications, and equipment installations.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of utilities including power, compressed air, water, and other critical services.
* Drive energy conservation and asset lifecycle management initiatives.



**5\. Supply Chain \& Inventory Management** 



* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials and consumables.
* Optimize inventory levels and reduce carrying costs.
* Monitor material consumption, yield, and wastage.
* Ensure effective warehouse management and dispatch planning.



**6\. Cost Management \& Profitability** 



* Prepare and manage plant operating budgets.
* Monitor manufacturing costs and implement cost\-control measures.
* Identify opportunities for waste elimination and process improvement.
* Improve overall plant profitability through operational efficiencies.
* Drive value engineering and lean manufacturing initiatives.



**7\. Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)** 



* Ensure strict compliance with all safety, health, and environmental regulations.
* Promote a zero\-accident culture across all manufacturing facilities.
* Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and emergency preparedness drills.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental norms and pollution control requirements.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.



**8\. Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws, factory regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Liaise with government authorities, auditors, customers, and certification agencies.
* Ensure compliance under the provisions of the applicable laws including:

title: Fabrication & Production supervisor
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Production Supervisor leads day\-to\-day operations within the fabrication shop and final packaging area, ensuring safe, efficient, high\-quality production that meets customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for supervising shop\-floor personnel, coordinating production activities across work centers, managing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement through Lean and operational\-excellence practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise fabrication shop and final packaging operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and on\-time delivery targets.
* Plan, prioritize, and schedule production activities across multiple work centers based on workload, capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Assign daily work to shop employees according to skill level, certifications, workload, and production priorities.
* Maintain and regularly update the shop\-floor skill matrix; identify training needs and coordinate employee development activities.
* Ensure compliance with Flowserve safety policies, safe work practices, and applicable environmental requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by conducting regular safety discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure production processes comply with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements, including adherence to documentation, traceability, inspection, and record\-retention procedures.
* Monitor and manage key operational KPIs, including utilization, efficiency, productivity, scrap, rework, quality performance, and schedule adherence.
* Analyze production losses, quality issues, and daily shop\-floor constraints; implement corrective and preventive actions using structured problem\-solving tools.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives, including AMEF/FMEA, Value Stream Mapping, 5S/6S, SMED, standard work, visual management, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Apply statistical process\-control principles to monitor process performance, identify variation, and improve product quality.
* Support inventory management activities, including material availability, WIP control, inventory accuracy, and coordination with planning and supply chain teams.
* Ensure appropriate use of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, and other production\-planning tools for reporting, scheduling, and daily operational management.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, manufacturing procedures, inspection plans, and customer specifications.
* Ensure fabrication and assembly activities comply with applicable engineering and industry standards, including API 610, ASME, AWS, and other relevant requirements.
* Support and oversee API and non\-API pump manufacturing processes, ensuring that approved procedures and quality requirements are consistently followed.
* Conduct training for shop employees on safety, quality, procedures, technical requirements, Lean practices, and standard work.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and Maintenance teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall plant performance.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, process control, and ISO 9001/ISO 14001 requirements.
* Familiarity with API 610, ASME standards, and preferably AWS welding standards.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling software.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-development skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in pump manufacturing, including API and non\-API pump production processes.
* Experience implementing Lean, Operational Excellence, or continuous\-improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.

 To oversee the overall management, maintenance, operations and commercial performance of the assigned property, ensuring optimal asset utilization, high service standards, regulatory compliance, cost efficiency and tenant/occupants related service and satisfaction.

**a) Property Operations** 



* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the property and ensure smooth and efficient functioning.
* Liaise with Government Agencies (CSEZ / Fire / PCB / Electrical etc).
* Ensure properties comply with local state government regulations.
* Ensure proper upkeep, cleanliness, safety, security and overall presentation of the property.
* Maintain records of income, expenses, and leases.
* Coordinate with facility management, housekeeping, security, engineering and other service teams.
* Establish and monitor operational standards, SOPs and service levels.
* Conduct regular property inspections and ensure timely resolution of identified issues.
* Oversee and manage property staff.



  





**b) Maintenance \& Engineering** 



* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of buildings, equipment, utilities and other assets.
* Ensure timely maintenance of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, civil, fire \& safety and other infrastructure.
* Monitor AMC contracts and ensure service providers meet agreed standards.
* Plan and monitor repair, renovation and improvement work.
* Coordinate property maintenance and repairs with Engineer in Charge.

**c) Tenant / Occupant Management** 



* Maintain effective relationships with tenants, occupants, clients and other stakeholders.
* Market property and attract new tenants.
* Address tenant/occupant complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Monitor compliance with lease terms, property rules and applicable operational requirements.
* Coordinate property handover, fit\-outs, inspections and exit formalities where applicable.



  





**d) Financial \& Budget Management** 



* Prepare and monitor the annual property operating budget.
* Control operational expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Prepare and manage budgets for property operations.
* Monitor utility expenses, maintenance costs and other property\-related expenditures.
* Review vendor invoices and ensure expenditure is within approved budgets.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports covering operational and financial performance.



  





**e) Stakeholder Management** 



* Prepare periodic operational, financial, maintenance and compliance reports.
* Provide management with updates on property performance, risks, incidents and improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal departments including Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Projects and Administration.
* Maintain good relations with other SEZ developers and keep well updated on latest events / SEZ developments
* Maintain effective relationships with government authorities, consultants, vendors and other external stakeholders.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Planning, coordination and execution.
* Vendor and contract management.
* Budget and cost management.
* Statutory and regulatory compliance.
* Health, safety and security management.
* Negotiation and Relationship management.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making.



  





**Education Qualifications** 




 Graduation in any discipline.
 



 Professional certification in Facilities/Property Management will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Experience** 




 6 to 8 Years of experience in property management, facilities management, real estate, hospitality, commercial buildings, residential projects or a similar environment. Experience in managing large properties, multiple vendors and multidisciplinary teams will be preferred. Experience in liasoning with Governmental Organization’s will be preferred.

title: QA Manager (Australia Migration GSM)
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. Setting the Quality Standard
 



 –Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved
 



 –Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward
 



 –Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it
 



 –Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure
 



 2\. Checking Files Before Submission
 



 –Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority
 



 –Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements
 



 –Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign\-off
 



 3\. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules
 



 –Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines
 



 –Updates the team quickly whenever rules change
 



 –Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements
 



 4\. Improving How Things Work
 



 –Creates clear step\-by\-step processes for the team to follow
 



 –Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly
 



 –Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening
 



 5\. Reducing Errors and Rejections
 



 –Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from
 



 –Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened
 



 –Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again
 



 –Works toward getting files right the first time, every time
 



 6\. Reporting to Leadership
 



 –Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing
 



 –Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends
 



 –Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly
 



 7\. Working With Other Teams
 



 –Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff
 



 –Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business
 



 –Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk
 



 8\. Training the Team
 



 –Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills
 



 –Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes
 



 –Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager
 



 9\. Protecting Client Information
 



 –Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private
 



 –Follows all legal and company rules around data protection
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 –Has a relevant degree
 



 –Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services
 



 –Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years
 



 –Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires
 



 –Has used case management or CRM systems before
 



 –Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus
 



 Work Location: In person

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high\-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
   

  

 Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer\-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
   

  

 The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day\-to\-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day\-to\-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high\-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer\-focused team culture.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned business stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and reliable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing regular updates on service requests, priorities, and operational performance.
* Resolve operational issues and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
* Support service reviews by providing updates on performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process standardization, simplification, and automation.
* Lead implementation of process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, knowledge articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Monitor operational metrics and identify trends to support informed decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the team.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams across Client Service Operations to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Work closely with leadership to support operational planning, resource management, and service expansion initiatives.
* Share best practices across Business Support Services to promote consistency and standardization.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Service Delivery: SLA achievement, Turnaround time, Queue management, Delivery throughput
* Quality: Quality scores, Rework rates, Process compliance, Audit readiness
* Operational Performance: Productivity, Capacity utilization, Workload balancing, Operational efficiency
* Stakeholder Experience: Stakeholder satisfaction, Escalation resolution, Responsiveness, Service adoption
* People: Team engagement, Performance management, Training completion, Capability development
* Continuous Improvement: Process improvements implemented, Standardization initiatives, Automation opportunities identified, Knowledge management contributions


**Essential Traits**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Management, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Client Service Operations, Shared Services, Business Operations, Business Support Services, or Professional Services.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or coordinating operational teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery within a shared services or operational support environment.
* Strong operational leadership and service delivery management.
* Experience managing teams within a shared services or business operations environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience with workflow management, reporting, and operational governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Monday.com, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or similar workflow tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**About Kroll**
 Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century\-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting\-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
   

  

 In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com

**Process \& Continuous Improvement**

**Operating Model Effectiveness**

* Support implementation of consistent onboarding, role clarity, and operational standards across markets.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure Operations remains aligned to business needs while maintaining global consistency.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and develop the APAC Operations team, setting clear priorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Coach and support team members to build capability, drive accountability, and encourage continuous improvement.
* Allocate resources and workload to ensure effective delivery against regional and global priorities.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture focused on operational excellence and stakeholder partnership.


****Qualifications****
* Strong experience in media, business operations, financial operations, or operational leadership roles.
* Good understanding of media agency functions, delivery models, and financial processes.
* Proven track record of driving operational improvement, transformation, and organisational change.
* Experience implementing governance frameworks, controls, and performance management processes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior leaders.
* Excellent project and programme management capabilities.
* Outstanding communication, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment.  About DHL Blue Dart Express India:

It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.

Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. Position Overview:
   

  

 The Manager – Business Development / Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth through effective sales process management across all product categories, including DP, International, Retail, Cargo, and E\-Retail. This role involves overseeing the sales team, implementing strategic sales and marketing plans, and enhancing revenue through channel partners. Additionally, the Manager – Business Development monitors performance metrics and fosters strong relationships with key clients to ensure operational excellence and profitability. Job Purpose:
   

  

 To drive the revenue growth by managing the sales process for all product categories within the branch. This role focuses on implementing strategic sales initiatives, optimizing channel partner performance, and ensuring operational excellence. Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 Sales Strategy \& Planning
   

  

  

* Develop and implement short\-term and long\-term sales strategies aligned with organizational revenue and profitability goals.
* Forecast sales trends, set performance targets, and devise action plans to achieve growth objectives across all product categories.
* Collaborate with the Regional Sales Head – Product to identify opportunities for new offerings or product modifications to drive revenue.


 Sales Operations \& Performance Management
   

  

  

* Monitor branch sales performance against targets, analyse deviations, and implement corrective measures to ensure consistent growth.
* Oversee the sales process to ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices.
* Drive revenue growth through effective channel partner management, including performance tracking and support initiatives.


 Client Relationship Management
   

  

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, decision\-makers, and business partners to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
* Negotiate rates, service terms, and offers in consultation with the Branch Head, ensuring adherence to pricing and profitability guidelines.


 Financial Management
   

  

  

* Ensure timely collections and manage account receivables to meet financial targets and maintain healthy cash flow.
* Support the Branch Head in achieving overall profitability through effective cost control and revenue optimization.


 Team Leadership \& Capability Building
   

  

  

* Provide direction, coaching, and support to the sales team to drive performance and productivity.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels and foster a high\-performance, target\-oriented culture.
* Support capability\-building initiatives, including sales training, skill enhancement, and performance evaluation programs.


 Qualifications \& Experience:
   

  

 Education:
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field; a Master’s degree (MBA) is preferred.
* Relevant certifications in sales management or marketing are advantageous.


 Experience:
   

  

  

* 3\-5 years of experience in sales, marketing, or business development roles.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and managing branch operations within the logistics or express delivery industry.
* Strong experience in developing and executing strategic sales plans, monitoring performance metrics, and achieving financial targets.


 Skills \& Capabilities:
   

  

 Technical Skills:
   

  

  

* Proficiency in sales management techniques and strategies.
* Strong understanding of market analysis and competitive landscape.
* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools to monitor sales performance.
* Knowledge of logistics and express delivery industry practices.
* Ability to develop and implement effective marketing plans.


 Key Competencies:
   

  

  

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a high\-performing sales team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building customer relationships.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities to drive sales performance.
* Adaptability and resilience in responding to changing market conditions.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high\-quality service and solutions.


 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

 KRAs
   

  

 KPIs
   

  

 Revenue Growth
   

  

  

* % achievement of branch revenue targets
* % increase in overall sales volume year\-over\-year
* Revenue generated from new customer acquisitions


 Customer Engagement
   

  

  

* Customer satisfaction score (NPS or similar metrics)
* % of customer complaints resolved within defined turnaround times


 Operational Efficiency
   

  

  

* % adherence to operational cost targets (OCPK and OCPM)
* % of on\-time deliveries


 Team Development
   

  

  

* Employee engagement scores within the sales team
* % of team members participating in training and development programs


 Market Expansion
   

  

  

* Number of new clients acquired in targeted segments
* % increase in market share for assigned product categories


 Compliance and Reporting
   

  

  

* Timeliness of sales reporting to senior management
* % adherence to compliance standards and internal policies


 Performance Management
   

  

  

* Adherence to performance management system timelines for sales staff
* % of sales team meeting or exceeding individual performance targets


 Why join DHL Blue Dart?
   

  

 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
   

  

 Here’s what makes us stand out:
   

  

 Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
   

  

 Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
   

  

 Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
   

  

 Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
   

  

 A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
   

  

 Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
   

  

 The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.
   

  

 This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

title: Senior Cost Manager
description:
**Who is Turner \& Townsend?**




 All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.
   

  





**Our purpose:**




**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**




 The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.
   

  





**Our values:**




**Love a challenge:** 
 We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.
   

  





**Stronger together:** 
 We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.
   

  





**Bring out the best in everyone:** 
 We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Will be responsible for the pre and post contract QS works. Should have know how of the following: Quantity survey, Rate Analysis, BOQ Preparation, Value Engineering, Market Knowledge on pricing, verification of contractor interim Bills and Final Bills, cost reporting. Will be SPOC for the project and would be Leading the project from front and other cost team member. Presenting the project cost related information as per Client requirement.
   

  




* Will be the SPOC for the project.
* Should possess in depth knowledge of pre contract \& post contract cost management works and other associated works.
* Estimating, rate analysis \& cost planning and producing final cost plan to client.
* Should have working knowledge of Cost X , MS Excel and other related software.
* Dealing effectively with quantification, preparation of budget, cost to complete, procurement \& tendering process for Civil packages.
* Should be able to perform Cost audit work as necessary.
* Should have knowledge of change management process \& can prepare cost reports.

 At CricHeroes, we're building the world's largest Cricket Network with over
 **50\+ million users** 
 . Through the Store, we're creating the go\-to destination for everything a cricketer needs from merchandise to equipment.
 



  





 We're looking for a
 **Store All\-Rounder** 
 to build and grow our Tennis Cricket Equipment category. If you're passionate about cricket, enjoy building products, and love taking ownership, this role is for you.
 



  





**The Challenge** 




 Build the most trusted tennis cricket equipment brand for grassroots cricketers by creating exceptional products, building strong manufacturing partnerships, and scaling the business end\-to\-end.
 



 You'll own the category like it's your own business.

**Product \& Category Management**

* Identify customer needs and develop products that players love.

**What We're Looking For**

**Apply If This Sounds Like You** 




 If you're excited to build products, grow a business, and create the most loved tennis cricket equipment brand, we'd love to hear from you.

title: License Owner & Operator, Ahmedabad
description:
**Love football (soccer) and have an entrepreneurial mindset?
   

  

 Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Ahmedabad.**
**This is not a salaried management role—it's an opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to build and operate something of their own while making football more accessible in their local community. We're looking for someone ambitious, community\-driven, and passionate about the game.**
**Does This Sound Like You?**
 Visit
 **www.strangersoccer.com** 
 and explore the
 **"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"** 
 section to learn more.
   

  

 If this opportunity aligns with your goals, complete the interest form to start the conversation. We also recommend downloading the Stranger Soccer app to experience the platform firsthand.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Launch and grow the Stranger Soccer brand in Ahmedabad
* Recruit, train, and manage a small local team (2\-3 people), supported by Official Hosts
* Secure suitable football venues and regular playing opportunities
* Drive marketing and customer growth through digital and local initiatives
* Oversee game operations while delivering an outstanding player experience
* Work closely with Stranger Soccer HQ, supported by established operations and technology teams


**What We're Looking For**
* Passion for football and strong connections within the local football community
* Experience in management, operations, sales, or customer\-facing roles
* An entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work independently
* A strong sense of ownership and ambition to grow Stranger Soccer locally
* Motivation to deliver results, with rewards tied to performance and growth


**About Stranger Soccer**
 Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.
   

  

 Our app lets players discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.
   

  

 Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates across 10\+ cities and has delivered over 100,000 games worldwide. We're looking for passionate License Owners who want to bring this experience to their communities—whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or football.
   

  

**Our Mission**
 To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
   

  

**Ready to be part of the journey?**
 We'd love to hear from you.

title: Category Head / Manager - Apparel
description:
**Role:** 
 Category Head / Manager \- Apparel
 



**Category:** 
 Baby \& Kids Wear Category
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
 



**Budget:** 
 22 to 25 LPA
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time · Onsite
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ Years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 We are a leading Indian baby and kids consumer brand with a growing portfolio of products designed for modern parents. As the company continues to expand its product portfolio, we are looking for an experienced
 **Apparel Head** 
 to build and scale the
 **Baby \& Kids Wear category** 
 as a significant growth opportunity.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a senior
 **Apparel / Category Leader** 
 who can own the Baby \& Kids Wear business end\-to\-end from
 **category strategy, consumer and trend understanding, design and product development to sourcing, merchandising, inventory planning, launches and commercial performance** 
 .
 



  





 This is a business ownership role, not a pure design or merchandising position.
 



 You will be responsible for building commercially successful collections while ensuring the right balance between
 **design, quality, price, availability, inventory and profitability** 
 .
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong understanding of the
 **complete apparel value chain** 
 and experience scaling Baby Wear, Kids Wear or related fashion/apparel categories across retail, D2C or other consumer businesses.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Category \& Business Ownership
 


* Own the
 **Baby \& Kids Wear category** 
 and its overall business performance.
* Develop annual, seasonal and category growth plans.
* Own category\-level revenue, margin, profitability and inventory outcomes.
* Analyse sales, margins, sell\-through, stock cover, ageing and SKU\-level performance.
* Identify category gaps and opportunities across price points, age groups, styles and product segments.
* Build a balanced portfolio of core, seasonal and new products.
* Drive sustainable category growth while maintaining healthy inventory and margins.



 Design \& Collection Development
 


* Lead the development of seasonal and core collections from concept to launch.
* Define collection themes, colour palettes, prints, fabrics, silhouettes and product direction.
* Translate consumer insights, market trends and competitive intelligence into commercially viable products.
* Build and manage collection calendars and launch timelines.
* Ensure collections have the right balance of
 **fashion, functionality, comfort, safety and commercial viability** 
 .
* Evaluate product performance and use consumer and sales data to inform future collections.



 Product Development \& Apparel Expertise
 


* Own product development from initial concept through sampling, approvals and production.
* Have strong knowledge of
 **knitted and woven fabrics** 
 and their application in baby and kids apparel.
* Understand GSM, shrinkage, pilling, colourfastness, fabric performance and garment durability.
* Have strong understanding of fit, patterns, stitching, trims, construction and garment finishing.
* Ensure apparel meets appropriate standards for
 **comfort, quality, durability and safety** 
 for babies and children.
* Work closely with technical and quality teams to resolve product and manufacturing issues.



 Sourcing \& Vendor Management
 


* Build and manage a reliable network of
 **mills, garment manufacturers, factories and trim suppliers** 
 .
* Drive product development and sourcing from concept to commercial production.
* Evaluate and develop vendors based on quality, capability, capacity, cost and delivery performance.
* Own product costing, BOMs, target pricing and manufacturing feasibility.
* Negotiate with suppliers to achieve competitive cost structures without compromising quality.
* Monitor vendor performance and drive improvements in quality, lead time and OTIF.
* Develop alternate sourcing options for critical products and materials.



 Merchandising \& Range Management
 


* Lead merchandising strategy across the Baby \& Kids Wear portfolio.
* Build assortment plans based on consumer demand, seasonality, price points and channel requirements.
* Define SKU architecture and collection depth.
* Monitor product\-level performance and make timely decisions on replenishment, markdowns, continuation and discontinuation.
* Ensure new collections are launched with the right inventory and channel readiness.



 Forecasting \& Inventory Planning
 


* Own demand forecasting and seasonal merchandise planning.
* Work closely with sales and ecommerce teams to translate demand signals into inventory requirements.
* Establish SKU\-level inventory plans and replenishment mechanisms.
* Maintain healthy stock cover and inventory turns.
* Minimise stock\-outs, excess inventory and ageing stock.
* Use sales and inventory data to continuously improve forecast accuracy and buying decisions.



 Team Leadership
 


* Lead and develop teams across
 **design, merchandising and product development** 
 .
* Set clear KRAs, KPIs, SOPs and review mechanisms.
* Build a strong product and category culture focused on ownership and commercial outcomes.
* Mentor team members and build leadership capability within the function.
* Ensure clear accountability across the product lifecycle.



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Supply Chain
* Procurement
* Quality
* Ecommerce
* Retail / Sales
* Marketing
* Finance
* Operations



 to ensure seamless execution from
 **product concept → development → sourcing → production → launch → sell\-through** 
 .
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* Category Revenue \& Growth
* Gross Margin \& Profitability
* Collection Launch Adherence
* Product Success Rate
* Sell\-through %
* Inventory Turns
* Stock Cover
* Forecast Accuracy
* Stock\-out \& Ageing Inventory
* Vendor OTIF
* Product Quality \& Returns
* New Product Contribution
* Team Performance



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **10\+ years of experience** 
 in apparel, fashion, merchandising, category management or product leadership.
* Strong experience in
 **Baby Wear / Kids Wear / Children's Apparel** 
 is highly preferred.
* Experience owning or significantly contributing to a complete apparel category or business.
* Strong understanding of the
 **end\-to\-end apparel value chain** 
 — design, product development, fabrics, sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising and inventory.
* Strong fabric and garment knowledge, particularly across knitted and woven products.
* Proven experience in vendor development, product costing and manufacturing management.
* Strong understanding of demand forecasting, assortment planning and inventory management.
* Commercial orientation with the ability to connect product decisions to
 **revenue, margin and profitability** 
 .
* Experience working with retail, D2C, ecommerce or consumer brands.
* Strong team leadership and cross\-functional stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high ownership and accountability.



  





**Qualification** 




 Graduate / Postgraduate in
 **Fashion Design, Textile Technology, Apparel Manufacturing, Fashion Management** 
 or a related discipline.
 



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for candidates currently working in senior roles such as
 **Apparel Head, Category Head, Business Head, Product Head, Design \& Merchandising Head or similar leadership positions** 
 within Baby Wear, Kids Wear, Fashion, Apparel, Retail, D2C or consumer brands.
 



 The ideal candidate should have demonstrated ownership across multiple stages of the apparel value chain and be able to combine
 **strong product understanding with commercial and category thinking** 
 .
 



  





 Why Join?
 


* Lead and build a high\-potential
 **Baby \& Kids Wear category** 
 .
* Own the category across product, sourcing, merchandising and commercial performance.
* Work closely with leadership on category strategy and growth.
* Build collections that directly reach a large base of parents and young consumers.
* Opportunity to build a category and team with significant scope for growth.

title: Director - Aftermarket
description:
**Director\-Aftermarke** 
 t is the end\-to\-end P\&L owner for Milacron India's aftermarket business, spanning spares revenue, service delivery, customer success, and channel economics.
   

  

 This role is intended to create a single accountability center for aftermarket growth and is expected to unlock Whitespace revenue across the installed base by establishing structured coverage, pricing discipline, and cross\-functional execution rigor.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**P\&L Ownership \& Revenue Growth**
* Own the complete national aftermarket P\&L – spares revenue, M\-Powered, retrofits, service billings and new AM product lines
* Set and deliver annual revenue targets in partnership with Head of Sales \& Marketing and Regional leadership
* Protect margin guardrails across pricing, channel economics and service billing models
* Lead monthly AM reviews with Regional Aftermarket Heads; drive corrective action on revenue and coverage gaps


**Strategy \& Growth Roadmap**

* P\&L ownership across sales and service lines


**Analytics \& Planning**
* Data\-driven performance management with strong revenue forecasting capability
* Strategic roadmap development and governance planning
* Target setting, pipeline tracking and proficiency in MIS / BI tools


**Leadership**
* Cross\-functional leadership – ability to align Sales, Spares, Service and Supply Chain
* Executive and board\-level communication
* Team building across central and distributed regional teams


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of total experience, with at least 5–7 years in aftermarket, service or B2B industrial sales leadership roles
* Demonstrated P\&L ownership in capital goods, industrial equipment or allied sectors (e.g., compressors, machine tools, auto components, material handling)
* Proven track record of building and scaling aftermarket revenue including spares and service revenue streams
* Experience managing large, geographically distributed field teams (service engineers, sales managers)
* Exposure to channel/dealer networks and distributor management is a strong plus
* MBA or equivalent preferred; engineering background (Mechanical / Production) is advantageous


****Education****

 \&

title: Calibration Laboratory Head
description:
Job Title: Calibration Laboratory Head
 



 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



 Company: Oizom Instruments Pvt. Ltd.
 



  





**About Oizom:** 




 Oizom is a leading environmental monitoring solutions company, building innovative sensor\-based platforms to measure, analyze, and visualize environmental data. Our solutions help governments, industries, and researchers make data\-driven decisions for cleaner and healthier environments.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are hiring a Calibration Laboratory Head to lead the technical direction and quality oversight of our calibration laboratory for gas, dust, and meteorological instruments. This role involves defining calibration processes, developing SOPs, planning setups for new parameters and capabilities, and driving measurement accuracy improvement through structured testing.
 



  





**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs):** 




 ● Develop and maintain calibration SOPs, work instructions, and technical documentation across gas, dust, and meteorological parameters
 



 ● Plan and define calibration setups for new parameters, instrument types, or measurement ranges — providing technical specifications, workflow design, and environmental requirements
 



 ● Design and supervise testing experiments to identify and reduce sources of measurement error — linearity, drift, cross\-sensitivity, and environmental influence studies
 



 ● Set calibration quality standards, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement
 



 ● Prepare and maintain measurement uncertainty budgets and ensure traceability to national/international standards
 



 ● Build and maintain quality documentation and processes aligned to ISO/IEC 17025 standards
 



 ● Provide technical direction, training, and mentorship to the team.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instrumentation, Environmental Engineering, Applied Physics, Atmospheric Science, Metrology, or a related field
 



 ● Minimum 4 years of hands\-on experience in a calibration or testing laboratory environment, with a total professional experience of 6\+ years preferred.
 



 ● Strong understanding of measurement uncertainty estimation and GUM methodology
 



 ● Experience with gas analyzers, dust/particulate monitors, or meteorological sensors
 



 ● Demonstrated ability to write SOPs, design calibration workflows, and build technical documentation ● Proven ability to lead and coordinate with technical teams
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 ● Experience with NABL or ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation processes
 



 ● ISO/IEC 17025 Internal Auditor or Lead Assessor certification
 



 ● Experience in designing testing experiments, method validation, or accuracy improvement initiatives ● Familiarity with air quality regulatory standards and calibration protocols
 



 ● Proficiency with data analysis tools and statistical methods

title: Associate General Manager - Management Audit & Assurance Services
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Team Lead \- MAAS is responsible for executing and managing day\-to\-day audit activities across multiple business units, including overseeing third\-party auditors, supporting compliance initiatives, conducting focused risk assessments, and ensuring audit quality and efficiency. The role involves close collaboration with the Sector Head to achieve the audit function’s goals in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Team Lead \- MAAS**
**Audit And Compliance**
 Execute the internal audit plan as defined by the Sector Head, managing the operational details to ensure comprehensive audit coverage across assigned business units.
   

  

 Oversee and coordinate with third\-party auditors, ensuring alignment with the internal audit framework and resolving any discrepancies between internal and external audit findings.
   

  

 Conduct compliance checks and monitor adherence to internal policies and regulatory requirements, escalating critical compliance risks to the Sector Head.
   

  

 Maintain detailed records of audit activities, ensuring all audit findings are accurately documented and communicated effectively to internal stakeholders and external auditors.
   

  

 Recommend operational improvements and process efficiencies based on audit findings, working to implement changes in collaboration with internal teams.
   

  

**Corporate Governance And Risk Management**
 Identify and report operational and compliance risks specific to each business unit, providing insights to help shape the Sector Head's risk management strategy.
   

  

 Collaborate with unit leaders to address high\-risk areas identified through audits.
   

  

 Act as the point of contact for business unit managers on governance and compliance matters, ensuring timely responses to risk and compliance inquiries.
   

  

 Support sector heads in engaging with the Audit Committee and Risk Management Committee to comprehend their expectations and ensure that the necessary follow\-up actions are executed, including aspects such as the internal audit budget, resource allocation, and co\-sourcing strategies
   

  

**M\&A Advisory Support**
 Manage integration audits for acquired entities to ensure their processes align with the internal governance and compliance framework.
   

  

**Internal Investigations**
 Manage the operational aspects of investigations into compliance violations, ensuring all evidence is collected systematically and securely.
   

  

 Handle whistleblower cases under the guidance of the Sector Head, managing the process to ensure compliance with internal protocols and confidentiality standards.
   

  

 Compile detailed investigation findings and summaries for review by the Sector Head, outlining key issues and potential corrective actions.
   

  

**Quality Assurance And Control**
 Monitor the quality of audit processes, implementing corrective actions and improvements as needed to maintain high standards.
   

  

 Ensure that internal audit methodologies, as set by the Sector Head, are applied consistently across all audits, adjusting based on specific unit needs.
   

  

 Track and report on key performance indicators related to audit effectiveness, efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction, providing feedback to the Sector Head.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Business CEOs
   

  

 Business CFOs
   

  

 Business HODs
   

  

 Group Finance Team
   

  

 Group Legal Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Audit Agencies
   

  

 Regulatory Bodies
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 CA / CPA / CIA
   

  

 MBA \- Finance (desired)
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 10\+ years of work experience

title: Senior Executive, Supply Chain Planning
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The role is responsible for driving innovative and collaborative supply chain solutions to optimize cost\-to\-serve and maximize product availability in both offline and online retail environments. title: Machine Shop Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bansal Forge Precision Pvt. Ltd., established in 2004, is a global manufacturer of high\-quality forged and machined components serving automotive, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. The company combines advanced forging and machining technologies with stringent global standards to deliver durable, reliable, and custom\-crafted solutions. Bansal Forge is trusted by leading OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and multinational partners, backed by certified quality systems and zero\-defect commitments. The organization promotes a people\-centric culture that values respect, integrity, and continuous improvement, while aligning its operations with sustainability and environmental responsibility. Its vision is to be a world\-class forging plant that empowers industries through innovation, strong partnerships, and customer\-focused solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Machine Shop Manager is responsible for overseeing daily machining operations, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and safety protocols are consistently met. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru includes managing machine shop staff, coordinating workflow, optimizing machine utilization, and maintaining equipment and tooling. The role involves planning and monitoring production schedules, resolving technical and operational issues, and collaborating with engineering, quality, and maintenance teams to improve processes and reduce downtime. The Machine Shop Manager will track performance metrics, implement continuous improvement initiatives, and support audits and compliance requirements. The individual will also contribute to training, coaching, and developing team members to maintain a skilled and efficient workforce.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in Production Planning and Production Management to coordinate machining operations and meet delivery timelines.
* Hands\-on expertise in Machining processes, machine tools, and shop\-floor practices to ensure efficient and safe operations.
* Experience in Quality Management and Inspection to maintain standards, conduct checks, and support zero\-defect output.
* Knowledge of CNC and conventional machining, tooling selection, and process optimization.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and tolerances.
* Proven experience in team leadership, shift management, and performance monitoring in a machine shop or manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field; relevant experience in forging or precision machining is an advantage.
* Effective communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills, with a commitment to safety and compliance.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services (Network Security)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Senior Manager, Technical Services leads multiple delivery pods within the Global Delivery Center Technical Services organization (NetSec) and, where applicable, manages first\-line managers. The role sits between hands\-on delivery leadership and the Director\-level strategic mandate: you will translate the broader Technical Services strategy into concrete operating plans, scale delivery capacity across pods, own executive\-level customer escalations end\-to\-end, and develop the next generation of managers on the team. This position requires seasoned people\-of\-people leadership, strong operational discipline, and a proven ability to build repeatable delivery motions in a high\-growth environment.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

 Delivery Program Leadership
   

  

 Cross\-Pod Execution: Own delivery outcomes across multiple pods / functional areas health of engagements, utilization, margin, and customer satisfaction with a weekly operating rhythm and a clear escalation ladder.
   

  

 Playbooks \& Standards: Codify how the Global Delivery Center Technical Services team delivers engagement kickoff templates, quality gates, technical review checklists, handoff protocols and drive consistent adoption across managers and leads.
   

  

 Capacity Planning: Own the multi\-quarter capacity model for your area; partner with Recruiting on the hiring plan and with Sales on the demand forecast.
   

  

 People \& Manager Development
   

  

 Manage Managers: Develop your first\-line managers running structured 1:1s, coaching them through hiring, performance conversations, and escalations rather than doing the work for them.
   

  

 Talent Bench: Own the succession plan and readiness ratings for your area; identify and grow next\- manager candidates from within the IC ranks.
   

  

 Culture Owner: Set the tone for how your teams work together high\-trust, high\-standards, low\- drama and hold the line on it when pressure spikes.
   

  

 Hiring at Scale: Own the end\-to\-end hiring plan for your area role definition, interview loops, calibration, offer strategy and drive the pass\-through rate.
   

  

 Customer \& Sales Partnership
   

  

 Executive Customer Relationships: Be the Technical Services face for strategic accounts in your region QBRs, steering committees, and post\-mortems.
   

  

 Sales \& GTM Alignment: Partner with Sales Leadership and Solutions
   

  

 Consulting on pipeline shape, deal shaping, and services\-attach; help scope large / complex engagements.
   

  

 Partner Enablement: Where relevant, work with the Partner Ecosystem team to grow delivery capacityand quality through channel partners. Escalation
   

  

 Ownership
   

  

 Own the Recovery: Lead customer escalations end\-to\-end for your area — structure the recovery plan, sequence the technical and commercial workstreams, and drive to a written closure.
   

  

 Executive Communication: Represent status crisply upward (Director / VP) and outward (customer executive sponsors) during high\-pressure situations.
   

  

 Operational Rigor
   

  

 Metrics \& Reporting: Own the weekly / monthly business review for your area utilization, delivery health, CSAT, attrition, hiring velocity and act on the signals.
   

  

 QBR Participation: Contribute directly to Regional QBRs with a defensible read on plan\-to\-actuals and a forward view.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Educational Background: Undergraduate degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; MBA or Masters degree preferred.
   

  

 Proven Leadership: 5\+ years managing service delivery teams of 10\+ professionals in a high\-growth technology environment, including 1\+ year of experience managing other managers or team leads.
   

  

 Security Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of Network Security concepts and product delivery — Palo Alto Networks NGFW / Panorama / Prisma Access / SASE strongly preferred; broader familiarity with the adjacent NetSec ecosystem (Cloud, SD\-WAN, ZTNA) valued.
   

  

 Delivery Program Ownership: Track record of running multi\-pod / multi\-account delivery portfolios —building playbooks, standardizing quality bars, and scaling capacity without proportional headcount growth.
   

  

 Manager Development: Concrete examples of first\-line managers you have hired, coached, and grown ,including cases where you handled underperformance decisively.
   

  

 Escalation Command: Demonstrated ability to serve as the calm, decisive owner of high\-visibility customer escalations with a written record of resolutions rather than heroics.
   

  

 Executive Communication: Fluent presenting to internal executives (RVP / VP) and external customer /partner executives; able to translate technical complexity into business outcome.
   

  

 Multitasking Mastery: Proven ability to oversee many concurrent engagements and prioritize a complex workload proactively without dropping commitments.
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
