title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

 Office
   

  

 As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you will perform meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our colleagues bring our Mission to life every day by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate financial, procurement, billing, project accounting and operational processes using NetSuite capabilities.


 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 8\+ years of hands\-on functional experience with Oracle NetSuite ERP.
* Proven experience leading at least one brand\-new, end\-to\-end NetSuite implementation or major ERP\-to\-NetSuite migration.
* Strong functional expertise across:
+ Core Financials
+ Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)
+ Order\-to\-Cash (O2C)
+ Project Management
+ Project Accounting

* Hands\-on experience configuring NetSuite financial modules, workflows, approval hierarchies, roles, dashboards, reports and saved searches.

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a hands\-on
 **NetSuite functional leader**

title: Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-255176 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 17, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
**Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.


Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Channel Operations Leadership*

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.

*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*

* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.

*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*

* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.

*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*

* Lead Channel analytics support including net sales reconciliations, inventory reporting, compliance reporting, DOH analysis, 852/867 validation activities, and operational dashboards.
* Review variances, trends, recurring exceptions, payment drivers, and operational metrics to improve execution quality and transparency.
* Ensure reporting outputs support decision\-making, payment approvals, audit requirements, and operational planning activities.
* Drive reporting standardization, KPI adoption, and analytics maturity across the Channel organization.

*Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement*

* Oversee AIN execution support for product launch readiness, MMDS activities, approved WAC maintenance activities, master data coordination, and launch documentation governance.
* Partner with ATO launch SMEs on transition planning, launch support activities, SOX documentation requirements, and process readiness.
* Drive automation, simplification, AI\-enabled opportunities, reporting improvements, issue reduction initiatives, and workflow optimization.
* Support system enhancements, UAT execution, defect management, access readiness, and digital transformation initiatives across Channel operations.

*People Leadership \& Transition Readiness*

* Lead, coach, and develop AIN\-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
* Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign\-off before independent ownership expands.
* Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
* Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.

*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*

* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
* Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.

**What We Expect of You**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 8 to 13 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, Gross\-to\-Net, Channel operations, revenue management, contract operations, commercial finance, analytics, or related areas.
* 3\+ years of experience leading people, operational teams, or complex cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience partnering with U.S.\-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Pricing, Contracting, Commercial Operations, Compliance, IT, or Revenue Management organizations.
* Experience leading process execution, reporting, controls, documentation, reconciliations, or operational transformation initiative

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fees and rebates, inventory management rebates, DOH methodologies, scorecards, net sales reconciliations, payment package governance, and Gross\-to\-Net operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting SOX controls, operational audits, access governance, issue management, UAT activities, and system enhancements.
* Demonstrated success leading transitions, KT programs, process standardization, automation, reporting modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive\-ready communication, people leadership, analytical, and change\-management skills.

description:

**Job ID:** 25111049


Not ready to apply?  

Join our Talent Network
**Description**


Manager, Clinical Operations
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  

  

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  

  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job Summary**
---------------


Accountable for and provides management support and direct supervision to Clinical Operations staff in the assigned areas including Site Selection support, site contracts support, regulatory/ethics submissions, site activities including site activation as well as On\-Site Monitoring and/or Central Monitoring through Study Close Out. Provides training, consultation and oversees metric compliance and quality related to operating activities of assigned staff to ensure project deliverables are met. Collaborates and oversees Clinical Operations Team to ensure fulfillment of customer requirements and compliance with related regulations. Supports senior management in operational level planning. May participate in business development presentations as a subject matter expert in Clinical Operations functions within the Company.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Line management of Clinical Operations staff, responsibilities including interviewing and selection, termination, professional development, performance appraisals, and employee counselling May be involved in assignment of project work and will review workloads for all direct reports. Manages staff by establishing goals that will increase knowledge and skill levels, and by delegating tasks commensurate with skill level.
* Review workload for all staff in reporting chain, participate in managing the resource availability for the assigned staff, providing support that projects are suitably resourced and staffing needs are identified in a timely fashion.
* Provide expert operational oversight and guidance to support prioritization of activities, review and monitor the work performed, metric compliance, and development of contingency plans, among others.
* Assist in recruiting new staff, including participation in interview process and new hire on boarding. Proactively work to ensure staff retention and turnover rates remain within expected levels.
* Ensure quality and adherence to Standard Operating Procedures/Work Instructions (SOP/WIs) and compliance with federal and local guidelines and ICH GCP. Ensure all staff follow required training and complete required documentation. Provide regular updates to management accordingly.
* Work closely within appropriate business unit/region to ensure staff performance on studies and correct deficiencies as identified by staff, customers, and auditors. Able to contribute to BU level process improvements. May provide business development support.
* May conduct several types of sign off and assessment visits to ensure Clinical Operations on\-site performance. Develop and oversee training plans to address performance deficiencies. Ensure staff adhere to training guidelines, training records maintenance, and individual and corporate training needs are identified and addressed.
* Organize and chair clinical staff meetings at regular intervals. Manage issues and provide follow up for action items requiring resolution.
* Facilitate and support project and team/country reviews with Clinical Operations staff, focusing on budget, schedule, and risk analysis. Use department systems, reports, and dashboards to identify performance issues, process gaps and monitor overall performance progress in line with departmental goals and metric targets. Oversee all quality control efforts of assigned teams.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, nursing degree, or equivalent related experience, plus extensive clinical research experience in a contract research organization, pharmaceutical or Biotechnology Company, including some time in a leadership capacity or equivalent combination of education, training and experience is required.
* **Preference to have experience in the industry, managing clinical portfolios, and in clinical operations.**
* **Strong experience in Regulatory \& Startup process.**
* **People management experience in m****anaging 15\-16 direct reports.**
* Extensive knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
* Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal, and change management skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade.
* Strong time management, technical and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
* Knowledge of basic financial concepts as related to forecasting and budgeting. Understands project budgets.
* Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace modern technologies.
* Ability to travel as necessary (up to 25%)

**Get to know Syneos Health**

  

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

**About the Role**

Our Operations Manager makes sure what the organization commits to internally actually happens, on schedule and with a record to prove it. You will own our compliance calendar, access governance, vendor management, asset register, document control and business continuity. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and lead an Operations Specialist. This is a hands\-on role in a growing company: you will build and run the processes yourself rather than oversee a large team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the compliance calendar, including certifications, insurance renewals, statutory filings, partner requirements, document reviews and control cycles, each with an owner and a due date.
* Make sure every scheduled control runs on time and its evidence is filed within five business days, so we are always audit\-ready (SOC 2 Type II).
* Approve internal access requests, run quarterly access reviews, and keep elevated access time\-limited and properly approved.
* Manage vendors and third parties so that each one has an executed agreement, a risk rating and a review date before it touches company data.
* Own the asset estate from procurement to disposal, including licence reconciliation and equipment recovery from departing staff in three countries.
* Maintain the controlled document library and master register, and keep every document current and on its review cycle.
* Own business continuity planning and annual testing, and run the quarterly risk register review.
* Coach and develop the Operations Specialist, and flag capacity risks before a deadline is missed.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5\+ years in operations, compliance or governance, with at least 2 years managing people or owning a function.
* Hands\-on experience running compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit frameworks, including control evidence and audit readiness.
* Experience with access management, vendor risk, and asset or licence management.
* Strong documentation discipline, including SOPs, registers, version control and review cycles.
* The judgement to escalate issues early rather than absorb them.
* A self\-starter who works independently, plans their own week and follows through without close supervision.
* Strong critical thinking: you question whether a process actually works, spot gaps before they become problems, and bring solutions, not just issues.
* Zoho One experience is strongly preferred (WorkDrive, Projects, Desk, Books). Candidates without Zoho experience who show strong judgement and learn systems quickly will also be considered.
* Able to work US Eastern business hours consistently. This is a night\-shift role in India.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* A background in managed IT services or technology companies.
* Experience with multi\-entity or multi\-country organizations.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Submit your resume through Indeed. Please include a short note describing a compliance or control process you personally built or ran, and what you used to evidence it.

* Paid time off

title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
   

  

 As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and manage a team of Analysts \& Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery.
* Act as a Subject matter expert \& support the team on complex document processing
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
* Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues.
* Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
* Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
* Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play\-books.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency.


**Who You Are**
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2\+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back\-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw\-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem\-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R\&D
* Highly self\-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team\-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

title: Sr. Lead, Alternatives Data Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.
   

  

 As a Senior Lead of the Alternatives Data Operations, you will lead the operations function that is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. You will manage a team of Alternatives Data Ops analysts who review Private Fund statements, modify data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocess data within SLAs. In this role, you'll own the operational strategy, team performance, and continuous improvement of the Alternatives Data Ops function—a critical component of Addepar's Alternatives offering success.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include building and scaling a high\-performing team, establishing processes and metrics that optimize quality and throughput, managing SLA performance, and serving as the primary liaison between the Alternatives Data Ops team and cross\-functional partners including the Alternatives Product Team, Engineering, Client Delivery, and additional personnel across the organization.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for Alternatives and Market data operations, aligning with Addepar's business objectives and corporate growth plans.
* Drive automation and efficiency initiatives, identifying opportunities to reduce manual work, streamline workflows, and scale the team's capacity
* Collaborate with senior leadership to understand the organization's evolving needs and ensure the data operations strategy is closely aligned with these goals.
* Own operational strategy and metrics, establishing KPIs around data quality, processing speed, and client satisfaction—identifying trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement
* Lead issue resolution and escalation, proactively managing blockers and maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Client Solutions to implement new processes and tooling that improve the data processing experience and increase operational efficiency


**Operational Management**
* Oversee the spectrum of operational workflows for alternatives data and market data feeds, ensuring smooth execution and rapid issue resolution.
* Maintain effective process controls to ensure quality standards, and organizational objectives and deliverables are achieved. Establish, monitor, and report on Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for data delivery, ensuring consistent and timely provision of accurate data to internal and external stakeholders.
* Implement robust KPI tracking, metrics and analytics to measure operational effectiveness, resource utilization, operations scalability, and cost\-effectiveness
* Establish and maintain processes, workflows, and playbooks that ensure consistency, quality, and scalability across the Alternatives Data Ops function


**People Management and Culture**
* Lead and grow the Alternatives Data Ops team, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and fostering career development—helping team members understand the business impact of their work and creating opportunities for growth within the function
* Mentor managers/leads and consistently promote knowledge sharing and best practices to all groups.
* Manage a global team, fostering a strong culture alongside achieving results: Balance driving performance with cultivating a high\-performing, inclusive, and growth\-oriented team culture. Lead by example, empowering team members to innovate and collaborate effectively, while ensuring accountability for measurable outcomes
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members.


**Who You Are**
* 10\+ years of experience in data operations, data management, or a related field within the financial services or wealth tech industry.
* Proven experience in a senior leadership role
* Extensive experience with Alternatives Data (e.g., Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Real Estate, Private Credit) is a must. Experience with Market Data (e.g., equities, fixed income, derivatives, pricing, corporate actions) is a nice to have.
* Proven experience using process automation, operational workflow re\-engineering and continuous improvement to enhance operational efficiency and scalability by using modern tools and technologies.
* Demonstrated track record of improving data quality and operational efficiency.
* Strong project management and analytical skills with experience in leading change management
* Experienced with leading global teams, cross\-functional and cross\-regional projects, and learning and development initiatives.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with clients, external data partners, and internal team members and stakeholders.


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

 At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Manager, has the responsibility of managing day\-to\-day activities of the Ready Benefits team, consisting of COBRA Specialists and EDI Specialists. Mentoring people, monitoring processes, strong stake holder management, and ensuring technology is leveraged to exceed customer service level agreements (SLA) is required. This role will actively support process and technology initiatives that will improve the operational performance of the team while providing a great customer experience.
   

  

**Primary/ Essential Duties And Key Responsibilities**
* Your main responsibility is to ensure that the day\-to\-day operations of the department are running smoothly and ensuring performance metrics like Timeliness, Quality, Productivity and other SLA’s for the team are met
* Should be effectively able to manage performance of a team of 12 \- 20 members.
* Strong stakeholder management with India and US stakeholders.
* Assist in the workload management and prioritization of day\-to\-day duties and projects.
* Drive the establishment and refinement of the UKG Services implementation methodology and best practices
* Track and/or project management of various projects to ensure timeliness
* Attend and/or lead recurring service calls, business reviews, and project debrief for assigned customers
* Support managers and LT with automation and transformation projects supported by business
* Should be able to demonstrate ability to coach/mentor/guide the team
* Serve as first point of escalation for any issues that arise, including problems with customers, third parties, internal teams, and internal systems
* Monitor completion of requirements and provide leadership sign\-off of processing and daily activities
* Communicate potential service issue or business issue to LT and draft/propose correction and mitigation plan
* You are expected to demonstrate how you foster relationships with internal stakeholders by establishing and maintaining exceptional business relationships and working collaboratively
* Problem solving, time management and priority setting skills
* Expected to demonstrate UKG core values
* Generate operational metrics to communicate and manage the performance of the production team
* Engage in hiring along with the manager
* Implement quality control measures effectively


**Qualification**
* Overall, 8 – 10 years of work experience in Benefits related teams, with 3\+ years of people management experience
* Working knowledge of employee life\-cycle, U.S. Benefits Administration, carrier file feeds (benefits and payroll)), related regulations, ERISA guidelines, and HIPAA Compliance
* Ability to work in US shifts


**Preferred Qualifications/Skills**
* Technical experience with Benefit Administration Software and/or other HCM Benefits Administration technology solutions preferred
* Strong background in US Benefit Administration including employee benefit and carrier files and in customer support.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)


**Interpersonal Skills**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Conflict resolution
* Excellent customer service skills
* Ability to handle multiple tasks under stringent timelines
* Highly motivated and team oriented


**Education/Certification/License**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Accounting, Commerce, Computer Science or a related field or equivalent work experience will be considered


**Company Overview**
 UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.

description:

 Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill \+ passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Global freight forwarding Team Leader trains, coaches and mentor’s coordinators to be successful in accomplishing quality and productivity goals. The team leader’s responsibilities include: \- resolving queries, break management, error trending analysis, reporting, evaluating team performance, maintaining up\-to\-date knowledge of our products and services, and ensuring that all coordinators are performing their duties as expected. The Team Leader will monitor staffing and manage the queue to realign against the turnaround time. They will collaborate with the supervisor to identify department needs and goals.
   

  

 Judgment and independent initiative may be required to identify, adapt and apply approaches to solve problems. This position monitors the efficiency of processes at their maximum level and ensures process, policy, and procedure changes are administered.
   

  

**Skills Set Required**
* Should be well versed with Brokerage Systems \& Terminologies
* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and guide the team
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and communication skills
* Shift flexibility
* Ability to work independently, make sound judgments, without supervision based on the needs of the process


**Supervises And Develops Others**
* Is expected to be the leader of the work group
* Determines employees’ training needs to produce continuous development plans
* Provides on\-going feedback and support to improve performance
* Resolves individual and group performance issues in accordance with UPS’s policies and procedures in a timely manner to motivate and foster teamwork
* Holds others accountable to established performance levels to achieve individual and group goals


**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as a liaison between Associates and Supervisors
* Coach associates to maintain service levels
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations, ensuring team performance and adherence to timelines.
* Shares skill and knowledge with associates while addressing questions regarding the systems and work
* Stays current on service features and system enhancements through formal and informal training
* Assist and support associates with difficult work\-related situations
* Prioritize the workflow to meet the deadlines of the department
* Communicates to Supervisor any issues or problems that need escalation or management attention
* Identifies and implements changes and process improvements to maximize efficiency, decrease errors, and reduce costs within the department.
* Reviews status and quality reports and adjusts controls to ensure proper procedures and corrective action steps are in place
* Conducts audits, identifies exceptions, implements corrective actions, reports findings, and maintains schedules to ensure compliance with internal audit


**Additional Requirements**
* Immediate joiner preferred
* Experience in US \& CA Brokerage within UPS is preferred

 Permanent

title: Manager - Core Performance
description:
Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on\-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.
   

  

 We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.
   

  

 VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.
   

  

 VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Job Title**
 TM \- Core Performance
   

  

**Designation**
 Manager \- Core Performance
   

  

**Band**
 M1
   

  

**Function**
 Technology
   

  

**Sub\-Function**
 Central Operations Group :Core Performance\-Active Operations
   

  

**Reports To**
 TL \- Data Core Performance
   

  

**Location Type:**
 Pune\-COR
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The TM – Core Performance role requires strong knowledge of 4G LTE/EPC and 5G NSA/SA architecture, along with hands\-on experience in Packet Core KPI monitoring, analysis, and troubleshooting. The role also requires a good understanding of core network elements, DNS, interfaces, protocols, Cloud/NFV infrastructure, and Cloud KPIs such as CPU, memory, disk, VM/container health, and network utilization. Key responsibilities include identifying KPI degradation, performing PCAP analysis, conducting troubleshooting and RCA, and coordinating with internal teams and vendors to maintain network performance and service stability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* PAN\-India Core Monitoring: Monitor performance across multi\-vendor core network nodes, including MME, SGW, PGW, and PCRF.
* Success Rate Tracking: Track key Packet Core success metrics, including S11 SR, ASR, PDN, LUSR, and WiFi\-to\-LTE handovers, and initiate timely corrective actions.
* Capacity and Throughput Management: Audit IP pool utilization and SGW/PGW throughput trends to support demand forecasting and capacity planning.
* Enterprise Platform Oversight: Monitor DRA/OCS performance and AAA/APN\-wise KPIs to support enterprise service efficiency and stability.
* P1 Incident Response: Support high\-priority incident resolution through real\-time KPI analysis, alerting, and coordination with cross\-functional teams.
* Reporting and Audits: Conduct parameter audits for quality compliance and publish weekly Data Core and Cloud KPI trend reports.
* Technology Evolution: Build knowledge across emerging technology areas, including WiFi, DNS, Cloud KPIs, and Packet Core 4G/5G architectures.
* Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor infrastructure\-level Cloud KPIs such as CPU load, virtualization latency, VM/container health, and virtual switch packet drops for cloud\-native telecom functions.
* OpenSignal, Customer Complaints and User Experience Monitoring: Monitor OpenSignal KPIs, including download/upload speed, latency, packet loss, discard rate, and TTFB. Analyse customer complaints and experience indicators, correlate them with network KPIs to drive service improvements and corrective actions.


**Technical/ Functional Competencies**
* Packet Core KPI Monitoring: Track performance across MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, and DNS elements.
* Enterprise Core Performance: Monitor DRA, OCS, PCRF, AAA, and APN performance indicators.
* Data Core Protocols: Understand S11, S5, and S8 interfaces, along with GTP, Diameter, and Radius protocols.
* Capacity Utilization Analysis: Analyse IP pool utilization, throughput trends, and demand projections.
* Network Performance Reporting and Alerting: Prepare KPI dashboards, configure threshold alerts, and support performance reporting.
* Cloud Infrastructure Performance: Understand RHOSP and RHOCP architectures and monitor key cloud performance indicators.
* User Experience KPI Correlation: Correlate OpenSignal, TTFB, latency, throughput, packet loss, and discard\-rate metrics with network performance.


**Behavioural \& Leadership Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking: Strong capability to dissect complex network data and troubleshoot underlying protocol issues.
* First\-Time\-Right Approach: High commitment to quality and accuracy in execution to minimize network downtime.
* Accountability \& Ownership: Demonstrated capability to own network issues from initial detection through to final resolution.
* Digital Mindset: Adaptable to evolving cloud\-native telecom technologies and automated monitoring systems.
* Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across cross\-functional engineering and infrastructure teams.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Minimum Education Qualification**
 B.E./B.Tech — Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science.
   

  

**Years Of Working Experience**
 Minimum 4–6 years of experience in core network performance management or Packet Core operations, with exposure to multi\-vendor 4G/VoLTE environments and a basic understanding of Cloud/NFV infrastructure.

**Internal Stakeholders**

* SNOC — INM, FM, CHM, PM teams
* COG Central Core Operations team
* Enterprise and APN operations teams
* IT Security and Compliance teams


**External Stakeholders**
* OEMs: Nokia, Ericsson, Cisco, Huawei, Mavenir, ZTE, RH teams.
* Managed Services Partners: Third\-party operations and network monitoring vendors.
* Enterprise \& Roaming Partners: Interconnectivity and national/international roaming carriers.

title: Commercial Closing Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 SQUAREA is a luxury real estate advisory firm headquartered in Kharadi, Pune, with a strong and growing presence in Dubai. The firm provides end\-to\-end advisory services across luxury residential properties, branded residences, Grade‑A commercial real estate, and investment\-led real estate portfolios for clients in India and overseas. Leveraging deep market expertise and global experience, SQUAREA helps investors identify premium apartments in Pune, high\-quality commercial assets, and research\-backed investment opportunities. The team offers strategic, data\-driven guidance tailored to individual client needs, spanning residential, commercial, and branded developments. In Dubai, SQUAREA also enables clients to access top\-tier properties and high\-yield investment options, supporting confident participation in global real estate markets.
   

  

**Role Description** 
 The Commercial Closing Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune City, responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end closing process for commercial real estate transactions. This role coordinates all documentation, compliance checks, and funding activities to ensure accurate and timely closings for Grade‑A commercial assets and other investment\-led deals. The Commercial Closing Manager will collaborate closely with sales teams, lenders, legal advisors, and clients to manage loan and mortgage\-related requirements, resolve issues, and maintain clear communication throughout the transaction lifecycle. Daily responsibilities include preparing and reviewing closing packages, tracking transaction milestones, monitoring disbursements, and maintaining detailed records in line with regulatory and internal standards. The role also contributes to process improvement, supports risk management, and helps deliver a smooth and transparent closing experience for all stakeholders.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in commercial real estate closings, with practical experience managing Closings and Funding activities.
* Proficiency in handling Loans and Mortgage Lending documentation, compliance requirements, and lender coordination.
* Demonstrated Sales collaboration skills, with the ability to support deal structuring and closing timelines.
* Solid understanding of commercial real estate transactions, title and legal documentation, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with clients, legal teams, and financial institutions.
* Prior experience in commercial real estate, banking, or mortgage operations is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfort with using transaction management software, spreadsheets, and digital documentation tools.
* Ability to work on\-site in East Pune and collaborate in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**
**Process \& Data Ownership**
* Own end\-to\-end RtR process and enterprise Master Data governance framework
* Define and maintain global process and data standards, ownership model, and controls
* Ensure alignment of Master Data across Finance, Customer, Vendor, and Material domains
* Act as primary point of accountability for process integrity and data quality impacting financial reporting


**Project \& Transformation Leadership**
* Own and manage global portfolio of RtR and Master Data transformation initiatives
* Lead delivery of strategic programs (ERP initiatives, automation, data governance, harmonization, centralization)
* Define priorities, business cases, and implementation roadmap aligned with GBS and Finance strategy
* Ensure delivery of measurable outcomes (cost, quality, control, scalability)
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies across Finance, O2C, P2P, and Supply Chain
* Ensure strong project governance, risk management, and escalation


**Performance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and monitor KPIs for:
+ Process performance (cycle time, cost, efficiency)
+ Master Data quality (accuracy, completeness, timeliness) across all domains

* Drive continuous improvement based on performance insights
* Track project delivery and benefits realization


**Governance \& Operating Model**
* Define global operating model for RtR and cross\-functional Master Data
* Align ownership across GBS, Corporate, and business functions
* Enforce standards through governance mechanisms and stakeholder management
* Ensure alignment with regulatory, audit, and control requirements (incl. SOX where applicable)


**Stakeholder Management**
* Partner with Finance, Sales, Procurement, and Supply Chain leaders to align on process and data ownership
* Drive adoption of global standards and data governance principles
* Resolve cross\-functional conflicts related to process or data decisions
* Report performance, risks, and transformation progress to senior leadership


**Transformation \& Go\-Live Readiness**
* Ensure readiness of RtR and Master Data for system implementations and business transitions
* Oversee data migration, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation
* Ensure cross\-domain data dependencies are managed (customer, vendor, material impacting financial postings)


**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience**
* Experience in GBS / SSC / BPO environment
* 8\+ years in RtR process ownership roles with strong exposure to Master Data governance
* Proven track record leading large\-scale global transformation programs
* Strong experience in:
* Process design and standardization
* Master Data management across Finance, Customer, Vendor, Material
* SAP experience required, including relevant Master Data domains
* Experience in automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement programs
* Understanding of financial controls and impact on reporting


**Additional Qualifications**
* Strong business acumen and ownership mindset
* Ability to drive cross\-functional data ownership and enforce standards
* Strong program and project management capability
* Resilient, proactive, and execution\-focused
* Strong stakeholder and communication skills across matrix organization
* High process and data orientation with focus on integrity, control, and scalability


**About Us**
 Our purpose at Avient Corporation is to be an innovator of materials solutions that help our customers succeed, while enabling a sustainable world.
   

  

 Innovation goes far beyond materials science; it’s powered by the passion, creativity, and diverse expertise of 9,000 professionals worldwide. Whether you’re a finance wizard, a tech enthusiast, an operational powerhouse, an HR changemaker, or a trailblazer in materials development, you’ll find your place at Avient.
   

  

 Join our global team and help shape the future with sustainable solutions that transform possibilities into realities. Your unique perspective could be the key to our next breakthrough!
   

  

 We believe that all of our global employees are leaders and that the six most important behaviors for driving our strategy and culture are the same no matter if an employee is a leader of self, a leader of others, or a leader of the business.
   

  

 By
 *playing to win, acting customer centric, driving innovation and profitable growth, collaborating seamlessly across Avient, and motivating and inspiring and developing others and yourself* 
 you will accelerate your ability to achieve Avient’s strategic goals, to meet our customer needs, and to accomplish your career goals.
   

  

 At Avient, we believe a wide variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds gives us the creativity to be successful in a rapidly changing world. In support of this, we stress equality of opportunity for all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable laws. Decisions on hiring, promotion, development, compensation or advancement are based solely on a person’s qualifications, abilities, experience and performance.

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Manager - Credit Risk
description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Manager – Credit Risk to lead credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will combine hands\-on credit expertise, client management, solution development and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong financial analysis and commercial credit underwriting expertise, sound credit judgment, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to translate client requirements into practical processes and solutions.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead delivery of credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements, ensuring quality, timelines and client requirements are met.
* Perform and review financial and credit analysis, including financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flows, liquidity, leverage, profitability, working capital, AR/AP aging and other key credit indicators.
* Monitor credit portfolios and risk trends, identifying emerging risks, changes in financial performance and other indicators requiring attention, and communicate relevant insights to clients.
* Conduct quantitative and qualitative credit assessment, including business model, industry, customer concentration, debt obligations, contracts and supporting documentation, to identify key risks and form a credit view.
* Own client communication and requirement gathering, translating business needs into underwriting frameworks, processes, SOPs and practical risk/technology solutions.
* Manage and develop internal team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and capability building.
* Drive process improvement, standardization, automation and risk\-monitoring initiatives, and proactively communicate key risks, trends and recommendations to clients.



  





 What we are looking for
 


* 5 years of experience in commercial credit risk, financial analysis or risk consulting, preferably within banking, lending, fintech or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, ratio analysis, cash\-flow and working\-capital assessment, with sound credit judgment.
* Strong credit judgment and attention to detail, including ability to identify financial, operational and qualitative risks from multiple information sources.
* Excellent client\-facing, communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to understand ambiguous requirements and develop practical solutions.
* Experience managing/reviewing junior team members and taking ownership of project delivery.
* Experience with process design, SOP development, automation or analytics initiatives.
* Should have strong understanding of Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis/modeling skills.
* Exposure to credit underwriting, financial spreading, banking/transaction data or risk analytics platforms is an advantage.



  





 Educational Qualifications
 


* CA / CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Equivalent qualifications with relevant credit risk/underwriting experience may also be considered.
