title: Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics
description:
**About Company**
 Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e\-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers \& All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.
   

  

 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
   

  

 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
   

  

**Website:** 
 https://groupbayport.com/about\-us/
   

  

**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
   

  

**Designation:** 
**Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics**
**Location: Gandhinagar**
**About The Role**
 This role owns end\-to\-end execution of Bayport's outbound and inbound logistics operation — from raw material import through SEZ export compliance, carrier management, international transit, and final delivery with proof of delivery — while also owning full financial control of the freight and 3PL spend that flows through the department. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has run high\-volume international parcel/express operations before and can bring immediate rigor, carrier relationships, and operational and financial discipline to a fast\-scaling, compliance\-intensive environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* International Carrier \& Freight Management: Own the relationship and performance of FedEx, UPS, Emirates and other carrier partners — rate negotiation, annual contracts, service\-level management, escalation handling, and carrier score carding across air, sea, and surface.
* Inbound \& Outbound Logistics: Own inbound raw material import logistics with a focus on cost and lead\-time reduction, alongside full ownership of outbound sea and air shipments across B2B, B2C, and marketplace channels.
* SEZ \& Trade Compliance: Ensure disciplined, audit\-ready execution of shipping bill filing, customs documentation, and SEZ regulatory requirements, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and Importer of Record (IOR) procedures across key markets (US, Canada, UK, Australia, EU, China).
* 3PL Vendor Bill Audit \& Financial Control: Own the checking and audit of all 3PL/carrier vendor bills against contracted rates and actual service delivered and drive timely payment and reconciliation in coordination with Finance and the vendor — this is a named, direct accountability of this role, not a shared or informal responsibility.
* End\-to\-End Operational Ownership: Drive the full flow from production handover through packing, carrier dispatch, in\-transit visibility, destination customs, last\-mile delivery, and signed proof of delivery (POD).
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Logistics Manager and the wider team covering domestic/non SEZ vendor operations, SEZ compliance, night operations, MIS/sea freight/refund \& reship, and Atlanta linked shipping — building capability and accountability at every level.
* Performance \& MIS Reporting: Own a KPI\-driven daily/weekly/monthly MIS reporting cadence — cycle time by stage, on\-time pickup/delivery, freight cost, exception and lost\-shipment tracking, and POD closure — with full visibility to the Head of Supply Chain \& Logistics.
* Cost \& Network Optimization: Continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost per shipment, improve carrier mix, and eliminate avoidable delays or rework across the network.
* Business Expansion \& Vendor Development: Identify and onboard logistics partners in new geographies as Bayport's brands expand into new international markets.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with Production Planning, Material Planning, and Vendor Management to tighten the handover from production to logistics and resolve root\-cause issues jointly rather than in isolation.
* Exception \& Escalation Ownership: Personally own resolution of high\-impact exceptions — customs hold, lost shipments, delivery disputes — ensuring timely closure and clear communication.
* Marketplace Logistics: Build the roadmap and business case for bringing marketplace last mile fulfilment in\-house


**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**
* A fully visible, stage\-wise logistics dashboard covering the complete order lifecycle — inbound through final delivery, not just packing\-to\-carrier\-handover
* A clean, current, reconciled 3PL vendor billing process with no payment disputes or aged discrepancies with Finance
* Measurable improvement in on\-time pickup and on\-time delivery percentages across all three carriers
* A formalized, audit\-ready SEZ and customs compliance process with clear ownership and turnaround times
* A functioning POD/exception closure process with defined liability and resolution timelines
* A stable, accountable, well\-led Logistics team operating on clear KPIs and a regular performance cadence


**Required Experience**
* 10–15 years in international logistics/parcel\-express operations, with substantial experience managing outbound and inbound volume through global carriers
* Prior experience with FedEx, DHL, UPS, or a comparable global express/parcel carrier is strongly preferred — this significantly shortens the learning curve for Bayport's carrier\-heavy, SLA\-driven model
* Demonstrated experience with export/import compliance, customs documentation, duties/tariffs, and ideally SEZ or bonded\-warehouse environments
* Direct experience auditing 3PL/carrier invoices and managing reconciliation with Finance
* Track record of leading and developing operational teams of meaningful size, with a hands\-on, floor present leadership style
* Experience building or owning KPI dashboards and driving performance through data, not just tenure or relationships


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree or equivalent is a plus
* Six Sigma / Lean or equivalent process\-improvement certification is an advantage


**Key Competencies**
* Operational and financial rigor under time\-sensitive, SLA\-driven conditions
* Strong carrier and vendor negotiation skills, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and IOR procedures across key international markets
* Direct, transparent communication style with the ability to hold a team accountable while developing them
* Proficient in logistics software, MS Office Suite, and ERP systems
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-scaling, still\-formalizing process environment — able to build structure, not just follow it

title: Plant Head
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Plant Head will be responsible for the overall leadership, management, and operational performance of the manufacturing facilities of Vidya Wires Limited and ALCU Industries Limited. The role encompasses end\-to\-end responsibility for production, quality, maintenance, supply chain coordination, cost optimization, safety, compliance, people management, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure achievement of business objectives.
 



 The incumbent shall drive operational excellence by maximizing productivity, ensuring customer satisfaction, maintaining statutory compliance, and fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and innovation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Business Planning** 



* Develop and implement plant strategies aligned with the organization's business objectives.
* Prepare annual operating plans, budgets, capacity plans, and production forecasts.
* Drive business growth through process optimization, productivity enhancement, and cost reduction initiatives.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to achieve operational targets.
* Support expansion projects, new product development, and technology upgradation initiatives.



**2\. Production \& Operations Management** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end manufacturing operations across all units.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Optimize machine utilization, manpower productivity, and resource allocation.
* Minimize downtime, rejection, rework, and process losses.
* Ensure effective implementation of production planning and control systems.
* Coordinate with the sales, procurement, stores, and logistics teams for seamless operations.



**3\. Quality Management** 



* Ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal quality standards, and applicable industry requirements.
* Drive quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects and customer complaints.
* Monitor process capability and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Lead internal and external quality audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems such as International Organization for Standardization standards and customer\-specific requirements.



**4\. Maintenance \& Engineering** 



* Ensure preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of all plant equipment and utilities.
* Improve equipment reliability, availability, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Lead capital expenditure projects, plant modifications, and equipment installations.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of utilities including power, compressed air, water, and other critical services.
* Drive energy conservation and asset lifecycle management initiatives.



**5\. Supply Chain \& Inventory Management** 



* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials and consumables.
* Optimize inventory levels and reduce carrying costs.
* Monitor material consumption, yield, and wastage.
* Ensure effective warehouse management and dispatch planning.



**6\. Cost Management \& Profitability** 



* Prepare and manage plant operating budgets.
* Monitor manufacturing costs and implement cost\-control measures.
* Identify opportunities for waste elimination and process improvement.
* Improve overall plant profitability through operational efficiencies.
* Drive value engineering and lean manufacturing initiatives.



**7\. Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)** 



* Ensure strict compliance with all safety, health, and environmental regulations.
* Promote a zero\-accident culture across all manufacturing facilities.
* Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and emergency preparedness drills.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental norms and pollution control requirements.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.



**8\. Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws, factory regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Liaise with government authorities, auditors, customers, and certification agencies.
* Ensure compliance under the provisions of the applicable laws including:
* Factories Act and applicable state factory rules
* Environment, Health and Safety regulations
* Industrial relations and labour laws
* Fire and electrical safety requirements
* Legal metrology and other industry\-specific regulations



**9\. People Management \& Industrial Relations** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop departmental heads and plant employees.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Drive employee engagement, performance management, and succession planning initiatives.
* Maintain healthy industrial relations and proactively address employee grievances.
* Coordinate with the HR department for manpower planning, training, and workforce development.



**10\. Continuous Improvement** 



* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, Kaizen, and 5S initiatives.
* Lead digital transformation and automation projects.
* Benchmark plant performance against industry standards.
* Encourage innovation and continuous improvement across functions.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Production achievement against plan
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
* Capacity utilization
* Cost per unit produced
* Rejection and rework percentage
* Customer complaint rate
* On\-time delivery performance
* Machine downtime
* Inventory turnover ratio
* Energy consumption per unit
* Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
* Employee attrition and absenteeism rates
* Audit and compliance scores



  





**Educational Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Industrial, or related discipline).
* MBA in Operations Management is preferred.
* Six Sigma Certification is preferred.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in manufacturing operations.
* At least 5–8 years of experience in a senior leadership role as Plant Head, Operations Head, or Manufacturing Head.
* Experience in wire, cable, copper, aluminium, metal processing, or related manufacturing industries is preferred.
* Proven track record in managing multiple manufacturing units.



  





**Required Competencies** 




**Technical Competencies** 



* Production planning and control
* Lean manufacturing and TPM
* Quality management systems
* Cost management and budgeting
* Supply chain management
* Maintenance management
* Industrial engineering
* ERP/MRP systems
* Statutory compliance and factory operations



**Behavioural Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking
* Leadership and team building
* Decision\-making ability
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Communication and negotiation skills
* Change management
* Conflict resolution
* Result orientation
* Stakeholder management

title: Fabrication & Production supervisor
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Production Supervisor leads day\-to\-day operations within the fabrication shop and final packaging area, ensuring safe, efficient, high\-quality production that meets customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for supervising shop\-floor personnel, coordinating production activities across work centers, managing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement through Lean and operational\-excellence practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise fabrication shop and final packaging operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and on\-time delivery targets.
* Plan, prioritize, and schedule production activities across multiple work centers based on workload, capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Assign daily work to shop employees according to skill level, certifications, workload, and production priorities.
* Maintain and regularly update the shop\-floor skill matrix; identify training needs and coordinate employee development activities.
* Ensure compliance with Flowserve safety policies, safe work practices, and applicable environmental requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by conducting regular safety discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure production processes comply with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements, including adherence to documentation, traceability, inspection, and record\-retention procedures.
* Monitor and manage key operational KPIs, including utilization, efficiency, productivity, scrap, rework, quality performance, and schedule adherence.
* Analyze production losses, quality issues, and daily shop\-floor constraints; implement corrective and preventive actions using structured problem\-solving tools.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives, including AMEF/FMEA, Value Stream Mapping, 5S/6S, SMED, standard work, visual management, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Apply statistical process\-control principles to monitor process performance, identify variation, and improve product quality.
* Support inventory management activities, including material availability, WIP control, inventory accuracy, and coordination with planning and supply chain teams.
* Ensure appropriate use of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, and other production\-planning tools for reporting, scheduling, and daily operational management.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, manufacturing procedures, inspection plans, and customer specifications.
* Ensure fabrication and assembly activities comply with applicable engineering and industry standards, including API 610, ASME, AWS, and other relevant requirements.
* Support and oversee API and non\-API pump manufacturing processes, ensuring that approved procedures and quality requirements are consistently followed.
* Conduct training for shop employees on safety, quality, procedures, technical requirements, Lean practices, and standard work.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and Maintenance teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall plant performance.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, process control, and ISO 9001/ISO 14001 requirements.
* Familiarity with API 610, ASME standards, and preferably AWS welding standards.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling software.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-development skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in pump manufacturing, including API and non\-API pump production processes.
* Experience implementing Lean, Operational Excellence, or continuous\-improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Exposure to statistical process control, quality tools, and structured corrective\-action methodologies.
* Knowledge of welding, fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging processes for industrial equipment.


 Flowserve is a world\-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000\+ employees in 50\+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges themselves to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000\+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.

 EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co\-workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision

**Scope**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Major Incident Manager (8–12 years) to lead and oversee the management of high\-severity incidents across complex IT environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in IT operations, ITIL\-aligned service management, and cross\-functional coordination, ensuring minimal business impact and rapid restoration of services.
   

  

**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Incident management in multi\-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure (on\-prem \+ cloud).
* Understanding of cloud\-native monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Operations Suite).
* Exposure to containerized platforms (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker).
* Familiarity with DevOps/SRE practices (CI/CD, automation, “observability as code”).
* Managing incidents in SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of cloud security, compliance, and governance impacts during incidents.

* End\-to\-End Incident Management: Manage the complete lifecycle of major incidents—from identification and logging to resolution and closure—ensuring adherence to SLAs and operational best practices.

* Team Leadership \& Mentorship: Guide and mentor Major Incident Managers, L2/L3 support teams, and other operational staff on effective incident handling and crisis management.
* Proactive Risk Management: Collaborate with monitoring, infrastructure, and cloud teams to identify potential service\-impacting risks and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
* Reporting \& Metrics: Maintain dashboards, KPIs, and metrics to track incident trends, team performance, and continuous service improvement.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5– 8 years of experience in IT operations, service management, or incident management roles, with significant exposure to major incident handling.
* Deep understanding of ITIL processes, especially incident, problem, change, and service continuity management.
* Proven experience managing high\-impact, enterprise\-wide incidents in complex, multi\-cloud or hybrid IT environments.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and crisis coordination skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities under high\-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to drive cross\-functional teams during critical incidents.

* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure.
* ITIL Intermediate or Expert certification.
* Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and incident management dashboards.
* Experience in stakeholder reporting to C\-level executives.
* Exposure to compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements for IT operations.

description:

 To oversee the overall management, maintenance, operations and commercial performance of the assigned property, ensuring optimal asset utilization, high service standards, regulatory compliance, cost efficiency and tenant/occupants related service and satisfaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




**a) Property Operations** 



* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the property and ensure smooth and efficient functioning.
* Liaise with Government Agencies (CSEZ / Fire / PCB / Electrical etc).
* Ensure properties comply with local state government regulations.
* Ensure proper upkeep, cleanliness, safety, security and overall presentation of the property.
* Maintain records of income, expenses, and leases.
* Coordinate with facility management, housekeeping, security, engineering and other service teams.
* Establish and monitor operational standards, SOPs and service levels.
* Conduct regular property inspections and ensure timely resolution of identified issues.
* Oversee and manage property staff.



  





**b) Maintenance \& Engineering** 



* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of buildings, equipment, utilities and other assets.
* Ensure timely maintenance of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, civil, fire \& safety and other infrastructure.
* Monitor AMC contracts and ensure service providers meet agreed standards.
* Plan and monitor repair, renovation and improvement work.
* Coordinate property maintenance and repairs with Engineer in Charge.
* Maintain appropriate records of assets, maintenance activities and service history.



  





**c) Tenant / Occupant Management** 



* Maintain effective relationships with tenants, occupants, clients and other stakeholders.
* Market property and attract new tenants.
* Address tenant/occupant complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Monitor compliance with lease terms, property rules and applicable operational requirements.
* Coordinate property handover, fit\-outs, inspections and exit formalities where applicable.



  





**d) Financial \& Budget Management** 



* Prepare and monitor the annual property operating budget.
* Control operational expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Prepare and manage budgets for property operations.
* Monitor utility expenses, maintenance costs and other property\-related expenditures.
* Review vendor invoices and ensure expenditure is within approved budgets.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports covering operational and financial performance.



  





**e) Stakeholder Management** 



* Prepare periodic operational, financial, maintenance and compliance reports.
* Provide management with updates on property performance, risks, incidents and improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal departments including Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Projects and Administration.
* Maintain good relations with other SEZ developers and keep well updated on latest events / SEZ developments
* Maintain effective relationships with government authorities, consultants, vendors and other external stakeholders.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Planning, coordination and execution.
* Vendor and contract management.
* Budget and cost management.
* Statutory and regulatory compliance.
* Health, safety and security management.
* Negotiation and Relationship management.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making.



  





**Education Qualifications** 




 Graduation in any discipline.
 



 Professional certification in Facilities/Property Management will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Experience** 




 6 to 8 Years of experience in property management, facilities management, real estate, hospitality, commercial buildings, residential projects or a similar environment. Experience in managing large properties, multiple vendors and multidisciplinary teams will be preferred. Experience in liasoning with Governmental Organization’s will be preferred.

title: QA Manager (Australia Migration GSM)
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. Setting the Quality Standard
 



 –Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved
 



 –Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward
 



 –Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it
 



 –Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure
 



 2\. Checking Files Before Submission
 



 –Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority
 



 –Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements
 



 –Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign\-off
 



 3\. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules
 



 –Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines
 



 –Updates the team quickly whenever rules change
 



 –Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements
 



 4\. Improving How Things Work
 



 –Creates clear step\-by\-step processes for the team to follow
 



 –Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly
 



 –Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening
 



 5\. Reducing Errors and Rejections
 



 –Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from
 



 –Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened
 



 –Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again
 



 –Works toward getting files right the first time, every time
 



 6\. Reporting to Leadership
 



 –Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing
 



 –Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends
 



 –Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly
 



 7\. Working With Other Teams
 



 –Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff
 



 –Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business
 



 –Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk
 



 8\. Training the Team
 



 –Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills
 



 –Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes
 



 –Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager
 



 9\. Protecting Client Information
 



 –Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private
 



 –Follows all legal and company rules around data protection
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 –Has a relevant degree
 



 –Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services
 



 –Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years
 



 –Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires
 



 –Has used case management or CRM systems before
 



 –Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus
 



 Work Location: In person

title: Identity Access Management Operations and Engineering Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
 With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.
   

  

 Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
   

  

**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:** 
 Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 As Identity Access Management Operations and Engineering Manager for IT Risk and Security, you will lead an IAM Operations and Identity Engineering function within StoneX, owning both the day\-to\-day identity service the firm depends on and the engineering of the platforms that deliver it. The estate runs core identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID with Active Directory, and Okta. Around them sit enterprise PKI, privileged access management, modern authentication and identity governance tooling, alongside legacy platforms now being retired. The ideal candidate will have experience working in a regulated financial environment and is a highly skilled, experienced and motivated leader willing to drive and grow our identity function across a globally distributed team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Primary duties will include:**
* Own the identity service catalogue end to end \- joiner, mover and leaver processing, access request, entitlement and group administration, privileged account issuance, certificate services and application onboarding and the service levels each commitment carries.
* Set the engineering and operations roadmap and act as technical design authority across both core identity platforms; Entra ID with hybrid directory services and Okta as well as identity governance and administration, privileged access management, PKI and certificate lifecycle, federation and single sign\-on, and modern authentication.
* Run the operational disciplines behind the service: incident and problem management for identity outages, change control, capacity and availability planning, and a documented escalation and on\-call model that holds across time zones.
* Design, implement and maintain IAM policies, procedures and standards to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of sensitive data and resources.
* Manage and lead a team (1\-3\) of identity engineers and analysts and building coverage so that every platform has more than one engineer, in more than one region, who can safely operate it.
* Drive standing privilege down across the estate: run the access certification and recertification cycle, enforce segregation of duties and least privilege, eliminate orphaned and dormant accounts, and bring service, workload and other non\-human identities under the same lifecycle discipline as people.
* Act as identity manager you will be working with the team and supporting internal audit, external audit and client or scheme assessments including SWIFT CSP, inc. producing evidence on request, owning remediation actions and closing findings to agreed dates.
* Automate the routine work out of the service: provisioning and deprovisioning driven from authoritative HR sources, policy and role\-based entitlement in place of ticket\-by\-ticket approval and reporting instrumented so identity risk is visible without a manual data pull.
* Own identity data quality and metrics, account ownership, lifecycle state, entitlement mapping and application registration as the foundation every downstream control, report and detection depends on.
* Lead directory and tenant consolidation and legacy platform decommissioning, including the absorption of acquired identity estates onto the strategic Entra ID and Okta platforms, working directly with the application teams that depend on those platforms rather than routing every migration through the identity team.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams \- security architecture, security operations, enterprise IT, HR, compliance and the business to assess IAM requirements and develop solutions that meet business needs.
* Manage external partners and vendors against their commitments, and contribute to forecasting and planning for identity licensing, tooling and headcount.
* Maintain IAM process documentation, including end\-user guidance, runbooks and team processes and procedures, to a standard that allows work to move between regions without loss.


**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need** 
 :
   

  

* This individual must be capable of working with internal and customer\-facing teams to facilitate process improvement and customer support resulting in an enhanced security posture, reduction in risk and improvement in end\-user experience. Excellent communication, strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential.
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 6 years in identity and access management and 3\+ years leading and directly managing an IAM team, with accountability for both a production service and an engineering backlog; experience in financial services a plus.
* Proven experience designing, implementing and managing complex IAM processes and solutions within large organizations.
* Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of both core platforms. Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory in a hybrid estate — tenant and forest design, synchronisation, conditional access, privileged role management and entitlement models. Okta — policy architecture, authentication journeys, application integration, lifecycle management and federation at scale.
* Production delivery experience across at least three of: identity governance and administration tooling, privileged access management such as CyberArk, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, federation and single sign\-on, and multi\-factor or passwordless authentication.
* Knowledge and implementation of key security concepts such as RBAC, zero trust, identity lifecycle automation, least privilege and identity governance, together with command of the underlying protocols SAML 2\.0, OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SCIM, Kerberos and LDAP.
* Automation and scripting ability sufficient to lead engineers credibly e.g. PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and the Okta management APIs with practical use of source control, pipelines and configuration\-as\-code applied to identity change.
* Demonstrated operational management discipline: service level definition and reporting, incident, problem and change management, and oversight of vendors or managed service providers.
* Direct experience owning identity controls through audit \- preparing evidence, defending design decisions to auditors or regulators, and closing findings.
* Understanding of a broad range of general information security domains, including networking, cybersecurity, governance and risk, and cloud.
* Strong leadership skills with a track record of successfully leading distributed and cross\-functional teams across time zones, including offshore or GCC\-based staff.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**What makes you stand out:**
* You have an operations mindset and an engineer's instinct; you see an inefficient process and immediately think of how to automate it away rather than staff it.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and are comfortable juggling a live service and a delivery roadmap at the same time.
* You are equally comfortable in both platforms and can reason about where a capability belongs — Entra ID or Okta — rather than defaulting to the one you know best.
* You build people as deliberately as you build platforms, and you measure your team by the cover and capability it has, not by the hours it works.
* You have experience in a Zero Trust program, or with securing non\-human identities including service accounts, workload identities and emerging agentic and AI workloads.


**Education / Certification Requirements:**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information security or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\) preferred.
* Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Administrator preferred.
* CISSP, CISM, CyberArk Defender or Sentry, or an equivalent identity governance credential preferred; ITIL foundation or equivalent service management training is a plus.


**Working environment:**
* 4 days' work from office
* Working hours aligned to India business hours, with overlap into CET / BST.
* Team distributed across UK, US and Latam locations; participation in an escalation and on\-call rotation should be expected.
* Travel requirements, for leadership meetings and conferences.

title: Collateral Management - Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Who we are looking for:**
 We are looking for a candidate with deep experience in Collateral Management to reduce credit risk by exchanging cash/securities with counterparties. Should have knowledge in the end to end functions including Onboarding activities ideally.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 Collateral management main focus is to reduce credit risk by exchanging eligible cash or securities between counterparties. The daily calculations are based on MTM of the underlying trades and results in sending Margin Calls, which in turn lead to agreeing transfers. Based on the agreements between our clients and the counterparties the Collateral team in India ensures that all the exposures are fully collateralized and the agreed collateral transactions settle as agreed. The critical onboarding process is particularly important.
   

  

**What you will be responsible for: As Officer you will:**
* End to End Margin call processing \- Process daily margin calls daily for all agreed clients, who will include banks and fund clients and both cash and security margin calls.
* Reconcile collateral balances, investigate and solve discrepancies; be the main point of contact/ escalations
* Fails investigation \- Checking the cash non\-receipt reports and the custody settlement system (MCH) and initiating correspondence with the client
* Reporting \- Generate a variety of reports, which includes client and internal reporting from an access database and Protocol.
* Portfolio reconciliations \- Completing any daily or ad hoc manual portfolio reconciliations.
* Interest Processing \- Month end interest statement generation, settling interest, updating interest agreements, and updating and validating interest rates.
* Ensure that the team meets accuracy and timeliness criteria.
* Carry out responsibilities fairly and impartially; create and maintain an engaged work environment.
* Assist in developing and implementing new workflow approaches and methods as well as system enhancements
* Collaborate with internal and external groups to identify, analyze and proactively resolve issues
* Be the key point of contact for internal/external clients in a most agile manner
* Provide inputs into hire, discipline, control work and terminate employment for direct reports and broader team as needed
* Provide inputs to promote, increase salary and bonus for direct reports and broader team as needed
* Provide coaching and development opportunities to staff
* Manage Performance Priorities and development plans
* Ensure SOPs/Job Aides/regulations are met and escalate as needed
* Comprehensive and demonstrated knowledge of overall process and operating model. Understand how Onboarding impacts OPS deliverables and plan to create an error free environment.
* Identify all risk issues, breaches and suspicious transactions and acts in accordance with the 'risk' escalation chain and operating procedures
* Execute on the risk framework changes and/or escalation chain changes. Ensure all Key controls are identified, implemented and adhered to
* Perform related duties as assigned (Projects \- India and Global)
* Provide back and coverage as required across EMEA/NA shift


**What We Value**
* These skills will help you succeed in this role
* Communicates effectively and accurately in English \- experience in facing clients
* Strong leadership, management, and organizational skills
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Ability to work on own initiative and proactive
* Very good management skills
* Self\- motivated, flexible, personable
* Good interpersonal skills and an understanding of the rudimentary aspects of the global financial industry and also to Collateral Management would be advantageous


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce


**Additional Requirements**
* Experience on Colline platform is a must
* Knowledge on Macros, SQL \& MS Access Database queries


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Service Delivery Manager – MSP (SDM) is the focal point of driving the overall technical services delivery to any MSP customer from Day 1 as the project goes live. SDM is introduced as the SPOC from Technical Services at the beginning of the new logo implementation through any of the packages available with Nexthink. As the project enters the run phase, the SDM manages the delivery of scoped Managed Services (hereafter referred to as “Accelerate”) to Nexthink’s MSP Partner \& their end customer. They play a pivotal role in supporting the MSP \& their customer to realise value from the Nexthink platform. The SDM is supported by one or more Professional Services Consultants (PSC) as well as other support functions like Partner Success Manager, Product Managers, Product Support and more over, backend teams creating new content over the Nexthink platform. The objective of SDM is to ensure that Accelerate services are aligned with the customer success plan, and the value metrics being tracked for the customer, ensuring a continuous value delivery to the customer.
   

  

 The role will coordinate the daily activities of the assigned PSCs, along with the other supporting Accelerate teams located globally and focus on the highest priorities and the biggest impact to the customer, while providing quality assurance, and delivering within the agreed service levels.
   

  

 The role is a combination of technical and business skills; in which the candidate would work with the MSP \& their customer right from doing DEX Management planning, document mutually agreeable success parameters, assigning BAU tasks to Accelerate PSCs and setting a governance to track the achievements of set goals \& ultimately, document and present value achieved to the customer. The candidate should have the ability to assess technical requests, have meaningful discussions with customer on their objectives and map the same back to different product features / packages offered by Nexthink. SDM would be responsible to create and drive the Service Delivery Strategy for the customer and would work internal and external stakeholders across the customer and partner organizations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the Managed Service Provider (MSP) and their customer, overseeing all deliverables outlined in the Services contract.
   

  

 Participate actively in Customer Steering Group meetings, collaborating with the MSP to discuss Nexthink's role in the customer's Digital Experience (DEX) strategy, understand the partner / customer’s priorities and effectively, ensure timely and qualitative delivery of services.
   

  

 Provide guidance to the PSC \& MSP to drive the Business as Usual (BAU) operations. Recommend new business use cases and engage with the customer / MSP to increase adoption of Nexthink.
   

  

 Analyze customer’s business needs \& pain areas through regular connects, understanding of TCDs from Service Desk \& various data seen from Nexthink. Identify opportunities to increase automation of issues \& leverage existing as well as custom created contents to deliver value to the customer’s / MSP business.
   

  

 Gain a deep understanding of the customer's business goals and objectives as outlined in the MSP contract, aligning Nexthink's deliverables with these objectives.
   

  

 Comprehend the customer's DEX goals, strategic plans, pain points, and limitations to offer informed advice on leveraging Nexthink effectively.
   

  

 Conduct thorough analysis of Nexthink data and present actionable insights to the customer. Create well documented presentations, capturing insights from data and provide recommendations.
   

  

 Organize and coordinate for regular governance calls with MSP as well as bi\-monthly / quarterly business review meetings with a focus on getting things done, based on CSP and mutually agreed road\-map.
   

  

 Collaboratively plan the Customer Success Plan and strategy with the PSM, Sales team, PSC \& SC regularly; ensure to update the CSP based on the customer’s priorities.
   

  

 Lead and manage the PSC / PSCs assigned to specific projects, ensuring their tasks and goals align with the Customer's Success Plan (CSP).
   

  

 Identify and advocate for automation opportunities that bring value to the customer. Prioritize and request custom automation or report creation as needed, working backend with the other support teams of Accelerate.
   

  

 Develop content tailored to customer requirements, collaborating with the Shared Services team for custom scripting, reports using external tools with Nexthink data, custom NQL queries.
   

  

 Support customer initiatives related to Nexthink operations, including existing and upcoming projects. Encourage customer participation in Technical Previews of new features.
   

  

 Organize regular product roadmap workshops to keep customers informed about new features and modules.
   

  

 Meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and take prompt action, including internal escalations or partner notifications, in case of any impacts on SLO achievement.
   

  

 Identify and fulfill agreed\-upon use cases, consistently delivering results quarter after quarter.
   

  

 Validate any new service / content requirements from the partner and raise the records in JIRA ticketing system. Assign tasks to self or PSC, post validation.
   

  

 Establish and maintain a regular communication cadence with the MSP and customer through weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings, ensuring that progress is tracked by PSCs.
   

  

 Maintain updated Action Trackers \& other relevant documents on OneDrive, including customer related insights and roadmap discussions. Update Salesforce records as required.
   

  

 Prepare all customer\-facing and internal deliverables, ensuring they meet high\-quality standards.
   

  

 Coordinate and communicate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Partner Success, to align Managed Services activities.
   

  

 Increase the footprint of Nexthink across different functions of the customer, within IT as well as non\-IT related usage. Enhance stickiness of Nexthink to ensure smooth renewal and possible product upsells.
   

  

 Escalate issues internally and externally when necessary to ensure prompt resolution. Follow\-up with Product Support or relevant resolver groups to ensure timely resolution of issues raised. Raise RED FLAGS to alert in case of any deviations.
   

  

 Stay informed about product development and releases at a level necessary to fulfill the above responsibilities, and inspire PSCs to innovate continuously to maximize Nexthink's value.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering preferred.


**Experience:**
* 8 \- 10 years of experience in technical consulting, analytics, and automation, with a preference for candidates with this background.
* Consulting\-based approach in previous roles coupled with good project management skills.
* Knowledge of Nexthink / competing products would be an advantage.
* Flexible to work in UK / US shifts


**Key Skills and Attributes:**
* Analytical Expertise: Proficient in analyzing data to identify pain points and opportunities, with a strong commitment to providing actionable insights and driving automation.
* Transformation Experience: Demonstrated experience in transformation projects, such as Win10 and O365 migrations.
* End User Computing (EUC) Mastery: Extensive technical knowledge of end user computing (EUC) management.
* Collaborative Aptitude: Skilled at collaborating with dispersed teams, including CTOs, product management, and support, to deliver the right solutions and innovate based on customer input.
* IT Operations Proficiency: Deep understanding of IT operations.
* Quick Learner: Ability to rapidly acquire knowledge of new technologies.
* Customer\-Centric: Proven ability to gather and manage customer feedback, comprehend customer pain points, and propose practical solutions.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong ability to engage with customers and collaborate effectively within a team.
* Problem Management: Exceptional problem\-solving skills to address complex issues effectively.
* Adaptability: Capability to excel in challenging environments and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Enthusiasm for Innovation: Passion for working in an international, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment and eagerness to learn and adopt new technologies.
* Technical Proficiency: Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Office 365, web browsers, and other standard EUC applications.


**Preferred:**
* Nexthink certified professional / previous experience of working with Nexthink or similar DEM tools.
* Practical knowledge of Windows, Office 365 \& overall EUC insights
* Understanding of SQL, XML, PowerShell, PowerBI would be ideal.
* Practical experience of data integration methods and technologies
+ in any of the following:
+ IT systems
+ Enterprise infrastructure management / Data Centers
+ Application development and management
+ Managed IT Services
+ Security
+ Analytics – EU data

* Project Management skills (ITIL, PMP)


**Additional Information**
 We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real\-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.
   

  

 With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.
   

  

 If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:
   

  

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.

**Description**
 We are seeking a talented, dedicated, and highly analytical Seller Manager to drive selection and in\-stock for Amazon sellers. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role on an important initiative at Amazon. This position requires a candidate with proven analytical skills with experience driving process improvement, thought leadership, and delivering results.
   

  

 The Seller Manager will be responsible for executing inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize customer experience, sales, margin and turns. They will be relentlessly focused on delivering high in\-stock rates for sellers in order to meet the needs of our customers. They will dive deep into core drivers of in\-stock performance for sellers, and proactively identify opportunities to improve tools and workflows. This role interacts closely with retail and operations business partners across Amazon, and is pivotal to the growth of this strategic initiative.
   

  

 The successful candidate will communicate effectively across teams and levels, while balancing the needs and requirements of internal and external customers. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize in a changing business environment will also be key. Our team culture is goal\-oriented, collaborative and driven to achieve results. We seek an individual who is motivated by a fast\-paced and highly entrepreneurial environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 ▪ Maintain excellent in\-stock rates for sellers across owned category and/or region
   

  

 ▪ Execute inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize sales, turns, and inventory health
   

  

 ▪ Monitor, analyze and own key performance indicators such as in\-stock rate, procurement lead time (PLT), fill rate, forecast accuracy and days of cover (DOC)
   

  

 ▪ Forecast and manage efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows and health for sellers, including forecasting, purchasing, and removing unproductive inventory
   

  

 ▪ Drive root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and project manage improvements with the ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
   

  

 ▪ Work with internal teams collaboratively, to help drive tools and process improvements that affect purchasing and procurement workflows, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually

* MBA
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

* Experience influencing C\-level executives

* Strong working knowledge of warehouse operations such as picking, packing, shipping, and data entry.
* Proficiency with warehouse management systems (WMS), inventory control software, and basic computer skills for data entry.
* Ability to read and interpret shipping documents, bills of lading (BOL), and inventory reports.

 About the Role
   

  

 The Debt Manager \- Flows \- Commercial Vehicle is responsible for planning, organizing, directing, and overseeing the activities of the collections department. This includes managing agencies associated with the company within the assigned territory. The role focuses on optimizing the efficiency of EMI recovery from customers while ensuring adherence to all bank guidelines, contributing to the broader organizational objectives.

* Follow up regularly with defaulting customers.
* Ensure adherence to collection processes and legal guidelines.
* Initiate recovery processes for absconded default customers.
* Recommend legal action for non\-recoverable cases and coordinate with the legal team for case closure.

 Education

* Strong organizational and planning skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Ability to manage and motivate teams and external agencies.
* Knowledge of legal guidelines and recovery processes.
* Proficiency in maintaining MIS and administrative records.

title: Growth Manager
description:
Job Title: Program Manager \- New Store Growth
 



 Function: Growth
 



 Level: Manager
 



 Location: HQ / Regional HQ
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a Program Manager to own and drive demand\-led growth for new stores and expanding cities, with a relentless focus on maximising total orders. This role will sit at the intersection of Growth, Category, Supply, Brand, Monetisation, and Product, ensuring that newly launched stores scale rapidly, capture high order volumes, and build sustainable demand momentum from day one.
 



 The person will strategise and execute targeted demand generation initiatives designed specifically to drive order growth. The role requires someone who is deeply strategic and capable of leading high\-stakes cross\-functional execution to scale order throughput across new store networks and city expansions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Define, strategise, and execute end\-to\-end demand growth playbooks for new stores and city expansions, centered on accelerating total order volume.
2. Partner with Monetisation teams to unlock high\-yield brand partnerships, sponsored placements and co\-marketing budgets that directly fuel order growth in new launch zones.
3. Collaborate with Category and Supply teams to ensure campaign SKUs are fully stocked and available in dark stores ahead of launch.
4. Work alongside Brand, Performance Marketing, and CRM teams to design the communication strategy for the new stores.
5. Run daily and weekly demand governance cadences, tracking execution timelines, cross\-functional dependencies, and order targets for new store launches.
6. Track demand\-side metrics including traffic, conversion, repeat behavior, and customer funnel drop\-offs.
7. Conduct root cause analyses on underperforming stores, designing corrective action plans across functions to recover the lost order potential.
8. Prepare weekly business reviews with insights, root causes, actions, owners, timelines, and impact tracking.
9. Develop repeatable, cross\-functional playbooks for new store openings to streamline launch execution, minimise time\-to\-scale, and ensure consistent order ramp\-up across new catchments



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 



1. 1\-2 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, revenue operations, business development, category growth, or program management.
2. Strong analytical skills with hands\-on comfort in Excel / Google Sheets, SQL, dashboards, and BI tools.
3. High ownership, structured problem solving, and strong follow\-through.
4. Strong stakeholder management across Growth, Category, Supply, Operations, Product, Analytics, and City teams.
5. Comfortable working with store\-level, SKU\-level, category\-level, and funnel\-level data.
6. Proven ability to identify root causes from data and drive cross\-functional action.
7. Ability to manage multiple stores / cities / categories simultaneously in a fast\-paced operating environment.
8. Prior experience in quick commerce, e\-commerce, grocery, retail, FMCG, food delivery, marketplace, or hyperlocal businesses will be preferred.

title: Global Process Owner - Integrated Business Planning
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Global Process Owner, Integrated Business Planning (IBP)**
**Function:** 
 Supply Chain Systems \& Process Excellence
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The
 **Global Process Owner (GPO), Integrated Business Planning (IBP)** 
 is responsible for designing, deploying, governing, and continuously improving the end\-to\-end planning processes that support the company's global Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) business. This role serves as the global business owner for Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and related planning processes enabled through SAP IBP, SAP S/4HANA, and associated planning technologies.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep supply chain planning expertise with strong business acumen and proven experience implementing and scaling SAP IBP and MRP capabilities across complex manufacturing environments. The role will ensure planning processes, systems, governance, master data, analytics, and organizational behaviors are aligned to support business growth, operational excellence, and supply chain resiliency.
   

  

 This individual will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, translating business requirements into scalable planning capabilities while driving adoption, utilization, and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Process Ownership**
* Serve as the global business process owner for Integrated Business Planning (IBP), S\&OP, demand planning, supply planning, inventory planning, and MRP processes.
* Define, document, and govern global planning standards, process flows, policies, and controls.
* Establish a scalable planning operating model that supports global manufacturing and supply chain operations.
* Maintain process governance frameworks, KPIs, roles, responsibilities, and operating rhythms.
* Ensure alignment between demand, supply, inventory, manufacturing, procurement, and fulfillment processes.


**SAP IBP Ownership \& Deployment**
* Lead deployment, optimization, and governance of SAP IBP across global operations.
* Own business requirements for Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Response \& Supply, and S\&OP capabilities within SAP IBP.
* Drive standardized utilization of SAP IBP processes, workflows, analytics, and planning methodologies.
* Partner with IT and system integrators on roadmap development, enhancements, testing, and system releases.
* Ensure SAP IBP capabilities are fully adopted and delivering measurable business value.


**MRP \& Planning Process Excellence**
* Establish global standards for MRP configuration, planning parameters, replenishment strategies, and planning governance.
* Drive improvements in material planning effectiveness, inventory performance, and supply responsiveness.
* Develop governance around planning master data including lead times, planning strategies, safety stock, sourcing rules, and planning calendars.
* Improve planning stability and decision\-making through enhanced planning policies and controls.
* Lead initiatives that optimize system\-generated planning outputs and reduce manual interventions.


**Business Transformation \& Change Management**
* Lead planning process transformation initiatives supporting business growth and operational maturity.
* Drive cross\-functional adoption of standardized planning processes.
* Develop training programs, playbooks, and governance mechanisms to ensure sustainable process compliance.
* Facilitate organizational change management activities during system deployments and business transformations.
* Act as a trusted advisor to planning, operations, procurement, and executive leadership teams.


**Analytics \& Performance Management**
* Define planning process KPIs and performance reporting frameworks.
* Establish measurement systems for forecast accuracy, plan attainment, inventory performance, capacity utilization, and service levels.
* Develop executive dashboards and planning analytics in partnership with business intelligence teams.
* Perform root cause analysis on planning performance gaps and drive corrective actions.
* Provide executive\-level insights and recommendations on planning effectiveness and business performance.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Collaborate with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Procurement Operations, Manufacturing, Order Fulfillment, Finance, Commercial Operations, and IT organizations.
* Lead global process councils and planning governance forums.
* Align system capabilities with evolving business requirements and strategic objectives.
* Support M\&A integration, new site launches, network expansion, and operational scaling initiatives.
* Drive end\-to\-end process integration across the entire supply chain planning ecosystem.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Systems, or related field.
* Minimum 10\-12 years of progressive supply chain experience with significant focus on planning processes, systems, and transformations.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading SAP IBP deployments, implementations, or large\-scale optimization initiatives.
* Proven experience implementing and governing MRP processes within SAP S/4HANA or equivalent ERP platforms.

 Area Debt Manager\-Recoveries \-Consumer Loans and Cross Sell

 – Collections

 The role bearer has the responsibility to manage a team and co\-ordinate the operational recovery activities for an area credit portfolio in their assigned territory.
