title: DEPUTY MANAGER
description:
**Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader**
 We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.
   

  

**Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities**
**Overall responsibilities and duties:**
**Responsibilities**
 The Buyer is responsible to develop and manage the supplier panel for a specific commodity segment, selecting suppliers according to Faurecia group criteria, apply purchasing policy, and develop suppliers to continuously improve QCD performance. The Buyer identifies and leads ideas and initiatives in order to improve the global productivity and achieve or surpass financial objectives. Additional responsibilities of the buyer are:
   

  

* Improve financial performance of the Division through supplier negotiations, resourcing and productivity actions
* Monitor supplier Quality, Cost and Delivery performance and challenge supplier when supplier is falling short of targets


**The Main Responsibilities Of The Role Are**
* Develop and execute segment Commodity Strategy;
* Define and lead activities aligned to Commodity Strategy
* Responsible for delivering purchasing budget, updating forecast, reporting monthly savings
* Support Program Buyers with sourcing of new segments and supplier Panel definition
* Pursue optimally economical costs for goods/services required, in conjunction with obtaining continual long term agreement savings opportunities
* Performs continual review and evaluation of the current supply base and also new potential suppliers through cross\-functional supplier audits/visits based on the criteria provided by Group
* Facilitate continuous improvement activities with the supply base to support VA/VE savings opportunities
* ECR/EO activity – obtain quotes for engineering changes, understand and challenge supply base assumptions
* Lead supplier VA/VE activity and participate in lean manufacturing workshops
* Progress savings from inception through to implementation
* Conduct management meetings to review and improve supplier performance
* Manage and understand supplier´s tool life and monitor/secure capacity
* Other duties and specific projects as identified to support commercial targets and supplier optimization ▪ Identify savings, update forecast file and follow through to completion. Take ownership and responsibility for actions under buyer, lead activity
* Identify savings at month end and cross\-reference against productivity file to confirm completion.
* Report savings each month to Manager and confirm with Controller that they are captured.
* Charge Back validation costs via QSS database for poor quality and delivery performance.
* Follow supplier debits from forecast to debit memo to receipt of cash
* Calculate retroactive debits/credits for late identified savings, ensure they are captured at month end, follow through to cash receipt or debit execution.
* Hold monthly supplier management reviews to identify savings gaps, get up to speed on quality issues, communicate FAS intentions, understand supplier glide path to target etc.
* Interface between department and plant or Commercial Business Unit.
* Issue PO for approval for changes required/authorized
* In event of supplier disruption to plant (quality or delivery), understand root cause/scope of issue and facilitate supplier interaction to help resolve issue
* Monitors of the Supplier Global Performance Measurement in terms of quality and service of the cost via the SBG reporting structures
* Follows market trends for specific commodities and raw materials
* Prepares and deploys Commodity Strategies \& Cost Models for various commodities
* Understand all cost break\-downs and challenge supply base accordingly to ensure cost is optimized
* Have the ability to fully understand cost models and be able to provide input towards generating a cost model


**Your profile and competencies to succeed**
**Minimum education level:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or related field.
   

  

**Experience**
* 12 years in automotive industry
* 12 years in purchasing functions
* SAP experience (preferred)


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Must have very good Excel and Word skills
* Strong communication skills
* Able to accommodate \~15% \- 20% travel (domestic \& international)
* Commitment to the highest ethical standards and willingness to adhere to Faurecia’s Code of Ethics and Code of Management
* Team Player


**What We Can Do For You**
* At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
* We are the seventh\-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast\-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in\-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
* We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net\-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1\.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.


**Why join us**
 FORVIA, a global automotive technology supplier, comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA.
   

  

 With over 137 500 people, including more than 12,000 R\&D engineers across 40\+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow. Composed of 6 business groups and a strong IP portfolio of over 12,400 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMs worldwide.
   

  

 In 2025, the Group achieved a consolidated revenue of 26\.2 billion euros prior to IFRS 5\. FORVIA SE is listed on the Euronext Paris market under the FRVIA mnemonic code and is a component of the SBF 120 index.
   

  

 FORVIA aims to be a change maker committed to foreseeing and making the mobility transformation happen. www.forvia.com

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
   

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**
 This is a leadership role where you will own the technology, maintenance, process and setting for the equipment for the line. You will possess deep expertise and will be viewed as the technology expert of the line/s.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 You will:
   

  

* Partner \& enable the line leader(s) to deliver the SQCDSM targets\-Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability \& Morale for the lines, to ensure Process stability; Participate in the DMS\- Daily Management systems meetings at the shift and line level
* Own the technology and process and centerline settings for the equipment and process and has deep technical mastery of the process and equipment; own the Progressive maintenance systems and work processes and the Progressive Maintenance Key Performance Indicators for the line/s along with Centerline Management systems; owns the Repairs \& Maintenance budget of the line
* Develop, own and execute the line/s preventive and time\-based maintenance systems and plans and builds capability of the team to execute themselves; Build (spends at least 50% of time) technical and maintenance skills of the technicians working in the shifts, so that they are able to operate and maintain their equipment themselves; be part of the PM Pillar, own all PM systems and work process at the line level and lead some of them at the department level
* Partner with the Asset and Reliability team for system improvement and execution of special maintenance tasks; be responsible for Change Management on the line/s, localization of spares and proper break\-down analysis and R\&M cost reduction for the line/s; represent the department/line/s as the site technology owner in the regional and global technology forums
* Assist in VSU for the new initiatives and enables the VSU team; help the line leader in internal and external benchmarking and reapplication; be the subject matter expert on one of the component categories and will be a trainer of PM related subjects for the plant


**What You Will Bring**
 A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
   

  

* Advanced knowledge (including AM\-Autonomous Maintenance Step 4 systems \& Progressive Maintenance Step 3\) \& skill to maintain the dedicated equipment(s)at basic conditions independently, including the execution of AM \& PM (BD\-Breakdown maintenance, planned maintenance) standards on dedicated equipment(s) and TPM \- Phase 3 \& 4 tools problem solving tools.
* The capability to lead a Role for the Line. Qualify and coach the next level SWP owners and drive the common opportunity areas across the line in PDCA\-Plan Do Check Adjust approach
* The capability to work as the Line Leader, developing and aligning goal/master plan for the line, deploying and managing IDP for the members, coaching team members on their performance management and career development


**Education / Certifications: Engineering qualification is a must**
 Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

 and

 powdered beverages,
 *Oreo* 
 and
 *Cadbury Bournvita* 
 biscuits, and
 *Halls* 
 and
 *Cadbury Choclairs Gold* 
 candies get safely into our customers hands—and mouths
 *.* 
 Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research \& Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 – the fourth time we’ve received this award.
   

  

 Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:

 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As the
 **Manager, Membership – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)** 
 , you will lead the execution, governance, and continuous improvement of U.S. Membership operations supporting Amgen's commercial contracting and market access organization. You will oversee customer eligibility, GPO alignments, customer onboarding, membership maintenance, contract alignment, customer master data governance, 340B/PHS eligibility management, rebate and pricing\-related customer support, and operational controls.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with Membership SMEs, Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Government Pricing, Customer Operations, Finance, Information Systems, MDM teams, wholesalers, GPOs, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready execution of Membership operations. You will lead a team of Associates and Senior Associates while supporting transition, capability building, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence across the Membership function.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Membership Operations Leadership*
* Lead end\-to\-end Membership operations including customer onboarding, eligibility validation, customer setup, system alignment, ongoing maintenance, reporting, and closeout activities.
* Ensure execution of activities within established SLAs, quality standards, operational controls, and compliance requirements.
* Oversee intake and triage activities for membership requests, declaration forms (DEC), roster updates, customer changes, and contract alignment activities.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues impacting customer eligibility, membership alignment, customer setup, and stakeholder satisfaction.


*Customer Eligibility \& Membership Governance*
* Lead governance of customer eligibility determinations, GPO participation validation, class\-of\-trade assessments, contract alignment reviews, and membership approvals.
* Oversee validation activities involving DEA, HIN, HIBCC, HRSA, OneKey, customer identifiers, legal entity hierarchies, and parent\-child relationships.
* Review and approve complex customer setup requests, hierarchy modifications, contract eligibility decisions, and compliance\-sensitive customer updates.
* Govern customer additions, drops, strategy changes, acquisitions, organizational restructures, and customer maintenance requests.


*Customer Master Data \& System Governance*
* Oversee customer setup and maintenance activities across HCM, GCPS, SAP, MDM, OneKey, and related commercial operations platforms.
* Ensure timely creation and maintenance of customer records, legal entity hierarchies, customer attributes, contract affiliations, and GPO alignments.
* Partner with MDM and Information Systems teams to resolve customer data issues, interface failures, hierarchy challenges, and system synchronization problems.
* Support UAT activities, system enhancements, process automation initiatives, and technology transformation efforts.


*Rebuttal, Escalations \& Exception Management*
* Lead customer eligibility dispute investigations, denial reviews, rebuttal activities, and exception resolution processes.
* Provide decision support and recommendations for disputed customer eligibility determinations involving GPOs, wholesalers, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure complete documentation, audit trails, business rationale, and stakeholder communications supporting membership decisions.
* Drive resolution of complex operational issues impacting pricing access, membership alignments, customer eligibility, rebates, chargebacks, and contract execution.


*340B, PHS \& Specialized Membership Programs*
* Oversee quarterly Public Health Service (PHS) and 340B eligibility maintenance activities, including OPA file reviews, customer additions, removals, and eligibility updates.
* Ensure timely maintenance of SAP flags, CPOCOT assignments, customer eligibility statuses, and contract alignments supporting 340B participation.
* Govern controls supporting wholesaler notifications, eligibility reporting, and system synchronization activities.
* Provide oversight for VA, Kaiser, OBU, IBU, Specialty Pharmacy, Hospital Coalition, , and other specialized Membership programs.


*Reporting, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement*
* Own Membership KPI reporting, SLA reporting, operational dashboards, management reporting, customer eligibility reporting, and ad hoc analytical requests.
* Lead trend analysis, root cause investigations, workload assessments, dispute reviews, and operational health monitoring.
* Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, reporting enhancements, and productivity initiatives.
* Support special projects, business initiatives, system implementations, and transformation efforts.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Support special projects, business initiatives, system implementations, and transformation efforts.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation supporting customer eligibility determinations, approvals, setup activities, roster updates, and membership decisions.
* Support SOX testing, internal audits, compliance reviews, and control monitoring activities.
* Proactively identify and mitigate operational, financial, compliance, and data quality risks.


*People Leadership, Transition \& Capability Building*
* Lead, coach, and develop Membership Associates and Senior Associates within AIN.
* Establish performance expectations, quality standards, career development plans, and capability development frameworks.
* Support hiring, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and workforce planning activities.
* Partner with ATO SMEs to establish SOPs, training plans, readiness criteria, governance models, and transition plans supporting migration of Membership activities into AIN.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is an experienced pharmaceutical commercial operations leader with expertise in customer eligibility, membership operations, contract administration, master data governance, market access operations, and stakeholder management. The individual should possess strong leadership, analytical, problem\-solving, and change\-management skills, with the ability to lead teams in a highly regulated environment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Commerce, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* 8 to 12 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial operations, Membership operations, Market Access, Customer Master Data, Managed Markets, Contracts \& Pricing, Revenue Management, or related business functions.
* 2\+ years of people leadership, project leadership, or process ownership experience.
* Strong analytical, operational, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in regulated environments with controls, governance, and compliance requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of U.S. pharmaceutical customer eligibility, GPO operations, customer master data management, Market Access, and Membership governance.
* Experience with GCPS, HCM, SAP, Model N, OneKey, HIBCC, HRSA/OPA, Tableau, Power BI, and related commercial operations systems.
* Knowledge of 340B, PHS, Hospital Coalition, Specialty Pharmacy, VA, Kaiser, OBU, IBU, customer onboarding, and eligibility processes.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting audits, SOX controls, governance programs, and operational transformation initiatives.

title: USA Properties Business Manager
description:
**PRIME DEVELOPERS US** 




*Job Description* 




**Property Business Manager** 




*(Based at Hyderabad Office, India \| Managing One US Commercial Property)* 




**Company** 





 Prime Developers – Texas\-based commercial real estate developer/owner\-operator (est. 2017\), managing retail, flex, and office plaza properties across Austin, Cedar Park, Leander, and Lewisville, TX.
 




**Location** 





 Hyderabad Office, India – in\-office role
 




**Scope** 





 One assigned US commercial property
 




**Reports To** 





 Company Leadership / Ownership
 




**Direct Reports** 





 On\-site Property Manager and ground staff at the assigned property
 




**Work Hours** 





 Overlap with US business hours (Central Time) required
 




**Reporting Cadence** 





 Regular reports to leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance
 




**About Prime Developers** 





 Prime Developers has offered real estate development and investment services since 2017, specializing in iconic commercial and residential properties across the Texas market. The company owns and operates a growing portfolio of multi\-tenant retail, flex, and office plazas, and is actively acquiring additional commercial spaces — creating an expanding need for hands\-on, accountable operational oversight across the portfolio.
 




**Role Overview** 





 Prime Developers is looking for a Property Business Manager, based at the company's Hyderabad office, to take full ownership of the day\-to\-day wellbeing, performance, and growth of one assigned US commercial property. This is not a ground\-up development role — the focus is on operating, maintaining, and growing an established building/commercial space after acquisition or completion.
 





 The person in this role will act as the single point of accountability for the assigned property, directing and coordinating an on\-site Property Manager and ground staff based in the US, while personally owning leasing/bookings, maintenance oversight, marketing, accounting coordination, and overall growth of the asset. Regular reports will be shared with leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own the end\-to\-end performance of the assigned commercial property — treat it like a business unit with full accountability for its upkeep and growth.
 



 • Exercise decision\-making authority on growth\-oriented initiatives for the property — leasing terms, budget allocation, capex, vendor contracts — and be able to justify each decision with clear financial and operational reasoning.
 **(This will discuss with client)** 




 • Direct and coordinate the on\-site Property Manager and ground staff (maintenance, leasing/front\-desk, vendors) from the Hyderabad office.
 



 • Oversee bookings, leasing, and occupancy — track vacancies, tenant renewals, and new leasing opportunities to maximize occupancy and revenue.
 



 • Manage maintenance operations — schedule repairs and preventive maintenance, track work orders, and ensure ground staff/vendors resolve issues promptly.
 



 • Coordinate accounting and financial oversight — track rent collection, operating expenses, budgets, and P\&L for each property in partnership with accounting/finance resources.
 **(If Applicable)** 




 • Drive marketing and growth initiatives — improve property visibility, tenant mix, and occupancy through marketing efforts and local partnerships.
 



 • Manage vendor and contractor relationships — sourcing, negotiating, and overseeing US\-based vendors for repairs, landscaping, security, and other services.
 **(Client Decision)** 




 • Ensure compliance with US property regulations, local codes, licensing, and insurance requirements applicable to each property.
 **(If applicable/required)** 




 • Provide regular reporting to leadership on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance status, and growth initiatives for the property.
 



 • Be ready to take on additional properties and support onboarding/operational setup as the company's portfolio grows.
 



**Requirements** 




 • MBA in Finance (or equivalent) with 2–3 years of relevant experience, including a demonstrated track record of making business/financial decisions and justifying them with sound reasoning and data.
 



 • Prior experience in property management, facilities management, or commercial real estate operations (US market experience strongly preferred but not mandate).
 



 • Demonstrated ability to manage a team remotely and hold on\-site staff accountable without being physically present at the property.
 



 • Working knowledge of leasing/occupancy management, basic accounting/P\&L, and vendor management.
 



 • Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable working significant overlap with US business hours.
 



 • Familiarity with property management or leasing software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, or similar) is a plus.
 **(These are software’s recommended but its client decision)** 



* • Highly organized, ownership\-driven mindset — comfortable being the accountable owner of an asset's outcomes rather than just a coordinator.

 The Animation Supervisor oversees the day\-to\-day operations of the animation department. They are responsible for expediting high\-quality character, creature, and object animation for photo\-realistic feature films.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

title: Vice President - Platform Engineering & Operations
description:

 You will lead a multi\-disciplinary team focused on building resilient, self\-healing platforms while overseeing global Tier 1 and Tier 2 operational support. * Tooling Innovation: Leverage AI/ML to predict potential system failures and optimize resource allocation.

* Cost Optimization: Drive the FinOps agenda, ensuring cloud consumption is transparent, attributed, and optimized.

**Required Qualifications**

* The "Automation First" Filter: A natural tendency to automate repetitive tasks and a disdain for "toil."

 Environmental Engineering.

 recycling plant.

 pelletizing, utilities and wastewater treatment.

 teams.

 established, including capacity, products, project budget, timeline, machinery suppliers, exact
 



 responsibilities and operational results.

title: Manager R&D
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Laboratory Setting, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)
   

  

**About Company:**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $45 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. While our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our global distributed team delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 As Manager, R\&D, you will lead a focused and diverse SPCI Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) team, driving cost optimization, project execution, continuous improvement. You will collaborate with global and cross\-functional partners to build a strong pipeline of VAVE initiatives and deliver measurable business impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the SPCI VAVE team and drive the strategy, development, and execution of cost\-out initiatives across programs.
* Deliver \~$5M or more in annual cost savings while developing and maintaining a strong \~$10M\+ cost\-out pipeline to support the following year’s savings commitments.
* Drive execution excellence by coordinating cross\-functional project teams, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule while maintaining or improving product quality.
* Generate and develop cost\-out opportunities using structured ideation and analysis techniques, including product cost analysis, should\-costing, costed BOM analysis, site material\-spend analysis, product teardown, competitive benchmarking, and VAVE methodologies.
* Engage effectively with global partners and stakeholders, communicate progress, highlight risks and opportunities, and proactively seek support when required.
* Provide leadership, supervision, and coordination across project management and engineering design activities for VAVE projects as part of the programs.
* Partners with project leaders to identify and address project risks early, establish clear mitigation plans, and remove barriers to successful execution.
* Collaborate closely to develop robust Design Verification Plans (DVPs) supporting project implementation.
* Identify process gaps and establish standard work and PPI systems to strengthen execution and drive continuous improvement. Apply PPI and Lean methodologies and support PPI, Keys, and Lean initiatives.
* Develop and execute the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), including effective management of resources and project expenses.
* Establish and maintain the team's proficiency matrix and resource\-loading plans to ensure the right capabilities and capacity are available to meet program priorities.
* Mentor, coach, and develop team members, providing guidance and opportunities that support their continued professional and technical growth.
* Perform all responsibilities in alignment with the Code of Ethics, Diversity \& Inclusion principles, and the 4\-I Values.


**Required Qualifications, Skills And Competencies**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 10\+ years of engineering experience (8\+ years with a Master’s degree), with strong experience in sustenance engineering and Cost\-Out/VAVE project execution.
* 3\+ years of leadership and multi\-project management experience, including management of programs with \~25\+ concurrent projects.
* Proven track record of delivering approximately $5M\+ in cost savings and building and managing a significant Cost\-Out/VAVE pipeline.
* Strong expertise in VAVE and product cost optimization, with hands\-on experience in product cost analysis, should\-costing, costed BOM analysis, material\-spend analysis, product teardown, and competitive benchmarking.
* Proficiency in stage\-gate and technical review processes, with experience driving projects through key engineering and business milestones.
* Strong program management skills, including planning, prioritization, execution, risk management, resource allocation, and delivery against commitments.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution excellence across multiple cross\-functional initiatives, delivering projects on schedule while maintaining or improving product quality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical, business, and leadership audiences.
* Strong people leadership and talent development skills, including mentoring, coaching, capability development, resource planning, and performance management.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to support identification of root causes and drive effective solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Competencies**
* Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; MBA is an added advantage.
* Proven ability to lead strategic, cross\-functional initiatives and translate strategy into actionable plans and measurable results.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of PPI, Lean, and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Working knowledge of regulatory requirements, product certifications, and applicable engineering standards, preferably in a regulated product development environment.
* Ability to operate effectively in a global matrix organization, build strong cross\-functional relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Ability to interpret complex simulation, experimental, and engineering data and translate insights into sound technical and business decisions.

 \- Post Graduate (MBA's / Masters) degree in Finance or Business Administration
   

  

 Certifications if any \- Any certification related to research is preferred, but not mandatory
   

  

**Experience Range**

**Foundational Skills** 
 \*
   

  

* Hands\-on experience of Industry/Market level databases such as Gartner, Wood Mackenzie, IDC, BMI, EMIS, Frost \& Sullivan, Euromonitor, SNL, Nielsen, etc.

description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Eloqua \- Manager, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by implementing and configuring Oracle's suite of applications. Your role will involve managing the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization, confirming seamless integration and utilization of business applications. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on delivering strategic solutions that align with client objectives and enhance their business processes.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will be responsible for supervising and developing teams, managing client service accounts, and driving client engagement workstreams. You will leverage your leadership skills to inspire your team, navigate complex situations, and deliver quality outcomes. Your role will involve strategic planning, mentoring junior staff, and maintaining accountability for project success. You are expected to embrace technology and innovation, using these tools to enhance delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to deepen your understanding of business contexts and develop your personal brand. You will be instrumental in building meaningful client relationships and delivering solutions that meet their strategic needs.
   

  

**Experience**
* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud and enterprise marketing automation solutions.
* Experience leading multiple end\-to\-end Oracle Eloqua implementations, enhancements, integrations, and campaign transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, campaign automation, CRM integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, campaign specialists, administrators, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Marketing Automation, CRM, Lead Management, Customer Journeys, Campaign Management, Analytics, Data Integration, and enterprise marketing technology ecosystems.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, enhancement, and support of Oracle Eloqua marketing automation solutions.
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of marketing automation initiatives including demand\-generation programs, lead\-nurturing journeys, event campaigns, audience segmentation, email campaigns, landing pages, forms, and automated customer and prospect journeys.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into scalable and reusable Eloqua solution designs and automation strategies.
* Lead requirement\-gathering workshops and solution\-design sessions with Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Data, Analytics, and Operations teams.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and marketing stakeholders and recommend appropriate campaign designs, segmentation strategies, personalization approaches, lead\-management processes, and marketing automation capabilities.
* Own technical and functional design decisions and ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data\-governance, and marketing\-technology standards.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution designs, campaign specifications, integration mappings, testing strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Eloqua projects, campaigns, and workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, integration issues, campaign\-processing challenges, and platform limitations and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support, internal technology teams, application owners, and third\-party vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, integrations, and technical escalations.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and ensure clear communication on scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, CRM, Technology, Data, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Eloqua solution architecture and define scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end integrations and data flows across Eloqua, CRM, CDP, middleware, analytics, and third\-party applications.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases to present Oracle Eloqua features and proposed solutions.Present architecture, campaign flows, integrations, and implementation approaches to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define suitable solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, and resource requirements
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Eloqua projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Eloqua Technical Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of complex Eloqua Campaign Canvas and Program Canvas solutions.
* Design and manage campaign orchestration involving segmentation, decision rules, personalization, lead nurturing, lead scoring, routing, and automated communications.
* Oversee the creation and management of:
* Email campaigns
* Landing pages
* Forms
* Progressive profiling
* Segments
* Shared filters
* Contact fields
* Custom objects
* Campaign Canvas
* Program Canvas
* Lead\-scoring models
* Campaign reporting and dashboards
* Establish reusable campaign templates, design standards, naming conventions, folder structures, and asset\-management practices.
* Define and govern audience segmentation and personalization strategies based on customer, prospect, campaign, behavioral, and CRM data.
* Lead implementation of lead\-nurturing programs and automated journeys across different stages of the customer and prospect lifecycle.
* Design and manage lead\-scoring models and lead\-management processes, including qualification, routing, and hand\-off to CRM or sales teams.
* Ensure effective synchronization of contacts, leads, campaigns, responses, opportunities, and other marketing data between Eloqua and CRM applications.
* Establish campaign quality\-assurance processes covering configuration review, end\-to\-end testing, integration testing, data validation, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Monitor campaign processing, integration jobs, CRM synchronization, and data flows and proactively resolve failed\-processing or configuration issues.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for complex campaign, data, integration, synchronization, and platform issues and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Review overall Eloqua platform usage and recommend improvements related to scalability, performance, usability, and operational efficiency.


**Integration and Data Management**
* Lead and govern integrations between Oracle Eloqua and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of campaign, contact, lead, opportunity, response, consent, and marketing\-preference data flows across integrated applications.
* Design and manage integrations between Eloqua and:
* Salesforce CRM
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Event\-management platforms
* Webinar platforms
* Websites
* Analytics platforms
* Data warehouses
* Customer Data Platforms
* Third\-party marketing applications
* Experience with REST APIs, web services, SFTP/file\-based integrations, middleware, batch integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Define source\-to\-target mappings and ensure appropriate data transformation, validation, synchronization, and error\-handling mechanisms.
* Promote data\-quality standards across Eloqua and connected marketing applications.
* Ensure appropriate management of customer consent, subscriptions, preferences, and marketing communication eligibility.


**Campaign Analytics and Optimization**
* Lead analysis of marketing and campaign performance, including:
* Email deliverability
* Open and click engagement
* Campaign responses
* Conversion performance
* Audience and segmentation effectiveness
* Lead\-nurturing performance
* Lead\-scoring effectiveness
* Campaign operational metrics
* Work with business and analytics teams to define campaign KPIs, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Translate campaign and engagement data into actionable recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and customer engagement.
* Identify automation and optimization opportunities to reduce manual campaign activities and improve scalability.
* Evaluate new Eloqua capabilities, third\-party applications, and marketing technologies and recommend adoption based on business value.


**Platform Governance and Administration**
* Define and maintain Eloqua platform\-governance standards including:
* Naming conventions
* Folder structures
* Campaign standards
* Templates
* Asset\-management standards
* Documentation standards
* Access controls
* Environment housekeeping
* Oversee Eloqua user provisioning, role\-based access, permissions, and periodic access reviews.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of responsibilities and alignment with security and governance requirements.
* Establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), campaign checklists, solution documentation, reusable templates, and best\-practice frameworks.
* Drive platform\-health reviews and identify opportunities for cleanup, optimization, and standardization.
* Ensure campaign and platform processes align with applicable data privacy, consent, preference\-management, and digital\-marketing compliance requirements.


**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage a team of Associates, Senior Associates, developers, campaign specialists, and Eloqua administrators.
* Provide technical and functional guidance and act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Eloqua issues.
* Allocate work, manage priorities, monitor delivery, and ensure appropriate resource and capacity planning.
* Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to functional, technical, security, quality, and operational standards.
* Mentor team members through technical sessions, knowledge\-sharing, coaching, and hands\-on guidance.
* Provide regular performance feedback and support career and capability development within the team.
* Establish development, campaign, testing, integration, and deployment best practices across the team.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, solution reviews, status discussions, and issue\-resolution sessions.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and mitigation plans clearly to business and technology leadership.
* Build strong relationships across Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Operations, Data, Analytics, and other stakeholder groups.
* Support resource planning, project estimation, workload management, delivery forecasting, and prioritization.
* Support proposals, solution estimations, technical presentations, demonstrations, and pre\-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, campaign accelerators, templates, frameworks, and automation components.
* Drive continuous improvement across Eloqua implementation, campaign delivery, platform administration, integrations, and support processes.
* Contribute to the broader Marketing Technology roadmap and recommend enhancements to platform capabilities, integrations, analytics, automation, and user adoption.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of Campaign Canvas, Program Canvas, segmentation, email campaigns, forms, landing pages, contact management, custom objects, shared filters, lead scoring, and campaign reporting.
* Strong understanding of marketing automation concepts including demand generation, campaign orchestration, lead nurturing, personalization, segmentation, lead management, and campaign analytics.
* Strong experience integrating Oracle Eloqua with Salesforce, Oracle Sales, or comparable enterprise CRM applications.
* Strong understanding of marketing and CRM data models and data movement across integrated applications.
* Experience managing complex marketing automation programs involving multiple stakeholders, technologies, integrations, and dependencies.
* Strong experience in solution design, requirements analysis, testing, deployment, production support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root\-cause analysis and recommend scalable solutions.
* Experience defining and monitoring marketing KPIs, operational metrics, dashboards, and campaign\-performance reporting.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, presentation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a dynamic delivery environment.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing technical and functional team members.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with Oracle CX Sales Cloud / Oracle Fusion Sales, including REST/SOAP web services, integrations, Application Composer, Groovy scripting, and reporting.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM, particularly campaign, lead, contact, opportunity, and marketing\-integration processes.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, SFTP/file\-based integrations, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with marketing analytics, BI/reporting, and data\-visualization platforms.
* Understanding of email deliverability, subscription and preference management, consent management, data privacy, and digital\-marketing compliance.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, testing, release management, and defect resolution.
* Oracle Eloqua or related Oracle Marketing / CX certifications are desirable.
* Exposure to Customer Data Platforms such as Oracle Unity and the activation of customer segments and attributes into Eloqua is an added advantage.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Data Infrastructure \& Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate \& business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data \& platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests.
   

  

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SME, drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully\-designed solutions. Additionally, train/mentor the Test Automation team and help with creating dashboards for the reporting purposes.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Developing testing automation that provides timely, useful, and actionable independent insight on the operational health of Bank of America’s processes.
* Work closely with process owners in the Front\-Line Units and Control Functions (FLUs/CFs) to obtain an understanding of their processes, including underlying data, flows, and controls, and to identify risks to successful execution, so that appropriate testing and monitoring can be developed.
* The processes to be assessed span across multiple Products, Regulations and Enterprise Processes. The outputs of the methodologies will be used to drive process improvements and timely detection and reporting of errors.
* The role requires being able to document and verbally explain the intuition and details behind the methodologies in a manner that is clear, concise, and consumable for a broad set of audiences that include key stakeholders across the Bank, as well as auditors and regulators.
* The Test Tools and Automation SME will then convert the test requirements into automated tests via Python and SQL.
* Enabling automatic test document generation from code
* Use programming skills and knowledge of software development lifecycle principles
* Design and develop and implement models and tests
* Produce clear, concise and repeatable technical documentation for models and/or tests
* Responsible for creating and revising code for data retrieval/manipulation when needed
* Responsible for securing testing data that meets the needs / supports given test design
* Independently gather test scripting and data requirements and work with data partners to ensure appropriate test design and sampling requirements are incorporated into the Test Plans
* Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements
* Perform debugging and code reviews to ensure quality of code.
* Ensure accuracy and quality development and hold validation session with the stakeholders to get a sign\-off .
* Ensure adherence to the SLA’s / Metrics – productivity, turnaround\-time and accuracy.
* Communicate regularly with management and other support colleagues.
* Manage stakeholders with respect to business deliverables.
* Drive projects independently and ensure timely deliverables.
* Train/Mentor the team in case of any issues


**Requirements:**
**Experience : 8 \- 10 yrs**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

* Graduates or Post\-Graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering B.Tech/B.E./M.C.A

description:
Manager – Quality Audit (Order to Cash
   

  

**Job Title: Manager – Quality Audit (Order to Cash)**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Manager – Quality Audit to lead the Quality Management Framework for Order to Cash (OTC) operations across Billing, Cash Application, Collections, and Dispute Resolution. This role will be accountable for designing and sustaining a disciplined, repeatable, and data\-driven audit program that improves operational accuracy, strengthens internal controls, and connects quality outcomes to measurable business performance. The Manager will collaborate closely with vendor partners and cross\-functional stakeholders to define requirements, co\-build audit solutions, and drive successful deployment of audit workflows, risk\-based sampling, defect management, RCA/CAPA processes, and quality performance reporting across OTC operations. The role will also establish globally aligned audit standards, governance routines, and calibration practices to ensure consistency, transparency, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will combine strong OTC process expertise, audit and controls knowledge, leadership capability, and a proven ability to convert quality insights into sustained operational improvement and service excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Management Framework Leadership:** 
 Lead the end\-to\-end quality audit program for OTC processes and define enterprise standards for audit execution, governance, and continuous improvement across regions and teams.
   

  

**Audit Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Design and run transaction\-level audits across Billing, Cash Application, Collections, and Dispute Resolution using approved scorecards, evidence requirements, and quality dimensions such as SOP adherence, documentation, approvals, coding accuracy, outcome quality, and closure/completion.
   

  

**Sampling Methodology:** 
 Establish and maintain risk\-informed sampling methodologies by process and subprocess, with clear rules for ramp\-up, stabilization, and run\-rate operations; increase sample rates based on repeat defects, declining quality trends, new transitions, or elevated business risk.
   

  

**Error Taxonomy \& Calibration:** 
 Standardize critical and non\-critical error definitions, promote consistent scoring through calibration sessions, and resolve audit disputes through fact\-based review and governance escalation when needed.
   

  

**Defect Management, RCA \& CAPA:** 
 Own the defect management process, including centralized defect logging, trend analysis, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, containment, effectiveness validation, and closure discipline.
   

  

**Governance, Controls \& Compliance:** 
 Strengthen governance by ensuring adherence to internal controls, audit standards, SOX/statutory requirements, and approved operating procedures. Support control documentation, audit readiness, and remediation tracking in partnership with internal and external audit stakeholders.
   

  

**Performance Reporting \& Business Insight:** 
 Develop and socialize scorecards, dashboards, and management reporting that provide visibility to audit pass rates, defect trends, critical error rates, rework, first\-time\-right, process accuracy, CAPA closure, and links to business outcomes such as customer experience, revenue protection, working capital, and SLA performance.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management:** 
 Act as the primary quality contact for operations leaders, process owners, transition teams, and cross\-functional partners. Facilitate daily quality huddles, weekly calibrations, and monthly quality and operations reviews to drive issue resolution and decision\-making.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement \& Automation:** 
 Identify recurring pain points and conversion opportunities for SOP updates, job aids, training refresh, control redesign, and automation of sampling, audit execution, defect tracking, and reporting. Champion use of digital tools and analytics to improve audit efficiency and traceability.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Capability Building:** 
 Recruit, coach, and develop quality analysts or auditors; set performance expectations; create capability plans; and build a prevention\-led quality culture that drives accountability, consistency, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Transition \& Stabilization Support:** 
 Provide quality oversight for migrations, scope expansions, and process changes by validating readiness criteria, reviewing documentation, increasing audit coverage where appropriate, and ensuring a controlled handoff to steady\-state operations.
   

  

**Customer and Business Outcome Focus:** 
 Ensure audit findings are translated into meaningful operational actions that reduce escalations, improve service quality, protect cash flow, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen overall OTC health.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.
   

  

 8–10 years of progressive experience in Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, Finance Shared Services, Quality Audit, Controls, or Operational Excellence roles.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience across key OTC sub\-processes such as Billing, Cash Application, Collections, Dispute Resolution, and AR reporting or reconciliations. Working with
   

  

 3\+ years of people leadership or matrix leadership experience in a shared services, GBS, BPO, or complex operations environment.
   

  

 Experience designing or managing audit frameworks, scorecards, sampling plans, defect management, and RCA/CAPA processes.
   

  

 Strong familiarity with internal controls, SOX or compliance requirements, and process documentation standards.
   

  

**Certifications**
 Preferred: CPA, CA, CIA, CISA, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, Lean, or equivalent quality / audit certification. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), PMP, Quality Management certifications, or other finance controls / continuous improvement credentials.
   

  

**General Accountabilities And Job Information**
 This role typically operates in a global or regional shared services environment and may require collaboration across time zones and functional boundaries.
   

  

 Success in this role is measured through sustained improvements in audit accuracy, reduction in repeat defects and rework, stronger compliance adherence, improved governance effectiveness, and demonstrable impact to OTC business outcomes. Strong coaching and people\-development capability with a track record of building high\-performing, quality\-focused teams.

title: Financial Inclusion District Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vedavaag Systems Ltd is a technology\-driven company headquartered in India, focusing on innovative solutions that support governance, financial services, and inclusive growth. The organization works closely with public and private sector partners to extend essential services to underserved and rural communities. Vedavaag Systems Ltd emphasizes operational efficiency, customer\-centric service delivery, and sustainable models that promote financial inclusion. The company offers opportunities for professionals interested in social impact, technology\-enabled service delivery, and expanding access to financial services across diverse regions in India.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Financial Inclusion District Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Telangana, India. This role oversees district\-level financial inclusion initiatives, including planning, implementing, and monitoring programs that extend banking and financial services to underserved communities. The person in this role will manage field teams, coordinate with partner banks and agencies, track performance against outreach and service targets, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and guidelines. Daily responsibilities include reviewing operational reports, resolving escalated issues, conducting site visits, facilitating community engagement activities, and ensuring quality customer service and data accuracy. The District Manager will also promote inclusive practices, support training and capacity building for staff, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service delivery.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and monitor district\-level financial inclusion initiatives.
* Experience in Diversity \& Inclusion and Employee Engagement to foster an inclusive, motivated, and high\-performing field workforce.
* Excellent Communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and community stakeholders.
* Background in banking, financial services, or financial inclusion programs is highly beneficial.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare performance reports, and use insights to drive improvements in outreach and service quality.
* Proven people\-management experience, including supervising field teams and conducting training and performance evaluations.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, social sciences, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site across district locations in Telangana and willingness to travel within the assigned region as needed.

title: Regional Launch Director SIR
description:
**Job Description Summary**
* Job Description


 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the
   

  

 launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional
   

  

 collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional
   

  

 launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing
   

  

 mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the
   

  

 short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close

**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the short and long term.  Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

* Together with Supply Chain and Platforms, drive decisions for regional product allocations if needed, at\-risk manufacturing and API purchases to optimize upsides and mitigate risk.

**Essential Requirements**
