* A minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in the GLP\-1 or Biosimilar field
* Sales/commercial leadership and mindset
* Sound Project Management experience (min 5 years)
* Hands\-on approach combined with business acumen, strategic thinking, and pragmatism
* Experience in managing/leading cross\-functional matrix teams
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills
* Stakeholder engagement with respect for different cultures and diverse groups.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Agility, Brand Awareness, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Data Strategy, Digital Marketing, Go\-To\-Market Strategy, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Marketing Strategy, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Marketing

title: Senior CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area.
   

  

 The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C\&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals.
   

  

 The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C\&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations.
* To prepare C\&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan.
* Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level.
* Track progress of C\&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities.
* Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards.
* Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem\-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met.
* Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success.
* Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management.
* Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule.
* Well versed with risk\-based approaches to C\&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE)
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C\&Q.
* Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensures C\&Q non\-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities


**Working Conditions**
* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 10\-15 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects.
* Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* In\-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta\-V, 800xA, etc.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage.
* Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results\-oriented mindset.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Manager - Custom Clearance (Ghatkoapar & JNPT) - 2 positions
description:
**Company Description** 
 Transcon Freight Systems Pvt Ltd is a logistics specialist providing comprehensive transportation solutions for a wide range of clients. Headquartered in Mumbai, India, the company supports global operations through offices in Houston, USA and Antwerp, Belgium. Transcon focuses on efficient, reliable movement of goods across international routes, offering services tailored to diverse industry needs. Team members work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment that values accuracy, accountability, and customer\-focused service.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Manager \- Custom Clearance (Ghatkopar \& JNPT) is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end customs clearance operations at designated locations. The role includes managing documentation, coordinating with customs authorities and other regulatory bodies, and ensuring timely clearance of import and export consignments. The manager will supervise operational teams, monitor compliance with customs regulations, and resolve issues related to shipments, duties, and inspections. Daily activities involve communicating with clients and internal stakeholders, tracking cargo status, optimizing workflows, and maintaining accurate records and reports. This role also includes identifying process improvements, managing vendor and agency relationships, and supporting senior management with operational insights.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong analytical skills to interpret customs regulations, assess documentation accuracy, and solve operational issues.
* Operations management skills to lead customs clearance processes, coordinate activities at Ghatkopar and JNPT, and optimize workflows.
* Effective communication skills to interact with clients, customs officials, internal teams, and external partners.
* Inventory management skills to track cargo movement, maintain updated records, and support efficient logistics planning.
* Customer service skills to handle client queries, manage expectations, and ensure a professional, solution\-oriented approach.
* Knowledge of Indian customs laws, port procedures (especially JNPT), and documentation requirements for imports and exports.
* Experience in freight forwarding, logistics, or customs brokerage, preferably in managerial or supervisory roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain, commerce, or a related field; professional certifications in customs or logistics are an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site, manage multiple priorities, and maintain accuracy under time\-sensitive conditions.

title: Assistant Manager / Manager - OTC Settlement & Collateral
description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Assistant Manager / Manager \- OTC Settlement \& Collateral**
**Office Location \- Mumbai, Airoli**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced professional to join our Capital Markets Operations team as an Assistant Manager / Manager.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end OTC Derivatives Operations, including trade lifecycle management, pre and post\-settlement activities, Nostro reconciliations, collateral management, margin call processing, dispute resolution, and corporate actions. The ideal candidate should possess strong operational expertise, stakeholder management skills, and hands\-on experience in driving automation initiatives using AI, Agentic Bots, and Intelligent Process Automation solutions.
   

  

**OTC Operations \& Settlement**
* Manage end\-to\-end OTC trade lifecycle processes across various asset classes including FX, Equities, Rates, and Credit Derivatives.
* Oversee pre\-settlement and post\-settlement activities, ensuring timely and accurate settlement of trades.
* Investigate and resolve settlement failures, breaks, and operational discrepancies.


**Nostro Reconciliations**
* Perform daily cash and securities Nostro reconciliations.
* Investigate reconciliation breaks and coordinate with counterparties, custodians, and internal stakeholders for timely resolution.
* Ensure aging items are minimized and tracked through closure.
* Prepare MIS and reconciliation metrics for management review.


**Collateral Management \& Margin Operations**
* Manage collateral allocation, optimization, substitutions, and collateral movements.
* Oversee daily variation margin, initial margin, and regulatory margin calculations.
* Process and validate margin calls with counterparties.
* Ensure compliance with ISDA, CSA, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor collateral exposures and mitigate settlement and counterparty risks.


**Dispute Management**
* Investigate and resolve margin and valuation disputes with counterparties.
* Track dispute aging and implement root cause analysis to prevent recurring issues.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation and audit trails.


 Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS\&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services.
   

  

 Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 SS\&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

title: Global Command Center Operations Senior Manager
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
 NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Global Command Center Operations Manager is responsible for leading the 24x7 Global Command Center responsible for monitoring, event correlation, incident response, escalation coordination, operational communications, and service reliability across critical infrastructure, applications, networks, job scheduling, and telephony services. This role provides operational leadership for geographically distributed teams and ensures that Command Center functions consistently meet availability, resiliency, compliance, and service management expectations.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, metrics\-driven operations leader with strong ITIL/ITSM discipline, deep infrastructure operations awareness, and the ability to translate technical events into clear executive\-level business impact. This leader will drive process maturity, automation, alert quality, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across global operations while maintaining a high\-accountability and service\-focused team culture.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
 Operational Leadership and Service Reliability
   

  

* Lead day\-to\-day and shift\-based 24x7 Global Command Center operations across monitoring, triage, escalation, incident communications, and operational coordination.
* Oversee functional coverage for server operations monitoring, network operations monitoring, application operations monitoring, lab operations monitoring, Helix/Control\-M job scheduling, Windows and Linux L2 support, and Genesys/IP telephony operations.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, uptime expectations, alert response targets, escalation procedures, and operational performance metrics.
* Drive proactive monitoring, event correlation, alert tuning, runbook quality, and automation to reduce noise, improve response times, and minimize manual intervention.
* Maintain operational readiness for high\-severity events, business\-impacting incidents, planned maintenance windows, and critical change activity.


 Incident, Problem, and Change Management
   

  

* Lead Command Center participation in major incidents by coordinating bridge engagement, ensuring role clarity, maintaining focus on service restoration, and escalating to appropriate technical and leadership teams.
* Partner with Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, infrastructure, application, security, and vendor teams to support fast restoration and durable corrective actions.
* Review incident trends, recurring alerts, failed jobs, chronic infrastructure events, and escalation patterns to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support post\-incident reviews, root cause analysis, known error documentation, corrective/preventive action tracking, and lessons\-learned adoption.
* Ensure Command Center teams follow approved change, incident, problem, access, and communication processes.


 Governance, Compliance, and Audit Readiness
   

  

* Create, maintain, and enforce SOPs, technical runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, operational checklists, and process documentation.
* Ensure operational evidence is complete, accurate, timely, and defensible for internal reviews, SOX audits, control testing, and regulatory inquiries.
* Partner with security, risk, compliance, and technology owners to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, access protocols, and data protection expectations.
* Establish governance routines to review operational metrics, control gaps, aged actions, process exceptions, and continuous improvement progress.


 Team Leadership and Talent Development
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of team leads, engineers, analysts, and operations specialists across multiple shifts and domains.
* Own staffing plans, shift coverage, onboarding, training, performance expectations, development plans, succession planning, and quality accountability.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, operational discipline, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to monitor team engagement, morale, readiness, skill gaps, escalation behaviors, and adherence to operational standards.


 Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs including availability, SLA adherence, alert volume, alert aging, MTTA/MTTR, escalation effectiveness, incident recurrence, job failure trends, change\-related incidents, and runbook compliance.
* Prepare concise executive\-level updates on operational health, incident trends, risk areas, improvement plans, staffing readiness, and service reliability.
* Use data to identify systemic issues, automation opportunities, process bottlenecks, and training needs.
* Partner with tool owners and engineering teams to improve dashboards, observability, event correlation, workflow automation, and operational intelligence.


 Vendor and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Manage vendor engagement related to operations tools, monitoring platforms, job scheduling, infrastructure services, telecom platforms, and support escalations.
* Hold vendors and internal service teams accountable for service delivery, timely escalation, issue ownership, and contractual/service commitments.
* Serve as an operational bridge between senior leadership, infrastructure teams, application teams, security, service management, vendors, and site leadership.
* Support budget planning, resource planning, capacity needs, tool rationalization, and operational investment recommendations.


**Skill Requirements/Preferences**
 Required Skills and Experience
   

  

* 12\+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure operations, technology operations, command center, NOC/SOC/AOC, service management, or related enterprise technology functions.
* 8\+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers, team leads, engineers, analysts, or shift\-based operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing global or multi\-site operations with cross\-functional responsibility for service reliability, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and executive communication.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, major incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and service level management.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, alerting, ITSM, and job scheduling platforms such as ServiceNow, Helix, Control\-M, SolarWinds, Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, AppDynamics, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server operations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, network fundamentals, firewalls, VPNs, SD\-WAN, DNS/DHCP, telephony/VoIP, and application operations monitoring.
* Experience creating operational dashboards, performance reporting, service health reviews, incident trend analysis, and continuous improvement plans.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, access control, SOX, control evidence, policy adherence, and operational governance processes.
* Strong vendor management, escalation management, service accountability, and stakeholder communication capabilities.


**Preferred Technical Skills**
* Experience with hybrid cloud environments including Azure, Oracle Cloud, AWS, VMware vSphere, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience improving event management through alert rationalization, event correlation, automation, AIOps, or runbook orchestration.
* Familiarity with resiliency practices including disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity planning, lifecycle management, backup/recovery, high availability, and operational risk reduction.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation concepts using PowerShell, Python, Bash, API integrations, workflow automation, or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts.
* Experience leading transformation efforts that modernize command center operations, reduce toil, improve service health visibility, or improve incident response maturity.


 SOME OF THE SOFT SKILLS / ABILITIES REQUIRED FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE INCLUDE
   

  

* Calm, composed leadership during high\-pressure, business\-impacting incidents.
* Clear, concise, and audience\-appropriate communication for executives, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to command and control incident bridges while maintaining accountability, urgency, and respectful collaboration.

title: Equity Swaps Corporate Actions (Prime Services)-Manager
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
 We are seeking an experienced Officer‑level professional for our Equity Swaps Corporate Actions team, responsible for overseeing and executing day‑to‑day BAU processing for Equity Swaps in line with the operating model, internal SLAs, and control frameworks.
   

  

 The role sits within State Street Markets Operations’ Financing Solutions business, supporting the Prime Services Equity Swaps product. The Officer will act as a key point of escalation and subject matter expert, partnering closely with Trading, Swap Operations, Stock Loan, Custody, and Risk teams to manage mandatory and voluntary events, restrictions, and lifecycle processing in a controlled, audit‑ready environment. Corporate actions on equity swaps represent a high‑risk, high‑complexity operational area where errors can directly impact P\&L, client outcomes, and regulatory posture. As an Officer, this role plays a critical part in safeguarding economic neutrality, ensuring accurate processing outcomes, and reinforcing a strong control and escalation framework across synthetic and hedge books.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets which is transforming our operating model that provides support to sales and trading desks across all regions EMEA, APAC and North America 24/6\. Since synthetic market access is growing globally, Prime Services are expanding their product offering to include Equity Swaps. Clients take advantage of a range of financing solutions, from memo\-pledge and self\-financing to self\-borrow and repledge. Our Secured financing solution offers accessibility to cash investment and financing outlets for a wide range of institutional participants. State Street is one of the largest agent’s lenders in the world, with over 40 years of experience and more than 250clients across multiple global markets. Our depth of lendable assets and strong market position provides more trading opportunities When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSGM business unit. Join us to make your mark in the capital markets industry.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For****
 As Equity Swaps Corporate Actions (Prime Services)\-Manager, you will:
   

  

* Oversee and perform processing of mandatory and voluntary corporate actions and dividend events impacting Equity Swaps portfolios.
* Manage and review event lifecycle activities including event capture, entitlement calculation, election processing, and settlement of cash and stock outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for complex or time‑sensitive voluntary corporate action elections, providing guidance and decision support as required.
* Ensure accurate booking and alignment of corporate action adjustments across swap and custody accounts.
* Review, investigate, and resolve breaks related to positions, entitlements, or cash flows, determining root cause and appropriate remediation.
* Oversee execution of daily, event‑based, and periodic controls, ensuring adherence to documented procedures and control standards.
* Escalate material issues, control gaps, or processing risks in line with governance and escalation frameworks.
* Provide support and guidance to Senior Associates on complex processing, investigations, and control execution.
* Liaise with internal teams including Swap Operations, Trading, Stock Loan, and Custody to resolve issues and manage event impacts.
* Support responses to internal and external queries related to swap‑linked corporate actions and income events.


****What We Value****
* These skills will help you succeed in this role
* Strong technical understanding of corporate actions and asset servicing within an Equity Swaps or Prime Services environment.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment in managing risk, prioritizing issues, and determining when escalation is required.
* Strong reconciliation, investigative, and problem‑solving skills.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure, especially around critical market deadlines.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time‑management skills.


****What You Will Bring To The Role****
* Strong front‑to‑back understanding of Equity Swap Operations processes, lifecycle events, and interactions between synthetic and physical positions.
* Hands‑on experience supporting front‑office exception management, middle‑office systems, and downstream settlement / payment processes.
* Familiarity with systems such as NUVO, TRAIANA, DUCO, or similar platforms is an added advantage.


****Education \& Preferred Qualifications****
* Strong front‑to‑back understanding of Equity Swap Operations processes, lifecycle events, and interactions between synthetic and physical positions.
* 8\-10\+ years of experience in Corporate Actions, Asset Servicing, or Investment
* Hands‑on experience supporting front‑office exception management, middle‑office systems, and downstream settlement / payment processes.
* Experience providing oversight, coaching, or review support to junior team members.
* Familiarity with systems such as NUVO, TRAIANA, DUCO, or similar platforms is an added advantage.


****Additional Requirements****
* Shift Time: NA \- 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM IST OR EMEA \- 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST
* Persona: 4 days’ work from office
* Location: Mumbai


****About State Street****
**What we do** 
 . State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.

You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

description:

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 GCOR Trade Surveillance team monitors firm’s trading activity from a market abuse/market manipulation perspective. Global trade surveillance activities are designed to adhere to financial services laws, rules and regulations to determine whether key controls are operating as intended and are effective in terms of mitigating compliance risk (e.g. compliance policy, standard or procedure). Continuous surveillance of business activities is performed through automated systems (SMARTS, Actimize etc.) and filters. Surveillance is also performed through patterns and trends analysis, and manual reviews.
   

  

 This team in GCOR Trade surveillance will work very closely with the APAC Regional Trade Suverillance teams to conduct surevillance efforts on fixed income and equities
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Individuals will be part of the Trade Surveillance group supporting one of the global regions AMRS, EMEA and APR. Individual will be responsible for monitoring trading activities across multiple asset classes for market abuse and manipulation. The individuals will also be responsible for investigating potential compliance/control room issues with multiple levels of management for appropriate disposition
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Perform trade surveillance on restricted and watch listed securities.
* Obtain deal updates (from Investment Bankers) – when needed for watch list reviews.
* Conduct trade surveillance to monitor market abuse across asset classes (equity, fixed income and derivatives trading).
* Monitor trading activity using various exceptions based reports.
* Liaising with upper management, preparing and presenting monthly reviews to senior management.
* Working closely with the Line of Business (LOB) to understand the process and managing LOB process expectations.
* Managing day to day process requirements.
* Managing employee conflict.
* Conducting employee performance discussions.
* Analyze T\+1 trading data on trade surveillance platforms for potential compliance issues.
* Investigate potential compliance issues with management and document findings.
* Work with the global compliance teams to document findings.
* Analyze and organize data, identifying any trends in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate, organized and current compliance records and documentation in a manner consistent with the department’s needs.
* Participate in the Parameter Review process for the Trade Surveillance models.
* Enables smooth migrations of work to GBS from onshore and maintaining/creating LOB confidence for the GBS team.
* Conducting LOB/GBS Executive presentations, including routine and monthly connects.
* Understand end to end Internal Controls and broader Global Business Services functions to ensure adherence to enterprise standards and reporting requirements.
* Train and set up a strong, fungible /Cross trained pool of resources within the GBS Trade Surveillance team


**Requirements\***
* Education\* Postgraduate in any field. Certifications If Any


**Experience Range\***
* 10\-13 years


**Foundational skills\***
* Experience in capital markets operations with a thorough understanding of trade life cycle and surveillance functions
* Strong capital market knowledge
* Working knowledge of derivative products
* Strong analytical, interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills
* Excel skills and attention to detail
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills
* Experience in working with Surveillance applications like Actimize, SMARTS.
* Ability to work in a high\-energy and dynamic environment.
* Ability to multi\-task, assist in critical items/projects and those that require extensive research, while independently prioritizing his/her workload
* Ability to analyze large sets of data to develop and present executive level reporting
* Experience in operating on a global scale, across multiple functions/regions and with multiple stakeholder


**Work Timings\***

 Other Regions – IST 11\.30 PM/12\.30 PM to 08\.30 PM/09\.30 PM

description:
**Role Summary** 




**Eze Perfumes**

**Marketplace Growth Manager** 

 to join our Mumbai\-based global operations team. Your primary mission is to own the P\&L and scale our brand presence across major
 
**US marketplaces**

**Amazon (FBA)**

**Walmart (WFS)** 

 .
 





 This role requires a unique individual who can sit in Mumbai but think like a US consumer. You will be responsible for the entire marketplace lifecycle—from strategic inventory planning and cross\-border logistics to high\-performance PPC advertising and AI\-driven listing optimization. You will act as the "CEO" of our US marketplace channels, ensuring Sawai’s heritage\-rich fragrances become a household name in the North American market.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Strategy \& P\&L Ownership** 



* **Revenue Accountability:** 

 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for US marketplaces, including top\-line revenue, contribution margins, and platform\-specific fees.
* **GTM Execution:** 

 Develop and execute the Go\-To\-Market strategy for new product launches in the US, ensuring optimal pricing, positioning, and initial review velocity.
* **Growth Roadmaps:** 

 Build monthly and quarterly growth plans that balance aggressive customer acquisition with sustainable profitability.



**2\. Amazon \& Walmart Channel Mastery** 



* **Listing Excellence:** 

 Own the creation and optimization of SEO\-rich product listings, including titles, bullet points, and backend keywords tailored specifically to US search intent.
* **A\+ Content \& Storefronts:** 

 Work with the content team to ensure Amazon A\+ content and Brand Stores reflect a premium, luxury fragrance aesthetic.
* **Account Health:** 

 Monitor and maintain "Gold Standard" account health metrics, managing IPI scores, buyer\-seller messaging, and compliance with platform policies.



**3\. High\-Performance Advertising (PPC)** 



* **Campaign Management:** 

 Direct and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display ads to maintain a target ACOS/TACOS.
* **Competitor Conquesting:** 

 Implement aggressive keyword\-bidding strategies to capture market share from competitors in the premium fragrance and essential oil categories.
* **DSP \& External Traffic:** 

 Explore and manage Amazon DSP or external traffic drivers (Social to Amazon) to boost ranking and BSR.



**4\. Cross\-Border Logistics \& Inventory Planning** 



* **Demand Forecasting:** 

 Coordinate with the Mumbai and Silvassa teams to forecast US demand, ensuring stock is manufactured and shipped in time to avoid stockouts.
* **FBA/WFS Management:** 

 Manage shipments from India to US 3PLs or Amazon/Walmart fulfilment centers.
* **Efficiency:** 

 Optimize "Inventory Age" and minimize storage fees through strategic liquidation or promotional pulses.



**5\. AI\-Driven Operations** 



* **Automation:** 

 Implement AI tools for automated keyword research, sentiment analysis of customer reviews, and competitive price monitoring.
* **Content Scaling:** 

 Use LLMs to rapidly iterate on ad copy, A/B test listing titles, and automate routine reporting tasks.
* **Sentiment Analysis:** 

 Leverage AI to decode "Voice of Customer" data from reviews to inform the R\&D team in India for future product iterations.



**Technical Proficiencies \& Tools** 



* **Marketplace Core:** 

 Amazon Seller Central and Ads (Expert), Walmart Seller Center, eBay.
* **Analytics \& Research:** 

 Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Viral Launch.
* **Advertising Tech:** 

 Amazon Advertising Console, Pacvue, or Perpetua.
* **AI Stack:** 

 ChatGPT/Claude (for SEO \& Copy), Midjourney (for creative ideation), and Excel/Google Sheets (Advanced formulas \& Pivot Tables).
* **Operations:** 

 Experience with ERPs and cross\-border shipping documentation (ShipStation, etc.).



**Core Strengths** 



* **The "Global\-Local" Mindset:** 

 Ability to translate Indian manufacturing excellence into a brand voice that resonates with US luxury buyers.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 

 You don’t make guesses; you make data\-backed decisions based on click\-through rates, conversion rates, and session data.
* **Agility:** 

 The US marketplace landscape changes weekly (algorithm updates, fee changes); you must be able to pivot strategy instantly.



**The Ideal Fit** 



* You have a proven track record of managing a $1M\+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) portfolio on Amazon US.
* You are comfortable working hours that overlap with the US East Coast/West Coast to coordinate with partners and monitor live sales events (e.g., Prime Day).
* You have a passion for the fragrance/beauty industry and understand the nuances of selling "scent" through a digital screen.



**How to Apply** 





 If you are ready to take a heritage Indian brand to the global stage, send your resume and a summary of your biggest marketplace "win" to
 
**hr@incredibleindriya.com** 

 .
 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate the intersection of Indian craftsmanship and global digital commerce.

description:
**Roquette** 
 is a family\-owned global leader in plant\-based ingredients and a leading provider of pharmaceutical excipients.
   

  

**Want to help us make a difference?**
 Using plant\-based resources, we collaborate with our customers and partners to imagine and offer ingredients to better feed people and treat patients.
   

  

 Each of our ingredients responds to unique and essential needs, and they enable healthier lifestyles.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Team Leader – Food Application Scientist** 
 to lead our India Application (CTS) Laboratory and drive technical innovation across Savory, Baking, Dairy, Beverage, Confectionery, and Plant\-Based applications. This role combines strong people leadership with hands\-on application development, customer engagement, and cross\-functional collaboration to support business growth and innovation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a seasoned food scientist with deep technical expertise, strong commercial acumen, and proven experience leading high\-performing teams in an international food ingredients environment.
   

  

 This position will be located in
 **Mumbai.**
**Our Team**
 Drawing insights from customer interactions, our CTS team develops, formulates, and evaluates our customers' products in the labs.
   

  

 As the markets we serve at Roquette are Global, the CTS teams are globally based to better serve our customers around 4 areas (Europe, Americas, Greater Asia \& China).
   

  

 The CTS team builds strong partnerships with our Global R\&D, as well as our commercial and marketing teams, to enhance customer service and support.
   

  

**Their mission?**
 To support the NBI’s business growth for Greater Asia region focusing on India with application work in the Dairy, Beverage and Confectionery Area. In addition to that, to support the technical development role India for local customers and channel partners.
   

  

**Your Experience And Talents Will Make The Difference To**
**Team Leadership \& Application Excellence**
* Lead and develop the India Food Application (CTS) team, fostering a high\-performance and collaborative culture.
* Ensure timely and effective technical support for customer projects involving both new product development and existing ingredient portfolios.
* Prioritize application projects in partnership with Commercial and Marketing teams to support strategic business objectives.
* Coach and mentor team members, supporting their technical and professional development.
* Promote a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and scientific excellence.


**Customer \& Technical Support**
* Provide expert application support to customers across Dairy, Beverage, Confectionery, Savory, Baking and Plant\-Based Nutrition segments.
* Visit customers regularly to support product development, technical discussions, troubleshooting, training programs, and innovation workshops.
* Collaborate with channel partners on customer visits, product concepts, technical training, promotional campaigns, and business opportunity development.
* Deliver technical presentations, seminars, and application training for internal and external stakeholders.
* Together with Marketing team, coordinate, plan and execute promotional events like trade shows, customer seminars and webinars.


**Product Development \& Innovation**
* Provide strategic technical leadership in identifying, evaluating, and translating new ingredient technologies into commercially viable food applications for the Indian market. Develop innovation roadmaps and recommend product development strategies based on market insights, customer needs, competitive analysis, and technical feasibility.
* Lead the development and evaluation of innovative food and beverage applications, including:
+ Savory – sauces, dressing, meat, non\-meat
+ Baking – snacks, cereals, cakes etc
+ Dairy products
+ Plant\-based alternatives
+ Specialized nutrition
+ Ready\-to\-drink beverages
+ Ready\-to\-mix powders
+ Yogurt
+ Paneer
+ Confectionery applications

* Design, execute, and evaluate laboratory and pilot\-scale trials using a scientific approach.
* Conduct shelf\-life studies, analytical testing, and performance evaluations of application prototypes.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of laboratory activities, trial results, reports, and technical presentations while supporting innovation and intellectual property initiatives.


**Laboratory Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure laboratory operations comply with company safety, food safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve laboratory SOPs, processes, and best practices.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and support efficient day\-to\-day laboratory operations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance laboratory efficiency and effectiveness.


**Collaboration \& Global Connectivity**
* Partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Quality, R\&D, and Global Food CTS teams to deliver customer\-focused solutions.
* Collaborate with global CTS teams to share technical knowledge, best practices, and support cross\-regional projects.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and market trends through participation in technical forums and industry events.


**Additional Key Responsibilities – Laboratory Setup \& Infrastructure Management**
* Lead the planning, setup, expansion, and continuous enhancement of food application laboratories in line with business and innovation requirements.
* Define laboratory infrastructure requirements, including utilities, workflow design, food safety, hygiene, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate, recommend, and procure laboratory and pilot\-scale equipment based on application needs, technical specifications, budget, and long\-term business objectives.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Procurement, EHS, and Quality teams during laboratory design, commissioning, equipment installation, qualification, and validation.
* Develop equipment qualification, calibration, preventive maintenance, and lifecycle management plans to ensure reliable laboratory operations.
* Ensure laboratory facilities comply with food safety, regulatory, and company standards while driving continuous improvement in laboratory capabilities.


**What We Will Love About You**
* Strong business and commercial acumen with a customer\-centric mindset.
* Deep understanding of the Indian food ingredients and food applications market.
* Excellent technical knowledge of Savory, Baking, Dairy and Beverage applications.
* Strong influencing, stakeholder management, and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Outstanding presentation, communication, and technical training skills.
* Proven leadership capability with experience mentoring, coaching, and developing technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with experience working in multicultural and cross\-functional teams.
* Passion for innovation and delivering customer\-focused solutions.


 And also …
   

  

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of experience in Food Application, Product Development, or Technical Service within the food ingredients industry.
* At least 10 years of hands\-on experience in Savory, Baking Dairy and Beverage applications.
* Experience in Plant\-Based Nutrition and Specialized Nutrition is highly desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of people management experience, leading technical or application teams.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects within a multinational or international organization.
* Demonstrated customer engagement, technical problem\-solving, and innovation capabilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across cultures.


**Why Join Us?**
 This is an opportunity to lead a high\-impact technical team, shape customer innovation, and contribute to the development of next\-generation food solutions while collaborating with global experts in a dynamic international environment.
   

  

**If you identify yourself in this position, please apply by uploading your resume and let's start the journey together!**
 Roquette is proud to be a global company where you can find personal and professional growth through multiple diverse experiences.
   

  

 Roquette strives to create a dynamic workforce while remaining firmly committed to equal opportunity by complying with EEO laws.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, Roquette understands that to be successful we must always be inclusive in our approach.
   

  

 To find out more about our products, values and sustainable development ambitions visit us at www.roquette.com and at www.sustainability.roquette.com

title: Independent Director
description:
More choice can disguise duplication, poor differentiation and trapped working capital. The Director will challenge the architecture of categories, opening price points, premium ladders, private labels and seasonal ranges. Management should demonstrate which customer missions each range serves, how products earn space online and in stores, and when a slow\-moving item will be marked down, returned, repurposed or exited.
 



  





 Board reporting must connect assortment breadth with availability, margin, inventory age, fulfilment complexity and customer satisfaction. Revenue growth that depends on proliferating low\-productivity stock\-keeping units should be recognised early.
 



  





 Items used for cooking, storage and household organisation can create safety, durability and disclosure obligations. The Director will examine supplier qualification, material declarations, product testing, labelling, complaint investigation, batch traceability and recall readiness. Private\-label ambition must be matched by clear ownership of specification and quality—not delegated informally to the supplier.
 



  





 When an adverse signal appears, the Board needs a decision process that protects customers before legal certainty is complete. The appointee will ask whether marketplace sellers, imported ranges and exclusive products are governed to comparable standards.
 



  





 The Director will help the Board look beyond gross billing to realised margin after discount, funding, payment cost, fulfilment, returns, damage, loyalty benefits and clearance. Supplier rebates and promotional support should be recognised only when the underlying conditions are evidenced. Channel teams must not shift inventory or cost between stores, digital operations and marketplaces to make one route appear successful.
 



  





 The Board will expect the appointee to probe price integrity, personalised offers, dark patterns, misleading scarcity messages and the fairness of refund or exchange practices.
 



  





 An omnichannel promise depends on accurate location\-level stock, dependable reservation and a rational fulfilment decision. The Director will oversee management’s response to phantom inventory, cancelled orders, split shipments, store\-pick failures, shrinkage and reverse\-logistics leakage. Investment proposals for automation, distribution capacity or new stores should be tested against demand density and the full cost to serve.
 



  





 The appointee will insist on decision\-ready store economics: mature versus ramp\-up performance, occupancy burden, local catchment, cannibalisation, labour productivity, omnichannel contribution and exit costs. Lease commitments need downside cases and explicit approval limits. A flagship’s strategic value may be real, but it must be articulated and reviewed rather than used indefinitely to excuse poor economics.
 



  





 Loyalty and personalisation can improve relevance, but they also create privacy, consent and security duties. The Director will question what data is collected, why it is retained, how models shape offers, and whether customers can exercise meaningful choice. Technology partners, payment providers, delivery networks and marketplace channels should be subject to risk\-based oversight and incident responsibilities that are understood before failure.
 



  





**The Board contribution beyond oversight** 




  





 The new Director will participate in annual strategy, capital\-allocation and leadership reviews. They should help management balance store expansion, digital capability, supply\-chain resilience, private\-label development and brand investment. The Board wants independent thinking on customer proposition and disciplined experimentation: pilots need hypotheses, decision dates and stopping rules.
 



  





 The appointee may serve on audit, risk, stakeholder or nomination and remuneration committees. They will support succession planning for merchandising, operations, technology and supply\-chain leadership; review incentives for unintended behaviours; and seek direct assurance where management information does not reconcile with customer or employee experience.
 



  





**The person sought** 




  





 The mandate suits a former chief executive, chief operating officer, commercial leader, supply\-chain leader, finance leader or digital\-retail executive who has governed a multi\-category consumer business.
 



  





 Experience with sourcing, private labels, inventory, store economics, e\-commerce or consumer protection is strongly relevant. The candidate must be comfortable moving from a customer complaint to its systemic operational and financial implications.
 



  





 Independence, curiosity and willingness to visit operations are essential. Applicants must hold active IICA Independent Directors Databank registration and disclose current interests involving suppliers, marketplaces, landlords, logistics providers, payment companies or competing retailers.

* Self\-motivated and able to operate independently, proactively seeking clarity in ambiguous situations
* Highly adaptable and able to pivot quickly in response to changing priorities
* Analytical thinker with proven history of surfacing actionable insights to inform prioritization of process and data improvements across systems and enhancement requests

* Familiar with Agile, Scrum or other iterative product management style

description:

 4–6 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Function:** 
 Operations / Transformation
 



**Organisation:** 
 Havas Life Mumbai
 



  





**About Havas Life Mumbai** 




 At Havas Life Mumbai, we believe meaningful ideas have the power to improve lives. As part of the global Havas Health Network, we partner with leading pharmaceutical, healthcare, wellness, and consumer health brands to create award\-winning campaigns that educate, inspire, and drive real impact. From brand strategy and integrated campaigns to digital experiences, content, and medical communications, our work combines creativity with science to solve complex healthcare challenges.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **AI Lead** 
 who can drive the next phase of
 **AI\-led transformation** 
 at Havas Life Mumbai.
 



 This role is about identifying how AI can fundamentally improve the way we work from
 **process redesign and automation to productivity, cost optimisation and smarter program management** 
 . You will work across functions to identify opportunities, evaluate emerging AI solutions and take initiatives from idea to implementation and measurable business impact – by aligning to the global Havas vision and mission and AI Transformation framework.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Identify operational and process inefficiencies across functions and develop AI\-led solutions to improve productivity, quality, speed and scalability.
* Lead AI transformation programs end\-to\-end from opportunity identification and business case development to implementation, adoption and impact measurement.
* Evaluate and experiment with Generative AI, AI agents, automation platforms, LLM\-based tools and emerging AI technologies to identify practical business applications.
* Liaise with Global AI teams and implement mandates to local.
* Partner with Creative, Strategy, Medical, Client Servicing, Operations, HR, Finance and other teams to redesign workflows and implement AI\-enabled processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, resource optimisation and cost reduction, and build measurable ROI cases for transformation initiatives.
* Manage multiple cross\-functional programs, including timelines, stakeholders, dependencies, milestones, and success metrics.
* Establish scalable AI\-enabled workflows, frameworks, and operating models that can be adopted across teams.
* Track and communicate productivity gains, cost efficiencies, adoption and business impact of AI initiatives to leadership.
* Drive AI adoption and change management through workshops, training, and continuous enablement.
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape, identifying tools and technologies that can create meaningful competitive and operational advantages for the organisation.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 4–8 years of experience in AI transformation, digital/business transformation, automation, consulting, operations excellence, program management, innovation, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, workflow automation and emerging AI tools/platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business problems into practical technology and AI solutions.
* Strong program management and stakeholder management skills, with experience driving cross\-functional initiatives.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify and quantify productivity, efficiency, and cost\-saving opportunities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and presentation skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where experimentation, learning, and implementation are equally important.

title: Sr Operation Manager Wedding
description:
**Role: Wedding Operations Manager** 




**Company:** 
 Benchmark Marcom Pvt Ltd
 



**Location:** 
 Pune (with extensive travel as required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 







  





**Role Overview** 




 This role is the backbone of execution.
 



 As the Wedding Operations Manager, you are responsible for translating plans and designs into flawless on\-ground reality. You own logistics, timelines, vendor coordination, manpower, and problem\-solving across all wedding events.
 



 This is not a desk role. It requires presence, decisiveness, and the ability to stay composed while managing complexity, scale, and pressure.
 



 You are the person who ensures that what was promised is delivered—quietly, efficiently, and without drama.
 







  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Event Operations \& Execution** 



* Own end\-to\-end operational planning for all wedding events
* Create detailed event\-wise execution timelines and run\-of\-show documents
* Ensure smooth setup, transitions, and breakdowns across events
* Anticipate operational risks and plan contingencies in advance



**2\. Vendor \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate with all vendors: decor, production, lighting, sound, hospitality, logistics, security, artists, and venues
* Share clear timelines, layouts, and expectations with each vendor
* Monitor vendor performance and adherence to timelines and scope
* Handle on\-ground negotiations, issue resolution, and last\-minute adjustments



**3\. Team \& Manpower Management** 



* Plan and deploy on\-ground teams effectively
* Assign clear roles and responsibilities to coordinators and staff
* Ensure team discipline, punctuality, and alignment
* Act as the central command point during events



**4\. Budget \& Resource Control** 



* Ensure execution stays aligned with approved budgets
* Track scope changes and flag cost implications early
* Minimise wastage through smart planning and reuse
* Coordinate with planning and accounts teams on reconciliations



**5\. Client \& Internal Coordination** 



* Work closely with Client Service, Planning, and Design teams
* Ensure client\-approved plans are executed accurately
* Shield clients from operational stress during events
* Communicate calmly and clearly during high\-pressure moments



**6\. On\-Ground Crisis Management** 



* Handle unexpected issues decisively (weather, delays, vendor failures, guest\-related challenges)
* Make quick, practical decisions without escalating panic
* Maintain control and clarity in chaotic situations







  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 4\-6 years of experience in wedding operations, large\-scale events, or hospitality operations
* Strong understanding of Indian weddings and multi\-day event formats
* Proven ability to manage large teams and multiple vendors
* Excellent logistical and organisational skills
* Comfort working long hours during event periods



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with destination weddings
* Exposure to luxury or high\-end events
* Understanding of production, staging, and technical setups
* Ability to read layouts, drawings, and spatial plans







  





**Skills \& Traits We Value** 



* Calm under pressure
* Decisive and solution\-oriented
* Highly organised
* Strong leadership presence
* Clear communicator
* Physically and mentally resilient







  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* Events run on time with minimal visible stress
* Vendors perform efficiently and responsibly
* Clients experience smooth, confident execution
* Issues are resolved before they escalate
* Planning and design intent is protected on ground







  





**Working Style \& Culture Fit** 



* This is a high\-ownership role
* Requires authority, accountability, and maturity
* Not reactive firefighting; structured operations are expected
* You will be trusted to make decisions independently







  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive fixed salary based on experience
* Performance\-linked incentives per project
* Growth opportunity into Head of Operations roles

 Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!

* Manage end\-to\-end operations of vending machines across assigned client locations.

 **Senior Manager \- Operational Procurement \& SCM** 
 . The role ensures that approved demand is converted into purchase orders, supplier commitments are effectively managed, and materials are delivered on time to support production, project, and customer requirements globally.  Power without pause. Heating, cooling and oil\-free air without end. We keep our customers’ worlds on. From world\-class events that last a few weeks to mining operations and remote communities who rely on us for decades.

**You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Logistics, or a related discipline.
* MBA or post\-graduate qualification preferred.
* \>15 years of experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Materials Management.
* Minimum 5 years leading Operational Procurement or Supply Chain teams in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong experience in Import \& Export operations, logistics management, and supplier delivery management.
* Experience supporting global procurement operations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or equivalent.


**What You’ll Get**
* A full\-time role based in Pune.
* Competitive Compensation \& Benefits
* Dynamic \& Supportive Work Environment: Thrive in an innovative and forward\-thinking culture that values your expertise and will foster professional growth.
* Accelerate your career with dedicated pathways for advancement, access to specialised training programs and ample opportunities for skill enhancement.

title: Senior GIS Migration Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.
   

  

 TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Data Migration Lead will oversee and execute the migration of geospatial data from legacy systems such as GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri's Utility Network (UN). This role requires expertise in Esri technologies, Utility Network configuration, and data transformation tools like FME. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in utilities (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and experience managing complex data migration projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end data migration projects from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri Utility Network.
* Analyze legacy data models and design migration strategies to align with Esri Utility Network schema and best practices.
* Configure and implement Esri Utility Network models, including network rules, topologies, and asset configurations.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) workflows using FME and Python (ArcPy).
* Perform data quality assessments and validations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness during migration.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration objectives, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data compatibility, schema mapping, and network topology during migration.
* Optimize migration processes for performance and scalability, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
* Document migration workflows, methodologies, and lessons learned for future reference.
* Provide training and support to teams on Esri Utility Network and post\-migration processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in GIS, with at least 4\-6 years in data migration projects.
* Strong expertise in Esri technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and Utility Network.
* Hands\-on experience with data migration from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri platforms.
* Proficiency in FME (Feature Manipulation Engine) for data transformation and automation.
* Advanced Python scripting skills (ArcPy) for geoprocessing and data migration tasks.
* In\-depth knowledge of utility network models (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and their operational workflows.
* Experience with spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills to manage cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Esri Utility Network configuration, including network rules, subnetwork management, and tracing.
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of GE Smallworld data structures and migration challenges.
* Experience with large\-scale enterprise GIS implementations and integrations.
* Certification in Esri technologies or FME is a plus.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

 The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.
   

  

 TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

 .

 .

 **gross margin and contribution margin** 
 .

 5\. Commercial \& Working Capital Management

 **working capital blocked in inventory** 
 .

* Identify opportunities to convert dormant inventory into cash.

 6\. Process \& Control

 .

description:
**Company Description** 
 Sentinels Security Pvt Ltd is a security services provider with experience across retail, corporate offices, agencies, and diverse service industries, giving the company deep insight into client needs and risk environments. The organization offers a broad range of services, including uniformed security personnel, periodic security checks and audits of premises, and event security management. Sentinels also provides fire control measures, handling of firefighting equipment, and support for emergency evacuation drills to enhance safety and compliance. Additional specialized services include VIP protection, investigations, and surveillance solutions, making Sentinels a comprehensive partner for security and risk management.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior Manager – Technology will lead the technology backbone that supports the organisation's manpower security services operations across all client sites. This includes computer hardware and software, networking infrastructure, CCTV and video surveillance, access control systems, and AI\-driven solutions used for guard force monitoring, incident detection, and operational efficiency. The role leads a team of 10 qualified support professionals and is accountable for system uptime, security systems reliability, budget management, vendor relationships, and the technology roadmap that enables reliable, technology\-augmented security service delivery to clients.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



  





**Security Systems \& Client Site Infrastructure** 



* Oversee design, deployment, and maintenance of CCTV and video surveillance systems across all client sites and the central command/monitoring centre
* Manage access control systems (biometric/RFID) deployed at client premises, including integration with guard attendance and visitor management systems
* Ensure video management software (VMS), NVR/DVR infrastructure, and storage/retention policies meet client SLAs and statutory requirements
* Act as the technical point of escalation for client\-facing security technology issues and site audits
* Support pre\-sales and client onboarding with technology scoping for new security contracts (camera counts, access points, connectivity requirements)



  





**IT Infrastructure \& Command Centre Operations** 



* Manage enterprise networking across the head office, branch offices, and client site connectivity (LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls, redundancy/failover)
* Own hardware and software lifecycle management — procurement, deployment, licensing, patching, and AMC renewals
* Ensure high availability of the central monitoring/command centre systems used for real\-time guard and site supervision
* Maintain cybersecurity hygiene across IT and connected security\-systems networks (physical–digital security convergence)



  





**AI \& Technology\-Enabled Security Solutions** 



* Evaluate and implement AI\-based video analytics (intrusion detection, loitering/perimeter alerts, facial recognition, PPE/uniform compliance) to strengthen guard force effectiveness
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled tools for guard tour management, incident reporting, and real\-time dashboards for clients
* Partner with technology vendors/consultants to pilot and scale AI solutions, assessing ROI and client value
* Champion digital transformation initiatives that differentiate the organisation's manpower security offering



  





**Team \& People Management** 



* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 10 across networking, CCTV/access control, IT support, and AI/systems functions
* Own hiring, performance reviews, training, and succession planning for the technology team
* Set and monitor team KPIs/SLAs for site uptime, incident response time, and resolution turnaround
* Coordinate with Operations, Client Servicing, and HR teams to align technology support with guard deployment schedules



  





**Budget, Vendor \& Governance** 



* Own the annual technology budget, including AMC renewals, licensing, and capex for new client site rollouts
* Negotiate and manage vendor/OEM contracts for networking, CCTV, access control, and AI platforms
* Act as the single point of accountability during client audits, security incidents, or system failures at any site
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, and audit\-readiness (ISO 27001 exposure preferred, given client data and surveillance footage handling)
* Ensure compliance with data privacy and surveillance regulations applicable to client sites and jurisdictions served



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 Education:
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or a related field (mandatory)
* MBA or MTech preferred



  





 Experience:
 


* 10–15\+ years in IT/technical roles, including 4–5\+ years in a managerial capacity
* Proven experience managing a team of 8–15\+ technical staff
* Demonstrated ownership of an IT/technical budget
* Experience managing vendor/AMC contracts at scale
* Experience deploying and managing CCTV, access control, and networking systems across multiple/distributed sites — security services, facilities management, or similar multi\-site industry background strongly preferred
* Exposure to guard force / command\-centre monitoring technology is a strong advantage



  





 Technical Knowledge:
 


* Enterprise networking (routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, VLAN) across distributed/multi\-site environments
* Server/OS administration and hardware lifecycle management
* CCTV/VMS systems at scale, with storage/retention and multi\-site monitoring experience
* Access control systems and integration with attendance/visitor management platforms
* Working knowledge of AI/ML tools relevant to security — video analytics, automation, predictive alerts
* Cybersecurity fundamentals, particularly around physical security system networks



  





**Key Competencies:** 



* Strategic thinking with hands\-on technical credibility
* Strong stakeholder management across Operations, Client Servicing, Finance, HR, and Compliance
* Crisis and incident management, including client\-facing escalations
* Change management for new system and AI rollouts across distributed sites
* Vendor negotiation and contract management
* Client\-centric mindset \- understanding that technology directly supports service delivery and contract retention.
